m: Motie-Aasted-Madsen-van Stiphout c.s. over vrijmaken van budget voor de kinderombudsman
Asks that funds be freed within the National Ombudsman budget to establish and sustain the children's ombudsman, with the youth team absorbed into its staffing.

Amendment limiting supervision of new schools at the start to the basic conditions for education in the first paragraph of the article, removing the words 'in ieder geval'.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Vlies ter vervanging van nr. 13 over het bij algemene maatregel van bestuur kunnen verbieden van soorten aanbiedingen

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Vlies ter vervanging van nr. 11 over een landelijk verbod op stuntprijzen
Proposes a national ban on alcohol sold below 70% of the usual shelf price at the same outlet, to protect public health.
To protect public health it is prohibited to offer alcoholic drinks commercially for consumption elsewhere at a price below 70% of the usual price

Het is ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid verboden bedrijfsmatig of anders dan om niet alcoholhoudende drank aan te bieden voor gebruik elders dan ter plaatse tegen een prijs die lager is dan 70% van de prijs

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Vlies ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 16 over het garanderen op het niveau van de eindtoetsen en eindexamens van de verankering van de referenti

Removes the requirement that the Inspectie checks whether the teaching process fits the reference-level framework, leaving core objectives as the only benchmark, and anchors reference levels in final tests and exams.
It is no longer necessary, nor desirable, for the Inspectorate to check whether the teaching process is compatible with the extensive reference framework.
Het is niet meer nodig, noch wenselijk dat de Inspectie toetst of het onderwijsproces verenigbaar is met het omvangrijke referentiekader.

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Vlies ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 9 over het garanderen op het niveau van de eindtoetsen en eindexamens van de verankering van de referentieniveau
Removes the inspectorate's role in checking whether teaching processes align with the reference levels framework, relying instead on final tests and exams and core objectives.
It is no longer necessary, nor desirable, for the Inspectorate to check whether the teaching process is compatible with the extensive reference framework.
Het is niet meer nodig, noch wenselijk dat de Inspectie toetst of het onderwijsproces verenigbaar is met het omvangrijke referentiekader.
Amendement van het lid Van der Vlies over het garanderen op het niveau van de eindtoetsen en eindexamens van de verankering van de referentieniveaus voor alle sectoren

Deletes statutory requirements that inspectorate and examination-related rules apply the language and arithmetic reference levels, leaving anchoring to final tests and exams and removing inspection of teaching processes.
It is no longer necessary, nor desirable, for the Inspectorate to check whether the teaching process is compatible with the extensive reference framework.
Het is niet meer nodig, noch wenselijk dat de Inspectie toetst of het onderwijsproces verenigbaar is met het omvangrijke referentiekader.
Amendement van het lid Van der Vlies ter vervanging van dat gedrukt onder nr. 7
Deletes the articles that let the government prescribe diagnostic tests in schools, leaving the didactic freedom of schools untouched.
The government therefore cannot now prescribe diagnostic tests.
De regering kan daarom nu geen diagnostische toetsen voorschrijven.

Amendment deletes provisions letting the government later intervene by general administrative order in schools' didactic freedom.
It is remarkable that the government wants to reserve the possibility to later intervene in the didactic freedom of schools.
Het is merkwaardig dat de regering zich de mogelijkheid wil voorbehouden te zijner tijd wel in de didactische vrijheid van scholen in te grijpen.

that students must hold a master's certificate within two years

the age limit used for selling alcoholic drinks should not be a choice option for municipalities, but general policy

qa: Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over opvang in (pleeg)gezinnen van jonge alleenstaande moeders en hun kind (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

An SGP MP asked ministers about placing young single mothers and their children in foster or host families, the financing and referral process via youth care bureaus, a unified indication, the abortion guideline, a single information point, and funding for teen-mother shelters. The ministers answered that host families are informal care outside indicated youth care, that separate indications for mother and child are workable, that the abortion guideline is due in 2012, and that shelter funding will be decided in the forthcoming cabinet position on the sector study.
It is up to the provinces and metropolitan regions to make arrangements with foster care providers on how the financing of help to young mothers with their child takes shape in practice.
Het is aan de provincies en grootstedelijke regio’s om met de pleegzorgaanbieders afspraken te maken over hoe de financiering van hulp aan jonge moeders met hun kind in de praktijk vorm krijgt.

Vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Van der Vlies (beiden SGP) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de gereserveerde middelen voor palliatieve zorgprojecten (ingezonden 2 juni 2010).

Two SGP MPs asked the health minister why funds earmarked for palliative care projects were frozen under a departmental commitment pause, now extended to 1 August 2010, and whether stalled follow-up projects could be funded retroactively. The minister confirmed the extension due to a possible budget overrun, said the pause applies regardless of the palliative care dossier not being declared controversial, and promised to resume processing of subsidy requests once the pause is lifted.
Until 1 August 2010 it will be examined which measures can be taken to prevent a budget overrun.
Tot 1 augustus 2010 wordt bekeken met welke maatregelen een overschrijding op de begroting voorkomen kan worden.

Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de uitgestelde versoepeling van het maatregelenpakket inzake Q-koorts (ingezo

An MP asked whether the agreed easing of the Q-fever measures would take effect in full once all dairy goat and sheep farms were vaccinated, and why easing for sheep farms was postponed although they appear fully vaccinated. The ministers answered that easing requires full vaccination of all dairy goat and sheep farms and no expert signals to reconsider, and that they will inform parliament in June; they decided to ease only once both sectors are fully vaccinated.

Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en voor Jeugd en Gezin over het aantal alcoholintoxicaties bij jongeren in de periode 2007 tot en met 2009 (ingezonden 22 apri

MP Van der Vlies asked the ministers about the rise in alcohol intoxications among young people between 2007 and 2009, including the 48% increase in 2009, school prevention programmes, aftercare and hospital registration. Minister Klink answered that the rise is worrying, partly explained by better registration and alcohol affordability, that schools have adequate programmes, that a hospital aftercare pilot is running with an interim evaluation due in June, and that registration coverage is sufficient.
We find it worrying that the number of alcohol intoxications rose from 337 in 2008 to 500 in 2009.
Wij vinden het zorgwekkend dat het aantal alcoholintoxicaties is gestegen van 337 in het jaar 2008 naar 500 in 2009.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Schoolstage: pornofilms bewerken» (ingezonden 20 mei 2010).

MP Van der Vlies asked the minister whether a vocational student's internship involved editing pornographic films, how the internship was ended, whether similar cases are known, and whether the school should have sought another assignment at the same firm. The state secretary confirmed the report, explained that the training firm was asked about the incident and that the student was given a replacement placement, noted that no similar cases are known, and said the recognition body is reviewing the firm.

The knowledge centre has meanwhile contacted the vocational institution and the training firm to assess whether this was a one-off incident or whether there are grounds to withdraw the firm's recognition.

Het kenniscentrum heeft inmiddels over deze kwestie contact opgenomen met de mbo-instelling en het leerbedrijf om te bezien of dit een eenmalig incident was of dat er redenen is om het leerbedrijf de erkenning te ontnemen.
Vragen van het lid Van der Vlies (SGP) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Vette onvoldoende voor onderwijsinspectie» (ingezonden 7 mei 2010).

An SGP MP asked the minister of Education about a newspaper report on poor inspectorate ratings, challenging the independence and robustness of the inspectorate's school-results (opbrengst) methodology, its evaluation, its effect on small schools and on the breadth of curriculum, and legal certainty when results become a funding condition. The minister defended the methodology as grounded in scientific debate, explained the reasons for changing the small-school calculation, and argued that anchoring results assessment in an AMvB and ministerial regulation increases legal certainty.
Furthermore, new testing instruments may come onto the market, for which new norms must be set.
Verder is het zo dat er nieuwe toetsinstrumenten op de markt kunnen komen, waarvoor nieuwe normen moeten worden vastgesteld.
qn: Vragen van de leden Ferrier (CDA), Kraneveldt-van der Veen (PvdA), Anker (ChristenUnie), Van der Vlies (SGP), Dezentjé Hamming-Bluemink (VVD) en Dibi (GroenLinks) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over

MPs Sneller, Van Nispen and Ceder asked about the Dutch transfer-of-sentenced-persons policy and the case of Mr Singh, a detainee in the US with a court-ordered transfer request. The Minister (Staatssecretaris Rutte) defended the binding-requirement policy, said a cassation appeal was lodged, and rejected calls to reform the WOTS framework or move decisions to an independent judge.

An SP MP asks the State Secretary about the shortage of social lawyers, retirements, training incentives in law faculties, lawyer admission requirements, and funding for the social legal profession. The State Secretary answers that a visioning process will report in Q1 2026, that a legislative change is expected in early 2026, that law faculties are not for him to direct, and that the RvR sets a maximum of toevoegingseenheden as a quality instrument.
I will inform your House in the first quarter of 2026 about the outcomes of this process.
Ik zal uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2026 over de uitkomsten van dit traject informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kabinet stuurt vrouwen terug naar Taliban in Afghanistan’

SP MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked how the government opposes Taliban violations of women's rights, whether IND rejects and returns Afghan women using vague criteria, and how the ECJ ruling on gender-based persecution is implemented. The government answers that it raises women's rights in EU and UN fora and in the joint CEDAW state-responsibility case, but that individual asylum cases, including the rejection criteria, are assessed individually and it will not discuss specific cases.
Legally, an individual assessment of every asylum application remains possible.
Juridisch gezien blijft een individuele beoordeling van elke asielaanvraag mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de stand van zaken van de uitvoering van de SP motie om te stoppen met de commerciële noodopvang

Two MPs from the SP ask the minister about progress in ending commercial emergency asylum shelter, as required by two adopted motions, including how many places and parties remain and how costs are developing. The minister says COA is expanding regular shelter places and the number of hotel and boat places rose to about 21,000 by 1 November 2025, costs are not expected to fall this year, and the government is pursuing measures to reduce inflow and speed outflow.
The number of regular COA shelter places is rising steadily, from an expected approximately 40,000 on 1 November 2025 to approximately 51,000 by 1 January 2027.
Het aantal reguliere opvangplekken van het COA stijgt gestaag, naar huidige verwachting van circa 40.000 op 1 november 2025 naar circa 51.000 op 1 januari 2027.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de slachtoffers van persoonsverwisseling door identiteitsfraude en de grote gevolgen voor hun leven en hun behandeling door de overheid

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about victims of mistaken identity caused by identity fraud, including unlawful detention, the 867 cases where names on final judgments are known to be wrong, unclear compensation and redress, the integrity of the criminal justice chain, and whether Justid wrongly corrected judgments. The State Secretary answered that a plan of action, a new review framework, a simpler review procedure and an Auditdienst Rijk evaluation are underway, that some wrongly detained persons have been identified and released, and that Justid's past unauthorised corrections ended in 2017.
For all future reviews, the review and handling framework mentioned in the answer to question 3 will determine in which cases Justid may correct the incorrect name in the systems.

Voor alle toekomstige toetsingen wordt in het, in het antwoord op vraag 3 genoemde, toetsings- en handelingskader bepaald in welke gevallen Justid de foutieve tenaamstelling in de systemen mag corrigeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet publiceren van een kritisch onderzoek naar corruptiebestrijding

An SP MP asks why the ministry did not publish a critical exploratory study on anti-corruption policy, which it allegedly judged as substandard, and questions the ministry's claims about factual errors, missing information and the lack of progress since 2005. The Minister answers that the document is an internal record of interviews rather than a finished report, cites specific alleged inaccuracies and omissions, defends the redactions, and declines to criminalise trading in influence for now while pointing to the forthcoming EU corruption directive.
Although the document, because of its layout and title, looks like a finished report, it is an internal record of conversations held.
Hoewel het document vanwege de aangebrachte opmaak en titel oogt als een afgerond rapport, is het een interne verslaglegging van gevoerde gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat 4 op de 10 mensen met een lichamelijke beperking toegankelijkheidsproblemen ervaart wanneer ze gaan stemmen

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the ministers how they respond to a Zonnebloem survey finding that four in ten people with physical disabilities face accessibility problems when voting, and about checking polling station accessibility. The government acknowledges the problem, describes the Action Plan on accessible voting, notes that 68% of polling stations certified as accessible failed some criteria in the 2024 sample, and lists short- and long-term measures, with the Kiesraad taking over accessibility checks from the 2026 municipal elections.
The Ministry of the Interior subsidises the Stichting Prokkel so that people with a mild intellectual disability can work at a polling station under supervision.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties geeft subsidie aan de Stichting Prokkel om mensen met een licht verstandelijke beperking onder begeleiding te laten meewerken bij een stembureau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, Sneller en Koops over het bericht dat justitiepersoneel bekneld raakt door de doorgeslagen verzuimaanpak van Detentiecentrum Rotterdam

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that a harsh sick-leave policy at Detentiecentrum Rotterdam pressures staff, blocks access to occupational doctors and may breach good employer rules. The State Secretary denied the policy is structural or that absenteeism there is significantly above the DJI average, acknowledged an incidental misapplication, and declined a separate investigation while noting ongoing verzuim monitoring.
However, this does not concern a structural practice or standing policy.
Het gaat hier echter niet om een structurele werkwijze of staand beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de berichten dat op sommige plaatsen in Nederland de aanpak van (ondermijnende) criminaliteit doorgeslagen lijkt

An MP asks the Minister of Justice about reports that the aggressive local approach to undermining crime in Zaanstad and Breda, including home visits and forced entry into garages, bypasses residents' protections, with no information given and damage left unrepaired. The minister replies that home visits must follow statutory safeguards, that residents can object, go to court, contact the ombudsman or claim damages, and that municipalities are responsible for their own approach.
If the conduct of the authorities leads to a dispute with a citizen, that citizen can turn to the court.
Wanneer het handelen van de betrokken overheden leidt tot een geschil met een burger dan kan deze zich wenden tot de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het bericht dat commerciële beunhazen tientallen miljoen verdienen door een tekort aan structurele opvangplekken

SP MPs asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration how intermediary René Derkzen earned 44 million euros in emergency asylum reception contracts, whether the prices were market-conform, and how such commercial emergency reception will be ended. The minister acknowledged prices were too high, terminated the intermediary contract, said COA now contracts hotels directly, and pointed to the ongoing FIOD/Public Prosecution investigation as reason not to comment further on the case.
At this moment, pending the investigation by the FIOD and the Public Prosecution Service, I cannot respond further on substance to this matter.
Ik kan op dit moment, hangende het onderzoek van de FIOD en het Openbaar Ministerie, niet verder inhoudelijk reageren op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat tientallen asielkinderen veel te laat zorg krijgen die zij nodig hebben

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about a report that dozens of asylum children received necessary care too late and about shelter conditions, care access, relocations and proposed multidisciplinary teams. The minister said the underlying study is unknown to the department and COA, that care runs through regular GP and healthcare channels, that relocations are minimised under a care-continuity protocol, and declined to create separate arrangements or funding.
COA also has no access to the medical records, does not know which persons are involved, nor when they were referred or will be referred to necessary follow-up care.
Het COA heeft ook geen toegang tot de medische gegevens, weet niet om welke personen het gaat en wanneer zij verwezen zijn of worden naar benodigde vervolgzorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de oproep van de vakbonden om de nullijn voor rijksambtenaren te schrappen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Interior whether the civil service pay freeze (nullijn) should be dropped to allow open cao negotiations, whether a promised function-grading budget for implementers was honoured, and whether the minister would meet the unions. The minister replied that a meeting with the unions was arranged, that formal negotiations start in November, and that no statements on the government's negotiating position can yet be made.
No statements can yet be made about the upcoming negotiations and the employer Rijk's position.
Over de komende onderhandelingen en de inzet van de werkgever Rijk kunnen op dit moment nog geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraak van de Afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State dat Nederland verplicht is kinderen te horen in de asielprocedures

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the government will respond to a Council of State ruling that unaccompanied children aged 12 to 15 must be given a real chance to be heard in asylum and Dublin procedures, and whether children under 12 and the information given to children will change. The minister agrees children must be able to express their views, says the IND practice will be adjusted to inform children of their right to be heard and to require individual justification for refusals, and says new policy for under-12s is still being developed, so no further statement can yet be made.

Hearings therefore took place with their parents or legal guardian on their behalf, unless the accompanied minor or their parent or legal guardian requested that the minor be heard directly or the IND had good reasons for it.

Het gehoor vond dus plaats met hun ouders of wettelijke vertegenwoordiger mede voor hen, tenzij de begeleide minderjarige of zijn ouder of wettelijke vertegenwoordiger verzochten om de minderjarige rechtstreeks te horen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van Nispen over het (demissionaire) kabinetsstandpunt inzake het initiatiefwetsvoorstel Centraal Aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR)

MPs Van der Lee and Van Nispen asked the government about its position on the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR), including the KPMG report, the UBO register's 25% threshold, and notary and Chamber of Commerce feasibility. The acting government declined to pre-empt parliamentary handling, said it would give its appraisal when the bill is debated, and stated the UBO register and CAHR are complementary.
The cabinet does not anticipate the parliamentary handling of the initiative bill for a central shareholders register (CAHR).
Het kabinet loopt niet vooruit op de behandeling van het initiatiefwetsvoorstel voor een centraal aandeelhoudersregister (CAHR) door uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rolverdeling tussen de ministeries betreffende het onderwijs aan kinderen in de asielopvang

An MP from the SP asked the Ministers of Education and of Asylum and Migration how responsibility for education for children in asylum reception is divided between the ministries, whether the Education Minister can intervene, and how the 3-month access deadline and the school admission timelines are met. The state secretary answered that OCW sets the legal framework, municipalities hold the duty to provide places, COA handles placement and coordination, and the ministries consult regularly, while admitting that the three-month target is not always met and that the Education Minister has no specific powers beyond emergency temporary newcomer facilities, which have been used 16 times.
Due to the persistent shortage of reception places, it is not always possible to place children in locations where educational facilities are available.
Door het aanhoudende tekort aan opvangplekken lukt het niet altijd om kinderen te plaatsen in locaties waar onderwijsvoorzieningen beschikbaar zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het RSJ-advies over het stemrecht van gedetineerden

MPs Van Nispen and Koops asked about the RSJ advice on voting rights for detained persons, noting that practical obstacles cause many votes to be lost and asking what can be improved before the next election. Staatssecretaris Rutte answered that voting by proxy is the statutory route, that DJI will implement several measures including clearer information, proxy forms, a pilot mobile polling station and access to voting aids, and that the RSJ recommendations are adopted where feasible and legally possible.
Where feasible and legally possible, the RSJ recommendations are therefore adopted.
Waar uitvoerbaar en juridisch mogelijk, worden de aanbevelingen van de RSJ daarom overgenomen.
Antwoord op van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Werkenden zitten bijna 9 uur op een dag, gevolgen zijn zorgwekkend’

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about reports that Dutch workers sit about 8.8 hours a day, the health risks, effective ways to change this, and the role of employers and the government. The State Secretary answered that sedentary work is a serious concern, that employers should take a broad approach to encourage movement at work, and that the government supports this through the prevention strategy, the Nederland Beweegt action plan and cooperation with partners.
It is up to the employer to take measures, and up to the employee to actually use the opportunities.
Het is aan de werkgever om maatregelen te nemen, en aan de werknemer om de mogelijkheden ook echt te benutten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het belang van verslavingsartsen en de resultaten van een enquête hierover

SP MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the health minister about a VVGN survey showing addiction doctors want the two-year training extended by one year with interdisciplinary placement, and whether that is needed. The minister acknowledges the signals, will ask the CGS for its view on necessity, and says extension would require NZa recalculation of funding if deemed necessary for starting competence.
That is why I will also ask the College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) of the KNMG to give its view on this necessity in the short term.
Daarom zal ik ook het College Geneeskundige Specialismen (CGS) van de KNMG op korte termijn verzoeken om zijn visie te geven op deze noodzakelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel 'Rijk of arm geen factor bij overleg over asielopvang'

An SP MP asked whether the sociaaleconomische status (SES-WOA score) is ignored in the regional asylum reception talks, despite the Spreidingswet amendment, and what the minister will do. The minister answers that the SES-WOA score was built into the indicative distribution used in the talks and in the distribution decisions, so socioeconomic capacity is already considered, and sees no reason for new guidelines.
Through this score, socioeconomic differences are not ignored in the distribution of asylum reception places.
Middels deze score worden sociaaleconomische verschillen niet genegeerd bij de verdeling van asielopvangplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de misstanden in de penitentiaire inrichtingen en de beloofde verbeteringen ten aanzien van de veiligheid van gedetineerde vrouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about abuse of detained women by prison staff, the handling of complaints and whistleblowers, medical care, and media contacts following the documentary series 'Dubbel Gestraft'. The Minister acknowledged the abuses, listed measures taken by DJI and the Inspectorate, and declined to launch a new large-scale investigation for now.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over misstanden in Jeugdinrichtingen en de gevolgen voor jonge gedetineerden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about abuses in youth detention facilities, including sexual abuse, suicide-risk failures, unanswered parental contact, mishandled complaints and staff-juvenile relationships. The Minister answered that such misconduct is unacceptable, describes existing procedures (incident reports, reporting duty, complaint channels, parental contact), and states that all known abuses were investigated, without committing to new structural measures.
Unlawful use of a position I condemn at all times.
Het onrechtmatig gebruik van een positie keur ik te allen tijde af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Ondernemingsstrafrecht zonder klassenjustitie’

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether out-of-court OM transactions with large companies and banks amount to class justice, since they avoid prosecution and admission of guilt, and whether OM penal orders should replace them. The minister denied that transactions are a buy-off practice, explained the criteria, review committee and publication of high transactions, and agreed penal orders are preferred where suitable.
The First Supplementary Act to the new Code of Criminal Procedure proposes replacing review of high transactions by the independent committee with judicial review.
In de Eerste aanvullingswet bij het nieuwe Wetboek van Strafvordering wordt voorgesteld de toetsing van hoge transacties door de onafhankelijke commissie te vervangen door rechterlijke toetsing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat sportmedium Sport Knowhow XL wordt overgenomen door Golazo Media

MP Van Nispen asks the government about the takeover of sports media outlet Sport Knowhow XL by Golazo Media, which also publishes other sports titles and runs sports events, and the risks to independence and diversity of sports reporting. Minister Bruins replies that the takeover is between private parties, was not notifiable to the ACM, and that other independent media still cover sports policy, without describing concrete steps.
The takeover concerns an agreement between private media parties.
De overname betreft een overeenkomst tussen private mediapartijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel hoe de jacht op ‘verdachte’ inwoners in de armste wijken ontspoort

An MP asked the ministers about an investigative article on an integrated intervention team in Zaandam that allegedly targeted residents of poor neighbourhoods with harsh, discriminatory-sounding tactics, and whether officials felt pressured and unable to report concerns. The government answered that the municipality of Zaanstad is investigating the team's conduct and communication, that discrimination is unacceptable, and that fundamental rights must be safeguarded, but largely defended the area-based approach and left the detailed review to the municipality.
When asked, the municipality of Zaanstad indicated it would further examine the signals from the FTM publication regarding communication and internal working methods for accuracy and background.
Desgevraagd heeft de gemeente Zaanstad aangegeven de signalen uit de publicatie van FTM ten aanzien van de communicatie en de interne werkwijze nader te onderzoeken op juistheid en achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aanstaande Tussenevaluatie Wet herziening partneralimentatie en de nog altijd bestaande ongelijkheid op de arbeidsmarkt tussen vrouwen en mannen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about labour-market inequality between women and men and how the upcoming interim evaluation of the partner maintenance law will assess financial dependence, shorter maintenance periods, the hardship clause and co-parenting. The State Secretary answered that the evaluation will examine economic independence of ex-partners, state costs and use of the hardship clause, due in the third quarter, but declined to pre-judge outcomes or commit to revising the hardship clause.
The interim evaluation is currently in its final phase. I expect to be able to send the interim evaluation to your House in the third quarter.
De tussenevaluatie bevindt zich momenteel in de afrondende fase. Ik verwacht de tussenevaluatie in het derde kwartaal aan uw Kamer te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitvoering van de motie over kinderen in de asielopvang

An SP MP asked the minister how the motion on housing children in suitable asylum locations is being implemented, including reports of unsuitable sites, consultation with municipalities, and what will be done before the summer holidays. The minister endorses the motion's aim but says that due to a structural shortage of places it cannot yet be implemented in the short term, points to a COA inventory of child-suitable locations and planned measures, and gives partial commitments.
I fully endorse the objective of this motion and it remains my aim that children are housed in suitable locations.
Ik onderschrijf de doelstelling van deze motie geheel en het blijft mijn inzet dat kinderen worden opgevangen in geschikte locaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Van Nispen, Piri en Bruyning over kinderen in de noodopvang

MPs from D66, SP, GroenLinks-PvdA and Nieuw Sociaal Contract asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about children housed in emergency reception locations, including overcrowding, unsuitable sites, municipal population conditions, schooling delays, repeated relocations and access to youth care. The minister answered all 18 questions in substance, acknowledged shortcomings, and pointed to a COA inventory study due in summer 2025 and steps on schooling and relocation.
COA does not keep track of whether a minor asylum seeker is enrolled in a school or regularly attends it.
Het COA houdt niet bij of een minderjarige asielzoeker staat ingeschreven op een school en of het kind de school geregeld bezoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat uitvoeringsorganisaties geen vertrouwen hebben in de uitvoering van het escalatiemodel voor overlastgevende asielzoekers per 1 juni

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why implementing the escalation model for nuisance-causing asylum seekers from 1 June in Ter Apel was going ahead despite concerns from the municipality, police, IND and COA about capacity, enforcement, legal framework and staff safety. The Minister answered that the pbl (procesbeschikbaarheidslocatie) started on 1 June as the motion required, that the legal preconditions were realised, that enforcement will come from cooperation in the chain and the local tripartite, and that a follow-up meeting is planned, but largely referred back to an earlier letter of 30 May without substantive detail.
The Ministry of Asylum and Migration will continue discussions with the partners in the migration chain and the local tripartite on this.
Het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie gaat daarover samen met de partners uit de migratieketen verder in gesprek met de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over de scheve verdeling in structurele asielopvangplekken tussen rijke en arme gemeenten

MPs Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration why poorer municipalities host about five times more structural asylum reception than richer ones, questioning the Zutphen plan and the lack of contributions from wealthy municipalities. Minister Keijzer replied that the Dispersal Act requires each municipality to meet its allocated quota, that the Zutphen plan was dropped by the council, that the ministry will engage municipalities that fall short through interbestuurlijk toezicht, and that she agrees expensive emergency forms should be phased out.
The Ministry of Asylum and Migration will engage with municipalities that have not yet met their quota. Interadministrative supervision will be exercised over municipalities that do not comply.
Het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie treedt in gesprek met gemeenten die hun opgave nog niet hebben gerealiseerd. Op gemeenten die hier niet aan voldoen wordt interbestuurlijk toezicht uitgeoefend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boswijk, Diederik van Dijk en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Gokgedupeerden’ willen hun geld terug van onlinecasino’s: maken ze een kans, ze drukten toch zelf op het knopje?' en 'Gokbedrijv

MPs Boswijk, Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether gambling operator Unibet, which operated illegally before licensing, should keep its Dutch licence while it withholds transaction data from players suing to recover losses, and whether the regulator should act. The State Secretary answered that licence decisions rest with the independent Kansspelautoriteit, that the Ksa will weigh conduct in future licence assessments, that the matter of data access is for the courts, and that the Netherlands supports the European Commission's infringement procedure against Malta over Bill 55.
It is not for me to decide on suspending or revoking a licence.
Het is niet aan mij is om te besluiten over het schorsen of intrekken van een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de Commissies van Toezicht in de gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the state secretary about transparency, appointment procedures, annual reports, handling of complaints, and unimplemented 2009 recommendations concerning the prison Commissies van Toezicht. The state secretary answered that the commissions are independent, that appointment decisions were published anonymously after a FOI request, that annual reports are only received and not assessed by the ministry, and that a follow-up inspection is at the Inspectorate's discretion.
For the sake of the privacy of individual CvT members, however, no access can be given to individual appointment decisions traceable to persons.
Omwille van de privacy van de individuele CvT-leden kan echter geen inzage worden gegeven in individuele, tot personen herleidbare benoemingsbesluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht dat Eurojackpot de nieuwe hoofdsponsor van de KNVB Beker wordt

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether it is acceptable that Eurojackpot, part of the state-owned Nederlandse Loterij, became the main sponsor of the KNVB Cup, whether the deal falls outside the online gambling advertising ban, and whether legislation and dialogue with the KNVB are planned. The Secretary of State answered that lotteries are not covered by the sports sponsorship ban, that organisations should weigh their social responsibility, that stricter online gambling advertising rules are planned, and that no talks with the KNVB are foreseen because no rules are broken.
Since the agreement has already been concluded and no advertising rules for lotteries are being breached, I see no reason to hold a conversation with the KNVB about this.
Aangezien de overeenkomst reeds is gesloten en geen reclameregels voor loterijen worden overtreden, zie ik geen aanleiding om hier een gesprek met de KNVB over te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Beckerman over de sloop van de woonwijk Mrija voor 1000 Oekraïners in Vlaardingen

MPs De Nispen and Beckerman (SP) asked ministers about plans to demolish the Mrija housing estate housing about 1,000 Ukrainians in Vlaardingen for a new wastewater treatment plant, questioning responsibility, the waste of recently built homes, and alternatives. The Minister of Asylum and Migration answered that the wastewater plant is a Delfland water board responsibility, the municipality is responsible for follow-up choices, the Rijk supports relocation and subsidises housing business cases, and she invites the municipality to submit business cases to the NOO.
The Rijk has no direct involvement in carrying out that obligation.
Het Rijk heeft met de uitvoering van die verplichting geen directe betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht dat de tweelingbroer van de staatsecretaris van Defensie directeur wordt van een drone-bedrijf

SP MPs asked the Defence minister whether the Defence state secretary's twin brother taking a job at a drone company, while the army invests millions in drones, creates a conflict of interest, and what safeguards exist. The minister answered that the appointment was known within Defence, cited existing post-employment and integrity rules, and promised the state secretary would be cautious in direct contacts with AI Armaments.

Furthermore, the State Secretary will be restrained in direct contacts with AI Armaments, and specific communication about and/or specific cooperation with AI Armaments falls under the responsibility of the Minister.

Verder geldt dat de Staatssecretaris terughoudend zal zijn in directe contacten met AI Armaments en dat specifieke communicatie over en/of specifieke samenwerking met AI Armaments onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister valt.
Antwoord op van de leden Van Nispen en Mutluer over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het politieonderwijs en de structurele tekorten in de opsporing

MPs Van Nispen and Mutluer asked the Justice Minister about police training capacity at the Politieacademie, shortages in investigation roles, and the use of field academies and external providers. The minister confirmed the shortages, outlined new direct-entry routes and training numbers, and said quality is safeguarded by central certification while a structural route is being developed, without committing to the requested early letter on external providers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuursorganen risicoprofilering mogen toepassen zonder specifieke wetgeving

An MP asked the government about reports that public bodies may use algorithmic risk profiling without specific legislation, and whether this conflicts with GDPR Article 22, CJEU case law and fundamental rights. The government answers that risk selection not leading to decisions without meaningful human intervention falls outside Article 22, commits to transparency measures (Algorithm Register, notification of citizens, a report to parliament before end 2025), but declines to publish all national profiling algorithms.

Following the motion by MPs Kathmann and Six Dijkstra, the State Secretary for the Interior is currently gathering input from other governments and implementing bodies on the possibilities to always inform citizens when a (partly) automated risk selection has taken place and led to a decision.

Naar aanleiding van de motie van de leden Kathmann en Six Dijkstra haalt de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties momenteel input op bij de medeoverheden en uitvoeringsorganisaties over de mogelijkheden om burgers altijd te informeren als er een (deels) geautomatiseerde risicoselectie heeft plaatsgevonden en dit tot een besluit heeft geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah, van Nispen, Boswijk, Koops en Bruyning over het uitblijven van investeringen voor het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the State Secretary whether the 2025 spring budget omitted funds for prisons, whether the 23 million euro withdrawal from DJI's equity amounts to a cut, and what the consequences are for staff, early release, unexecuted sentences and pardon requests. The State Secretary confirmed no extra funds were allocated, explained the withdrawal as a legal requirement used to cover other justice costs, and warned of a growing capacity shortfall of around 800 places by 2030, while answering the timing question late.
Without additional investments I cannot realise structural capacity expansions and many necessary renovations cannot be carried out.
Zonder aanvullende investeringen kan ik geen structurele capaciteitsuitbreidingen realiseren en kunnen veel van de noodzakelijke renovaties niet uitgevoerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verder aan het licht gekomen misstanden in sektes door Undercover

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister and State Secretary about abuses in the De Lichtfamilie sect revealed by an undercover documentary, including shunning, extortion, and claims that cancer patients are responsible for their illness, and about the status of a sect hotline and a motion on protecting people from sects. Struycken answered that the abuses are unacceptable and can be prosecuted by the OM, that the IGJ and Wkkgz/Wet BIG can act against harmful alternative care, and that a hotline pilot at Fier started in 2024 with a 2.5-year budget of €926,907, with further information promised in a letter before the summer recess.
The details of the Fier help desk will be communicated to the House in the letter on insecurity and coercive control in (closed) groups due before the summer recess.
Over de nadere vormgeving van het hulppunt bij Fier wordt de Kamer geïnformeerd in de Kamerbrief onveiligheid en dwingende controle in (gesloten) groeperingen die voor het zomerreces uitgaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lahlah en Van Nispen over het ondermijnen van de forensische geneeskunde door de recente aanbesteding van medische arrestantenzorg

MPs Lahlah and Van Nispen asked whether awarding all ten medical custody-care lots to one GP organisation undermines forensic medicine, and about risks to staffing, quality and the rule of law. The Minister declined to judge the provisional award, stated that custody care is distinct from forensic examination, pointed to quality and separation requirements and to the ongoing Versterking Forensische Geneeskunde programme, and noted a court procedure that may delay the final award.
The award is not yet final, as a court procedure is ongoing.
De gunning is nog niet definitief, aangezien er een procedure loopt bij de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontslag van de bewindspersonen

An MP asked the Prime Minister who decided that all PVV-nominated ministers and state secretaries should be dismissed, whether they agreed, and whether a constitutional rule prevents them from continuing as caretakers without a party. The Prime Minister answered that after the PVV withdrew support on 3 June, the ministers and state secretaries it nominated offered their resignations, and that no constitutional rule prevents caretaker ministers from continuing; he referred back to that answer for the question on continuing without party affiliation.
There is no constitutional rule that prevents continuing the work as a caretaker minister.
Er is geen staatsrechtelijke regel die zich verzet tegen het voortzetten van het werk als demissionair bewindspersoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over “het riante wachtgeld voor de opgestapte PVV-bewindslieden”

SP MPs Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Minister of the Interior whether the lengthy benefit scheme (Appa) for ex-politicians, including the departed PVV ministers, should be abolished or brought under the unemployment benefit rules, including its lack of a fault test. The minister rejected the 'wachtgeld' label, defended the Appa benefit as a safety net needed because of the confidence convention, and declined to abolish it or apply the WW fault test.
No, I am not willing to abolish the benefit scheme for former politicians.
Nee, ik ben niet bereid de uitkeringsregeling voor oud-politici af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bestuurders van sportclubs afhaken

MPs asked whether the government shares concerns that board members of sports clubs are withdrawing due to regulatory burden and the Wbtr's director-liability risks, and whether proposals and timelines will follow. The government answered that it is running a regulatory-burden review and a Significant Public study on whether volunteer insurance covers liability risks, with results expected before summer recess, and that the Wbtr evaluation (due before 1 July 2026) will examine unintended effects on volunteer liability.
The expectation is that the outcomes of this study will be sent to your House before the summer recess.
Het is de verwachting dat de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek voor het zomerreces naar uw Kamer worden gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over de berichten dat KaFra Housing winst maakt op de huisvesting voor asielzoekers

Two SP MPs asked whether it is acceptable that KaFra Housing, a commercial provider, houses asylum seekers in former worker accommodation and profits from public funds, and whether the state should investigate such arrangements. The minister replied that COA renting commercial locations is not unusual, that emergency shelter is costlier and is being phased out, that the locations meet quality standards, and that no further investigation is deemed necessary.
I do not recognise the picture painted that asylum seekers are being housed in poor living conditions at these locations.
Ik herken niet het beeld dat geschetst wordt dat er asielzoekers met slechte woonomstandigheden op deze locaties worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over de omstreden en nog altijd actieve sekte Pater Pio

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked the Justice Minister about the Pater Pio sect in Twente, including reports of deaths linked to refusal of medical care, child corporal punishment and exorcisms, and why complaints have not stopped the group. The minister says the IGJ can intervene if harm results, that prosecutors have found insufficient evidence or grounds in past complaints, and that a Fier victim helpline launches in summer 2025 with police cooperation still being worked out.
The Fier help point will go live in summer 2025.
Het hulppunt bij Fier zal in de zomer van 2025 live gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Leerlingen pesten elkaar met nepnaaktbeelden, middelbare scholen willen verbod op uitkleedapps'

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked about reports that pupils circulate AI-generated fake nude images of classmates and schools want a ban on nudify apps. The government says bullying is unacceptable, points to existing criminal law, school safety duties, support for School & Veiligheid and Helpwanted, and rejects a general ban as easily circumvented, while promising a cabinet response to the 'Online seksueel geweld' report after the summer.
A more general ban on offering the nudify apps does not, however, seem appropriate at this time.
Een algemener verbod op het aanbieden van de uitkleedapps ligt op dit moment echter niet voor de hand.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weigering van een stichting om openheid van zaken te geven over de financiële afwikkeling van de stichting en het vermogen dat mede bestaat uit giften van derden

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers how a dissolved foundation (Stichting Kanjer Wens) can refuse to disclose how its assets, including donations, were wound up, and whether transparency rules should be tightened. The government answered that existing rules (Civil Code liquidation and turboliquidatie registration at the Chamber of Commerce, tax reporting for former ANBIs, and donor inspection rights through courts) provide adequate transparency, and it saw no need to change the law at this stage.

On the obligation to register information at the Chamber of Commerce during the winding-up of a foundation, reference is made to the answer to question 3, so that they can check what happened to the assets.

Voor wat betreft de verplichting tot registratie van informatie in het handelsregister bij financiële afwikkeling en/of vereffening van een stichting wordt verwezen naar het antwoord op vraag 3 en kunnen zij nagaan wat er met het vermogen is gebeurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitbuiting van Indonesische verpleegkundigen en hun zaak tegen een Hogeschool

MP Van Nispen asked ministers about the exploitation of Indonesian nursing students under a work-study scheme run by a university of applied sciences, including a settlement gag clause, IND concerns, the revocation procedure and whether exploiters profited. The government answered that the settlement is private and outside its competence, that the IND recognised the institution after a revised programme, that a Labour Inspectorate fine investigation is ongoing with results to be published, and that it will review legal vulnerabilities.
The cabinet will examine vulnerabilities in the current laws and regulations and determine which follow-up steps are desirable.
Het kabinet zal kwetsbaarheden in de huidige wet- en regelgeving bezien en nagaan welke vervolgstappen gewenst zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de nasleep van de moord op een Nederlandse vrouw in India

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs minister why a victim's family was never informed about the investigation into the 2012 murder of a Dutch woman in India, what the status of the case is, and what the government can do given the suspect remains free. The minister answered that consular help is given on request, that the ministry will not comment on individual cases for privacy reasons, that Netherlands cannot interfere in a foreign legal process, and that without a request from a Dutch citizen it has no power to act toward a lawyer or local authorities.
On individual consular matters, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs does not make statements out of consideration for the privacy of those involved.
Over individuele consulaire zaken doet het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken geen mededelingen omwille van de privacy van betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zichtbaarheid van huiselijk geweld in het familierecht

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a Verwey-Jonker report finding that domestic violence is rarely considered in family law decisions on custody and access, and about risk-screening tools, training, and a pending motion on a assessment framework. The government acknowledges the research, promises a policy response to the Chamber before summer, and defers substantive answers on the report's recommendations and the motion to that letter.
We will also inform the Chamber in this letter about what follow-up we will give to the findings of the research.
Wij zullen de Kamer in deze brief ook informeren over welk gevolg wij zullen geven aan de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over geheime en onwettige detentieplaatsen in Nederland

MP Van Nispen asked the minister how an advocate was held at a secret, unlawful detention location, who ordered it, why no supervisor was informed, how many such placements occurred, and whether transparency will be guaranteed in future. The state secretary admitted the Inspectorate should have been informed, said new agreements and a supervisory commission are being set up, but withheld operational details citing security and did not give numbers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt, Piri, Rajkowski, Van Nispen, Boomsma en Van Zanten over het preventiefonds en schaderegelingen voor ondernemers in Ter Apel

MPs asked whether the 800,000 euro preventive fund for Ter Apel is nearly exhausted, how remaining costs will be financed, whether damage settlement will be broadened by this summer, and whether a single counter for damage claims and preventive funds can be set up. The minister said the funds were paid to Westerwolde municipality, that the damage scheme will be widened case by case, and that a single counter is being explored with a decentralised grant to be decided by the municipality.
As promised to the House and stated in the letter of 11 March 2025, the damage scheme will be broadened.
Zoals aan de Kamer toegezegd en benoemd in de Kamerbrief op 11 maart 2025, zal de schaderegeling verruimd worden.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Nispen over de zorgwekkende uitkomsten van de inspectie Gezondheid en Jeugd over de situatie van kinderen in de opvang.

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration how the government responds to the Inspectorate's findings that children and other vulnerable asylum seekers face serious health and development risks in reception, and what will be done. The minister acknowledges shortcomings and responsibility, points to improvements and to planned measures (continuity-of-care guideline, mental health access, maternity care), but says reception capacity shortages limit placement of children in suitable locations, and promises further information before the May recess.
Yes, together with the COA I am taking up these recommendations.
Ja, samen met het COA pak ik deze aanbevelingen op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een van de belangrijkste opleidings- en toetsingsinstituten voor Tolken is overgenomen door een Tolkenbemiddelaar

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the takeover of the interpreter training and certification institute KTV by intermediary Global Talk, which already leads the market, concentrates testing power and weakens independent quality control and complaints mechanisms. The Staatssecretaris answered that KTV remains independent and open to all, that the Wbtv recognition and audit system guarantees test quality, that no independent complaints body yet exists but routes are being mapped, and that the integrated fee model is unchanged.
For recognition of tests, a quality plan must be submitted substantiating the assurance of quality, uniformity and validity of the testing.
Voor erkenning van toetsen moet een kwaliteitsplan worden ingediend waarin de borging van de kwaliteit, uniformiteit en validiteit van de toetsing wordt onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Michon-Derkzen en Koops over de omgang met een informant van de politie

MPs asked the Justice Minister about a police informant who was detained and could not defend himself after being prosecuted, and whether compensation or legal gaps should be addressed. The Minister declined to comment on the individual case, citing the need to protect informant identities, and said existing rules adequately cover informants, so no legal gap is seen.
As Minister, I do not comment on individual cases or on matters concerning whether persons work or have worked as informants for the police and judicial authorities.
Als Minister ga ik niet in op individuele zaken en op zaken die zien op de vraag of personen als informant voor politie en justitie werken of in het verleden hebben gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Klikken over uitkeringsfraude? Dat kan in steeds meer gemeenten, maar ook kritiek neemt toe'

MPs Van Kent and Van Nispen (SP) asked whether municipal anonymous fraud hotlines for welfare benefits should be curbed, given reports of harm to citizens and social trust. The State Secretary defended municipal discretion over hotlines, said they yield useful signals and that investigations include hearing rights, and rejected a ban while answering several questions only in general terms.
So I will not introduce a ban on the hotlines.
Ik ga dus geen verbod invoeren op de meldpunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de Sportpas

Van Nispen (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about his view of a sports pass for youth, its development since December 2024, and when and where the pilot and effectiveness study will take place. Karremans said he is enthusiastic, is commissioning a study on the sports pass effects, and will inform the House in June before the next committee debate, without yet naming pilot municipalities.
I aim to inform you in June, ahead of the next committee debate, about what the study will look like exactly and in which municipalities the sports pass will be tried out.
Ik streef ernaar u in juni, voorafgaand aan het eerstvolgende commissiedebat, te informeren over hoe het onderzoek er precies uitziet en in welke gemeenten de sportpas uitgeprobeerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport van de commissie Vander Meer II en de tarieven voor de sociaal advocatuur

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security when she received the Van der Meer II report on social legal aid, why she tempered budget expectations, why the response came late, how she will respond to the VSAN emergency plan, what budget claims she has made for the Spring Memorandum, and asked for answers within a week. The State Secretary replied that she received the embargoed report on 10 February 2025, gave no budget figures, will address the VSAN proposals and a visie-traject in a letter before the 1 April debate, cannot disclose Spring Memorandum positions before cabinet deliberation, and that the one-week deadline was not met but answers would precede the new debate date.
Reserving budget without knowing how high that amount should be does not fit within the government-wide budgetary rules.
Budget reserveren zonder te weten hoe hoog dit bedrag zou moeten zijn, past niet binnen de overheidsbrede begrotingsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er op een derde van de mbo’s sport- en beweeglessen geen structureel onderdeel van het curriculum zijn

MP Van Nispen asked about a report finding that sport and movement lessons are not a structural part of the curriculum at a third of mbo schools, and about barriers such as accommodation, timetables and funding. The state secretary replied that vocational schools themselves decide how to organise movement education, pointed to voluntary tools and programmes such as TestJeLeefstijl, the Gezonde School approach and quality funds, and said there is no statutory hours norm in vocational education.
It is up to the vocational schools themselves whether and how they organise movement education.
Het is aan mbo-instellingen zelf of en hoe zij bewegingsonderwijs vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor, Van Nispen en Flach over het bericht 'Ambtenaren verwachten ontevreden VNG na Kamerbrief'

MPs Chakor, Van Nispen and Flach asked why the government did not implement a motion requiring consultation with municipalities and provinces (VNG and IPO) on the new GDP-based normering system and its effects on the municipal and provincial funds. The State Secretary answered that consultations took place in 2024-2025, that government and local authorities hold different views on 2026 finances, that the matter was discussed in the BOFv of 6 March, and that the Minister will inform parliament before the 26 March debate.

Between November 2024 and February 2025 there were both administrative and civil-service consultations with the subnational governments on the financial effects and the pros and cons of the new calculation method for task changes.

Er is in de periode november 2024 tot februari 2025 zowel bestuurlijk als ambtelijk gesproken met de medeoverheden over de financiële effecten en de voor- en nadelen van de nieuwe berekeningswijze van taakmutaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de fundamentele koerswijziging van het Openbaar Ministerie om veel meer strafzaken zelf af te gaan doen met OM-strafbeschikkingen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's decision to issue far more OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) for property crimes, including whether this bypasses judicial review, weakens rights and victim protection, and was properly communicated. The minister answered that the OM acts within its statutory powers, that the change aims to shorten case durations and relieve courts, that safeguards and legal aid remain in place, and that a Kamer debate and WODC research are planned.
The OM functions independently and autonomously with regard to sentencing in criminal cases.
Het OM functioneert ten aanzien van de strafoplegging in strafzaken zelfstandig en onafhankelijk.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat de subsidie stopt voor Samen Recht Vinden in het licht van de ontwikkelingen en de aangenomen voorstellen voor laagdrempelige voorzieningen voor sociaal-jurid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security why the subsidy for Samen Recht Vinden, a low-threshold legal aid initiative in Zeeland, is ending despite its value and a Chamber motion on a nationwide low-threshold legal support network. The State Secretary answered that the pilot funding was always temporary, that structural funding falls outside the legal aid budget, and that a one-off bridging contribution for 2025 is being considered together with a coordinator to strengthen the national network.
However, I see no possibilities, from my responsibility for the system of subsidised legal aid, to structurally finance initiatives such as Samen Recht Vinden.
Ik zie echter geen mogelijkheden om vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid voor het stelsel van gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand om initiatieven zoals Samen Recht structureel te financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het NOS-item 'Ondanks verbod toch gokreclame op Belgische voetbalshirts, 'kan ook hier gebeuren''

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Belgian clubs' circumvention of gambling advertising bans could happen in the Netherlands, and whether clubs should be held to account for keeping gambling sponsorship until the ban takes effect. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Dutch ban on sports sponsorship by licensed online gambling operators takes effect on 1 July 2025, that new legislation will tighten advertising rules, and that he sees no ground to address clubs on existing contracts.
I therefore see no reason to address clubs now regarding these contracts.
Ik zie dan ook geen grond om clubs nu aan te spreken op deze contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een broker miljoenen aan belastinggeld verdiende door de financiering van asielbedden in hotels

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about reports that broker LCHD earned tens of millions in taxpayer money by financing asylum hotel beds, and why intermediaries were used despite a COA agreement to avoid them. The minister declined to comment on the case pending FIOD and OM investigations, said LCHD's services ended, acknowledged high costs, and stated that new hotel contracts are now largely concluded without external intermediaries while leaving room for external expertise.

As indicated in answering the questions of 1 July 2024, pending the outcomes of the investigations by the Public Prosecution Service and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service, I will make no further statements about this case.

Antwoord 2 en 4 Zoals aangegeven bij de beantwoording van de vragen van 1 juli 2024 3 zal ik vooruitlopend op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Fiscale Inlichtingen- en Opsporingsdienst geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de sektarische Twee aan Twee-beweging die ook in Nederland slachtoffers maakt

An MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about the Twee aan Twee movement, a closed group alleged to involve abuse and isolation of members, including in the Netherlands. The State Secretary said no police, prosecution or child protection cases were known, saw no need for independent research now, and pointed to a new Fier help and knowledge point for victims of coercive groups.
I currently see no need for independent research into this specific group.
Ik zie op dit moment geen noodzaak voor onafhankelijk onderzoek naar deze specifieke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over bezoeken van De Eritrese ambassadeur voor de Europese Unie en de Benelux-landen aan Nederlandse steden

SP MPs asked whether local authorities were consulted about visits by Eritrea's ambassador to Amersfoort and Amsterdam, whether the visits constitute foreign interference, and whether the ambassador will be addressed. The government said municipalities were not informed in advance, that unlawful conduct would prompt firm action, and that Eritrean diplomats were previously expelled for coerced diaspora tax collection.
Municipalities Amersfoort and Amsterdam indicated that they were not informed in advance of the meetings and therefore they were not discussed within the local security triangle.

Gemeente Amersfoort en gemeente Amsterdam hebben aangegeven dat zij niet op voorhand op de hoogte waren van de bijeenkomsten en dat hier dus ook niet binnen de lokale veiligheidsdriehoek over is gesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de oproep van het Openbaar Ministerie om de wetgeving tegen corruptie te verbeteren

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why prosecutors say Dutch law makes bribery of officials hard to prove, including the requirement of a direct quid pro quo, and whether Dutch law lags other EU states on trading in influence. The minister replied that the bribery offences are sufficiently broad, no direct link to a counter-performance is required, proof is hard in practice, Dutch law lacks a separate trading-in-influence offence, and legislative changes will be considered after the EU anti-corruption directive negotiations conclude.
So at present I do not have the picture that the current legislation offers insufficient possibilities to prosecute officials for corruption.
Ik heb dus op dit moment niet het beeld dat de huidige wetgeving onvoldoende mogelijkheden biedt om ambtenaren te vervolgen voor corruptie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over Unibet die de weg naar de rechter voor gedupeerden blokkeert en traineert

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether Unibet, licensed only since recent legalisation, is obstructing Dutch gamblers' court claims by refusing transaction records, and whether its licence should be suspended. The Secretary of State answered that the AVG and betrouwbaarheid questions fall to the Data Protection Authority, the court and the Ksa, that the state does not intervene in civil disputes, and that the Ksa cannot yet judge whether the conduct is an antecedent, while committing only to inform the regulators.
It is not for me to decide to suspend or revoke a licence.
Het is niet aan mij om te besluiten over te gaan op het schorsen of intrekken van een vergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over Chileense en andere illegale adopties en archivering adoptiedossiers

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked about the status of the Chilean criminal investigation into illegal adoptions, state recognition of victims' suffering, and how adoption files are stored and made accessible after provider licences expire. The Staatssecretaris answered that the Chilean investigation is ongoing with no outcome yet, outlined existing support services (INEA) and a planned transfer of adoption archives to the Nationaal Archief, and noted that the government apologised in response to the Joustra commission report.
Furthermore, the National Archives was not previously involved in adoption and is not burdened with any past misconduct.
Daarnaast is het Nationaal Archief in het verleden niet betrokken geweest bij adoptie en is het niet belast met eventuele misstanden uit het verleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tegen betaling laten vertrekken van criminele asielzoekers

MPs Van Nispen asked the Minister for Asylum and Migration about reports that the Dienst Terugkeer en Vertrek paid cash and goods to criminal former asylum seekers to leave the country, and whether this rewards crime. The Minister confirmed that about 900 cases used case-specific support, roughly 2% exceeding regular amounts, with a few high payments, and said such support is an exceptional last resort while pledging to reduce its need.
As you know, I cannot go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend kan ik niet ingaan op individuele zaken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Grinwis over de scheve positie van de onvrijwillige schuldeiser ten opzichte van de vrijwillige schuldeiser naar aanleiding van het artikel ‘Insolventierecht is failliet bij

MPs Van Nispen and Grinwis asked whether the bankruptcy creditor ranking, which does not distinguish involuntary from voluntary creditors, unfairly leaves victims of environmental damage unpaid, and whether the Secretary of State will study reordering creditor priority. The Secretary of State disagrees with the article's conclusions, explains the existing ranking and the security-right rationale, notes the Omgevingsbesluit financial-security requirement for major risk firms, and declines to change the system after WODC research found too many drawbacks.
I am not convinced that reversing the order so that involuntary creditors take over the separatist position of security holders would ultimately lead to a better system.
Ik heb niet de overtuiging dat het omdraaien van de volgorde waarin «onvrijwillige» schuldeisers de separatistenpositie overnemen van zekerheidsgerechtigden uiteindelijk leidt tot een beter systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitzichtloze situatie voor de stateloze Igor en Galina die al 17 jaar in Nederland wonen

An MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration why stateless Igor and Galina, long resident in the Netherlands, have still not received a residence permit after a 2024 Council of State ruling, and what will be done to resolve their case. The Minister confirmed the ruling only found insufficient reasoning and ordered a new decision, that a new decision has now been taken, and declined to discuss the individual case or to quantify similar cases.
However, I will not go into this individual case, in accordance with the agreements on this with your House.
Ik ga echter niet in op dit individuele geval, conform de afspraken hierover met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over recente arresten van het Gerechtshof over de proceskostenvergoeding in Mulderzaken

MP Van Nispen asked the State Secretary whether recent Court of Appeal rulings on capped procedural cost compensation in Mulderzaken (traffic-fine cases) change the intended policy and whether the law must be amended. The State Secretary answered that the arrests lead to no different assessment, that the Public Prosecution Service is considering follow-up steps, and that the Procurator-General intends cassation in the interest of the law, with further measures to be decided later.
It is up to the Public Prosecution Service to take legal follow-up steps in response to the ruling.
Het is aan het OM om juridische vervolgstappen te nemen naar aanleiding van het arrest.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de grote onrust die heerst bij rechtbanktolken over de te lage tarieven en de grote achteruitgang in de kwaliteit van tolkendiensten door het nieuw ingesteld overheidssystee

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about unrest among court interpreters over low rates and declining service quality under the new system routing assignments through commercial agencies, including cases of no-shows, postponed trials and calls to recruit Belgian interpreters. The State Secretary acknowledged the concerns but argued individual cases are not representative, pointed to monitoring data showing positive trends, and promised further dialogue with interpreter representatives and a monitoring letter.
Individual cases do not always give a representative picture of how the system works.
Individuele casussen geven niet altijd een representatief beeld van de werking van het systeem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palmen en Van Nispen over het schenden van het verschoningsrecht door het OM

MPs Palmen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's breach of legal professional privilege in the Castor case, the settlement with Stibbe and an asset manager, the role of the landsadvocaat, and a disciplinary ruling on the landsadvocaat. The minister answered that the OM acknowledged a procedural error, that the Supreme Court filled a legal gap, that a new OM directive and a chain project are underway, and defended the landsadvocaat's good faith while answering most questions substantively.
The OM acknowledges that this constitutes a procedural irregularity.
Het OM erkent dat hier sprake is van een vormverzuim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen d.d. 3 oktober 2024 over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen ask about the responsibility of dance sport federations (NADB) for misconduct, the lack of apology and recognition for a whistleblower, the absence of mandatory VOG checks, the independence of the CVSN reporting centre, and the reach of the Alliantie Dans Veilig. The Secretary of State answers that federations have limited responsibility, that a whistleblower meeting will be arranged, that VOG remains voluntary and that a law to create an independent integrity centre is in preparation.
To strengthen social safety in sport, I am currently working on a bill that will lead to the establishment of an independent integrity centre, which will also separate the CVSN from NOC*NSF.

Om sociale veiligheid in de sport te versterken, werk ik momenteel aan een wetsvoorstel dat zal leiden tot de oprichting van een onafhankelijk integriteitscentrum, waarmee het CVSN tevens wordt losgekoppeld van NOC*NSF.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Criminelen vroegen studiefinanciering aan op naam van Helmondse vrouw: rechter geeft minister veeg uit de pan’

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked how the ministry and DUO respond to a court finding that inadequate checks let student finance be fraudulently claimed in a victim's name, and about compensation, DigiD safeguards and legal access. The minister acknowledged a 2018 control gap that has been fixed, said the debt of the victim will be written off and DUO will try to recover from perpetrators, and committed to reviewing the court's ruling on advance payments without a legal basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over kluisverklaringen die mogelijk vernietigd worden

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked whether witness statements (kluisverklaringen) from a detained criminal, Goran K., should be destroyed when no cooperation deal with the Public Prosecution Service is reached, and how relevant information and imminent threats are handled. The Minister answers that statements are destroyed under statutory retention rules unless specific arrangements or serious interests justify earlier destruction, that information from non-agreed statements cannot be used for investigation, that threats are always acted upon, and declines to comment on the individual case.
It is not appropriate for me to go further into the substance of this individual case.
Het past mij niet om verder inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chakor en Van Nispen over foutieve geboortedata in de Basisregistratie personen

MPs Chakor and Van Nispen asked whether incomplete birth dates (00 or XX) in the BRP, which can cause problems with digital systems such as AOW, can be replaced by a usable fictitious date. The State Secretary says about 35,950 residents still have a partial or unknown birth date, that people can request rectification via their municipality using a sworn statement, and that the Minister of Asylum and Migration can supply a date where needed, but does not commit to a new general measure.
Persons registered in the BRP with an incomplete birth date can submit a request to their municipality to have their birth date rectified.
Personen die met een onvolledige geboortedatum in de BRP staan, kunnen bij hun gemeente een verzoek indienen om hun geboortedatum te laten rectificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het beperken van inspraak van maatschappelijke organisaties bij nieuwe wetten
