The MP asks why the government gave advisory bodies only a one-week consultation on a bill introducing a two-status asylum system and stricter family reunification rules, and why it treated confidentiality and an accelerated procedure as justified. The minister answers that urgency to relieve the asylum chain justified a shortened consultation, that the ministry will still take later advice into account, and that the 'confidential' marking was an error since consultations are not confidential.
For that reason, a limited consultation period of one week was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor een beperkte consultatieperiode van één week.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mutluer en Helder over het afluistersysteem van de politie

MPs Van Nispen, Mutluer, Helder and Van der Werf asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the police wiretap system from Elbit was delayed and that an upgrade was bought as a backup, including questions about the supplier's staff access, human rights risks and AI use. The Minister denies that a new system was secretly bought, says the upgrade was a precaution, states that the new system will only be used once it meets requirements, and gives no firm guarantee on the first-half 2025 rollout.
Furthermore, it is good to note that because of the confidential tender, I cannot make statements about the supplier of the current wiretap system.
Verder is het goed om aan te geven dat vanwege de aanbesteding onder geheimhouding ik geen uitspraken kan doen over de leverancier van het huidige tapsysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over frauderende tussenpersonen bij de opvang van asielzoeker in hotelkamers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about alleged fraud by a broker (LCHD) that COA cannot end due to contract terms, whether budget cuts caused the reliance on intermediaries, and how such brokers can be excluded in future. The Minister declined to comment on the case pending OM and FIOD investigations, stated COA now works largely without external intermediaries, pointed to multi-year budget allocations, and said COA ended cooperation with LCHD from 1 January 2025.

As indicated in the answers to the questions of 1 July 2024, I will not make further statements about this case in anticipation of the outcome of the investigation by the Public Prosecution Service and the Fiscal Intelligence and Investigation Service.

Zoals aangegeven bij de beantwoording van de vragen van 1 juli 2024 zal ik vooruitlopend op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie en de Fiscale Inlichtingen en Opsporingsdienst geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over het nieuws dat arbeidsmigranten worden uitgebuit door werkgevers die de noodopvang voor asielzoekers verzorgen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked about reports that migrant workers were exploited by private firms running emergency asylum accommodation on cruise ships, including unpaid long shifts and dismissal without housing, and about tax avoidance and why asylum seekers do not do the work. The minister called the conditions unacceptable and said investigation is needed, that emergency sites require specialist staff and fast setup, that COA checks contractors via Bibob and CSR rules, and that COA is reviewing contracts and activating residents more, while not committing to contract-wide sanctions.
It is my ambition to limit this expensive and suboptimal form of accommodation to a minimum as quickly as possible.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze dure en suboptimale vorm van opvang zo snel mogelijk tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op het lid Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Politieke partijen blijven anonieme donaties aannemen’ uit Vrij Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether political parties can still receive anonymous or split donations via loopholes, including advice to return gifts over EUR 250 to the donor and the ability to split large donations. The Minister defended the rules as transparency-focused, said full loophole closure is not possible, and pointed to a forthcoming Political Parties Act bill.
It is not possible to legally close all possible circumvention routes.
Het is niet mogelijk om wettelijk alle mogelijke omzeilingsroutes te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen bij de UNHCR betreffende het kleinere aantal vluchtelingen dat Nederland gaat opvangen

An SP MP asks the Minister of Asylum and Migration about UNHCR concerns over the reduced Dutch resettlement quota of 200 refugees instead of 500, its proportionality, the lack of a permanent residence permit for resettled refugees, and whether a special status is planned. The minister answers that the cabinet's October decisions stand, that the quota reduction applies 'until further notice', that resettled refugees receive the same temporary asylum permit as other status holders, and that no exception is currently foreseen.
'Until further notice' means until the current (or a successor) cabinet considers that other action is needed.
Tot nader order betekent totdat het huidige (of een opvolgend) kabinet meent dat andere inzet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Piri en Podt over de (beveiligde) opvang van COA-bewoners en ongedocumenteerden met ernstige psychische problemen

MPs asked the government why it appeared to downplay concerns that the Veldzicht centre would stop accepting COA residents and undocumented migrants with severe psychiatric problems, and where such people could be placed safely. The minister answered that no decisions had yet been taken, that beds for the group remain available with case-by-case assessment, that responsibility is shared across ministers, and that the group will not be left on the street, while deferring full answers until a decision on the cooperation agreement was taken.
Discussions are taking place between the parties involved to ensure it is clear under which criteria and conditions this group can be placed in the reserved beds at Veldzicht.
Er vinden gesprekken plaats tussen betrokken partijen om te borgen dat duidelijk is onder welke criteria en randvoorwaarden deze groep op de gereserveerde bedden in Veldzicht geplaatst kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Podt en Van Nispen over Veldzicht en de uitvoering van de motie-Van Nispen c.s. (Kamerstuk 24 587, nr. 995)

Two MPs asked whether the government will ensure that vulnerable undocumented migrants and COA residents with serious mental health problems, covered by a motion, do not end up on the street, after two people were refused access to Veldzicht. The minister confirmed the target group, said one refused person was ordered admitted by a court, and said that cases are assessed individually and cooperation arrangements remain in place, without giving a firm guarantee on all points.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament 'Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht' (reference 544779), you can assume that the current population staying in Veldzicht without a suitable alternative in mental health care will not simply be put on the street.

Zoals aangegeven in de Kamerbrief «Samenwerkingsconvenant COA en Veldzicht» (referentie 544779), kunt u ervan uitgaan dat de huidige populatie die in Veldzicht verblijft zonder passend alternatief in de GGZ niet zomaar op straat wordt gezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Podt over het bericht ‘Ministeries laten gevaarlijke man op straat zwerven, ondanks waarschuwingen’

MPs Van Nispen and Podt asked the Asylum and Migration Minister, on behalf of the Justice Secretary, why a dangerous undocumented man with a violent past was left on the street despite warnings, why he was refused by the Veldzicht clinic, and how this squares with earlier promises and a motion. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said he will be admitted to Veldzicht following a court ruling, defended clinic admission decisions as medical, and said the government shares responsibility while promising to clarify admission conditions with partners.
We do not go into individual situations.
Wij gaan niet in op individuele situaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de wereldwijde gevaren van gokken voor de volksgezondheid

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked how the government views the Lancet Commission's warnings that gambling poses a global public health threat, and whether Dutch policy (led by the Ministry of Justice and Security) sufficiently protects vulnerable people. The State Secretary responded that player protection is being strengthened through new rules on deposit limits and contact moments, a tougher KSA responsible-gambling policy rule, a planned law revision after the Wet koa evaluation, and continued international cooperation, while rejecting a WHO resolution as currently unnecessary.
Protecting people from the negative effects of gambling is my primary concern.
Het beschermen van mensen tegen negatieve effecten van gokken staat voor mij voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het landgebonden aanbod van kansspelen

MP Van Nispen asks whether the land-based gambling market functions well, whether online gambling is riskier, whether competition and Holland Casino's state shareholding should be reconsidered, and whether gambling policy will stay consistent. The Secretary of State says there are no signs of problems controlling addiction risks on land-based gambling, notes financial strain from the gambling tax increase, reaffirms the state shareholding is not strictly necessary but has added value, and promises a new gambling policy vision by March 2025.
By March 2025 at the latest I will send your House my vision on the future development and objectives of gambling policy.
Uiterlijk in maart 2025 stuur ik uw Kamer mijn visie op de toekomstige ontwikkeling en doelstellingen van het kansspelbeleid toe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het werken met ambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration whether she blocked the appointment of an interim spokesperson with a past link to Mayor Halsema, whether this was linked to Wilders' demand for Halsema's resignation, and what signal this sends to civil servants. The minister declined to comment on the individual case in nearly every answer, stating only that advisers work independently and the minister bears political responsibility.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen uitspraken over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Eerdmans over het bericht dat gemeenten nauwelijks van elkaar leren over nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Nispen and Eerdmans asked whether municipalities learn enough from each other about preventing New Year's Eve disorder, and what role the minister sees for herself. The minister replied that knowledge sharing already happens via VNG networks, regional consultations and the Strategic Consultation with mayors, that local preparation is a municipal responsibility, and offered no new concrete step.
Preparing for the New Year's celebration is a local responsibility and runs through the local triangle.
Het voorbereiden van de jaarwisseling is een lokale bevoegdheid en verloopt via de lokale driehoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht ‘Overheid verzwijgt informatie over advocatenneef Taghi, AD stapt naar de rechter’

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether earlier information about lawyer Youssef T., nephew of Ridouan Taghi, was withheld, why access to the EBI was not refused sooner, and why AD had to go to court under the Open Government Act. The state secretary refers to earlier answers, says the denial of access was based on signs of misuse of his privileged position and lifted once the bar dean found no evidence, denies obstruction of journalists, and declines to discuss the pending court case.
Since this is an ongoing procedure, I cannot go into the substance of it.
Nu dit een lopende procedure betreft kan ik hier niet inhoudelijk op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de status van zelfmelder en het risico op willekeur

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security whether the self-surrender (zelfmelder) system is growing arbitrary, with similar cases treated differently, and whether CJIB should adopt objective protocols. The State Secretary rejects the charge of arbitrariness, stresses individual assessment within the Regeling USB, announces extra detention places and a prioritised call-up scheme, and promises an analysis of the self-surrender policy by Q1 2025.
The aim is to complete this analysis in the first quarter of 2025.
Het streven is deze analyse in het eerste kwartaal 2025 af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri en Van Nispen over het bericht 'GGD-arts slaat alarm: 'Asielkinderen opvang Assen zijn ondervoed en bang'

MPs Piri and Van Nispen asked whether children should no longer be housed in the Expo Hal emergency shelter in Assen, how long residents stay and how often the 20-day limit is exceeded, and how the child-appropriate housing motion will be implemented. The Minister answers that emergency shelter is still needed to prevent people sleeping on the street, that the COA is working to move children to regular shelters, that residents stay on average 15 days with 90 of 473 exceeding 20 days, and that no firm end date can be given.
Given that I depend on other parties to realise shelter, I cannot give a timeframe for when the use of emergency shelter locations will no longer be needed.
Gelet op het feit dat ik voor het realiseren van opvang afhankelijk ben van andere partijen kan ik geen termijn geven waarop de inzet van noodopvanglocaties niet meer nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport ‘Van wet naar werkelijkheid: Bewegingsonderwijs op de Basisschool’

An SP MP asked the state secretaries about a Mulier Institute report finding about a third of primary schools fail the 90-minute weekly physical education norm, and asked what support, facilities, teacher recruitment and enforcement steps would follow. The government says it expects all schools to comply, notes the earmarked subsidy ended and funds moved into the general subsidy budget, delegates facility duties to municipalities, and says the Inspectorate can issue a remedial order.
I expect all schools to comply with the statutory obligations that apply to education, including the hours norm for physical education.
Ik verwacht van alle scholen dat ze voldoen aan de wettelijke verplichtingen die gelden voor het onderwijs, inclusief de urennorm voor bewegingsonderwijs.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de alarmerende cijfers betreffende de teruggang van het aantal sociaal advocaten en de toegang tot het Recht die hiermee nog meer onder druk komt te staan

MP Van Nispen asked about NOvA figures showing a sharp decline in social lawyers, the resulting pressure on access to justice, and the causes including low fees, workload and a lack of new entrants. Secretary Struycken acknowledged the concerns, pointed to the ongoing Commissie-Van der Meer II review of fees expected in February 2025, announced a longer-term dialogue with the profession, and gave no new funding commitment.
I intend to inform you in a separate letter in April 2025 about this process in more detail.
Ik ben voornemens om u in april 2025 bij separate brief over dit traject nader te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat 18.000 asielzoekers niet kunnen werken omdat de wachtlijsten voor een bsn torenhoog zijn

MP Van Nispen asked why the backlog for citizen service numbers (BSN) for asylum seekers has risen to about 18,000, who is responsible for registration, and when the backlog will be cleared. The State Secretary answered that capacity at the few designated registration offices is insufficient, that several municipalities will be funded to register 16,500 people by May 2025, and that responsibilities are split among ministries, municipalities and agencies.

The Ministry of the Interior, with a contribution from the Ministry of Asylum and Migration, will this year provide specific grants to Amsterdam and Gilze en Rijen to carry out 16,500 BRP registrations between November 2024 and May 2025.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties verstrekt nog dit jaar, met een bijdrage van het Ministerie van Asiel en Migratie, specifieke uitkeringen aan de gemeente Amsterdam en de gemeente Gilze en Rijen om in de periode van november 2024 tot mei 2025 16.500 inschrijvingen in de BRP te gaan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koekkoek, Van Nispen en Ceder over het artikel 'The brutal truth behind Italy’s migrant reduction: beatings and rape by EU-funded forces in Tunisia'

MPs Koekkoek, Van Nispen and Ceder asked the government about a Guardian report on abuses by Tunisian coast guard forces funded through EU migration cooperation, including rape, beatings, EU financing, and EU monitoring. The government answered that it has raised concerns with the European Commission, that EU funds must not contribute to human rights violations, that it has no independently verified evidence of several alleged abuses, and that it will keep raising human rights in bilateral and EU contacts.
The Netherlands has conveyed these concerns to the European Commission.
Nederland heeft deze zorgen bij de Europese Commissie kenbaar gemaakt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bamenga over het bericht dat een van de Regionale Informatie en Expertisecentra (RIEC) jarenlang persoonsgegevens over nationaliteit en land van herkomst verzamelde

MPs Van Nispen and Bamenga asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that a RIEC recorded nationality and country of origin for years, including a 2016 draft analysis with discriminatory wording about Turkish Dutch people and neighbourhoods labelled as enforcement bottlenecks. The minister distanced the government from the wording, stated that nationality is not a signal for RIEC cases, that the practice was dropped in 2022, and declined to commission statistical research or ask the Data Protection Authority to investigate.

Are you willing to conduct statistical research into indications that people with a non-Dutch background or lower socio-economic class have been investigated by the RIEC far more often than people with a Dutch background or higher socio-economic class? If not, why not?

Bent u bereid statistisch onderzoek te doen naar aanwijzingen dat personen met een niet-Nederlandse achtergrond of een lagere sociaal-economische klasse veel vaker zijn onderzocht door het RIEC dan mensen met een Nederlandse achtergrond of een hogere sociaal-economische klasse? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar Klassenjustitie in Nederland

MPs asked whether the NOS/Investico and Groene Amsterdammer findings that lower-educated suspects with a migration background receive harsher treatment indicate class justice, and what the government will do. The minister answered that such unequal treatment is unacceptable, that the OM and judiciary are addressing it, and that two WODC studies due mid-2025 will determine any further measures.
On the basis of the outcome of these studies we will assess whether, and if so which, additional measures in the criminal justice chain should be taken to counter any unjustified unequal treatment.

Aan de hand van de uitkomst van deze onderzoeken zullen wij beoordelen of, en zo ja, welke aanvullende maatregelen in de strafrechtketen genomen dienen te worden om eventuele ongerechtvaardigde ongelijke behandeling tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de aanpak van witteboordencriminaliteit faalt en is verslechterd de afgelopen jaren

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the fight against white-collar crime is failing, including that more fraud suspects escape punishment and that prosecution priorities are too narrow. The minister disputes the data basis, says white-collar crime lacks a clear definition, points to ongoing priorities on corruption and money laundering, extra funding, and states that the strict enforcement of fraud and money-laundering offences is handled through the OM.
It is unclear on which data the conclusions of the Financieel Dagblad article are based.
Het is onduidelijk op welke gegevens de conclusies uit het artikel van het Financieel Dagblad zijn gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het voornemen om tien procent te bezuinigen op de crisisbeheersing en de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Justice and Security minister about a planned 10% cut to the disaster-control grant (BDuR) for safety regions and whether it is an unintended effect of the coalition agreement, and how it will affect regional crisis management and volunteer fire services. The government confirms the 10% cut and its effect on regional budgets, says the BDuR will remain a specific grant, and points to a feasibility study on volunteer firefighters and natural-fire funding.
The cabinet has since decided that the BDuR will continue to exist as a specific grant.
Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten dat de BDuR blijft voortbestaan als specifieke uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Lahlah over de omgang met het parlement en de problemen in het gevangeniswezen

MPs Van Nispen and Lahlah asked whether a PVV motion on prison clothing was coordinated with the state secretary and whether the government is serious about parliament and prison staff concerns. The state secretary denied any pre-arranged contact or media plan, said plans to restrict branded clothing predate the motion, and said he takes parliament and staff seriously.
There was no contact between the PVV MP and me before the two-minute debate regarding the motion submitted by the PVV MP, other than the usual sounding out by my political assistant.

Er is geen sprake geweest van contact tussen het PVV-Kamerlid en mij voorafgaand aan het tweeminutendebat ten aanzien van de door het PVV-Kamerlid ingediende motie, anders dan de gebruikelijke sondering door mijn politiek assistent.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat rijkere gemeenten meer sociaaljuridische hulp hebben en dat er juist minder sociaaljuridische hulp is in gemeenten met meer mensen met schulden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about a study finding that wealthier municipalities offer more socio-legal aid while municipalities with more debt problems offer less, and whether this inequality should be addressed with a nationwide network. The State Secretary acknowledged the study's findings but noted its limitations, said municipalities are responsible for debt aid, and committed to national discussions and a regional pilot in Noord/Midden Limburg to improve access.
It is essential in a constitutional state that citizens have good access to justice, including (socio-)legal assistance.
Het is essentieel in een rechtsstaat dat burgers goede toegang hebben tot het recht, waaronder (sociaal)juridische hulp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en van Nispen over het nieuws dat veel kinderen in erbarmelijke omstandigheden wonen in de asielnoodopvang in Nederland

MPs Dijk and van Nispen asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration about the rising number of children living in harsh conditions in emergency asylum shelters, and whether this breaches children's rights, harms education and health care, and what steps will be taken. The minister acknowledges the pressure on reception capacity, admits emergency sites are poorly suited to children, and describes existing measures and ongoing talks, but gives no firm timeline for ending child placements in emergency shelters.
With the current pressure on reception capacity, however, it cannot be said by when children will no longer be housed in emergency shelters.
Met de huidige druk op de opvangcapaciteit is echter niet te zeggen op welke termijn het niet meer voor zal komen dat kinderen op noodopvanglocaties verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht Frauderende Twentse zorgondernemer gaat «gewoon» door in Drenthe: «Het liep direct al uit de hand»

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the minister how a fraudster with a history of large-scale care-fraud could again run a care provider, and how care offices check providers' past. The minister replied that screening relies on VOG, Bibob checks and care office contracting, that the Wbsrz and expanded licensing from 2025 will help, and that a Wibz bill on profit distribution and integrity is planned.
It must not be possible that someone responsible for abuses in care simply becomes active in care again.
Het moet niet kunnen dat iemand die verantwoordelijk is voor misstanden in de zorg, zomaar weer actief wordt in de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Werf, Mutluer, Michon-Derkzen, Van Nispen en Aardema over het bericht ‘Politiehack van 62.000 medewerkers is gevaarlijk: naam agent is handelswaar’

MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the police data breach exposing contact details of about 62,000 officers, including timing of notification, risks to officers and families, and safeguards against similar leaks. The minister answered that work contact details and occasionally private contact details were exposed, that a pass-the-cookie attack by likely state actors was used, that notification was delayed in part, and that measures are being taken but investigations are ongoing and the wider lessons for government systems are limited.
In the interest of the ongoing investigations, I cannot say anything about that.
In het belang van de lopende onderzoeken kan ik daar geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de tuchtrechtelijke veroordeling van de landsadvocaat

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the disciplinary reprimand of the State Advocate for keeping privileged emails, and whether the State should break with his firm. The minister answered that the emails should have been deleted once privilege was confirmed, acknowledged this should have happened, and said the matter will be discussed with the firm, while rejecting claims against the firm and refusing to reclaim fees.
I regret that these emails were not immediately removed from the file once it became clear that they concerned privileged information.
Ik vind het te betreuren dat deze e-mails niet direct uit het dossier zijn verwijderd, toen duidelijk werd dat het verschoningsgerechtigde informatie betrof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onveilige situatie voor meldingen van fraude en de barrière om meldingen te doen van misstanden

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security what has come of earlier commitments to better protect reporters of unusual transactions, notably gatekeepers such as notaries, who feel unsafe and report less, and whether anonymous reporting could be allowed. The minister replies that existing safeguards (restricted receipt by the FIU, company-name-only reporting, anonymisation by the prosecution service) are in place, that a further exploration of measures is ongoing with results due autumn 2024, and that anonymous reporting by gatekeepers is not possible because traceability of information is essential to the legal system.
It is not possible to anonymously report unusual transactions to the Financial Intelligence Unit Netherlands.
Het is niet mogelijk om anoniem meldingen van ongebruikelijke transacties te doen aan de Financial Intelligence Unit Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van de Landsadvocaat in de besluitvorming omtrent het uitroepen van een asielcrisis en de plannen voor een noodwet op het gebied van Asiel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Asylum and Migration when the Landsadvocaat (state's legal advisor) became involved in the planned asylum crisis declaration and emergency law, and why the consultation was informal and undocumented. The minister answered that informal contacts began end of August, that the process stopped after two meetings once all legal angles were covered, that no minutes exist, and that decisions and their justification will be accounted for to parliament as usual.
No minutes were made of the conversations with the Landsadvocaat.
Er is geen verslag gemaakt van de gesprekken met de Landsadvocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Een leeg shirt voor de 20-jarige voetballer, want die mag geen reclame maken voor een gokwebsite’

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the July 2025 ban on online gambling sponsorship in sport also covers amateur clubs and whether loopholes like Belgian-style foundations are closed. The State Secretary answered that the ban applies to amateur clubs too, that public advertising including sports venues is also prohibited, and promised a policy response on the Wet kansspelen op afstand evaluation before year end.
Under article II, paragraph 1, sub a of the Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand, from 1 July 2025 licensed remote gambling providers are prohibited from sponsoring sport.

Op grond van artikel II, lid 1, sub a van het Besluit ongerichte reclame kansspelen op afstand (Besluit orka) is het vanaf 1 juli 2025 verboden voor vergunde aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand om de sport te sponsoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kwart van ouders met lager inkomen doet kind niet op zwemles, oplopende kosten vaak de reden’

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the state secretary about low-income parents not enrolling children in swimming lessons due to rising costs, including VAT, municipal provision, a motion on subsidies and school swimming. The state secretary said municipal schemes and the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur exist, that no budget is available now, and that school swimming scenarios will be presented around early 2025.
I expect the results of a study by the Mulier Institute this autumn, which will clarify the obstacles for municipalities to join one or more funds.
Ik verwacht dit najaar de resultaten van een onderzoek van het Mulier Instituut waarin duidelijk wordt wat de belemmeringen voor gemeenten zijn om aan te sluiten bij één of meerdere fondsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gedwongen afstand doen van kinderen in het verleden

An MP asks the State Secretary about the UN rapporteurs' call for Dutch action on forced adoptions and baby separations from 1956 to 1984, and the government's delay and stance on truth-finding, archives, and the parliamentary motion against invoking statute of limitations. The State Secretary says the independent De Winter Commission is investigating and results are expected in spring 2025, that consequences including the limitation defence will be reconsidered then, and that dialogue with the UN rapporteurs is welcome.
In that context I will also reconsider the possibility of invoking a statute of limitations defence in proceedings concerning these events.
Daarbij zal ik ook de mogelijkheid tot het inroepen van een verjaringsverweer in procedures over deze gebeurtenissen opnieuw bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM de criminaliteit in de zorg niet meer aan kan en er jaarlijks voor 10 miljard wordt gefraudeerd

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked the Health and Justice ministers how they respond to reports that the Public Prosecution Service cannot handle healthcare crime and that around 10 billion euros is defrauded yearly, and what they will do about it. The minister answers that tackling care fraud is a priority, lists planned measures (new licensing grounds, data sharing, profit-distribution conditions, a review of open-house contracting, and stricter inspection of diplomas), and promises further letters and a bill in 2025.
I agree with the questioners that commercial interests of care providers or investors must never take precedence over the public interest in care and youth assistance.
Ik ben het eens met de vragenstellers dat commerciële belangen van zorgaanbieders of investeerders nooit vóór het maatschappelijk belang van zorg en jeugdhulp mogen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis, Inge van Dijk, van Eijk en Paulusma over de aanpak van misstanden in de danswereld

MPs from several parties asked the government why victims of abuse in the dance world feel that compensation, apologies and trauma care are missing, and why the answers to earlier questions were so cold. The government replies that it relies on the Alliantie Dans Veilig and two new commissions, refers trauma care to existing mental health providers, says compensation is for the sector and civil or criminal law, and promises continued involvement without committing to new measures.
As for compensation for victims, that is a matter for the sector itself. It is not the role of the government here.
Wat betreft een tegemoetkoming aan slachtoffers is dat aan de sector zelf. Dat is hier niet de rol van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de overwegingen van het kabinet om Nederlandse gedetineerden naar Estland te sturen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Ellian) asked the State Secretary about the government's plan to send Dutch prisoners to Estland because of a cell shortage. The State Secretary confirmed an exploratory process, said Estonia is currently the only European country known to have surplus capacity, and promised that Parliament will be informed of the outcome before any irreversible steps are taken.
Your House will be informed of the outcome of the exploration.
Uw Kamer zal worden geïnformeerd over de uitkomst van de verkenning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over malafide bewindvoerders die stelen van kwetsbare cliënten

MP Van Nispen asks about a bewindvoerder who stole from vulnerable clients, why such a person could be appointed and continue, and whether funds, lifetime bans or a public system should be introduced. The State Secretary acknowledges the abuse is unacceptable, describes existing quality requirements, court supervision, annual accounts and dismissal and registry measures, and says a WODC study on publicly organised guardianship is underway.
As soon as abuses come to light, the district judge can suspend or dismiss a guardian.
Zodra er misstanden aan het licht komen, kan de kantonrechter een bewindvoerder schorsen 3 , dan wel ontslaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de nieuwsberichten dat gemeenten vanwege een te laag ingeschatte inflatie door het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) mogelijk een half miljard euro mislopen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities are shortchanged by about half a billion euro because CPB underestimated inflation, and whether they should be fully compensated for inflation. The minister answered that the fund system grows with GDP without direct inflation compensation, that the government sees no reason to change it, and that the CPB's forecasts are independent and volatile.
In view of the above, the cabinet sees no reason to change the system.
Het kabinet ziet gezien bovenstaande geen reden om de systematiek te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Michon-Derkzen over diverse onderwerpen naar aanleiding van het werkbezoek aan Curacao en Bonaire

Michon-Derkzen and other MPs asked the government about justice-chain staffing shortages, prison problems, police equipment, the Curaçao port, the youth crime prevention, gambling regulation, the Istanbul Convention, legal aid, and related Caribbean Netherlands matters after a study visit. The minister's answers mostly state that these are autonomous responsibilities of the Caribbean countries, describe existing Dutch support, and promise further reports on several items.
The JVO is a closed consultation between the four autonomous countries of the Kingdom.
Het JVO is een besloten overleg tussen de vier autonome landen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘(Oud-)topsporters noemen lagere inkomsten ‘ramp voor de clubs’: ‘Bezuinig niet op sport’’

Three MPs asked the minister about press reports that budget cuts threaten sport, including volunteer burden, the CDA and GroenLinks-PvdA proposals, gambling tax differentiation and the health costs of cutting sport. The state secretary answered that sport is valued and that a multi-year strategy and clearer information will follow, but gave no figures on the cuts and no firm commitment on the gambling-tax motion or a sports law.
As indicated in the letter of 2 April 2024, I aim to inform the House further on this before the legislative consultation on the Sport and Exercise budget item for 2025.
Zoals aangegeven in de brief 2 van 2 april 2024 streef ik ernaar uw Kamer hier voor het wetgevingsoverleg over begrotingsonderdeel Sport en Bewegen voor het jaar 2025, nader over te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Nispen over fraude met hotelkamers voor asielopvang

An MP asked about alleged fraud and corruption involving a commercial intermediary (LCHD) that billed COA for hotel rooms for asylum reception, including Van der Valk hotels, and why no tender was held. The minister confirmed an OM/FIOD criminal investigation, defended the reliance on hotels and private intermediaries amid the reception crisis, said no tender was needed for leasing existing property, and promised an October letter on emergency reception costs.
I can confirm that the Public Prosecution Service and the FIOD are conducting a criminal investigation. Pending that, I will make no further statements on this matter.
Ik kan u bevestigen dat het OM en FIOD een strafrechtelijk onderzoek uitvoeren. Vooruitlopend daarop zal ik geen verdere uitspraken doen over deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Nispen over berichtgeving over de het verleden van de BVD met betrekking tot het uitwisselen van informatie over vermeende Indonesische communisten

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of the Interior whether she would respond to press reports that the former BVD shared information on suspected Indonesian communists with the CIA and Indonesian authorities, and whether thorough historical research should be done. The Minister replied that the files show exchanges with Western services but cannot conclusively establish BVD contribution to persecution or killings, that no information went to an Indonesian service in the 1960s as far as the files show, and that the AIVD has appointed a historical adviser to promote external academic research.
Like my predecessor, I attach great value to independent and scientific research, including into the BVD.
Net als mijn ambtsvoorganger hecht ik grote waarde aan onafhankelijk en wetenschappelijk onderzoek, ook naar de BVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over olympische sporters die moeite hebben met rondkomen

MPs asked whether the topsport stipend is adequate for elite athletes who struggle to make ends meet, whether it should be seen as a job, and about claw-back rules, the income threshold, and the ongoing review of the support package. The state secretary answered that NOC*NSF and the Fonds voor de Topsporter are primarily responsible for the stipend rules, that a new support model is being explored, and that an update will follow in autumn 2024.
It is my intention to inform your House in autumn 2024 about the progress.
Het is mijn voornemen om uw Kamer in het najaar van 2024 over de voortgang te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat opvallend veel scholieren online gokken

Opposition MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the government about reported rises in people in treatment for gambling addiction, linked to the legalisation of online gambling, and what it will do. The Secretary of State answered that a direct causal link to online legalisation cannot be shown, while acknowledging the increase is worrying and pointing to new speed limits, advertising restrictions, a planned evaluation and unchanged treatment capacity policy.
On the basis of the available figures and studies, I cannot endorse that the increase in people in treatment for gambling addiction is in large part due to the legalisation of online gambling.

Op basis van voorliggende cijfers en onderzoeken kan ik niet onderschrijven dat de toename van het aantal mensen dat in behandeling is voor gokverslaving daadwerkelijk voor het grootste gedeelte te wijten is aan het legaliseren van het online gokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de inval van overheidsdiensten bij een brievenbusfirma in Amersfoort

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a raid on a letterbox-company address in Amersfoort, where hundreds of companies were registered, and how such fraud risks are overseen. The government answered that registration of many companies at one address is legal but can signal fraud, that no single authority supervises this, and that it will conduct a problem exploration of the system, reporting around mid-2025, while pointing to various existing and planned measures.
As your House knows, I cannot and will not go into individual case matters.
Zoals uw Kamer weet kan en zal ik niet ingaan op individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te weinig personeel voor het toezicht op de AIVD en MIVD, in aanvulling op eerdere vragen over hetzelfde onderwerp van het lid Six Dijkstra (NSC)

An MP asks why oversight of the AIVD and MIVD is understaffed and under-resourced just as the Temporary Act is being introduced, and whether ministers' earlier promises were sincere. The government answers that oversight is not being scaled down, that the Temporary Act is an accent shift rather than a new oversight system, that the CTIVD is responsible for recruiting its own staff, and that application of new powers will be phased in to match the CTIVD's capacity.

When applying the Temporary Act, account is taken of the capacity problems the CTIVD faces, so that the use of powers under the Temporary Act's conditions matches the practice of implementation and oversight.

Bij de toepassing van de Tijdelijke wet wordt rekening gehouden met de capaciteitsproblemen die de CTIVD ondervindt zodat de toepassing van bevoegdheden onder de condities van de Tijdelijke wet aansluit bij de uitvoerings- en toezichtspraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Boswijk over gokverslavingen door illegale gokreclames en de negatieve rol die illegale gokbedrijven hierin spelen

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Boswijk asked about illegal targeting of online gambling ads at young people, Holland Casino's role, rising gambling addiction among youth and related suicide and poverty risks. The Secretary of State answered that the ad ban is strict and the Kansspelautoriteit enforces it, that Holland Casino made a human error and has taken structural measures, and that new play-limit rules take effect on 1 October 2024 while further research is planned.
The Gambling Authority (Ksa) supervises compliance with this and enforces where necessary.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) ziet toe op de naleving hiervan en handhaaft waar nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tekort aan sociaal advocaten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the shortage of social lawyers, whose numbers are falling while retirements rise, and about low fees and recruitment. The Secretary of State replied that the signals were already known, pointed to existing measures (training subsidy, education outreach, fee reviews by the Van der Meer II commission due end 2024), and said causes of attrition are not yet clear.
Sufficient supply of social lawyers is needed to make access to justice effective.
Er is voldoende aanbod van sociaal advocaten nodig om toegang tot het recht te kunnen effectueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over grensoverschrijdend gedrag op het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how she would respond to a union survey showing widespread bullying, intimidation and discrimination at the ministry, and what concrete steps would improve staff safety. The minister acknowledged the findings, argued internal surveys show a more positive picture, listed existing measures and said the recommendations would be discussed with unions and acted upon.
I have taken note of the report arising from the FNV survey on social safety at the Ministry of Justice and Security.
Ik heb kennis genomen van het rapport naar aanleiding van de FNV Enquête naar sociale veiligheid bij het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder, Van der Werf, Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over het eindrapport van de Commissie Schneiders, de overdracht van het dossier aan de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid en de opvolging v

MPs asked whether the Schneiders Commission should continue monitoring implementation of its 20 recommendations on the Landelijke Eenheid, given union and works council concerns that the transition is unfinished and that oversight passes to the Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid. The Minister replied that oversight rests with the police leadership through an internal monitoring process, with Schneiders staying on as adviser and the Inspectie checking quality of task performance, and that no extension of the commission is planned.
Oversight of and direction for implementing the recommendations is the responsibility of the police leadership and, by extension, the leadership of the national units.
Toezicht op en sturing geven aan de opvolging van de gedane aanbevelingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de korpsleiding en in het verlengde daarvan de leidingen van de landelijke eenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Mohandis , Inge van Dijk, Van Eijk en Paulusma over de afhandeling van de misstanden in de danswereld en de omgang met slachtoffers

MPs asked the Minister of VWS and the State Secretary of OCW how the government is handling misconduct in the dance sector, including compensation, apologies, trauma care for victims, and the status of adopted motions. The government responded that the Alliantie Dans Veilig, with recognition statements, support networks, OCW dance round tables and a school-level social safety programme, is taking action, while leaving the date for compensation and the sports-offender ban to a separate letter on motions.

Recently the omnibus letter on motions and commitments on sport and exercise was sent by the Minister of VWS to the House of Representatives, and the motions concerning the dance sector form part of it.

Onlangs is de verzamelbrief over de moties en toezeggingen sport en bewegen door de Minister van VWS naar de Tweede Kamer verzonden, de moties met betrekking tot de danssector vormen daar onderdeel van.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mohandis en van Nispen over de gestegen prijzen van zwemles

MPs Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the health minister about rising swimming lesson prices, the number of families supported by the Jeugdfonds Sport en Cultuur, funding for poor households and whether the minister will set targets to reduce children without swimming diplomas. The minister answered that the Jeugdfonds supported 20,707 children in 2023, but gave no exact figures for children in poverty, estimated costs of full funding at 3.5 to 10.5 million euro, and declined to commit to a target because swimming diplomas are primarily the parents' responsibility.
Obtaining swimming diplomas for children is primarily a responsibility of the parents.
Het behalen van zwemdiploma's door kinderen is primair een verantwoordelijkheid van de ouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over inzage in en onderzoek naar archieven met betrekking tot adopties uit Chili

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Minister for Legal Protection about access to and investigation of archives on adoptions from Chile, including documents now held by FIOM and whether they will be opened without restrictions. The minister said FIOM has opened dossier access, is discussing permanent archiving of non-personal material, and will review the scope of access in new adoption legislation, but declined to commission a separate investigation into the Chilean adoptions, citing an ongoing criminal investigation in Chile.
In the context of the new adoption legislation, I am examining the possibilities to make access to dossiers as unrestricted and complete as possible.
In het kader van de nieuwe adoptiewetgeving onderzoek ik de mogelijkheden om de inzage van dossiers zo onbeperkt en volledig mogelijk te maken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over signalen dat een grote groep mensen ten onrechte een brief heeft ontvangen van de IND waarin wordt aangegeven dat zij geen rechtmatig verblijf zouden hebben in Nede

MPs Van Nispen and Dijk asked why Dienst Toeslagen sent letters stopping allowances based on IND residence codes, causing distress and wrongful loss of benefits for some EU citizens, and asked about compensation, legal aid and prevention. The government admits a system design error, says about 800 letters were sent with 180 later reinstated, and defends the approach while promising to reinstate and not claw back benefits where residence is confirmed.
The cabinet finds it highly undesirable that persons who are not lawfully residing in the Netherlands and therefore have no entitlement to allowances receive them.
Het kabinet vindt het zeer onwenselijk dat personen niet rechtmatig in Nederland verblijven en dus geen recht hebben op toeslagen deze ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mensen met schulden en zzp’ers die in de knel komen door te strenge regels voor de aanvraag van rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked whether people with debts are excluded from legal aid because their taxable income exceeds the Wrb limit, whether disposable income should be used, why that was abolished in 2006, and whether self-employed people are unfairly excluded. The minister confirmed the exclusion, acknowledged hardship cases, announced a temporary discretionary scheme for seizure cases and a study of lower middle incomes, but refused to change the rules for now.
Currently it is being explored whether a temporary legal basis can be created for the Council to deviate from the Wrb means-test system in these cases.
Momenteel wordt nader verkend of er een tijdelijke grondslag voor de Raad gecreëerd kan worden om in deze gevallen af te wijken van de systematiek voor de draagkrachttoetsing van de Wrb.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Mohandis en Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden sportclubs niet meer kunnen verduurzamen

MPs Van Dijk, Mohandis and Van Nispen asked the minister about reports that hundreds of sports clubs cannot sustainably upgrade their facilities because the BOSA subsidy budget is exhausted, and about whether the budget should be increased. The minister answered that the budget ceiling for 2024 is raised from 79 to 111.5 million euro, that demand still exceeds it, and that the application portal closes on 1 August.
The subsidy ceiling for 2024 is thus raised in total from 79 million euro to 111.5 million euro.
Het subsidieplafond voor 2024 wordt daarmee in totaal verhoogd van € 79 miljoen naar € 111,5 miljoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mutluer en Van Nispen over alarmpistolen die door jongeren worden omgebouwd tot dodelijke vuurwapens

MPs Mutluer and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about youths converting alarm pistols into lethal firearms, including conviction figures, social media sales, youth motives, and cross-border and platform enforcement. The minister answered that 265 of 1,721 weapons convictions in 2023 involved minors, announced a youth weapons action plan review and a National Firearms Focal Point, and said Telegram's DSA obligations and cross-border enforcement would be pursued.
The Judiciary's registration systems cannot search specifically for convictions for selling or possessing an alarm pistol.
In de registratiesystemen van de Rechtspraak kan niet specifiek gezocht worden op veroordelingen voor het verkopen of bezitten van een alarmpistool.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord

Three MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether civil servants had made a legal analysis of the coalition agreement, whether it would be shared under Article 68 of the Constitution, and whether analyses from other ministries would be shared. The answer refers to a separate letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement dated 7 June 2024, rather than answering the questions directly in this document.

The written questions from MPs Sneller, Chakor and Van Nispen on legal analysis(es) of the coalition agreement (submitted 30 May 2024) were answered by way of a letter on civil-service analyses of the coalition agreement.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sneller, Chakor, Van Nispen over Juridische analyse(s) van het hoofdlijnenakkoord (ingezonden 30 mei 2024) zijn beantwoord middels een brief over Ambtelijke analyses hoofdlijnenakkoord
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi en Palmen over mankementen in het huidige boetesysteem in Nederland

MPs Van Nispen, Lahlah, El Abassi and Palmen asked the Justice Minister about problems in the Dutch traffic fine system, including imprisonment for unpaid fines (gijzeling), debt, child welfare effects, insurance fines, proportionality of escalating reminders, and the possibility of income-dependent fines. The Minister answered that gijzeling is subject to judicial review and that payment arrangements exist, but declined to adopt income-based fines, a 30% reduction, or a maximum of 150 euro, citing costs and burden on the criminal justice chain, while promising a WODC evaluation and a ministry study on escalation.
We cannot entirely rule out that children were placed out of home at the time because their parent was imprisoned for non-payment.
Wij kunnen niet geheel uitsluiten dat kinderen destijds uit huis zijn geplaatst doordat hun ouder werd gegijzeld.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Inruim 400 woonwijken ligt tot 10.000 kilo vuurwerk opgeslagen: 'Dat is 400 keer heel gevaarlijk''

MP Van Nispen asked about reports that up to 10,000 kg of fireworks are stored in about 400 residential neighbourhoods, and about the Twente report on fireworks disasters, brigade firefighting instructions, and whether storage in residential areas should be banned. The government answers that storage rules (sprinklers, fire walls, 8-metre distance) apply, that a joint cabinet response to the Twente report is in preparation, that evacuation is now the priority in fireworks fires, and that it will inform parliament before the summer recess on whether rules should be tightened.
Parliament will be informed about this before the summer recess.
Uw Kamer wordt hier voor het zomerreces over geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de beïnvloeding van de Eritrese diaspora door de Eritrese regering

MPs Dobbe and Van Nispen asked whether the Eritrean government influences its diaspora in the Netherlands, what measures will prevent this, and whether a new investigation is planned. The minister answers that the evidence of pressure is mixed, that the OBI approach and earlier measures remain in place, that diaspora taxation cannot be banned under current law, and that no new investigation is planned beyond the earlier study.
The cabinet acknowledges that the social pressure Eritreans in the Netherlands apparently experience cannot be ignored.
Het kabinet erkent dat de sociale druk die Eritreeërs in Nederland kennelijk ervaren niet kan worden genegeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Six Dijkstra en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Oud-NCTV-chef Schoof werd gewaarschuwd dat burgers online volgen via nepaccounts waarschijnlijk niet mocht'

MPs Six Dijkstra and Van Nispen asked whether the NCTV knowingly continued internet monitoring via fake accounts without a legal basis, and why documents were released only after a court order. The minister denies the NCTV acted unlawfully, says the legal view was long held to be defensible, admits the Woo deadline was overrun, and points to new supervision under the 2023 coordination act.
It is not good that the statutory period within which documents should be provided has been exceeded.
Het is niet goed dat de wettelijke termijn waarbinnen stukken behoren te worden verstrekt is overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Uitermark over het bericht ‘Ook mensen met een paar jaar cel niet in gevangenis door personeelstekort’

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that some offenders with multi-year prison sentences are not being summoned to prison due to staff shortages, including those with sentences near four and five years, and asked for breakdowns by sentence length, offence type, and the self-surrender criteria. The Minister confirmed that twelve outstanding self-surrenders have sentences over three years (highest about 4.5 years), that 87.1% have 90 days or less remaining, explained the CJIB assessment framework and the temporary summons stop for adult male self-surrenders, and said the one-week deadline could not be met.
Due to the potential traceability to individuals, I do not provide information on individual cases.
In verband met de potentiële herleidbaarheid naar personen verstrek ik geen informatie over individuele zaken.
Antwoord opvragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dobbe over het bericht 'Rechter gefrustreerd: klinieken willen verward persoon niet opnemen'

Two SP MPs asked, after a court ruling, how the government will ensure a man with a court-ordered care measure is placed in a secure care facility rather than left homeless, and what is being done about the wider placement problem. The minister answered that a place was found and the man admitted from 29 March 2024, acknowledged that secure specialist places are scarce, and said a work agenda and a letter on the Wzd and forensic care alignment will follow before summer.
As far as we are aware, that information is also not registered.
Voor zover ons bekend wordt die informatie ook niet geregistreerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de documentaire ‘Jehovah – Van God Los’ over seksueel misbruik in de gemeenschap van Jehovah’s Getuigen, harde uitsluiting uit de gemeenschap en zelfs suïcides

An MP asked the Ministers about a documentary on sexual abuse, shunning and suicides within Jehovah's Witnesses, asking about internal handling of abuse reports, the confidentiality of internal records, the ANBI status of religious organisations, and whether shunning should be criminalised. The government answered that victims must be able to report to Dutch authorities, that privacy rules apply to the community's records, that the ANBI rules are neutral but the government can speak out, that a helpline platform and further research are planned, and that criminalising exclusion is not appropriate.
Regardless of the internal procedures of a religious community, victims must in all cases have the possibility to report crimes within the Dutch legal system.
Ongeacht de interne procedures van een religieuze gemeenschap, moeten slachtoffers in alle gevallen de mogelijkheid hebben om binnen het Nederlandse rechtssysteem aangifte te doen van misdrijven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen en Koekkoek over gestapelde gezinshereniging

MPs Piri, Veldkamp, Van Nispen and Koekkoek asked the Minister of Justice and Security why she claimed thousands of people were affected by chained family reunification (nareis-op-nareis), given IND's uncertainty and expert signals of a marginal phenomenon, and how this squares with the cabinet's fall. The Minister answered that her conclusion rested on general family reunification figures and IND's Stand van de uitvoering 2023, that the law leaves room for misuse, that a broad migration package could not be agreed and the change is left to a next cabinet.
I concluded, based on the general figures on family reunification plus the total inflow figures and the IND's Stand van de uitvoering, that chained family reunification is a problem.
Ik heb op basis van de algemene cijfers over nareis plus de totale instroom cijfers en de Stand van de uitvoering 5 van de IND geconcludeerd dat nareis op nareis een knelpunt is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Dijk over barrières voor sociaal advocaten om toeslagenouders juridisch bij te staan

SP MPs asked the government why the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand reverted the temporary 0.5 unit weighting for childcare-benefit (toeslagen) cases, lowering the number of parents each lawyer can help, and raised concerns about information withholding, procedural obstacles and the position of children in the restoration scheme. The State Secretary answered that the reversion restores standard policy now that the restoration workload has started, that information sharing has been improved, and that no new independent route for children before the Commissie Werkelijke Schade is planned.
It is not desirable that a different quality standard is applied to the assistance of affected parents than to regular cases.
Het is niet wenselijk dat er voor de bijstand van gedupeerde ouders een andere kwaliteitsstandaard wordt gehanteerd dan voor reguliere zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over het bericht dat gemeenten de nieuwe norm voor grotere schoolpleinen niet meenemen in beleid

SP MPs asked whether the government will act on reports that municipalities are not applying the new norm for larger school playgrounds in their policy, and whether they will discuss this with the VNG and school associations or fund larger playgrounds. The minister replied that the norm is a non-binding guideline, that space trade-offs are a municipal responsibility, that the government will discuss it with the VNG and school associations, and that municipal funds are freely spendable.
It is possible that municipalities sometimes get into difficulty in this area and have to make choices.
Het is mogelijk dat gemeenten soms in de knel komen op dit vlak en keuzes moeten maken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dobbe en Van Nispen over de berichten 'Recordaantal meldingen van personen met verward gedrag in 2023' en 'Duizenden kwetsbaren wachten op plek beschermd wonen'

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of health and justice about rising reports of people with confused behaviour reaching police and about waiting lists for protected housing, asking whether ggz shortages and funding cuts cause these trends. The minister answered all 14 questions in substance, rejecting a causal link to ggz capacity and maximum waiting times, while acknowledging long waits and listing existing programmes.

I do not have data on how many homeless people who come into contact with the police over confused behaviour are on a waiting list for protected housing or have previously been admitted to a ggz institution.

Ik beschik niet over gegevens over hoeveel mensen die dakloos zijn en in aanraking komen met politie vanwege verward gedrag, op een wachtlijst voor beschermd wonen staan of eerder opgenomen zijn geweest in een ggz-instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de gebrekkige nazorg zoals PTSS behandeling bij de politie’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about inadequate aftercare and PTSD treatment for firefighters, including the lack of insight into PTSD cases, the classification of PTSD as occupational illness, costs and salary deductions for affected firefighters, and whether the government will act. The Minister acknowledges there is no good overview of firefighters with PTSD, says the employer responsibility lies with the 25 safety regions, reports discussions in the Veiligheidsberaad and that a model PTSD scheme is being developed, and promises to keep monitoring and inform parliament.
I agree with you that there is currently no good insight into the number of firefighters with PTSD in the Netherlands.
Met u constateer ik dat er momenteel geen goed zicht is op het aantal brandweermensen met PTSS in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Nederlandse geheime dienst maakte decennia gebruik van naziapparaat’

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the Minister knew that the BVD used Gestapo and Sicherheitsdienst files, including torture confessions, to spy on former resistance fighters, and whether such use should be condemned and independent research allowed. Minister De Jonge answered that the BVD's use of Nazi documents is described in a 1995 study, that torture is categorically rejected, that the BVD did not use Nazi methods, and that the AIVD will cooperate with any NIOD research while rejecting claims of a broader loss of trust or the need for large-scale investigation.
It goes without saying that I reject torture.
Het spreekt voor zich dat ik folteringen verwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat er miljoenen euro's extra nodig zijn om de brandweer in Noord-Holland Noord overeind te houden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the Noord-Holland Noord safety region needs several million euros more to keep fire brigade capacity adequate, and whether staffing and safety are at risk. The minister said the safety board is free to allocate its funds within legal frameworks, that municipalities are responsible for providing resources, that staffing is currently still responsible but under pressure, and that volunteer recruitment is primarily a regional responsibility.
The board of the safety region is free to spend these funds at its own discretion provided current regulations are complied with.
Het bestuur van de veiligheidsregio is vrij deze middelen naar eigen inzicht te besteden mits aan vigerende regelgeving wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en PSV in zee gingen met dubieuze Aziatische gokbedrijven'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether Ajax and PSV's sponsorship deals with Asian gambling firms were adequately vetted for money-laundering risks, and about the legal framework, supervision, the planned gambling sponsorship ban and Curaçao's gambling reform. The government answered that football clubs are not gatekeepers under the Wwft, that supervisors' investigations are confidential, that the sponsorship ban applies from 1 July 2025 with no acceleration, and that the Curaçao law is delayed but being monitored.
Whether supervisors are investigating particular cases or entities is supervisory-confidential information.
Of toezichthouders onderzoek doen naar bepaalde casussen of entiteiten is toezichtsvertrouwelijke informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hoe een schaduwteam van Yeşilgöz een omstreden asielaanpak doorvoerde’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about an NRC report on a 'shadow team' that shaped the asylum approach to nuisance-causing asylum seekers, raising concerns about ethnic profiling, unclear definitions of nuisance, pressure on the Public Prosecution Service, and procurement rules. The Minister denies ethnic profiling is permitted or occurred, says the Public Prosecution Service acts independently, defends the approach as operating within existing law, and declines to publish the internal documents directly, referring to a separate information request response.
By letter of 1 March, the request for information from MP Podt on this matter has been carried out.
Bij brief van 1 maart jl. is er uitvoering gegeven aan het Informatieverzoek van lid Podt hieromtrent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een oplichter die meerdere malen met succes vrouwen heeft opgelicht en niet te stoppen lijkt

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers why a suspected romance fraudster who defrauded several women keeps operating, whether the civil route is realistic for victims, and what can be done to stop him. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that victims can always report to the police and pursue civil claims, and that it is working on lowering court fees and on fraud prevention and the role of notaries and guardianship bodies.
Let me first state that I do not comment on individual cases.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat ik geen uitspraken doe over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over het feit dat het niet noodgevallen nummer van de Brandweer in handen is van een commerciële partij

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked why the non-emergency fire brigade number 0900-0904 is operated by a commercial party, why callers pay per-minute fees, and why it is not free like the Marechaussee number. The minister answered that KPN is not the owner but a platform provider, the number is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking, service fees partly cover costs without profit, and cost estimates for free numbers were not provided.
The number 0900-0904 is not in the hands of a commercial party, but is managed by the Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Het nummer 0900-0904 is niet in handen van een commerciële partij, maar in beheer bij de Landelijke Meldkamer Samenwerking (LMS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de conclusies van het inspectierapport ‘vernietiging adoptiedossiers’ en de rechtsbescherming van geadopteerden

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the inspection report on destruction of adoption files, the timeliness and suitability of INEA services, the complaints route, transfer and digitisation of files, and oversight. The Minister mostly referred to earlier policy, stated that the Archiefwet does not apply to private intermediaries but the Wobka and AVG do, promised to address the Wobka and an oversight role for the Inspectie JenV, and declined to establish an independent investigation or complaints point.
I therefore see no added value in an independent reporting point.
Ik zie daarom geen meerwaarde in een onafhankelijk meldpunt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het persbericht ‘Griffierechten verlaagd’ om een verhoging van de griffierechten aan te kondigen

An SP MP asked why a government press release framed a partial indexation of court fees as a fee reduction, and whether this improves access to justice. The minister defended the framing, stating fees are about 13.5% lower than if full indexation had applied, backed by a structural 27 million euro, and pointed to a broader access-to-justice programme.
Not indexing for 2023 and partially applying indexation for 2024 means court fees for litigants are structurally about 13.5% lower than if the indexations had been fully applied.
Het niet indexeren voor 2023 en het gedeeltelijk doorvoeren van de indexering voor 2024 betekent voor rechtzoekenden dat de griffierechten structureel circa 13,5% lager uitkomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over bericht ‘Sabotage in Iran: een missie in duisternis’

An SP member asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers for a timeline of the alleged AIVD operation sabotaging Iran's nuclear program, when the AIVD was approached by the CIA and Mossad, whether Parliament was informed, and whether AIVD agents routinely join foreign services' operations. The government declined on substance, citing the statutory duty of secrecy on service methods, and pointed to CTIVD oversight and the CIVD channel for any future briefing.
Given the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the services' methods, I cannot respond substantively to the alleged Dutch involvement.
Gelet op de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten, kan ik niet inhoudelijk reageren op vermeende betrokkenheid van Nederland.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de berichten 'Affaires, ruzies, gesprekken met de psychiater: Amsterdamse politici decennialang bespioneerd door de veiligheidsdienst', 'Leden van het Nederlands Auschwitz C

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of the Interior about press reports that the domestic security service BVD spied on politicians, Auschwitz Committee members and others for decades, including whether this was lawful, proportionate, and subject to political control. The minister answered that the BVD operated under a then-applicable, thinly codified legal framework in a different threat context, that the BVD kept no records of its information exchanges, and that the files were transferred to the National Archives with partial access restrictions.
The BVD did not keep track of what those services did with the information they received.
De BVD hield geen overzicht bij van wat er door die diensten met de door hen ontvangen informatie werd gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het doorprocederen tegen geadopteerden

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why the state keeps appealing against adoptees such as Mr Noordoven, delays a Woo document request, and does not reimburse their litigation costs. The minister defends the appeal as clarifying legal questions, says the Woo request is complex and not tied to the civil case, and only states that settlement talks on compensation are ongoing without disclosing outcomes.
I cannot provide any information on the outcome of these discussions.
Ik kan geen mededelingen doen over de uitkomst van deze gesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijk en Van Nispen over het vertrek van demissionaire ministers

SP MPs asked the Prime Minister why he agreed to early departures of caretaker ministers, whether such exits harm continuity and public trust, and whether pensions continue. The government answered that the PM does not grant or refuse such departures, that staying is generally desirable but a personal decision, and that continuity is handled case by case; it gave no new commitment.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de steunmaatregelen om amateurverenigingen voor de hoge energieprijzen te compenseren in 2024 komen te vervallen

An SP MP asked why temporary energy-cost support for amateur sports clubs and public swimming pools ends in 2024 and whether clubs are at risk without it. The minister replied that the support was explicitly temporary (2022–2023), that no alternative plan is planned, that the sector is being monitored, and that a decision on further energy support is for a future cabinet.
Last winter I supported public swimming pools and amateur sports clubs through non-structural specific grants to municipalities.
Afgelopen winter heb ik openbare zwembaden en amateursportverenigingen door middel van niet-structurele specifieke uitkeringen aan gemeenten ondersteund.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Sneller over zorgen over de uitwerking van een Kamerbreed aangenomen motie voor de aanbesteding van tolkendiensten in Nederland en de grote zorgen over de toekomst va

Three MPs from SP, VVD and D66 asked the Minister of Justice and Security about concerns that the implementation of a House-adopted motion on tolk tenders (removing travel costs and raising the registration tariff by 15 euro) could leave court interpreters worse off. The Minister answered that the tariff increase is meant to compensate interpreters, that pay will be monitored, and that a full assessment of hourly rates will follow later.
Once service provision is fully implemented and the relevant data are available, the fees that intermediaries pay to self-employed interpreters will become transparent.
Zodra dienstverlening volledig is geïmplementeerd en de gegevens hierover beschikbaar zijn, worden de vergoedingen, die intermediairs aan zelfstandig ondernemende tolken betalen, inzichtelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters het vonnis al klaar hadden liggen voor de uitspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that judges had drafted verdicts before hearings, which he said could undermine trust in the judiciary. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the Hague Court of Appeal disputes their accuracy, called draft verdicts exceptional, and declined to order a survey of courts or consult the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
In my view this does not show bias before the verdict has been formally determined by the judges.
Naar mijn mening geeft dit geen blijk van vooringenomenheid voordat de uitspraak formeel is vastgesteld door de rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het percentage kinderen zonder zwemdiploma is verdubbeld

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the doubling of children without a swimming diploma, the large income gap in swimming skills, and steps to reverse the post-COVID decline and reinstate school swimming. The minister calls the situation worrying and points to municipal and private initiatives, Jeugdfonds support, and a national study on reintroducing school swimming expected in early 2024.
At present I am having research carried out into the total costs and requirements of reintroducing school swimming at national level.
Op dit moment laat ik onderzoeken wat de totale kosten en vereisten zouden zijn voor het herinvoeren van schoolzwemmen op landelijk niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het Witboek zwembaden voor gemeenten van de FNV

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the minister about the FNV white paper on swimming pools, pool workers' fragmented collective agreements and low pay, school swimming, pool greening, and a national swimming diploma, referring to earlier motions. The minister largely responded by pointing to existing initiatives, pilots, studies, and ongoing talks with stakeholders, committing to inform the Chamber before the next committee meeting.
As previously promised, I will inform you before the WGO Sport 2024 about the (preliminary) outcomes of both studies.
Zoals eerder toegezegd, informeer ik u voorafgaand aan het WGO Sport 2024 over de (voorlopige) uitkomsten van beide onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een kwart van de speeltuinen binnen vijf jaar dreigt te verdwijnen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether they would act on reports that a quarter of playgrounds may close within five years and whether a sports/play norm, a statutory basis for playgrounds, and more support for volunteers were planned.
