The minister said the data cannot establish the severity, that playground policy is a municipal responsibility, that the government is studying the added value of statutory anchoring, and that it cannot guarantee playgrounds will survive.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat online casino’s spelers misleiden om overmatig te gaan gokken

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that major online casinos mislead players into excessive gambling, including high default stakes, hidden bonus conditions, unwanted bonus harassment and state-owned operators' conduct. The minister responded that the Kansspelautoriteit is responsible for enforcement, that talks with operators and the Consumentenbond are underway, that stricter rules and a responsible-gaming package are being prepared, and that the Wet koa will be evaluated before drawing conclusions.
The Consumentenbond has not made its research data public.
De Consumentenbond heeft haar onderzoeksgegevens niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Van Nispen over inzage door geadopteerden in hun eigen adoptiedossier

MPs Ellian and Van Nispen asked why people adopted within the Netherlands still lack unhindered access to their adoption and separation files, which are held in fragmented places, and what interests could outweigh that access. The minister acknowledged the fragmentation and outlined transfers to the National Archives, noting that access rights are strong but not absolute and that private institutions fall outside government control.
An adoptee or relinquished person has the right to information about their origins.
Een afgestane of geadopteerde heeft het recht op afstammingsinformatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuik en Bikker over het bericht dat influencers via Telegram slachtoffers voor duizenden euro’s oplichten door neppe sportuitslagen te helpen promoten

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that influencers promote fake sports results on Telegram to defraud young people, and about the harms of matchfixing and gambling. The minister answered that the influencers are described as inciting followers to crimes, that fraud prevention campaigns and gambling-integrity rules are in place, that the online gambling law will be evaluated in 2024, and that further measures on advertising and responsible gambling are planned.
I am aware of the report about influencers who lure young people into the arms of fraudsters.
Ik ben bekend met het bericht over influencers die jongeren in de armen van oplichters lokken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Temmink over het bericht dat de gemeente Den Haag, in navolging van de gemeente Deventer, cameradrones toepast bij het inspecteren van dakkapellen en uitbouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Temmink asked about municipalities using camera drones to inspect dakkapellen and extensions, raising privacy, DPIA, aviation permit, retention, anonymisation and legality concerns. The Minister answered that municipalities are responsible for privacy compliance, that Deventer and Den Haag have taken steps (DPIA, notices, blurring, limited retention), and that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens and courts will judge lawfulness.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for compliance with privacy legislation.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van privacywetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de conclusies van het inspectierapport ‘vernietiging adoptiedossiers’

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection, in 27 numbered questions, about the inspection report on the destruction of intercountry adoption files, the state's liability and compensation, oversight of adoption intermediaries, and adoptees' access to records. The minister answered that no information about adoptees themselves was lost, that compensation is not planned in favour of expanded support through the INEA centre, and that the state continues to defend pending civil claims.
I see no reason to stop defending the currently ongoing proceedings.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om niet langer verweer te voeren in de thans lopende procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuws dat Sociaal Raadslieden moeten stoppen met hun werk waardoor een belangrijke toegang tot het recht voor mensen wegvalt

An MP asked the minister about news that the social legal aid service (Sociaal Raadslieden) in Breda would close due to budget cuts, and about its wider importance and funding. The minister replied that the proposal was reversed, that funding and provision are municipal responsibilities, and that a Divosa inventory of first-line legal aid across municipalities is expected in October 2023.
Social legal aid work is a responsibility of the municipality. The municipality is autonomous in this and is directed by the municipal council.
Het sociaal raadsliedenwerk is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente. De gemeente is hierin autonoom en wordt daarin aangestuurd door de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het hoger beroep van moeders die gedwongen hun kind moesten afstaan in de periode 1956 tot en met 1984.

The SP MP Van Nispen asks whether the government honours the motion calling on the state to waive limitation defences in past domestic adoption cases, including the appeal by Trudy Scheele-Gertsen and Bureau Clara Wichmann. Minister Weerwind replies that limitation must remain available for legal certainty and a fair engagement with the past, that the state is not categorically excluding it, and that the independent commission's findings will be followed by appropriate consequences, to be reported around late 2024.
Being able to invoke limitation in legal proceedings is, in my view, essential for a balanced engagement with the past and for the proper functioning of the rule of law.
Het kunnen doen van een beroep op verjaring in een juridische procedure is mijns inziens essentieel voor een evenwichtige omgang met het verleden en voor het goed functioneren van de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over een actieve sekte in Zeeland waar mensen worden misleid en waar miljoenen euro’s omgaan

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an active cult in Zeeland (Maerloo) whose members give up personal assets, and about the lack of a reporting point for cult victims and the limited police capacity on sects. The Minister says the matter is known, that prosecution is for police and the public prosecutor and cannot be discussed, that a reporting point is not chosen and victim help is being explored within existing structures, with information due by year end.
Insofar as this question aims to inquire about any criminal measures taken or being taken against (members of) Maerloo, I note that I cannot and may not comment on this.

Voor zover met deze vraagstelling wordt beoogd te informeren naar eventuele strafrechtelijke maatregelen die zijn/worden getroffen jegens (leden van) Maerloo, merk ik op dat ik mij hierover niet kan en mag uitlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker  en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Keer op keer werd de minister gewaarschuwd, en nu heeft Nederland 450.000 nieuwe gokkers'

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked whether the government was warned about online gambling advertising increasing youth gambling after the 2021 Kansspelen op afstand law, and about the Finance Ministry's dealings with Nederlandse Loterij and the gambling sector. The minister declined to answer the historical questions substantively, promising a Kamerbrief after a document search, and summarised later advertising restrictions and the Finance Ministry's shareholder pressure on Nederlandse Loterij.
Answering these questions is only possible after a thorough search of information and communication systems and archives within my ministry.
Beantwoording van deze vragen acht ik alleen mogelijk na een grondige zoekslag in informatie- en communicatiesystemen en archieven binnen mijn ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Temmink en Van Nispen over de lobbyactiviteiten van de fabrikant van de taser

MPs Temmink and Van Nispen asked whether police officers were invited to a Axon (taser maker) roadshow with gifts and meals, how new police equipment is procured, and whether the term 'excited delirium' is scientifically grounded. The Minister says the roadshow page was removed, no police invitations were found, procurement is demand-led under police purchasing policy, and it is not for the Minister to research the medical diagnosis.
As far as can be checked, it has not appeared that police officers were invited to this roadshow.
Voor zover dat nagegaan kan worden is niet gebleken dat voor deze roadshow politiefunctionarissen zouden zijn uitgenodigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de schokkende adoptiemisstanden in Chili en het verhaal van de geadopteerde Mirjam Hunze

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about alleged child abduction and illegal adoption practices in Chile involving a Dutch nun, and about the Fiom files and a risk that records passed through the nun's heirs could be lost. The Minister acknowledged the cases, said an ongoing criminal investigation in Chile should be awaited, noted that Inea has received documents from the heirs and is inventorying them, and offered openness to talk with affected adoptees.
The Dutch embassy in Chile has confirmed that a criminal investigation is underway in Chile into several cases of alleged illegal adoption practices.
Door de Nederlandse ambassade in Chili is bevestigd dat er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek in Chili loopt naar meerdere gevallen van vermeende illegale adoptiepraktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de positieve resultaten van de evaluatie Huizen van het Recht en de vervolgplannen van het Kabinet

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the positive findings of the evaluation of the Huis van het Recht pilot in Heerlen and the government's follow-up plans. The minister welcomed the findings as valuable, declined a detailed policy response pending a WODC overarching analysis expected in early 2024, and promised to inform parliament on the national follow-up afterwards.
A comprehensive policy response to this specific evaluation report is not something I consider opportune.
Een uitgebreide beleidsreactie op dit specifieke evaluatierapport vind ik niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de grote toegevoegde waarde die rechtswinkels hebben voor eerstelijns rechtshulpverlening

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the value of law shops for first-line legal aid, their under-resourcing, and the lack of coverage in some regions. The minister agreed on the importance of collaboration with the bar and professionalisation, noted no proof yet that law shops relieve the legal process, and said mapping of first-line provision by Divosa is due in October 2023 while declining to set up new law shops or invest directly.
Divosa has therefore been asked to carry out a mapping study of independent first-line provision in all Dutch municipalities.
Daarom is Divosa gevraagd om een inventariserend onderzoek naar de onafhankelijke eerstelijnsvoorzieningen in alle gemeenten in Nederland te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over een agent die veroordeeld is voor racistische belediging en een functie krijgt bij de vreemdelingenpolitie

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister why a police officer convicted of racist insults was set to take a temporary post at the aliens police, and whether the case was handled adequately. The minister answered that the appointment has since been reconsidered and deemed unsuitable, that the disciplinary and criminal sanctions were applied, and that no specific measures for the Rotterdam force are currently seen as necessary.
I cannot go into individual cases that are before the judge.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die onder de rechter zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een slachtoffers die na jaren procederen nog steeds geen geld heeft teruggekregen van hun bewezen oplichters en het opzetten van een fonds voor slachtoffers van oplichting

Van Nispen (SP) asked why a couple defrauded of 141,000 euro has, after five years of civil litigation, recovered nothing, and whether a state fund for fraud victims should be set up with the state recovering from perpetrators. The minister said he cannot comment on the individual case, pointed to criminal-case damages claims, civil enforcement by bailiffs and bank data procedures, announced lower court fees, and declined to create a victim fund or to investigate one.
I cannot go into this individual case, but I understand that having to litigate for years to recover the amount owed is extremely frustrating and can produce distressing situations.

Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele kwestie maar ik begrijp dat het jarenlang moeten procederen om het verschuldigde bedrag terug te krijgen buitengewoon frustrerend is en schrijnende situaties kan opleveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de totstandkoming van de brief over de toekomst van interlandelijke adoptie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the letter on the future of intercountry adoption was drafted, after press reports that an earlier draft proposed ending adoption and that D66 objected to it. The minister answers that his view has not changed, only the implementation: adoption remains possible in a stricter system, the five-year phase-out deadline was dropped, and he rejects the claim of backroom politics and declines to resubmit the decision to parliament.
On balance I have concluded that children's interests are best served when they can be safely cared for in their own country, culture, and close to their biological family.
Ik heb alles overwegend geconcludeerd dat de belangen van kinderen het beste zijn gediend wanneer zij in het eigen land, cultuur, dicht bij de biologische familie, veilig kunnen worden opgevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de stappen die hij op korte termijn gaat nemen om de knelpunten in de sociaal advocatuur te verbeteren

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what short-term steps will address shortages in social legal aid, including VSAN criticism of indexation, advance payments and training subsidies. The minister replies that the plan covers short, medium and long term measures, keeps the 1 January 2024 indexation date, is examining reinstating advance payments, and states no extra short-term funds are available.
In the short term, no additional financial resources are available on top of that.
Op de korte termijn zijn daarbovenop geen extra financiële middelen beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Michon-Derkzen en Van Nispen over de sekte La Luz Del Mundo

MPs Michon-Derkzen and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the La Luz Del Mundo sect, its Den Haag presence, victim support, a central reporting point and a Belgian knowledge centre. The minister answered that police have no information warranting criminal action, that victims can be supported by existing services, and that a broader review of victim help and a reporting point is pending in a separate letter.
I refer you to the aforementioned letter of 30 June.
Ik verwijs u naar voornoemde brief van 30 juni.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een onterecht veroordeelde man opnieuw achter de tralies is beland mede door toedoen van de Nederlandse overheid

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Dutch state contributed to a wrongly convicted man being re-jailed in Spain after a pardon was granted, and what the state would do to free him and compensate him. The minister declined to discuss the individual case on privacy grounds, referred to general procedures for pardons and information-sharing with foreign authorities, and said the handling would be reviewed if found inadequate.
I cannot provide you with detailed information on this without going into the particulars of the individual case.
Ik kan u hierover geen gedetailleerde informatie verschaffen zonder in te gaan op de bijzonderheden van de individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen en Kuik over de handhaving van het aanstaande verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen door de Kansspelautoriteit

MPs asked whether the Kansspelautoriteit's chair signalled soft enforcement of the upcoming ban on untargeted online gambling advertising, and whether the regulator should fine every breach. The minister replied that enforcement is the regulator's responsibility, that normative talks precede fines, that operators had enough preparation time, and declined to discuss the chair's statements with the regulator.
It is up to the Ksa to give further substance to how it supervises and enforces compliance with the advertising ban.
Het is aan de Ksa om nader invulling te geven aan de wijze waarop zij toezicht houdt en handhaaft op naleving van het reclameverbod.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijke vernietigen van adoptiedossiers door de Centrale autoriteit Internationale Kinderaangelegenheden en de rechten van geadopteerden in Nederland

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether adoption files were destroyed by intermediaries or the Central Authority, what remedies adoptees have, and whether the government will centralise access to files. The minister answered that about 50 metres of files were destroyed in 1999 under a 1978 retention list, that the files held little descent data, that INEA and an overview page will support adoptees, and that full centralisation is not feasible.
It is known that about 50 metres of files were destroyed in 1999, but it is unknown how many files this involved.
Er is bekend dat er ongeveer 50 meter aan dossiers in 1999 zijn vernietigd, onbekend is om hoeveel dossiers het hierbij ging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het nieuws dat de Binnenlandse Veiligheidsdienst jarenlang illegaal advocaten en academici bespioneerde

Left-wing SP MPs asked the Interior Minister about reports that the BVD illegally surveilled lawyers and academics, including Bakker Schut and people around him, and whether this resembled police-state methods and was a criminalisation of a lawyer. The minister replied that the 1970s investigations took place under a much thinner legal framework, that the RAF terrorism context applied, that today's stricter safeguards for lawyers (court authorisation, CTIVD oversight) are in place, and that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss the specific operational case.
Finally, I cannot publicly discuss the intelligence investigations of the AIVD and its predecessors.
Ik kan, ten slotte, in het openbaar niet ingaan op de inlichtingenonderzoeken van de AIVD en diens voorgangers.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over rechtvaardige compensaties voor SBF-ers die door privatiseringen onder andere ministeries werkten dan het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (J&V) en nog geen uitzicht he

An SP MP asked why former SBF employees of privatised TBS clinics and youth institutions have not been compensated like Justice and Security civil servants, and whether the clinics should be held to earlier agreements. The Minister replied that compensation is the responsibility of the privatised clinics and institutions as employers, not the state, and declined to direct them.
It is the responsibility of the privatised clinic or institution to determine whether compensation is due to the SBF leave employee of that clinic or institution.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verzelfstandigde kliniek of inrichting om na te gaan of een compensatie aan de orde is voor de SBF-verlofmedewerker van die kliniek of inrichting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het hoger beroep van moeders die gedwongen hun kind moesten afstaan in de periode 1956 tot en met 1984

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the appeal by mothers forced to give up their children (1956-1984) seeking state recognition, the court's finding that the state did not act culpably, the expectation that the state would not invoke limitation periods, and what the government will do. The minister said an independent inquiry runs to end 2024, that the state will assess any limitation defence case by case under Supreme Court criteria, and that projects on dossier access and psychosocial support are underway.
That is why I consider it important that an independent commission now investigates what happened in the period 1956-1984.
Daarom vind ik het belangrijk dat er nu door een onafhankelijke commissie onderzoek wordt gedaan naar wat er in de periode 1956–1984 heeft plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitsluiting van de rechtstoegang voor mensen die op papier een hoger inkomen hebben dan de grens van de Wet op de rechtsbijstand

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about middle-income people who fall outside legal aid income limits and about self-employed people without staff being excluded from legal aid for business matters. The Minister acknowledged the signals and some distressing cases, pointed to alternatives such as legal expenses insurance and social lawyers, and committed to further research and to continued talks with the Juridisch Loket on improving access.
That is why I will first carry out further research into this, so that I can then make well-founded choices to actually help people who fall between the cracks.
Daarom ga ik daar eerst nader onderzoek naar doen, om vervolgens goed onderbouwde keuzes te kunnen maken om mensen die tussen wal en schip vallen daadwerkelijk te helpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het intrekken van tolkendiensten en het werven van tolken in België om in Nederland te gaan werken

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the OM cancelling interpreter assignments, the recruitment of Belgian interpreters by Global Talk, and related pay and register issues. The Minister answered that cancellations stem from excessive travel distances and efficiency, denied selective treatment, and promised monitoring and contract changes but no concrete new action on pay beyond waiting for a vertaaltarief study.
Enquiries with the OM show that its systems cannot establish how many of the interpreter assignments provided by the CVOM interpreter bureau were withdrawn in a given period.

Uit navraag bij het OM blijkt dat uit de systemen van het OM niet te herleiden is hoeveel van de door het tolkenbureau van Centrale Verwerking Openbaar Ministerie verstrekte tolkdiensten er in een bepaalde periode zijn ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van der Laan, Mohandis en Bikker over het lekken van cijfers over misbruik in de danswereld

MPs asked the minister why figures from the dance-sector abuse investigation leaked before the victims were informed, and who held the figures. The minister answered that the leak is regretted, that only the ministries of VWS and OCW received the draft conclusions, and that the government will respond after studying the final report due 22 May.
I have not yet responded substantively, but I think it is important to state that my concern is with the victims.
Ik heb nog niet inhoudelijk gereageerd, maar vind het wel belangrijk om aan te geven dat mijn zorg uitgaat naar de slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de intimidatie door criminelen van poortwachters bij het melden van ongebruikelijke transacties

An MP asks the Justice Minister about intimidation of gatekeepers (notaries, accountants, estate agents) who report unusual transactions, and whether reporters can be anonymised in criminal files as urged by a motion. The minister answers that existing safeguards exist, an extra measure was added, full anonymisation of reporting institutions is not possible because of transparency and traceability of evidence, and further consultations and measures will follow.
Standard anonymisation of the name of the reporting institution is not possible, as this may compromise the transparency and traceability of the evidence.
Het standaard anonimiseren van de naam van de meldende instantie is niet mogelijk, gezien dit de transparantie en de herleidbaarheid van het bewijs in het geding kan brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het nieuws dat kringloopwinkels zich grote zorgen maken om het moeten bijhouden van een verplicht register voor alle binnengekomen producten middels het Digitaal

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about concerns from thrift shops over a mandatory product register via the Digitaal Opkopers Register, and whether it serves to prevent handling stolen goods and money laundering. The minister answered that the registration duty already exists, that it will be narrowed to theft-sensitive goods with a limited regime for free-donated items, and that a proportionate arrangement is being negotiated with the trade association.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de gevolgen voor mensen als de Staat blijft procederen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the State should be more restrained in appealing against citizens who already won in first instance, given the financial and mental burden, and whether the framework 'Behoorlijk omgaan met schadeclaims' and the Leijten/Ellian motion on the State as litigant will be applied. The minister acknowledges the burden, says the existing framework requires restraint and weighing of individual interests and that its current relevance will be reviewed, with a government update expected around summer.
As I indicated above, there is a framework within central government to ensure proper handling of damage claims within central government.
Zoals ik hierboven heb aangegeven, bestaat er binnen de rijksoverheid een kader om een behoorlijke omgang met schadeclaims binnen de rijksoverheid te borgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er opnieuw minder sociaal advocaten actief zijn in het stelstel

Senator Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that fewer social lawyers are active in the legal aid system despite rising case numbers, and about the causes, the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's warnings, fees, training costs, the point system and a proposal from the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen. The minister acknowledges the shortage risk, points to a plan of action with training subsidies, pay improvements and a possible fund, and commits to further work and a progress report before summer.
In the coming period I will intensively work on strengthening the social legal profession so that possible shortages are prevented.
De komende tijd ga ik intensief aan de slag met de versterking van de sociale advocatuur zodat mogelijke tekorten worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over proceskostenvergoedingen in Mulderzaken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether procedural cost awards in Mulderzaken (traffic fine appeals) flow to no-cure-no-pay agencies, how high they are, and whether incentives are perverse. The minister confirmed such awards occur, reported rising totals up to 5.6 million euro in 2021, commissioned WODC research on abuse of the cost scheme, but did not yet give the average per case.
In the short term it cannot be answered what average amount is involved per case. I will inform the House of this later, once I have received the data.
Op deze korte termijn kan niet beantwoord worden welk bedrag er gemiddeld per zaak gemoeid is. Hierover zal ik uw Kamer, zodra ik de gegevens ontvangen heb, alsnog informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de dood van een gedetineerde in een meerpersoonscel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the death of a detainee in a shared cell at PI Krimpen aan den IJssel, the screening of prisoners for shared cells, occupancy rates, rights protection, and staff risks. The minister expressed sympathy, described screening criteria and the complaint routes, and said a calamity investigation is underway and that measures will follow from its results.
Following this incident, DJI has started a calamity investigation to gain more insight into the circumstances and background.
DJI is naar aanleiding van dit incident een calamiteitenonderzoek gestart om meer inzicht te krijgen in de toedracht en achtergronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters en officieren voor het eerst in de Nederlandse geschiedenis willen gaan staken

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges and prosecutors threatening a first-ever strike over their collective labour agreement and workload, and about related warnings from the judiciary's association. The minister acknowledged the right to strike, pointed to large investments in the judiciary and prosecution service, and said he would answer the substantive questions once negotiations resume, which they did on 23 March.
Because the negotiations are still ongoing, I cannot yet make further statements on this.
Vanwege de nog lopende besprekingen kan ik hier nog geen verdere uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Mutluer over het bericht ‘Meer geld naar gokreclames in aanloop naar verbod’

MPs Van Nispen, Bikker and Mutluer asked why gambling advertising spending rose despite industry self-regulation promises, and when the promised ban would take effect. The Minister said a ban on untargeted online gambling advertising takes effect by 1 July 2023, that self-regulation is insufficient, and that he has repeatedly urged restraint from state-owned gambling companies.
The ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling will be adopted shortly and takes effect by 1 July 2023 at the latest.
Het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen wordt binnenkort vastgesteld en treedt uiterlijk per 1 juli 2023 in werking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het afpakken en herbestemming van misdaadgeld

MP Van Nispen asked how the government plans to return confiscated criminal assets to society more easily, why this is needed, whether it will increase confiscations, and why it is linked to investing in neighbourhoods. Minister Yeşilgöz answered that pilots (Schiedam, then Rotterdam and Breda) are testing how to repurpose assets, that the government will report on any legal obstacles in its half-yearly letters, and that neighbourhood investment is funded separately from asset recovery.
Through these pilots it will become clear whether, and if so which, laws and rules currently stand in the way of structurally repurposing assets for society, and how they should be changed.
Aan de hand van deze pilots zal blijken of, en zo ja welke, wetten en regels momenteel in de weg staan van het structureel maatschappelijk herbestemmen en hoe deze gewijzigd dienen te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij en Mutluer over het bericht 'Zorgen om online gokken in de klas: ‘Ze denken snel geld te verdienen’'

MPs from four parties asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for Health how minors gain access to online gambling accounts, whether gambling operators take age checks seriously, and when a ban on gambling advertising takes effect, including whether a two-strikes model should apply. The minister acknowledges the problem, says the Kansspelautoriteit has received no signals of circumvention, promises awareness activities and a ban on untargeted gambling ads by 1 July 2023, but rejects a two-strikes model as not fitting proportionate enforcement.
That is why I am doing everything I can to bring the ban on untargeted advertising for online gambling into effect as soon as possible.
Daarom stel ik alles in het werk om het verbod op ongerichte reclame voor online kansspelen zo snel mogelijk in werking te laten treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over aanhoudingen door de politie

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Interior ministers about police arrests of Extinction Rebellion activists before a planned A12 blockade, including Amnesty's concerns about the right to demonstrate. The minister answered that the arrests were for suspected incitement, not preventive detention, that courts upheld most area bans, and that a full response to Amnesty's report will follow before summer 2023.
There has been no question of preventive arrests.
Er is geen sprake geweest van preventieve arrestaties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van der Lee, Ceder, Teunissen, Piri, Kuzu en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de overdracht van Singh aan Nederland gebaseerd is op politieke onwil

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Foreign Ministers whether the government has done enough to bring detained Dutch national Jaitsen Singh from the United States to the Netherlands, and why a transfer (WOTS procedure) was not pursued after a parole denial. The government answers that a WOTS transfer does not meet the policy criteria because of insufficient ties to the Netherlands, that a pardon route on humanitarian grounds remains open, and that the family's willingness to take him in does not change the assessment.
The cabinet continues to make efforts to bring Mr Singh to the Netherlands on humanitarian grounds because of his advanced age and fragile health, provided he poses no danger to society.
Het kabinet blijft zich inspannen om de heer Singh op humanitaire gronden vanwege zijn hoge leeftijd en fragiele gezondheid naar Nederland te brengen, mits hij geen gevaar voor de samenleving vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan hulp voor nabestaanden van moord met psychische problematiek

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the lack of help for relatives bereaved by murder who develop complicated grief, including whether insurers, occupational health services and mental health waiting lists are barriers. The ministers acknowledge the impact and need for tailored support, deny signals of insufficient recognition or insurer refusal, and point to existing waiting-list agreements and planned monitoring without committing to new concrete steps.
However, which assistance and support a person has been helped with can differ per bereaved person.
Met welke bijstand en ondersteuning iemand is geholpen kan evenwel per nabestaande verschillen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen in de klinieken in het terbeschikking (tbs-)stelsel

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about problems in tbs clinics, including capacity pressure, staff workload, incidents, bureaucracy, quality and security measures, and aftercare for staff with trauma. The minister acknowledges capacity pressure and staffing problems, denies the system is unsustainable, and describes measures such as new places, a quality framework, security works and a new procurement strategy, while declining to comment on an ongoing lawsuit.
Because the lawsuit you refer to is still ongoing, I cannot go into this further.
Omdat de rechtszaak waar u aan refereert nog loopt, kan ik hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de privatisering van politietaken

Two MPs (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the privatisation of police tasks, including which partners join dialogue tables on a future police vision, which stakeholders and disciplines are involved, which tasks are inherently public, and whether Parliament will be involved. The minister answers that strategic dialogue tables and essays will shape a white paper, that Parliament will be informed later, and that the political debate on public versus shared police tasks is needed, though substantive answers on task allocation are deferred.

As stated in my letter of 5 July 2022, I want to arrive at a thorough deepening and I attach importance to carefully going through all parts of the necessary process before formulating a substantive answer to the above questions.

Zoals aangegeven in mijn brief van 5 juli 2022 wil ik komen tot een grondige verdieping en ik hecht eraan alle onderdelen van het hiervoor noodzakelijke proces zorgvuldig te doorlopen, alvorens een inhoudelijk antwoord te formuleren op bovenstaande vragen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het artikel: ‘De rechtspraak is kennelijk alleen openbaar voorzover het de rechter behaagt’

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a press report that a court refused a person access to a judgment on grounds of insufficient interest, and why publication of judgments matters. The Minister replies that the decision to release judgments to non-parties lies with the independent judiciary under the Code of Criminal Procedure, that publication on rechtspraak.nl is the broader form of openness, and that he will inform parliament further in early 2023.
It is not for a minister to decide whether a court judgment is provided to someone other than a party to the proceedings or a lawyer.
Het is niet aan een bewindspersoon om te bepalen of een rechterlijke uitspraak wordt verstrekt aan iemand anders dan een procespartij of advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Knops, Ellian en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Adviescommissie stapt op omdat minister ongeschikte notarissen benoemt'

MPs Knops, Ellian and Van Nispen asked why the Minister for Legal Protection appointed candidate notaries against negative advice from the advisory committee, which resigned, and about delays and information to parliament. The minister confirmed the resignation and that he departed from negative advice in three cases in 2022, after hearing and objection procedures, and committed to clarifying the notion of personal suitability and informing parliament.
In all three cases, after inserting a comment phase with a view to the required care and legal obligation and in one case an objection phase, I concluded that appointment would be justified.

In alle drie de gevallen ben ik – na het inlassen van een zienswijzefase met het oog op de vereiste zorgvuldigheid en wettelijke verplichting en in een geval een bezwaarfase – tot de conclusie gekomen dat benoeming verantwoord zou zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna alle slachtoffers van het Essex-drama in Nederland zijn geweest

SP MPs asked whether the Essex lorry deaths victims had mostly been in the Netherlands, after a Myria report implied 38 of 39 victims were previously known there, and asked about Dutch handling of Vietnamese human trafficking and smuggling. The State Secretary answered that the passage was a misreading: fingerprint comparison found only two prior Dutch presences, the report was amended, the observation was not subject to the transit-prohibition given no concrete knowledge of smuggling, and no new investigation is planned.
This research showed that two of the 39 victims had been in the Netherlands before the tragedy.
Uit dit onderzoek is gebleken dat twee van de 39 slachtoffers voorafgaand aan het drama in Nederland zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de documentaire 'Het laatste woord' en de straf die Jurriën in erbarmelijke omstandigheden uitzit in Tunesië

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about the documentary 'Het laatste woord' and the harsh detention of a Dutch national, Jurriën, sentenced to 20 years in Tunisia. The minister of Foreign Affairs answered that the ministry provides consular assistance, has visited him 54 times, supported clemency requests, and cannot assess the legal proceedings abroad.
It is for the detainee and his lawyer to raise the aspects regarding the legal proceedings and legal remedies, and for the judge to then decide on them.
Het is aan de gedetineerde en zijn advocaat de aspecten ten aanzien van de rechtsgang en rechtsmiddelen aan de orde te stellen en aan de rechter hierover vervolgens te beslissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese inmenging in Nederland

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen and Leijten asked about reports of Chinese 'police service stations' in the Netherlands, whether those staff can stay and be prosecuted, whether the AIVD knew, where the limits of foreign interference lie, what infrastructure Chinese state actors hold and how to prevent its use as leverage, and whether cruciale sectors should be under Dutch control. The government said the stations have been closed after diplomatic protests, that no evidence yet shows staff were sent from China, that investigation continues and prosecution is not ruled out, declined to comment on AIVD knowledge, pointed to its three-track anti-interference approach and a planned espionage bill, and described the Vifo screening law and a reinforced vital-infrastructure approach while citing partial Chinese ownership of Rotterdam container terminals.
Regarding the knowledge level, working methods or sources of the intelligence services, the AIVD, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet de AIVD, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het standpunt van het kabinet inzake mensenrechten en internationale sporttoernooien

MPs Westerveld, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the government how it will respond to calls from KNVB and FNV to improve migrant worker rights in Qatar ahead of the World Cup, and how it intends to influence sports federations and FIFA on human rights and compensation. The ministers answered that constructive-critical diplomacy and dialogue with Qatar are the chosen approach, noting reforms but ongoing concerns, and largely pointed to sports federations, companies and the KNVB for further action while expressing openness to compensation and diplomatic support.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to operate in line with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij ondernemen in lijn met de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen en de VN-richtlijnen voor bedrijfsleven en mensenrechten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten, Kwint en Van Nispen over de inzet van voorspellende algoritmes met betrekking tot kinderen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether the police would keep using the ProKid Plus algorithm to predict violent crime among children, and about oversight, data, safeguards and links to youth care and the Top400 approach. The minister answered that ProKid Plus was used only once in a 2016 Amsterdam trial, is no longer used, that a new police alerting system (ProKid 23-) is still under legal and ethical assessment, and described existing legal safeguards and oversight, while committing to no new structural rule changes.

The experiences with ProKid Plus underline the importance of good safeguards for the use of algorithms, to which the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations, together with the Minister for Legal Protection, is giving extra attention.

De ervaringen met ProKid Plus onderstrepen het belang van goede waarborgen voor het gebruik van algoritmen, waar de Staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties in samenwerking met de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming extra aandacht voor heeft.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat de Nederlandse staat geen zicht heeft op Nederlanders die in het buitenland een gevangenisstraf hebben uitgezeten en daarna terugkeren naar Neder

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether the state can monitor Dutch citizens returning after serving prison sentences abroad, and whether transfer rules should be relaxed. The minister acknowledged the gap for sex offenders convicted outside the EU and UK, said an options study will be reported in Q1 2023, but defended the current transfer criteria and the five-year binding test.

I share the concern that there is currently insufficient oversight, because information about a conviction outside the European Union for a sex offence cannot currently be taken into account when assessing an application for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Ik deel de zorg dat daar nu onvoldoende zicht op is, omdat informatie over een veroordeling buiten de Europese Unie (EU) voor een zedenmisdrijf nu niet meegenomen kan worden bij de beoordeling van een aanvraag voor een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat iemand 2,5 jaar onterecht vast zat na machtsmisbruik van de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asked the ministers about a man who was wrongly held for 2.5 years after the Dutch state misused its power in a transfer-of-sentence procedure, and why rule-of-law protection failed. The minister regretted the situation, acknowledged the state acted unlawfully, declined to discuss the individual case further, and said the IOS department has introduced a framework to prevent similar cases.
The Dutch state acknowledged in this procedure that it acted unlawfully by subjecting the person to a second transfer-of-sentence procedure.
De Nederlandse staat heeft in deze procedure erkend dat ze onrechtmatig heeft gehandeld door betrokkene aan een tweede procedure van strafoverdracht te onderwerpen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er cruciale informatie ontbreekt in een proces-verbaal

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about a court ruling that a police report omitted and misrepresented facts, leading to the prosecution being declared inadmissible, and about whether victims are informed, whether police conduct was professional, and what measures follow. The minister declined to comment on the individual case pending a Rijksrecherche investigation, stated that such deliberate misinformation in reports is serious, described the professionality framework and disciplinary options, and said the OM is evaluating internally and will report after the investigation.
I am not making any statements on this case at present, because the investigation is ongoing and I do not wish to influence it.
Ik doe op dit moment geen uitspraken over deze zaak, omdat het onderzoek nog loopt en ik dat niet wil beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het innen van een schadevergoedingsmaatregel voor slachtoffers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why a victim of online extortion, a vulnerable young man, has received none of the damages awarded by the court, and what is being done to improve collection of compensation orders. Minister Weerwind replied that the CJIB uses a range of collection instruments with a reasonable success rate, that a victim advance scheme exists, that the Donner committee reform is still being developed with a letter promised by 1 June 2023, and that improvements will be considered without committing to specific new measures.
I cannot go into this individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op deze individuele zaak.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vervolgen van verslagleggingsfraude

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether financial statement fraud (art. 336 Sr) is prosecuted actively enough, citing its scale, conviction and prosecution numbers, and a set of proposals (binding instruction to prosecutors, banning trust offices, mandatory audits, UBO and filing enforcement). The government answered that damage cannot be reliably measured, prosecution is adequate and independent of ministerial instruction, and rejected most proposals, noting existing sanctions and oversight mechanisms.
Given what the OM already does on this subject, I consider giving a specific instruction unnecessary and moreover undesirable.
Het geven van een specifieke aanwijzing vind ik mede gelet op wat het OM reeds doet op dit onderwerp dan ook niet nodig en acht ik bovendien onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over uitbetalingen van geld en speelwinst door online kansspelaanbieders

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether online gambling operators deliberately delay payouts, whether they should pay out instantly, and whether cancelling a withdrawal after requesting it should be banned. The Minister for Legal Protection replied that delays may be justified by fraud checks, that operators must pay 'without undue delay' under the Bkoa, that the Kansspelautoriteit supervises this and has an ongoing investigation into the duty of care, and that no intervention such as banning cancellation is warranted for now.
It is up to the Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) to supervise whether gambling providers comply with this.
Het is aan de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) om toezicht te houden op dat kansspelaanbieders zich hieraan houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het voortbestaan van een onrechtmatige toestand van huwelijkse gevangenschap en de mogelijke verjaring

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the ongoing unlawful state of forced marriage (huwelijkse gevangenschap) can become time-barred, how many women sought legal aid or consular help, and what the government will do about funding, training and international cooperation. The minister answers that a pending bill makes the duty to cooperate in dissolving such a marriage legally enforceable and not subject to limitation, that the register cannot show how many cases were funded, that the fee point increase was raised to 19 points in 2022 but no further increase is planned, and that consular help is limited and the topic will be raised in EU and bilateral channels.
It can never, and therefore also not after a lapse of time, be required of anyone to remain bound in a religious or belief-based union that they do not wish to maintain.
Het kan nooit, en dus ook niet na verloop van tijd, van iemand worden gevergd dat hij blijft vastzitten in een religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke verbintenis die hij niet wenst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het weglopen van tolken bij de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about interpreters leaving police work, unpaid invoices, quality concerns and the procurement reform of interpreting services, citing a newspaper report. The minister disputed the picture, said the new intermediary system is largely working, described monitoring and contract measures, and committed to follow-up on payments and quality without conceding structural failure.
Identified defects and shortcomings are taken up by the police contract management and, where necessary, discussed with the intermediary directly or during the fortnightly contract meeting.
Geconstateerde gebreken en onvolkomenheden worden opgepakt door het contractmanagement van de politie en zo nodig direct of tijdens het tweewekelijks contractoverleg besproken met de intermediair.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het voornemen dat nu ook het Openbaar Ministerie in Den Haag wegens capaciteitsproblemen strafzaken wil schrappen

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister for a reaction to the Public Prosecution Service in The Hague dropping 53 criminal cases due to capacity problems, and why ancillary confiscation cases were included. The minister regrets the decision, says no other regions face this, explains the selection criteria (cases at least four years old, no direct victims, no serious violence or sex offences) and acknowledges the injustice of confiscation cases being dropped.
I have agreed with the College of Procurators-General that, should such a situation arise again, I will be informed in good time and in advance.
Ik heb met het College van Procureurs-generaal afgesproken dat ik, mocht een dergelijke situatie zich weer voordoen, tijdig en van tevoren wordt geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de desastreuze gevolgen van de hoge energieprijzen voor de sport

An SP MP asks the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the consequences of high energy prices for sports clubs and facilities, including whether prices and access are at risk and what compensation will be provided. The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to energy-saving advice, sustainability support, the TEK compensation scheme and the price cap, says the sector shares responsibility, and defers a full answer on the motions to November.
I will inform the House about that in November.
Ik informeer uw Kamer daarover in november.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er een groot tekort aan officieren van justitie is

MPs Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister how she would respond to reports of a large shortage of public prosecutors, what the consequences are, whether the previous Rutte cabinets' policy caused it, what extra efforts will be made, how the new funding is allocated and when the shortage will be solved. The Minister acknowledged high workload and understaffing, cited a 2020 study attributing it to complexity, legislation and COVID backlogs, listed structural extra funding and recruitment measures, and gave no firm date for solving the shortage.
The College takes the necessary decisions, within existing possibilities, to achieve a responsible and phased expansion of the number of prosecutors.
Het College neemt – binnen de bestaande mogelijkheden – de nodige beslissingen om tot een verantwoorde en gefaseerde uitbreiding van het aantal officieren te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het buitenspeelbeleid in gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-term Care and Sport about the absence of structural attention to outdoor play in national and municipal policy, the share of municipalities with outdoor-play policy and monitoring, and plans to adopt foreign practice and integrate play space into urban planning. The minister answered that 40 percent of municipalities have specific outdoor-play policy, that a knowledge agenda, data harmonisation and a municipal toolbox are in progress, and that concrete play-space design remains the municipalities' responsibility.
The concrete design of public space in a neighbourhood, however, always requires tailored work and also depends on the population composition; responsibility for this lies with the municipality.
De concrete invulling van de openbare ruimte in een wijk vraagt echter steeds maatwerk en is ook afhankelijk van de bevolkingssamenstelling, de verantwoordelijkheid daarvoor ligt bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming van gedupeerden van het kinderopvangtoeslagenschandaal

The SP MP Van Nispen asked why childcare benefit scandal victims must go to court to enforce statutory decision deadlines and obtain access to their files, and what the government will do about it. The government acknowledges that many decisions are overdue (41,335 applications past the one-year deadline as of 30 September 2022), points to capacity constraints, prioritisation and ongoing improvement measures, and says it will report in the 12th progress report.
Unfortunately, it is not succeeding in giving parents a decision within the statutory deadlines for the integral assessment and objections.
Het lukt helaas niet om ouders binnen de wettelijke termijnen uitsluitsel te geven bij de integrale beoordeling en bezwaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over dat de Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen pas in actie komt na een rechterlijke uitspraak

An SP MP asks why the Dutch tax authority's Herstel Toeslagen unit only acts on childcare-benefit victims' files after court rulings, and how this squares with the law and costs. The government answers that files are handled in order of registration with priority for urgent cases, that late-decision appeals are a consequence of the system rather than deliberate policy, and that it will report further in the next progress report.
As a result, late-decision appeals cut across the processing order based on date of registration.
Hierdoor doorkruisen de beroepen niet tijdig de behandelvolgorde op basis van volgorde van aanmelding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat politie en NFI de grote golf van explosies nauwelijks aankunnen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that police and the NFI struggle to handle the surge in explosions and ram raids, causing investigations to stall, and what the government will do about capacity and funding. The minister acknowledges capacity pressure, argues investigations are not delayed in a harmful way, points to structural extra funding, an annual service level agreement and possible use of other providers, but does not commit to a specific new capacity study.
To reduce pressure on the forensic chain, I have structurally allocated money, in an annual increasing financial series, to make it more robust.
Om de druk op de forensische keten te verminderen heb ik (in een jaarlijks oplopende financiële reeks) structureel geld vrijgemaakt om deze robuuster te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat gedetineerden niet met verlof kunnen vanwege maandenlange wachttijden bij de verlofaanvraag

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that detainees convicted of serious violent or sexual offences were denied leave because of months-long waits for psychologists to complete risk assessments. The minister acknowledged the delays, attributed them to an overly broad November 2021 amendment to the leave regulation, and said the wording is being corrected with interim measures from 6 September 2022.

The amendment provided that a risk assessment and offence analysis become mandatory for re-integration leave of detainees convicted of a serious violent or sexual offence who are transferred to a forensic care institution.

Met de wijziging werd geregeld dat een risicotaxatie en delictanalyse verplicht worden betrokken bij het re-integratieverlof van gedetineerden die zijn veroordeeld voor een ernstig gewelds- en zedenmisdrijf
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdringing van legaal sekswerk door illegaal sekswerk

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security about legal sex work being displaced by illegal sex work, citing a newspaper report that the legal sector is struggling partly because of government policy. The government answered that local regulation varies, that unlicensed work carries risks, that it is working on financial access, the opting-in scheme, COVID support gaps and stigma, and that it is engaging the sector and municipalities, though it made no firm commitment to new legislation beyond the planned regulation bill.
Together with the relevant ministries and partners in the local domain, I continue to engage with the sex industry as a full discussion partner.
Ik blijf, samen met de betrokken ministeries en met partners uit het lokale domein, in gesprek met de seksbranche als een volwaardige gesprekspartner.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Rudmer Heerema en Van Nispen over het artikel 'KVLO: 'Tekort sportaccommodaties brengt bewegingsonderwijs PO in gedrang''

MPs Heerema and Van Nispen asked the minister about a KVLO report warning of too few gymnasium places to deliver two hours of physical education in primary schools, and whether municipalities were using their funds properly and preparing in time. The minister answered that municipalities have no earmarked funds and that the matter is local, that an inventory was done and a communication plan will be drawn up, but gave no figures on the shortfall or on intervention.
Gymnasium capacity is a local matter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verlenen van gratie en de motivering van dat besluit

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how often clemency has been granted, why clemency was given to a convicted Dutch presenter serving nine years, and how the decision was motivated. The minister gave yearly clemency figures, said the decision was case-specific and based on a positive Belgian-law-informed advice from the court, declined to discuss details citing privacy, and said reasons are only given in the decision if a request is refused.
Given the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot go into the substance of this case further.
Gelet op de privacy van de betrokkene kan ik verder niet inhoudelijk ingaan op deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat TBS-patiënten die geriatrische zorg nodig hebben nu nergens terecht kunnen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that TBS patients needing geriatric care have nowhere suitable to go, and whether a dedicated facility was planned. The minister confirmed there are no specialised units yet, explained the current arrangements via FPCs and DJI, and said a specialised unit is being scoped and an option is included in the 2024 tender, with updates promised in a June 2023 letter.
I will keep you informed of progress in the forensic care progress letter of June 2023.
Ik zal u op de hoogte houden van de voortgang in de voortgangsbrief forensische zorg van juni 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodzaak van onderzoek naar misstanden in vrouwengevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported abuses in women's prisons, including alleged sexual misconduct by a guard at PI Nieuwersluis, abuse of power and denial of medical care elsewhere, and when the Inspectorate last examined these prisons. The Minister confirmed the Inspectorate is investigating the Nieuwersluis case and has been asked to widen its inquiry, but said the Inspectorate sets its own scope and the Minister cannot instruct it to investigate specific topics.
I have informed the Inspectorate JenV of this and asked it to include these reports in its investigation and, if there is reason to do so, to extend it to the other women's prisons.

Ik heb de Inspectie JenV hiervan op de hoogte gesteld en gevraagd deze meldingen te betrekken in haar onderzoek en indien nodig uit te breiden naar de andere vrouwengevangenissen als daar aanleiding toe is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de mogelijkheid in het erfrecht dat de dader erft van een slachtoffer

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether a man found not criminally liable and sentenced only to TBS, who killed his wife, may inherit from her, and whether inheritance law should be tightened so perpetrators cannot benefit. The Minister acknowledged the outcome feels very unjust but declined substantive comment because the case is under appeal, explained the limited unworthiness grounds in Article 4:3 BW, and said he will await the procedure before considering broadening those grounds.
I first want to await the further procedure before examining whether it is necessary to expand the unworthiness grounds of Article 4:3 BW.
Ik wil nu eerst de verdere procedure afwachten voordat ik ga onderzoeken of het nodig is om de onwaardigheidsgronden van artikel 4:3 BW uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over justitiële dwalingen en de reactie daarop

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she views a court finding of a miscarriage of justice, whether excuses are due, whether the system is working and whether the novum criterion for review should be loosened. The Minister regrets the wrongful conviction, defends the current review regime as balanced, says excuses are primarily for the organisations involved and that the novum criterion will not be changed.
For a detailed justification of that position I refer to the letter in question.
Voor een uitgebreide motivering van dat standpunt verwijs ik naar de bedoelde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het problematisch tekort aan sociaal advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a predicted shortage of social lawyers, whether raising their fees is the remedy, whether research will be done on narrowing fee gaps with commercial lawyers, and whether tariffs and hours will be kept current. The minister acknowledges the report's concerns, says fees were structurally improved from January 2022 with a repricing process underway, declines to study fee gaps with commercial lawyers citing limited public funds, and plans additional research on regional spread and supply and demand.
I am not going to commission research into the differing fees for commercial and social lawyers.
Een onderzoek naar uiteenlopende vergoedingen voor de commerciële en sociale advocatuur ga ik niet laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘onderhandse financiering van vakantiewoningen baart experts zorgen’

SP MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked ministers about reports that private, non-bank mortgage financing of holiday parks and homes raises money-laundering and undermining risks, and about regulation of park takeovers and oversight of gatekeepers. The government answered that such financing can be a risk indicator, that the Actie-agenda vakantieparken and existing Wwft and FIU measures apply, that no regulation of individual transactions is planned, and that it will report the results of the Actie-agenda and a banks/gatekeeper dialogue later.
It is important that all parties that may have insight into this are alert to it in performing their tasks.
Het is belangrijk dat alle betrokken partijen die hierop zicht kunnen hebben, daar alert op zijn bij de uitoefening van hun taken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat advocatenkantoor Houthoff nog steeds zaken doet met Russische klanten

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether law firm Houthoff still serves Russian clients despite sanctions, whether the Amsterdam dean (a partner at Nauta-Dutilh) can independently oversee it, what the investigation into Houthoff found, and when legal aid to Russian clients is exempt from sanctions. The minister answered that legal aid is permitted for non-sanctioned Russian clients, that aid necessary for litigation to a sanctioned party is exempt from the prohibition under a line still awaiting European Commission confirmation, that the dean's conflict of interest is addressed by a professional statute and planned reforms creating a national supervisory authority, and declined to detail the internal investigation citing confidentiality.
As I indicated in answer to earlier parliamentary questions, given the special position of the legal profession in our society, supervision of lawyers takes place independently of the government.

Antwoord 3 Zoals ik in antwoord op eerdere Kamervragen 6 heb aangeven vindt, gelet op de bijzondere positie van de advocatuur in onze samenleving, het toezicht op advocaten onafhankelijk van de overheid plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de justitiële samenwerking tussen Nederland en India niet goed verloopt

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether she was aware that Dutch authorities get no cooperation from India despite knowing where suspects are, what efforts have been made to improve judicial cooperation, whether she will invest in a new treaty like Belgium's, and whether the Dutch justice chain uses liaison officers in India. The Minister confirmed awareness, said cooperation is continually reviewed and intensification is being explored with Indian authorities, and stated that the integral assessment has not yet led to placing a police liaison in India.
At this moment the possibilities for this are being explored with the Indian authorities.
Op dit moment worden de mogelijkheden daartoe met de Indiase autoriteiten verkend.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'het bericht dat de Nederlandse Staat onaanvaardbaar heeft gehandeld door zich te beroepen op de verjaringstermijn in een zaak omtrent interlandelijke adoptie'

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court ruling that the State acted unacceptably by invoking the limitation period in an intercountry adoption case, and what it means for other adoption cases and out-of-court settlement. The Minister says the State no longer relied on limitation in this case, that limitation defences in domestic adoption cases must be assessed case by case, that cassation is still being considered, and that out-of-court resolution will be sought where appropriate.
Given that a decision on cassation still has to be made, I cannot say anything about this at this moment.
Daar kan ik – gegeven het feit dat nog over cassatie moet worden beslist – op dit moment nog niets over zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de grote zorgen om jihadisten die in Nederland blijven terwijl het paspoort is afgepakt

MP Van Nispen asks whether withdrawing the Dutch nationality of convicted jihadists, who may then remain in the Netherlands unmonitored, weakens oversight and public safety, and what the government will do about warnings from the NCTV, municipal mayors and probation services. The minister acknowledges reduced oversight after withdrawal, describes return efforts, monitoring by AVIM and the AIVD, and an ongoing WODC evaluation of counter-terrorism measures, but gives no major new commitments.

In response to the outcomes of this research, the predecessors acknowledged in their letter of 25 June 2020 the dilemma that oversight and room to act regarding those concerned diminish when Dutch nationality has been withdrawn but the persons have not yet left the Netherlands.

Mede als reactie op de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek is door onze voorgangers in de brief van 25 juni 2020 het dilemma onderkend dat het zicht en handelingsperspectief op de betrokkenen verminderen wanneer het Nederlanderschap is ingetrokken, maar betrokkenen nog niet uit Nederland zijn vertrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Knops over de open communicatie vanuit de Extra Beveiligde Inrichting (EBI)

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Knops asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that communication from the EBI high-security prison stayed open without oversight, and why authorities did not intervene despite warnings. The minister denied that unsupervised communication was possible, explained the handling of the lawyer-impersonation case and the FBI-sourced tip, and promised a letter on implementing the Ellian motion while withholding details of ongoing criminal investigations.
As is known, I can share little or no information publicly about ongoing investigations.
Over lopende onderzoeken kan ik zoals bekend geen tot weinig informatie (openlijk) delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over vakantieparken die mogelijk misbruikt worden door criminelen om hun geld wit te wassen

Two MPs from the SP asked ministers about holiday parks possibly misused by criminals for money laundering, including the role of municipalities, BIBOB screening and intimidation of officials. The Minister of Justice and Security answered that the problem is known, that an interdepartmental action agenda and guidance exist, that a Kadaster registration change is being evaluated, and that no mandatory BIBOB screening will be imposed, leaving this to municipalities' discretion.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over racisme en geweld bij de politie en een incompleet dossier

SP MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about racism and police violence in Rotterdam and a court ruling that the prosecution's file was incomplete, leading to inadmissibility. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, described the internal disciplinary outcome and criminal proceedings, and promised stricter sanctioning of discrimination and a forthcoming update to parliament.
I cannot go into individual cases that are before the court.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die onder de rechter zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Nispen over het toezicht op beheer van erfrechtelijke aanspraken van minderjarigen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why supervision of parents' and guardians' management of minors' inheritance rights has been absent in practice and why the promised bill on better supervision has not yet been sent to parliament. The minister acknowledges the case is distressing but questions whether it is a widespread problem, and says the bill is delayed due to reprioritisation; he promises to reconsider the researchers' recommendations and report this autumn.
More effective protection of minors' assets through better supervision of the management by parents and guardians therefore has my attention.
Effectievere bescherming van het vermogen van minderjarigen door beter toezicht op het bewind van ouders en voogden heeft daarom mijn aandacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de verdubbeling van het aantal zaken dat de politie zonder onderzoek terzijde schuift

Van Nispen (SP) asks the Justice Minister how she responds to reports that police dropping cases without investigation have doubled since 2018, whether victims of fraud and assault can accept that perpetrators are not traced, whether capacity shortages were foreseeable, whether the plans suffice, and how many dropped cases are acceptable. The minister answers that case selection is a necessary consequence of scarce capacity guided by the OM's screening framework, that staffing should rebalance around 2024–2025, and that some relative scarcity will always remain.
Deploying police capacity is by definition a matter of making choices.
De inzet van politiecapaciteit is per definitie een kwestie van keuzes maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het de vertrouwelijkheid van meldingen die binnenkomen bij de meldkamer

An MP asked the Minister of Justice whether an investigation was opened after reports that confidential data from the police control room leaked to a journalist, and about the number of breach-of-confidentiality cases. The minister declined to open an investigation, saying the police found no indication of data sharing, and gave police disciplinary statistics, noting that the police decide whether to communicate on the matter.
No, no investigation has been launched. The police have no indication that confidential personal data were shared with third parties.
Nee, er is geen onderzoek ingesteld. De politie heeft geen aanwijzingen dat vertrouwelijke persoonsgegevens zouden zijn gedeeld met derden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een jongerenwerker publiekelijk aan de schandpaal is genageld door de overheid zonder dat daar een veroordeling aan ten grondslag ligt

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about a youth worker publicly named as a suspect in subsidy fraud without conviction, questioning police disclosure, seizures, and legal protection. The minister answered that authorities must act lawfully and proportionately, declined substantive comment on the pending case, and acknowledged the police press release was unintentionally identifying, which was regretted.
I cannot make substantive statements about this individual criminal case, which is still before the court.
Over deze individuele strafzaak, die nog onder de rechter is, kan ik zoals bekend geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de oproep van de Consumentenbond om het gebruik van lootboxes in videogames te reguleren

An SP MP asked the government whether it would regulate loot boxes in video games (manipulative design, misleading odds, pay-to-win, addiction, age rating) following a Consumentenbond call. The government answered that consumer-protection information duties and ACM enforcement apply, that a Europe-wide consultation starts in Q4 2022, that a Trimbos report and a parliamentary motion are being considered with a letter promised after the summer, and that prevention and PEGI age ratings (not 18+ for loot boxes) remain the approach.
The cabinet is currently considering several policy initiatives based on these recommendations. Your House will be informed about this after the summer.
Het kabinet beraadt zich op dit moment op een aantal beleidsinitiatieven op basis van deze aanbevelingen. Uw Kamer wordt hierover na de zomer bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodzaak tot het wettelijk verankeren van zaakstoedeling in de rechtspraak

An MP asked whether random case allocation in the judiciary should be anchored in law, given the Court's Article 6 case law and the Venice Commission standards. The Minister replied that objective, transparent criteria are essential, that formal statutory codification is not strictly required, and that the judiciary's Code will be evaluated after two years with a comparative study of allocation models, without committing to a bill.
I will ask the Council for the Judiciary to evaluate the operation of the rules on case allocation drawn up by the judiciary, two years after the Case Allocation Code took effect.
Ik zal de Raad voor de rechtspraak vragen om de werking van de door de Rechtspraak opgestelde regels voor de toedeling van zaken te evalueren, 2 jaar na inwerkingtreding van de Code Zaakstoedeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Plas over de brandweerzorg

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Plas asked the Justice Minister about relaxed fire-service response times, closures of fire stations and changes made without consulting staff or local councils, and about the lack of data and protective equipment for women firefighters. The minister answered that veiligheidsregio boards are responsible for service levels and accountable to municipal councils, that a new legal framework is due by year-end, and that the region has postponed closure planning and been invited for talks.
Within the legal frameworks, the boards determine the ambitions and quality level of the safety region.
Binnen de wettelijke kaders bepalen de besturen de ambities en het kwaliteitsniveau van de veiligheidsregio.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over getroffen maatregelen op het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid naar aanleiding van de lessen uit het Toeslagenschandaal op gebied van hardheden en de informa

The SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the Justice and Security Ministry what measures it has taken, following the childcare benefits scandal, to find and fix harsh or disproportionate laws and procedures and to manage its information (including chat messages and FOI requests). The minister replies that the department is carrying out the government-wide inventory of harsh rules under the Ploumen/Jetten motion, is applying a shared analysis toolkit, will report on timelines in an annexed letter, and is clarifying the chat-message retention rules for ministers, with a practical proposal promised by end of August.
To this end, a practical proposal for a uniform working method that ministers can use will be made by the end of August.
Hiertoe wordt voor eind augustus een praktisch voorstel gedaan voor een uniforme werkwijze die door de bewindslieden gebruikt kan worden.
