Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan aandacht voor de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand op rechtenopleidingen

MP Van Nispen asked whether law degree programmes neglect subsidised legal aid (sociale advocatuur), citing individualism, career focus and possible influence from large law firms, and what should change. Minister Dijkgraaf answered that curricula are for institutions to decide, that shortages are being studied by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that talks with universities and the NOvA are ongoing, and that the internship scheme has been reopened.
Talks are being held with universities and universities of applied sciences on whether the curriculum sufficiently connects with social legal practice.
Met de universiteiten en hogescholen worden gesprekken gevoerd of binnen het curriculum voldoende aansluiting bestaat met de sociale advocatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het Kremlin aan de Zuidas

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether law firm Houthoff profited from work for sanctioned Russian state banks such as Sberbank, whether it should have done client due diligence, and whether prosecution, confiscation, and a legal framework for supervising lawyers are possible. The minister answered that the Amsterdam bar supervisor found no sanctions breach, declined to comment on the individual case, said prosecution depends on concrete signals, and said a legal framework for lawyer sanctions supervision is being prepared with an outline letter promised before the budget debates.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en van der Staaij over het bericht 'Te weinig rechters in Gelderland, 1500 rechtszaken geschrapt'

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Public Prosecution Service dropping about 1,500 cases in Gelderland due to a shortage of judges, and its effects on victims, trust in justice, other districts and the appeal route. The minister regrets the situation, explains the capacity shortage and recruitment measures, and says victims can object to a dismissal only via article 12 of the Code of Criminal Procedure while cases are being reviewed.
Where victims relied on a judge making an independent ruling on the case they were involved in, this is now not happening.
Daar waar slachtoffers erop vertrouwden dat een rechter een onafhankelijk oordeel zou vellen over de zaak waar ze bij betrokken waren, gebeurt dit nu niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Leijten over discriminatie en racisme bij politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Justice and Interior ministers about discrimination and racism within the police, following a documentary in which police officers said they would not return to the force. The minister acknowledged the problem, described a new police leadership statement, a national coordinator for combating racism, and a planned tiered sanctions regime, but declined to set a firm timeline and gave limited concrete figures.
I will inform your House as soon as possible about the elaboration of this.
Over de uitwerking hiervan zal ik uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Michon-Derkzen over het verdwijnen van sektesignaal

MPs Van Nispen and Michon-Derkzen asked whether the government would implement the motion for a reporting point for cult signals and why the Sektesignaal point was discontinued. The minister says the motion will be carried out after the Hendriks commission reports on 1 November, police handle cult reports adequately, and cult-related reports at Sektesignaal were fairly stable at around 100 dossiers per year.
I will carry out the motion submitted by your House as intended, so that the functions of the reporting point are housed in the most suitable place.
Ik zal de door uw Kamer ingediende motie conform de bedoeling uitvoeren, zodat de functies van het meldpunt op de meest geschikte plaats worden ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aanpak van voetbal gerelateerde criminaliteit en het opleggen en handhaven van stadionverboden

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about football-related crime, the rising number of stadium bans, whether bans should be combined with reporting obligations, the digital reporting duty, camera surveillance and face-covering rules. The minister answers that most stadium bans are civil-law measures handled by clubs and the KNVB, that combining them with area bans is only appropriate in serious cases, that the digital reporting duty is delayed by fraud and privacy risks, and that further agreements with partners will be implemented before the new season.
Unfortunately, no figures are available on this.
Helaas zijn hiervan geen cijfers beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van de NVvR over de werkdruk rechtspraak en OM

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to the NVvR open letter on high workload and overtime at the judiciary and the Public Prosecution Service, and what it will do to reduce workload and safeguard quality. The minister acknowledges the high workload, points to measures already taken (extra officers and judges, structural extra budget, ICT improvements, time-use study follow-up) and says the issue is under discussion with the Raad voor de rechtspraak and the College van procureurs-generaal, without committing to new parliamentary reporting beyond existing channels.
As indicated, the discussion on workload is ongoing.
Zoals aangegeven is het gesprek over werkdruk gaande.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat het aantal gokverslaafden is toegenomen sinds de opening van kansspelmarkt en dat inmiddels al 100 miljoen euro aan gokreclames is uitgegeven

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked whether gambling addiction has risen since the online gambling market opened and whether gambling advertising, speed limits and fragmented spending limits are adequately controlled. The Minister answered that no baseline existed, LADIS data will return by autumn, that speed limits are being studied, that untargeted ads are being restricted and role-model advertising banned from 30 June 2022, and that a cross-operator limit is under investigation.
I see no added value in separately requesting data from addiction clinics outside this system in the meantime.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde in het tussentijds buiten dit systeem om uitvragen van gegevens bij verslavingsklinieken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen die ongehuwd samenwonenden kunnen ondervinden als hun relatie ten einde komt

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the financial problems unmarried cohabiting partners face after a long relationship ends, and whether alimony, a share in accumulated assets, or a judicial fairness correction should be introduced for them. The minister stressed partner autonomy and personal responsibility, said unmarried partners can make their own agreements, and promised a substantive response to the alimony research report after the summer, including on partner alimony for unmarried cohabitants.
After the summer I will send Parliament a substantive response to the report and in that context respond on partner alimony for unmarried cohabitants.
Na de zomer zal ik een inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport aan uw Kamer toezenden en in dat kader met een reactie komen omtrent partneralimentatie voor ongehuwd samenwonenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ontwikkelingen rondom de landsadvocaat

MP Van Nispen asks whether the financial supervisor BFT has stopped using the law firm Pels Rijcken, whether BFT should use firms it supervises, and whether stricter requirements should apply to notaries the State uses, and asks about the composition of the Silvis commission. The minister confirms BFT is ending the framework contract, says BFT will assess case by case, that the State's notarial services will be sourced with stricter demands where feasible, and that the Silvis commission will advise on the longer term and may add a notarial expert if needed.
For the future, BFT wants to consider case by case whether, and if so which law firm, is engaged.
Het BFT wil voor de toekomst per kwestie bekijken, of, en zo ja, welk advocatenkantoor wordt ingeschakeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat tragische beelden op internet massaal gedeeld worden, tot groot verdriet van nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about widely shared footage of a fatal accident, the family's plea to stop sharing it, and whether a low-threshold reporting facility for victims of online privacy violations, as requested in an earlier motion, has been set up. The minister said the facility is an ambition for this cabinet period, agreed in principle that next-of-kin should be relieved of repeated reporting, but stressed that a legal framework must first be developed and fundamental rights considered.
It is my ambition to establish this facility and have it operational still within the current cabinet period.
Het is mijn ambitie om deze voorziening nog in de huidige kabinetsperiode tot stand te brengen en operationeel te hebben
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontbreken van een nationaal zwemdiploma en garanties voor veiligheid en kwaliteit van het zwemonderwijs

An SP MP asked the Minister for Long-Term Care and Sport about the absence of a national swimming diploma and safeguards for the safety and quality of swimming lessons, citing a Radar report. The minister acknowledged concern, said the sector currently bears primary responsibility, and said the national swimming safety council is exploring regulation scenarios and that the minister will decide on a national diploma after consultation, while declining to adopt the proposal to reintroduce school swimming.
At present, a high degree of responsibility rests with the sector itself to provide swimming lessons responsibly.
Op dit moment ligt een hoge mate van verantwoordelijkheid bij de branche zelf om op een verantwoorde wijze zwemles te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over verdrinkingen in Nederland

An SP MP asked about the true number of drownings in the Netherlands, CBS reporting methods, a possible repeat of a 2009 traffic-drowning campaign, suicide prevention with Stichting 113, and aftercare for lifeguards facing suicide attempts. The minister explains that CBS counts accidental drownings under the cause-of-death classification while broader reporting is planned, says the 2009 campaign had measurable awareness effects but limited proven impact on drownings, and promises to discuss suicide prevention with Stichting 113 and to raise lifeguard aftercare with open-water supervisors.
With the broader perspective that CBS adopts in future publications, I expect that we will have a complete picture of all drownings in the Netherlands in the future.
Met de bredere blik die het CBS in volgende publicaties hanteert, ga ik ervan uit dat we in de toekomst een compleet beeld hebben van alle verdrinkingen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over individuele ambtsberichten

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked about how Dutch individual intelligence reports (ambtsberichten) on Rwanda are produced, whether they can be verified, whether lawyers of genocide suspects get access, and the state of Rwanda's rule of law after Dutch aid ends. The government answered that the process uses vetted informants and independent sources, that courts can inspect underlying files confidentially, that ICJ monitoring of trials continues until final judgment, and that development aid is being phased out while human rights funding continues.

The competent court and/or the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State can obtain confidential access to the underlying documents to assess whether they support the conclusions of the individual intelligence report.

De bevoegde rechtbank en/of de Afdeling Bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State kan op vertrouwelijke basis inzage krijgen in de achterliggende stukken om te bezien of die de conclusies van het individuele ambtsbericht kunnen dragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over het bericht dat de Belgische overheid gokreclames aan banden gaat leggen

Two MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Belgium's plan to restrict gambling advertising and about the status of Dutch measures to curb risky gambling ads, speech limits, bonus communication and youth gambling. The Minister answered that the Besluit werving, reclame en verslavingspreventie will be amended for consultation before summer, that the rolmodel ban takes effect 30 June 2022, that sector self-commitments are still being implemented with new figures promised in autumn, and that the Ksa has sufficient capacity.
The draft decree is currently being worked out and is on track to go to consultation before the summer.
Het conceptbesluit wordt momenteel uitgewerkt en ligt op koers om voor de zomer in consultatie te worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de weigering van bedrijven op basis van geautomatiseerde kredietchecks

Two SP MPs asked whether automated credit checks by companies, which collect and retain privacy-sensitive data, are desirable, what legal basis exists, whether human intervention is required under the GDPR, who must correct erroneous data, and where citizens can turn when wrongly excluded. The minister acknowledged the impact on citizens, explained the GDPR principles and data controller responsibilities, and referred supervision to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens while describing existing rectification rights and programmes.
However, it cannot be established in general terms on which legal basis(es) the processing in the context of offering credit checks is based.
Het is echter niet in algemene zin vast te stellen op welke grondslag(en) de verwerkingen in het kader van het aanbieden van kredietchecks zijn gebaseerd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal meldingen van agressie- en geweldsincidenten in de jeugdgevangenissen toeneemt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising aggression and violence incidents in youth detention centres, staffing, working conditions, group sizes, closures and Horsterveen. The minister attributes the rise partly to higher occupancy, a tougher population, COVID measures and stricter registration, reports a decline since 2021, and outlines staffing measures, the VOM programme, and temporary measures, while rejecting changes to group sizes and making Horsterveen permanent.
Let me first state that aggression and violence against young people and staff in the youth detention centres is unacceptable.
Laat ik vooropstellen dat agressie en geweld tegen jongeren en personeel in de justitiële jeugdinrichtingen (hierna: de JJI's) onacceptabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het voornemen van de NS om de boa-bevoegdheid weg te halen bij hoofdconducteurs

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the government about NS's plan to remove the boa (special investigating officer) powers from its 2,800 head conductors, including the role of cost savings, staff shortages, safety impacts and consultation with staff. The state secretary answered that NS is responsible for safety and the decision, that the change saves about 5.7 million euro a year with little boa use, that safety is preserved through Veiligheid & Service staff, and that NS is exploring keeping boa powers for willing conductors.
NS is responsible for the safety of its passengers and staff. It is up to NS to decide on the necessary safety measures, such as the deployment of boas, in consultation with the works council.

NS is verantwoordelijk voor de veiligheid van haar reizigers en personeel. Het is aan NS om over de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen, zoals de inzet van boa's, te besluiten in afstemming met de ondernemingsraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraak van de voorzieningenrechter dat het OM niet goed is omgegaan met het verschoningsrecht van advocaten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how the Public Prosecution Service (OM) should handle lawyer-client privilege after a court ruled it breached privilege by reading lawyers' emails, and whether it would change practice, filter at providers, destroy such emails and review other cases. The minister accepted the ruling's core points, announced interim stricter procedures (provider filtering, secrecy officers, graying out, publication of policy) and an updated guideline, while declining further investigation of past cases and appealing the ruling.
In addition, based on the ruling, so-called 'un-graying' can only occur after a final, irrevocable judicial decision.
Daarnaast geldt, op basis van de uitspraak, dat het zogenoemde «ontgrijzen» slechts aan de orde kan zijn na onherroepelijk rechterlijk oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over  het kosteloos wijzigen van de geslachtsnaam voor slachtoffers van incest

An SP MP asked whether free name change for incest victims should be extended to cases where the perpetrator is a non-namegiving relative such as a brother or uncle. The minister answered that free change is limited to cases where the perpetrator is the namegiving parent, that he sees no reason to drop the cost-recovery principle, but will review the AMvB rules on name change in 2023 and take the wish into account.
I currently see no reason and financial room to abandon the principle that government services must be cost-covering.
Ik zie thans geen reden en financiële ruimte om het uitgangspunt los te laten dat diensten van de overheid kostendekkend moeten worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de toegenomen geweldsaanwendingen door de politie

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police use of force rose in 2021, how this affects police capacity and public trust, and whether inexperienced trainees are deployed with few-years officers. The minister said causes cannot yet be reliably identified, pointed to a pending evaluation of the new registration method, and stated that trainees are supervised by certified practice supervisors while the police monitor the situation.
On the basis of the figures, however, it is not possible to draw sound conclusions about the causes of this.
Op basis van de cijfers is het echter niet mogelijk verantwoorde conclusies te trekken over de oorzaken hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over concept vonnissen en inloopkamers

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a draft verdict accidentally published by the Rotterdam court and about the use of the inloopkamer (intake chamber) with legal clerks drafting judgments. The Minister answered that the publication was an unfortunate mistake without legal effect, that criminal cases normally do not use draft verdicts, and that the judge remains responsible for judgments and random case allocation applies.
The court's view written in the verdict already drafted in that case following the completed hearing on 2 February was not final, because pleadings were still to be held in that case.

Het oordeel van de rechtbank dat was opgeschreven in het vonnis dat in die zaak al gemaakt was naar aanleiding van de afgeronde behandeling van de zaak op 2 februari was niet definitief, omdat er in die zaak nog gepleit zou worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een incident in justitiële jeugdinrichting Den Hey-Acker

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a fatal stabbing at the Den Hey-Acker youth detention facility, staff concerns about rising offender severity, and whether structural change is needed. The minister said four inspectorates are investigating with results expected in Q1 2023, listed interim measures such as a knife ban and staff coaching, and said he will await the inspectorates' findings before adding measures.
The inspectorates are examining how Rijks JJI Den Hey-Acker acted before, during and after the incident and what lessons and improvement points there are.
De inspecties onderzoeken hoe Rijks JJI Den Hey-Acker heeft gehandeld in de aanloop naar, tijdens en na het incident en welke leer- en verbeterpunten er zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het uitkeren van een schadevergoeding aan de Groesbeekse kopschoppers

MP Van Nispen asks why the Public Prosecution Service paid compensation to the Groesbeek 'kopschoppers' after withdrawing from the case, and why the reasons for the withdrawal remain secret. The Minister answers that compensation is awarded by the court on equity grounds, declines to judge individual court decisions, and states that secrecy over 'serious interests' is necessary to protect them, noting the Procurator-General found the prosecution's balancing reasonable.
Neither the OM nor I can, however, give openness about the serious interests.
Het OM noch ik kunnen echter openheid geven over de zwaarwegende belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘aanpak dronesmokkel gevangenissen schiet al drie jaar nauwelijks op’

Oppositional MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection why drone smuggling into prisons has hardly been tackled in three years, whether staff are at increased risk, why solutions take so long, whether staff and unions are consulted, and whether no-fly zones exist around prisons. The Minister denies the approach is failing, reports declining but still high contraband finds, describes drone detection systems operational in five prisons with rollout planned, and says talks are ongoing with the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management on a flight ban, while staff and unions are consulted through existing works-council channels.
There is an ongoing struggle against contraband; there is no question of a failing approach.
Er is sprake van een continue strijd tegen contrabande, er is geen sprake van een falende aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van Nispen over de landsadvocaat en fraude-onderzoeken

MPs Omtzigt and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about Pels Rijcken, the State's counsel firm, refusing to share an internal fraud investigation with the public prosecutor and about related fraud, claims and governance questions. The minister answered that the prosecutor and firm are following the statutory procedure for confidential information, that the investigation results were made available to Parliament for confidential inspection, and that many questions cannot be answered because of ongoing criminal investigations.
The prosecution service and Pels Rijcken are currently following the appropriate statutory procedure for disclosing data subject to a duty of confidentiality.
Het OM en Pels Rijcken doorlopen momenteel de geëigende wettelijke procedure die bestaat voor verstrekking van gegevens waarop een geheimhoudingsplicht rust.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en van Nispen over de kosten van het opruimen van drugsdumpingen en de zaak van de 90-jarige gedupeerde landeigenaar

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked about municipal and provincial demands that a 90-year-old landowner pay for clean-up of chemical drug waste dumped on his land, and about the adequacy of the national compensation scheme. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing a pending objection procedure, acknowledged the scheme's EUR 25,000 cap is being exceeded in large cases, and said talks with the provinces and BIJ12 are ongoing with an update promised before summer.
There is an objection procedure ongoing in this case with the competent authority.
Er loopt in deze zaak een bezwaarprocedure bij het bevoegd gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de vergunningsprocedure voor nieuwe toetreders tot de online kansspelmarkt

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked the minister about the licensing of new online gambling operators, including an overview of pending applications, transparency about applicants, and welcome bonuses for young players. The minister declined to name applicants with pending licence requests (citing reputational harm), explained the Ksa's criteria and six-month timeline, rejected public consultation on applications, and said the Ksa supervises bonus rules for 18-24 year olds.
The Ksa cannot provide the requested overview of names.
De Ksa kan het gevraagde overzicht van namen niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het toezicht op de naleving van de sancties tegen Rusland op de Zuidas

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether a 2019 Houthoff case breached Russia sanctions, who supervises sanctions compliance across four bodies, whether capacity is sufficient, and why only 14 administrative fines but no criminal action since 2015. The minister answered that law firms lack supervision and a statutory regulation is being prepared, that prosecution is for the OM, that additional capacity is being assessed, and that a national sanctions coordinator was appointed.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that criminal action was taken against violations of sectoral sanctions measures concerning the sanctioned flow of goods.
Het OM heeft aangegeven dat strafrechtelijk is opgetreden tegen overtreding van sectorale sanctiemaatregelen aangaande de gesanctioneerde goederenstroom.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zaak van Patrick Noordoven en het feit dat de Staat in hoger beroep gaat tegen een eerdere uitspraak in deze zaak

An SP MP asked why the State is appealing a court ruling that found it acted unlawfully toward adoptee Patrick Noordoven, and how it can justify continuing the litigation. The Minister of Legal Protection declined to discuss the grounds of appeal because the case is pending, pointed to the State's apologies and to planned support for adoptees, and refused to withdraw the appeal.
On the grounds of the appeal I make no statements, as is usual in pending proceedings.
Op de gronden van het hoger beroep doe ik – zoals gebruikelijk in een lopende procedure – een mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderhouden van contacten van achterblijvers met gedetineerden en het opschorten van de e-mail-service eMates

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the eMates email service for detainees was suspended, questioning the speed, lack of consultation and impact on detainees and families. The minister answered that the suspension follows a Public Prosecution Service concern, that an independent audit (about three months) will assess risks to personal data and security before any resumption, and that alternative contact channels remain available.
When the investigation is completed, a decision will be made on whether and under which conditions the eMates messaging service can be resumed.
Wanneer het onderzoek is afgerond zal besloten worden of en onder welke condities de berichtenservice via eMates kan worden hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over enkele deurwaardergerelateerde zaken

MP Van Nispen asks whether serving full underlying documents on third parties in attachment proceedings violates debtor privacy, whether a pilot replacing summons with written petitions reduces human contact, and asks the minister to reflect on this. The minister agrees in principle to reconsider the privacy-sensitive service requirement in a future Rv amendment after consultation, and describes the Amsterdam 'Zorgzaken' pilot as structurally embedded and expanded, while monitoring whether vulnerable debtors lose information.

At a future amendment of the Rv this will therefore be taken into account, after consultation with the Council for the Judiciary and the Royal Professional Association of Court Bailiffs on how best to shape it.

Bij een volgende wetswijziging van het Rv zal dit daarom worden meegenomen, na afstemmening met de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders over hoe dit het beste vorm kan worden gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over belangenbehartigers die betalen voor cliëntgegevens om zaken binnen te halen

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the government will act against third parties paying for victims' personal data to win injury claims, and whether a fee ban should be considered. The minister acknowledged the practice, said existing rules and the sector's Nationaal Keurmerk Letselschade adequately protect victims, and declined to introduce a fee ban for now.
The existing rules and regulations provide sufficiently adequate protection for injury victims against dishonest practices, so a fee ban is, in my view, not currently on the agenda.

De bestaande norm- en regelgeving bieden voldoende adequaat bescherming aan slachtoffers met letselschade tegen malafide praktijken, waardoor een provisieverbod wat mij betreft nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan en Van Nispen over de ontoereikendheid van de aanpak om ontuchtplegers en daders van seksueel geweld in de sport te weren

MPs Van der Laan and Van Nispen asked the minister whether screening tools such as the VOG and the NOC*NSF blacklist adequately keep sex offenders out of sports coaching, and about information-sharing gaps. The minister acknowledged the gap, declined to link disciplinary information to the VOG, said a shared registration system is blocked by the GDPR, and promised further talks and a national action plan without committing to a specific legal change.
I consider linking disciplinary information to the Certificate of Conduct for Natural Persons (VOG) undesirable.
Ik acht het koppelen van tuchtrechtinformatie aan de Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag Natuurlijke Personen (VOG) niet wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Rudmer Heerema over de voorkeur voor de vakleerkracht bewegingsonderwijs

MPs Van Nispen and Rudmer Heerema asked whether all physical education lessons in primary schools should be given by ALO-qualified specialist teachers, including what barriers exist and whether a law change is planned. The minister replied that the current mix of specialist and qualified group teachers should remain, that a full switch is unrealistic given teacher shortages and funding, and that no law change is warranted.
Given the current education labour market, I see no reason to change the law on this point.
Ik zie, gelet op de huidige onderwijsarbeidsmarkt, geen aanleiding om de wet op dit punt te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Tuchtraad Banken het onderzoek naar de voormalig topman van ING noodgedwongen heeft moeten stopzetten

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Finance Minister whether the Banking Disciplinary Board's halted investigation into former ING chief Ralph Hamers, caused by bank non-cooperation, shows the banking disciplinary system is failing and should be anchored in law with enforcement powers. The minister said the system works through sector self-regulation under DNB supervision, that banks are obliged to cooperate, and that she will stress active cooperation with the sector without proposing legislative changes.
It is primarily up to the supervisor to judge compliance with the norms of the Wft
Het is primair aan de toezichthouder om een oordeel te vellen over de naleving van de normen uit de Wft
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over het bericht dat het onderzoek naar fraude bij de landsadvocaat onvolledig en niet onafhankelijk genoeg was

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked the Justice Minister about reports that the deken's investigation into fraud at Pels Rijcken was incomplete and insufficiently independent, and about the effectiveness of oversight of law firms. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, pointed to planned reforms creating a single national supervisor for advocates, and said talks with the NOvA are ongoing, with no firm commitment on the specific demands.
Given the independence of the legal profession and its supervision, I am reluctant to respond to an individual case, and this is no exception.
Gelet op de onafhankelijkheid van de advocatuur en het toezicht daarop ben ik terughoudend met het reageren op een individuele casus, zo ook deze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een vergewisplicht voor websites met naaktbeelden en pornografisch materiaal

An MP asks whether a court ruling requiring adult websites to verify consent of people appearing in intimate material should lead to a general duty on platforms to verify consent and age, and whether the minister will discuss consequences with the industry. The minister says the ruling confirms earlier positions, rejects a general verification duty as conflicting with EU liability rules and no-general-monitoring principles, but will raise platform obligations in existing working groups and EU-level agreements.
A general verification duty is in tension with the liability exclusion for service hosting providers and the prohibition of general monitoring.
Een algemene vergewisplicht staat op gespannen voet met de uitsluiting van aansprakelijkheid zoals die geldt voor service hosting providers en het verbod op algemene monitoring
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het stopzetten van de succesvolle gedragsinterventie “sport en gedrag”

MP Van Nispen asks whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' behavioural intervention, which runs on project funding until end-2022, will be continued and funded structurally, and whether Halt or the Justice Ministry should take it over. The Minister says the intervention is well-regarded but its effects are not yet proven, that funding after 2022 is still under discussion with Halt and the KNVB, and that the justice role of Halt does not cover cases without a police report.
For a decision on funding after 2022 it is therefore still too early.
Voor een besluit over de financiering na 2022 is het daarom nu nog te vroeg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de vandalen van de coronarellen het betalen van aangerichte schade ontlopen

An SP MP asked why perpetrators of the January 2021 Covid-protest riots have paid little of the damage they caused, and why a victim-damage fund was never set up. The Minister of Justice answered that about 55 convicted rioters were ordered to pay about €551,000, of which only about €36,700 had been collected by January 2022, that the government compensated affected businesses and took over their claims, and that it is still examining how to recover these amounts from perpetrators.
However, I can assure you that it is my ambition to have perpetrators pay as much as possible for the damage caused.
Ik kan u echter verzekeren dat het mijn ambitie is om daders zoveel als mogelijk te laten betalen voor de aangerichte schade.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Nispen over signalen dat verzekeraars en gemeenten mogelijk weer afspraken zouden willen maken over Wmo-regresrecht

An SP MP asked whether insurers and municipalities might again agree to buy out Wmo recourse rights for injury claims, and whether victims are being passed between municipality and insurer. The government answered that victims keep the freedom to choose between municipality and insurer, that no new convenant is planned, that VNG and the insurers' association keep talking, and that it sees no added value in raising the matter again with them.
In practice the victim has the freedom to choose between the municipality and the insurer.
In de praktijk heeft het slachtoffer de vrijheid om te kiezen tussen gemeente en verzekeraar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops en Agnes Mulder over de toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM

MPs Van Dijk, Van Nispen, Knops and Mulder asked about the status of the EU's accession to the European Convention on Human Rights, the remaining legal and political objections, and when talks would resume. The minister replied that negotiations are progressing slowly through seven rounds since 2020, that several legal objections remain (partly resolved), the next round is scheduled for May 2022, and the Netherlands will actively push to speed up accession.
The Netherlands wishes to fulfil the treaty obligation for the EU's accession to the ECHR as quickly as possible.
Nederland wenst de verdragsrechtelijke verplichting tot toetreding van de EU tot het EVRM zo snel mogelijk te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over problemen bij beslag op minimumuitkeringen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked whether minimum benefit recipients are left below subsistence when enforcement agents collect small positive differences after indexation, and how often this happens. The minister replied that borrowers can ask for the protected allowance to be recalculated after a structural income change, that the issue will be reviewed in the evaluation of the Wet vereenvoudiging beslagvrije voet in 2022/2023, and that the suggested legislative fixes are not adequate.
A citizen, but also their debt assistant or protective administrator, can ask the enforcing parties to recalculate the protected allowance after a structural change in their circumstances.

Een burger, maar ook diens schuldhulpverlener of beschermingsbewindvoerder, kan bij een structurele wijziging van zijn omstandigheden de beslagleggende partijen vragen om de beslagvrije voet opnieuw vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over witwaspraktijken bij de landsadvocaat

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about money-laundering practices linked to the state's legal adviser Pels Rijcken, including whether it should be prosecuted, the status of investigations, the planned expert commission, whether a Bibob check should apply, and why no sanction was imposed unlike ING. The Minister declined substantive comment citing ongoing criminal investigations, pointed to the Bar and financial supervisor reviews, said the commission's details would follow, and explained the ING transaction as a prosecutorial matter.
Since the criminal investigation is still ongoing, I cannot make substantive statements about this in the interest of the investigation.
Aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog lopende is, kan ik in het belang van het onderzoek geen inhoudelijke uitspraken hierover doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijke schendingen van het verschoningsrecht door OM en FIOD

MP Van Nispen asked whether the OM and FIOD have breached legal privilege (verschoningsrecht) for lawyers, how they handle privileged material, whether the Landsadvocaat was consulted, who supervises the geheimhouder-officier van justitie, and whether an independent review or central body is needed. The Minister explains the procedures (rechter-commissaris review, geheimhouder-officier and -medewerker, Hoge Raad 2020 ruling, OM guidance being updated) and says the PG at the Hoge Raad supervises the OM, declining to add a new review power for now.
In the interest of ongoing cases I cannot go into individual cases.
Ik kan in het belang van lopende zaken niet op individuele zaken ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijkheden van 112 bellen als iemand niet kan spreken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the 112 emergency protocol when callers cannot speak, the accessibility of alternative 112 options, a silent-call code, the registration requirement for emergency SMS, and the share of prank or misuse calls. The minister described the protocol and disconnection rules, said alternatives are being made easier and a 'can't speak now' button is planned, noted 1,361 SMS registrations, and reported that about 40 percent of 112 calls are misuse.
In a future update of the 112NL app this option will be introduced via an 'I cannot speak now' button.
In een toekomstige update van de 112NL-app wordt deze mogelijkheid geïntroduceerd middels een «ik-kan-nu-niet-spreken-knop».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afname van de zwemvaardigheid onder kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked why the share of children with swimming diplomas is falling and what the minister will do to reverse it, including whether the pool closures during lockdowns were justified. The minister acknowledges concern, explains that pool closures were a deliberate trade-off favouring swimming lessons only from March 2021, and says the backlog is mainly the sector's responsibility, with a letter on progress promised for spring 2022.
That is why on 8 March 2021 the importance of swimming lessons was weighed more heavily than limiting the number of infections.
Daarom is op 8 maart 2021 het belang van zwemles zwaarder gewogen dan de beperking van het aantal besmettingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en van Nispen over de “te slappe” aanpak van geweld tegen hulpverleners

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether the prosecution service's handling of violence against care workers, including out-of-court OM penalty orders, undermines victims' sense of being taken seriously and their right to be heard. The Minister answered that OM penalty orders are a full legal equivalent of a court judgment, that the OM considers victims' interests and their right to be heard, and that victims can challenge a penalty order via a complaint to the appeals court under article 12 Sv.
The OM supports the victim as well as possible in obtaining compensation for their material and immaterial damage.
Het OM ondersteunt het slachtoffer zo goed als mogelijk bij het verkrijgen van een vergoeding van zijn materiële en immateriële schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over suïcide onder agenten waarbij het dienstwapen is gebruikt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about suicides among police officers using their service weapon, including delays in the promised guidance for supervisors on taking back service weapons, the inspectorate's handling of a family's concerns, and whether criminal investigation is blocked by state immunity. The minister answered that the handbook was finished in 2019, that a supervisor conversation guide is being developed, that the inspectorate's findings were shared only verbally at the family's request, and that the prosecutor's decision not to investigate the state is not for the minister to judge.
Beforehand it was agreed with the next of kin and their lawyer that the findings would only be shared orally with them.
Vooraf is met de nabestaande en diens advocaat afgesproken de uitkomsten enkel mondeling met hen te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan maatwerk bij het Centraal Justitieel Incassobureau (CJIB)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Nationale ombudsman's finding that the OM and CJIB failed to provide tailored treatment in enforcing a compensation measure, including whether a EUR 6,000 surcharge should be removed. The minister answered that the surcharges are set by law with no room to undo them, that the ombudsman's recommendation to deduct them was not followed, and that the CJIB has since expanded payment-arrangement and debt-relief options.
Only the recommendation to deduct the legally imposed surcharges from the outstanding amount has not been followed.
Enkel de aanbeveling om de wettelijke opgelegde verhogingen in mindering te brengen op het openstaande bedrag is niet opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht over coronabesmettingen in het gevangeniswezen en maatregelen om het virus buiten te houden, zoals 2G

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about COVID-19 infections in prisons, detainee and visitor hardship, whether the 2G-style visit rules are proportionate and lawful, and whether prison measures should be reviewed. The minister reported 199 infections, denied that visits require full vaccination or prior infection (a negative test suffices), and said measures follow government policy and RIVM guidance with a letter to parliament promised for early March.
I will inform your House at the beginning of March about the current state of affairs.
Ik informeer uw Kamer begin maart over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over toenemende intimidaties in het gevangeniswezen

MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about rising intimidation of prison staff, reported in a union survey, and whether staffing levels, vetting, and workplace culture are adequate. The minister acknowledges the concern, says a link to staffing is hard to establish, and lists recruitment, vetting (VOG), security and training measures, with a promise to inform parliament in the next progress letter.
On the outcome of these talks I will inform your House in the next progress letter on the vision for the prison system.
Over de uitkomsten van deze gesprekken zal ik uw Kamer bij de volgende voortgangsbrief over de visie op het gevangeniswezen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een verdwenen onderzoek van de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid

MP Van Nispen asks why an Inspectorate report on police capacity for weapons-licensing (korpscheftaken) was withdrawn and never reached parliament, and whether the ministry pressured the inspectorate. The minister replies that the report was withdrawn on the inspectorate's own initiative because its focus drifted to management capacity, that parliament was informed earlier, and that the inspectorate's independence is adequate, while promising concrete steps and a follow-up letter on the related Wpbr report.
The draft report focused on management aspects, such as financing and the allocation of strength and resources.
Het conceptrapport was gericht op beheersaspecten, zoals de financiering en de verdeling van sterkte en middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over nijpende tekorten aan forensische artsen

An SP MP asks the health and justice ministers about acute shortages of forensic doctors, including reliance on temporary contractors, retirements, pay, and whether the EUR 20 million per year needed should be decided now or left to a new cabinet. The government acknowledges the acute and long-standing shortage, describes recruitment, training and reorganisation measures, and says the funding decision is for the new cabinet.
It is up to the cabinet to take a definitive decision on this, including securing the necessary funding.
Het is aan het kabinet om hierover een definitief besluit te nemen, waaronder ook het borgen van de benodigde dekking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdere afname van het schoolzwemmen

An SP MP asked the government about the continued decline of school swimming lessons (from 31% to 26% of schools) and whether national action is needed. The minister answered that school swimming is not a statutory task and is a local matter, pointed to existing subsidy and a national swimming safety plan, and committed to consulting education and municipal stakeholders and to a catch-up support for COVID-related swimming delays.
School swimming is not a statutory task for education.
Schoolzwemmen is geen wettelijke taak voor het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM het onderzoek naar fraude bij Pels Rijcken aan een commerciële partij heeft overgelaten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service's top leadership blocked a prosecutor who wanted to escalate the criminal fraud investigation into Pels Rijcken, and whether the OM handed inquiries to a commercial party, Deloitte, and gave it access to seized devices. The minister answered that the OM decided to temporise the criminal probe pending supervisory investigations and the Deloitte report, denied that Deloitte obtained access to devices, said the OM determines investigation strategy, and pointed to a WODC study on self-investigation due in spring 2022.
It is for the OM, and not for me, to determine the approach to a criminal investigation.
Het is aan het OM, en niet aan mij, om de inzet op een strafrechtelijk onderzoek te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aansprakelijkheid van social media platforms bij wraakporno

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether social media platforms can be held liable for aiding and abetting image-based sexual abuse (revenge porn) despite the EU e-commerce liability exemption, and what the government's position is. The minister answered that platforms can lose the liability exemption once they know of unlawful content and fail to act, that the DSA revision is underway, and that the government will keep working on regulation and enforcement, without committing to a specific new liability rule for platforms.
My policy is aimed at undoing criminal offences and unlawful acts as quickly as possible.
Mijn beleid is erop gericht strafbare feiten en onrechtmatigheden zo snel mogelijk weer ongedaan te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de resultaten van de pilot vergoeding eigen risico zorgverzekering voor slachtoffers van seksueel geweld

An MP asked whether the government would scrap the health insurance deductible for sexual violence victims seeking help, after a pilot study found victims experience compensation as recognition and the seven-day cutoff is questioned. The minister answered that a policy response will follow in spring 2022 after consultation with stakeholders, explained the seven-day rationale (acute care and evidence collection), and pointed to a campaign and a new study on barriers to help-seeking.
A substantive policy response on the follow-up will be sent to the House of Representatives in spring 2022.
Een inhoudelijke beleidsreactie ten aanzien van het vervolg wordt in het voorjaar van 2022 naar de Tweede Kamer gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over signalen van slechte zorg, fraude en hoge salarissen bij een instelling die zorg zou moeten leveren aan ex-gedetineerden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about poor care, fraud signals and high salaries at a provider of care to ex-prisoners in Enschede, including what supervision was in place and whether the director was screened. The minister answered that DJI knew of the signals since March 2020, launched a material audit in July 2021 and did not renew the contract, while defending its supervision, the tender exclusion grounds and the planned recovery of funds.
At present the investigation into the lawfulness of the care services declared by Zorg en Research is ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt het onderzoek naar de rechtmatigheid van de door Zorg en Research gedeclareerde zorgprestaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over zwemles

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked about long swimming lesson waiting lists caused by COVID-19 restrictions, the classification of swimming lessons, child safety, and the COVID pass requirement at swimming schools. The minister answered at length, estimating 69,000 to 92,000 children lost lesson time and stating the lessons are now possible again, but declined to give exact figures and did not commit to re-seeking OMT advice.
It is difficult to say how many children have not obtained a diploma as a result of the restrictions.
Het is moeilijk te zeggen hoeveel kinderen nu geen diploma gehaald hebben als gevolg van de beperkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Sportsector verbaasd: aanstaand Minister Ernst Kuipers houdt interne fitnessclub in ziekenhuis open'

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why the Erasmus MC staff gym stayed open while sports were restricted for the public, and whether sport should be permitted again, including for under-18s, in line with OMT advice. The Minister answered that sport is important for everyone, that the cabinet decided on 14 January to allow indoor and outdoor sport again for all age groups without time restrictions, and that the questions could not be answered before the press conference.
Sport and exercise are very important for staying or becoming fit. That applies to everyone.
Sport en bewegen is heel belangrijk om fit te blijven of te worden. Dat geldt voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zaak Ivana Smit

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the government would press Malaysia harder on the case of Ivana Smit and what concrete progress had been made since earlier answers. The minister replied that the Netherlands has repeatedly raised the case and offered legal assistance, but that its room to act is very limited because Malaysia's prosecutor leads the investigation and interfering in foreign proceedings is unwanted.

The Netherlands' room to act is however very limited, since the criminal investigation is carried out by Malaysia's Public Prosecution Service and interference in a foreign legal process is undesirable.

Het handelingsperspectief van Nederland is echter zeer beperkt, aangezien het strafrechtelijk onderzoek door het Maleisische Openbaar Ministerie wordt uitgevoerd en inmenging in een buitenlandse rechtsgang ongewenst is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over contact van gedetineerden met journalisten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why prisoners need prior permission from the prison director to speak to journalists, whether this should be reversed to a Belgian-style after-the-fact sanction system, and how often such requests are granted or refused. The minister replied that the current permission system with a balancing test and appeal routes is adequate, that no data on requests are registered, and that no change is planned.
I see no reason at this time to change the procedure.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de werkwijze te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de beschikbare informatie met betrekking tot afpakken van misdaadgeld, witwassen en Bibob

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for information on the effectiveness of confiscating criminal proceeds, money laundering policy and Bibob screening, including statistics on Bibob advice, confiscation orders and enforcement durations. The Minister answered that organised crime is hard to quantify, pointed to existing monitors, a WODC feasibility study, evaluations and Court of Audit reports due in 2022, and supplied tables covering 2014-2020 Bibob advice and 2010-2021 confiscation data.
To better map both organised undermining crime and the effectiveness of government action against it, the WODC is conducting a feasibility study on a monitor on my ministry's behalf.

Met het oog op het beter in kaart brengen van zowel georganiseerde, ondermijnende criminaliteit als de effectiviteit van het overheidsoptreden hiertegen, voert het WODC in opdracht van mijn ministerie een haalbaarheidsstudie uit voor een monitor
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de dubbelrol van een Amsterdamse rechter

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an Amsterdam judge who also works as director of the Criminal Justice Chain at the ministry, questioning impartiality and conflicts of interest. The minister replied that such side functions are permitted under the WRRA and the judiciary's guidelines, that the court president as functional authority assessed and registered it, and that a bill to ban judges from parliament is in consultation while possible wider restrictions on side functions may be discussed in parliament.
This means judges may hold side functions as long as these do not impede the proper performance of the office and do not give rise to (the appearance of) partiality.
Dit betekent dat rechters nevenfuncties kunnen bekleden zolang deze niet in de weg staan aan een goede vervulling van het ambt en niet (de schijn van) partijdigheid met zich brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over rechtsbijstand bij verhoor van minderjarigen

MP Van Nispen asks why the government has not complied with a Amsterdam district court ruling extending legal aid to unarrested minors questioned by police, and whether the state will appeal and provide a temporary arrangement to safeguard the lawfulness of interrogations. Minister Dekker replies that the ruling was implemented for the individual case, that the government disagrees with the court's reading of the directive and has asked for an appeal to the Council of State, and that a temporary arrangement for summoned minors is being prepared.

At present I am in discussion with the legal profession and the most involved chain partners to arrange a temporary provision, examining how legal aid during police interrogation is to be arranged for summoned juvenile suspects.

Momenteel ben ik met de advocatuur en de meest betrokken ketenpartners in gesprek om een tijdelijke voorziening te treffen, waarbij wordt bezien op welke wijze rechtsbijstand bij politieverhoor wordt geregeld voor ontboden jeugdige verdachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de afschaffing van het directe klachtrecht van consumenten bij de Tuchtraad Financiële Dienstverlening’

An SP MP asked the Finance Minister whether the Verbond van Verzekeraars removed consumers' direct complaint right to the Tuchtraad Financiële Dienstverlening against his criticism, and questioned AFM oversight and self-regulation. The minister denied any restriction, explained the single-counter design via Kifid, and refused an independent investigation, though he promised to urge insurers to make the complaint route more visible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onschuldigen die zich geïntimideerd voelen door undercoveragenten

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about innocent third parties intimidated by undercover officers, asking how far powers under article 126j Sv reach, how proportionality is checked, and whether rules should be tightened. The minister said that prosecutors and courts assess lawfulness case by case, that he will not comment on individual rulings, and that a new commission under Sorgdrager will advise on strengthening safeguards before any changes to rules are considered.
Going forward, a new commission will among other things examine which aspects of the undercover powers need further strengthening of safeguards.
Naar de toekomst toe zal een nieuwe commissie zich onder andere richten op de vraag op welke aspecten van de undercover bevoegdheden nadere versterking van de waarborgen nodig is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de bezuinigingen op de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about budget cuts to the fire service in the Noord-Holland Noord safety region, including whether safety is affected, the removal of vehicles and volunteers, and why earlier questions were answered late. The minister replies that regional boards set their own budgets and service levels, that cuts are efficiency measures without affecting fire service tasks, that the ministry does not register vehicle and team data, and that earlier questions were already answered.
The board of a safety region adopts the (multi-year) budget of the region.
Het bestuur van een veiligheidsregio stelt de (meerjaren)begroting van de regio vast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en Van Nispen over de Kamerbrief 'Financiële compensatie voor het tekortschieten in de informatievoorziening bij wijziging van de SBF-regeling'

MPs Palland (CDA) and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the SBF-scheme compensation, arguing that SBF-ers suffered pension damage from the 2010 and 2013 changes and that DJI's poor information provision was wrongful. The Minister answered that no pension damage has been established, accepted the Boot/Lubbers finding of inadequate information only for the 2013 change (compensated), and declined further talks with the affected group.
I have not planned any consultation or follow-up steps with the SBF employees who used the SBF leave scheme or with the interest group 'SBF moet eerlijk'.
Ik heb geen overleg of vervolgstappen gepland met de SBF-medewerkers die gebruik hebben gemaakt van de SBF-verlofregeling of van de belangengroep «SBF moet eerlijk» gepland staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gerechtsdeurwaarders die discutabele incasso’s proberen te incasseren

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether bailiffs earn more from debt collection than from official duties, whether they properly vet client companies with dubious reputations, and how consumers are protected from confusion and unfair pressure. The Minister answered that collection is a permitted side activity subject to independent BFT oversight, that bailiffs must communicate carefully and face disciplinary liability for undue pressure, and that a Wki quality bill and further consultations on the roles of bailiffs are underway, while leaving the burden of disputing invoices largely with the debtor and the creditor.
It is certainly not good if the bailiff is seen as an extension of companies with a dubious reputation.
Het is zeker niet goed als de gerechtsdeurwaarder als verlengstuk wordt gezien van bedrijven met een dubieuze reputatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de recorduitgaven aan de landsadvocaat

SP MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked why government spending on the state's lawyer (landsadvocaat) reached a record in 2020, how it is itemised, and how this squares with the aim of curbing juridification and with refusing legal aid to Groningen gas-damage victims. The minister explained the rise as incident-driven (COVID and Groningen litigation), itemised costs per ministry, and said legal aid for Groningen residents is being arranged through a novella while the state's own lawyer use is necessary and kept under scrutiny.
The cabinet is preparing for that with the state's lawyer.
Het kabinet bereidt zich daar met de landsadvocaat op voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbescherming bij de NCTV

MP Van Nispen asks how the NCTV handles data-access and deletion requests, given a settlement with an imam over deleted data and reports that the NCTV's data processing lacks the access rights and oversight applicable to police, and whether the NCTV should be placed under supervision like an intelligence service. Minister Grapperhaus answers that individual cases are not discussed, that access requests follow a fixed AVG procedure with appeal possible, that the NCTV is not an intelligence or police service and is not subject to the WIV, and that a legislative proposal adding safeguards has been submitted.
Individual cases are not discussed, and therefore the substantive handling of the present case is not discussed either.
Op individuele zaken wordt niet ingegaan en dus ook niet op de inhoudelijke afhandeling van het onderhavige geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over illegale casino’s op Curaçao

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Minister for Legal Protection and the State Secretary for the Interior and Kingdom Relations about the scale of illegal online gambling from Curaçao, the Dutch Gambling Authority's (Ksa) ability to collect fines, and the status of a motion on the Team Bestrijding Ondermijning. The government answered that Curaçao is autonomous in licensing and enforcement, that it is working with the Netherlands on reform under the Curaçao package, that Ksa fines against Curaçao-based firms are hard to collect, and that the motion is considered fulfilled.
Imposing an order subject to a penalty or a fine is, however, only one of the means that can be used to stop illegal providers.
Het opleggen van een last onder dwangsom of boete is echter maar één van de middelen die kunnen worden ingezet om illegale aanbieders te stoppen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de praktijk van het uitsluiten door Jehova’s Getuigen van afvallige leden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about shunning of former Jehovah's Witnesses, including what help the state offers victims, whether the law is adequate, and the status of a reporting point for cult victims requested by motion. The minister answered that shunning per se is not a criminal offence, victims can use regular mental health care and general victim support, no signals justify new criminalisation, and the reporting point will be set up carefully, with results of a commission expected in spring 2022.
Excluding former members by the Jehovah's Witness community is, however, not a criminal offence in itself.
Het uitsluiten van ex-leden door de gemeenschap der Jehova's Getuigen is echter op zichzelf geen strafbaar feit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel 'Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt'

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked whether the Inspectorate of Justice and Security will investigate a case in which a rapist under intensified supervision struck again despite warning signs, and why no further inquiry is planned. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found no reason for further investigation after questioning police and probation, that the information it received is confidential supervisory information and cannot be shared, and that no reason for a new inquiry has come to light.
That information cannot be shared. The Inspectorate of Justice and Security received this information from the police and probation service in the context of its supervisory duties.
Die informatie kan niet worden gedeeld. Deze informatie heeft de Inspectie Justitie en Veiligheid van de politie en de reclassering gekregen in het kader van haar taakuitoefening als toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over openbaarheid van het onderzoek naar afluisterapparatuur

MP Van Nispen asked why the police research into interception equipment was not public, whether the police ignored a Bits of Freedom objection despite a court-imposed penalty of 15,000 euros, and how often the police respond late to complaints and objections. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the report was partly published and sent to parliament on 29 October, that the objection was decided that day, that the police admits the late response and is working to improve, and that six court cases in five years resulted in 35,700 euros in penalties; he did not answer the question on late responses in general, saying no central record exists.
The police is aware that this is an undesirable situation.
De politie is zich ervan bewust dat dit een onwenselijke situatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheid van registertolken- en vertalers en anonimiteit

Van Nispen (SP) asked why certified interpreters' and translators' personal details appear on translations while other case participants are anonymised, how threatened interpreters are protected, how intercept interpreters are shielded, and how confidential data is kept from third parties. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors and judges are not anonymised in general, that intercept interpreters now receive anonymous accounts, that intermediaries sign confidentiality agreements, and that interpreters in sensitive cases may choose to hide their contact details and anonymisation of interpreters can be considered when needed.
Interpreters and translators therefore have the option to choose whether their contact details can be found in the public part of the register or not.
Tolken en vertalers hebben daarom de mogelijkheid zelf te kiezen of hun contactgegevens via het openbare deel van het register te vinden zijn of niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over suïcide onder agenten waarbij het dienstwapen is gebruikt

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about police suicides involving service weapons, whether officers with psychological problems may take their weapons home, the Rijksrecherche and Inspectorate investigations, the number of suicides and PTSS cases, and psychological support capacity. The minister answered that a uniform guideline now lets supervisors withdraw service weapons for psychological reasons, that no Rijksrecherche investigation was held because it falls outside its remit, that the Inspectorate handled the case within regular oversight without a report, and that 24 police suicides occurred 2016–2020, nine with service weapons.
Because of medically confidential information, no information is available on the number of police officers diagnosed with PTSD in the past five years.
Vanwege de medisch vertrouwelijke informatie is er geen informatie beschikbaar over het aantal politiemedewerkers waarbij in de afgelopen vijf jaar de diagnose PTSS is vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het ambtshalve toevoegen van een advocaat door een rechter aan een moeder die niet zelfredzaam is

Two SP MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a court that appointed a lawyer ex officio for a mother who could not look after her own interests, despite no statutory basis, and how such cases should be handled. The minister welcomed the outcome, pointed to early-signalling efforts, said costs fall on the legal aid budget, and declined to create a statutory basis for now, awaiting a WODC study due spring 2022.
I do not consider a statutory amendment to create an ex officio legal aid assignment for interested parties who are not self-reliant to be appropriate at this time.
Ik acht een wetswijziging om een ambtshalve last tot toevoeging te creëren aan belanghebbenden die niet zelfredzaam zijn, nu niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over de aanhoudingen van journalisten tijdens demonstraties

Two SP MPs asked why three journalists were detained at climate demonstrations and what rules protect press identity during arrests. The Justice Minister answered that press cards carry rights but also duties, that the police apply internal rules, that the arrests were lawful and no prosecution followed, and that the issue will be raised in the PersVeilig steering group.
In the aforementioned cases it turned out that the arrest was lawful.
In de voornoemde zaken is gebleken dat de aanhouding rechtmatig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het strafontslag van een agente die grensoverschrijdend gedrag van een leidinggevende aankaartte

MP Van Nispen asked about the dismissal of a police officer who reported cross-border behaviour by a superior and about whether leaking to media breaches oath and confidentiality duties, plus questions on reporting procedures, whistleblower transfers, and the number of problem teams. Minister Grapperhaus answered that internal reporting, external channels and the AGFA advisory commission exist, that media disclosure of confidential information may breach the oath, gave limited figures, declined to comment on the individual case as an employer-employee matter, and said the question on the debate timetable could not be met.
However, I cannot make statements about this case because it concerns a matter between employer and employee.
Ik kan over deze casus echter geen uitspraken doen omdat het hier een aangelegenheid tussen werkgever en werknemer betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mogelijk onterecht in rekening gebrachte kosten door de deurwaarder

Two SP MPs asked whether bailiffs may charge debtors €84.64-€85.36 for bank-account information requests under art. 475aa Rv even without subsequently seizing funds, and whether this is justified. The Minister defended the separate tariff as comparable to EAPO work, rejected evidence of abuse, promised to raise transparency and tariff concerns with the bailiffs' association, but refused to drop the tariff.
I will continue to raise the practical operation of this bank-inquiry arrangement in my regular discussions with the KBvG.
Ik zal in mijn reguliere gesprekken met de KBvG aandacht blijven vragen voor de praktijkwerking van onderhavige regeling omtrent bankbevragingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Palland en van Nispen over het RTL4 nieuwsitem inzake de intimidatie van de advocaten van de nabestaanden van de MH17-zaak

MPs Palland and Van Nispen asked whether lawyers for MH17 victims' relatives were intimidated, likely by Russia, and what the government would do about it. Minister Grapperhaus declined to confirm individual cases or attribution for security reasons, citing close cooperation with intelligence services and general awareness measures, and offered a confidential technical briefing to the House.
For security reasons, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het strafmaximum voor het onttrekken van een lijk aan nasporing

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the two-year maximum penalty for unlawfully removing a corpse from investigation (art. 151 Sr), which a court called too low, will be raised, and whether the Criminal Code gives enough room for intent and manner. The minister replied that WODC research on broader criminalisation of corpse desecration, including art. 151, is underway and he will report to the House after its results, without committing to a change.
I am awaiting the results of this research and will respond in due course, and will inform your House of that.
Ik wacht de resultaten van dit onderzoek af en zal te zijner tijd met een reactie daarop komen, waarover ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat door de huidige vorm van geboorteaangifte bij de burgerlijke stand de risico’s op fraude of illegale adoptie groot zijn

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the current birth registration procedure allows fraud and illegal adoption, whether the government has data on the scale of the problem, and whether it will consult FIOM, Defence for Children and the Dutch association for civil registry officers. Minister Dekker replies that safeguards in Dutch birth registration are sufficient, that cases of fraud in the Netherlands are very rare and no current indications exist, that false foreign birth certificates are a residual risk beyond Dutch control, and that the government will keep watching signals and is willing to discuss with the organisations concerned.
Regarding possible signals of recent cases of illegal taking-in of children, I am willing to discuss with the organisations involved.
Over mogelijke signalen van recente gevallen van illegale opneming ga ik graag in overleg met de betrokken organisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen  over het bericht over veroordeelde criminelen die vrij rondlopen in Turkije

An SP MP asked why a man convicted in absentia for strangling his niece in 2004 has evaded justice for 17 years in Turkey, and what is being done about impunity for offenders abroad. The minister agreed the situation is unacceptable, explained that Turkey does not extradite nationals but may take over enforcement of sentences under the Wots framework, reported 16 open cases and reminders sent, and said the case remains a topic with Turkish authorities while declining to give case-specific details.
On individual criminal cases, contact about them with a foreign authority, and how a foreign authority acts on them, I make no statements.
Over individuele strafzaken, het contact daarover met een buitenlandse autoriteit en de wijze waarop door een buitenlandse autoriteit wordt gehandeld, doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over slachtoffers van oplichting en het verhaal van de schade na civiele vonnissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about victims of fraud who win civil judgments but cannot recover damages from fraudsters, and whether the state should help collect or advance compensation. The Minister answered that enforcement via bailiffs is adequate, that the state has no role in collecting civil awards, and that the Donner committee's advice is under discussion with chain partners.
At this moment I see no reason for the government to play a role in this.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding voor de overheid om hierin een rol te vervullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de staat van de brandweer

MP Van Nispen (SP) asks the Minister of Justice and Security about fire service coverage: the motion Van Raak on area-based response times, a station closure in Ede, falling volunteer numbers, the Rotterdam care-home fire report, Uitruk op Maat, and vanishing fire vehicles. The minister answers that service quality is the responsibility of the safety regions and their boards, that the regions are responsible for response times and capacity, and that some bylaw changes and a platform are still being developed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tekorten bij de Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the staffing shortages at the Dienst Bewaken en Beveiligen, including how many vacancies exist, why the problem persists despite earlier funding, and what the solution is. The Minister reported 49 open vacancies, outlined the recruitment results and additional investment, and pointed to the Commissie Bos report and planned structural reinforcement of the protection system.
There are currently 49 vacancies for carrying out personal protection tasks (as of September 2021) at the Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatie Beveiliging (DKDB).
Er zijn momenteel 49 vacatures voor de uitvoering van persoonsbeveiligingstaken (peildatum: september 2021) bij de Dienst Koninklijke en Diplomatie Beveiliging (DKDB).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over Chinese drones die gebruikt worden door de politie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether police use Chinese DJI drones, why they were chosen, whether data could reach Chinese servers, and whether a Rijksbreed policy on foreign technology is needed. The minister confirmed police use DJI drones, said procurement law gave no basis to exclude them, acknowledged the data-leak reports could not be verified, and declined to commission further investigation or a government-wide overview of such technology use.
Such an overview is not available.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het overschrijven van een voertuig op een andere naam na overlijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether a vehicle can be re-registered after the owner's death using only the registration card and code, without checks on how these were obtained, and whether a blockade requiring a certificate of inheritance should be introduced. Minister Visser answered that the RDW does not check how the card and code were obtained, that a certificate of inheritance is required only when the code cannot be shown, and that a blockade would not fully solve the problem and would impose costs and delays on heirs.
I am not in favour of introducing a block on re-registration after death.
Ik ben er geen voorstander van om een blokkade voor overschrijving op te werpen na overlijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Van Nispen en Westerveld over het sterker, gerichter en efficiënter fixen van matchfixing
