Three MPs (Van der Laan, Van Nispen, Westerveld) asked the ministers about matchfixing, including its prevalence, prosecutability under Dutch criminal law, information sharing between betting operators, investigators and sports bodies, and funding for prevention. The minister answered that the government is reviewing the anti-matchfixing structure, that existing offences like fraud and bribery only partly cover matchfixing, and that monitoring and the Kansspelwet evaluation will follow, with no clear commitment to new legislation yet.
The nature and extent of matchfixing in the Netherlands is not known.
De aard en omvang van matchfixing in Nederland is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het grote tekort aan zwemleraren en de risico’s voor de zwemveiligheid

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Health about a severe shortage of swimming instructors and lifeguards threatening swimming safety and pool services, its causes, consequences and remedies. The State Secretary acknowledged the shortage, said pool operation is a municipal task so the national role is facilitating, and listed national plan measures on training, retention and the image of the profession.
Since swimming is a public task assigned to the municipalities, I see the national government's role as mainly facilitating and supporting.
Aangezien zwemmen een publieke taak is die bij de gemeenten belegd is, zie ik voor de rijksoverheid vooral een faciliterende en ondersteunende rol weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het besluit om coronatoegangsbewijzen verplicht te stellen voor ouders die hun kind naar zwemles komen brengen

Two MPs from the SP asked why the government extended the COVID certificate requirement to parents bringing children to swimming lessons, and whether exemptions could be made. The Minister defended the measure as an OMT-advised step to reduce transmission, noted parents can obtain a QR code by vaccination, recovery or testing, and refused to create an exemption.
I choose not to make an exception for this.
Ik kies ervoor om hier geen uitzondering voor te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkdruk van gevangenispersoneel bij de Rijks Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages, workload and safety at the Rijks Justitiële Jeugdinrichtingen, including the Hunnerberg warning and the failure to meet the 77-hour daily programme norm. The minister acknowledged the pressure, listed short- and medium-term measures (Horsterveen opening, temporary agency staff, mbo group leaders, staff survey) and admitted the statutory 77-hour norm is sometimes not met, while declining to provide private-institution staffing data.
Unlike the RJJI, which falls under my management, I have no insight into staff turnover at private institutions.
In tegenstelling tot de RJJI, die onder mijn beheer valt, heb ik geen inzicht in het personeelsverloop van particuliere inrichtingen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Kathmann, Kuik, Van Nispen, Van der Staaij, Pouw-Verweij, Ellemeet, Gündoğan, Omtzigt en Van Esch over de daadwerkelijke inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand en het be

MPs from several parties asked the government about protecting minors and vulnerable groups from online gambling advertising, the 30% youth-audience interpretation in the industry gambling advertising code, enforcement by the Kansspelautoriteit, and the implementation of the Vos motion and amendment on warnings. The minister answered that the ban on targeting youth is absolute, enforcement lies with the Ksa, a time-slot restriction is currently not feasible, and a new warning text is being developed via Trimbos.
The Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) supervises compliance with advertising restriction measures laid down in laws and regulations.
De Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) houdt toezicht op de naleving van reclamebeperkende maatregelen die zijn neergelegd in wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de complexe schadevergoeding van benadeelden in strafzaken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a court ruling showing that Dutch criminal procedure does not allow a split verdict (deciding guilt first, then victim compensation) should be addressed by allowing an interim judgment, citing cases with remorseful offenders and the Donner commission's advice. The minister answered that the law was deliberately designed this way, declined to propose an interim-judgment option now, and pointed instead to a planned separate compensation procedure in the new Code of Criminal Procedure, which is still under Council of State advice.
I do not consider it appropriate at this time to anticipate this with a proposal for a possibility, by means of an interim judgment, to handle the injured party's claim only after a finding of guilt.

Ik vind het nu niet aan de orde om daarop vooruit te lopen met een voorstel voor een mogelijkheid om door middel van een tussenvonnis de vordering van de benadeelde partij pas na een schuldigverklaring te behandelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgwekkende fysieke ontwikkeling van kinderen en de nieuwe generatie sporters

An MP asked the State Secretary about declining motor skills and fitness among children and young athletes, citing a warning from coach Jac Orie, and asked whether government action is sufficient, including why a third weekly PE lesson has not been introduced. The government acknowledges the decline, points to the two-hour weekly PE requirement from 2023, the Nationaal Sportakkoord and the 'Nederland Vitaal en in beweging' advice, and defers further steps to a next cabinet.
It is up to a next cabinet to take further steps on this.
Het is aan een volgend kabinet om hier vervolgstappen in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Ellian en Kathmann over internationale kinderontvoeringen

MPs Van Nispen, Ellian and Kathmann asked how countries that are party to the Hague Child Abduction Convention but fail to comply can be held to account, whether the agreements are adequately enforced, and whether the Dutch Central Authority has sufficient capacity. The Minister answered that return is the starting point but courts decide, that cooperation and the revised Brussels II-bis regulation from August 2022 aim to improve enforcement, and that the Central Authority responds on average within five working days.
It is not for me to pass judgment on the ruling of an independent judicial body (in another country).
Het is niet aan mij een oordeel te vellen over de uitspraak van een onafhankelijke gerechtelijke instantie (in een ander land).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about unclear bank commitments on compensating spoofing fraud, including the undefined term 'gross negligence' and possible differences between banks. The minister replied that banks use voluntary compensation criteria, that individual banks may be more generous, and that he will raise compensation with the banks again while working on an integrated approach to online fraud.
Given the customer confidentiality that applies to individual cases, I am not familiar with the details of individual spoofing cases and how the different banks have handled them.
Gezien de klantvertrouwelijkheid die geldt rondom individuele gevallen, ben ik niet bekend met de details van individuele spoofinggevallen en hoe deze door de verschillende banken zijn afgehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onrechtmatig handelen van de NCTV en de uitspraken van de minister dat dit niet het geval zou zijn

An SP MP asked whether internal legal advice showed that the NCTV acted unlawfully before the minister denied this in parliament, and why information and affected individuals were not handled earlier. The minister acknowledged that legal advice from March 2021 found the legal basis for certain NCTV data processing vulnerable, which led to suspending activities, while defending earlier practice and stating that a bill to strengthen the legal basis is being prioritised.

Through the Tasks and Legal Bases project, however, the NCTV itself came to the view that this general legal basis, given legal developments by current standards, must be classed as legally vulnerable.

Door het project Taken en Grondslagen kwam de NCTV echter zelf tot het inzicht dat die algemene rechtsgrondslag gezien de rechtsontwikkeling naar huidige maatstaven als juridisch kwetsbaar moet worden bestempeld
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rechtsbijstand

An MP from the SP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why funding for the social legal profession (sociaal advocaten) was only raised now, how the reform affects lawyers' income and access to justice, and how a voluntary levy on commercial law firms would work. The Minister replies that the tariffs are being raised structurally from 2022 under scenario 1 of the Van der Meer committee, that the levy is still under discussion, and that the reform aims to reduce demand for legal aid.
I see no reason at this time to expand the scope of subsidised legal aid.
Ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de scope van de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand te verruimen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de situatie van Jezidische slachtoffers

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked the Dutch government about the precarious situation of Yazidi victims of IS, including women with children from IS rapists, and whether the Netherlands should create an asylum programme like Germany, France and Canada. The government acknowledged likely genocide and described support programmes, explained that resettlement is UNHCR-led and that the Netherlands has no humanitarian admission programme, and outlined revised asylum assessment practice for Yazidis; it did not answer the final question on timing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inwerkingtreding van de Wet kansspelen op afstand

An SP MP asked about the readiness of the CRUKS gambling exclusion register, privacy safeguards, the Verslavingspreventiefonds and care access before the 1 October 2021 launch of online gambling. The minister acknowledged that CRUKS failed on 1 October despite stress tests, explained privacy rules and oversight by the Kansspelautoriteit and the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens, described the prevention fund and helpline, and said care capacity was sufficient, while promising monitoring letters.
Unfortunately, the testing could not prevent the system from not working on 1 October.
Het testen heeft helaas niet kunnen voorkomen dat het systeem op 1 oktober jl. niet werkte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bikker over de valse start van het online gokken en de storing in het Centraal register uitsluiting kansspelen

MPs Van Nispen and Bikker asked why the Cruks gambling self-exclusion register malfunctioned at the launch of legal online gambling on 1 October 2021 and why the Kansspelautoriteit allowed licensed operators to accept players before registration worked. The minister acknowledged the start was flawed, explained the technical causes and the decision to allow play from 2 October as the safer alternative to illegal sites, and said Cruks now functions stably and the regulator will evaluate the start-up problems.
The Kansspelautoriteit has informed me that consumer privacy was not at risk at any point in the entire process.
De Kansspelautoriteit heeft mij bericht dat de privacy van consumenten in het gehele proces niet in gevaar is geweest.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid van Nispen over ‘de ernstige financiële tekorten bij de politie’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a projected police budget overrun of 157 million euros, a vacancy and purchasing freeze, and whether cuts threaten police capacity and safety. The minister answered that the overrun has been reduced to about 80 million, a task force report was produced and published, an independent follow-up study was commissioned, and essential services are protected from cuts, but withheld the full timing of decisions pending that study.
The police and I have jointly commissioned an independent follow-up study into as objective a picture as possible, shared by all parties, of the police's current financial position.

De politie en ik hebben bovendien gezamenlijk opdracht gegeven tot een onafhankelijk vervolgonderzoek naar een zo objectief mogelijk en door alle betrokkenen gedeeld beeld van hoe de politie er nu financieel voor staat
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de opstelling van de staat in zaken rondom afstandsmoeders en verjaring bij adoptie

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked why the state is now being sued over non-voluntary domestic adoptions and whether it should waive limitation defences as it did for intercountry adoption. The Minister said the Commission report is still under review with stakeholders, that the state assesses limitation defences case by case, and that the court must now decide.
It is now up to the court to rule on this defence.
Het is nu aan de rechtbank om over dit verweer te oordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de implementatie van het nieuwe gevangenisregime onder de Wet Straffen en Beschermen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the early implementation of the Wet Straffen en Beschermen in prisons, including whether all facilities were ready on 1 July, delays in leave applications, the 6-week leave decision period, BBA and PP occupancy and choice, reduced sport and shopping hours, and whether the regime reduces recidivism. The Minister replied that preparations were thorough, that old leave forms remained usable and new ones are coming, that no fixed 6-week decision term exists, that BBA hours are nationally set and reasonably meet the Pbw, and that the reform is expected to reduce recidivism.
If bottlenecks emerge in that process, they will be assessed on the facts and resolved where necessary.
Als daarbij knelpunten aan het licht komen zullen deze naar bevind van zaken worden beoordeeld en indien nodig worden opgelost.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opmars van ondergronds bankieren

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Finance ministers about the rise of underground hawala banking, its size, police capacity to trace it, and international action. Minister Grapperhaus acknowledged the trend, said exact volumes are unknown, described police capacity and international cooperation efforts, and gave no concrete new commitment.
There are no exact figures on the size of underground banking in the Netherlands.
Er zijn geen exacte cijfers over de omvang van ondergronds bankieren in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het afwijzen van de asielaanvraag van MH17-getuigen

SP MPs asked why the IND rejected asylum applications from two witnesses in the MH17 case and whether they are adequately protected. The Secretary of State declined to discuss individual cases, explained that IND and witness-team assessments follow different frameworks, and said the OM handles relevance of witness testimony and protection.
I do not provide information about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kwaliteit en het opnemen van politieverhoren

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security minister about the quality of police suspect interviews, recording of interviews, withdrawal of the OM instruction on recording, and treatment of people with mild intellectual disabilities. The minister denies the quality problems, says recording is not feasible for all interviews, and defends the withdrawal of the OM directive as not weakening suspects' rights.
The importance of audiovisual recording lies mainly in the right to a fair trial, as laid down in Article 6 ECHR.
Het belang van audiovisuele registratie is met name gelegen in het recht op een eerlijk proces, zoals neergelegd in artikel 6 EVRM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Laan, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan internationale eisen voor antidopingbeleid en de mogelijke sancties voor de Nederlandse Sport

MPs Van der Laan, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands fails to meet WADA's revised anti-doping code, when the government and the anti-doping authority learned of the non-compliance, and what sanctions Dutch sport could face. Minister Blokhuis answered that the independence of the Doping Appeals Committee (BND) is the remaining compliance issue, that legislation is being prepared, and that sanctions would not apply retroactively and could be contested before CAS.
I have answered the questions separately.
Ik heb de vragen afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er geen gerechtstolk Fries meer beschikbaar is om financiële redenen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government was aware that Frisian court interpreters had stopped working over low pay and why it allowed this, and what it would do to restore access to justice in Frisian. Minister Dekker answered that the new tariff and contracting system will let interpreters negotiate rates with intermediaries, that Frisian-speaking judges and prosecutors provide access, and that a website and monitoring will follow, without committing to raise pay now.
I regret that the sworn interpreters and translators registered in the Register of Sworn Interpreters and Translators have decided to stop providing interpreting services for the judicial system.
Ik betreur het dat de in het Register beëdigde tolken en vertalers ingeschreven tolken Fries op dit moment hebben besloten geen tolkdiensten meer te verrichten ten behoeve van de rechtspleging.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van een dodenlijst in de Penitentiaire Inrichting Zaandam

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a list containing names of staff at PI Zaandam found during a cell inspection, including how it arose, who had access, staff risks and aftercare, and whether the suspect was transferred. The minister confirmed the list, said police and prosecutors are investigating, withheld details pending that inquiry, described aftercare meetings with staff, and declined to discuss individual transfers.
As long as the results of that are not yet known, I cannot make further statements about the list or about what may have been done with the list.
Zolang de resultaten daarvan nog niet bekend zijn, kan ik geen verdere mededelingen doen over de lijst of over wat er mogelijk met de lijst kan zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Nispen over rammelende feitenonderzoeken in de jeugdbescherming

MPs Kwint and Van Nispen asked about unreliable fact-finding reports in youth protection, including a reported case of a wrongly placed child and complaints procedures. The Minister of Justice replied that the case did not rest on a wrong file, that a Dutch action plan on fact-finding runs to end 2021, that the existing checks are adequate in his view, and that a future youth protection scenario is under consultation.
Imposing a youth protection measure may under no circumstances be based on faulty fact-finding.
Het opleggen van een jeugdbeschermingsmaatregel mag overigens nooit gebaseerd zijn op foutief feitenonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verantwoordelijkheid voor het reinigen van de woning van een dierbare na een geweldsincident of zelfmoord

MP Van Nispen asks whether next of kin should be responsible for and bear the cost of cleaning a home after a violent incident or suicide, and whether a national policy or fund is needed. The ministers agree the situation is distressing and not reasonably expected of relatives, estimate about fifty cases a year, and commit to talks with Slachtofferhulp Nederland, police, the prosecution service and the Schadefonds to map practice before deciding on any extra measure.
Cleaning the home after such an incident can in principle not reasonably be expected of next of kin.
Het reinigen van de woning na een dergelijk incident kan in beginsel redelijkerwijs niet van nabestaanden verwacht worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toezicht op en van advocatenkantoor Houthoff op haar cliënten

The MP asked the ministers whether a major Dutch law firm, Houthoff, was adequately supervised for client due diligence and anti-money-laundering compliance after press reports of weak checks and profit over compliance. The government answered that the firm was inspected in 2019 with no irregularities found beyond administrative recommendations, that supervision lies with the local bar dean and the BFT, and that it is not for the minister to order further investigation.
Houthoff was inspected by the supervisor in 2019 as part of a thematic investigation into law firms' compliance with the Wwft.
Houthoff is in het kader van een thematisch onderzoek naar de naleving van de Wwft door advocatenkantoren in 2019 doorgelicht door de toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een vrouw wordt bedreigd door undercoveragenten

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that an innocent woman was threatened by undercover police officers, asking about proportionality, legal basis, number of similar cases, and planned rules. The minister declined to comment on the individual case due to ongoing appeal proceedings, explained the legal framework for systematic information gathering, and said he could not provide figures on how often the method was used.
First of all, I want to emphasise that it is not appropriate for me as Minister to give opinions on individual criminal cases, especially when legal proceedings are still ongoing.
Allereerst hecht ik eraan te benadrukken dat het mij als Minister niet past oordelen te geven over individuele strafzaken, in het bijzonder wanneer er nog juridische procedures lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wettelijk tuchtrecht voor verzekeraars

An SP MP asks the government about the disciplinary regime for insurers, including the 2008/2009 limits on consumer complaints, whether consumers can still complain directly, individual liability, sanctions and the independence of the Tuchtraad. The minister answers that consumers were never stripped of the right to complain, that a statutory duty for insurers to submit to discipline is planned, and that DNB will supervise compliance while the sector retains operational control.
I also call on insurers to make the possibility of filing disciplinary complaints sufficiently known in their internal complaints procedure and on their website.
Ik roep verzekeraars ook op om de mogelijkheid tot het indienen van tuchtklachten voldoende kenbaar te maken in hun interne klachtenprocedure en op hun website.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat Amsterdam een tekort aan rechters en officieren van justitie heeft

MP Van Nispen asked the ministers about reports that Amsterdam's courts and prosecution service face shortages of judges, prosecutors and funds, and about budget compensation for case complexity, experiments and digitalisation. The ministers answer that staffing shortages are tied to a tight labour market and turnover, that the problem affects all districts, that funding is set via price and volume agreements with the judiciary and prosecution, and that no new short-term funding is committed while the cabinet is caretaker.
The starting point is that the current caretaker cabinet does not anticipate decision-making on possible investments by a next cabinet.
Uitgangspunt hierbij is dat het huidige demissionaire kabinet niet vooruit loopt op besluitvorming over mogelijke investeringen door een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over de tarieven, de kwaliteit en de aanbestedingen van tolk- en vertaaldiensten door politie en justitie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the emergency list of interpreters used by police and justice, interpreter tariffs, quality, and a gag clause preventing interpreters from discussing rates set by AVB. The minister explained the emergency list is limited to urgent situations under monitoring, denied any fine clause, and committed to reporting on monitoring in mid-2022.
This always happens in consultation and with approval from the client, and is recorded in writing with reasons given.
Dit gebeurt altijd in overleg en na goedkeuring met de opdrachtgever en wordt schriftelijk vastgelegd en met redenen omkleed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een familie die vermalen wordt in de molens van de overheid

Parliamentary questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why a family was harmed by government action over a small cannabis plantation, including Tax Authority estimates, closure of their home under article 13b Opiumwet, and denial of subsidised legal aid. The ministers declined to discuss the specific case, citing tax secrecy and the judge's role, defended the legal framework and noted ongoing evaluations and a planned legal-aid review.
A specific case cannot be discussed.
Er kan niet worden ingegaan op een specifieke casus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er vragen leven rondom de privacy van Burgernet

An MP asked the Minister about privacy concerns over the Burgernet alert system, including unclear responsibility, location tracking, collection of postcode and house number, and whether a risk analysis was done. The minister answered that police own Burgernet, the app does not track citizens, a 2019 privacy scan found privacy safeguarded with most recommendations adopted, and that the child-abduction alert feature is ready pending launch.
As requested, I have attached the report for you, with an accompanying memo, in consultation with the police and the external advisory firm.
Zoals verzocht heb ik het rapport voor u, met een begeleidende memo 4 , bijgevoegd, dit in afstemming met politie en het externe adviesbureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar de beveiligingssituatie van Peter R. de Vries en de advocaten van de kroongetuige

An SP MP asked the Justice minister about the security arrangements for journalist Peter R. de Vries and the lawyers of the crown witness, including whether risks were known, why Joustra was chosen to lead an inquiry, and whether his independence was questioned. The minister answered that the Onderzoeksraad voor de Veiligheid will take on the inquiry, that the independence of the investigation is protected, and that security measures were intensified after the attack.
Given the OVV's earlier-announced task and the importance of careful, adequate and independent investigation, the cabinet does not wish to anticipate any conclusions.
Gezien de eerder gemelde taak van de OVV en het belang van zorgvuldig, adequaat en onafhankelijk onderzoek, wil het kabinet niet op eventuele conclusies vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over de verkeersondersteuning bij wielerwegwedstrijden

Two SP MPs asked the ministers whether police shortages threaten cycling road races, whether volunteer or certified motorcycle traffic marshals could replace police escorts, whether a legal status for the race caravan is being considered, and about the timeline for measures. The ministers answer that police are willing to help find solutions, that a package of no-regret measures is being implemented with evaluation by the end of 2022, and that a study into the tolerated practice of traffic rule violations will be started.
The preparations for the study into the tolerated situation regarding traffic rule violations during cycling races will be started as soon as possible.
De voorbereidingen voor het onderzoek naar de gedoogsituatie omtrent verkeersregels tijdens wielerwedstrijden zetten we zo spoedig mogelijk in gang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de marktwerking in het notariaat

An MP from the SP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about market competition in the notarial profession, including whether the Bureau Financieel Toezicht (BFT) oversight is adequate, staffing, the high-risk notary offices, cooperation with accountants and tax advisers, affordability, the link between market liberalisation and incidents, and whether a new evaluation should be carried out. The Minister replies that the BFT's oversight is adequate and risk-based, that the KNB's peer reviews complement it, that affordability is not in question, and that no new evaluation is needed at present, though a KNB future-oriented exercise is awaited.
The BFT has various enforcement instruments ranging from a norm-transmitting conversation, through a written warning, to filing a complaint with the Chambers for the notariat.

Het BFT beschikt over verschillende handhavingsinstrumenten oplopend van een normoverdragend gesprek, via een schriftelijke waarschuwing tot het indienen van een klacht bij de Kamers voor het notariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het feit dat geadopteerden op dit moment 835 euro moeten betalen voor het wijzigen van hun achternaam naar hun oorspronkelijke achternaam

An SP MP asked why adoptees must pay 835 euro to revert to their original surname, arguing they had no say in the original name change and asking whether fees could be waived or reduced and whether adoptive parents are consulted. The minister confirmed the fee, said government services must be cost-covering and that fees are reviewed periodically, but committed to no change and said adoptive parents are not consulted.
As soon as I see opportunities to do so from the perspective of cost-covering, I will adjust the fees.
Zodra ik daartoe vanuit het perspectief van kostendekkendheid mogelijkheden zie, zal ik de leges aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het handelen van het Openbaar Ministerie en de internationale samenwerking in de zaak Ivana Smit

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the Public Prosecution Service's handling of the death of Ivana Smit in Malaysia, including poor communication with the family, delays in sharing the autopsy report, unreturned phones, and cooperation with Malaysian authorities. The Minister said the investigation is under Malaysian authority, that the family was kept informed and a copy of the autopsy was provided in 2018, and that the phones remain under investigation.
The phones are still under investigation and for that reason cannot yet be returned to the next of kin.
De telefoons zijn nog in onderzoek en kunnen om die reden nog niet worden teruggeven aan de nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het bericht dat een man uit zijn woning werd gezet nadat daar één wietplant was aangetroffen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked whether mayors still use the Damocles-style closure power (art. 13b Opiumwet) as intended, how many evictions result, and what aftercare exists after a man was evicted over one cannabis plant. The Minister confirmed the report, said no overview of evictions exists, pointed to an ongoing evaluation and a Raad van State review, and stated that proportionality, subsidiarity and council accountability plus legal remedies safeguard those affected.
No overview exists of the number of evictions resulting from closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act.
Over het aantal uithuiszettingen naar aanleiding van sluiting van woningen op basis van artikel 13b Opiumwet bestaat geen overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de zeggenschap over veiligheidsregio’s

Two SP MPs asked how much say municipalities still have over safety regions, what happens if municipalities refuse higher contributions or cannot pay, whether funding is adequate, and about conditions and plans for merging safety regions. The minister replied that municipal mayors and councils retain governance and budget influence, that contributions are binding once adopted, that funding comes via the general municipal fund with some tension over priorities, and that no concrete merger request exists while the ministry will weigh boundary criteria and regional support if one arises.
My current policy is not to take any steps to push safety regions towards merging, but to consider any proposals from safety region boards to merge.
Mijn huidige beleid is geen activiteiten te ontplooien om veiligheidsregio’s tot fusie te bewegen, maar eventuele voorstellen van besturen van veiligheidsregio’s om te fuseren in overweging te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake Rechtshulppakketten

An SP member asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the NOvA suspending cooperation on legal aid packages, the adequacy of the proposed hourly rate of about 86 euros for divorce work, and whether scenario 1 of the Van der Meer committee will be implemented by 1 January 2022. The Minister says the NOvA's decision is regrettable, that the experiment's fees are a step up within budget limits, that no new trajectories will stop, and that options for implementing the motion are being examined with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
As soon as the cooperation allows, we will resume the development of legal aid packages, including the divorce experiment.
Zodra de samenwerking dit toestaat zullen we de ontwikkeling van rechtshulppakketten, waaronder het experiment scheiden, hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de fraudezaak bij het kantoor van Pels Rijcken

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the Pels Rijcken fraud case, covering court supervision of mass-claim settlements, notary and BFT oversight, the state's continued use of Pels Rijcken as landsadvocaat, and disclosure of ongoing investigations. The ministers answered that existing safeguards are sound in principle, that several investigations are ongoing so they cannot yet say whether the checks failed, and that Parliament will be informed when results are available, with an external advisory report due in September.
To get a complete picture of what went wrong in this case, we first want to await the outcomes of the various ongoing investigations.
Om een volledig beeld te krijgen van wat is misgegaan in de onderhavige casus, willen wij eerst de uitkomsten van de diverse lopende onderzoeken afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over Rotterdams brandweerpersoneel dat verplicht moet stoppen met werken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether it is wrong that experienced Rotterdam firefighters must stop working after twenty years due to budget cuts, and whether the minister would intervene with the safety region. The minister replied that the arrangement is not budget-driven, that safety regions are the employer responsible for second-career policy, and that he respects that division of responsibility.
I respect the division of responsibilities. The safety regions are the employer of firefighting personnel and therefore responsible for working conditions and second-career policy.
Ik respecteer de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling. De veiligheidsregio’s zijn de werkgever van het brandweerpersoneel en dus verantwoordelijk voor de arbeidsvoorwaarden en het tweede loopbaanbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over onrecht in de jeugdbeschermingsketen en een verborgen gehouden onderzoek van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked about alleged injustice in the youth protection chain and an unpublished ministry review on a father's case. The Minister answers that complaint and appeal routes exist, the action plan on fact-finding continues, and the department did not share the review because the problem was already being addressed and it cannot judge individual cases.

Given the nature of the review and because it showed the problem was already known and being addressed, there was no reason to inform me about the review and therefore also not to share it with your House.

Gezien de aard van de verkenning en doordat uit de verkenning bleek dat de problematiek reeds bekend was en werd opgepakt, is geen aanleiding gezien om mij te informeren over de verkenning en daardoor ook niet om de verkenning met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ingewikkelde coronamaatregelen voor speeltuinen, stads- en kinderboerderijen

An SP MP asked why small neighbourhood playgrounds reopened in March 2021 while city and children's farms stayed closed, and when those farms could reopen. The minister explained the phased reopening approach, noting children's farms mainly outdoors reopened on 19 May as part of step 2 of the plan.
It is always important that children can play and move outdoors.
Het is te alle tijden belangrijk dat kinderen in de buitenlucht kunnen spelen en bewegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over het artikel ‘Hoe een verkrachter opnieuw kon toeslaan alle alarmsignalen ten spijt’

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about a newspaper report on a rapist who reoffended despite warning signs while under reclassering supervision, including whether reports to the reclassering were timely, why he was allowed to live with his mother despite breached conditions, and whether an independent investigation should be ordered. Minister Dekker answered that the reclassering was informed in time, that living with his mother was a justified temporary arrangement, that the reclassering's housing problem is broader and addressed via detention-reintegration plans, and that no independent investigation is warranted since the Inspectie saw no reason to investigate.

Given the information I have about the conduct of the reclassering and the other agencies involved in this case, I see no reason to characterise it as careless and to investigate the matter further (or have it investigated).

Gelet op de mij bekende informatie over het handelen van de reclassering en de andere betrokken instanties in deze casus zie ik geen aanleiding om dit als onzorgvuldig te bestempelen en de zaak nader te (laten) onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, Van Nispen en Kathmann over het terughalen van ontvoerde kinderen

MPs Ellian, Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Minister for Legal Protection about slow cooperation between central authorities in international child abduction cases, including a case of a child taken to Thailand, and what could be done to speed up return. The minister said cooperation is generally adequate, that deadlines vary by country, that the Hague Convention sets a six-week guideline, and that the Thailand case has full attention without discussing the individual case.
Without going into the individual case, I can assure you that the matter of Mr De K. has the full attention of the Central Authority.
Zonder in te gaan op de individuele casus kan ik u verzekeren dat de zaak van de heer De K. de volle aandacht van de Centrale autoriteit heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ellian over de uitvoering van een motie waarin werd gevraagd om de oprichting van een meldpunt voor sektesignalen

MPs Van Nispen and Ellian asked why the government has not yet implemented the adopted motion to create a reporting point for cult victims and their families, and why it is linked to the separate inquiry into organised sadistic abuse of minors. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he is awaiting advice from the Commissie Hendriks on the most suitable position for such a point before acting, and that police and existing bodies can handle reports in the meantime.
I want to carry out the motion you submitted in line with your intention, so that the functions of the reporting point are placed in the most suitable location.
Ik wil gefundeerd de door u ingediende motie conform uw bedoeling uitvoeren, zodat de functies van het meldpunt op de meest geschikte plaats worden ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over nieuwe ontwikkelingen rondom de zaak Julio Poch

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about new developments in the Julio Poch case, including experts doubting Dutch lawfulness in sharing data with Argentina and the Machielse commission's lack of hearing the affected person. The minister largely refused to add to the commission's findings, defended its independence and procedural choices, and said the documents were returned to their originating organisations under agreed conditions.
For me, it is paramount that the report of the Commission Dossier J.A. Poch shows a thorough investigation along various lines.
Voor mij staat voorop dat het rapport van de Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch blijk geeft van een grondig onderzoek langs verschillende sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bikker en Palland over de kleinschalige detentievoorziening De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the small-scale detention unit De Compagnie in Krimpen a/d IJssel, including its outcomes, funding, possible nationwide rollout and reported closure. The minister answered that it is a pilot with promising recidivism and financial indications but no full cost-benefit analysis, that its elements will be built into the BBA concept, and that no irreversible steps will be taken before informing the House after the summer recess.
I will inform your House about this after the summer recess.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover na het zomerreces informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de nieuwe Oekaze Kok en de soepeler omgang met het contact tussen ambtenaren en Kamerleden

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked why the revised guidelines on external contacts of civil servants with MPs still cause uncertainty and fear among officials, and whether the rules are in fact looser than the former Oekaze Kok. The minister answers that the rules are meant to be more permissive, outlines awareness training and a planned debate, and defends the remaining limits on civil servants' contact with Parliament as flowing from ministerial responsibility.
The cabinet wishes to stress that the rules have certainly not become stricter, but that the revision has in fact created more room for contacts between civil servants and MPs.
Het kabinet wil vooropstellen dat de regels zeker niet strenger zijn geworden, maar dat er met de herziening juist méér ruimte is gekomen voor contacten tussen rijksambtenaren en Kamerleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wens om politieagenten een wettelijk vastgelegde veteranenstatus te laten krijgen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked why police officers still lack a statutory veteran status, whether the government recognises the trauma and PTSD care gaps they face, and what happens to legacy PTSD cases under the new scheme. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the veteran criterion does not fit police work, that the PTSD scheme is being reformed with commitments to simplify and speed up handling, and that legacy cases and transitional rules are being arranged with unions.
The scheme is being improved on the basis of the principles: simpler, less pressure on the employee, speed in handling and reintegration at the police.
Het stelsel wordt verbeterd aan de hand van de uitgangspunten: eenvoudiger, minder druk op de medewerker, tempo in de afhandeling en re-integratie bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de minimumtarieven voor tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the new statutory minimum rates for interpreters and translators in criminal cases also bind police and whether police pressure, delisting threats and geographic matching undermine them. The minister confirms the minimum rates apply, says interpreters may negotiate higher rates with intermediaries, and defers monitoring and evaluation of the new system to mid-2022.
It is not possible to have the assessment of the new system's functioning take place earlier than mid-2022 as currently committed.
Het is niet mogelijk de beoordeling van de werking van de nieuwe systematiek eerder plaats te laten vinden dan medio 2022 zoals nu is toegezegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kritiek op de inloopkamers in de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about criticism of the new 'inloopkamers' (walk-in chambers) in the judiciary, including concerns over tunnel vision, digital-only hearings, delegation of judgment drafting to juridical staff, and reduced motivation of verdicts. The Minister defended the chambers as part of the 'Tijdige rechtspraak' programme to cut backlogs, stressing voluntary participation, experienced judges, judge responsibility for verdicts, and no need for further talks with the NVvR.
The establishment of the walk-in chamber is temporary, until 31 December 2023 at the latest.
Het instellen van de inloopkamer is tijdelijk tot uiterlijk 31 december 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vrijheid van advocaatkeuze bij rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An MP asked the minister whether a CJEU ruling extending free choice of lawyer under rechtsbijstand insurance, and the wide variation in insurers' maximum budgets, requires government action. The government says existing law already reflects the ruling, the AFM supervises compliance, insurers must decide how to implement it, and it will consider further research and possibly a WODC study before deciding whether minimum tariffs or other measures are needed.

After consulting the Verbond van Verzekeraars and the Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten, we will assess whether additional research is needed and, if so, ask the WODC to consider whether it fits next year's research agenda.

Wij zullen na overleg met het Verbond van Verzekeraars en de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten beoordelen of er aanvullend onderzoek nodig is en zo nodig het WODC vragen om te bezien of dit past binnen de onderzoeksagenda van volgend jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de beschikbaarheid en de betaalbaarheid van het aanbod van sport op televisie

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether paywalls making popular sport available only on subscription harm access and what could be done, including a review of the events list. The minister says the market should set broadcasting, notes the events list guarantees free-to-air access for major events, and promises an evaluation in 2023 but no immediate new research.
It is up to the public and commercial broadcasters to determine the content of their programming.
Het is aan de publieke en commerciële omroepen om de inhoud van hun programmering te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Hijink en Leijten over het afschuiven van uitbetalingen bij letselschade door verzekeraars aan gemeenten

MPs Van Nispen, Hijink and Leijten (SP) asked about insurers redirecting injury-claim victims to municipalities for costs insurers should bear, and about slow payouts and municipal recovery of costs. The minister answered that insurers may not require victims to first go to the municipality, that victims may choose, that no fixed settlement term exists, and that municipalities are responsible for recovering costs, with no direct national role beyond pointing to a convenant option.
An insurer of the liable party may not require a victim to first approach the municipality to claim support under the Social Support Act 2015.

Een verzekeraar van de aansprakelijke partij mag niet van een slachtoffer verlangen dat hij zich eerst tot de gemeente wendt voor een beroep op ondersteuning via de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sneller over het overgangsrecht bij de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Van Nispen and Sneller asked the Minister for Legal Protection about transitional law for the new Wet Straffen en Beschermen, including suspended inmate transfers to restricted facilities, reduced leave under the new regime, and whether prisoners who self-reported during Covid face stricter rules. The Minister defends immediate application and the 1 July 2021 start date, says DJI will clarify leave-request handling and communicate the rules, but rejects postponing or phasing in the reform.
I am aware that critical questions have been raised, for example by advocates, regarding the immediate effect and the transitional law adopted under the Wet SenB.

Ik ben bekend met het feit dat er kritische vragen zijn gesteld – door bijvoorbeeld belangenbehartigers zoals advocaten – met betrekking tot de onmiddellijke werking en het in het kader van de Wet SenB getroffen overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van de Landelijke Expertisegroep Bijzondere Zedenzaken (LEBZ) in het publieke debat omtrent hervonden herinneringen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the LEBZ expert group's role in the public debate on recovered memories, including reports that its coordinators tried to influence media coverage and criticism of a clinical guideline. The minister replied that external experts speak in a personal capacity, that the LEBZ assesses cases only after police investigation, that an independent WODC study is being prepared, and that police take victim concerns seriously.
I have registered the subject for research with the WODC.
Ik heb het onderwerp aangemeld voor onderzoek bij WODC.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Werf over politieke inmenging bij de NCTV

Two MPs from SP and D66 asked the Justice Minister whether the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV) has been politically influencing threat assessments and prosecutorial matters, and how independent the NCTV is. The Minister answered that the NCTV is independent in drafting threat analyses, denied any NCTV involvement in OM prosecutions, and said the NCTV's role will be discussed in a forthcoming debate.
At the same time, the NCTV is independent in drafting threat analyses, and therefore free from political or administrative influence.
Tegelijkertijd is de NCTV onafhankelijk bij het opstellen van dreigingsanalyses, dus vrij van politieke of bestuurlijke invloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat criminelen infiltreren in de Rotterdamse haven

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice about reports of criminal infiltration of Rotterdam port companies, drug seizure follow-up capacity (HARC team), replacing staff with cameras, private security versus a security risk area, TFOC cooperation, and why the integrity report on customs was not published. The minister answers that capacity is being reviewed and an integrated plan for gateways is in preparation, cites existing teams and cameras as supplements, and declines to publish the report because the researchers own the copyright and do not want publication.
The researchers are the owners of the report, to which copyright applies.
De onderzoekers zijn de eigenaren van het rapport, waarop het auteursrecht van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma  en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van motie-Sjoerdsma c.s. (Kamerstuk 21 501-02, nr. 2283) over Commissie Dossier J.A. Poch

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the implementation of the motions on the Poch Committee archive, including whether a Cabinet minutes passage and the Omtzigt motion on article 68 of the Constitution bear on parliamentary access to documents. The minister confirmed the awareness of these matters, said the committee archive was transferred to the department on 4 June and is being reviewed under article 68, and that disclosure will happen as quickly as possible.
As I also indicated in my answers to written parliamentary questions, my starting point remains that this disclosure will take place as soon as possible.
Zoals ik ook heb aangegeven in mijn antwoorden op schriftelijke Kamervragen, is mijn uitgangspunt daarbij nog steeds dat deze verstrekking zo spoedig mogelijk zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over uitleveringen en uitzettingen aan Rwanda

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about extraditions and expulsions to Rwanda, citing a critical Nederlands Juristenblad article on the country's human rights and fair-trial situation. The government replied that it sees no reason to change policy, points to ICJ monitoring of the 2016 extraditees' trials and to the lack of found due-process violations, and says it shares some NGO concerns while engaging Rwanda on them.
The cabinet sees no reason in this article to adopt different policy regarding extradition to Rwanda.
Het kabinet ziet in dit artikel geen reden om tot een ander beleid met betrekking tot uitlevering naar Rwanda te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het jaarverslag van de rechtspraak 2020 en het belang van de dialoog tussen wetgever en rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the judiciary's 2020 annual report, covering the lack of room for tailored решения in corona support laws, youth-care problems, open norms in legislation, longer court processing times, and dialogue between legislature and judiciary. The Minister acknowledged limits on tailoring in Tozo/NOW, outlined youth-care reform bills and open-norm delegation reasoning, described backlog-reduction programmes, and committed to arranging a round-table with the state powers on a standing consultation.
Together with my colleague at BZK I am currently preparing a round-table meeting between representatives of the state powers.
Met mijn ambtsgenoot van BZK bereid ik momenteel een rondetafelgesprek tussen vertegenwoordigers van de staatsmachten voor.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat Jehova’s Getuigen proberen gespreksverslagen te bemachtigen die zijn opgemaakt in het onderzoek naar misbruik bij de Jehova’s Getuigen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether the Jehovah's Witnesses' attempts to obtain interview records from a university abuse study endanger victims' anonymity and why the organisation is pursuing them. Minister Dekker answered that participants were promised confidentiality, that a privacy impact assessment was made, that he is disappointed in the organisation's legal action, and that he sees no point in discussing the requests' motives with its leadership.

The people who reported there were informed that their information is treated confidentially and that their personal data will not be shared with the Jehovah's Witnesses community or other third parties.

De personen die zich daar hebben gemeld, zijn geïnformeerd over het feit dat hun informatie vertrouwelijk wordt behandeld en dat hun persoonsgegevens niet met de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen of andere derden worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de strenge criteria voor de herziening van strafzaken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why the Arnhem villa murder convictions, based on coerced confessions now viewed as potentially unsafe, cannot be reopened since the Supreme Court found no novum, and whether the revision criteria should be widened to cover unsafe convictions, ECJ rulings and ECHR breaches. The Minister rejects widening the novum concept, defends the Supreme Court's decision as a matter for the judiciary, and announces a bill to allow revision after an ECHR strike-out following a unilateral state declaration of violation.
I intend shortly to submit to the Advisory Division of the Council of State a legislative amendment ensuring that a final Dutch criminal conviction can also be revised

Ik ben voornemens op korte termijn aan de Afdeling advisering van de Raad van State een wetswijziging voor te leggen die ertoe strekt te verzekeren dat een onherroepelijke Nederlandse rechterlijke veroordeling eveneens kan worden herzien
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opbrengsten en meerwaarde van speeltuinen

An SP MP asked the government to respond to an Ecorys cost-benefit study claiming playground work yields €52 million a year, to address municipal funding shortfalls, and to adopt a national legal framework for playgrounds. The state secretary answered that playgrounds are a local responsibility, that the study's savings are indicative and mostly later and in other domains, and that no new national legislation is needed.
Playgrounds are primarily a matter for the local level.
Speeltuinen zijn primair een aangelegenheid van het lokale niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de openbaarheid van de uurtarieven van de door de overheid ingehuurde advocaten

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the hourly rates paid to lawyers hired for police officers were withheld, and asked for disclosure in line with an adopted motion. The minister refused disclosure of the rates in this case, citing harm to the law firm's competitive position and a Council of State ruling, while disclosing total costs, the number of officers and the period.
Disclosing the hourly rates could unfairly disadvantage the law firm that handled this case.
Met de openbaarmaking van de uurtarieven zou het advocatenkantoor die deze zaak heeft behandeld, onevenredig kunnen worden benadeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van nudismewebsites die een toevluchtsoord voor pedoseksuelen zouden zijn

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether nudism websites with images of naked children serve as havens for paedophiles, whether they are hosted in the Netherlands, how consent is verified, where the line with child pornography lies, and what can be done. The minister said some such sites are hosted in the Netherlands, that images of nudism are not automatically illegal and are assessed case by case under article 240b, and pointed to ongoing internet-cleaning measures, a planned administrative enforcement regime for companies, and a planned low-threshold takedown facility for unlawful content.

For companies that do not cooperate sufficiently with this, I have started a legislative process so that in future an authority can intervene under administrative law with penalty payments and administrative fines.
Voor bedrijven die hier onvoldoende aan meewerken ben ik een wetgevingstraject gestart zodat in toekomst een autoriteit bestuursrechtelijke kan ingrijpen met dwangsommen en bestuurlijke boetes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen en Kathmann over overleveringen aan Polen

MPs Van Nispen and Kathmann asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands still extradites suspects to Poland despite rule-of-law concerns, whether judges can suspend extraditions, and what safeguards and alternatives exist. The minister answered that each extradition request is individually tested by the Amsterdam court under CJEU case law, that suspension requires a systemic breach finding, and that guarantees and return arrangements are possible but limited.
Surrender can only be refused if there are grounds for it in the individual case.
Overlevering kan alleen worden geweigerd als daar in het individuele geval gronden voor bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over negatieve publieke uitlatingen van een hoge ambtenaar van de NCTV over Pieter Omtzigt

Two SP MPs asked why a senior NCTV official's public tweets criticising Pieter Omtzigt were permissible and whether they breach the civil service conduct norm, and whether that official was involved in threat assessments for him. The ministers answered that the freedom of expression of officials is weighed against functioning-based criteria, that two fact-finding inquiries are ongoing so no conclusions can be pre-empted, and that the official had no direct or indirect role in threat analysis for Omtzigt.
While these investigations are ongoing, we can and will not anticipate those conclusions, given the duty of care we must observe as employer.
Lopende deze onderzoeken kunnen en willen wij niet vooruitlopen op die conclusies, mede gelet op de eisen van zorgvuldigheid die als werkgever in acht zijn te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een uitspraak van het Gerechtshof Amsterdam over de onafhankelijkheid van advocaten bij “zelfonderzoeken” en het verschoningsrecht

An SP MP asked the ministers whether a Amsterdam Court of Appeal ruling, allowing a lawyer to invoke legal privilege while conducting an 'independent' internal fraud investigation for a client, undermines the independence of such self-investigations and whether they should be stopped. The minister replied that existing professional rules and disciplinary law sufficiently address the tension, the Bar revised its guidance, and a WODC study on self-investigations will start after summer 2021 and finish in March 2022.
As I have indicated before, the applicable professional and conduct rules and disciplinary law in my view provide sufficient means to address a possible tension between partiality and independence.

Zoals ik eerder heb aangegeven bieden de geldende beroeps- en gedragsregels en het tuchtrecht naar mijn mening voldoende mogelijkheden om een mogelijke spanning tussen partijdigheid en onafhankelijkheid het hoofd te kunnen bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een OM-schikking

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice about a prosecutor's settlement with SHV subsidiaries, including how cooperation discounts are calculated, why fines were so low relative to turnover, and why the investigation took 4.5 years. The minister answers that discounts are case-by-case, the settlement was not turnover-based, self-reporting discounts were denied for facts not self-reported, and resources were adequate, while giving only partial detail on methodology.
In this context, the WODC study on the pros and cons of self-investigation by lawyers is also examining how other countries handle self-reporting by companies in financial-economic crime.

Hierbij merk ik op dat, in het kader van het onderzoek van het WODC naar de voor- en nadelen van zelfonderzoek door advocaten, ook wordt onderzocht hoe in een aantal andere landen wordt omgegaan met zelfmeldingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de problemen met het halen van je recht na een medische misser

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked about long claim-settlement times and high rejection rates for victims of medical errors, and about measures such as GOMA, a no-fault fund and a faster complaints route. The Minister of Medical Care answered that long durations are largely due to complex causation questions, that existing measures and a Chamber for long-running injury cases are being pursued, and that a no-fault fund is not supported because the Belgian experience showed little gain.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er crisis is binnen het undercoverteam van de politie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports of turmoil in the police undercover team, including sick leave levels, whistleblowers transferred after reporting misconduct, and who investigates and whether the work is endangered. The minister answered that an independent commission under Oebele Brouwer will investigate the circumstances of an officer's death and possible links to working conditions, that sick leave figures are 4.6% and 5.9%, and that the police has a whistleblower scheme while individual cases cannot be discussed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de politietop luxe vluchten boekt

Parliamentarian Van Nispen asked whether senior police officials booking business-class flights is inappropriate, how many earn over 150,000 euro, whether independent investigation is warranted, the state of the Dienst Landelijke Informatieorganisatie, and why a Wob request took 1.5 years. The minister answered that business class is allowed with valid reasons, an internal investigation found the travel lawful though efficiency was not sufficiently checked, 34 officers earned over 150,000 euro in 2020, a programmatic approach was set up, and the delay was regretted with the chief informed.
Handling the Wob request in question was very labour-intensive and there was understaffing.
Het afhandelen van het wob-verzoek in kwestie was zeer arbeidsintensief en er was sprake van onderbezetting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inning van verkeersboetes voor buitenlandse kentekens

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether unpaid traffic fines for foreign-registered vehicles can be collected, why collection rates differ by country, and what action has been taken; the Minister says he agrees fines should be paid regardless of origin, reports stable collection rates around 82.5% for non-residents, and states that enforcement is not selective by plate and that the EU CBE directive should be extended to parking offences.
Over recent years the collection rate of traffic fines issued to non-residents shows a constant picture: the weighted collection rate lies around 82.5% in the period 2015–2019.
Over de afgelopen jaren laat het inningspercentage van verkeersboetes gericht aan niet-ingezetenen een constant beeld zien: het gewogen inningspercentage ligt in de periode 2015–2019 rond de 82,5%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker en Van Nispen over de NOS-berichten inzake matchfixing

MPs Bikker and Van Nispen asked the government about rising gambling addiction during the COVID crisis, the expected effects of opening the online gambling market, and matchfixing risks. The Minister answered that addiction trends cannot be verified because the LADIS database is not operational, that the market opening on 1 October 2021 will proceed with stricter prevention rules, and outlined existing matchfixing cooperation and reporting arrangements.
Unfortunately it is not possible to determine whether the number of people with a gambling addiction seeking help has increased.
Het is helaas niet mogelijk om in beeld te brengen of het aantal mensen met een gokverslaving dat zich heeft gemeld bij hulpverlening is toegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over kinderen die geen zwemdiploma halen

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked why about 1% (later 4%) of children lack a swimming diploma, which groups are affected, what barriers exist including for children with disabilities, and what financial and quality measures the minister will take. The minister cited a Mulier Institute study finding about 45,000 children without a diploma, outlined planned research into motives and barriers due in 2021, referenced municipal fee schemes and the National Swimming Safety Plan, but committed to further study rather than concrete new measures.
I previously commissioned a repeat of the 2018 study.
Ik heb in een eerder stadium opdracht gegeven de studie van 2018 te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over het bericht dat de politie jarenlang onterecht informatie met de belastingdienst heeft gedeeld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers why police in Oost-Nederland shared suspects' data with the Tax Authority for years allegedly without proper basis, and what was done about it. The government answers that a legal basis exists under the Bpg and RIEC convention but its practical application needs attention, that police suspended sharing in Oost-Nederland, is developing a uniform working method with the Tax Authority and RIEC's, and that the Data Protection Authority would be consulted later if needed.
In addition, the police will work with the Tax Authority and the RIEC's to develop a uniform working method that guarantees careful information sharing.
Daarnaast gaat de politie samen met de Belastingdienst en de RIEC’s een uniforme werkwijze ontwikkelen waarbij een zorgvuldige informatiedeling gegarandeerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over anonieme bedreiging en intimidatie op huisadressen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether anonymous intimidation at home addresses by groups such as Vizier op Links is punishable and how victims will be protected. The government said 51 reports and ten complaints have been filed, that the Public Prosecution Service is assessing whether criminal offences occurred, and pointed to local security measures and support for politicians.
The Public Prosecution Service is currently investigating whether the actions in question qualify as criminal offences.
Het Openbaar Ministerie onderzoekt momenteel of de betreffende handelingen zich kwalificeren als strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de screening van justitiële zorginstellingen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the procurement of forensic care, including the use of an open house procedure, providers rejected elsewhere still being contracted, and whether market competition is desirable. The minister says DJI contracts 180 providers, admits some providers raise quality concerns requiring intensive contract management, promises a new procurement system and quality framework, and defers the motion reply to a forthcoming letter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht dat online discriminatie geen prioriteit heeft

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether online discrimination deserves tackling, how many reports and prosecutions occurred in 2019–2020, how much police capacity is devoted to it, and whether platforms take enough responsibility. The minister agreed it deserves tackling, said no separate online figures exist, noted no dedicated police FTE, called for stronger platform action and promised a renewed approach to online discrimination before the summer recess.
No figures are available that show the number of criminal convictions for online discrimination or the number of expressions made inaccessible by providers and platforms.

Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar die inzicht geven in het aantal strafrechtelijke veroordelingen van online discriminatie dan wel het aantal uitingen dat door providers en platformen ontoegankelijk is gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een daling van het aantal sociaal advocaten en de kerncijfers van de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand 2020

The MP asks whether 2020 saw the largest ever drop in social lawyers, why the number of legal aid grants and Wsnp admissions fell, and what the Juridisch Loket's 19% drop in contacts means. The minister answers that active social lawyers fell 5.1% in 2020, attributes limited significance to the macro figures, promises a monitoring programme and a fuller progress report in July, and sees no need for acute measures.
Based on the current picture of the figures, I see no need for acute measures at this time.
Op grond van het huidige beeld van de cijfers zie ik thans geen noodzaak voor acute maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het NFI de komende jaren minder onderzoeken kan doen door financiële tekorten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) faces financial shortfalls that will reduce its investigations for police and prosecutors, and whether its budget is being cut and extra funds withheld. The minister confirmed that investigation output will fall by roughly 0.6 to 1.0 million euro in 2021 despite an extra 1 million euro, attributing this to needed investment in IT and lab equipment, and said no further budget is available within the current ministerial budget.
It is correct, however, that in the coming years the NFI will be able to carry out fewer investigations for the police and the Public Prosecution Service.
Het klopt echter dat het NFI de komende jaren minder onderzoeken uit kan voeren voor politie en OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat brandweerpersoneel al jaren waarschuwt voor onveilige situaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that fire service personnel have long warned of unsafe conditions, including whether dive teams are life-saving and whether a minimum number of dive teams per area should be set. The Minister confirmed dive teams can save lives, said the number of dive teams has been roughly constant at about 50, and rejected a national minimum norm, leaving staffing to regional safety boards.
Data on the number of dive teams are not registered by me myself.
Gegevens over het aantal duikteams worden niet door mijzelf geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een malafide hostingbedrijf waartegen niet wordt opgetreden

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a hosting company suspected of cybercrime, malware and child pornography hosting was not prosecuted for years, and what the government's analysis and plans are. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, cited liability limits for hosting providers under Dutch and EU law, pointed to capacity investments and to pending legislation (an online child abuse enforcement authority and the EU Digital Services Act) plus sector initiatives.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals u bekend ga ik niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smeets, Van Nispen en Bikker over de ontstane onduidelijkheid bij de detentiefasering door invoering van de Wet straffen en beschermen

MPs Smeets, Van Nispen and Bikker asked the Minister for Legal Protection about uncertainty over when the Wet straffen en beschermen (Wet SenB) takes effect and how it affects detainees' phasing and casework before that date. The Minister answered that the law partially takes effect on 1 July 2021 and the penitentiary programme rules on 1 December 2021, that DJI will communicate the changes to detainees, and that current rules apply until then.
These entry-into-force dates (1 July and 1 December 2021) will be given effect in an entry-into-force decree to be published by mid-June 2021.
Deze inwerkingtredingsdata (1 juli en 1 december 2021) krijgen hun beslag in een inwerkingtredingsbesluit dat uiterlijk medio juni 2021 zal worden gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het inbouwen van verborgen ruimtes in auto’s voor criminele activiteiten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the legal construction of hidden compartments in cars used by criminals, police calls to criminalise it, and garage obligations, capacity and international cooperation. The minister acknowledged the problem, said a criminalisation proposal is under review without commitment, and noted there is no mandatory reporting duty and no structural police-garage cooperation.
At present it is being examined whether the proposal to criminally prohibit building hidden compartments is the best solution to this problem.
Op dit moment wordt bekeken of het voorstel om het inbouwen van verborgen ruimtes strafrechtelijk te verbieden de beste oplossing is voor deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kathmann en Van Nispen over het stopzetten van AMBER Alert

MPs Kathmann and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the police are ending the AMBER Alert contract for missing-child alerts and moving them into Burgernet, questioning its effectiveness, cost, consultation and the minister's earlier praise. Minister Grapperhaus answered all eleven questions, defending the move as lawful and cost-efficient while stating that missing-child alerts continue and the minister remains convinced of their value.
The police decided not to extend the commercial contract with Netpresenter B.V. for the service for this functionality, currently branded AMBER Alert.
De politie heeft besloten het commerciële contract met het bedrijf Netpresenter B.V. voor de dienstverlening voor deze functionaliteit, die momenteel de merknaam AMBER Alert draagt, niet te verlengen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht lijkschennis

MPs Van der Staaij, Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether necrophilia and desecration of corpses should be made a criminal offence in the Netherlands, given that similar acts are punishable in neighbouring countries. Minister Grapperhaus answered that necrophilia is not directly punishable but can be prosecuted under other provisions, that no societal demand for a separate offence has been found, and that he will ask the WODC to explore the question and report this year.
I will ask the WODC to conduct an exploration of the possibilities for criminalising necrophilia
Ik zal het WODC vragen een verkenning te doen van de mogelijkheden tot strafbaarstelling van necrofilie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over vrijwilligheid bij de brandweer

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the exclusion of the volunteer firefighters' union from a task-differentiation think tank, the claimed impact on all volunteer posts, and EU rules on volunteers, and whether the Chamber will be consulted before irreversible steps. The minister answers that the union joined the think tank in its final stage, that EU working-time and part-time rules apply regardless of the employer, that the veiligheidsregio's decide the organisation within existing law, and that details of the next phase will be reported to the Chamber later.
I will inform the Chamber about this at a later moment.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover op een later moment informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over spanningen en mogelijke integriteitskwesties in de vakbond van justitieambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reported tensions, integrity allegations and high expense claims within the justice officials' trade union, and how many complaints had been filed. The Minister declined substantive comment, saying the union has its own statutes and that internal investigation is for its members, while explaining that internal reports at his ministry are investigated and that a confidential reporting point exists.
The alleged conduct concerns members and/or board members in their capacity within a trade union, and for that reason I must exercise restraint.
Het gaat om vermeende gedragingen in de hoedanigheid van lid en/of bestuurder van een vakbond en om die reden dien ik hier terughoudendheid te betrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een klokkenluider bij de politie ernstig gepest werd

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a police whistleblower in the Rotterdam appgroup case was transferred because of the pressure, whether whistleblowers deserve protection, and how the force responds to racist remarks and the mild sanction given. The minister answered that the officer moved voluntarily for a career step, that the whistleblower protection ban and complaint procedures exist, and that disciplinary measures were imposed after advice from an independent committee.
I agree that police officers who become aware of conduct or activities within the organisation that may harm or threaten the public interest should be protected when they report this.
