Ik ben het ermee eens dat politiemedewerkers die op de hoogte zijn van gedragingen of activiteiten binnen de organisatie die het algemeen belang kunnen schaden of bedreigen, dienen te worden beschermd als zij dit melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'onduidelijkheid bij gemaakte afspraken door banken inzake het vergoeden van spoofingfraude'

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the current state of compensation for spoofing fraud victims, the banks' agreement on what counts as gross negligence, and whether differing bank assessments are acceptable. The minister answered that banks have compensated about 96% of telephone-number spoofing cases, that a joint framework defining gross negligence is being finalised, and that a further letter will follow in May.
To be able to assess future cases of spoofing properly, it is important that the banks quickly establish the definition of the coulance assessment criteria.
Om ook toekomstige gevallen van spoofing goed te kunnen beoordelen is het belangrijk dat de banken snel de definitie van de toetsingscriteria voor coulance vaststellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over "de crisissteunmaatregelen voor amateursportverenigingen"

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked why amateur sports clubs filing nil payroll returns for June 2020 are excluded from NOW 3.0 wage support while others get a fallback month, and asked for a fix. The minister says the rules are not unjust, points to the TASO scheme as a compensation route, and says the government is examining widening TASO for the first two quarters of 2021 without changing the NOW reference month.
In addition, it is being examined whether the TASO scheme for the first and second quarters of 2021 can be widened to support sports associations as appropriately as possible with wage costs.
Daarnaast wordt onderzocht of de TASO-regeling voor het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2021 kan worden verruimd om sportverenigingen zo passend mogelijk te ondersteunen in de loonkosten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de kritiek op peperdure advocaten van politieagenten en de onderbetaling van sociaal advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asks why the police paid about 1.3 million euros in lawyers' fees to defend officers in one case, whether those rates are justified, and why legal aid lawyers are underpaid. The ministers say the fees cover 26 officers over about three years, reflect market rates, and that the state is a paying client; they also outline a plan to increase legal aid fees and a structural reform programme.

Disclosure of information may be withheld to the extent that the interest does not outweigh the interest in avoiding undue advantage or disadvantage to natural or legal persons involved or third parties.

Openbaarmaking van gegevens mag achterwege blijven voor zover het belang niet opweegt tegen het belang van onevenredige bevoordeling of benadeling van bij de aangelegenheid betrokken natuurlijke personen of rechtspersonen danwel derden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Reddingsbrigade ernstige zorgen heeft over het zomerseizoen

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the minister understands the Reddingsbrigade's concern that COVID-19 measures prevent lifeguards from preparing for the summer season, and whether exemptions will be granted so they can train in pools and open water. The minister answers that the Reddingsbrigade has been informed that lifeguards with a mandate to supervise official swimming locations may train under an exemption from the group-formation ban and the safe-distance rule, and that practical certification may take place in pools.
We have since been in contact with Reddingsbrigade Nederland to explain how they can train within the current applicable measures
Wij hebben inmiddels contact gehad met Reddingsbrigade Nederland om toe te lichten op welke wijze zij binnen de huidige geldende maatregelen kunnen trainen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat sekswerkers tijdens de lockdown met meer geweld te maken krijgen

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked why sex workers, many outside the income-support schemes during the lockdown, face more violence and financial distress and whether a special support measure and police assurances for victims are planned. The minister acknowledged the concern, explained which schemes (Tozo, WW, NOW, bijstand, TONK) may apply depending on employment status, said the police will not fine victims reporting crime, and promised to raise the signals with municipalities.
The cabinet has asked municipalities to apply the TONK generously.
Het kabinet heeft gemeenten verzocht de TONK ruimhartig toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de noodklok luidt om de stijging van het aantal hacks bij datalekken

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the reported rise in hacks, phishing and malware breaches, the government's rising misdirected-data incidents, whether the AP and police have enough capacity to investigate, how many reports led to prosecution, and whether multi-factor authentication should become the norm. The minister acknowledged the trends, said the AP's role is supervision not cybercrime investigation and that capacity is still being assessed, gave police staffing figures, could not link breach reports to prosecutions, and said multi-factor authentication is advised but not mandated.
It is therefore not possible to establish which reports to the AP led to investigation and/or prosecution.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om vast te stellen welke meldingen bij de AP hebben geleid tot opsporing en/of vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over een radiouitzending over het Essexdrama waarbij 39 slachtoffers vielen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked about an Argos radio broadcast on the Essex tragedy, the police surveillance of two Vietnamese minors, the lawyer's exclusion, why no Dutch prosecutions followed, and alleged pressure on the EMM report. The state secretary defended the police and prosecution handling, said no concrete suspicion arose, gave limited figures on missing Vietnamese minors, and declined to order a new investigation.
It is generally not customary to inform a lawyer about the progress of a police investigation.
Het is in het algemeen niet gebruikelijk om een advocaat te informeren over de voortgang van een politioneel onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat strafrechtdeskundigen het rapport van de commissie Machielse kraken

MPs Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Justice Minister why legal experts reached different conclusions than the Machielse commission on the Poch case, and whether the commission's underlying documents would be shared. The minister declined to change his view, deferred to the commission's own response, and said the commission's archive will be reviewed for release to parliament once transferred to his department.
Once the archive has been transferred to my department, these documents will be reviewed to assess which documents can be provided to your House under Article 68 of the Constitution.

Zodra het archief is overgedragen aan mijn departement, zullen deze documenten worden doorgenomen om te beoordelen welke documenten op grond van artikel 68 Grondwet aan uw Kamer kunnen worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Westerveld over het ontbreken van zwemlessen voor kinderen

MPs Van Nispen and Westerveld asked the minister why swimming lessons for children remained suspended and how the risks to child water safety, compensation and reopening were being addressed. The minister acknowledged the sector's disappointment, announced that pools reopen for swimming lessons for children up to 12 from 16 March, and said the Nationale Raad Zwemveiligheid is consulted on resumption.
With this adjustment the cabinet wants to prevent a generation of children without a swimming diploma entering the summer.
Met deze aanpassing wil het kabinet voorkomen dat een generatie kinderen zonder zwemdiploma de zomer in gaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over illegale aanbieders van kansspelen op afstand

MPs Van Nispen asked about the start of the Dutch online gambling law, abuse of legal operators' trademarks by illegal advertisers, a Kindred director's comments on using player databases, and Ksa enforcement capacity. The minister answered that the law takes effect 1 April with licences from 1 October, that the Ksa tackles illegal offers via platform agreements and new powers, that operators must wait about two years nine months before licensing and may not use player data for marketing, and that enforcement capacity will be expanded from summer.
From the summer, enforcement capacity will also be expanded so these powers can be used effectively.
Vanaf de zomer zal ook de handhavingscapaciteit worden uitgebreid om deze bevoegdheden effectief te kunnen inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over miljoenenfraude bij de landsadvocaat

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister about large-scale fraud by a former top figure at the state's legal advisory firm, questioning oversight capacity, the four-eyes principle, the state's reliance on the firm, and when the minister was informed. Minister Grapperhaus largely declined to address specifics pending ongoing criminal, supervisory and internal investigations, while defending the arrangement and promising to seek further information from the firm and to inform the House later.
Since various investigations are still ongoing on this matter, I cannot go into more detail on this at the present moment.
Aangezien ter zake nog diverse onderzoeken lopen, kan ik hier op dit moment nog niet inhoudelijk nader op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge en Van Nispen over onderwijs in het gevangeniswezen

MPs Van den Berge and Van Nispen asked whether education in detention has been cut, whether only basic education and arbeid-focused programmes remain, and whether 2 hours weekly of education meets international norms. The Minister replied that education has not been cut since 2015, that 4 hours weekly are available for education, re-integration and meaning-making, that no data is kept on hours per activity, and that Dutch practice complies with the European Prison Rules and Mandela Rules.
No data is kept on how many hours are spent on education within the 4 hours available for education, re-integration and meaning-making.
Er worden geen gegevens bijgehouden over hoeveel uur wordt besteed aan onderwijs, als onderdeel van de beschikbare 4 uur voor ORZ.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een gratis consult bij een OM-strafbeschikking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a free lawyer consultation for people facing OM penalty orders (strafbeschikkingen) in corona cases has not yet been introduced, and why it took months when cases were quickly shifted to penalty orders. The minister replied that the free consult will start on 1 April 2021 for cases with an OM hearing, with the rest following once the CJIB adjusts its systems, and that the delay reflects the time needed to adapt ICT and work processes.
On 1 April the standard consultation will start being offered to suspects who are heard by the OM before the penalty order.
Op 1 april zal worden gestart met het aanbieden van het standaard consult aan de verdachten die voorafgaand aan de strafbeschikking door het OM worden gehoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma and Van Nispen asked whether the government would make a humanitarian request for transfer of Mr Singh's sentence to the Netherlands, given his health and the failure of earlier clemency requests, and why it rejects the WOTS transfer procedure and continuing enforcement. The minister replied that transfer is not a humanitarian instrument, that the government is diplomatically supporting a clemency request instead, and that it sees no room for a WOTS request because of the lack of remaining sentence and binding to the Netherlands.

In my letter to the House of 21 September 2020, responding to the motion by Van Nispen et al., I indicated why I see no room for a request to the American authorities to transfer enforcement of his sentence to the Netherlands.

In mijn brief aan uw Kamer d.d. 21 september 2020, in reactie op de motie van het lid Van Nispen c.s., heb ik aangegeven waarom ik geen ruimte zie voor een verzoek aan de Amerikaanse autoriteiten tot overdracht van de tenuitvoerlegging van zijn straf aan Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de dwang op commerciële advocatuur om gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand te gaan verlenen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection why commercial lawyers should be compelled to provide subsidised legal aid, questioning the plan's planning, its effect on legal aid quality, and whom it benefits. The Minister says he will seek a less voluntary contribution from commercial firms, citing existing initiatives and possible forms such as shared infrastructure, expertise, internships or a fund, and rejects withdrawing the plan.
With a less voluntary approach I want to ensure that commercial lawyers contribute more than they do now to legal aid for less well-off and often vulnerable legal seekers.

Met een minder vrijblijvende aanpak wil ik bewerkstelligen dat commerciële advocaten meer dan nu het geval is hun steentje gaan bijdragen ten behoeve van de rechtshulp aan minder draagkrachtige en vaak ook kwetsbare rechtzoekenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van vermenging van accountancy en advocatuur

MP Van Nispen asked the Finance and Justice ministers whether accountancy firms offering legal services and combining audit with advisory work is desirable, and whether the law permits it. The ministers answered that the two professions serve different interests, that the audit-advisory separation rules and professional codes constrain such combinations, and that they will monitor developments and examine the Cta and Kwartiermakers' structural alternatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Kuiken, Markuszower en Voordewind over de poging van het Koninklijk Huis om een strafzaak te beïnvloeden

MPs from six parties asked the Prime Minister and Justice Minister about alleged attempts by circles around the Royal House to influence the Poch criminal case, leaks from the investigation, and withheld Argentine legal-aid documents. The minister answered that the Commission Poch found no confirmation of the alleged influence, that a leak prosecution is likely time-barred, and that the archive documents will be assessed for release under Article 68 of the Constitution after the Commission is dissolved.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de coronabesmettingen in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the rise in COVID-19 infections in Dutch prisons, including the outbreak at PI Ter Apel, and about measures on staff working from home, masks, shared cells, testing, Skype access and vaccination priority. The minister answered that DJI follows RIVM guidelines plus extra measures, admitted that Ter Apel did not fully keep to the internal group-size rule, and committed to sending the OMT advice to parliament.
From the start, the priority of PI Ter Apel has been to keep the virus outside the walls.
Vanaf het begin is het de prioriteit van de PI Ter Apel geweest om het virus buiten de muren te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over uitlevering van oorlogsmisdadiger en wapenhandelaar Kouwenhoven aan Nederland

SP MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about the extradition of convicted war criminal and arms dealer Kouwenhoven from South Africa, including a December 2020 High Court ruling and whether his assets are being pursued. The Minister said the matter is before South African courts, that Dutch authorities remain in close contact with South Africa and that Nederland continues to seek extradition, and that no asset confiscation order exists in the Dutch case so no asset investigation arises.
It is not for me to further interpret rulings of foreign judges, nor how the extradition procedure relates to any other procedures concerning Mr. Kouwenhoven.

Het is niet aan mij om verdere duiding te geven aan uitspraken van buitenlandse rechters, noch hoe de uitleveringsprocedure zich verhoudt tot eventuele andere procedures in relatie tot dhr. Kouwenhoven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het belang van het openhouden van speeltuinen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister why regional safety authorities closed managed playgrounds during the COVID-19 lockdown, given children's need for outdoor play, and whether an exception should be made. The State Secretary answered that closing public places including managed playgrounds is necessary to limit virus spread for now, that outdoor play is important, and that the measures are temporary and will be reviewed.
That is why the cabinet had to take further measures to close public places, including managed playgrounds, until at least 9 February 2021.
Daarom heeft het kabinet verdergaande maatregelen moeten treffen om tot in elk geval 9 februari 2021 publieke plaatsen te sluiten, met inbegrip van beheerde speeltuinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de dwangsom van de ACM aan commerciële bemiddelingswebsites

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the minister why the government did not act earlier against commercial websites charging extra for VOG certificates, and whether rules should be tightened or other ministries asked to act. The minister answered that Justis and the ACM have taken action, that intermediaries cannot be obliged to inform consumers of the free route, and that the ACM enforces unfair trading practices.
I will continue to follow developments surrounding the intermediary websites for VOG applications.
Ik blijf de ontwikkelingen rondom de bemiddelingswebsites voor VOG aanvragen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over misstanden bij adoptie en verjaringsproblematiek

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Zembla revelations of irregularities in intercountry adoptions, whether ministries knew, how the adoption-limitation motion will be implemented, how many cases are pending against the state, and whether the state will stop invoking limitation. The minister replied that a commission (COIA) is investigating, its report is expected in February 2021, and a full reaction including the motion will follow; three civil cases are pending and the limitation question will be addressed later.
I will send you a response after receiving the report.
Ik zal na ontvangst van het rapport een reactie aan u doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de second opinion voor nabestaanden

MP Van Nispen asked about the second opinion pilot for bereaved relatives at the Openbaar Ministerie, whether treatment of relatives has improved, and whether relatives and their experts can get a second inspection of the police file. The minister said the pilot ended in December 2020 and will be reported in the spring 2021 letter, that the OM is open to a second file inspection in principle, but experts' access is decided case by case.
The Public Prosecution Service in principle deals generously with requests for inspection from relatives.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat in beginsel ruimhartig om met verzoeken tot inzage van nabestaanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over stalking

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a stalking case in Vogelenzang, the rising number of stalking cases, reports that victims were discouraged from filing complaints, spy-apps, the SASH risk tool, planned policy changes, police capacity, and whether contact and location bans could be imposed more easily. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of stalking, described measures taken after the inspectorate report (SASH use, revised prosecution guidelines effective 1 March 2021, casus coordinators), and argued that existing tools already allow fast contact and location bans, so no legal change is needed.
As the police themselves also state in this report, the police initially did not act adequately in this case.
Zoals de politie zelf ook aangeeft in dit bericht, heeft de politie in deze zaak in eerste instantie niet adequaat gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de wettelijk verankering van de Code zaakstoedeling

Van Nispen (SP) asked why the case-allocation code (Code zaakstoedeling) for courts was not anchored in statute following the ECtHR Miracle Europe judgment, and whether allocation must be random and transparent. Minister Dekker replied that the judgment does not require statutory codification, that the code's criteria for non-random allocation are objective enough, and that no further legal anchoring is needed.
A further statutory anchoring is not necessary in my view, as I explained in the answer to questions 2 and 3.
Een nadere wettelijke verankering acht ik niet noodzakelijk, zoals ik heb toegelicht in het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over de berichtgeving m.b.t. coronabesmettingen binnen het gevangeniswezen: 'Corona in gevangenis: 84 gedetineerden in quarantaine'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about COVID-19 infections in prisons, including 84 detainees quarantined at PI Roermond, prisoners not being allowed to wear masks, a Complaints Commission ruling against the PI Heerhugowaard directorate, and video-call problems. The minister confirmed the infections and said masks are generally not worn by detainees for order and security reasons, while noting that other measures apply and that the matter is under advisory review and pending appeals.
Information on infections among staff cannot be shared with you, as it may not be recorded.
Informatie over besmettingen onder personeel kan ik niet met u delen aangezien dit niet vastgelegd mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen om bedreigde advocaten

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about threats against lawyers, including shootings at offices, and proposals for better protection, address shielding and transport of criminal lawyers, and a 'safe house' retreat. Minister Grapperhaus replied that EUR 55 million is invested structurally in protection systems, that a resilience programme for lawyers and journalists is underway, and that a safe-house concept will be assessed with the professional groups before any state co-funding is considered.
When there are concrete plans, I am willing to look at whether and how the government can support this financially.
Wanneer er concrete plannen liggen, ben ik bereid om te kijken of en op welke wijze de overheid dit (financieel) kan ondersteunen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tegemoetkomingsregeling voor sociale advocatuur

MP Van Nispen asks why a COVID-19 compensation scheme for social lawyers is expected to be barely used and whether its budget, drawn from legal aid underspending, will benefit social lawyers; he also asks about repayment terms for advance payments and monitoring of lawyers' income. The Minister answers that the scheme was a safety net, the April 2020 drop in legal aid grants has largely recovered, unused funds go to the legal aid system, and the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand can extend repayment terms case by case.
The Raad voor Rechtsbijstand will therefore decide in individual cases on spreading the repayment of the advance over a longer period if the lawyer or mediator invokes this.

De Raad voor Rechtsbijstand zal daarom in individuele gevallen op grond van eerder genoemd artikel een beslissing nemen omtrent de verrekening van het voorschot over een langere periode indien daar door de advocaat of mediator een beroep op wordt gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verrekenen van proceskosten met schulden van schuldenaars ten koste van rechtsbijstandsverleners

MP Van Nispen asked whether courts' rulings and municipal practice allow winning parties' costs awards to be set off against their debts, harming legal aid lawyers and access to justice. The Minister answered that such set-off is a widespread legal tool aimed at reducing citizens' debts, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand applies a hardship clause protecting lawyers' fees, and that the amount involved cannot be determined.
It is therefore not possible to determine how much money that would involve.
Het is dus niet te achterhalen om hoeveel geld dat zou gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over schadevergoedingen door banken bij spoofing

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked ministers about bank compensation for spoofing victims, whether banks should be obliged to compensate as with phishing, and how police can trace stolen funds. The minister replied that banks are legally bound to compensate only bancaire fraude, that spoofing falls outside this, and that he is negotiating with banks and exploring legal changes with reports due in early 2021.
I will inform the House in the first quarter of 2021 on progress on both points.
Ik informeer uw Kamer in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 over de voortgang op beide punten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een forensische zorginstelling moet stoppen met Tbs-behandelingen, omdat zij de financiën niet meer rond krijgt

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he would act after reports that a forensic care clinic must stop TBS treatment due to financial problems, and whether tariffs should differentiate by actual costs such as housing, and how to curb self-employment in forensic care. The minister said he does not recognise the claim that TBS treatment is generally loss-making, that NZa tariffs (with up to 10% above the maximum) remain leading, and that the Taskforce Forensische Zorg is addressing labour market issues.
I do not recognise this picture. I have no signals that the treatment of these patients is in many cases loss-making.
Ik herken dit beeld niet. Ik heb namelijk geen signalen dat de behandeling van deze patiënten in veel gevallen verlieslatend zou zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het uitblijven van een vervolgingsbeslissing in de strafzaak tegen de NAM

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked why the public prosecutor has still not decided on prosecuting the NAM five years after the Groninger Bodem Beweging filed its complaint, despite the investigation being completed in September 2019, and whether the delay amounts to a de facto refusal to prosecute. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the investigation and assessment were complex, that the NAM's response period and COVID-19 caused further delay, and that the prosecution service will publish its outcome and position soon, while declining to comment on the Court of Appeal's findings or on the merits of pending decisions.

Moreover, the prosecution service has informed me that it will soon make the outcome of the investigation public, and at that point the position the prosecution service takes in this case will also be made public.

Overigens heeft het OM mij bericht dat zij binnen afzienbare tijd naar buiten komen met de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en dan zal tevens het standpunt dat het OM in deze zaak inneemt, naar buiten worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Sekte-alarm niet gehoord’

MP Van Nispen asked whether Justice neglected warnings about the Orde der Transformanten, whether cutting the Sektesignaal reporting point hindered action against sects, and what the police and prosecution did with reports of abuse. Minister Grapperhaus said an independent investigation is underway, that Sektesignaal's role has been taken over by RIEC cooperation, that police and prosecution never disclose details of reports, and that every report is handled and existing archives will be checked.
The police and the prosecution never give substantive information about reports or complaints made, out of confidentiality and to protect the privacy of possible perpetrators and victims.
Politie en het OM geven nooit inhoudelijke informatie over meldingen of aangiftes die zijn gedaan vanwege vertrouwelijkheid en om de privacy van mogelijke daders en slachtoffers te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële problemen bij de Geschillencommissie

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the Geschillencommissie's subsidy request of 7 July 2020 had not been answered, whether its closure would harm consumers and courts, and how its survival would be secured. The Minister said he would decide shortly after hearing the SGC, reaffirmed that the SGC's survival must not be endangered, and that he remains in contact with it.
A decision on the SGC's subsidy request will be taken in the short term.
Op korte termijn zal een besluit op het subsidieverzoek van de SGC worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over waarom de zorgbonus niet wordt uitgekeerd aan zorgverleners die werkzaam zijn in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Ministers for Medical Care and Legal Protection why prison and forensic (TBS) healthcare staff are excluded from the COVID-19 care bonus, whether 1.5 metre distancing can be guaranteed there, and whether the exclusion should be lifted. The government answered that DJI follows RIVM guidance with extra measures where distancing is impossible, and that the bonus scheme does not cover DJI, which instead must apply the CAO Rijk extra-reward framework at managers' discretion.
DJI falls outside the scope of the bonus scheme, so no subsidy application for a bonus can be submitted for DJI staff.
DJI valt niet onder de werkingssfeer van de bonusregeling, zodat voor personeel werkzaam bij DJI geen subsidieaanvraag voor een bonus kan worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de documentaire ‘De laatste sociaal advocaten’

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection, after a documentary on the last social lawyers, about low legal-aid fees, shrinking lawyer numbers, risks to access to justice, and why the Van der Meer report's fee problem was not fixed. The minister answers that the legal-aid system is being renewed within existing budget limits, a temporary fee supplement applies in 2020–2021, and the new system should be fully in force by 2025.
With the combined measures of the system renewal we are aiming for better remuneration for lawyers and mediators working in the system.
Met de gecombineerde maatregelen van de stelselvernieuwing zetten we in op een betere vergoeding voor advocaten en mediators die in het stelsel werkzaam zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het sluiten van zwembaden en het stoppen van zwemlessen voor kinderen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care about the sudden closure of swimming pools and cessation of children's swimming lessons, the miscommunication about it, and the lack of impact assessment. The minister admitted a website error, said the child-specific effects were not assessed since the measures were temporary and part of a package, and announced reopening for groups of up to 30 from 19 November.
The specific consequences of closing swimming pools have not been mapped out.
De specifieke gevolgen van de sluiting van zwembaden zijn niet in kaart gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Doneeractie voor Mani die leven redt, maar zelf opdraait voor de kosten’

MPs Yeşilgöz-Zegerius and Van Nispen asked why a citizen who rescued someone in a cardiac arrest was left with a large bill for damages, and what the government would do about burgerhulpverleners' losses and insurers. The minister answered with statistics on civilian rescuers, said police and ambulance arrival times are not tracked for this specific situation, and noted that Utrecht municipality is working to compensate the rescuer, while stating that Slachtofferhulp is not the right route.
On the mayor's instruction, a solution is being examined in consultation with Mr Chawoshey to compensate him for the costs incurred.
In opdracht van de burgemeester wordt er in overleg met de heer Chawoshey gekeken naar een oplossing om hem te compenseren in de gemaakte kosten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en het lid Van den Berge over het gebrek aan hulp bij zoektochten van geadopteerden naar hun verleden

MPs Van Nispen and Van den Berge asked why the new subsidy for adoptees searching for their origins funds a central information point and organisations rather than individual searches, and whether it would be reviewed after the COIA report. Minister Dekker answered that the funding strengthens organisations to serve as many adoptees as possible, that the costs of individual searches are hard to estimate (tens of millions), and that he is willing to keep talking with adoptees.
I am willing to remain in dialogue with adoptees and to listen to their wishes.
Ik ben bereid met geadopteerden in gesprek te blijven en te luisteren naar hun wensen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van Nispen over onderzoeken die uitwijzen dat koppen in de sport leidt tot hersenschade

MPs Westerveld and Van Nispen asked the health minister about reports that major sports bodies obstruct research into head-injury damage from heading and fund congresses on the topic. The minister answered that research must be independent, that sports bodies' funding is acceptable if independence is guaranteed, that she is in talks with the KNVB on heading measures, and that the KNVB-AMC/VU heading study results are expected in spring 2021 but delayed.
I believe that scientific research must always be conducted independently.
Ik vind dat wetenschappelijk onderzoek altijd onafhankelijk moet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Laçin over onvoldoende mogelijkheden voor de politie om verkeershufters aan te pakken

MPs Van Nispen and Laçin asked how police could better catch extreme-speed drivers who post their offences online, including more trajectory controls, a speed limiter, platform takedowns and wider investigative powers. The minister said enforcement has been stepped up and trajectory controls are being installed on N-roads, but admitted investigation from video alone is hard and said that making Article 5a Wvw a provisional-detention offence is being prepared in a draft omnibus bill.
I expect the bill can be submitted to the Council of State for advice early next year.
Ik verwacht dat het wetsvoorstel naar verwachting begin volgend jaar ter advisering aan de Raad van State kan worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wel of niet stilleggen van de eredivisie voor vrouwen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why the women's Eredivisie was initially halted by the new corona measures, whether this was considered, and what the government will do about inequality in women's football. The minister said it was not initially clear, the women's league was placed on equal footing with the men's once the KNVB guaranteed equal safety measures, and promised to press the KNVB for structural change toward equal status and pay.
It was not clear in advance that the women's Eredivisie would also be halted.
Het was niet op voorhand duidelijk dat ook de Vrouwen Eredivisie zou worden stilgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de beslissing om Holland Casino en de automatenhallen open te houden gedurende de fase van zwaardere coronamaatregelen

Van Nispen (SP) asked why Holland Casino and amusement halls were allowed to stay open during the stricter COVID measures when hospitality had to close, and questioned their duty of care on gambling addiction and distancing. Minister Dekker replied that the OMT did not advise closing these venues, the package applied equally to them, the sector's protocol and regulators' oversight cover the duty of care and distancing, and the government closed such buildings for two weeks in its 3 November measures.
The OMT did not advise closing sectors such as casinos and amusement halls in this case.
Het OMT heeft in dit geval niet geadviseerd sectoren zoals casino’s en speelautomatenhallen te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over het blog van de voorzitter van de Raad van Bestuur van de Kansspelautoriteit Imago en ‘backlash’

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog by the Kansspelautoriteit chair warning of a public 'backlash' after opening the online gambling market, and whether the government would protect vulnerable people and the lottery revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch market is regulated rather than liberalised, that strict advertising and care-duty rules apply, that the regulator will monitor and enforce, that the law will be evaluated after three years, and that the sector will revise its advertising code.
Three years after the law takes effect it will be evaluated, with explicit attention to the effects on consumer protection and addiction problems.
Drie jaar na de inwerkingtreding van de wet zal deze worden geëvalueerd, waarbij nadrukkelijk zal worden gekeken naar de effecten op consumentenbescherming en verslavingsproblematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over geheime belangen die leidden tot niet-ontvankelijk verklaring op verzoek van het OM zelf

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why the prosecution service requested its own inadmissibility in an attempted-homicide case despite an internal advice rejecting that option, and why the victim cannot obtain the case files. The minister answers that the prosecution weighed serious interests and found no other viable option, refuses to disclose those interests or the internal deliberations, and says a procurator-general inquiry is being considered.
The interests to be protected are so weighty that no clarity can be provided about the reasons for the prosecution service requesting its own inadmissibility.
De te beschermen belangen zijn zo zwaarwegend, dat geen duidelijkheid kan worden verschaft over de redenen voor het vorderen van de eigen niet-ontvankelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Europese aanbestedingen van diensten van tolken en vertalers in de strafrechtketen

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the effects of EU-wide tendering of interpreting and translation services in criminal justice, citing problems in other member states such as Denmark and the German approach of in-house provision. The minister answers that the Dutch situation differs, that the new system stimulates many intermediaries and binding tender conditions protect interpreters, and that no EU-level exemption is needed.
I have chosen a solution suited to the Dutch situation.
Ik heb gekozen voor een bij de Nederlandse situatie passende oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtsbijstand aan verdachten bij strafbeschikkingen door het OM tijdens de coronapandemie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether no agreement was reached on legal aid for suspects receiving OM penal orders during the pandemic, and why suspects summoned but not detained lack assistance. The minister replied that talks with the NOvA and chain partners are ongoing, that summoned suspects are informed of their right to subsidised legal aid, and that the quality of OM penal orders has improved according to oversight reports.

I am currently in talks with the legal profession and the relevant chain partners to provide some form of legal assistance in cases that were not submitted to the police judge during the coronavirus crisis but are settled by the OM with a penal order.

Ik ben momenteel in gesprek met de advocatuur en de betrokken ketenpartners om in de zaken die door de coronacrisis niet aan de politierechter zijn voorgelegd, maar door het OM met een OM-strafbeschikking worden afgedaan, in een vorm van rechtsbijstand te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over vervalsingen en het aanvraagproces van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG)

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked about forged Verklaringen Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) and commercial websites charging extra for VOG applications. The minister answered that forgeries are fraud, that Justis reports them, that employers must check authenticity, and that unauthorised use of government logos has been stopped with further steps under study.
Justis has informed municipalities of the existence of commercial parties.
Justis heeft gemeenten op de hoogte gesteld van het bestaan van commerciële partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het interview met de broer van kroongetuige Nabil B.

An MP asks the Justice Minister about an interview with the brother of a crown witness who complains about inadequate protection and not being taken seriously by the prosecution, and about whether the deal was concluded before family protection was arranged. The minister acknowledges family interests could have been weighed more heavily, says protection measures were in place at presentation, and points to limited protection capacity while leaving detailed responses on the family's concerns to the coordinating prosecutor.

The statement referred to in question 5 means that in decision-making on a crown witness deal, the possible position of family members and other involved parties could have been more explicitly weighed in the considerations.

Met de uitspraak waarop wordt gedoeld in vraag 5, is bedoeld dat in de besluitvorming over een deal met een kroongetuige nadrukkelijker de mogelijke positie van familieleden en andere betrokkenen in de afwegingen hadden kunnen worden betrokken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek van de RSJ naar het naleven van de coronamaatregelen in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the RSJ's conclusion that shared cells (MPC) are irresponsible during COVID-19 is correct, and how quarantine and testing of cellmates and new prisoners are handled. The minister rejects the RSJ's conclusion, keeps MPC use in place, and describes new quarantine rules for cellmates of symptomatic prisoners while referring to RIVM testing guidelines.
I do not share the RSJ's conclusion.
Ik deel de conclusie van de RSJ niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat de prestatie-eisen het bestrijden van misdaad dwarsbomen

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether performance-based funding for the Public Prosecution Service, courts and police creates financial pressure to prosecute certain cases and undermines fighting crime. The minister replied that local authorities set priorities, denied that funding forces prosecution choices, described the current funding systems, and said an independent WODC study on financing will be reported in March 2021.
There is no question of performance agreements that force a choice for criminal prosecution of specific cases.
Er is geen sprake van prestatieafspraken die dwingen tot een keuze voor strafrechtelijke afdoening van specifieke zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over de trage afhandeling van letselschadezaken door verzekeraars

MPs asked the minister for Legal Protection whether self-regulation by insurers in personal injury claims has failed and whether the government will tighten rules, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal. The minister acknowledged the problem and attributed delays largely to necessary case complexity, but rejected legislation, sanctions and a disciplinary tribunal, pointing instead to the Letselschade Raad's keurmerk and other industry measures.
Legally anchoring and tightening the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, as well as imposing sanctions for non-compliance with that code, do not fit well with this approach.
Het wettelijk verankeren en aanscherpen van de Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade, alsmede het stellen van sancties op het niet-naleven van die gedragscode, verhouden zich daarmee niet goed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over bedrijven die handelen in kredietgegevens van personen zonder hen daarover te informeren

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether private credit-scoring firms may trade personal creditworthiness data without informing the individuals concerned, and whether the Dutch Data Protection Authority should be urged to investigate. The minister said the GDPR requires transparency toward data subjects, that firms are primarily responsible for compliance, and that the Authority is independent and is already investigating several credit bureaus, so it would not intervene in its priorities.
I wish to emphasise that these companies are primarily responsible for safeguarding personal data.
Ik hecht eraan te benadrukken dat deze bedrijven in de eerste plaats zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor het waarborgen van persoonsgegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het invoeren van een directe WA-verzekering

Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers of Finance and Legal Protection about the insurers' plan for direct motor liability insurance, the ACM's role, and foreign examples. Minister Hoekstra answered that no prior ACM approval is needed, that direct insurance has pros and cons, that Europe requires compulsory liability insurance but permits this arrangement, and that he will leave the initiative to the insurance sector for now.

I see a possible role for myself and my colleague for Legal Protection only if the desirability of direct insurance is firmly established and insurers are unable to offer this product without changes to laws or regulations.

Ik zie pas een mogelijke rol voor mijzelf en mijn ambtsgenoot voor Rechtsbescherming weggelegd als de wenselijkheid van een directe verzekering zonder meer vaststaat en verzekeraars niet in staat zijn dit product aan te bieden zonder aanpassingen in wet- of regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Staaij over de verjaringstermijn bij adoptie en het bewaren van adoptiedossiers

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Staaij asked whether the limitation period in intercountry adoption cases should start only when the adoptee comes of age, and how adoption files will be kept after Stichting Kind en Toekomst stops mediating. The minister defended absolute limitation periods for legal certainty, pointed to the COIA inquiry, said the files stay with the foundation and the Ca takes over if it is dissolved, and said a bill extending the retention period to 100 years will go to consultation by end 2020.
I can imagine that the court's ruling on limitation is disappointing, not only for the person seeking justice but possibly also for other adoptees.
Ik kan mij kan voorstellen dat de betreffende uitspraak van de rechter inzake de verjaring teleurstellend is, niet alleen voor de rechtszoekende, maar mogelijk ook voor andere geadopteerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over non-consensuele naaktbeelden en pornografie, kinder- en wraakporno op pornosites

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about non-consensual intimate images, child and revenge porn on porn sites, the platforms' responsibility, and whether a consent-verification duty should be introduced. The minister answered that victims have removal routes, that platforms have a growing responsibility and legal exposure, but that he opposes a separate statutory consent-verification duty, instead favouring a low-threshold removal procedure and Europe-level agreements.
The cabinet has no insight into the absolute number of victims of online sexual violence.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in het absolute aantal slachtoffers van online seksueel geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over drugspakketjes die vanuit Nederland naar het buitenland worden verzonden

MP Van Nispen asks the Justice Minister about drug parcels sent from the Netherlands abroad: complaints from other countries, slower responses to mutual legal assistance requests, why Dutch customs cannot stop the drugs, whether PostNL and customs have enough capacity to screen parcels, and whether intra-EU parcels are under-checked. The Minister refers to earlier answers, says customs and police check risk-based rather than opening all parcels, and states that customs' control capacity in postal flows will be expanded.
To further shape that approach, the control capacity of Customs in letter and parcel post will be expanded.
Om die aanpak nog beter in te vullen zal de controle-capaciteit van de Douane in de brief- en pakketpost worden uitgebreid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de adoptie van een ernstig ziek meisje uit Malawi

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers why a seriously ill Malawian girl adopted by a Dutch mother could not be insured in the Netherlands, why the passport decision took so long, and whether the adoption could be recognised quickly. The minister answered that insurance is tied to residence in the Netherlands, that the adoption was a local one under Malawian law, that a visa for medical treatment was issued, and that a reconsideration of the objection will take place as soon as possible.
Within the objection procedure, a reconsideration of the rejection will take place as soon as possible.
In het kader van de bezwaarschriftprocedure zal zo spoedig mogelijk een heroverweging van de afwijzing plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet voldoen aan de zorgplicht jegens gedetineerden in verband met bescherming tegen het COVID-19 virus

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Penitentiary Supervisory Commission ruling that the PI Heerhugowaard (Zuyder Bos) failed its duty of care to protect detainees against COVID-19, and whether this applies to all prisons. The minister said the ruling is under appeal, that DJI's measures (visit and leave suspension, quarantine, medical intake) apply in all prisons, and that he is convinced the duty of care is met everywhere.
Against this ruling, the facility director lodged an appeal with the Council for Criminal Justice and Youth Protection on 13 August 2020.
Tegen deze uitspraak heeft de vestigingsdirecteur bij de Raad voor Strafrechtstoepassing en Jeugdbescherming op 13 augustus 2020 beroep ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen en Sjoerdsma inzake het bericht over de zaak van de heer Singh

MPs Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Van Nispen and Sjoerdsma asked the Minister of Legal Protection what steps had been taken after a motion to bring Jaitsen Singh, detained in a US prison for 36 years, to the Netherlands, including whether a transfer request existed, whether the discretionary power should be used to start a transfer procedure, and whether diplomatic pressure for clemency would be pursued. The minister replied that no formal transfer request exists, that the US review is ongoing, that no transfer procedure will be initiated by the Netherlands, and that diplomatic support for a clemency request by Singh himself will be provided if no societal risks are involved.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een resocialisatietraject in de Oostvaarderskliniek

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that the Inspectorate found serious failures in the Oostvaarderskliniek's resocialisation trajectory for a tbs patient, and what the government will do. The Minister says the draft inspection report is still in hearing, the clinic has already taken improvement measures, the definitive reports are expected later this year, and he will respond only after reviewing them.
The report of the Inspectorate Justice and Security is still in the hearing phase.
Het rapport van de Inspectie JenV (hierna: de inspectie) bevindt zich nog in de wederhoorfase.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘dat een problematische gokker veel te lang zijn gang kon gaan in het casino’

An MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about reports that a problem gambler lost a quarter million euros at Holland Casino, including whether the casino tracks and informs customers of their losses, whether it has adequate tools and oversight for addiction prevention, and whether there are daily limits on casino card payments. The Minister answered that Holland Casino does not systematically record wins and losses, that the Gambling Authority supervises its addiction-prevention duty and is finishing a review in 2020, that compulsory referral of a relative or to addiction care is not imposed, and that the Wet Koa will tighten rules.
The Gambling Authority supervises Holland Casino and checks whether it takes sufficient measures and provisions to prevent gambling addiction as far as possible.
De Kansspelautoriteit houdt toezicht op Holland Casino en controleert daarbij of het voldoende maatregelen en voorzieningen treft om kansspelverslaving zoveel mogelijk te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Hengelose onderneemster maakt megawinsten met zorg voor ex-gedetineerden’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a care bureau for ex-prisoners that reportedly made large profits from publicly funded care, and whether oversight of such providers is adequate. The minister said the provider is a small residential facility outside the profit ban, that annual DJI checks found no irregularities so far, that a further DJI investigation is due in October, and that no general changes to oversight or the care model are currently planned beyond improving the procurement system.
Following media reports, DJI is currently conducting further investigation at the care provider.
Naar aanleiding van de berichtgeving in de media vindt op dit moment nader onderzoek door DJI bij de zorgaanbieder plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bedreigen van agenten

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security why a threat of physical violence against a police officer, made in front of his family, could not be prosecuted, and whether all threats of violence against police should be punishable. The minister replied that prosecution is a matter for the Public Prosecution Service, that threats of simple assault fall outside the legal threshold of Article 285 of the Criminal Code, and that the existing toolkit already offers broad scope for criminalisation without committing to a legislative change.
Ultimately, it is up to the Public Prosecution Service to determine whether a set of facts falls within that scope.
Het is uiteindelijk aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen of een feitencomplex daarbinnen valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over mogelijke fouten bij het dodelijk drama met Rik van de Rakt als slachtoffer

SP MPs asked whether information-sharing failures between COA, the municipality and care providers contributed to a fatal incident involving an asylum status holder, and whether the system should be investigated. The State Secretary said the criminal investigation is ongoing, that COA shared what legally could be shared, that medical data sharing is governed by consent rules, and that she is willing to review information sharing with partners and noted recent inspection reviews.
The criminal investigation is still ongoing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Diplomaten uit de bocht'

An SP MP asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers about diplomats involved in traffic offences and other crimes who escape prosecution due to immunity, including whether immunity was lifted, how traffic checks and compensation work, and why countries of origin are not published. The minister replied that traffic violations fell by 51.8%, immunity was lifted only four times with prosecution pursued where possible, and naming countries would not be appropriate at present.
The number of other criminal offences committed by diplomats (i.e. embassy, consulate and international organisation staff with some form of immunity) is low relative to the size of the population.

Het aantal overige strafbare feiten, begaan door diplomaten (i.c. medewerkers van ambassades, consulaten en internationale organisaties die over een vorm van immuniteit beschikken) is laag, afgezet tegen de omvang van de populatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vergoeden van affectieschade voor broers en zussen van het slachtoffer

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why siblings of a victim are not by default entitled to compensation for affection damage under the Dutch law, unlike parents, and whether the law should be changed. The minister answered that the law uses a fixed group of parents, partners and children, that siblings can only claim via the hardship clause on a case-by-case basis, and that no amendment is planned, though the group of claimants will be considered in the forthcoming evaluation.
No, at present I see no reason to amend the law.
Nee, ik zie op dit moment geen aanleiding om de wet te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdrinkingen deze zomer en de financiële problemen bij de Reddingsbrigade

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Medical Care about drownings in summer 2020 and the Reddingsbrigade's financial problems, including volunteers paying fees, the status of a drowning-prevention plan, and a motion on structural funding. The minister expressed sympathy, endorsed shared responsibility for water safety, said talks with the Reddingsbrigade on finances are ongoing, and promised more insight this autumn.
I expect to have more insight this autumn into what is needed to secure the continuity and quality of the Reddingsbrigade's work so that water safety is not compromised.
Ik verwacht dit najaar meer inzicht te hebben wat nodig is om de continuïteit en de kwaliteit van het werk van de Reddingsbrigade te borgen zodat de zwemveiligheid niet in het geding komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep voor meer geld voor het Europees Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Justice Minister whether he pleaded for more money for the European Public Prosecutor's Office (EPPO) at the JBZ Council, and why, given the EPPO is not yet operational. The minister denied it was on the agenda, said he only stated after the meeting that Europol, Eurojust and the EPPO should be adequately equipped, and answered the budget and MFF questions by referring to earlier letters and the European Council conclusions.
No, the EPPO was not on the agenda and was also not discussed at the JBZ Council of 7 July 2020.
Nee, het EOM stond niet geagendeerd en is ook niet besproken op de JBZ-raad van 7 juli 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het kansspelkarakter van loot boxes in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the gambling character of loot boxes in video games, including whether an international approach is pursued, the reach of prevention websites and helplines, the independence of the PEGI rating system, and why FIFA 20 receives a PEGI 3 rating. The minister answered that loot boxes are an international phenomenon but international legal harmonisation is not straightforward, that a WODC study and PEGI consultation are underway, and that the Kansspelautoriteit assesses individual cases, with further steps to be considered depending on outcomes.
I expect to inform your House together with the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about the outcomes of this study in early 2021.
Ik verwacht uw Kamer in begin 2021, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport, over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de uitzending van Argos over ritueel misbruik

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about an Argos broadcast on ritual abuse, including whether the LEBZ receives such reports, why an advisory working group's recommendation was not followed, whether new research is needed, and whether a helpline like Sektesignaal should be restored. The minister answered that ritual abuse cannot be excluded but prior investigations found no supporting evidence, that the LEBZ has handled about 25 such cases with no prosecutions, that the consultation obligation was lifted in 2016, that no new research is planned, and that Sektesignaal's role is now covered by other partners.
Since a new Directive in 2016 this obligation no longer applies, given the very small number of reported cases with aspects of ritual abuse.
Sinds een nieuwe Aanwijzing in 2016 geldt deze verplichting niet meer gezien het zeer geringe aantal aangifte van zaken met aspecten van ritueel misbruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over twijfels bij het gebruik van een bepaald risicotaxatie-instrument bij de reclassering vanwege het gevaar op etnisch profileren

An MP asks whether the risk-assessment algorithm OxRec used by the probation service may lead to ethnic profiling, including whether it uses neighbourhood data and how large its error margins are. The Minister answers that ethnicity is excluded, that the neighbourhood score is based on socioeconomic status validated against recidivism, that the probation worker keeps the final judgement, and that the instrument's accuracy is within the range expected of such tools.
It is designed as a tool so that the probation worker overlooks nothing and critically reviews their own assessment.
Het is ontworpen als hulpmiddel hierbij zodat de reclasseringswerker niets over het hoofd ziet en zijn eigen beoordeling kritisch bekijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een mogelijke aanbesteding van het Centraal Administratie Kantoor

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the CAK's collection tenders overlap with the CJIB, why small bailiff offices are excluded by the lot structure, and whether price is effectively the selection criterion. The minister explains the CAK is transferring most enforcement to the CJIB, the remaining tender is a separate gradual transition, and lots are limited for efficiency and single-contact reasons, with 70% weight on quality.
Within the tender the CAK applies the following price and quality ratio: price 30% and quality 70%.
Het CAK hanteert binnen de aanbesteding de volgende verhouding voor prijs en kwaliteit: prijs = 30% en kwaliteit = 70%.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de schuldsanering en een effectieve schuldenrechter

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister about debt relief, the accessibility of the Wsnp debt-discharge procedure, and a more effective debt judge. The Minister answered that the government is working with the State Secretary on better linking the voluntary and statutory debt tracks, and will inform Parliament in summer 2020 on concrete steps, while rejecting an external supervisory body and a maximum duration for voluntary debt assistance.
I am not in favour of a maximum term, but I am in favour of progress and transparency.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een maximumtermijn, maar wel van voortgang en transparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de versoepeling van de corona-maatregelen in het gevangeniswezen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a Ramadan gathering of 50 detainees per group at PI Krimpen aan den IJssel breached the 30-person RIVM limit, why staff gatherings and the easing of visits and leave were so slow and limited to a few prisons. The minister admitted the 30-person limit was breached and regretted it, explained the visit easing was phased to manage infection risk, and said visits were opened in all suitable prisons from 16 June 2020.
It is correct that in this situation the RIVM guideline prescribing a maximum of 30 people gathering together was breached.
Het is correct dat in deze situatie de RIVM-richtlijn die voorschrijft dat er maximaal 30 mensen bijeen mogen komen is overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de situatie in gevangenissen in coronatijd

An MP from the SP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about conditions in prisons during the COVID-19 period, including reports that detainees were silenced, visits and leave suspended, Skype access, lawyer visits, hygiene and quarantine, a detainee death, and a court ruling on multi-person cells. The Minister answered that DJI information is reliable, that sanctions for speaking to media are case-by-case, that visits and leave were suspended to prevent spread and are gradually being restored, and that quarantine and hygiene measures follow RIVM guidance.
A detainee must ask the director for permission to speak with the media.
Een gedetineerde moet de directeur om toestemming vragen voor een gesprek met de media.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de opstand in jeugdgevangenis Den Hey-Acker

The MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a riot at the Den Hey-Acker youth detention centre, whether staff shortages caused it, and whether incidents are under-reported. The Minister said the incident is being investigated internally with results to the inspectorates in September, denied a one-staff-per-youth rule and staff shortages as cause, stated that only incidents causing serious injury trigger a special incident report, and described aftercare for staff.
The inspectorates asked DJI to carry out an internal investigation into the incident and report back to them.
De inspecties hebben DJI verzocht intern onderzoek naar het incident uit te voeren en hen daarover te rapporteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Sjoerdsma, Sneller, Markuszower, Kuiken, Buitenweg en Wassenberg over nieuwe onthullingen in de zaak van Julio Poch

MPs asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Poch case, including whether the Royal House was informed, why a 2008 travel journal and a 2009 ministerial note were not sent to parliament, and on what legal basis documents are withheld during an ongoing inquiry. The minister answered that the Royal House question is part of the Machielse commission's remit, that the journal was handed to the commission, and that the 2009 note was shared confidentially with parliament, while declining to release further documents during the inquiry to protect its independence.
Given the importance of establishing the truth, however, I am reluctant to provide separate documents during the ongoing inquiry.
Gezien het belang van de waarheidsvinding ben ik echter terughoudend met het verstrekken van separate documenten tijdens het lopende onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de wenselijkheid van zelfonderzoek in fraudezaken

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether the professional rules for lawyers guarantee objectivity when they conduct self-investigations in fraud cases, including the risk of perverse financial incentives and the lack of licensing. Minister Grapperhaus answered that lawyers remain bound by professional conduct rules and disciplinary law, that the OM and FIOD verify such self-investigations, and that no specific new rules are needed.
The OM has indicated it is open in future to self-investigation by professionals, including lawyers or (forensic) accountants, hired by suspect companies themselves.
Het OM heeft te kennen gegeven in de toekomst open te staan voor zelfonderzoek door professionals, waaronder advocaten of (forensisch) accountants
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Kansspelautoriteit machteloos staat tegen gokelementen in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Gambling Authority is powerless against gambling elements such as loot boxes in video games like FIFA, including the status of enforcement against providers and why enforcement takes so long. The minister answered that the Authority cannot comment on individual cases, outlined its sanction options, said enforcement is generally possible quickly though legal challenges can delay it, and maintained that the rules are sufficiently clear.
I note that the Gambling Authority (Ksa) cannot make statements about individual cases, whether ongoing or not.
Ik merk op dat de Kansspelautoriteit (Ksa) over al dan niet lopende, individuele zaken geen uitspraken kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de politieke verantwoordelijkheid in gevoelige zaken en de lopende strafzaak tegen Shell

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister how sensitive criminal cases are flagged to the minister, how the high-transaction procedure works, and what contact the ministry had with Shell over the Nigeria prosecution and a possible settlement. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the prosecution service informs him under the statutory duty of Article 129 RO, that he refrains from substantive comment on ongoing cases out of respect for prosecutorial independence and separation of powers, and that there was no ministry contact with Shell beyond seeking its view under the Wob request.
Part of this restraint is that I do not make substantive statements about an ongoing criminal case.
Onderdeel van de terughoudendheid is dat ik over een lopende strafzaak geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doe.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tolk- en vertaaldiensten die door het Openbaar Ministerie via bemiddelaars worden verdeeld

MP Van Nispen asked why the Public Prosecution Service (OM) has been procuring interpreting and translation services via intermediaries, whether this disadvantages interpreters, and when the government will respond to the Parliamentary Advocate's advice on tendering. Minister Grapperhaus replied that direct contracting of interpreters is no longer lawful after the Aanbestedingswet, that intermediary use is incidental existing practice, that interpreters will get a minimum tariff in future tenders, and that the response to the Parliamentary Advocate was sent on 20 May 2020.
As I explained in that response, it is not an option to continue contracting interpreting and translation services directly through the OM and courts.
Zoals ik in deze reactie heb toegelicht is het geen optie om tolk- en vertaaldiensten door OM en rechtbanken rechtstreeks in te blijven schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over aanbestedingen van tolk- en vertaaldiensten

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Minister of Justice whether preparatory steps for the interpreter and translation procurement programme (Tolken in de Toekomst), such as early registration and online tender notices, were irreversible given his earlier commitment. The Minister answered that these steps are not irreversible, that tendering is required by law, and that he would reply to the parliamentary advocate's advice by letter, which was already sent on 20 May 2020.
Yes, pending the advice of the parliamentary advocate, I have not taken any irreversible steps.
Ja, ik heb in afwachting van het advies van de parlementair advocaat geen onomkeerbare stappen gezet.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Van den Berge over de berichtgeving dat de politie en het OM steken laten vallen bij het afdwingen van het nakomen van door de rechter vastgestelde omgangsregelinge

MPs asked whether police and prosecutors neglect enforcement of court-ordered child contact arrangements, including reluctance to take complaints and the scope of criminal versus civil remedies. The Minister acknowledges the concern, says current reports are insufficient for firm conclusions, and points to an expert team reporting in October, with no concrete enforcement change committed yet.
I am awaiting their report before drawing further conclusions.
Ik wacht hun rapport af alvorens verdere conclusies te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over vrouwenonderdrukking

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about oppression of women in marriages with migrants, including a case where a woman was killed shortly after arriving, and about isolation of partners of knowledge migrants. The government says such practices are unacceptable, points to the action agenda on harmful practices and the Rotterdam pilot, but declines a national study and says it cannot bar sponsors from bringing partners under EU family reunification rules.
Because every case of forced isolation is one too many, it has not been chosen to set up a national study into the extent of forced isolation of marriage migrants.
Omdat elk geval van gedwongen isolement er één te veel is, wordt er niet voor gekozen om een landelijk onderzoek in te stellen naar de omvang van gedwongen isolement van huwelijksmigranten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de juridische basis van de beperkende maatregelen tegen verspreiding van het Coronavirus en de gevolgen van de opgelegde boetes

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about the legal basis of COVID-19 emergency ordinances, whether fines for breaching distancing rules and the resulting criminal record could affect VOG certificates, and related enforcement concerns. The government answered that a temporary statute will replace the ordinances to strengthen democratic legitimacy, that a single COVID fine would generally not block a VOG, and that enforcement follows a set framework with warnings first.
With legislation in the formal sense, democratic legitimacy is strengthened.
Met wetgeving in formele zin wordt de democratische legitimatie versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Bergkamp en Van Nispen over duivelsuitdrijving bij kinderen en andere misstanden binnen religieuze gemeenschappen

MPs asked whether exorcism practices against children in religious communities, including alleged sexual abuse and threats, are harmful and criminal, and how oversight, reporting and independent research could be strengthened. The minister agreed such practices can harm children and may be criminal, pointed to Veilig Thuis and the police for oversight, declined a separate national study, and said he would consider a constitutional-law angle on restricting religious freedom by statute.

Given the extensive research agenda of the WODC and the number of studies still in the queue, I do not consider it desirable to start a separate study into the nature and extent of exorcisms in the Netherlands.

Antwoord 7 Ik acht het – mede gezien de omvangrijke onderzoeksagenda van het WODC en de hoeveelheid onderzoeken die nog in de wachtrij staan – niet wenselijk om een separaat onderzoek naar de aard en omvang van duivelsuitdrijvingen in Nederland op te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Van Nispen over het bericht dat verenigingen voor jeugd- en jongerenwerk in de problemen komen door de coronacrisis

MPs Von Martels, Peters and Van Nispen asked the health minister about youth and scouting associations and playground foundations facing financial trouble due to the COVID-19 crisis, and whether they are excluded from support. The minister replied that some such organisations may qualify for national support schemes, that municipalities are primarily responsible, and that the full effects are not yet known.

The municipality is the first responsible government for these associations, and if the situation for scouting or youth work lasts long, these associations will have to look with the municipality at what options exist to keep these facilities from being endangered.

De gemeente is de eerstverantwoordelijke overheid voor deze verenigingen en mocht de situatie voor de scouting of jeugdwerk langdurig voortduren dan zullen deze verenigingen dan ook met de gemeente moeten kijken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Nispen en Groothuizen over rechtspraak in tijden van coronacrisis

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked how the judiciary during the COVID-19 crisis can resume physical hearings, reduce case backlogs, adjust financing and protect indebted citizens. The ministers answer that hearings resume from 11 May with priority for criminal, youth and family law, that backlogs will be addressed without yet presenting a plan, and that they will examine the proposed changes to police-judge powers and evaluate emergency measures later.
In our letter of 23 April we indicated that courthouses can also be opened outside office hours and hold hearings.
In onze brief van 23 april jl. hebben we aangegeven dat er de mogelijkheid is om gerechtsgebouwen ook buiten kantoortijden te openen en zittingen te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële gevolgen en regelingen voor sportverenigingen

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Health and Social Affairs why sports clubs using central payroll service bureaus cannot apply for the NOW wage subsidy, whether they should be excluded, and whether rules and accountant requirements should be changed for clubs with non-calendar fiscal years. The Minister of Social Affairs replied that the bureau is the formal employer and that changing the system is not feasible given speed and volume, pointing instead to a EUR 120 million sports support package and promising only that accountant-certificate thresholds are being examined.
Currently it is being examined below which threshold an accountant's statement is not required.
Momenteel wordt bezien onder welke grens een accountantsverklaring niet is vereist.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen inzake fundamentele rechten in het strafrecht

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of Legal Protection about fundamental procedural rights in criminal law during COVID-19 measures, including phone-only lawyer consultation, video hearings, detainee access to hearings, public access to trials, and cell placement. The ministers largely answered that rights are safeguarded, that measures are proportionate and temporary, and that they are monitoring and adjusting practice, while committing to some reviews and expansions.
In taking all measures, the principles of the rule of law, democracy and fundamental rights are safeguarded, subject to the restrictions arising from the necessary public health measures.

Bij het treffen van alle maatregelen worden de beginselen van rechtsstaat, democratie en grondrechten geborgd met in achtneming van de beperkingen die voortvloeien uit de noodzakelijke maatregelen ter bescherming van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over de excuses en schadevergoeding voor slachtoffers van Zusters van de Goede Herder

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked whether the proposed EUR 5,000 flat-rate compensation and apology for victims of forced child labour at the Zusters van de Goede Herder is adequate, and why it is aligned with victims of youth-care abuse.
