The minister defends the single amount as recognition of the government's inadequate supervision, says a separate Goede Herder case would be disproportionate to treat differently, and promises a Ministerial Regulation in autumn with the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven administering it.
In my letter of 19 December to the House I indicated that the government has a responsibility to take for having failed to supervise adequately, allowing the unlawful forced labour to continue.
In mijn brief van 19 december aan uw Kamer heb ik aangegeven dat de overheid een verantwoordelijkheid heeft te nemen voor het feit dat zij onvoldoende toezicht heeft gehouden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Helvert, Sjoerdsma, Ploumen, Van Ojik, Krol en Van Raan over de zaak van dhr. Singh

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign and Justice Ministers about the case of Mr Singh (J.S.), a Dutch prisoner in the United States, including whether a transfer request was received, whether Nederland can start a transfer procedure, whether a clemency request was made without his knowledge, and what efforts are made on humanitarian grounds. The government answered that no formal transfer request has been received, that the US was told he does not meet the binding criteria, that it expressed humanitarian support diplomatically, and that the initiative lies primarily with Mr J.S.
As far as the question concerns the specific circumstances of detainee J.S., I must inform you that no statements can be made about this for privacy reasons.
Voor zover de vraag ziet op de specifieke omstandigheden van gedetineerde J.S. moet ik u mededelen dat er in het kader van de privacy hierover geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de stakingsoproep van de Vereniging van Advocatenbelangen

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a strike call by the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen among social lawyers, the lack of a way to record strikers, the reform of legal aid and whether it will cause a shortage of social lawyers. The Minister answers that the July strike was withdrawn, that extra funding and monitoring are in place, that strike absence is not registered for privacy reasons, and that the reform is being developed in a learning manner with measures to attract young lawyers.
Question 4: Will you talk with the Legal Aid Board to set up a system as soon as possible that makes it possible to map how many social lawyers are striking? Answer 4: No.

Vraag 4 Gaat u met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand in gesprek om zo snel mogelijk een systeem op te richten waarbij het wel mogelijk is om in kaart te kunnen brengen hoeveel sociaal advocaten staken? Antwoord 4 Nee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake het bericht ‘ruziënde Russen kosten Nederlandse rechtspraak miljoenen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about an Argos report that Dutch courts are used by shell companies with little link to the Netherlands, costing millions, and about the NCC English-language commercial court. The minister denied any policy of luring shell companies, said no cost or company-type data exists, defended court access and the NCC, and declined to commission new research.
There is no policy or deployment of the judiciary to attract so-called letterbox companies to the Netherlands.
Er is geen sprake van beleid of inzet van de rechterlijke macht om zogeheten brievenbusfirma’s naar Nederland te lokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake omgangsregelingen gedurende de corona-maatregelen

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how court cases and contact arrangements (omgangsregelingen) were handled during the corona measures, including whether delayed family cases and possible abductions were being prioritised. The Minister acknowledged the frustration, explained that urgent child-safety cases are always heard and that contact arrangements should continue unless there are health complaints, and said the expert team on parental alienation will report interim findings before the summer.
Cases in which the safety of the child is at stake, such as possible abductions, have already been classed as urgent and are always handled.
Zaken waarin de veiligheid van het kind in het geding is, zoals bij mogelijke ontvoeringen, zijn al direct als urgente zaken aangemerkt en worden altijd behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over "het doorprocederen door de overheid"

Two SP MPs asked whether Enschede's municipality acted improperly by pursuing a benefit recovery to cover social investigation costs and monitoring bank spending to the euro, and whether this reflects a wider practice of prolonged litigation by government. The state secretary answered that it is a municipal case for the council to supervise, that no signals suggest a systemic practice, and that the government will share an interdepartmental plan to reduce unnecessary procedures with parliament before summer.
This concerns a case within an individual municipality. It is not for me or the Minister for Legal Protection to pass judgment on individual descriptions such as those in the article you cite.

Het betreft hier een casus binnen een individuele gemeente. Het is niet aan mij of de Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om een oordeel te vellen over individuele beschrijvingen zoals in het door u aangehaalde artikel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de dwangsom bij niet tijdig beslissen door de overheid

SP MPs asked whether the government should decide on time, whether the penalty-for-delay (dwangsom) regime still works as intended, why the Tax Administration has a different regime, and how much penalties were paid out in 2015-2019 per organisation. The minister agreed timely decisions matter, reported the regime has a preventive effect with some side effects, explained the Tax Administration's separate rules, and gave incomplete, non-uniform payment figures while noting the IND's sharp rise.
It turned out that these figures are not kept everywhere or in a uniform way.
Gebleken is dat deze cijfers niet overal en niet uniform worden bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vastlopen van de rechtspraak

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers why the courts were stalling, whether the government knew the figures before the debate, what it would do to shorten case durations and how it would better inform victims. The ministers answered that the capacity shortfall was foreseen, that an internal analysis showed a backlog and that a joint OM-judiciary analysis and extra measures were underway, while acknowledging victims suffer from delays and agreeing to explore proactive victim updates.
We consider this a good suggestion and will consult with the OM on how this can be shaped.
Wij vinden dit een goede suggestie en gaan met het OM in overleg hoe dit vormgegeven kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over falende bewindvoerders

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked about rogue court-appointed administrators (bewindvoerders) who allegedly defraud clients, and what the government will do about supervision and complaints. The minister answered that dismissal, liability and court supervision exist, that quality requirements and the Landelijk Kwaliteitsbureau are in place, and that stakeholders will explore mandatory training and the government will look into the motion on improving the system.
I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de coronamaatregelen door een tbs-kliniek niet nageleefd (kunnen) worden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether COVID-19 rules are being followed at the Oostvaarderskliniek forensic psychiatric centre, whether staff and patients are tested and protected, and why handovers were shortened. The minister answered that clinics follow RIVM guidelines, that protective equipment and testing are available under those guidelines, and that a staff member died, with patients and staff isolated when symptoms appear.
Yes, of course the clinics work in accordance with the applicable guidelines and measures.
Ja, vanzelfsprekend werken de klinieken conform de geldende richtlijnen en maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de betrokkenheid van de minister bij een mogelijke megaschikking met Shell voor corruptie in Nigeria

MP Van Nispen asked why the Minister of Justice referred earlier questions about his involvement in a possible Shell settlement over Nigerian corruption to documents published under the Wob, and asked for direct answers. The Minister replied that the documents were already public, that Wob and the information right under Article 68 of the Constitution are a separate matter, and that he was briefed by the Public Prosecution Service on the criminal investigation, but cannot discuss the content of those briefings because the investigation is ongoing.
Because the criminal investigation in this case is ongoing, I cannot make statements about the content of what was discussed.
Omdat het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in deze zaak lopende is, kan ik over de inhoud van het besprokene geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘het ontbreken van een meldpunt voor slachtoffers en familieleden van sektes’

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister why the Sektesignaal reporting point for cult victims was discontinued, and whether it would be restored. The minister denied that victims are poorly served, stated that Sektesignaal was only a referral service, commissioned a WODC study, and refused to restore the reporting point.
Following the Van Nispen motion, I have asked the WODC to conduct a study examining whether ending the subsidy to Sektesignaal has created a gap in the available instruments.
Naar aanleiding van de motie Van Nispen heb ik het WODC verzocht een onderzoek uit te voeren waarbij bezien wordt of het beëindigen van de subsidie aan Sektesignaal heeft geleid tot een lacune
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een-tweetjes tussen ministers en Kamerleden en onenigheid daarover tussen ministers

An SP MP asked whether a TV-and-press plan by a VVD justice spokesperson, offered to the minister of his own party, was an appropriate one-to-one arrangement, and whether the minister represents the government or his party. The minister answered that MPs may appear in the media, that the ministry only gave a general reply to a press inquiry, and that ministers must respect collective government policy and not announce plans outside agreed policy.
Ministers, as members of the government, observe the unity of government policy (Article 45, paragraph 3, of the Constitution).
Ministers nemen als lid van de regering de eenheid van het regeringsbeleid in acht (artikel 45, derde lid, Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de betrouwbaarheid en volledigheid van zelfonderzoek door eigen advocaten van bedrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether company self-investigations by their own lawyers in criminal fraud cases are reliable, whether the OM keeps track of them, and whether this risks truth-finding. The Minister answered that the OM sets no specific framework, that the FIOD checks and the OM verifies such investigations, that the OM plans to use them more often, and that the risks are adequately mitigated.
The number of criminal investigations in which self-investigations were submitted, and in how many cases this led to sentence reduction, is not registered as such by the OM.

Het aantal strafrechtelijke onderzoekszaken waarbij zelfstandige onderzoeken zijn aangedragen en in hoeveel gevallen dit heeft geleid tot strafvermindering, worden niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Van Wijngaarden, Ploumen, Van Ojik, van der Graaf, Van der Staaij, van Nispen over het onderzoek van Levada Centrum onder de Russische bevolking naar de publieke opinie over Ned

MPs asked the government about a Levada Centre survey of Russian public opinion on the Netherlands and MH17, including willingness to pay compensation, access to facts, and whether Russians could follow the trial in Russian. The government said it was aware of the survey, that trial information is available online in English and via the Dutch embassy, and that the judiciary chose to livestream the trial in English; a Russian-language livestream of the first session was made by Current Time and the government is looking into Russian summaries.

Within the limits of the law, the judiciary, partly because of the broad and diverse international involvement, decided to set up a livestream so the MH17 trial can be followed worldwide and in English as well as Dutch.

Binnen de mogelijkheden van de wet heeft de Rechtspraak, mede vanwege de brede en diverse internationale betrokkenheid, besloten om een livestream in te richten waardoor het MH17-proces wereldwijd en naast het Nederlands, ook in het Engels te volgen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het stakingsrecht van tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice whether interpreters and translators' strike action is understandable given reforms and outdated rates, and whether Openbaar Ministerie letters warning strikers of contract breach are intimidating. The Minister acknowledged concerns, defended the reform as necessary, said the letters were factual reminders that accepted assignments must be honoured, and stated refusing assignments has no effect on business relations.
We will closely monitor the operation of the new system and adjust it further if necessary.
De werking van de nieuwe systematiek zullen we nauwlettend gaan monitoren en verder bijstellen als dat nodig zou blijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer, Van der Graaf en Van Nispen over de totstandkoming van de Wet homologatie onderhands akkoord

MPs Nijboer, Van der Graaf and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how the WHOA bill was prepared, including which documents, consultation inputs and outside-party texts can be shared, and whether ministry contacts with third parties over amendments were improper. The minister answered that the bill's history and consultation reactions are largely available, that outside texts were used through a standard process, and that premature communication about draft amendments with the coalition and Finance occurred due to miscommunication.
This happened as a result of a miscommunication.
Dit gebeurde als gevolg van een miscommunicatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de maatregelen die worden getroffen in het gevangeniswezen in verband met het COVID-19 virus

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how COVID-19 measures in prisons are coordinated, how staff protection, testing, work, cell placement and electronic monitoring for ZBBI prisoners are handled. The minister answered that a central DJI crisis team coordinates measures, legal review was done, existing complaint rights remain, staff have protective equipment, and measures reduced multi-person cell use, though some questions were answered only by restating existing protocols.
The system of legal protection has not been changed. Detainees can, if they wish, file a complaint against the measures with the supervisory committee.
Het stelsel van rechtsbescherming is niet aangepast. Gedetineerden kunnen als zij dat wensen tegen de maatregelen in beklag bij de commissie van toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over berichten dat sociaal advocaten stoppen vanwege te lage vergoedingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that social lawyers are quitting over low fees and what the government will do to keep them. The minister acknowledged the departures, pointed to temporary extra funding and reform pilots, and said access to a social lawyer remains guaranteed while declining to predict further departures.
I am closely monitoring whether there is still sufficient supply of lawyers.
Ik laat nauwlettend monitoren of er nog voldoende aanbod is van advocaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink, Beckerman en Van Nispen over huisuitzettingen tijdens de coronacrisis

SP MPs asked why eviction summary proceedings are treated as urgent or postponed during the coronavirus crisis, whether evictions should be halted, and whether a law banning evictions is needed. The minister answers that eviction cases are postponed except in exceptional superspoed cases, that landlord associations agreed to avoid evictions during the crisis, and that the government will use emergency legislation to extend temporary leases.
Eviction cases have not been classified as urgent by the judiciary, so for now no oral hearings take place unless the judge in summary proceedings decides a hearing must go ahead.

Huisuitzettingen zijn door de rechtspraak niet aangemerkt als urgente zaken en voorlopig vinden er daarom geen mondelinge behandelingen plaats, tenzij de rechter in kort geding oordeelt dat een zitting moet doorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens de drukte niet aan kan

MPs Van Nispen and Verhoeven asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) lacks the capacity to handle its workload, including waiting times of at least six months, and about whether it must drop complaints. The minister acknowledges the shortage, notes €3.4 million added structurally in the 2019 spring memorandum and an external budget study, but declines to commit to an immediate budget increase before the study's results.
The aim of the study is to reach a shared picture of a sound financial basis for the AP to carry out all of its statutory tasks, both in the short and long term.
Doel van het onderzoek is te komen tot een gedeeld beeld van een gezonde financiële basis voor de uitoefening door de AP van al haar wettelijke taken, zowel op korte als lange termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen van uw Kamer over medische zorg in penitentiaire inrichtingen, detentiecentra en forensisch psychiatrische centra

An SP MP asked about medical care in prisons, detention centres and forensic psychiatric centres, including staffing shortages, waiting times for psychiatric prison places, use of isolation cells and medication safety. The Minister acknowledges recruitment difficulties and waiting lists of a few days, describes recruitment and capacity measures, and promises to review capacity in 2021 without committing to specific deadlines for resolving the problems.
The number of prisoners waiting for a place in a PPC fluctuates.
Het aantal gedetineerden dat op een plaatsing in een PPC wacht fluctueert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat juridische hulp aan lage inkomens in gevaar is door problemen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of internal conflict and dissatisfaction at the Juridisch Loket threatening legal aid for low-income people, and whether the minister would intervene or order an independent investigation. The minister answered that the matter is an internal one for the Raad van Toezicht, which has already investigated, that service continuity is assured, and that a separate ministerial investigation is not needed.
This is an internal matter. The Supervisory Board is the designated party to act on the findings and has informed me that it is doing so.
Dit is een interne kwestie. De Raad van Toezicht is de aangewezen partij om naar bevind van zaken te handelen en zij heeft mij laten weten dit te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Van Nispen, Kuiken en Van der Graaf over het onderzoekverloop naar de dood van Dascha Graafsma

MPs asked how the second opinion on the cause of Dascha Graafsma's death was set up, how bias was prevented, whether lessons would lead to rule changes, and what the government would do about the family's complaints. The minister answered that a separate police unit runs the forensic second opinion, reviewed by uninvolved prosecutors, that no rule changes are planned, and that the OM apologised and will keep communicating openly.
The OM and police have apologised for earlier communication that too firmly concluded this case was a suicide.
Het OM en politie hebben excuses gemaakt voor eerdere communicatie waarin te stellig werd geconcludeerd dat in deze zaak sprake was van zelfdoding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Peters over de kritiek van de toezichthouder op de marktwerking voor deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Peters asked the minister whether the regulator's criticism of market competition among bailiffs (deurwaarders) should change policy and whether a new study is needed. The minister acknowledged the regulator's concerns, kept the market model, and promised a one-off tariff adjustment and a ban on price agreements that endanger bailiff independence, while rejecting a new study.
I also want to, following the Regulation on limits to tariff models for bailiffs, prohibit price agreements between the bailiff and the client that endanger the bailiff's independent position.

Ook wil ik – in navolging van de Verordening Grenzen tariefmodellen gerechtsdeurwaarders 3 – prijsafspraken tussen de gerechtsdeurwaarder en opdrachtgever verbieden die de onafhankelijke positie van de gerechtsdeurwaarder in gevaar brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘de betrokkenheid van de minister bij een mogelijke megaschikking met Shell voor corruptie in Nigeria’

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how often and when he discussed a possible Shell settlement over Nigerian corruption with the Public Prosecution Service, whether this fits the separation of powers, and whether the same treatment applies to others. The minister answers that the prosecution service informed him repeatedly about this sensitive case under its reporting duty, that he cannot discuss the ongoing investigation's substance, and that such briefings are customary for sensitive cases.
As you know, I cannot make substantive statements about individual criminal cases in which the criminal investigation is ongoing.
Zoals bij u bekend, kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over individuele strafzaken waarin het strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verbeteringen voorgesteld door de Vereniging Advocatenbelangen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether he would respond to the Vereniging Advocatenbelangen's proposals to raise legal aid fees for social-law lawyers, and whether he agrees that the point rate is still insufficient. The Minister said he received the letter, referred to a separate reply to the association, agrees the fee system has fallen behind practice and needs restructuring rather than extra money, and noted the association was informed on 28 February 2020.
I share the view that the fee system of the Legal Aid Fees Decree has not kept pace with societal developments and changes in court practice.
Ik deel de mening dat het vergoedingensysteem van het Besluit vergoedingen rechtsbijstand niet mee ontwikkeld is met de maatschappelijke ontwikkelingen en veranderingen in de procespraktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Tekort aan psychiaters vertraagt rechtszaken’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about shortages of psychiatrists and psychologists at the NIFP causing delayed pro Justitia reports and court cases. The minister acknowledged the shortage as worrying, described temporary measures such as triage, a shorter report variant, an accelerated training route and a pilot increasing hours per report, but did not present a fundamental structural fix.
The NIFP is struggling with a shortage of available pro Justitia (pJ) reporters.
Het NIFP kampt met een tekort aan beschikbare pro Justitia (pJ)-rapporteurs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Raad voor de Rechtspraak een schadevergoeding van een oud-rechter moet betalen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Judiciary Council should bear and recover the damages a former judge owes a lawyer after being found to have lied, given the indemnity the Council granted him. The Minister answered that the indemnity is legally valid and no realistic recovery is possible, so the Council bears all costs, and that the Council has said the indemnity was a one-off.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onvrede en een staking onder tolken en vertalers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about dissatisfaction and a strike among interpreters and translators, citing unchanged fees since 1981 and budget cuts threatening legal quality. The minister said the impact of the strike is limited, and announced tendering of all interpreting services with statutory minimum rates, while acknowledging the sector's concerns and promising monitoring and further consultation.
We are therefore moving to tender all interpreting and translation services and introduce minimum rates.
We gaan dan ook over tot het aanbesteden van alle tolk- en vertaaldiensten en de invoering van minimumtarieven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Afwijzing vordering TUL in 2 strafzaken’

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Gelderland court ruling that refused to enforce suspended sentences despite convicting the defendants of new offences, because under the new Wet USB no appeal lies against such enforcement decisions. The minister agreed that enforcing a suspended sentence before the new conviction is final would conflict with the presumption of innocence, said CJIB measures now prevent such enforcement, and committed to amending the law soon.
I will bring this legislative amendment into procedure at very short notice.
Ik zal deze wetswijziging op zeer korte termijn in procedure brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over het bericht dat zorginstellingen misbruik lijken te maken van de regeling waarmee zij aanstelling of ontslag van een bewindvoerder, mentor of curator mogen vragen

Two MPs (Van Nispen and Hijink, SP) asked about reports that care institutions are misusing their power to request appointment or dismissal of guardians and administrators, and whether judges adequately check such requests and whether guardians are dependent on care institutions. Minister Dekker answered that the figures were misread (about 20 institutional requests per year since 2017), that safeguards against conflicts of interest exist, and that the evaluation did not show clear misuse, while promising to ask care umbrella organisations to raise the issue with members.
When a care institution files a dismissal or appointment request, the judge assesses the merits of the request and weighs all interests involved.
Als een zorginstelling een ontslag- en benoemingsverzoek indient, beoordeelt de rechter de gegrondheid van het verzoek en weegt hij alle betrokken belangen af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Groothuizen en Van den Berge over de werkwijze van de meervoudige kamers van de Hoge Raad

MPs Van Nispen, Groothuizen and Van den Berge asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Supreme Court's practice of 'reservists' taking part in deliberations conflicts with articles 75 and 5 of the Wet RO. The Minister answered that reservists only give legal input in deliberations, do not decide cases or join the final vote, so no conflict with the law arises and no amendment is needed.
In my view there is therefore no reason to amend the law.
Mijns inziens bestaat er dan ook geen aanleiding om de wet aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over het bericht dat de veiligheid in de gevangenis van Lelystad in gevaar is

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported rises in prison incidents, staffing shortages, mega-prisons, and whether multi-person cells and isolation cells remain workable. The minister replied that total incidents have fallen, that serious violence against staff prompted a further DJI review due before summer 2020, that staffing is being addressed through recruitment, and that multi-person cell use and isolation placements remain appropriate.
I have asked DJI to conduct further research into this.
Ik heb DJI gevraagd hier nader onderzoek naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de financiële tarieven in de forensische zorgsector

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about inadequate tariffs in forensic care, noting that providers representing about 30 percent of capacity have started a summary proceeding over the tariffs, and questioned whether the tariffs safeguard security. The Minister replied that the NZa-set maximum tariffs are considered cost-covering, that the court found DJI insufficiently motivated its discounts, and that he is in talks with providers and willing to ensure adequate tariffs, while the NZa tariff questions are part of a pending objection procedure.
The court has now ruled that DJI, in applying discounts, did not sufficiently justify that a realistic tariff exists for those products to which a discount was applied.
De rechter heeft nu geoordeeld dat DJI, bij het toepassen van kortingen, onvoldoende gemotiveerd heeft dat dan sprake is van een reëel tarief voor die producten waar een korting op is toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het id Van Nispen over de pilot met rechtsbijstandverlening door Achmea

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the legal aid pilot run by Achmea/LegalGuard, including its commercial interests, the filmed work visit, the legal basis under the Legal Aid Act, funding, and low uptake. The Minister answers that the pilot is a lawful provision under the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, denies any commercial promotion, and says the pilot will run to March 2020 with lessons drawn despite low participation.
That is why the pilot will not be stopped prematurely by the Raad.
Daarom wordt de pilot door de Raad niet voortijdig stopgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Verdachte steekpartij Den Haag 'gevaar voor zichzelf en omgeving', maar werd niet opgepakt'

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Justice about a stabbing in The Hague by a man previously flagged as dangerous who was not detained, asking how oversight failed and whether mental health care cuts were to blame. The government answered that several investigations are ongoing, that the IGJ has ordered an independent inquiry at Parnassia and the Wmo supervisor is also investigating, and it declined to discuss specifics because of the criminal case.
Because of the ongoing investigations, I cannot currently go into specific aspects of this case.
Vanwege de lopende onderzoeken kan ik op dit moment niet ingaan op specifieke aspecten van deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheidssituatie in het Justitieel Centrum voor Somatische Zorg te Scheveningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a cell fire at the JCvSZ prison in Scheveningen, fire-safety arrangements, hygiene shortcomings flagged by the health inspectorate, reports of a climate of fear, and protection of whistleblowers. The minister answered that fire safety is adequate, that the incident was caused by a prisoner burning papers and was handled quickly, that hygiene improvements are underway with a report due in spring 2020, that whistleblowers are protected by law, and that an inspection orientation on the fear-culture signals was completed and sent to parliament on 20 January 2020.
DJI is always open to signals from the work floor, and reporters of possible misconduct are taken seriously in accordance with the laws and regulations on whistleblowers.
DJI staat altijd open voor signalen vanaf de werkvloer en melders van eventuele misstanden worden, conform de wet- en regelgeving inzake klokkenluiders, serieus genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het personeelstekort in jeugdgevangenissen

MPs Van den Berge, Kuiken and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff shortages in youth detention centres, including juveniles being temporarily placed in a women's prison, closures, turnover, sick leave and the Juvaid incident. The Minister answered that the problem is staff shortage rather than a lack of beds, detailed staffing and absence figures, and described the Ter Peel arrangement and measures taken at Juvaid.
I am aware of that. Should there be cause to inform you, I will do so.
Ik ben daarvan op de hoogte. Mocht er aanleiding zijn u te informeren, dan zal ik dat doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat experts en slachtoffers zorgen hebben over het stoppen van Sektesignaal

MPs asked the Justice Minister whether experts and former cult members are right to worry that closing the Sektesignaal information centre leaves victims without support, and how sharing of information and reporting would work afterwards. The minister disagreed with the concerns, pointed to a 2013 WODC study and the low incidence of cult abuses, and said reporting and information sharing would run through police, inspectorates and the RIEC network.
Abuses within cults occur only to a limited extent in the Netherlands.
Misstanden binnen sekten komen in Nederland beperkt voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een wettelijke regeling voor zaakstoedeling

The SP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the delayed publication of the judiciary's Code of case allocation, its transparency, the implications of the ECHR Miracle Europe judgment, and how the flex pool of judges fits in. The Minister answered that the Code is expected to be published in February 2020 with implementation by mid-2020, that he is considering whether statutory anchoring is needed, and that the Code's principles also apply to the flex pool.
The Code of case allocation is expected to be published on rechtspraak.nl in February 2020.
De Code zaakstoedeling zal naar verwachting in februari 2020 op rechtspraak.nl bekend worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de actie #ikpiketnietmeer van 1 t/m 14 januari 2020 en het breken van deze staking

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many criminal-defence and youth lawyers withdrew from legal-aid duty rosters during the January 2020 strike, whether the reported 39% non-availability was accurate, and why emergency fees were paid for stand-in duty while structural fee increases were refused. The minister said the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand cannot determine how many lawyers withdrew specifically because of the strike, confirmed the 39% figure only as non-availability without reasons, and explained the emergency per-diem arrangement as a temporary measure funded within the Raad's budget.
The Raad voor Rechtsbijstand has informed me that this information cannot be traced.
De raad voor rechtsbijstand heeft mij laten weten dat deze informatie niet te achterhalen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Dam, Groothuizen, Helder, Kuiken, Van Wijngaarden en Van den Berge over het boek ‘Moordsporen, op zoek naar de waarheid achter cold cases’

MPs from several parties asked the Justice Minister about the book 'Moordsporen' on unresolved cold cases, including the Larissa Dumont case, and whether an independent second-opinion facility should be set up. The minister acknowledged the importance of resolving doubts for relatives, pointed to police learning and ombudsman initiatives, defended the prosecutor's earlier conclusions, and described an ongoing second-opinion pilot and existing complaint routes.
If relatives have doubts about the conclusions of the death investigation after it has concluded, they can raise them with the public prosecutor.
Indien nabestaanden na het overlijdensonderzoek twijfels hebben over de conclusies daarvan, kunnen zij deze kenbaar maken aan de officier van justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over de dreigende gijzeling van een journalist

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about threatened detention of two journalists (NOS and AD) for refusing to testify as witnesses, and whether the source-protection law is clear enough. The minister answered that these were two separate court cases, the law leaves room for case-by-case weighing, and he sees no reason to amend the law or its criteria.
I regard these as two separate incidents.
Ik beschouw het als twee losse incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over straffen die collectief worden opgelegd aan groepen voetbalsupporters na het gebruik van vuurwerk door één of enkelen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether collective closures of football stands after fireworks by a few supporters are fair and effective, and whether he will move to individual punishment. The minister answered that such sanctions are a matter for the KNVB and clubs, that stand closures are a last resort, that effectiveness cannot be established, that he does not share the fairness objection, and that he is implementing a person-focused approach with clubs and municipalities.
Imposing penalties for such incidents is a matter between the Royal Netherlands Football Association (KNVB) and the clubs.
Het opleggen van straffen bij dergelijke incidenten is een aangelegenheid tussen de Koninklijke Nederlandse Voetbalbond (hierna: KNVB) en de clubs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het terugtrekken van het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) uit een strafzaak wegens ‘belangen die beschermd moeten worden’

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service withdrew from a serious assault case and declared itself inadmissible without explaining why, leaving the court unable to rule on the merits. The Minister says the reasons cannot be disclosed without harming protected interests, that an evidentiary problem arose, and that the issue will be raised in the Reflectiekamer for learning.
Regarding the reasons, unfortunately no further explanation can be given in this special case without endangering the necessary protection of weighty interests.
Over de redenen kan in dit bijzondere geval helaas geen nadere opheldering worden gegeven zonder de noodzakelijke bescherming van zwaarwegende belangen in gevaar te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het blog van de voorzitter van de Nederlandse Vereniging van Jonge Strafrechtadvocaten (NVJSA)

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog by the NVJSA chair criticising the design sessions for legal aid, including a €25,200 external consultancy and claims of closed discussions and irreversible steps. The Minister answered that the consultancy followed procurement rules, that the design sessions were open, and that urgency justified quick steps on family law.
The costs for the external consultancy ultimately amounted to €25,200 (excluding VAT).
De kosten voor het externe adviesbureau bedroegen uiteindelijk € 25.200 (exclusief BTW).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het werkdrukonderzoek Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI) 2020 van FNV onder gevangenispersoneel

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the FNV workload survey of prison staff can show rising workload, whether the minister will reconsider multi-person cell use, and whether the EUR 100 million personnel fund will be made structural. The minister acknowledges the workload signals, points to recruitment and retention efforts and the convenant with unions, defends multi-person cells as a legitimate detention facility, and says the funds are reserved for 2019-2021 with further investment to be weighed afterwards.
I am still awaiting publication of the FNV report.
Ik ben nog in afwachting van de publicatie van het rapport van de FNV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vele klachten van een buurt na de komst van een forensisch centrum

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about many neighbourhood complaints after a private forensic youth centre opened in Amsterdam-Noord, including unclear responsibilities, lack of prior consultation, and whether the ministry funds places there. The minister replied that the centre is private, not run by the ministry, that the ministry buys no places, and that responsibility for neighbourhood issues, complaints, and oversight of local impacts lies with the municipality, with the Inspectorate for Healthcare and Youth able to act on care quality.
I therefore cannot answer your specific questions about the incidents and contact with the neighbourhood.
Uw specifieke vragen over de incidenten en contact met de buurt kan ik daarom niet beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht de uitspraken van de minister in de media inzake de strijd tegen georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Justice about media statements on a special brigade against organised crime, its staffing, funding, preventive measures, intelligence services' role and possible cuts to regional police. The minister answered that the team is additional to existing capacity, outlined a funding plan to be decided in spring, and said intelligence services have no role in the current design.
The expansion of police capacity for the multidisciplinary intervention team comes on top of the existing capacity.
De uitbreiding van de capaciteit (van politie) van het multidisciplinair interventieteam komt bovenop de bestaande capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het handhaven van de stakingsacties door sociaal advocaten in januari 2020

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how many social lawyers had signed up for January 2020 duty rosters after the deadline and how many still maintained their strike, and what the consequences were. The minister answered that about 1850 lawyers are now available, that the raad voor rechtsbijstand does not record how many strike, and that the few local gaps are being addressed by the council.
The raad voor rechtsbijstand does not record how many lawyers are on strike.
De raad voor rechtsbijstand registreert niet hoeveel advocaten staken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat forensische zorginstellingen onvoldoende gefinancierd worden

MP Van Nispen asked whether forensic care institutions are underfunded, whether three tbs clinics went to court over tariffs, and whether the ministry's tariffs fall below NZa maximums. Minister Dekker replied that DJI follows NZa maximum tariffs with some discounts, that no price negotiations took place, that the financing increase is adequate, and that a blanket 10% increase is rejected.
The tariffs applied nationally by DJI are based on the maximum tariffs set by the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa).
De tarieven die landelijk worden gehanteerd door DJI zijn gebaseerd op de maximale tarieven zoals vastgesteld door de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (Nza).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de oproep dat veel meer jongerenwerkers nodig zijn in de strijd tegen drugsgeweld

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how the government responds to calls for far more youth workers to keep young people out of drug-related violence and whether this fits the government's public statements, and when concrete plans and funding would follow. The minister answered that youth work is primarily a municipal responsibility, that a broader anti-subversion plan including youth work is being developed with municipalities, that 110 million euro was set aside for the start of the approach, and that further preventive measures will be communicated later, but declined to answer the questions in time for the scheduled debate.
Youth work and the deployment of youth workers is primarily a task of municipalities.
Jongerenwerk en de inzet van jongerenwerkers is primair een taak van gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het functioneren van het tbs-stelsel

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether tbs clinic Hoeve Boschoord downplays incidents to avoid capacity and funding limits, whether the Inspectorate's ongoing thematic study covers tbs treatment duration, the financial norms and related incentives, and whether a separate study should follow. The minister said the Inspectorate has started an orientation on Boschoord, that there is no reason yet to assume a national problem, that the Inspectorate's resocialisation study will examine treatment duration, financial norms and leave phasing, and that it will inform parliament on the wider inquiry as soon as possible.
The Inspectorate immediately started an orientation and will soon assess to what extent further investigation is needed.
De IJenV is direct een oriëntatie gestart en beoordeelt spoedig in hoeverre nader onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over evenwichtigere griffierechttarieven

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about proposals to rebalance court filing fees (griffierechten): lowering fees for small claims while raising fees for large claims, whether past fee changes raised revenue, whether high fees deter large cases, why the state keeps surplus on default cases, and how to improve SME access to justice. The Minister rejects the large-claim surcharge as a budget risk, declines to quantify past revenue gains, argues fees should not track real costs, and points to a planned budget-neutral bill lowering small-claim fees.
I cannot give an amount of additional revenue resulting from the changes to the court fee rates in 2010 and 2011.
Ik kan geen bedrag noemen aan extra inkomsten als gevolg van de wijzigingen in de griffierechttarieven uit 2010 en 2011.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Toorenburg over misstanden bij adopties en de betrokkenheid en wetenschap van de Nederlandse overheid

MPs Van Nispen and Van Toorenburg asked the Minister for Legal Protection about irregularities in intercountry adoptions, government knowledge of them, and whether the inquiry should be broadened and whether China adoptions remain responsible. The minister mostly pointed to the ongoing COIA inquiry, announced stricter oversight of sending countries, and said adoptions from China remain justified, while declining to give an interim report yet.
I attach importance to awaiting the findings of the COIA before being able to make statements about what is indicated in the question.
Ik hecht eraan de bevindingen van de COIA af te wachten alvorens uitspraken te kunnen doen over hetgeen in de vraagstelling wordt aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het zinloze karakter van de vervangende hechtenis bij betalingsonmacht

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about imprisoning people who cannot pay a compensation measure, and whether this breaches Article 5 ECHR. The minister acknowledges the problem, points to the upcoming gijzeling regime under the Wet USB that will exempt proven inability to pay, and rejects the ECHR argument while promising to review CJIB payment arrangements.
The starting point when applying gijzeling is that no one is detained if inability to pay is demonstrably present.
Uitgangspunt bij toepassing van de gijzeling is dat niet wordt gegijzeld als aantoonbaar sprake is van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de daling van de meldingen van mensenhandel vanwege een onjuiste interpretatie van de privacywetgeving

MP Van Nispen asks the Justice Minister whether the drop in reported human trafficking cases is due to a misreading of privacy law, and what will be done about information sharing and CoMensha funding. The State Secretary acknowledges the decline, attributes it partly to the GDPR and partly to capacity pressure and police reorganisation, promises a policy response in Q1 2020 and a programme on information sharing, but says CoMensha's basic subsidy is not being cut.
I aim to inform the House about this in the first quarter of 2020.
Ik streef ernaar uw Kamer hierover in het eerste kwartaal van 2020 te informeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het opnemen van gegevens van een MOT-melder in het strafdossier

MP Van Nispen asked whether the name of an MOT (unusual transaction) reporter, such as a notary, is still routinely included in criminal case files, given threat risks, and asked for measures to prevent this. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the reporter's firm name is included because prosecutors must be able to verify the transaction and the defence and judiciary must be able to test the basis for an investigation, with exceptions and witness protection possible in threatening cases; he agreed to consult the KNB on improving the reporting process.

Without stating the business or office name of the reporting institution in the criminal file, the defence and the sitting judiciary cannot test on the basis of which specific information an investigation was started.

Zonder vermelding van de bedrijfs- of kantoornaam van de meldende instelling in het strafdossier kan niet door de verdediging en de zittende magistratuur, worden getoetst op basis van welke specifieke informatie een opsporingsonderzoek is gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een leerling-zweminstructeur die wordt verdacht van ontucht met minderjarigen

An MP asked the ministers whether a swim instructor suspected of sexual misconduct with minors should have had a VOG, whether mandatory VOGs should apply to swim instructors, and whether clubs should be checked and inform parents. The minister condemned the conduct, declined to discuss the individual case during the criminal investigation and for privacy, and rejected a statutory VOG obligation for the sector while promoting voluntary VOG use within integrity policy.
Due to the privacy of the person concerned, I cannot answer these questions. Moreover, the criminal investigation is still ongoing.
In verband met de privacy van de betrokkene kan ik deze vragen niet beantwoorden. Bovendien loopt het strafrechtelijk onderzoek nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onrust bij de rechtbank Noord-Nederland

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reported unrest and a culture of fear at the Noord-Nederland district court, and whether he will back an independent investigation proposed by unions. The Minister acknowledges the situation, notes the court president has stepped down, and says the Council for the Judiciary will discuss the situation with the court, including the union's proposal, without committing to an investigation himself.
The Council for the Judiciary has stated in a press release that it will discuss with the court what is needed for the organisation and its employees.
De Raad voor de rechtspraak heeft in een persbericht laten weten met de rechtbank in gesprek te gaan over wat nodig is voor de organisatie en haar medewerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over "de landsadvocaat die ruim 2,1 miljoen euro verdiende aan de Groninger gaswinning"

SP MPs asked for a total overview of legal costs in Groningen gas-damage lawsuits, costs per case, and how the State Attorney's costs relate to the damage claims and the 200,000 euro legal-aid amendment. The minister provided yearly fees for the State Attorney in civil suits against the State, the number and cost of the six Northern Netherlands cases, declined to discuss the individual Nijhof case, and said the costs are not charged to compensation budgets while cost-minimisation remains the aim.
I cannot go into individual procedures that have been or are being conducted.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele procedures die zijn of worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Nispen over het bericht over het bericht dat er een onveilige situatie is binnen een TBS-kliniek

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of an unsafe situation at TBS clinic Hoeve Boschoord, staffing shortages and funding cuts in forensic care, and an incident of physical aggression. Minister Dekker answered that management heard staff concerns, DJI will monitor the situation, the Inspectie was asked to investigate, and a Taskforce and workforce measures address staffing and administrative burden.
That is why DJI will closely follow the situation at Hoeve Bosschoord in the coming period.
Daarom zal DJI de situatie in Hoeve Bosschoord de komende tijd aandachtig volgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Nederlandse hulp aan gevangenen in buitenland berust op willekeur’

Six MPs from CDA, SP, GroenLinks, D66, SGP and ChristenUnie asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers about Dutch assistance to Dutch prisoners abroad (the Singh case), including the five-year binding criterion, a WOTS transfer request and the handling of the case. The government answered that it cannot comment on individual cases, that existing criteria apply, that no official US transfer request was ever made, and that it promises no concrete new step.
I cannot make statements about ongoing cases and individual cases.
Ik kan geen uitspraken doen over lopende zaken en individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over ‘het verslavend karakter van onderdelen van videospellen’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about loot boxes in EA's Fifa games, including whether they amount to illegal gambling and why the Kansspelautoriteit has not acted. The minister answered that only loot boxes meeting the legal definition of a game of chance fall under the Wok, that the Ksa has sufficient capacity but does not comment on ongoing investigations, that the Belgian removal of Fifa coins does not automatically satisfy Dutch law, and that the government will talk with NICAM and commissioned WODC research.
It makes no statements about whether investigations are ongoing or not.
Over al dan niet lopende onderzoeken doet zij geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over het onderzoek naar oorzaken van langlopende letselschadezaken

MPs Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen and Kuiken asked why the University of Utrecht study into causes of long-running personal injury claims is delayed, and whether its independence is compromised given the involvement of the Letselschade Raad, insurers and QCPP. The minister attributes the delay to the broad design, privacy preparation, and insurer response rates, and defends the study's independence and balanced steering committee.
There are no reasons for me to doubt the independence and objectivity of the commissioning party.
Er zijn voor mij geen redenen om te twijfelen aan de onafhankelijkheid en objectiviteit van de opdrachtgever.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het rapport van de Commissie-Oskam over tarieven en marktwerking voor deurwaarders

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Commissie-Oskam report on bailiff tariffs and market competition, including doubts about the reliability of the underlying Pro Facto and Cebeon studies, performance contracts, and whether market competition should be curbed. The Minister declined to pre-judge the report, said a full policy response would follow this year, and rejected the claim that market competition has gone too far while calling performance contracts undesirable where they only serve to let clients profit from official acts.
I do not want to anticipate the substantive response to the report. I am currently preparing it and expect to send it to your House this year.
Ik wil niet vooruit lopen op de inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport. Deze bereid ik thans voor en verwacht ik dit jaar nog naar uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van den Berge en Kuiken over het bericht ‘Minister Dekker kan teloorgang sociale advocatuur niets schelen; NOvA blijft weg uit topberaad’

Three MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection how to react to the Dutch Bar Association (NOvA) withdrawing from the top-level consultation on legal aid reform, which it called pointless, and why trust had collapsed. The minister regrets the NOvA's decision, says the door stays open, explains that no extra budget was provided in line with the coalition agreement, and points to a governance review by Bureau Gateway, inviting the NOvA back to talks.
I have invited the NOvA to resume talks in the short term.
Ik heb de NOvA uitgenodigd om op korte termijn weer in gesprek te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het budget voor mediation in strafzaken bijna op is

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why the budget for criminal mediation was nearly exhausted and how future shortfalls would be prevented. The minister said extra underspending on youth funds would cover most of the 2019 gap, leaving about 40 mediations unfunded, and committed to resolving that with the judiciary while noting the 2020 budget is fixed.

Now that it appears the funds for 2019 are likely insufficient, I have informed the National Coordinator for Mediation in Criminal Cases at the Judiciary Council that the expected underspending on youth funds can be used for non-youth criminal cases.

Nu het er naar uit ziet dat de middelen voor 2019 waarschijnlijk niet toereikend zijn, heb ik de Landelijk Coördinator Mediation in Strafzaken bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak laten weten dat de verwachte onderuitputting bij de middelen voor jeugdzaken ingezet kan worden voor andere dan jeugdstrafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  blog  ‘Andere tijden voor de rechtsbescherming’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about a blog criticising legal aid pay, an advocates' piket strike in early 2020, and the cost comparisons used in government arguments. The Minister acknowledges the strike and the pay gap for social lawyers, cites cuts and reforms over two decades, and says a reform within the existing budget is planned.
I am currently mapping out how I will implement this motion.
Ik breng op dit moment in kaart hoe ik uitvoering ga geven aan deze motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gevangeniswezen, het tegengaan van het binnensmokkelen van verboden spullen en de inhuur van externen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about contraband smuggling into the Zaanstad prison, staffing and overtime pressure, multi-person cell use, vacancies, and external hiring of security staff. The minister said the smuggler was a visitor caught by police, that staffing and cell-use measures are being managed, and that external staff undergo the same VOG screening, while the government will consider further measures on centralised registration of dismissed contract staff.
I have asked DJI to further investigate whether DJI runs a risk as a result and which measures could be taken.
Ik heb DJI gevraagd nader te onderzoeken of DJI hierdoor risico loopt en welke maatregelen getroffen kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kuiken, Laan-Geselschap, Van Toorenburg en Den Boer over terrorismeverdachten die airsoft speelden als mogelijke voorbereiding op een aanslag

MPs from SP, PvdA, VVD, CDA and D66 asked the Justice Minister how airsoft, which RTL reported terrorism suspects played as possible attack training, is controlled, including whether introduced guests need a certificate of conduct (VOG). The minister said current oversight is adequate, that screening looks back eight years, and that he will discuss how to combat misuse with the airsoft association but sees no reason to change the rules now.
I do not comment on individual case matters.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het tappen van de klokkenluider in de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about the wiretapping of whistleblower Van Ooyen in the WODC affair, whether he knew of it, and why he filed a criminal complaint in a case that could implicate her. The minister answered that the investigation is for the Public Prosecution Service and the Rijksrecherche, that he filed the complaint on the prosecutor's advice, expressly stated the leak was not against her, and that talks on compensation are ongoing.
I cannot go into the details of an individual criminal investigation.
Ik kan niet ingaan op de details van een individueel strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de fiscale aftrek van partneralimentatie de komende jaren wordt verlaagd

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the phased reduction of the tax deduction for partner alimony would push payers into hardship and cause a flood of court cases for lower alimony, and what the costs and revenues are. The State Secretary answered that only about 28% of payers are affected, that reviews are case-by-case and mostly handled without a judge, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects no major rise in workload, and that the structural revenue is estimated at 41 million euros, without behavioural effects.
Paid partner alimony remains fully deductible.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de "bemoeienis van het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders"

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked on what legal basis the Ministry of Justice and Security gave the prosecution points on possible defence arguments in the Wilders case, and why officials analysed the prosecution's report. Minister Grapperhaus answered that he cannot go into the content of the documents because they are now part of the court file, and promised a full account to parliament once the case is no longer before the court.
This means that as Minister of Justice and Security I must be extremely restrained and at this stage I cannot go into the substance of the documents.
Dit maakt dat ik mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid uiterst terughoudend dien op te stellen en ik in dit stadium niet inhoudelijk op de (inhoud van de) documenten kan ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Nispen over het bericht  ‘Topambtenaren eisten harde aanpak in proces tegen 'kwaadaardige' Wilders’

MPs Kuiken, Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether ministry officials improperly advised the public prosecution service (OM) on prosecuting Wilders, citing reports that officials urged a tough approach and wanted to read the requisitoir in advance. Minister Grapperhaus largely refers to earlier answers and a letter sending documents to the Chamber, while stating the College of procurators-general must provide information the minister needs.
I refer you to my answer to questions 1 through 6 today on the questions from members Groothuizen and Van Nispen about the involvement of the Ministry of Justice and Security in the Wilders case.

Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 1 tot en met 6 van heden op de vragen van de leden Groothuizen (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) over bemoeienis van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid met het proces Wilders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het Europees aanbesteden van medische diensten in het gevangeniswezen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether European tendering of medical services in prisons, and the replacement of security contractor G4S by Trigion, reflect cost-cutting or quality concerns. The Minister answers that EU procurement rules legally require the tendering, that cost savings are not the aim, that quality requirements apply, and that the number of externally hired guards (230) will be reduced only once permanent staff are recruited and trained.
Cost savings are not an aim of tenders in this area.
Bezuinigingen zijn geen oogmerk van aanbestedingen op dit gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet controleren van diplomaten op alcoholgebruik na ongevallen

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers whether diplomats involved in accidents are exempt from alcohol testing while ordinary drivers are tested, and whether this difference should be ended. The minister replied that diplomatic immunity under international law can bar breath tests, that a criminal investigation continues where immunity is later found not to apply, and that since May 2019 the CJIB notifies immune persons of traffic fines via the Foreign Ministry.
Diplomats, and often also staff of international organisations of comparable rank, enjoy immunity from the Dutch courts so that they can function effectively and independently.

Diplomaten, en vaak ook medewerkers van internationale organisaties met een vergelijkbare rang, beschikken in verband met het effectief en onafhankelijk kunnen functioneren over immuniteit voor de Nederlandse rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het nieuwe record: ministeries geven 25 miljoen euro uit aan inhuur van de landsadvocaat

Van Nispen (SP) asks why ministries spent a record 25 million euro on the state's external counsel (landsadvocaat) in 2018, whether this conflicts with the government's aim to reduce juridification and procedures, and why this contrasts with underfunded legal aid for citizens. The minister answers that the costs are being critically reviewed, mainly reflect mandatory civil representation where the state is defendant, and that legal aid and state counsel spending are distinct; he also details Defence and Justice spending, the Groningen claims procedures, and aims to reduce unnecessary government litigation.
It is difficult to say why the costs of hiring the state counsel were higher in 2018 than in previous years.
Het is moeilijk aan te geven waarom de kosten van inhuur van de landsadvocaat in 2018 hoger zijn uitgevallen dan in voorgaande jaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat rechters nog steeds hun bijbanen niet melden

Mr Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether judges' non-reporting of side jobs, reported in the press, undermines transparency and risks conflicts of interest, and whether the minister will consult the judiciary. The minister answered that a complete, up-to-date register of side positions is important for public trust, that the duty to disclose is meant for transparency rather than discouraging side jobs, and that he will talk with the Council for the Judiciary about instruments to safeguard transparency and impartiality and report back.
I consider it, together with the Council for the Judiciary and the Dutch Association for the Judiciary, of great importance that the register of side positions is up to date and complete.
Ik vind het – met de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak – van groot belang dat het register nevenbetrekkingen actueel en volledig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het beïnvloeden van persberichten van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand door het ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid

MP Van Nispen asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security influenced the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's press release on its Monitor Gesubsidieerde Rechtsbijstand 2017, and why it commented on the draft. The minister answered that the ministry only sat on the monitor's supervisory committee, that it commented on the draft headline as not covering the report's content, that the Raad decided the final text, and that the correspondence is internal and not published.
It is the responsibility of the Raad to establish a definitive text of its press releases, whether or not based on comments made.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de Raad om, al dan niet op basis van gemaakte opmerkingen, een definitieve tekst van zijn persberichten vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gratis moeten leveren van rechtsbijstand door advocaten

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection why criminal lawyers receive no separate fees for frequent hearings and activities, and why they are expected to work largely unpaid under the fixed-fee system. The minister replied that work is covered by flat fees and surcharges, acknowledged imbalance in criminal-law fees, announced an investigation into extra-hours arrangements, and pointed to pilots and a EUR 10 million innovation reserve as steps toward better fees.
Under the current system, it is therefore not the case that lawyers perform their work for free.
In het huidige stelsel is het dus niet zo dat advocaten gratis hun werkzaamheden verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de wettelijke grondslag van de pilot van de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand met LegalGuard/Achmea

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand's pilot with LegalGuard/Achmea has a legal basis, given that no rules were set for contracting third parties to provide legal aid. The minister replied that the pilot rests on articles 7, 8 and 13 Wrb, that LegalGuard may use staff of a voorziening regardless of employment arrangements, and that no further policy rules are required.
No policy rules need to be set by the board of the Raad for this under article 13, third paragraph, Wrb.
Hiervoor hoeven op grond van artikel 13, derde lid, Wrb door het bestuur van de Raad geen beleidsregels te worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verdenking van omkoping en corruptie bij Shell en het verschoningsrecht van bedrijfsjuristen

The MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how the legal professional privilege of in-house lawyers, raised in the Shell corruption case, should be understood and whether its scope should be reconsidered. The Minister answers that in-house lawyers admitted as advocates may claim privilege only for advocate-type work, that the scope is under court review in the ongoing Shell case, and that a WODC study and a procedure in the new Code of Criminal Procedure are planned, but sees no reason to change the current scope.
Given that this concerns an ongoing criminal case that is before the judge on this legal question, I will not go into it further here.
Gelet op het feit dat het hier een lopende strafzaak betreft die ten aanzien van deze rechtsvraag onder de rechter is, zal ik daar hier verder niet op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat Justitie de integriteitsproblemen te lijf gaat met een tarotlezeres

Two MPs asked the Minister of Justice about a press report that the ministry used a tarot reader in a 'Week of Unblemished Conduct' integrity programme, and whether such activities were justified. The minister defended the week as a way to make integrity discussable, gave its costs and themes, said such sessions will recur, and rejected the complaints by anonymous officials while acknowledging the top must set the example.
Next year there will again be a Week of Unblemished Conduct organised.
Volgend jaar zal er weer een Week van het Onbesproken Gedrag georganiseerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Minder rechtszaken in Overijssel door tekort aan rechters’

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the Overijssel court cannot hold the agreed number of criminal hearing days due to a judge shortage, and that 500 appeal cases are being moved from the Arnhem-Leeuwarden appeals court to The Hague. The Minister confirms the shortfall (about 3.5% of hearing days), says already-scheduled cases are not delayed, leaves prioritisation to the prosecution service, describes recruitment and training measures and a temporary transfer regulation, and states that the regulation excludes Overijssel cases to limit travel burdens.
The court is working hard to reduce the shortage of judges as quickly as possible.
De rechtbank werkt er hard aan om het tekort aan rechters zo snel mogelijk terug te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wijzigen van de achternaam na incest

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why changing a surname after incest requires a costly, lengthy psychological procedure and fees, and whether exemptions or easier criteria could apply. The minister answered that the procedure will be simplified with medical evidence from the victim's own treating professional, that fees are waived after a final conviction and, following alignment with the Schadefonds Geweldsmisdrijven criteria, also when that fund has granted compensation.
I will change the procedure in these cases so that the victim can submit medical documents themselves showing physical or mental harm.
Ik ga de werkwijze in deze gevallen aanpassen, zodat het slachtoffer zelf medische stukken kan overleggen waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van lichamelijke of geestelijke hinder.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven feitenonderzoek kunnen doen naar fraude en corruptie

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked whether companies investigating their own fraud and corruption, with lawyers they hire, is acceptable and how it is controlled, including sentence reductions, transparency and the lawyers' privilege. Minister Grapperhaus replied that the OM and FIOD check such investigations for depth, completeness and accuracy, that the OM does not register the number of cases involving company-led investigations, and that transactions are published with a press release and fact summary.
The number of cases in which company-led fact-finding into fraud and/or corruption played any role is not registered as such by the OM.
Het aantal zaken waarin het feitenonderzoek naar fraude en/of corruptie door bedrijven op enigerlei wijze een rol heeft gespeeld, wordt niet als zodanig geregistreerd bij het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de pilot van Legal Guard, de overeenkomst met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand en eerdere vragen hierover

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Legal Guard pilot run by Achmea for the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, covering funding, fee structure, lawyer qualifications, client choice and evaluation. The minister answered that the pilot is the Raad's own initiative paid from its own funds, that fees are volume-based and not comparable to lawyers' flat fees, that the audit is by independent academics, and that the final report is expected in May 2020.
The total costs of the pilot are not yet known, as the pilot is still running.
De totale kosten van de pilot zijn nog niet bekend, aangezien de pilot nog loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over de onrust op het ministerie naar aanleiding van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek in de WODC-affaire

Opposition MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen asked Justice Minister Grapperhaus about the works council's criticism of the ministry's criminal complaint over a leak in the WODC affair, and about interviews of staff by the deputy Secretary-General looking for leakers. The minister defended the complaint as not contrary to the whistleblower scheme, admitted the interviews should not have covered the subject under criminal investigation and that the deputy SG resigned, but gave no records and did not rule out other leak inquiries.
Those conversations therefore should not have been held on that subject.
Deze gesprekken hadden daarom over dat onderwerp niet moeten worden gevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een ernstig geweldsincident in de  gevangenis

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a serious assault on a prison officer at JC Zaanstad, the incident figures, staffing levels, safety measures, and whether the perpetrator was wrongly housed in a regular ward for lack of psychiatric capacity. The minister described the incident, said staff can work safely, noted rising demand for PPC places and capacity expansion, and rejected claims of structural unsafety.
The staff at JC Zaanstad can perform their work safely and responsibly.
Het personeel in JC Zaanstad kan veilig en verantwoord het werk doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Belastingdienst om bij te dragen aan het bestrijden van georganiseerde criminaliteit en het afpakken van misdaadgeld

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked about the Tax Authority's contribution to fighting organised crime and seizing criminal proceeds, including why its EUR 7 million funding request from the Ondermijningsfonds was not honoured and whether regions can set their own priorities. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the request was declined due to uncertainty over a pilot, that Tax Authority priorities are set nationally within regional LIEC/RIEC structures, that extra structural funding is planned with details due on Prinsjesdag, and that asset-seizure ambitions are being pursued jointly with the Public Prosecution Service.
Given the operational nature of the spending proposals submitted by the other partners, I will not make the reinforcement plans public.
Gezien de operationele aard van de bestedingsvoorstellen die door de overige partners zijn ingediend zal ik de versterkingsplannen niet openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het deels instorten van het dak van het stadion van AZ in Alkmaar

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked the government about the partial collapse of the AZ stadium roof in Alkmaar, including whether budget cuts, municipal oversight, pressure on the municipality, and solar panels contributed. Minister Ollongren answered that the municipality found no evidence the roof was underbuilt, that investigations by Haskoning and the Onderzoeksraad are pending, and that she will inform parliament once outcomes are known.
The municipality of Alkmaar will inform me of the outcomes of this investigation. Once that has happened, I am willing to inform your House.
Over de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek zal de gemeente Alkmaar mij informeren. Nadat dit is gebeurd, ben ik bereid uw Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een wetsvoorstel inzake het toezicht op vermogensbeheer van minderjarigen

MP Van Nispen asked why a promised legislative change on supervision of guardianship assets of minors, announced after a 2017 study, had not yet been sent to parliament, and when it would be. The minister admitted delay, citing other personal-law projects, and said consultation is planned for 2020 with a bill possibly submitted in the second half of 2020.
I intend to put the bill on supervision of guardianship of minors' assets out for consultation during 2020.
Ik ben voornemens om het wetsvoorstel inzake toezicht op bewind bij minderjarigen in de loop van 2020 in consultatie te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van jeugdrechtadvocaten

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the youth lawyers' open letter complaining that the EU child-procedural-rights directive, now implemented, guarantees minors mandatory legal aid at police interrogation without an adequate fee, and that police and prosecutors shift responsibility onto the bar.
