The minister acknowledged the extra workload, said fees follow the existing point system (raised 50% in 2016), disputed that police and prosecutors shift responsibility, and promised to consult the bar and report before the budget debate.

In response to this letter, I will shortly consult further with the (youth law) bar, together with the police and the public prosecution service, within the existing functional contacts on implementing the directive and the practical application of the implementing law, and discuss the bottlenecks identified.

Mede naar aanleiding van deze brief zal ik op korte termijn, in het kader van de reeds bestaande functionele contacten over de implementatie van de richtlijn en de praktische uitvoering van de wet ter uitvoering van deze richtlijn, samen met politie en openbaar ministerie nader in overleg treden met de (jeugdrecht)advocatuur en daarbij ook de gesignaleerde knelpunten bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de stevige kritiek van de commissaris van de Koning in Noord-Brabant op de staat van de strafrechtketen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about sharp criticism from the Brabant commissaris van de Koning of the criminal justice chain, including understaffing, bureaucracy and digital backlog, and whether crime pays and police recruitment will meet targets. The Minister largely agrees with the criticism, points to chain cooperation priorities, anti-money-laundering and asset-recovery measures, extra funding, and monitoring of police recruitment, committing to keep the House informed.
I am closely monitoring developments and will of course keep your House informed.
Ik monitor de ontwikkelingen nauw, en houd uw Kamer hier vanzelfsprekend van op de hoogte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek waaruit het maatschappelijk rendement van sport en bewegen in Nederland blijkt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Medical Care about a social return on investment study of sport, including whether to study extra physical education, sport's effects on social-support and criminality costs and healthcare costs, and whether business should pay more. The minister replied that the findings confirm existing knowledge, that further research has little added value, that existing municipal knowledge-sharing suffices, and that no additional measures are needed.
This study confirms that investment in sport is well spent, but gives no reason for additional or alternative measures.
Deze studie is een bevestiging dat een investering in sport goed besteed is, maar geeft geen aanleiding voor extra of alternatieve maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vergelijking van rechtsstelsels en de methode van het World Justice Project

An SP MP asks the Ministers of Justice and Security and for Legal Protection why the government relies on the World Justice Project rule of law ranking, questioning its survey method, the expert sample, the unclear identity of the fieldwork company and whether firm conclusions about Dutch courts can be drawn. The Minister for Legal Protection defends the index as one of several indicators, says the 21 experts and the fieldwork contractors are as disclosed by the WJP, and maintains that the Dutch rule of law functions well.
As previously indicated, the World Justice Project has informed me that it contracted YouGov to carry out the population survey.
Zoals ook al eerder aangeven heeft het World Justice Project mij laten weten dat zij YouGov gecontracteerd hebben om het bevolkingsonderzoek uit te voeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Helvert, Omtzigt, Sjoerdsma en Van Nispen over gedetineerdenbegeleiding in het buitenland

MPs from CDA, D66 and SP asked whether Dutch detainees abroad can receive legal aid from the Netherlands, how subsidies for detainee support were distributed, and whether DutchAdvocates refuses or redirects cases and pressures former PrisonLAW clients. The minister replied that legal aid is primarily the detainee's own responsibility with local lawyers, that subsidy was transferred to DutchAdvocates from 2019 with PrisonLAW's agreement, that clients are free to choose their lawyer, and that no misconduct exists.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over de gebrekkige aanpak van mensenhandel en arbeidsuitbuiting

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked why human trafficking and labour exploitation cases so rarely lead to convictions, whether the rules on what counts as exploitation should be clearer, and what steps follow the National Rapporteur's report. The government says it is exploring clearer criteria for the grey zone between bad employment practices and trafficking, will send a cabinet response before autumn, and declines to comment on individual cases such as the fatal accident involving Romanian workers.
I will not go into individual cases. The Public Prosecution Service decides on prosecution.
Ik ga niet in op individuele zaken. Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat over de vervolgingsbeslissing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over illegale drugsdumpingen

Two SP MPs asked who is responsible for cleaning up illegal drug waste after the Raad van State ruled that landowners need not pay, and asked about the status of inter-governmental talks, funding, and urgency. The Minister answered that regional and local authorities bear responsibility, that the cabinet will provide EUR 1 million per year structurally for co-financing direct clean-up costs, and that proposals for a structural co-financing scheme will come before the summer recess.

The cabinet now makes available structurally EUR 1 million per year for the period 2019 through 2024 on the budget of the Ministry of Justice and Security to (co)finance the direct costs of clean-up of drug dumping.
Het kabinet maakt nu voor de periode 2019 tot en met 2024 structureel nog € 1 mln. per jaar vrij op de begroting van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting en ZVW-premie door oud-gevangenispersoneel dat met SBF-verlof is gegaan

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked whether former prison staff on SBF leave were wrongly charged income tax and health premiums after a 2013 law change, and why some were not compensated. The State Secretary answered that the 104-week limit runs from the start of SBF leave, that the Tax Authority and DJI reached a settlement in late 2018, and that 151 people were not refunded because no excess tax was paid for them.
This establishes that the white table applies to the remaining part of the 104-week period as of 1 January 2013.
Daarmee is vastgelegd dat op het per 1 januari 2013 resterende deel van het tijdvak van 104 weken de witte tabel wordt toegepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over nieuwe bezuinigingen en dreigende sluitingen van justitiële jeugdinrichtingen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked whether savings on youth detention institutions, possibly including closures, were being considered, and questioned the timing, capacity forecasts and consultation of the regions. The Minister replied that a reorganisation towards smaller and specialist facilities is set out in a letter of 28 June 2019, that the reforms fit the coalition agreement, that current occupancy forecasts show no short-term capacity shortage, and that a debate with the House is welcome.
The decision-making has been sent to you with my letter of 28 June 2019. I am happy to debate this with your House.
De besluitvorming heb ik u met mijn brief van 28 juni 2019 toegezonden. Ik ga hierover graag met uw Kamer in debat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  verlagen van drempels voor de herziening van afgesloten strafzaken

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether the threshold for asking the ACAS to review closed criminal cases should be lowered to cases with less than twelve years' maximum sentence, and whether the novum criterion for revision should be broadened. The minister answers no to both, arguing that the twelve-year threshold is justified, the 2018 evaluation found no reason to change it, and broadening the novum criterion would turn revision into a fourth instance and weaken its exceptional character.
On the other hand, I do see clear objections to other formulations.
Ik zie daarentegen wel duidelijk bezwaren tegen andere formuleringen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over de middelen die het notariaat ter beschikking heeft om fraude te bestrijden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether the notariat has enough tools to combat fraud, including BV fraud after the removal of preventive checks, EU digital incorporation, a VAT-number pre-check scheme and a central shareholder register. The minister acknowledges the notary's gatekeeper role, is in talks with the KNB, denies a clear causal link to simplified BV law, rejects the VAT pre-check idea because of the fiscal confidentiality duty, and says the government will prepare a position on the shareholder register initiative.
I am in discussion with the KNB about the instruments the notariat needs, given its gatekeeper role.
Ik ben in gesprek met de KNB over het instrumentarium dat voor het notariaat, vanwege diens poortwachtersrol, nodig en wenselijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de erkenning van gevangenisstraffen uit andere EU-landen

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister why Hungary refuses to take over enforcement of a Dutch national's sentence that the Netherlands had agreed to, and about the EU framework rules, typical durations, resocialisation effects and whether the minister will raise this with other states. The minister answers that the framework decision creates no obligation for the sentencing state to request transfer, that the Dutch procedure was not unusually long, that roughly half of transfers finish within deadlines, that Bureau Buitenland and municipal aftercare support returnees, and that no action with counterparts is planned.
In principle there is no obligation for the sentencing state to submit a request for recognition.
Er bestaat in beginsel geen verplichting voor de staat van veroordeling om een verzoek tot erkenning in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de enquête waaruit blijkt dat bijna 70% van de sociaal advocaten overwegen te stoppen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to a survey showing that nearly 70% of social lawyers are considering quitting, and whether this threatens subsidised legal aid, and asks about the state of the planned overhaul of subsidised legal aid. The minister says she is aware of the concerns, notes the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand figures show a decline in participating lawyers mainly due to lawyers failing minimum registration requirements, and promises a progress report and implementation plan before the summer recess.
I will therefore give this concern a place in the further elaboration of the outlines.
Ik geef deze zorg dan ook een plek in de nadere uitwerking van de contouren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked about the CJIB tendering of debt collection to bailiffs, including who takes over existing debts, costs for debtors, the abandoned postcode-based allocation model, protection of debtors' interests and the link with the Rijksincassovisie. The minister answered that the minimum subsistence amount is reset after 12 months, bailiff tariffs are statutory and unchanged, the old arrondissement-based model was dropped in 2001 to promote competition, and tendering allows bundling of one debtor's claims and selection of bailiffs aligned with the Rijksincassovisie.
The CJIB is committed to socially responsible collection and enforcement in line with cabinet policy.
Het CJIB zet zich in voor het sociaal-maatschappelijk verantwoord innen en incasseren conform het kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Kuiken, Krol, Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Minister in de strafzaak tegen het lid Wilders

MPs from D66, SP, PvdA, GroenLinks and 50PLUS asked the Minister of Justice about possible contacts between his predecessor Opstelten or ministry staff and the Public Prosecution Service over the case against MP Wilders, including a timeline of contacts and why ambtsberichten are kept confidential. The Minister says he cannot vouch for all contacts, will not comment on individual prosecutions, and provides a partial timeline with confidentiality grounds for withholding the advisory reports.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Groothuizen over het bericht dat er nu toch een strafrechtelijk onderzoek loopt naar de klokkenluiders van de WODC-affaire

MPs Van Nispen and Groothuizen ask why a criminal investigation now targets the sources of journalists in the WODC affair, after the minister earlier praised the whistleblower and why the ministry filed a complaint only in this case. The minister answers that the public prosecutor found grounds for investigation, that the ministry was obliged to file the complaint under the official secrecy provisions, and that the whistleblower deserves protection while leaking of confidential information is unacceptable.
As Minister of Justice and Security I have no involvement in individual criminal cases.
Als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid heb ik geen bemoeienis met individuele strafzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat door personeelstekorten er niet voldoende celinspecties plaats kunnen vinden in gevangenissen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether staff shortages in prisons prevent adequate cell inspections, whether sanctions are effective, and how working pressure and personnel will be addressed. The minister acknowledged the signals, said DJI prioritises inspections and recruitment, defended group-cell use, and announced a tightened sanctions card and a 2018–2021 convenant on workload.
I consider cell inspections of essential importance for safety in the institution, and therefore we must not compromise on them.
Celinspecties vind ik van wezenlijk belang voor de veiligheid in de inrichting, en daarom mogen we daar niet op inleveren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de oproep van burgemeesters meer te investeren in de handhavingscapaciteit van de Belastingdienst voor de aanpak van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether the government would respond to mayors' calls for more Tax Authority capacity to fight organised crime, and what it would concretely do to prevent a capacity shortfall. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the Tax Authority commits a substantial share of capacity to the integrated approach, that the requested extra funding for its enforcement bid was not granted, but that €1 million (2019) and €0.85 million (2020 onward) go to analysis capacity and a further increase of about €29 million structurally was decided.
The Tax Authority cannot currently always make the requested contribution.
De Belastingdienst kan op dit moment niet altijd de gevraagde bijdrage leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat marktwerking voor gerechtsdeurwaarders te ver is doorgeslagen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether market competition among bailiffs has gone too far, creating perverse incentives that undermine bailiffs' independence and whether government should encourage debt assistance and alternative procurement. The minister disagreed that competition has gone too far, said a commission is reviewing the tariff system, pointed to existing responsible-collection commitments, and said price will not be part of the CJIB tender competition.
I am awaiting the results of that investigation.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten van dat onderzoek af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat een Nederlandse strafrechtadvocaat de toegang tot de Verenigde Staten geweigerd wordt

SP MPs asked the government whether it would act after reports that a Dutch criminal lawyer representing terrorism suspects was denied entry to the United States, and how US authorities obtained that information. The minister said advocates must be free to practise, that the US decides its own entry criteria and gave no individual explanation, that the government raised the matter with US authorities and will monitor it, and that the Dutch government shares no information about such lawyers with the US.
Enquiries with the American authorities show that an application for an ESTA or visa is assessed against many different criteria.
Navraag bij de Amerikaanse autoriteiten leert dat een aanvraag voor een ESTA of visum wordt getoetst aan de hand van vele verschillende criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het  uitbreiden van burgeropsporing en het aanleveren van complete dossiers aan de politie en het openbaar ministerie door mensen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister what 'citizen investigation' in the Oost-Nederland prosecution service's annual plan means, why citizens are being asked to compile complete case files, whether budget cuts play a role, and whether citizens should bear investigative tasks. The Minister answered that the pilot is within the investigation agenda, citizens stay within legal limits without investigative powers, and investigation remains a government task.
Citizens cannot and will not be expected to carry out 'investigative acts' within the meaning of the Code of Criminal Procedure; they do not have formal investigative powers.

Van burgers kan en zal niet worden verwacht dat zij zelf «opsporingshandelingen» verrichten in de zin van het Wetboek van Strafvordering; zij beschikken immers niet over formele opsporingsbevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Van Nispen, Buitenweg, Groothuizen, Kuiken en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht Boek over politieonderzoek Nicole van den Hurk moet worden aangepast

MPs asked about a court ruling that a book on the police investigation into Nicole van den Hurk must be amended to protect relatives' privacy, and about how the police and prosecution service handle media contracts and embedded journalists. The minister admits errors were made, says the relatives were informed late, outlines a revised media guideline and standard contract, and says a Slachtofferhulp study will report by end 2019.
Errors were made. In weighing the public interest in openness against the protection of the relatives' privacy, insufficient attention was paid to the latter.

Er zijn fouten gemaakt. Bij de afweging tussen het maatschappelijk belang van openheid aan de ene kant en de bescherming van de privacy van de nabestaanden aan de andere kant is onvoldoende oog geweest voor het laatste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de pilot van Legal Guard en de overeenkomst met de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Legal Guard pilot with Achmea and its agreement with the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, covering costs, the choice of a 750-case cap, fee and eigen bijdrage differences versus social lawyers, quality requirements and confidentiality. The minister answered each question, defending the pilot as a learning experiment run by the Raad, while conceding that Legal Guard jurists are not subject to disciplinary rules like lawyers and that fee and cost-retention terms differ from those for social lawyers.
Confidentiality has been agreed regarding the fixed project costs and data traceable to persons working at the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and Legal Guard, or involved in the pilot.
Er is geheimhouding afgesproken over de vaste projectkosten en gegevens die herleidbaar zijn tot personen werkzaam bij de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand en Legal Guard, of betrokken bij de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de betrouwbaarheid en bruikbaarheid van de vergelijkingen tussen rechtsstelsels en het World Justice Project

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the reliability and usefulness of the World Justice Project Rule of Law Index as a comparison of Dutch judiciary quality, given criticism of survey methods, contractor identity and funding. The Minister defended the index as one of several indicators, acknowledged differing methods, and answered the funding and survey questions while maintaining the index remains meaningful.

As I indicated in answering your earlier parliamentary questions, the WJP is one of several indicators from which it is derived that the Netherlands has a well-functioning legal system compared with other countries.

Zoals ik bij de beantwoording van uw eerdere Kamervragen heb aangegeven is het WJP één van meerdere indicatoren waaraan wordt ontleend dat Nederland beschikt over een in vergelijking met andere landen goed functionerend rechtsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Laan-Geselschap, Groothuizen en Van Dam over de procedure en de capaciteit bij het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens

MPs asked about budget problems at the Council of Europe and the European Court of Human Rights, the reopening of Dutch criminal cases after a unilateral state acknowledgement of a Convention breach, and extra staff for Dutch cases at the Court. The minister said the Netherlands must meet its payment obligations and wants the Court spared from cuts, that the government will examine whether the reopening rules need amending, and that talks are underway on extra support for the Court's registry.

In view of this, I will examine whether amending the statutory provisions is necessary and desirable to ensure that revision is possible on the basis of a decision by the ECtHR following a unilateral government declaration that the Convention has been breached.

Gelet hierop zal ik bezien of aanpassing van de wettelijke regeling nodig en gewenst is om te verzekeren dat herziening mogelijk is op grond van de beslissing door het EHRM na een eenzijdige verklaring van de regering dat het verdrag is geschonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de hulp aan achterblijvers van vermiste personen in het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether families of people missing abroad should receive better and more standardised help, including a 24-hour help desk, and whether it is absurd that they are advised to crowdfund searches. The minister answered that the local authorities bear primary responsibility, that the ministry keeps families informed via a contact person, and that a dedicated search fund would undermine local responsibility, so the government will not set one up.
By setting up a search fund and creating the impression that the Dutch government can and wants to take over a case, that responsibility is actually undermined and undesirable effects can arise.

Door het instellen van een fonds voor opsporing en de indruk te wekken dat de Nederlandse overheid een zaak kan en wil overnemen, wordt die verantwoordelijkheid juist ontkracht en kunnen ongewenste effecten ontstaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkwijze en prijsafspraken van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars en de gevolgen voor de kwaliteit

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about legal expenses insurers reselling cases to third parties at fixed low fees without client knowledge, the secrecy of such contracts, and who guarantees quality. The minister answered that insurers say outsourcing is exceptional and disclosed to clients, that quality remains the insurer's responsibility under existing rules and complaint channels, and that the new subsidised legal aid system will use quality criteria, procurement steering and supervision, with a promise to reconsider outsourcing policy.
The Dutch Association of Insurers states it does not have figures on the number of cases that legal expenses insurers outsource for a fixed amount.
Het Verbond van Verzekeraars geeft aan niet te beschikken over cijfers van het aantal zaken dat door rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars wordt uitbesteed voor een vast bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het belemmeren van de vrije advocatenkeuze door rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about legal expenses insurers restricting clients' free choice of lawyer, citing a Kassa broadcast and criticism that in-house lawyers serve two masters and that cost caps for external lawyers are much lower than for in-house lawyers. The minister answers that quality is monitored by the AFM, insurers must inform clients of their choice rights under binding self-regulation, EU case law allows cost limits unless they make free choice illusory (a matter for courts), and the Verbond van Verzekeraars reports no signals that caps are insufficient.
This yields a varied picture, but in general it can be said that in other European countries too, insurers' salaried lawyers provide legal aid in kind.

Hieruit komt een divers beeld naar voren, maar in zijn algemeenheid kan gezegd worden dat ook in andere landen in Europa juristen in loondienst van rechtsbijstandsverzekeraars in natura rechtshulp geven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de aanbesteding van het CJIB

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked whether a new CJIB tender for bailiff debt collection contradicts the Rijksincassovisie, why it was started, and whether debtors bear extra costs when a new bailiff must re-establish the debt. The minister denied any conflict with the policy vision, explained the tender is needed because current two-year contracts are ending, and said ongoing files stay with the original bailiff.
No, the tender round does not conflict with the Rijksincassovisie.
Nee, de aanbestedingsronde is niet in strijd met de Rijksincassovisie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook weigert geld terug te betalen bij aankopen die op haar platform zijn gedaan door minderjarigen

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked the minister whether Facebook refuses refunds for in-game purchases made by minors without parental knowledge and what rules apply in the Netherlands. The minister answered that such refunds can be claimed under Dutch civil law, that Facebook has a refund tool and reportedly grants valid claims, and that parents can secure accounts, while the minister raised the issue with Facebook.
If something unexpectedly goes wrong and a child makes payments without permission, I am assured that Facebook is accommodating in refunding them.
Als er onverhoopt toch iets mis gaat en een kind zonder toestemming betalingen verricht, is mij verzekerd dat Facebook coulant omgaat met terugbetalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat kinderen in Nederland nog steeds kunnen gokken in videogames

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why children can still gamble through loot boxes in video games despite the Kansspelautoriteit finding breaches in 2018, why the offending games were not named, why FIFA changed in Belgium but not in the Netherlands, and whether the regulator has enough legal capacity to enforce. The minister answered that not all loot boxes breach the law, two games were fixed, two cases are ongoing, the regulator names firms only after an established breach, and the regulator is adequately equipped.
Because of possible unjustified reputational damage, the Ksa always chooses to name companies only after it has established that a breach has occurred and an enforcement measure has been imposed.
Vanwege mogelijk onterechte imagoschade kiest de Ksa er steeds voor om bedrijven pas bij naam te noemen nadat is vastgesteld dat er een overtreding is begaan en een handhavende maatregel is opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijk strafrechtelijke karakter van het sluiten van drugspanden door de burgemeester

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether mayoral closure of drug premises under article 13b Opiumwet may be a criminal charge that bars prosecution, and whether closures are being used too broadly. The minister answers that closure is a restorative, not punitive, measure, that mayors need only justify necessity and proportionality, that a monitoring motion will report by 2021, and that repressive action is for justice.
The decision must show an assessment of the concrete circumstances of the case as a whole, including an assessment of the proportionality of the consequences of closure for those involved.
Het besluit moet blijk geven van een beoordeling van de concrete omstandigheden van het geval in samenhang bezien, waaronder een beoordeling van de evenredigheid van de gevolgen van de sluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het succes van mediation in het strafrecht en de toereikendheid van het budget

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the success of mediation in criminal cases and whether the budget is sufficient, warning it may run out by October 2019. The minister responded that mediation is valuable for victims under conditions, that 774 mediation agreements were reached in 2018, and that the 2019 budget of 1.3 million euro, including 300,000 for youth cases, is expected to be sufficient.
For 2019 and subsequent years 1.3 million euro is available, of which 300,000 euro is exclusively for youth cases.
Voor 2019 en volgende jaren is 1,3 miljoen euro beschikbaar waarvan 300.000 euro exclusief voor jeugdzaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de start van de pilot consumentenzaken met Legal Guard

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the consumer-cases pilot with LegalGuard: how its goals are evaluated, whether it was tendered, how fees and quality standards compare to subsidised lawyers, and the rule-making and marketing study behind the legal aid reform. The minister answered that an independent evaluation and audit will be carried out by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that the pilot falls below tender thresholds and was initiated by the Raad, and that the reform design is still being refined through pilots and market research.
Evaluation is carried out independently of LegalGuard through a customer satisfaction survey by researchers at the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
Evaluatie gebeurt onafhankelijk van LegalGuard door middel van een klanttevredenheidsonderzoek door de onderzoekers bij de Raad voor Rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over een zwartboek waaruit blijkt dat verzekeraars letselschadezaken niet altijd goed afhandelen

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked about a Radar black book showing insurers do not always handle personal injury claims properly under the GBL code, and proposed statutory deadlines, sanctions, an independent tribunal and easier court access. The minister said a University of Utrecht study is under way, that the Tuchtraad already exists, that deelgeschillen procedures are available, and that responsibility is shared between two ministries, promising to decide on measures after the study results.
Based on the outcomes of the University of Utrecht study, I will engage with the various stakeholders involved.
Aan de hand van de uitkomsten van voornoemd onderzoek van de Universiteit Utrecht zal ik in gesprek gaan met de verschillende betrokken stakeholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het werkbezoek van de minister in België bij vrederechters

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection to report on findings from his working visit to a Belgian justice of the peace and what lessons he would apply in the Netherlands, and on what timeline. The minister described the visit and its discussions, said the Belgian model's features (low-threshold access, solution-oriented approach, referral) are being tested in Dutch district court pilots, and promised to send a WODC/Utrecht study on applicability to the Chamber before summer and to take stock with the judiciary after evaluating pilots.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over misstanden in woonzorginstellingen en gebrek aan toezicht hierop

MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked about drug use, weapons incidents and unreported problems at residential care facilities for forensic clients, and about inspection gaps and the award of contracts to small providers. The State Secretary largely rejected a systemic problem, said inspections and municipalities had acted adequately, and promised a letter on the forensic residential care supply and supervision structure.
The picture painted in the Omroep Gelderland articles is not a pretty one.
Het beeld dat geschetst wordt in de artikelen van Omroep Gelderland is geen fraai beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de blog ‘Een minister voor Rechtsbescherming is meer dan ooit nodig’

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection to respond to a blog arguing that legal aid costs in four criminal cases are high because the government prolongs proceedings, and to comment on the author's claims about lawyers and perverse incentives. The minister says he will not discuss the individual cases, stresses that prosecutors and courts weigh efficiency against rights, and states that the legal aid system contains an incentive to litigate that a renewed system is being designed to fix.
I will not go into the individual examples.
Op de individuele voorbeelden zal ik niet in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het Openbaar Ministerie de mogelijkheid zou willen om vaker met criminelen deals en afspraken te maken in grote strafzaken

An SP MP asked whether the government supports the Public Prosecution Service's idea of more plea and sentence agreements with suspects in serious cases, and objected to lower sentences for serious criminals, risks of wrongful confessions, reduced public visibility and victims' rights. The Minister says he is in principle positive about exploring such agreements under a clear statutory framework, while guarding sentence severity, victims' position and a full public trial for serious cases.
I therefore in principle welcome further exploring the possibility of process and sentence agreements, based on further input from the Public Prosecution Service.
Ik sta dan ook in beginsel positief tegenover het verder verkennen van de mogelijkheid van proces- en vonnisafspraken, aan de hand van nadere inbreng van het OM.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Bergkamp en Buitenweg over het kweken van wiet als medicijn

MPs Van Nispen, Bergkamp and Buitenweg asked why home cultivation of medicinal cannabis should remain illegal for patients who cannot get adequate relief from the five pharmacy-available varieties, and about the Tilburg case and the court ruling in Jeffrey's favour. The minister answered that the five varieties largely meet need, that home-grown cannabis cannot guarantee consistent quality and dosage, that the appeal against the ruling prevents comment, and that no talks with Tilburg are planned.
An urgent appeal has been lodged against this ruling. I therefore cannot respond to it.
Tegen deze uitspraak is spoedappèl ingesteld. Ik kan hier derhalve geen reactie op geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet goed aansluiten van strafmaxima bij delicten omtrent het nalaten van hulpverlening bij levensgevaar

The MP asks whether the penalties for failing to render aid in mortal danger (art. 450 Sr, an overtreding carrying at most three months' detention) fit with the penalty for death by negligence (art. 307 Sr), following the death of a Rotterdam teenager. The Minister answers that the current system is logical and consistent, that the aid duty is a moral-to-legal duty with a lighter sanction because intent need not be proven, and sees no reason for legislative change.
I therefore see no reason to initiate a legislative amendment on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om op dit punt een wetswijziging te initiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over 'het verhaal van Lisa’ en het bericht dat de afhandeling van een artikel 12-zaak niet juist zou zijn geweest

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a radio/investigative report on a child sexual abuse case handled via an article 12 complaint procedure, including a judge's alleged personal acquaintance with an involved party and whether the victim was heard. The Minister declined to judge individual cases, stated the prosecution's decisions were based on evidence, and said the system has adequate safeguards and that any new facts should be pursued through criminal law routes.
It does not befit me as Minister to judge in concrete cases the handling of the case, the course of the procedure, the judge's ruling, or the judges who handled the case.

Het past mij als Minister niet om in concrete gevallen te oordelen over de behandeling van de zaak, het verloop van de procedure, de uitspraak van de rechter, of over de rechters die de zaak hebben behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de eindeloze strijd voor een schadevergoeding via de rechtsbijstandsverzekering

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a 60-year-old woman still awaiting damages via her legal expenses insurer after five and a half years, and about insurer conduct and the role of insurers in the new legal aid system. The minister declined to judge individual disputes, pointed to the complaints routes (Kifid, Tuchtraad), said the Letselschade Raad is studying causes of long-running injury claims, and said insurers' role in the new legal aid system is still being explored.
As Minister, I do not assess individual disputes between insured persons and insurers.
Als Minister treed ik niet in de beoordeling van individuele geschillen tussen verzekerden en verzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het vergoeden van schade na fouten door het Openbaar Ministerie

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister why a Berkel entrepreneur, whose seized equipment and administration were allegedly lost through Public Prosecution Service errors, has not received compensation, and about the court fee hardship clause. Minister Grapperhaus refused to comment on the specific case pending before the appeal court, pointed to the district court's 2 May 2018 ruling that the State had not been shown to have caused the damage, and explained that the hardship clause in the Dutch civil procedure code is available for the courts to apply case by case.
Since the case you ask about is still pending before the Court of Appeal in The Hague, a restrained answer to your questions is appropriate.
Nu de zaak waar u naar vraagt nog aanhangig is bij het gerechtshof Den Haag, past een terughoudende beantwoording van uw vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rol van verzekeraars, Achmea in het bijzonder, bij het proces tot stelselherziening rechtsbijstand en de invloed op het ministerie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about insurers, especially Achmea, and their growing role in the legal aid system reform and their influence on the ministry, including a pilot with LegalGuard and the minister's earlier promotional video for Achmea. The minister replies that the pilot was initiated by the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that ministry officials had no involvement in choosing LegalGuard, that insurers are consulted as one of many parties, and that no decision on the new system has been taken yet.
In choosing LegalGuard (an Achmea initiative) as service provider for this pilot, neither I nor my officials had any involvement.
Bij de keuze voor LegalGuard (initiatief van Achmea) als dienstverlener in het kader van deze pilot hebben noch ikzelf noch mijn ambtenaren enige betrokkenheid gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Beckerman over de positie van de civiele rechter bij de mijnbouwschade in Groningen en de toegang tot het recht

MPs Van Nispen and Beckerman asked whether the draft bill moving earthquake damage claims from civil courts to administrative law (Instituut Mijnbouwschade) weakens Groningen residents' access to justice, and what is being done to make civil justice more accessible. Minister Wiebes replied that the bill is still with the Raad van State for advice, that administrative appeal is low-threshold, that the TCMG and a 200,000 euro fund for test cases are in place, and that the civil justice reform programme and an experiment law are planned.

The bill establishing the Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen is currently with the Council of State's Advisory Division for advice. For this reason I cannot anticipate discussions touching on the content of the bill.

Het wetsvoorstel Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen ligt op dit moment voor advies voor aan de Afdeling Advisering van de Raad van State. Om die reden kan ik nu niet vooruitlopen op discussies die aan de inhoud van het wetsvoorstel raken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat notarissen jarenlang Kadastergeld in eigen zak staken

MP Van Nispen asked whether notaries overcharged clients for Kadaster fees and why this went unnoticed, and questioned a disciplinary panel that found fraud but imposed no sanction. Minister Dekker answered that the notarial profession's oversight bodies found no evidence of a structural problem, that the disciplinary judge found the billing non-transparent but imposed no sanction given the circumstances, and that the professional body urged notaries to compensate clients.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over nieuwe misstanden in het Gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about new reports of misconduct and mould at the Scheveningen prison hospital (JCvSZ), including inspection frequency, complaint handling and whether enhanced oversight is needed. The minister replied that the inspectorate (IGJ) found no shortcomings requiring immediate intervention, that inspections are announced for security reasons but include unannounced elements, that the situation is not acceptable where mould exists but is being addressed, and that intensified oversight is not currently warranted, with continued routine monitoring.
The IGJ itself determines, on the basis of its findings, what the right steps are from the supervisory perspective.
De IGJ bepaalt zelf aan de hand van haar bevindingen wat de juiste stappen zijn vanuit het toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Feest in de bajes'

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection how detainees could film and party with mobile phones in PI Heerhugowaard, whether sanctions were imposed, whether staffing and camera coverage were adequate, and whether prison staff remain in control. The minister answered that the phones were contraband, sanctions were applied, staffing norms and inspections are in place, an investigation is ongoing, and staff remain in control though a stronger security awareness is needed.
An investigation is currently being carried out into how the contraband was brought into PI Heerhugowaard and how this can be prevented in future.
Er wordt op dit moment onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de manier waarop de contrabande in de PI Heerhugowaard is ingevoerd en hoe dit in de toekomst kan worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de harde kritiek vanuit de rechtspraak op het beleid waardoor het vertrouwen in en het gezag van de rechtspraak ondermijnd wordt

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to sharp criticism from the Hague district court president that government policy undermines judicial trust and authority, and whether she is troubled by it. The minister acknowledges judiciary financial and workload problems, rejects the claim that policy deliberately pushes citizens away from courts, denies the criticism's examples (criminal penalty orders, e-court, court fees) are valid, and points to strong judicial independence in the Netherlands.
I am committed to, and will continue to work toward, preserving the prominent and independent position that the judiciary holds in our constitutional state.
Ik maak me sterk en blijf dat doen voor het behoud van de prominente en onafhankelijke positie die de rechtspraak in onze rechtsstaat inneemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook tieners betaalde om hen te kunnen bespioneren

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Dutch youths used Facebook Research's paid data app, whether it is desirable and lawful under the GDPR for minors to be paid to share all their data, and whether the Dutch DPA knew of it and has enough capacity to supervise. The minister answers that the app targeted only the US and India, so the GDPR likely did not apply, that consent from minors under 16 requires parental authorisation, and that complaints about Facebook fall to the Irish lead supervisor while Dutch citizens can complain to the AP.

I do not consider it desirable that Facebook asks people for all their data in return for payment, because it is impossible to foresee what possibilities this data provision offers or which combinations of data can be made.

Ik vind het niet wenselijk dat Facebook mensen tegen betaling om al hun gegevens vraagt, omdat niet is te overzien wat de mogelijkheden zijn die deze dataverstrekking biedt of welke combinaties van data er kunnen worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Omtzigt over de teveel betaalde belasting over de SBF-verlofuitkering door oud-gevangenispersoneel

MPs Van Nispen and Omtzigt asked about excess payroll tax and health insurance premiums withheld from former prison staff receiving SBF leave benefits, and why refunds were limited to 104 weeks and to post-2013 cases. The state secretary answered that the 2013 statutory change has no retroactive effect, refunds were paid in December 2018 for the 104-week period, and the Tax Administration cannot deviate from this.
The statutory amendment has no retroactive effect for the first cohorts.
De wetswijziging kent geen terugwerkende kracht voor de eerste lichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat ex-gedetineerden nog steeds niet tot nauwelijks verzekeringen kunnen afsluiten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether ex-prisoners are still refused insurance even for unrelated products, whether the promised talks with insurers improved matters, and whether the criminal-record disclosure rule in the Civil Code should be narrowed. The minister answered that insurers assess individual risk, that the Association of Insurers reports few complaints, that the statutory framework should not be changed, and that the Vereende insurer serves high-risk applicants at higher premiums.
Amending the law is not something I consider opportune.
Aanpassing van de wet acht ik niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de inspanningen van de Nederlandse Overheid om misstanden bij sektes tegen te gaan en het voortbestaan van Sektesignaal

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether the government will take additional measures against abuses in sects, including whether to keep the Sektesignaal reporting service after 2019. The Minister replies that the existing legal framework is adequate, rejects stricter laws and a new study, and ends Sektesignaal's funding, pointing to an online referral function instead.
I consider this set of instruments appropriate and adequate and therefore see no reason to tighten the legislation or intensify policy on abuses in sects.
Ik beschouw dit instrumentarium als passend en toereikend en zie daarom geen reden om de wetgeving aan te scherpen of het beleid inzake misstanden bij sekten te intensiveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat een in Nederland veroordeelde pedofiel kon emigreren naar Kenia en zich daar jarenlang kon vergrijpen aan minderjarige meisjes

The SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice and Security how a convicted child abuser could emigrate to Kenya and abuse girls there for years, and what can prevent such travel. The minister answered that existing legal options are sufficient, that agencies will be reminded to use them, that Interpol Green Notice use is being explored, and that a letter on travel restrictions was sent.
I am of the view that there are sufficient legal possibilities to restrict the travel behaviour of convicted child abusers.
Ik ben van mening dat er voldoende juridische mogelijkheden zijn om het reisgedrag van veroordeelden van kindermisbruik te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aartsen en Van Nispen over het bericht dat slechte arbeidsomstandigheden en uitbuiting bij nagelsalons geen prioriteit hebben bij de Inspectie SZW

MPs Aartsen and Van Nispen asked why the Inspectorate SZW does not prioritise exploitation, illegal employment and underpayment in nail salons despite its stated priorities and warnings from the National Rapporteur on Human Trafficking and the Public Prosecution Service. The government replied that the Inspectorate runs a risk-based programme covering the wellness sector including nail studios, that 29 salons were inspected with violations found in half, that enforcement and signals receive continued attention, and that cooperation with police and partners exists, though exploitation is hard to detect.
Within this programme there is indeed attention for the wellness sector, and within it for nail studios.
Binnen dit programma is er wel degelijk aandacht voor de wellnessbranche, en daarbinnen voor nagelstudio's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het pas na een artikel-12 procedure verstrekken van een kopie van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why next-of-kin can only obtain a copy of a criminal investigation file after starting an article 12 complaint procedure, and whether this fits the motion calling for wider access with respect for privacy. The Minister explained three access routes, said the Public Prosecution Service now applies the revised guidelines more generously while protecting third-party privacy, and agreed to discuss the matter with the OM.
It is therefore not necessary for next-of-kin to start an article 12 complaint procedure in order to enforce access to the investigation file.
Het is dus niet nodig dat nabestaanden een artikel 12 klachtprocedure starten om toegang tot het onderzoeksdossier af te dwingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over incassobonussen van deurwaarders voor grote klanten

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about bonus arrangements between bailiffs and large creditors such as insurers and energy companies, and whether these threaten bailiff independence. The minister acknowledges the risk, notes the financial supervisor BFT is investigating, points to a forthcoming KBvG regulation limiting tariff models and the Oskam committee report, and describes the CJIB's upcoming tender and the Rijksincassovisie.
This earnings model may pose a risk to the independence of the bailiff.
Dit verdienmodel is mogelijk een risico voor de onafhankelijkheid van de gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over praktijkproblemen en rechtsbescherming bij de uitvoering van een Europees onderzoeksbevel

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about legal protection when property is seized under a European Investigation Order, including notification of the appeal deadline, confidentiality, public hearings and whether courts meet the 30-day decision deadline. The minister replied that notification practice is adequate, confidentiality is compatible with mutual recognition, a technical amendment on cassation will be added via a nota van wijziging, and no structural problem with the 30-day deadline is evident.

Why did the legislation implementing the directive choose to provide in Article 5.4.10(3) Sv that only the first and third paragraphs of Article 552d Sv apply, but not the second paragraph, which provides for cassation within fourteen days?

Vraag 7 Waarom is er in de wetgeving bij de implementatie van de richtlijn voor gekozen in artikel 5.4.10, derde lid, Wetboek van Strafvordering (Sv) op te nemen dat slechts het eerste en het derde lid van artikel 552d Sv van toepassing zijn, maar niet ook het tweede lid, waarin de mogelijkheid van cassatie binnen veertien dagen is opgenomen?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het sluiten van een contract voor een pilot met rechtshulppakketten

The SP MP Van Nispen asked whether a first contract for a legal aid package pilot had been signed, including with an insurer subsidiary for 1200 social security cases, and why parliament and current legal aid providers were not informed or consulted. The minister referred to a letter of 6 February 2019 and answered yes to the request for answers before the debate.
For the answer to these questions I refer to my letter dated 6 February 2019 on the legal aid pilot.
Voor het antwoord op deze vragen verwijs ik naar mijn brief d.d. 6 februari 2019 over de pilot rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Het rommelt in de straffabrieken van het OM’

Opposition MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about a NRC report that the Public Prosecution Service (OM) imposed penalties in ways that were not properly justified, including penalty orders issued without adequate proof of guilt, missing case files, high reversal rates, and backlogs leading to mass dismissals. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the cited figures came from an internal quality check that does not show improper guilt findings, acknowledges incomplete internal registration identified in 2014 and improved since, but declines a new independent inquiry and any halt to penalty orders.
I fully endorse the improvements and measures taken by the OM.
Ik onderschrijf de verbeteringen en genomen maatregelen door het OM volledig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een dreigende schikking tussen het Nederlandse openbaar ministerie en Shell vanwege haar handelen in Nigeria

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether the Public Prosecution Service is working toward a settlement with Shell over its conduct in Nigeria, whether settlements should require admission of guilt and prosecution of managers, whether Shell's size and royal title play a role, and for an update on a motion on prosecuting executives in high settlements. The minister answered that a transaction does not imply admission of guilt in criminal law, that the prosecution service expects responsibility-taking by the company, that size and royal title are irrelevant, and that the policy guideline will be revised to include prosecution of managers where possible.
It does not befit me to say that managers should be convicted where there is evidence of personal involvement.
Het past mij niet om te zeggen dat bij bewijs van persoonlijke betrokkenheid managers veroordeeld moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijk negatieve effecten van de e-privacyrichtlijn op het werk van het Expertise Centrum Online Kindermisbruik

MP Van Nispen asked whether the ePrivacy Directive would prevent the EOKM and private parties from scanning uploads for child sexual abuse material without user consent, and whether the EOKM could keep using its hash database. The State Secretary answered that uploads are not preventively scanned, that ePrivacy rules stop applying once content reaches the host's server so hash-based removal remains possible, and that national exceptions for crime prevention may be explored.
Regarding the approach to child pornographic content, I am considering together with the Minister of Justice and Security to explore this option if the number of reports does not decline.
Voor wat betreft de aanpak van kinderpornografische inhoud overweeg ik samen met de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid deze optie te verkennen wanneer het aantal meldingen niet daalt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de bruikbaarheid van de cijfers van het World Justice Project bij het vergelijken van rechtsstelsels

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice ministers how the World Justice Project Rule of Law Index is compiled, who funds and conducts the Dutch survey, how representative it is, and whether it justifies firm comparative conclusions. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the index is one of several indicators, that YouGov conducts the Dutch survey of about a thousand respondents in three cities, that the ministry does not fund it, and that the index is sufficiently reliable alongside other studies.
The World Justice Project is funded by, among others, foundations, governments, companies, individuals and national Bars of Lawyers.
Het World Justice Project wordt gefinancierd door onder andere stichtingen, overheden, bedrijven, individuen en nationale Ordes van Advocaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het gebrek aan landelijke regels voor zwemlessen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Medical Care why there are few national rules for swimming lessons (instruction, group size, diplomas, supervision) and whether the government will regulate them. The minister answered that safety is primarily self-regulated by the swimming industry under existing rules, that group size is left to providers, and that a role for government will be considered after a national swimming safety plan is delivered in autumn.
That is why I consider it important that swimming lesson providers are adequately equipped for this task and that children become familiar with swimming water and continuously improve their skills.
Daarom vind ik het van belang dat zwemlesaanbieders adequaat toegerust zijn voor deze taak en dat kinderen vertrouwd raken met zwemwater en hun vaardigheden continu verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over eerdere signalen van misstanden bij interlandelijke adoptie

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection what signals the ministry received about misconduct in past intercountry adoptions and the Dutch state's role, why it took FOI requests to uncover involvement, and what this means for support to adoptees searching for origins. The minister reports various signals from five countries, admits earlier signals were not investigated in depth, announces an independent external commission, and promises to share information and develop a support plan with organisations.
That information is grounds for me to set up an external commission that will conduct independent research into intercountry adoptions that took place in the past.
Die informatie is voor mij aanleiding om een externe commissie in te stellen die onafhankelijk onderzoek gaat uitvoeren naar interlandelijke adopties die in het verleden hebben plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over deals met kroongetuigen waarbij zij crimineel geld mogen houden

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how often deals with crown witnesses have allowed criminals to keep or reduce the proceeds of crime, what the costs are, and whether this is still justified. The minister answered that ten witness commitments were made from 2006 to 2018, that at most half of the confiscation claim was waived in one case, that the 2006 policy has been kept, and that he sees no reason to reconsider it.

I consider the arguments the then Minister of Justice set out in his letter of 12 April 2005 to support extending permissible commitments to reducing the confiscation claim for unlawfully obtained benefit still valid today.

Ik acht de argumenten die de toenmalige Minister van Justitie in zijn brief van 12 april 2005 uiteen heeft gezet ter onderbouwing van de uitbreiding van toelaatbare toezeggingen met de mogelijkheid tot het doen van de toezegging tot het verminderen van de vordering tot ontneming van wederrechtelijk verkregen voordeel, ook nu nog valide.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onrechtmatig handelen door een voormalig rechter en de Raad voor de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Supreme Court rulings that a former judge and the Raad voor de rechtspraak acted unlawfully toward a lawyer, and about why the Council paid the procedural costs and whether those costs will be recovered. The Minister confirmed the rulings, said the Council bears costs only in exceptional cases, declined to detail the settlement or recovery given ongoing negotiations, and gave no concrete general safeguards beyond expecting the Council to have learned lessons.
In the interest of this procedure, I cannot go into this further.
In het belang van deze procedure kan ik hier niet verder op ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het witwassen van miljarden euro’s door criminelen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers about estimates that some 16 billion euros is laundered yearly in the Netherlands, and whether banks can keep criminal money out, including the ING Curaçao transactions. The minister acknowledged the scale, pointed to DNB's supervision and deficiencies at banks, listed ongoing anti-money-laundering legislation and EU initiatives, and promised an integral policy response in Q1 2019.
It has already been promised to the House that an integral policy response will be sent in the first quarter of 2019.
Aan uw Kamer is reeds toegezegd dat een integrale beleidsreactie in het eerste kwartaal van 2019 zal worden toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het eenvoudig uitgeven van zwart geld in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Finance and Justice ministers about the ease of spending black money in the Netherlands after an undercover broadcast showed many shopkeepers accepting suspicious cash, and asked about FIU outreach, sector supervision and the chance of SME audits. The government answered that kitchen and bathroom sellers only came under Wwft supervision recently, outlined risk-based supervision and an integral policy response due in early 2019, and declined to give a percentage chance that an SME is audited.
The Wwft Supervision Bureau will pay attention to this.
Het Bureau Toezicht Wwft zal hier aandacht voor houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that the father of an abducted child had to pay maintenance, and whether the LBIO verifies foreign maintenance requests before enforcing them. The Minister answered that the LBIO will now include the paying parent's objections in court requests, check with the Dutch central authority for child abduction cases (subject to privacy limits), and develop a policy on refusing requests within the limited discretion the treaties allow, while stating that Ukraine's accession to the Hague Child Abduction Convention does not directly change the LBIO's assessment framework.
The LBIO has changed its working method in cases falling under the Hague Conventions of 1973 or 2007 or the New York Convention.
Het LBIO heeft de werkwijze veranderd in zaken die vallen onder de Haagse verdragen uit 1973 of 2007 of het Verdrag van New York.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over structurele problemen bij het CAK

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink (SP) asked the Minister of Health about a 93-year-old woman who received a 27,000 euro bill from CAK due to an administrative error, whether the minister would plead for debt forgiveness, and about CAK's practices, website information and communication. The minister answered that CAK will contact the woman to find a solution, that naheffing periods will be shortened to twelve months and CAK given more room for tailored solutions, that CAK must set contributions immediately after receiving data, that website improvements are ongoing, and that CAK will be asked to communicate personally with clients.

In addition, I want to examine together with CAK how, in cases like this where a client suffers such serious harm due to an error on CAK's side, the period for the back-charge can be considerably shortened.

Daarnaast wil ik samen met het CAK bekijken hoe in dit soort gevallen, waarbij een cliënt zo erg nadeel ondervindt door een fout aan de kant van het CAK, de termijn voor de naheffing aanzienlijk verkort kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het niet gebruiken van de digitale meldplicht rondom voetbalwedstrijden

Senator-level MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice minister why the digital reporting obligation (digitale meldplicht) for football banned persons is apparently not used, and what the status is of the promised person-focused approach and mandatory linking of reporting duties to stadium bans. Minister Grapperhaus answered that the tool has been used little, the OM knows of no cases since 2016 because no serious incidents justified it, and he will raise its use and technological options in a later evaluation and in a spring 2019 update.

At an evaluation, at a time yet to be determined, of the statutory measures against football hooliganism, I will ask for attention to the use of the digital reporting obligation and the reasons for whether or not it is applied.

Ik zal bij een evaluatie, op een nog nader te bepalen moment, van de wettelijke maatregelen ter bestrijding van voetbalvandalisme aandacht vragen voor de toepassing van de maatregel digitale meldplicht
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de gevarentoelage voor gevangenispersoneel mogelijk wordt afgeschaft

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection whether the hazard allowance for prison staff in the EBI, Terrorist and BPG wings is at risk, why cuts are considered, and how this fits with a TNO finding that the work remains heavy. The Minister says DJI is examining ways to reduce the burden, that there is no need to cut pay, and that results and the allowance will be reviewed at the end of 2019.
There is no need to cut the pay of staff in the EBI, TA and BPG wings.
Er is geen noodzaak om te bezuinigen op het loon van personeel van de EBI, de TA en de BPG-afdelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat bezorgde rechters de noodklok luiden over de financiering van de rechtspraak en de te hoge werkdruk

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about judges' open letter warning of underfunding, excessive workload and quality pressures in the judiciary. The minister acknowledged the concerns, rejected claims of shifted financial burdens and expanded Raad power, and pointed to ongoing talks on funding and workload studies without committing to new measures.
I take the concerns seriously and am discussing them with the Council for the Judiciary.
Ik neem de zorgen serieus en spreek daarover met de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onduidelijkheid over de verdeling van het geld voor de strafrechtketen

MP Van Nispen asks why the Justice Minister did not inform parliament in time before the 2019 budget debate about how the coalition-agreement funds for criminal justice chain capacity are divided, and why the 2018 split and multi-year figures are unclear. Minister Grapperhaus answers that the funds are released only after approved spending plans, that a plan for 2018 is approved (2.3m to prosecution, 1.3m judiciary, 0.8m NFI, 0.6m legislative capacity), and that the 2019 and later plan was only recently approved and will be added by amendment, while declining to provide a full cross-chain overview of past cuts.

Yes. As discussed and promised during the General Consultation on criminal law matters on 8 November and the General Consultation on organised crime on 14 November, I hereby inform you, before the budget debate, of the precise distribution of these funds for 2018 and the process toward a distribution for 2019 and later.

Ja. Zoals besproken en toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg strafrechtelijke onderwerpen op 8 november jongstleden en het AO georganiseerde criminaliteit op 14 november jongstleden heb ik u hierbij nog vóór de begrotingsbehandelingnader geïnformeerd over de precieze verdeling van deze middelen over het jaar 2018 en het proces om te komen tot een verdeling voor 2019 en later.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de reactie van de klokkenluider op het onderzoek naar beïnvloeding van WODC-onderzoeken

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister how to respond to whistleblower Van Ooyen's criticism of the Overgaauw commission's findings on alleged influence over WODC drug reports, and what will be done so whistleblowers are protected. Minister Grapperhaus defended the commission's conclusion that the reports were reliable, said confidential interview records are not available to him, and announced a standing integrity committee and independent reporting point for misconduct reports.
This permanent JenV integrity committee will consist of independent experts who will receive and investigate reports of suspected misconduct and non-integrity conduct by managers.

Deze vaste integriteitscommissie JenV zal gaan bestaan uit onafhankelijke deskundigen die meldingen van een vermoeden van een misstand en niet integere gedragingen van managers in behandeling neemt en onderzoekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over chaotische toestanden bij gevangenissen vanwege de op handen zijnde sluiting van vier inrichtingen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about chaos in prisons caused by the planned closure of four institutions, including staff and inmate transfers, safety equipment, working conditions and contraband in Zaanstad. The minister denied chaos, described a six-month phased transition plan with monitoring, and promised additional searches and reviews in Zaanstad.
The relocation of staff and detainees from the four locations to be closed, namely Almere, Zwaag, Zeist and Zoetermeer, is being carried out very carefully.
Het verplaatsen van de medewerkers en de gedetineerden uit de vier te sluiten locaties, te weten Almere, Zwaag, Zeist en Zoetermeer gebeurt zeer zorgvuldig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de politieverhoren en een mogelijke gerechtelijke dwaling in de Arnhemse Villamoord

An SP MP asked the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about police interrogation practices and possible miscarriage of justice in the Arnhem Villamoord case, including whether the novum-based review regime and interrogation rules need changing. The minister declined to judge the case pending the procurator-general's inquiry, pointed to ongoing professionalisation of interrogations and an upcoming evaluation and WODC monitor, and promised policy responses to the House.
It is still too early to conclude that this is the case here.
Het is nog te vroeg om de conclusie te trekken dat daarvan in deze zaak sprake is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht een voortvluchtige Amerikaanse verdachte

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how a US fugitive suspected of sexual offences against minors could live and work in the Netherlands undisturbed, and what legal options remain. The minister answered that extradition was refused because the offences were already time-barred under Dutch law, that current law no longer allows such limitation for these offences, and that the Americans may use international alerts instead.
Furthermore, I cannot make substantive statements about this individual case.
Verder kan ik geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Alkaya en Van Nispen over eerdere witwaspraktijken van ING

MPs Alkaya and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about ING's earlier money-laundering practices, the settlement with the Public Prosecution Service, whether natural persons were shielded from prosecution, and the minister's role given former ING counsel Grapperhaus. The minister answered that the Dutch prosecutor was not involved in the 2012 US settlement, that no agreement shielded individuals and prosecution remains possible if new facts emerge, and that the transaction was approved by the minister after the Justice minister recused himself.
It does not befit me to comment on any integrity violations that may have come to light in another investigation, not conducted by the Dutch Public Prosecution Service.
Het past mij niet om mij uit te laten over eventuele integriteitschendingen die in het kader van een ander onderzoek, dat niet is verricht door het Nederlandse OM, aan het licht zouden zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht over het verspreiden van een filmpje over een commerciële verzekeraar

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether a promotional-looking video of her visit to a commercial legal-aid insurer (Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand) amounted to advertising, who conceived it, and whether it complied with the handbook for ministers on commercial activities. The minister answered that the visit was part of many fact-finding visits, the video was made by her communications directorate, further such visits and videos will be shared, and the handbook guidance was fully followed.
In my view these guidelines were fully complied with in shaping my working visit to Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand.
In mijn beleving zijn deze richtsnoeren volledig nageleefd bij de vormgeving van mijn werkbezoek aan de Stichting Achmea Rechtsbijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Buitenweg en Groothuizen inzake het bericht ‘Het sluiten van woningen op grond van de Wet Damocles’

MPs Van Nispen, Buitenweg and Groothuizen asked the Justice Minister about closures of homes under article 13b of the Opium Act after a case where a tenant was evicted for 14 grams of cannabis. The minister said closure data are not centrally held, cited a study finding courts upheld appeals in 30% of published cases, noted a monitoring motion, and stated that closure is a measure to end violations rather than a punishment.
It is for the court to assess whether the mayor could reasonably use his closure power and, if so, whether the way the power was applied is proportionate.

Het is aan de rechter om te beoordelen of de burgemeester in redelijkheid van zijn sluitingsbevoegdheid gebruik heeft kunnen maken en, zo ja, of de wijze waarop de bevoegdheid is toegepast evenredig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over vrijwilligerswerk met gedetineerden en ex-gedetineerden

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the new subsidy system for volunteer work with detainees and ex-detainees, and about administrative burden raised by BONJO. The minister acknowledged the value of volunteer work, admitted possible extra administrative burden during transition, and committed to an implementation manager, an advisory committee and an evaluation of the new system.
I aim to keep these burdens to a minimum.
Ik streef ernaar deze lasten tot een minimum te beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Alkaya over het bericht dat Facebook telefoonnummers gebruikt voor advertentiedoeleinden

MPs Van Nispen and Alkaya asked whether Facebook uses phone numbers given for account security for advertising, whether this is lawful under the GDPR, and whether non-users can be targeted via uploaded contact data. The minister said he lacks data, that the Dutch Data Protection Authority decides whether to investigate and that Ireland's authority may be the lead regulator, and that using security-provided data for advertising without consent is not permitted under the GDPR.
It is up to the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP), as independent supervisor, to possibly investigate and make a judgment on the lawfulness of Facebook's conduct.
Het is aan de Autoriteit persoonsgegevens (AP) om als onafhankelijke toezichthouder eventueel onderzoek te doen en een oordeel te vellen over de rechtmatigheid van het handelen van Facebook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat advocaten Dekker ‘klassenjustitie’ verwijt

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers' accusations of class justice over planned reforms to subsidised legal aid, and about the claim that the government ignores the legal-aid target group. The minister says the reform proposal is being finalised, describes the Wrb user population from the 2016 monitor, and acknowledges that the government is the opposing party in most subsidised cases and commits to preventing unnecessary government litigation.
I believe the government should set a good example and therefore wants to focus on preventing unnecessary proceedings and juridification within government.
Ik vind dat de overheid het goede voorbeeld moet geven en wil daarom inzetten op het voorkomen van onnodige procedures en juridisering bij de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vertrouwensbreuk van organisatie PrisonLaw met het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken en het beëindigen van de subsidierelatie

An MP from the SP asked the Foreign Minister about the breakdown of trust with PrisonLAW, which ended its subsidy relationship, including alleged pressure to retract media statements, the confidentiality of an internal complaint investigation, and how legal aid for detained Dutch nationals abroad will be provided. The minister denied undermining PrisonLAW's independence, described contact as constructive, stated that the investigation is confidential for privacy reasons, and said a temporary solution will be arranged until 31 December 2019 with a new subsidy framework from 2020.
Due to the legal requirements for personal data protection, the investigation and handling of the complaint are confidential.
Vanwege de wettelijke eisen die worden gesteld aan persoonsgegevensbescherming zijn het onderzoek en de afhandeling van de klacht vertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het OM te vaak boetes uitdeelt

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister how he would respond to research suggesting the public prosecution service issues too many fines and that judges worry about truth-finding, and whether rights protection and dialogue with the Council for the Judiciary would be pursued. Minister Grapperhaus answered that neither the Procurator-General's supervision nor the evaluation of the OM-settlement law shows a shortfall in truth-finding, attributed the decline in criminal cases heard by judges to crime trends and other factors, and said talks with the OM and Council for the Judiciary are planned with the wider government response due in autumn.
Neither this supervision nor the evaluation research shows that truth-finding is lacking in out-of-court settlement by the public prosecutor.
Uit dit toezicht noch uit het evaluatieonderzoek blijkt dat het bij de buitengerechtelijke afdoening door de officier van justitie schort aan de waarheidsvinding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrief van rechters en officieren van Justitie

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to the NVvR letter warning that the judiciary is under strain, including staff shortages, overload, ICT problems, budget uncertainty and reserve depletion, and whether the planned review of judicial operations will protect quality.
