The minister acknowledges the concerns, points to funding increases, ongoing digitalisation resets, governance measures and a review, but answers mostly by restating existing policy and deferring to the Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Following the evaluation of the Judicial Map Revision Act and the digitalisation problems, I have indicated that the judiciary faces financial and governance problems.

Ik heb naar aanleiding van de evaluatie van de Wet herziening gerechtelijke kaart (HGK) en de problemen rond de digitalisering aangegeven dat de rechtspraak kampt met financiële en governance problemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verspreiden van een filmpje over een commerciële verzekeraar

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why she had a film made of her visit to Achmea Rechtsbijstand, a commercial legal-aid insurer, and distributed it on Twitter, and whether she risked it looking like advertising for that insurer. The minister answered that the visits are a way to learn about practice and that sharing footage shows what the visits involve, denied the advertising risk, and said she visited many organisations including social-law firms.
By sharing footage I make clear what these working visits consist of.
Met het delen van beeldmateriaal maak ik inzichtelijk waaruit deze werkbezoeken bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een onderzoek van de Kinderombudsman naar vervangende jeugddetentie

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the Children's Ombudsman's report on substitute youth detention for unpaid damages orders, including how often it is imposed and whether minors can pay. The minister answered that substitute detention is applied in under 1% of cases, that judges should weigh each minor's ability to pay, and that a new, more person-oriented payment arrangement policy since 2017 allows instalment plans, with a broader letter on youth criminal law promised.
At present it is being examined how, after substitute detention has been applied, further collection of the damages measure can still be achieved, for both minors and adults.

Op dit moment wordt onderzocht op welke wijze na de toepassing van vervangende detentie de verdere inning van de schadevergoedingsmaatregel nog bewerkstelligd kan worden, zowel bij minder- als meerderjarigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over de volmacht en de Participatiewet

Two SP MPs asked whether a son holding a power of attorney for his incapacitated mother can lose his Participatiewet benefit merely by being deemed able to dispose of her assets, and what options exist to prevent this. The Secretary of State replied that a power of attorney does not affect benefit entitlement if the funds are used solely for the principal, that the benefit must be stopped only if the duty to disclose is breached, and that municipalities have been informed via a Gemeentenieuws notice.
A power of attorney and being reasonably able to dispose of funds has no effect on the right to benefits, provided the funds are used exclusively for the benefit of the authorised person.
Een volmacht en het redelijkerwijs over middelen kunnen beschikken heeft geen invloed op het recht op bijstand, mits de middelen uitsluitend ten behoeve van de gemachtigde worden aangewend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat honderden advocaten de afgelopen jaren zijn gestopt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why hundreds of social lawyers have stopped, citing high workload and low fees, and asked whether the minister will provide a reasonable fee. The minister says the number of legal aid providers fell only 2% and is not alarming, and commits to reforming legal aid within existing budgets, starting with family law, while promising to inform parliament soon.
I feel the urgency to bring about changes in the short term.
Ik voel de urgentie om op korte termijn veranderingen tot stand te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat gevangenispersoneel alarm slaat over een plan om gevangenen veel meer zelf te laten regelen via tablets

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about staff concerns over a pilot giving prisoners self-service tablets (ZBJ), including fears of less human contact, unsafe situations, and the replacement of libraries. The minister answered that the pilot is in its test phase in three locations, staff and works councils were involved, the tablets are designed to increase human contact and coaching, and no physical library will be replaced during the pilot.
Thus the COR will take part in the pilot's steering committee.
Zo zal de COR deelnemen aan de begeleidingscommissie van de pilot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vele berichten dat kinderen en volwassenen verdrinken in de zomerperiode

An MP asked the Minister of Medical Care, with the Minister of Education, about drownings linked to weak swimming skills, falling swimming ability among children, and supervision of recreational water sites. The minister said the statistics show drownings are stable and largely in line with past years, pointed to the national swimming safety plan and the NL Zwemveilig project, and said provinces enforce supervision rules under the Whvbz, with no obligation for every recreational site to appoint supervisors.
I trust that this plan will adequately address the various aspects you mention.
Ik vertrouw erop dat dit plan voldoende in gaat op de diverse aspecten die u hiervoor noemt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Toenemende agressie tegen gevangenispersoneel’

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of rising aggression against prison staff, workload, and staffing norms in prisons. The minister acknowledged the reports, said staff stability and workload scores are unchanged, noted a fragile balance in staffing, and saw no need for additional measures given existing convenant-based investments.
In view of this, I currently see no need to take additional measures.
Gelet hierop zie ik op dit moment geen noodzaak aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked the Ministers of Justice and Finance about banks' strong legal position as secured creditors in insolvency, the disadvantage to other creditors, and whether the balance is still desirable. The Minister answered that the government will discuss the balance with insolvency practitioners within the ongoing faillissementsrecht reform, while defending the current pledge rules and noting that other creditors have their own protections.

Whether the above is still sufficient to keep the positions of the various parties in a bankruptcy in balance, I will discuss with practitioners within the reorganisation pillar of the bankruptcy law revision programme.

Of het voorgaande nog steeds voldoende is om de positie van de verschillende betrokkenen in een faillissement in evenwicht te houden, zal ik in het kader van het laatste wetsvoorstel in de reorganisatiepijler van het wetgevingsprogramma herijking faillissementsrecht bespreken met vertegenwoordigers uit de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op deurwaarders

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the four-person Bureau Financieel Toezicht can adequately supervise all bailiffs, and why investigations fell while bailiff offices under heightened supervision doubled. The minister replied that there is currently no enforcement shortfall, agreed to a 335,000 euro budget deficit for 2018, and will discuss funding for 2019 with the BFT and professional bodies in October.
I have agreed to a budget deficit for 2018 so that the BFT can carry out the proposed supervisory activities regarding bailiffs.
Ik heb ingestemd met een tekort op de begroting voor 2018 opdat het BFT uitvoering kan geven aan de voorgestelde toezichtactiviteiten ten aanzien van de gerechtsdeurwaarders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Buitenweg, Van Nispen en Kuiken over seksueel misbruik binnen de gemeenschap van Jehova’s Getuigen

Four MPs asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether at least five victims had filed reports of sexual abuse within the Jehovah's Witnesses, whether these reports warrant further investigation, how police and prosecutors handle them, whether Jehovah's Witnesses can invoke the clergy testimony privilege, and whether internal instructions to store abuse allegations in sealed envelopes comply with the GDPR. The minister confirmed the reports, said an ongoing criminal investigation prevents further comment, stated the prosecution has nationwide oversight, said the testimony privilege belongs to individuals not organisations and will be considered in the review of extending the reporting duty, and referred the GDPR question to the independent Data Protection Authority.
There is an ongoing criminal investigation, which may result in prosecution and trial.
Er is sprake van lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek, dat kan resulteren in vervolging en berechting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek naar de onveilige situatie van sekswerkers

MP Van Nispen asks the State Secretary for Justice and Security how he responds to research findings on the unsafe situation of sex workers and about the timing and effect of the revised prostitution regulation bill. The State Secretary condemns violence, promises to discuss the research findings with stakeholders and send a substantive reaction this autumn, and says the bill will be consulted after summer with the aim of enabling safe legal work.
I will discuss the findings and recommendations of the reports with the various stakeholders and on that basis examine whether additional measures are needed.
Ik zal de uitkomsten en aanbevelingen van de rapporten bespreken met de verschillende betrokken actoren en aan de hand daarvan bezien of er aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijk gebruik van Chroom-6 in de PI Ter Apel

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about possible Chromium-6 exposure from treated wood handled by staff and detainees at PI Ter Apel, including health complaints, reported internal risk assessments, and storage practices. The Minister answered that no Chromium-6 health complaints were known for Ter Apel, that the 2014 and 2016 risk assessments and a RIVM study will be pursued, and that suppliers were ordered to stop delivering chromium-treated wood.
I have therefore asked the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to examine whether, and if so how, more clarity can be provided on this.
Ik heb daarom het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) verzocht na te gaan of, en zo ja hoe, hier meer duidelijkheid over kan worden verschaft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verstrekken van een kopie van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden

An SP MP asked the Minister whether relatives of deceased persons still cannot obtain copies of criminal investigation files, and how the promised talks and motion on access were being followed up. The government replied that the Public Prosecution Service has amended its guidelines so relatives in principle get access to the file, with privacy weighed case by case, and that it will meet an experienced lawyer in August and report to parliament.
This means that under the amended Guidelines, relatives in principle always get access to the file.
Dit betekent dat op grond van de aangepaste Aanwijzingen nabestaanden in beginsel altijd inzage krijgen in het dossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onverenigbaarheid van het ambt van rechter en het Kamerlidmaatschap

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the judicial office should be declared incompatible with a seat in the Senate or House of Representatives, and whether other posts such as civil servant should also be incompatible with it. The minister said a position will be drafted with the Interior Minister and information sent to parliament after the summer recess, while stating that ancillary positions are generally considered a useful addition to the judicial office and existing guidelines suffice.
I have received the advice of the judiciary and am now preparing a position in consultation with the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Ik heb het advies van de rechtspraak ontvangen en bereid nu in overleg met de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties een standpunt voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er veiligheidsproblemen zouden zijn in de penitentiaire inrichting te Alphen aan de Rijn

SP MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of high sick leave and security problems at the Alphen aan den Rijn prison, including temporary staff use, delays in transferring convicted prisoners, medication errors and staffing. The minister acknowledged the signals, gave sick-leave and staffing figures, denied the medication-error allegation, and pointed to ongoing recruitment and measures to reduce absence.
I take the signals from staff seriously.
Ik neem de signalen van het personeel serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat FNV nu snel extra geld eist voor veiligheid cipiers

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about union demands for quick extra money for prison guard safety, the feeling of insecurity among guards due to understaffing, the status of the DJI convenant, tensions between permanent and temporary staff, and when improvements will be felt. The minister said recruitment is ongoing with 757 new executive staff hired, €100 million is earmarked for the convenant, and the convenant talks are continuing.
There are no financial obstacles to hiring the necessary prison security officers and penitentiary workers.
Er zijn geen financiële belemmeringen voor het aannemen van de benodigde inrichtingsbeveiligers en penitentiair inrichtingswerkers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er toch medische dossiers zoek zijn geweest in het gevangenisziekenhuis

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that medical records, specifically medication administration lists, were lost in a prison hospital and why earlier answers did not mention this. The minister acknowledged the omission, attributed the loss most likely to human error, and declined further investigation, noting the Inspectorate's routine oversight already covers record-keeping.
I see no reason to order additional investigation and I have confidence in the level of care provided at the JCvSZ.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om aanvullend onderzoek te laten doen en heb vertrouwen in het niveau van zorgverlening in het JCvSZ.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de vader van een ontvoerd kind alimentatie moet betalen

MPs Van Nispen, Van Oosten and Van Toorenburg asked whether the Dutch collection agency LBIO may enforce foreign alimony orders against a parent whose child was abducted abroad. The minister acknowledged the harshness, said the treaties offer limited grounds to refuse, and announced practical improvements such as LBIO summarising the left-behind parent's objections and checking for abduction cases in court requests.

As also promised during the General Consultation on Personal and Family Law on 16 May, I have engaged with the LBIO to examine how current practice can be improved, within the limited possibilities the treaties allow.

Zoals ook toegezegd tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Personen- en familierecht van 16 mei jongstleden ben ik met het LBIO in gesprek gegaan om te bekijken op welke wijze de huidige praktijk verbeterd kan worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over schuldenaars onder schrikbewind

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen (SP) asked about abuses by professional debt administrators (bewindvoerders), the lack of oversight, municipalities' ability to refer or assess them, liability for damages, and the market-law constraints on municipalities acting as administrators. The minister responded that existing court supervision, the ongoing evaluation of the 2013 reform, and the Wet markt en overheid apply, promising results of the evaluation around summer and largely pointing to the courts and the evaluation for answers.
I am awaiting the outcomes. These are expected around the summer and will be sent to your House as promised.
Ik wacht de uitkomsten af. Deze zijn rond de zomer te verwachten en worden zoals toegezegd aan uw Kamer toegestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Buitenweg en Van Nispen over de oproep om voor meer beveiliging voor de familie van kroongetuigen te zorgen

MPs Buitenweg and Van Nispen asked whether the minister will heed a lawyer's call to strengthen protection of the family of crown witness Nabil B., and about the status of a motion on filling vacancies at the protection service. The minister declined to discuss case details or protection measures for security reasons, said crown witnesses are indispensable, and said additional measures are being taken to fill vacancies in the medium term.

As I also reported in my letter of 5 June following the debate on combating liquidation violence, and as is generally known to your House, I cannot go into the details of the case or into any security measures taken to protect persons.

5 juni naar aanleiding van het debat over de strijd tegen het liquidatiegeweld, en zoals in het algemeen bekend is bij uw Kamer, kan ik niet ingaan op de details van de casus noch op de eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen die worden genomen om personen te beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de behandeling van klokkenluider Roelie Post door de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the SP asked the ministers whether the government would intervene in the case of whistleblower Roelie Post, who alleges retaliation and threats from the European Commission after exposing adoption corruption in Romania. The minister replied that the government considers threats against officials unacceptable, points to EU whistleblower guidelines, states it lacks details of the dispute, and sees no role for itself in mediation, though it would welcome a mutually acceptable solution.
For this reason, the government sees no obvious role for mediation.
Voor het kabinet ligt er om deze reden geen bemiddelende rol voor de hand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het contrast tussen de torenhoge toegewezen declaratie van een politie-advocaat en de bezuinigingen op de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the contrast between a very high declared fee awarded to a police officer's lawyer and cuts to subsidised legal aid, including why the hourly rate cannot be disclosed and whether ministry-appointed lawyers lack tariff agreements. The minister declined to disclose the rate as it falls under a private agreement, said no ministry tariff ceiling exists for such cases, and promised a directional perspective on reforming subsidised legal aid after the summer recess.
The hourly rate is part of this agreement, to which I am not a party.
Het uurtarief maakt onderdeel uit van deze overeenkomst, waarin ik geen partij ben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het manifest van de Vereniging Sociale Advocatuur Nederland en het verlaten van het rechtshulpoverleg

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the VSAN manifesto on legal aid and why VSAN and NVJSA left the consultation on reforming subsidised legal aid, and whether the budget-neutral starting point should be abandoned. The minister welcomed the manifesto's ideas for the programme, said the reform is bound by the coalition agreement and existing budgets, regretted their withdrawal, and promised a letter after the summer.

The framework for my approach is set by the coalition agreement: the new system will be designed along the lines of the Wolfsen and Van der Meer committee reports and within the existing budgetary space.

Het kader voor mijn aanpak is gegeven door het regeerakkoord: het nieuwe stelsel wordt ontworpen langs de lijnen van de rapporten van de commissies-Wolfsen en -Van der Meer en binnen de bestaande budgettaire ruimte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de sterke rechtspositie van banken in het geval van insolventie

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten (SP) asked the Ministers for Legal Protection and of Finance whether banks enjoy a privileged position in insolvency, whether this disadvantages other creditors, and whether enforcement practices such as collective pledge deeds and irrevocable powers of attorney should be curbed. The government answered that secured creditors' rights are a necessary condition for cheap credit, that other creditors also hold privileges, that no misuse of irrevocable powers of attorney is found, and that the insolvency law reform programme will revisit the position of pledge and mortgage holders with the advisory group.
This subject was already discussed in June 2017 with the group of representatives from the insolvency practice.
Dit onderwerp is in juni 2017 al eens besproken met de groep vertegenwoordigers uit de faillissementspraktijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gebrekkige veiligheid in gevangenissen door bezuinigingen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about unsafe prisons caused by budget cuts, including calls from the FNV union for structural safety agreements, action after the Inspectorate's 'Uit Balans' report, and whether staff sick-leave and workload were addressed. The Minister answered that a covenant with the DJI board, works council and unions set aside EUR 100 million over four years, that additional measures are underway, and that the staffing shortage was not caused by budget cuts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de verkoop van verboden nepvuurwapens

An SP MP asked whether the police campaign on imitation firearms had worked, whether incidents are rising, and whether the sale and possession of toy guns that are banned to carry should be restricted. The Minister says the first campaign was not measured but imitation weapon seizures fell 2015-2017, rejects restricting sales because the EU Toy Directive is binding and toy guns are not weapons under the Wet wapens en munitie, and states there is no prescribed government sales policy for toy guns.
Amending the Toy Directive requires an extensive procedure that is not currently on the agenda.
Het aanpassen van de Speelgoedrichtlijn vergt een uitgebreide procedure die op dit moment niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het afkopen van strafrechtelijke vervolging via schikkingen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about out-of-court settlements (hoge transacties) that let companies such as Rabobank and PON avoid prosecution, including whether individuals are spared, how publicity is handled, and whether the rules should change. The ministers defended the practice as efficient and effective, acknowledged that the 2013 Libor press release fell short of current standards, and said the practice is under review in the evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening, with judicial review via beklag under art. 12 Sv. already possible.
With regard to all suspects, the OM made a prosecution decision based on all information that had become known.
Ten aanzien van alle verdachten heeft het OM op basis van alle bekend geworden informatie een vervolgingsbeslissing genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de versoberde detentieomgeving een succesvolle resocialisatie in de weg staat

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether the austere detention regime undermines resocialisation and raises recidivism risk, citing a Nederlands Juristenblad article. The minister rejected the claim that the regime is sober, pointed to the activating DBT and plusprogramma with activities and reintegration options, and declined to commission additional research.

I am of the opinion that sufficient information from research is available to arrive at a balanced daily programme in which the principles of retribution and of general and special prevention are reflected.
Ik ben van mening dat voldoende informatie uit onderzoek voorhanden is om te komen tot een afgewogen dagprogramma waarin de principes van vergelding én van generale en speciale preventie terugkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Waarom de strijd tegen het UWV je kapot kan maken - en hoe het anders kan’

SP MPs asked why UWV rarely uses mediation in objection cases, whether objection procedures can be made independent, and what will be done for a woman in a euthanasia procedure judged fit for work. The State Secretary answered that mediation is offered at objection stage but used only when both parties agree, that UWV's objection directorate is organisationally separate and independent, that an independent commission is unnecessary, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
I cannot go into an individual case.
Ik kan niet ingaan op een individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het bericht dat Meld Misdaad Anoniem gegevens doorverkoopt

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Justice Minister whether Meld Misdaad Anoniem sells anonymous tips, whether municipalities and agencies must pay per tip, and whether police should investigate before arrests based on anonymous tips. Minister Grapperhaus rejected the claim of selling tips, explained the subsidy and fee arrangement, and stated that anonymous tips are only guiding information requiring independent verification, while promising to review the public-private financing with the supervisory board.
There is no question of "sale of anonymous tips".
Er is geen sprake van «verkoop van anonieme tips».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de tv-uitzending van Kassa waaruit bleek dat ex-gedetineerden moeilijk een schadeverzekering af kunnen sluiten

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether insurers may refuse ex-prisoners cover merely because of a criminal record, and whether the minister would address insurers' social responsibility for resocialisation. The minister answered that refusing ex-prisoners categorically would be undesirable, that Kassa's examples did not show systematic refusal, pointed to the Vereende as a fallback insurer, and said he would raise the issue with the Verbond van Verzekeraars.
In this light, I will bring to the attention of the Verbond van Verzekeraars the importance for people with a criminal record of being able to take out insurance.
In dit licht zal ik het Verbond van Verzekeraars het belang van mensen met een strafblad om verzekeringen te kunnen afsluiten onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over initiatieven voor laagdrempelige rechtspraak in de buurt

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about low-threshold 'neighbourhood judge' initiatives, including a Belgian justice-of-the-peace model, the discontinuation of the Spreekuurrechter pilot at the Noord-Nederland court, and the SP's Huizen van het recht proposal. The minister answered that experiments are being prepared and evaluated, that the pilot is not yet ready for regular use, that existing low-cost routes remain available, and that the proposal will be considered alongside legal aid reform.
The concept is therefore not yet ready to be included in the regular offering of the courts.
Het concept is op dit moment dan ook nog niet rijp om op te nemen in het reguliere aanbod van de rechtbanken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de positie van kwetsbare verdachten in het strafproces

An SP MP asks the Justice and Rechtsbescherming ministers about protecting vulnerable suspects in criminal proceedings, including a dissertation on mentally ill defendants, the choice between prosecution and compulsory psychiatric admission, false confessions, screening at first interrogation, and audiovisual recording of interrogations. Minister Dekker answers that the new Sv Book 6 draft addresses most recommendations, that case-by-case judgement applies, that existing safeguards exist, and that screening of all suspects is not straightforward; recording is required only for specified serious offences and is still being expanded.
Efforts are aimed at expanding these facilities.
Er wordt naar gestreefd deze faciliteiten uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het tekortschietende toezicht op malafide bewindvoerders

SP MPs asked why supervision of malafide court-appointed financial administrators (bewindvoerders) is weak, whether the 2014 quality requirements and centralised quality control work, how information is shared among judges, and about municipalities taking over administration and a white list. The Minister answered that supervision applies to all professional administrators, that a broader evaluation is underway with results expected around summer 2018, that information sharing among judges is informal but feedback-based, and that he has reservations about an online blacklist while favouring cooperation among courts, municipalities and administrators.
Around the summer I will inform the House by letter about the evaluation.
Rond de zomer informeer ik uw Kamer bij brief over de evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de hoge onkostenvergoeding die het OM bij een schikking betaalde aan een witwasverdachte

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why the public prosecution service paid about 200,000 euro in cost compensation in a settlement with the widow of a money-laundering suspect, why this was not disclosed in the press release, and why a settlement rather than prosecution was chosen. The minister answered that the compensation covered legal and asset-realisation costs (about 156,418 euro paid after offsets), that the omission from the press release was a lack of openness acknowledged after reflection, and that settlements are the most effective way to seize the assets, while promising a letter on high transactions and an evaluation of the Wet OM-afdoening.
On reflection, the prosecution service has stated that insufficient openness was given at the time about this aspect of the transaction.
Bij nader inzien heeft het OM aangegeven dat destijds onvoldoende openheid is gegeven over dit aspect van de transactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verstrekken van het onderzoeksdossier aan nabestaanden bij twijfel over de doodsoorzaak

The SP MP Van Nispen asked whether relatives who doubt a death's cause should get copies of police/prosecution case files and whether access for their own investigation could be widened, as adopted in a motion. The Minister answered that prosecutors decide case by case, weighing confidentiality, third-party privacy and risks to future prosecution, and pointed to an earlier letter for the motion response.
Providing a file for the purpose of one's own investigation deserves a separate assessment, which the handling public prosecutor must make case by case.
Het verstrekken van een dossier ten behoeve van eigen onderzoek verdient een heel eigen afweging, die de behandelend officier van justitie per zaak moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat “de beveiliging in tbs-kliniek Van der Hoeven te wensen overlaat”

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports of drugs, alcohol, child pornography and a computer found in the Van der Hoeven tbs clinic, and why these problems were not visible in earlier inspection reports, plus questions on drug controls, staff turnover and administrative burden. The minister disputes the clinic's depiction, says the Inspectorate will consider further investigation, points to an earlier inspection report and an action plan, and says broader findings on safety and staffing will be awaited and reported to parliament.
Both DJI and the Van der Hoeven clinic have stated that they do not recognise the picture described in the article.
Zowel DJI als de Van der Hoevenkliniek hebben aangegeven zich niet in het beeld zoals beschreven in het artikel te herkennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over E-Court

MPs Van Nispen and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection about e-Court, a private digital arbitration body used for debt collection, including its procedures, consumer protection, judicial review of its awards, and debt-collector fees. The minister acknowledged concerns, said the Hoge Raad will be asked prejudicial questions via an upcoming test case, and announced a review of debt collection procedures, but largely deferred on specifics and did not commit to changing the rules.
It is important that clarity is provided on the scope of judicial review of e-Court's decisions by the court.
Het is van belang dat er uitsluitsel komt over de vraag naar de reikwijdte van de toetsing van uitspraken van e-Court door de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen en Van Nispen over de uitvoering van de Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers

MPs Groothuizen and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the implementation of the Wet beëdigde tolken en vertalers, including quality of interpreters, use of non-registered interpreters and the reform based on the ABDTOPConsult report. The Minister answered that quality and price are being balanced, that about half of roughly 475,000 interpreting services in 2016 used a registered interpreter, and that the reform programme is ongoing with rollout expected in 2019.
Annex 1 provides an overview of interpreting services by these so-called obligated organisations, broken down by language, for 2016.
In bijlage 1 is een overzicht gegeven van tolkdiensten van deze zogenoemde afnameplichtige organisaties uitgesplitst per taal over 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de herziening van het stelsel voor gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister for Legal Protection about the ministry's redesign of the subsidised legal aid system, including the use of three commission reports, the reliance on stakeholder input, and why the redesign is constrained to existing budgets despite findings that more money is needed. The minister replies that the redesign follows the coalition agreement within existing budget limits, that a programme team and stakeholder sessions are underway, and that the Van der Meer findings are for policymakers to act on, rejecting the premise that more money is required.
The programme cannot carry out its mandate without the knowledge, expertise and experience of the professionals involved.
Het programma kan haar opdracht niet uitvoeren zonder de kennis, expertise en ervaring van betrokken professionals.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het contrast tussen de torenhoge toegewezen declaratie van een politie-advocaat en de bezuinigingen op de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked why a police-officer defendant's lawyer was awarded a very high fee of about 144,000 euro in a relatively simple assault case, while legal aid fees are being cut, and what the government will do about it. The Minister said the court's decision is not for him to comment on, that the right to choose a lawyer applies and that courts decide what is a reasonable fee, and that the lawyer's hourly rate is unknown to him; he noted the police-officer compensation arrangement and that the state bears the cost via the court ruling, but committed to no concrete action.
It is not for me as Minister of Justice and Security to comment on the Court of Appeal's decision.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid om in te gaan op de beslissing van het Gerechtshof.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over seksueel misbruik tijdens de tantramassage

An MP asked whether the Inspectorate for Healthcare had received reports of sexual abuse by tantra masseurs, what rules apply to the profession, whether police refused around thirty complaints, and whether the government would engage with the Tantra Misbruik reporting point. The ministers answered that the Inspectorate concluded these activities fall outside the Wkkgz and thus outside its supervision, that victims were advised to file police reports, and that they do not comment on individual cases, describing the police reporting process instead.
As I have previously informed the House, I do not go into individual cases and complaints.
Antwoord 4, 5 Zoals ik uw kamer eerder heb geïnformeerd 2 ga ik niet in op individuele casus en aangiften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen zou knoeien met medicaties

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about press reports that the Scheveningen prison hospital tampered with inmates' medication, asking whether renewed intensified oversight is needed. The minister said medication handling follows protocols, incidents are evaluated by the MIP committee, the IGJ lifted intensified supervision in 2014 and has found no reason to restore it, and the IGJ can decide on intensified oversight based on its own findings.
I have no indications that the medication dispensing process at the JCvSZ is currently going badly.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat het proces van medicijnverstrekking in het JCvSZ op dit moment slecht verloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Honderden Roma-kinderen in Nederland uitgebuit'

MPs Van Nispen and Van Dijk asked whether police handling of Roma children used for theft is perpetuating their exploitation, and about investigative capacity, forced marriage and organised child trafficking. The state secretary answered that an internal police report will be shared with parliament though sensitive parts will be withheld, pointed to existing WODC research and ongoing intensification measures, and said further research would add little value.

Yes, I will send this to you soon. However, I will not make certain parts of the administrative signal public, because it concerns sensitive investigative information, criminal methods and other information that should not be made public.

Ja, ik zal u dit spoedig doen toekomen. Bepaalde delen van het bestuurlijk signaal zal ik echter niet openbaar maken, omdat het gevoelige (opsporings)informatie, criminele handelwijzen en andere niet openbaar te maken informatie betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over justitiële dwalingen

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister for Legal Protection how she responds to Knoops's recommendations on reopening wrongful-conviction cases, including the novum test, single-instance assessment of new evidence, preservation of evidence, closer OM-advocacy cooperation, and evaluation of the Wet hervorming herziening ten voordele. The Minister replied that the novum criterion already applies, that evidence retention and the recommendations will be considered in the evaluation, and that the evaluation report is expected only by end 2018.
The study, which already subjects the statutory regime for further investigation of a possible novum to a general evaluation, has already been tendered and is under way.
Het onderzoek, waarin de wettelijke regeling van het nader onderzoek naar een mogelijk novum al aan een algemene evaluatie wordt onderworpen, is reeds aanbesteed en in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het bericht 'EU rift over rule of law deepens’

SP MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked the ministers about the European Commission's warnings to Romania over judicial reforms that could weaken the rule of law and shield corruption suspects, and about rule-of-law decline in several member states, EU justice cooperation, EU funds and Western Balkans accession. The minister confirmed awareness of the Commission's concerns, said the Cooperation and Verification Mechanism mainly signals problems without enforcement power, and stated that justice cooperation is based on mutual recognition with limited refusal grounds.
The Cooperation and Verification Mechanism (CVM) was designed after the accession of Bulgaria and Romania to monitor progress in judicial reform and the fight against corruption.

Het Coöperatie- en Verificatiemechanisme mechanisme (CVM) werd ontworpen na de toetreding van Bulgarije en Roemenië om voortgang te monitoren bij de hervorming van het rechtsstelsel, de bestrijding van corruptie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een voor aanranding veroordeelde trainer die toch coach kon blijven

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers how a trainer convicted in absentia of indecent assault was able to keep coaching, what should change, and how cross-border screening of such coaches can be improved. The minister declined to go into the case because it is pending in cassation, but pointed to the KNVB's actions, the VOG screening policy for youth coaches, the ECRIS information exchange, and a forthcoming policy response to the De Vries report.
Because the person concerned has lodged an appeal in cassation and the case is therefore still before the courts, I cannot go into the details of this case.
Omdat betrokkene in cassatie is gegaan en de zaak dus nog onder de rechter is, kan ik niet in detail ingaan op deze casus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het blokkeren van de laagdrempelige procedure bij de Spreekuurrechter voor aardbevingsschadezaken

MPs Beckerman and Van Nispen asked whether the Rechtbank Noord-Nederland blocked a Groningen earthquake damage case from the low-threshold Spreekuurrechter procedure after an internal intervention and contact with the NAM, and how access to justice for gas-damage victims will be ensured. The minister answers that the Spreekuurrechter pilot is for relatively simple disputes, the court itself judged the earthquake case unsuitable, the NAM was informed by letter and phone, and the new damage protocol and the EUR 200,000 fund for legal costs are being pursued.

For this deviating procedure a procedural regulation has been drawn up, which establishes that the Spreekuurrechter may decide that a case is not suitable for handling by the Spreekuurrechter, even if the parties would want it.

Voor deze afwijkende procedure is een procesreglement opgesteld en daarin is vastgelegd dat de Spreekuurrechter kan bepalen dat een zaak zich niet leent voor behandeling door de Spreekuurrechter, zelfs indien partijen dat wel zouden willen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de gevolgen van het mogelijke vertrek van de Noorse gevangenen uit Veenhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection about the possible early departure of Norwegian prisoners from Veenhuizen, the status of the Norwegian decision, whether the prison would stay open, and the timing and staff involvement. The minister noted the report, said a Norwegian extension is favoured but undecided, would assess consequences for capacity once clear, and said withdrawal could start from 1 September 2018 with staff involved under an existing agreement.

Once clarity exists on whether the lease of the Norgerhaven location to Norway is extended, it will be examined what the consequences of this decision are for the use of the total available detention capacity, including the capacity of Norgerhaven.

Zodra duidelijkheid bestaat over het al dan niet verlengen van de verhuur van de locatie Norgerhaven aan Noorwegen, wordt bezien wat de gevolgen van dit besluit zijn voor de bestemming van de totale beschikbare detentiecapaciteit, inclusief de capaciteit van Norgerhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kuiken over de recente geweldsgolf in Breda en de roep om extra rechercheurs

MPs Van Nispen and Kuiken asked the Justice Minister about a wave of violence in Breda and calls for 250 extra detectives, including whether unresolved serious cases and the lack of police capacity are acceptable. Minister Grapperhaus said the government is investing in police capacity, that €100 million from the coalition agreement has been released, and that a review of police deployment and a flexibility agenda are underway, without addressing the 250-detective figure or the budget adequacy directly.
The first 100 million from the coalition agreement has already been released at my initiative.
De eerste 100 miljoen uit het Regeerakkoord is op mijn instignatie nu al vrijgemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkwijze van slotenmakers

The MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why locksmiths open doors and replace locks on request without checking whether the requester is the resident, and whether the government will act. The minister agreed a locksmith should verify the requester, said police knew of no burglary cases using this method, and committed to consulting the trade associations and CCV on raising awareness.
I will consult with the locksmiths' trade association(s) to point out that their members can ask the client for identification when commissioned to open a door.
Ik ga met de branchevereniging(en) van slotenmakers in overleg, om hen te wijzen op het feit dat hun leden bij een opdracht om een deur te openen de opdrachtgever om zijn legitimatie kunnen vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het boek over de herzieningszaak Baybasin

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about Ton Derksen's book criticising the advocate-general's advice in the Baybasin revision case, the protests by former prison directors, and whether such scholarly work should play a role in the Supreme Court's revision decision. The minister declined to comment on the advice or the Supreme Court's role, noted that the court decides and may order further investigation, and said demonstrations are a matter for the public.
Given the independent position of an advocate-general, it is not for me as Minister for Legal Protection to reflect on the advice given in response to a revision application.

Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van een advocaat-generaal is het niet aan mij als Minister voor Rechtsbescherming om te reflecteren op de adviezen gegeven naar aanleiding van een herzieningsaanvraag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Advocaten ronselen in de bajes’

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about lawyers advertising to prisoners via eMates-printed correspondence and about recruitment practices. The Minister replied that DJI has no formal agreement with eMates, that advertising is not prohibited but targeted recruitment breaches professional conduct rules handled by the bar deans, and that DJI will pass complaints to eMates.
DJI has no formal agreements with eMates or other parties regarding advertising on private correspondence of detainees.
DJI heeft geen formele afspraken met eMates of andere partijen ten aanzien van het adverteren op (privé)correspondentie van gedetineerden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Incasso-oplichting blijft ongemoeid’

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked how debt collectors could wrongly charge debtors up to 500 euro in collection costs for years, and why the OM, curator and BFT had not acted. Minister Dekker answered that the BFT investigated, sought suspension and filed a disciplinary complaint, the chamber struck the bailiffs off in March 2017, and the OM is now handling a criminal complaint and will give extra attention to such cases in 2018.
The BFT did however intervene, as the answers below also show.
Het BFT heeft echter wel degelijk ingegrepen, zoals ook uit onderstaande antwoorden blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de aangifte tegen het brein achter de moord op Meesters

The SP member Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the family's complaint that no criminal investigation was opened against the alleged instigator of the murder of Meesters, and why the prosecution did not treat Robert D. as a suspect despite accusing him of commissioning the killing. The minister answers that the prosecution found insufficient legal and convincing evidence to prosecute D. and that police and prosecution have investigated the criminal organisation intensively, with two people convicted, and will review any new information.
As my predecessor has informed in the answers to parliamentary questions you cited, the prosecution saw insufficient lawful and convincing evidence to secure a conviction of D. for the commissioning.

Zoals mijn voorganger in de door u aangehaalde antwoorden op Kamervragen heeft laten weten zag het OM onvoldoende wettig en overtuigend bewijs om tot een veroordeling van D. voor de opdracht te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de incidentmeldingen rond de verloven van criminelen

An SP MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports of incidents and escapes during prison and tbs-clinic leave, the trend in incidents, how leave eligibility is assessed, and whether the whole leave system will be reviewed. The Minister disputes the picture of frequent escapes, reports stable or fluctuating numbers, describes the risk-assessment and advisory process, mentions past evaluation, and does not commit to a new review.
Nevertheless, I understand that such a message raises questions with your House as well as with citizens.
Desondanks begrijp ik dat een dergelijke boodschap vragen oproept bij uw Kamer alsook bij burgers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Nispen over het bericht dat bedrijven ongevraagd klantgegevens delen met Facebook

MPs Hijink and Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about a Consumentenbond report that companies share customer data with Facebook without consent, asking how many companies, sanctions imposed, and what steps will follow. The minister replied that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens is independent and must assess lawfulness, that Facebook provided no figures, that customers can object or withdraw consent, and that no concrete new action is promised.
It is up to the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens to assess whether Facebook Custom Audience targeting involves a legitimate interest on which the data processing can be based.
Het is aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens om te beoordelen of bij Facebook Custom Audience targeting sprake is van een gerechtvaardigd belang waarop de gegevensverwerking kan worden gebaseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat cipiers ziek van angst zouden zijn door onveilige situaties in de gevangenissen

An MP asks the Minister for Legal Protection about reports that prison guards are sick from fear due to unsafe conditions, the shortage of staff, delayed supply deliveries, and whether two guards can supervise 50 prisoners. The minister answers that safety is paramount, outlines recruitment drives, a convenant with unions, temporary external staff, and says the structural staffing is sufficient once vacancies are filled, while acknowledging reduced operational flexibility.
Safety always takes priority at DJI.
De veiligheid staat bij DJI altijd voorop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de strafrechtelijke aanpak van matchfixing

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked whether matchfixing should be made explicitly criminal, given evidence problems reported by prosecutors. Minister Grapperhaus replied that prosecutors have managed with existing law, that the Openbaar Ministerie will explore whether a separate offence adds value, and that a reporting duty and any sanction will be studied before further steps are taken.
The Public Prosecution Service will examine whether a separate criminal offence of matchfixing adds value to the current legal instruments for acting against fraud in sport.
Het Openbaar Ministerie gaat bekijken of zelfstandige strafbaarstelling van matchfixing meerwaarde heeft ten aanzien van het huidig wettelijk instrumentarium om op te treden tegen fraude in de sport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mogelijke kansspelkarakter van zogenoemde ‘lootboxes’ in videospellen

An SP MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection whether loot boxes in video games are gambling, whether children should be shielded from them, whether the Betting and Gaming Act still fits digital practice, and whether the Dutch regulator will act in the meantime. The minister said the Gaming Authority is investigating whether loot boxes are games of chance and that results are expected in early 2018, while declining to take further awareness steps beyond existing media actions.
The Gaming Authority (ksa) is currently investigating the possible relationship between problem gambling and video games and the harmful aspects of video games.
De kansspelautoriteit (ksa) doet momenteel onderzoek naar het vraagstuk van de mogelijke relatie tussen problematisch gokgedrag en videospellen en naar de schadelijke aspecten van videospellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over misstanden in het gevangenisziekenhuis te Scheveningen

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister for Legal Protection about reported abuses and complaints at the Scheveningen prison hospital, including whether oversight had weakened since 2014 and whether intensified supervision should be reinstated. The minister responded that complaints are handled through the prison complaints commission and appeal route, that the healthcare inspectorate will ask the prison director for a response, and that the inspectorate sees no reason to reintroduce intensified supervision.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het mislukken van een grote drugszaak door forse termijnoverschrijding door het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a large drug case collapsed after the Public Prosecution Service exceeded the prosecution time limit, leaving six suspects untried, and asked about causes, frequency, backlogs and measures. The Minister attributed the delay to staff turnover and case complexity, said the number of cases declared inadmissible is small, cited backlog figures, and promised only internal measures to prevent delays.
How much time the preparation took in total has not been registered as such.
Hoeveel tijd de voorbereiding in totaal in beslag heeft genomen, is niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over gedragsinterventie voor jongeren die zich misdragen hebben op het voetbalveld

Mr Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the 'Sport en Gedrag' training for youths who misbehaved on the football pitch will be discontinued for lack of funds and asked for support to keep it. Minister Bruins answered that the government funds the training through end-2018, that it is anchored in Halt's offer, and that talks with the KNVB and Halt on adapting it for other sports are ongoing.
Until the end of 2018 I support the Sport en Gedrag training, as part of the action plan 'Towards a Safe Sports Climate'.
Tot en met eind 2018 ondersteun ik de trainingen Sport en Gedrag, als onderdeel van het actieplan «Naar een Veilig Sportklimaat».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de samenloop tussen een internationale kinderontvoering en een lopende strafzaak

An MP asked the Minister for Legal Protection why a father who had been convicted of assaulting the mother, and was flagged for enforcement, could still have a child returned to Australia under the Hague Convention, and whether the prosecutor's cooperation protocol should be changed. The minister declined to discuss the individual case, said the civil courts decided the return and the prosecutor has little discretion to refuse enforcement, and saw no reason to amend the protocol.
I currently see no reason to amend the existing cooperation protocol.
Ik zie momenteel dan ook geen aanleiding het bestaande samenwerkingsprotocol aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te lange doorlooptijden in de strafrechtketen

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister about long case-processing times in the criminal justice chain, including a victim's complaint, whether a hearing can be guaranteed within months, rising delays, and prosecution and court capacity. The Minister acknowledges the problem, refuses to guarantee hearings within months, cites improving average durations, and promises further information in 2018 and a WODC study.
No. The speed with which a report leads to prosecution and then to a conviction depends on so many circumstances that I cannot give that commitment.
Nee. De snelheid waarmee een aangifte tot vervolging en vervolgens tot een veroordeling leidt, is van zo veel omstandigheden afhankelijk dat ik die toezegging niet kan doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht inzake kansloze aangiftes bij mensenhandel

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a report that a third of human trafficking complaints are dismissed within a month, whether this deters victims, the progress of a motion on combating trafficking, asylum versus trafficking residence procedures, IND's reliance on conviction, and steps to raise victims' willingness to report. The minister explained the new fast-track dismissal procedure piloted with police, prosecutors and IND, said data on residence grants cannot yet be broken down, and promised further consultation with partners and the National Rapporteur.
At present, however, no insight can be given into the number of grants made on the basis of a conviction, a criminal process lasting more than three years, or humanitarian circumstances.

Op dit moment kan echter geen inzicht worden gegeven in het aantal toekenningen dat heeft plaatsgevonden op basis van een veroordeling, een strafrechtelijk proces dat langer dan drie jaar in beslag heeft genomen, of op grond van humanitaire omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Van Nispen over de achterstanden bij de rechtbank Zeeland-West-Brabant

MPs Kuiken and Van Nispen asked about delays and incomplete case files in appeals from the Zeeland-West-Brabant district court, including possible breaches of the reasonable-time right and sentence reductions. The Minister acknowledged the problems, said the 80 percent figure reflected an earlier snapshot, pointed to measures taken by the court and appeal court, and saw no need for further consultation or action now.
The Council for the Judiciary has indicated that such data cannot be derived from the systems.
Antwoord 2 De Raad voor de rechtspraak (Rvdr) heeft aangegeven dat dergelijke gegevens niet uit de systemen kunnen worden afgeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over incassobureaus die de rechtbank misbruiken om hun klanten te intimideren

SP MPs asked the Justice Minister about debt collectors such as Hoist and Direct Pay allegedly misusing the courts to intimidate debtors, including the adequacy of judicial oversight, the resale of debts, and AFM supervision. The minister said individual cases are for judges, promised a debt-collection register, a judicial vision paper due early 2018, and tighter AFM engagement, but declined to commit to banning debt resale.
I cannot go into individual cases that are submitted to the judge.
Ik kan niet ingaan op individuele zaken die aan de rechter worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Nederlander die mogelijk 33 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Foreign and Justice ministers about Dutch Jaitsen Singh, possibly wrongly imprisoned in the US for 33 years, and whether the Dutch state abandoned him, including the handling of a trust report and internal disagreement over transfer. The minister denies abandonment, says regular consular assistance was given, that the transfer request was rejected under the treaty framework, and that no new US requests are pending yet, while support would resume if they are filed.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has provided Mr J.S. with regular consular assistance since the start of his detention.
Het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken heeft aan de heer J.S. sinds aanvang van zijn detentie de reguliere consulaire bijstand verleend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Ten Broeke, Voordewind, Van Nispen, Van Ojik, Thieme, Baudet, Kuzu, Van de Hul en Knops over het bericht dat de Nederlandse overheid grote steken heeft laten vallen in het verle

MPs from many parties asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Justice whether the Dutch government failed to assist Mr Singh, a Dutch national imprisoned in the US for 33 years, including over consular visits, a transfer request and the handling of his case. The government rejects the picture of failure, says it cannot intervene in foreign justice, explains that transfer was refused on legal grounds and pledges continued support for parole and review requests.
The ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice and Security do not recognise that picture.
De ministeries van Buitenlandse Zaken en Justitie en Veiligheid herkennen zich niet in dat beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat zaakwaarnemers ruim 600 miljoen aan zomertransfers hebben verdiend

MP Van Nispen asked the health minister for a response to reports that intermediaries earned over 600 million euros from summer transfers, and asked what measures could bring more transparency on intermediaries at European and Dutch level. The minister answered that football bodies have the primary role, that the KNVB keeps a public register of intermediaries, and that no additional measures are foreseen.
I do not foresee taking additional measures at this moment.
Het treffen van extra maatregelen voorzie ik op dit moment niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen  over het gebrek aan capaciteit bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut en het uitbesteden van zaken

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why the Netherlands Forensic Institute now outsources some autopsies to Belgium, why capacity has run short, and about the institute's improvement programme and future outsourcing plans. The minister attributed the shortage to the sudden death of one of four forensic pathologists amid rising caseloads, said no budget cuts affected forensic pathology, and promised a letter on the improvement programme and a vision on forensic research.

Before the budget debate of the Ministry of Justice and Security at the end of November, you will receive the previously promised letter setting out the status of the improvement programme following the culture study.

Voorafgaand aan de begrotingsbehandeling van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid eind november, ontvangt u de al eerder toegezegde brief met daarin de stand van zaken van het verbeterprogramma naar aanleiding van het cultuuronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over een arrestatiebevel tegen een Turkse journalist

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether journalist Can Dündar had cancelled a Netherlands visit because of a Turkish Interpol arrest request, and how the Netherlands handles such requests. The minister answered that he could not confirm the cancellation, that Dündar has since visited, that no Dutch government view on the foreign conviction is given, and that foreign Interpol requests are assessed case by case before registration.

A foreign arrest request or alert that the Netherlands receives via INTERPOL channels is not automatically acted upon: each is assessed case by case before being entered in the national investigation register.

Aan een buitenlands aanhoudingsverzoek of signalering dat Nederland via INTERPOL kanalen ontvangt, wordt niet automatisch gevolg gegeven: deze worden per geval beoordeeld alvorens deze worden ingevoerd in het nationale opsporingsregister.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen inzake de werkelijke vraag vanuit de politie en het openbaar ministerie (OM) naar sporenonderzoek en het budget van het Nationaal Forensisch Instituut (NFI)

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a WODC study into the forensic production capacity needed by police and prosecutors, its steering committee composition, whether it will update the PMJ forecasting model, and whether it will establish the real demand for forensic investigation and the related NFI budget. The minister confirmed the study started in August 2017, explained the composition of the steering committee and that stakeholders can contribute via expert sessions, and said the two-phase study will identify demand factors and feed a quantified forecast into the budget discussions.
The results of this will be submitted to the budget discussions of the Ministry of Security and Justice.
De resultaten hiervan worden ingebracht bij de besprekingen van de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Werkdruk justitiële inrichtingen vier keer hoger dan rest van werkend Nederland’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about an FNV survey finding workplace pressure in prisons four times higher than elsewhere, and whether DJI will invest in more staff and respond to the survey's recommendations. The minister acknowledged the findings, described a recruitment campaign and interim measures such as concentrating detainees and staff, and said talks with the works council are ongoing without committing to a specific timeline or full point-by-point response.
It is being considered how the FNV research can be incorporated into the various recommendations from the Mto.
Bezien wordt hoe het FNV onderzoek kan worden betrokken bij de verschillende aanbevelingen uit het Mto.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Drugscriminelen mogen geld houden omdat justitie er zooitje van maakte’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a news report that drug criminals could keep their illicit proceeds because the Public Prosecution Service mishandled a confiscation case, and asked how often this happens, the cause, and what measures are planned. The Minister replied that the conclusion is premature since the prosecution has appealed, that frequency is not centrally registered, that asset recovery is a policy priority with continuous review, and that the disagreement concerns the scope of additional financial investigation; no extra measures are considered for this individual case.

The question of whether the court has more often ruled that the Public Prosecution Service is inadmissible in its confiscation claim due to failing to meet an evidentiary order cannot be answered because this is not centrally registered.

De vraag of door de rechtbank vaker is geoordeeld dat het Openbaar Ministerie niet ontvankelijk is in zijn ontnemingsvordering in verband met het niet (kunnen) voldoen aan een bewijsopdracht, kan niet worden beantwoord omdat dit niet centraal wordt geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over hoe de supportersclub Oranje zichzelf verrijkte ten koste van de fans

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how board members of the Oranje supporters club enriched themselves at fans' expense, why the KNVB did not supervise them, and what sanctions and repayment would follow. The minister replied that the club is an independent organisation over which she has no influence, that malversation can be reported to the police, and that the KNVB is not its supervisor; she noted an independent investigation commissioned by the club.
The Oranje supporters club is an independent organisation that independently makes choices regarding business operations, accountability and supervision.
De supportersclub Oranje is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig keuzes maakt betreffende bedrijfsvoering, verantwoording en toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Beschermd door justitie, leven kapot'

The MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that the protection system for witnesses may fail to adequately support them, and whether witnesses' dissatisfaction, the need for evaluation, legal assistance, financial and medical support, and information for witnesses are adequate. The Minister largely rejects the need for changes, stating the system works as intended, witnesses can consult a lawyer, and that the government is studying whether to extend legal options for promises to criminal witnesses.
I see no reason for a different approach.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor een andere aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de berichtgeving van de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie en de Belastingdienst om criminelen in hun portemonnee te raken

Two SP MPs asked the Justice and Finance ministers about reported weak cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service and the Tax Authority in recovering criminal proceeds, including why confiscation often yields less than claimed, whether tax recovery works after failed criminal recovery, how often offshore concealment occurs, and whether multidisciplinary asset-recovery teams and more investigative capacity are warranted. The minister answered that cooperation already exists and is periodically evaluated, that figures on tax recovery and concealment are not kept, that RIEC structures are preferred over new teams, and that extra funding (5 to 20 million euro a year from 2018, plus 30 million reserved for 2018) has been provided.

The number of cases in which the Tax Authority still recovers money from criminals via tax reassessment after the criminal asset-recovery route has (partly) failed is not tracked and no figures are available.

Het aantal gevallen waarin de Belastingdienst als nog via fiscale navordering en naheffing geld terug haalt bij criminelen als het strafrechtelijke afpaktraject (deels) mislukt, wordt niet bijgehouden en cijfers zijn dan ook niet voorhanden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over slachtoffers die recht hebben op een schadevergoeding, maar geen aanspraak kunnen maken op de voorschotregeling bij schadevergoedingen en daardoor, wanneer de dader de schad

An MP asked why victims of offences in Book 3 of the Criminal Code (overtredingen) cannot receive a state advance on compensation, unlike victims of violent and sexual offences, and why the CJIB stops collecting after substitute detention. The minister defended the limited scope of the advance scheme on budgetary grounds, said the CJIB is examining wider collection after substitute detention, and declined to extend the scheme to overtredingen.
I still stand by this choice.
Ik sta nog steeds achter deze keuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de storingen in de tapinstallatie van de politie

MPs Van Nispen asked about reported storms of failures in the police wiretap system, the foreign-owned vendor's limited transparency, and the delayed replacement of the system. The minister confirmed earlier storm counts were unreliable, said a corrected investigation will report by year-end, outlined restricted vendor access rights, and said a new system tender should conclude in early 2018.
The vendor's registration system contains not only reports about the police system but also about other customers.
In het registratiesysteem van de leverancier staan niet alleen meldingen over het systeem van de politie, maar ook van andere klanten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kwint over het bericht dat er deze zomer meer mensen verdronken zijn dan in voorgaande zomers

MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked the Minister of Health about reports of more drownings this summer, the decline in swimming skills linked to cuts to school swimming, and what measures are needed. The minister said the number of drownings is comparable to other years, that parents are primarily responsible for teaching swimming, that school swimming is the responsibility of municipalities and schools, and that a sector action plan is being finalised.
School swimming is a responsibility of municipalities and schools.
Schoolzwemmen is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten en van scholen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de brandbrieven van de centrale ondernemingsraad Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen aan de directie van de Dienst Justitiële Inrichtingen (DJI)

An MP asks the state secretary about works council letters warning of high workload, sickness absence, violence and unsafe conditions in prisons, and what will be done about staffing and safety. The secretary acknowledges the problems, points to dialogue with the works council, a recruitment campaign for 250 fte, extra funding and safety measures, while rejecting claims that the prison system is out of control.
The director-general of DJI indicated to the central works council that it takes the content of the letters seriously.
Daarnaast heeft de hoofddirecteur van DJI aan de COR DJI aangegeven de inhoud van de brieven serieus te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Nispen over het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen naar aanleiding van de uitzending 'Dwaze vaders'

MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen ask the Minister of Justice about parents not honouring custody/contact arrangements after separation, the prosecution of parental abduction, the handling of mutual accusations in divorces by the Child Protection Board and prosecutors, and whether courts stop contact with one parent (often fathers). The Minister answers that civil enforcement tools exist, a WODC study on non-compliance is commissioned for 2018, criminal prosecution is used as optimum remedium with a prosecution guideline in preparation, and truth-finding is addressed via an action plan.
To gain more insight into the problem, I have, partly following a motion by MPs Bergkamp and Van Nispen, asked the WODC to conduct research into the non-compliance with custody arrangements.

Om meer inzicht in de problematiek te krijgen heb ik, mede naar aanleiding van een motie van de leden Bergkamp (D66) en Van Nispen (SP) 6 , het WODC verzocht om onderzoek te laten doen naar het niet nakomen van omgangsregelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht 'Krachtige luchtpistolen zomaar in de winkel'

An SP MP asked why powerful air weapons above 80 joules remain freely available and why the threshold is not lower, and questioned the lack of advertising limits. The State Secretary answered that a permit requirement for air weapons above 80 joules is planned, that advertising is not restricted beyond the Dutch Advertising Code, and that the 80-joule limit balances sport shooting needs and practical burdens.
I intend to amend the Wwm so that air weapons with a muzzle energy above 80 joules are added to article 2, Category III of the Wwm.
Ik ben voornemens om de Wwm zodanig te wijzigen dat luchtdrukwapens met een schotkracht hoger dan 80 joule, worden toegevoegd aan artikel 2, Categorie III van de Wwm.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de doorberekening van kosten van toezicht en tuchtrecht aan deurwaarders en schuldenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the costs of supervision and disciplinary law for bailiffs and notaries would be passed on to debtors or clients, and why bailiffs get no compensation. The minister answered that the professional bodies decide how to pass costs to members, that the law does not allow charging debtors, and referred back to the parliamentary debate on several figures.
However, I wish to emphasise that the law provides no basis for charging the costs to debtors.
Wel hecht ik er aan te benadrukken dat de wet geen grondslag biedt voor het doorbelasten van de kosten aan de schuldenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afkoop van het regresrecht waardoor letselschadeslachtoffers gedupeerd raken

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the buyout of the Wmo regress right via the VNG-Verbond van Verzekeraars convenant harms personal injury victims, who may be sent to municipalities first and face delays. The State Secretary replied that regress is a matter between insurer and municipality, that the victim is not affected, that the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade is not breached, and that no talks with stakeholders are planned.
Regress takes place in the relationship between insurer and regress claimant.
Regres speelt zich af in de verhouding tussen verzekeraar en regresnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de mogelijke uitlevering van Saïd C.

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked why the Netherlands arrested Saïd C. on a Moroccan extradition request, what guarantees Morocco gave on serving any sentence in the Netherlands and on a fair trial, and whether torture concerns and Dutch prosecution were considered. Minister Blok answered that Morocco agreed to transfer enforcement of any sentence to the Netherlands and to Dutch conversion of the sentence, that the request is now for a court to assess, that the minister declines to comment on the individual case, and that the Netherlands does not normally prosecute itself when another state requests extradition.
As is customary in individual cases, I exercise restraint in my statements about the case.
Er past mij, zoals gebruikelijk in individuele gevallen, terughoudendheid in mijn mededelingen over de zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de corruptieschandalen binnen de FIFA

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the FIFA corruption scandals, the Garcia report on the 2018 and 2022 World Cup bids, possible further investigation, Dutch-Belgian bid payments, and whether bid funds reached tax-haven structures. The minister answered that the report shows no clear proof of bribery, that Swiss and US investigations are ongoing, that the EU presidency pushed for transparency rules on major sports events, and that the KNVB-commissioned review found no unlawful payments and no signals of tax-avoidance flows.
Should I receive information about this, for example from the Swiss or American investigation, I will inform you further.
Mocht ik daar informatie over krijgen, bijvoorbeeld uit het Zwiters of Amerikaans onderzoek (zie antwoord op vraag 3) zal ik u daarover nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over capaciteitsgebrek bij sporenonderzoek

MPs Van Nispen and Van Raak asked the Minister of Security and Justice what caused the late start of forensic investigation after a fatal armed robbery, how large the capacity shortage is, how often such delays occur, and what measures will prevent staffing problems from hindering evidence collection in serious cases. The minister replied that the police had forensic officers on scene within an hour, that priority goes to the most serious cases with assistance from other units when needed, and pointed to the ongoing personnel reorganisation and recruitment of specialists.
The police information shows that in this case there was no late start to the forensic investigation.
Uit de informatie van de politie blijkt dat er in deze zaak geen sprake is van te laat starten met het sporenonderzoek.
