Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de berichtgeving dat matchfixing toeneemt in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers about expected growth in matchfixing in the Netherlands and how it is being tackled, including reporting channels, police and prosecution capacity, information sharing, and a proposed dedicated criminal law provision. Minister Blok answered that the rise is linked to the growing online gambling market, that a national platform, reporting channels and the upcoming online gambling law are being used, and that prosecutors see no need for a new statutory article.
The Public Prosecution Service does not make statements about ongoing investigations or what prompted them.
Over lopende onderzoeken en wat de aanleiding voor deze onderzoeken is geweest doet het OM geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Hijink over de slechte aanpak van faillissementsfraude

MPs Van Nispen and Hijink asked the Justice and Finance ministers why so few criminal reports are drawn up for simple bankruptcy fraud, and how enforcement, capacity, cooperation and registry powers could be improved. The Minister denies police neglect, cites the fraud monitor figures, defends the existing measures and cooperation, and promises further information on a study of guarantee schemes for curators.
I do not recognise the picture that the police give too little priority.
Ik herken het beeld, dat de politie te weinig prioriteit geeft, niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over Oekraïne als drugsroute

Two SP MPs asked about a BBC/RTL documentary alleging drug smuggling through Ukraine and corruption among border guards, and what the EU has done about it. The minister answered that anti-corruption efforts have intensified since the Euromaidan, that the EU supports Ukrainian border reform with several million euros, and that the scale of drug flows cannot be reliably estimated.
This is difficult to estimate: Ukrainian data on intercepted drug shipments mainly concern quantities of drugs entering Ukraine.
Dit is moeilijk in te schatten: Oekraïense data over onderschepte drugszendingen zien immers vooral op hoeveelheden drugs die Oekraïne binnenkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat boetes aan buitenlandse goksites niet geïnd worden

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice why administrative fines imposed on foreign online gambling sites go uncollected, how collection is blocked, and whether non-payment will count against future licence applications. The State Secretary answered that collection abroad is practically very difficult due to lack of international legal basis, that non-payment will weigh in future licence decisions, and that criminal enforcement and other measures are used, while denying that enforcement is deprioritised.
That certainly does not mean that such fines imposed have no consequences, because they can be weighed in a future licence application to offer remote gambling.

Dat betekent zeker niet dat dergelijke boetes die zijn opgelegd geen consequentie hebben, omdat deze kunnen worden meegewogen bij een toekomstige vergunningaanvraag om kansspelen op afstand aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over voortvluchtige criminelen die geen belasting hoeven te betalen

MPs Van Nispen and Leijten asked whether fugitive criminals can avoid paying tax in the Netherlands because of the durable-ties residence test, and whether this makes the Netherlands a tax haven for criminals. State Secretary Wiebes replied that residence is assessed on the circumstances, that the court ruling was specific to its facts, that Dutch rules do not differ from other countries, and that he sees no reason to depart from the residence principle for fugitives.
As stated, to my knowledge Dutch tax legislation does not differ in this respect from tax legislation in other countries.
Zoals gezegd wijkt de belastingwetgeving in Nederland in dit opzicht naar mijn weten niet af van de belastingwetgeving in andere landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de slechte kwaliteit van NFI rapporten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about criticism by Van Koppen that NFI forensic reports have recurring quality problems, including unexamined origin of items, unexplained conclusions, deliberately limited answers and hypotheses outside the expert's field. The Minister acknowledges some shortcomings in the cited case, defends the NFI's scope-limited reporting and quality systems, and promises a fuller response to the Nederlands Juristenblad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en van Nispen inzake het bericht dat scholen stoppen met schoolzwemmen

The SP MPs Van Nispen and Kwint asked whether they are concerned that four Utrecht primary schools stopped offering school swimming after a child drowned, whether other schools have done so, and what concrete measures the government will take to keep schools offering swimming lessons and to improve supervision and responsibility-sharing with pools. State Secretary Dekker answered that the decision lies with schools, that the government does not track their reasons centrally, that it will reiterate the 2005 school swimming protocol and the national platform's plan due at the end of 2017.
Offering school swimming is a consideration that schools make themselves.
Het aanbieden van schoolzwemmen is een afweging die scholen zelf maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgelijke ontwikkelingen binnen de rechterlijke macht in Polen

An SP MP asked the government about the erosion of judicial independence in Poland and what further action it would take. The government answered that it monitors developments closely, will keep pursuing multiple channels (EU, Council of Europe, UN, bilateral), and cites mutual trust in judicial decisions and ongoing dialogue with the Commission as its approach.
The cabinet is aware of developments in Poland, follows them closely and with concern.
Het kabinet is op de hoogte van de ontwikkelingen in Polen, volgt die op de voet en met zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tot staatsgeheim verklaren van de aantekeningen van een officier van justitie in een strafdossier

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the prosecutor's daily notes in the Sharleyne child death case were classified as state secret, and whether such notes are always classified. The minister refers to earlier answers and states that the OM is revising its procedures for autopsy and that a letter on relatives' access to case files will be sent before the summer recess.
For answering questions 1 through 5, I refer to the answers to the questions from MP Helder (PVV), submitted on 21 April 2017.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen 1 tot en met 5 verwijs ik naar de beantwoording van de vragen van het lid Helder (PVV), ingezonden op 21 april 2017
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de opstelling van verzekeraars bij letselschade verhardt

An SP MP asks the Justice Minister whether insurers are increasingly rejecting injury claims and stalling settlements, and whether the industry Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade (GBL) is effective, evaluated, enforceable, and should be made statutory. The minister replies that the code is working: 91% of claims settle within two years, audits were positive, sanctions and complaint routes exist, and he sees no added value in legislating the code, though he will raise a TV investigation with the Letselschaderaad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het achterblijven van het bestrijden van witwassen

Two SP MPs asked the Finance and Justice ministers why the Netherlands lags internationally on combating money-laundering risks, including ING and trust office cases, Panama Papers follow-up, capital controls, UBO and shareholder registers, and Algemene Rekenkamer recommendations. The minister responded at length, largely describing existing supervision, risk-based rules, DNB/AFM enforcement and planned monitors, while disputing the claim that financial institutions take due diligence insufficiently seriously and declining to comment on individual institutions due to confidentiality.
Due to the statutory duty of confidentiality, DNB cannot make further statements about individual institutions under its supervision.
In verband met de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kan DNB geen verdere uitspraken doen over individuele instellingen onder haar toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of infighting among bailiffs over competition rules and whether bailiff offices partly owned by debt collection agencies, which also receive their assignments from those agencies, breach the independence regulation. The Minister said the regulation applies to all bailiffs and must be enforced, that the KBvG will prepare a new regulation, that the BFT supervises compliance, and that the KBvG is expected to fulfil its enforcement role.
Naturally, an unequal playing field due to incomplete enforcement must be prevented.
Vanzelfsprekend dient een ongelijk speelveld door onvolkomen handhaving te worden voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Nispen over het programma Ontvoerd

MPs Van Dijk and Van Nispen asked whether the ministries of Foreign Affairs and Justice cooperated with the RTL programme Ontvoerd on child abduction, and raised concerns about child harm, due process and media interests. The state secretary answered that the Central Authority gave only general information in three meetings in 2012–2013, that the ministries were not involved in producing the programme, and that broadcasting and participation decisions rest with the broadcaster and parents.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1, 10 and 11, three meetings took place in 2012 and 2013 between officials of the Central Authority and the editorial team of RTL-Ontvoerd.
Zoals ik heb aangegeven in antwoord op de vragen 1, 10 en 11 hebben in 2012 en 2013 drie gesprekken plaatsgevonden tussen ambtenaren van de Centrale autoriteit en de redactie van RTL-Ontvoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘smokkel in gevangeniswezen’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that prison staff are alarmed by smuggled phones, weapons and drugs, staff shortages and rising workload, and whether incidents are monitored. The State Secretary answered that a bill criminalising bringing prohibited items into prisons is in preparation, listed existing controls and staffing measures, said incident data is recorded but not centrally counted for inspections, and noted an Inspectorate report on contraband would be published soon.
Figures on the number of (un)performed cell inspections are not kept centrally.
Cijfers over het aantal (niet) uitgevoerde celinspecties worden niet centraal bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over invallen bij thuiskwekers

An SP MP asked the Justice and Health ministers whether reported police raids on home cannabis growers were proportionate, how raid and eviction decisions are made, and whether medical use and personal circumstances such as a child with autism are weighed. The Minister answered that the reported accounts were partly incorrect, that such decisions are local discretionary assessments under the Damocles policy and Article 4:84 Awb, and that no central guideline weighs medical use or personal circumstances.
There is no central guideline for weighing whether and how personal circumstances factor into decisions on police raids and evictions at cannabis plantations.
Er is geen centrale richtlijn voor de weging of en hoe persoonlijke omstandigheden meewegen in besluiten bij invallen en ontruimingen van wietplantages door de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het onderzoek waaruit blijkt dat voorlopige hechtenis vaak onvoldoende wordt onderbouwd

Van Nispen (SP) asked the Minister of Justice and Security how he would respond to a Human Rights Board study finding that pre-trial detention orders are often poorly reasoned, what safeguards apply under European and international law, whether there is uniform practice on motivation, and what steps will improve reasoning. The Minister replied that the judiciary is implementing professional standards to improve reasoning, that the Dutch practice does not clearly violate European case law, and that a bill on alternatives to pre-trial detention has been submitted for advice.
The study by the Human Rights Board makes clear that decisions to impose pre-trial detention by judges are often still insufficiently reasoned (in writing).
Het onderzoek van het CRM maakt duidelijk dat beslissingen tot het opleggen van voorlopige hechtenis door rechters vaak nog onvoldoende (schriftelijk) worden onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de knelpunten bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

An SP MP asked the Justice and Finance ministers about obstacles to confiscating criminal assets, including a financial investigator's alarm, Tax Authority–prosecution cooperation, bank secrecy abroad, notary and lawyer privilege, and slow mutual legal assistance. Minister Blok rejects the picture of a poorly functioning system, points to new cooperation arrangements and planned reports, and promises a letter before summer on cooperation outside Europe.
I do not recognise the picture the report creates that the confiscation of criminal assets is in a poor state in the Netherlands.
Het beeld dat het bericht oproept dat het in Nederland slecht is gesteld met het afpakken van crimineel vermogen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bedonderen van ontevreden huurders in Groningen

MPs asked whether it is acceptable that legal advisers are paid by landlords not to take on tenant cases, and how the government will prevent this and protect tenants' access to the Huurcommissie. The minister said such contracts are disapproved of but depend on the case and are for courts to judge, that the Huurcommissie is accessible without legal aid, and that the number of such contracts is unknown.
In principle, citizens and businesses are free to decide with whom they enter into an agreement, when they do so, and what the content of the agreement is.
Het staat burgers en bedrijven in beginsel vrij om zelf te bepalen met wie zij een overeenkomst aangaan, op welk moment zij dat doen en om te bepalen wat de inhoud van de overeenkomst is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de politie aangiftes van huwelijkse gevangenschap niet in behandeling neemt

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether the government would look into police refusing to record complaints of forced marriage and polygamy, and how many such complaints exist, and whether the government would act further. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing the ongoing investigation, said the registration cannot separate forced-marriage complaints, pointed to existing expertise bodies, and saw no concrete reason for additional measures.
This concerns an individual case. Caution is required here, in the interest of the investigation and the protection of the privacy of the person concerned.
Het betreft hier een individuele zaak. Hiermee dient terughoudend te worden omgegaan, in het belang van het onderzoek en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over werknemersbelangen bij flitsfaillissementen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked how the government will protect employee interests in 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack restructurings), in light of an Advocate-General's opinion on the EU Business Transfer Directive and the Estro case. The minister answered that the opinion is non-binding, the CJEU ruling is awaited, the matter will be discussed with social partners in the WCO III preparations, and he will report back in a summer progress letter.

I am certainly willing to keep your House informed and propose that I will update you in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law recalibration programme, due in the summer, on the state of affairs.

Ik ben zeker bereid uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden en stel voor dat ik u in de eerst volgende voortgangsbrief in het kader van het programma herijking van het faillissementsrecht die in de zomer zal uitkomen, in zal lichten over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het aftreden van de directeur van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about interim findings of a culture investigation at the Netherlands Forensic Institute, the reasons for the director's resignation, why he was asked to stay on with full mandate, the unlawful procurement and the dismissal of procurement staff. The minister answered that the final report is due in May, the director resigned on personal grounds, he retains full mandate, the unlawful spending is itemised, and two staff were declared redundant but not dismissed, with measures taken since.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Van Nispen over de aanstaande voorkeurspeiling onder gedetineerden voor de vaststelling van het aanbod van geestelijke verzorging binnen justitiële inrichtingen

MPs Verhoeven and Van Nispen asked whether the new preference survey among detainees on prison chaplaincy would reflect their real needs, including non-religious care, and whether the humanist option should be labelled non-religious. The Secretary of State answered that all detainees receive the survey in 14 languages with an information leaflet explaining the options, that humanist care is described as non-religious there, and that results will be discussed with DJI and reported to the House.
Yes, I will discuss the results of the preference survey with DJI and then inform the House.
Ja, ik zal de resultaten van de voorkeurspeiling met DJI bespreken en daarna de Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onvoldoende middelen en capaciteit bij het Expertisebureau Online Kindermisbruik

An SP member asked the Justice and Health ministers about insufficient funding and capacity at the Expertise Bureau Online Child Abuse (EOKM), including police follow-up on Tor reports, proactive search powers, hosting provider takedown, sexting and sextortion support, Stop It Now funding and child sex tourism campaigns. The minister answered that current funding is considered adequate for now, that the police handle reports through a prioritisation process, that the EOKM has no investigative powers, and that other initiatives and funding decisions are being reviewed.
I will await this plan before entering further discussions with the EOKM about its future intentions.
Ik wacht dit plan af alvorens met het EOKM verder in gesprek te gaan over hun toekomstige voornemens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de handelwijze van een oud-rechter en de Raad voor de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice about a 2006 Raad voor de rechtspraak statement on a former judge's conduct, which a court now says must be rectified, and whether the judge's legal costs should be reimbursed. The Minister declined substantive comment while the case is pending, stating the Raad decides on cost recovery once the ruling is final.
Given the state of the procedure, I refrain from a substantive response.
Gelet op deze stand van de procedure onthoud ik mij van een inhoudelijke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat amateursportclubs het niet redden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about reports that many amateur sports clubs, especially football clubs, struggle financially and with volunteers, and whether club numbers are falling. The Staatssecretaris answered that support lies mainly with sports federations and municipalities, pointed to existing programmes and tools, and said the number of clubs fell only modestly through mergers while membership per club stayed flat.
Responsibility for supporting sports clubs lies with the sports federations and municipalities.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de ondersteuning van de sportverenigingen ligt bij de sportbonden en gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het aftreden van de directeur van het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the NFI director resigned voluntarily or under ministry pressure, how the decision came about, what role the ongoing culture investigation played, and whether procurement problems threaten material shortages. The minister answered that the director resigned on her own initiative, that interim findings were only presented orally and will not be sent to parliament, and that procurement irregularities are being addressed through reinforced teams and process changes.
There is no written report with interim results.
Er is geen schriftelijke rapportage met tussentijdse resultaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het groot tekort aan rechters

An SP MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about a reported shortage of about 227 judges, citing court presidents' projections of deficits in 2017 and 2018, the difficulty of recruiting qualified candidates, and open vacancies. The Minister answers that the Judiciary reports capacity expansion rather than a shortage, acknowledges training takes time, cites intensified recruitment and about 150 extra posts over three years, and sees no reason for a separate meeting with the Judiciary council.
There is an expansion of capacity that will lead to shorter processing times, better quality for those seeking justice, and lower workload for judges.
Er is sprake van uitbreiding van capaciteit die zal leiden tot kortere doorlooptijden, betere kwaliteit voor de rechtzoekende en lagere werkdruk voor de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het herkenbaar uitzenden van beelden ten behoeve van de opsporing

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about broadcasting recognisable CCTV images for investigative purposes, after a 68-year-old woman took her own life when such footage spread online. The minister said the criteria are set in the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving, that footage is removed once a suspect is identified, but that third-party redistribution cannot fully be prevented, and that the criteria are being reviewed with a new instruction expected before summer 2017.
The criteria and conditions for using investigative publicity are already being reviewed as part of the update of the Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving.
De criteria en voorwaarden voor inzet van opsporingsberichtgeving worden op dit moment in het kader van de actualisering van de Aanwijzing opsporingsberichtgeving al opnieuw bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over seksueel misbruik in de sport

The SP MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how she responds to calls to address sexual abuse in sport, including mandatory central reporting, a national reporting point, and a dedicated sports investigation body. The Minister replies that an independent NOC*NSF investigation is pending, that existing disciplinary rules and a cooperation protocol with police and prosecutors are being developed, and that no further measures will be decided until its outcome is known.
Based on the outcomes of the investigation, it can be decided whether additional measures are necessary.
Op basis van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek kan worden besloten of extra maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over de verdergaande ondermijning van de rechtsstaat en de democratie in Polen

Two SP MPs asked the government about the erosion of rule of law and judicial independence in Poland, EU sanctions under Article 7, judicial cooperation, and Kaczynski's remarks on a two-speed EU and refugees. The government answered that it follows developments closely, pursues dialogue bilaterally and in EU fora, considers Article 7 not currently at issue, and that judicial cooperation continues as no grounds to refuse were found.
Triggering the Article 7 procedure is not currently on the table.
Het in werking stellen van de artikel 7 procedure is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Nispen over het onterechte gijzelen van wanbetalers van boetes

MPs Recourt and Van Nispen asked whether debtors who cannot pay fines are wrongly subjected to imprisonment (gijzeling) and whether the prosecution uses it as a pressure tool, citing a critical column and the Ombudsman report. The State Secretary replied that gijzeling should target only those able but unwilling to pay, that the new prosecution approach has reduced and better-motivated claims, and that the CJIB and prosecution are improving referral and payment arrangements.
The OM and CJIB are working to further improve the process and will inform me further about the new approach and the outcomes.
Het OM en het CJIB werken aan het verder verbeteren van het proces en zullen mij over de nieuwe werkwijze en de uitkomsten nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Verhoeven over het bericht dat drugs met medeweten van de politie Nederland in is gesmokkeld

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Verhoeven asked whether police officers knowingly let cocaine shipments into the Netherlands, whether a tipster was paid, and whether the no-let-pass rule (doorlaatverbod) was breached. Minister Blok declined to address the specific questions because the criminal case is before the court, restated the legal framework for seizure and controlled delivery, and saw no reason for a further investigation.
Given that the criminal case is currently before the court, it is not appropriate for me to address these questions in substance.
Gelet op het feit dat de strafzaak momenteel onder de rechter is, past het mij niet om inhoudelijk in te gaan op deze vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Onschuldig en toch voor het leven gestraft'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about a report of a person wrongly treated as a suspect for about a year, with only a dismissal letter afterwards and little aftercare. The government acknowledges the harm, gives figures on wrongly-suspected cases and describes existing compensation routes and a re-integration convenant with municipalities, but offers no new aftercare for wrongly suspected persons beyond ongoing study.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that it is currently considering whether it is possible in such cases (sepot 01 cases) to send a non-automated message to the person concerned.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat zij momenteel bezien of het tot de mogelijkheden behoort om in dit soort gevallen (sepot 01-zaken) een niet-geautomatiseerd bericht te doen uitgaan naar de betrokken persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat nietsvermoedende Nederlandse meisjes op Twitter worden aangeboden als prostituee

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that girls' identities were used on social media to advertise them as prostitutes, and about police capacity, training, and the role of platforms. The minister confirmed awareness, said sextortion is not registered separately so no figures exist, defended police prioritisation and training, and placed responsibility for swift removal of content on social media providers.
Sextortion is registered as a form of extortion in police systems and not as a separate phenomenon.
Sextortion wordt als een vorm van afpersing geregistreerd in de politiesystemen en niet als apart fenomeen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het toch drastisch verminderen van de subsidie van de Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken

An SP MP asked why the subsidy to the Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken was apparently cut by 160,000 euro despite parliament's repeated wishes, and why the cut surfaced only after budget debates. The minister denied a cut, explained the 2009 transfer of the health-sector commission subsidy to his ministry, and said agreement was reached with the foundation on a 2017 subsidy of 1,273,060 euro.
The SGC board can accept a subsidy in line with the amount the SGC requested in its 2017 subsidy application, namely 1,273,060 euro.
Het bestuur van de SGC kan zich vinden in toekenning van een subsidie conform het bedrag dat de SGC in haar subsidieverzoek voor 2017 heeft aangevraagd, zijnde € 1.273.060.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Karabulut en Pieter Heerma over illegale huwelijken in moskeeen

MPs Van Nispen, Karabulut and Heerma asked about illegal religious marriages and forced marriage in mosques following an Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the government does about it. The minister says the scale is unknown, the Public Prosecution Service has found insufficient grounds for an investigation into the mosques named, and it is raising awareness among relevant parties while gemeenten handle victim care.
The Public Prosecution Service has judged that there are insufficient concrete grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft geoordeeld dat er onvoldoende concrete aanknopingspunten zijn voor een opsporingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het ontstaan van een tekort aan rechters

An MP asks the Justice Minister about the judicial vacancies and the claimed risk that the justice chain will stall. The minister answers that about nineteen judge vacancies exist, that this does not justify fears of a stall, and that the vacancies stem from replacement needs and the introduction of professional standards, with a phased rollout and intensified recruitment as remedies.
The Judiciary is taking measures by intensifying the recruitment and training of new judges, phasing in the professional standards and monitoring progress so that it can adjust in time if needed.

De Rechtspraak neemt maatregelen door de werving en opleiding van nieuwe rechters te intensiveren, de invoering van de professionele standaarden te faseren en de voortgang te monitoren, zodat zo nodig tijdig kan worden bijgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over te strenge limieten voor topsporters

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport whether Dutch Olympic qualification limits for athletes are too strict compared with other countries, and why. The minister replied that setting selection criteria is the responsibility of Dutch sport (NOC*NSF and the federations), not the government, and declined to change the limits or to engage with the federations.
It is up to Dutch sport itself to set the conditions for qualifying for dispatch to major international events.
Het is aan de Nederlandse sport zelf om voorwaarden te stellen om in aanmerking te komen voor uitzending naar grote internationale evenementen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over onderzoek naar seksueel misbruik in de sport

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about NOC*NSF's planned investigation into sexual abuse in Dutch sport, including its scope, support from the ministry, concrete measures, cooperation with police and prosecutors, and aftercare for athletes. The minister welcomed the sector-led investigation, said it would be independent and that the ministry had offered expertise without a funding request, and described existing prevention, complaint, disciplinary and reporting arrangements.
NOC*NSF has the investigation carried out independently.
NOC*NSF laat het onderzoek onafhankelijk uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de rehabilitatie van onterecht veroordeelden

The MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about the rehabilitation of wrongly convicted people following a court ruling on state co-responsibility for Du Bois's crimes, and what support and apology he received. The minister declines to comment on the court ruling, explains that rehabilitation is case-by-case with compensation and municipal reintegration support, and says the state's efforts for Du Bois were considered complete, with no structural remedy promised.
It is not for me as Minister of Security and Justice to intervene in decisions of an independent judicial body.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie om te treden in beslissingen van een onafhankelijk rechterlijk college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het opnemen van politieverhoren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of audiovisual recordings of police interviews and the status of the motion to record all such interviews. The Minister said current recording quality meets the obligations of the existing directive, that recording all interviews is not feasible in the short term, and that the motion will not be implemented soon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het gebruik van Nederlandse ambassades in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked the Foreign Minister about the use of Dutch embassy buildings abroad after reports that a minister's engagement party was held at the Paris residence. The minister denied a private party took place, said the event was a fundraising activity for the National Musical Instrument Fund, and stated that anyone within the stated framework could have used the residence.
There was no question of an engagement party in a government building.
Er was geen sprake van een verlovingsfeest in een rijksgebouw.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Segers over het betrekken van de pilot ‘spreekuurrechter’ bij het onderzoek naar de haalbaarheid en inpasbaarheid in de reguliere rechtspraak van een vrederechter

MPs Van Nispen and Segers asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a 'spreekuurrechter' (walk-in judge) pilot at the Noord-Nederland district court and whether its experience would feed into the study of a vrederechter (justice of the peace) model. The Minister confirmed awareness, said the Judiciary is evaluating the pilot, and said the WODC study on Belgium and France will draw on pilot experience, without specifying the study design.
It is not yet known how the study referred to in the motion will be designed.
Het is nog niet bekend op welke wijze het onderzoek als bedoeld in de motie zal worden vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Van Nispen en Karabulut over de aanhouding van demonstranten wegens belediging

Three SP MPs asked the Justice Minister whether arrests at a November 2016 demonstration for detained Kurdish parliamentarians were made for insult, how the decisions were taken, what the insults were, whether local authorities banned slogans, whether arrestees will be prosecuted, and whether protest rights are protected. The minister answered that one person was arrested for refusing to hand over a sign reading 'Erdogan Terrorista' with a Hitler-moustache image, which the Public Prosecution Service deemed insulting, that seven others were arrested for violence, that no slogan ban is known, that prosecution of the violence arrestees is for the Public Prosecution Service, and that freedom of expression is not absolute.
The Public Prosecution Service deemed this expression punishable as insult (article 266 of the Criminal Code).
Het Openbaar Ministerie oordeelde deze uiting als strafbaar (belediging, artikel 266 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over beperkingen van het demonstratierecht

MPs Van Raak and Van Nispen asked whether a mayor may require only 'positive messages' at demonstrations, as the mayor of Geleen did, and how this fits constitutional rights and controls on emergency measures. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wom bars content-based restrictions, that the mayor's conduct can be reviewed by the council and courts, and that local authority is responsible, while the Minister lacks instruction powers.
Imposing a demonstration ban based on the content of the thoughts or feelings to be expressed is not permitted.
Het opleggen van een demonstratieverbod op grond van de inhoud van de te openbaren gedachten of gevoelens is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Van Nispen over de asbestzaak in Dodewaard

MPs Smaling and Van Nispen asked how hundreds of visitors to an event in a contaminated former brick factory in Dodewaard were exposed to asbestos in 2011, why the building was not closed, and whether the Public Prosecution Service was fully informed. The government called the exposure reprehensible, said the owners were convicted, explained the closure and communication history, and said it had asked the municipality and province to inform visitors jointly.
The answer to how large the chance of actual health problems is depends on the specific circumstances of the case.
Het antwoord op de vraag hoe groot de kans is dat daadwerkelijke gezondheidsproblemen ontstaan, is afhankelijk van de specifieke omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het door nabestaanden opvragen van onderzoeksdossiers

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether bereaved relatives doubting a cause of death should be entitled to a copy of the (possibly anonymised) investigation file, and under what conditions copies are given. The minister answered that files are normally offered for inspection first, copies are assessed case by case balancing third-party privacy, and a broader entitlement is not planned, though the OM is reviewing clearer options for second opinions and will report by summer 2017.

Providing complete investigation files to relatives, whether or not anonymised, will always require an individual assessment because of the weighing of interests described above and the OM's responsibility toward third-party interests in society.

Een verstrekking van complete – al dan niet geanonimiseerde -onderzoeksdossiers aan nabestaanden, zal vanwege de hierboven geschetste belangenafwegingen en de verantwoordelijkheden van het OM ten aanzien van belangen van derden binnen de samenleving, altijd om een individuele beoordeling blijven vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Tongeren over de term ‘verkooppraatje’ bij het opleggen van een bijzondere voorwaarde aan een veroordeelde

MPs Van Nispen and Van Tongeren asked the Minister of Justice about the term 'verkooppraatje' used when imposing a special probation condition on a convicted offender, and why the government's letters of 31 August and 27 September 2016 appeared to conflict. The Minister answered that the statements are not contradictory: the August letter concerned the Public Prosecution Service's interpretation of the recordings, while the September letter concerned the words actually used, which both sides agree included 'verkooppraatje' by one advocate-general.
There was also then no difference of view between Van der G.'s lawyer and the OM that the word 'verkooppraatje' was used during the conversation of 17 September 2015.
Er bestond ook toen geen verschil van inzicht tussen de advocaat van Van der G. en het OM dat het woord «verkooppraatje» tijdens gesprek van 17 september 2015 is gebruikt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de samenwerking tussen Belastingdienst en OM bij het afpakken van crimineel vermogen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked whether cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on seizing criminal assets is still insufficient, whether OM's claim that Tax Authority referrals are declining is accurate, how the AAFD protocol is implemented, and what measures will be taken, including OM's suggestions for a training course and wider use of the Afpak-app. The minister rejects the claim of declining cooperation, describes the protocol procedures, RIEC and regional examples, says the Afpak-app is available and that no further measures are needed, while committing only to continued dialogue and attention to a regional contact point and best practices.
I do not recognise the picture that cooperation in this area between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority is declining.
Ik herken mij niet in het beeld dat de samenwerking op dit terrein tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en de Belastingdienst terugloopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Smaling over het bericht dat het sporten op kunststofgrasvelden mogelijk gevaarlijk is voor de gezondheid

MPs Van Nispen and Smaling asked the health minister about reports that playing sport on artificial turf with rubber granulate may harm health, and about the government's position in EU REACH classification. The minister answered that RIVM still finds no health effects on current evidence, that RIVM is analysing new studies and literature, and that results are expected before year-end.
I have asked RIVM to determine the presence of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) and other substances in the granulate.
Ik heb het RIVM gevraagd de aanwezigheid van polycyclische aromatische koolwaterstoffen (pak's) en andere stoffen in granulaat te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van verschillende uittreksels van justitiële documentatie

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a sepot-01 (dismissal for lack of evidence of the suspect's involvement) that was wrongly recorded in criminal records, and whether such dismissals should be excluded from extracts and the compensation rights of those affected. The Minister said dismissals of this kind are excluded from justitiële documentatie by design, that the sepot-01 entry was an erroneous re-delivery corrected in 2013, and that victims can still seek damages via the civil courts.

Because a sepot 01 is not included in the justitiële documentatie, this fact cannot play a role in, for example, sentencing in a subsequent criminal case or the issuing of a certificate of conduct (VOG).
Doordat een sepot 01 niet in de justitiële documentatie wordt opgenomen, kan dit gegeven geen rol spelen bij bijvoorbeeld de straftoemeting in een navolgende strafzaak of de afgifte van een VOG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels en Recourt over mediation in het strafrecht

MPs asked why funding for mediation in criminal cases ran out, halting new referrals after 28 October 2016, and how the government would meet article 51h of the Code of Criminal Procedure without it. The minister answered that the pilots were evaluated, a national scheme costs about €1.5 million a year, no structural funds were found, and restorative mediation remains possible through a subsidised victim-offender scheme.
There will simply no longer be money available for it from my budget.
Er zal alleen geen geld meer beschikbaar voor zijn vanuit mijn begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Oosten over de kwaliteit van forensische artsen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Oosten asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the quality of forensic doctors, citing claims that non-natural deaths and abuse are often missed by treating doctors and that forensic work is done on the side. The minister acknowledged the knowledge gap among treating doctors, said the profession is primarily responsible for quality, and pointed to ongoing steps including a NFI review of lijkschouw and the Hoes committee report due at year end.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat voortvluchtige criminelen ongrijpbaar zijn voor justitie in Arabische Emiraten

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether fugitive Dutch criminals in the UAE are beyond reach of justice due to lack of a treaty, how large the problem is, and what agreements exist or will be made. The minister disputed the scale of the problem, pointed to shared UN conventions providing an extradition basis, past extraditions, and existing cooperation talks, while promising to engage the UAE when necessary.
It is a fact that the Netherlands and the UAE are both party to various UN conventions on organised crime, drugs, terrorism and corruption, which all provide a treaty basis for extradition.

Het is een feit dat Nederland en de VAE beide partij zijn bij diverse VN-verdragen over georganiseerde criminaliteit, drugs, terrorisme en corruptie die allen een verdragsbasis bieden voor uitlevering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over de convenanten met KLM en TUI ter voorkoming van recidive van drugskoeriers

MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked about the convenants with KLM and TUI listing drug couriers, including legal protection, duration of listing and whether the listing amounts to extra punishment. Minister Van der Steur answered substantively on each point, describing the listing as a civil-law measure with rights of access and correction under the Wpg and Wbp and a three-year term, while stating the measure is reasonable and has few complaints.
It concerns a term that can be considered reasonable.
Het gaat om een redelijk te achten termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Reddingsbrigade Nederland zich ernstige zorgen maakt over de afnemende zwemvaardigheid van kinderen

MP Van Nispen asked the minister about the Reddingsbrigade's concern over declining child swimming ability, and whether compulsory school swimming should be reintroduced. The minister answered that parents have primary responsibility, 95 percent of children obtain diploma A, and reintroducing compulsory swimming lessons is not considered appropriate, while promising an update on the swimming education plan in autumn 2016.
For this reason, the cabinet does not consider it relevant to possibly reintroduce compulsory swimming education nationwide.
Mede hierom acht het kabinet het eventueel opnieuw Rijksbreed invoeren van verplicht zwemonderwijs niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de KNVB-app makkelijk te kraken zou zijn

The MP asks whether the KNVB fingerprint-based reporting app for banned hooligans, reportedly easy to hack, remains a good tool and how it will be developed. The minister says the demonstration is not conclusive, the pilot used different technology, and an Amsterdam pilot with attention to security will be awaited, while listing other measures.
Regarding the exact means used, G4S makes no statements for security reasons.
Over de exacte gebruikte middelen doet G4S om veiligheidsredenen geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Swinkels, Van Tongeren en Segers over de financiering van de rechtspraak

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Security and Justice about how the judiciary is funded, including judicial independence, the role of efficiency considerations, funding for new projects and workload from new legislation, and the Warsaw declaration on objective budget criteria. The answers were referred to a separate letter ('Positionering en financiering rechtspraak', Kamerstuk 29 279, nr. 352) rather than answered in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over tekortkomingen in de bestuursstructuur van de rechterlijke organisatie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice nine questions about alleged flaws in the governance structure of the judiciary, including its effect on the bench, on judicial independence and on the minister's distance from the judiciary. The minister responded by referring to a separate letter on the positioning and financing of the judiciary, as the questions were answered there.

The written questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) to the Minister of Security and Justice on shortcomings in the governance structure of the judiciary, question number 2016Z13490, have been answered by letter 'Positioning and financing of the judiciary'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over tekortkomingen in de bestuursstructuur van de rechterlijke organisatie , vraagnummer 2016Z13490 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «Positionering en financiering rechtspraak» (Kamerstuk 29 279, nr.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp, Sjoerdsma, Recourt, Van Nispen, Van Tongeren, Thieme, Van Klaveren, Krol, Houwers en Klein over de brief van een Nederlandse politieliaison in Thailand aan de Thaise autoriteiten

MPs asked the ministers about a 14 July 2014 letter from a Dutch liaison officer in Thailand requesting that Thai authorities open their own investigation into Van Laarhoven, and whether the Dutch government bears responsibility for his Thai prosecution. The minister answered that the request was made at the public prosecutor's request to speed up mutual legal assistance, that the courts found the state's conduct lawful, that consular assistance is provided, and that the prosecutor decides on instruments such as a transfer.
In general, cooperation with foreign authorities is not unusual when a suspect is located in another country.
In zijn algemeenheid is het niet ongebruikelijk dat samenwerking plaatsvindt met buitenlandse autoriteiten indien een verdachte zich in een ander land bevindt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het bericht dat Nederlanders schrikbarend lang stilzitten

Two SP MPs asked the Health and Social Affairs ministers about reports that Dutch people, especially young people, sit for very long periods and move too little, and whether sitting should be treated as a health threat. Minister Schippers answered that sitting time is linked to health risks, that causes are not well studied, and that existing programmes (Gezonde School, Alles is Gezondheid, Arbo rules) and a pending Health Council advice will be used, without committing to a new sitting norm.
I expect this overview by the end of 2016.
Ik verwacht dit overzicht voor eind 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verlagen van de maximumvergoeding voor sociale advocatuur naar 900 punten

Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the minister will still lower the maximum legal-aid fee for social lawyers to 900 points, questioning the rationale, cost savings, impact on access and income, and the proposed mixed practice. Minister Van der Steur confirmed the plan to cap points at 900 (regular) or 1,520 (complex) cases, with exceptions by the raad voor rechtsbijstand, and refused to withdraw it, though many questions were answered in part or with general reasoning.

I will propose an amendment to the Legal Aid Act that makes it possible to limit the number of points for which a legal aid provider can be assigned to 900 points (regular cases) or 1,520 points (complex cases).

Ik zal een wijziging van de Wet op de rechtsbijstand (Wrb) voorstellen die het mogelijk maakt het aantal punten waarvoor een rechtsbijstandverlener kan worden toegevoegd te beperken tot 900 punten (bij reguliere zaken) onderscheidenlijk 1.520 punten (bij bewerkelijke zaken).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de deprivatisering van sportaccommodaties

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport about the privatisation and de-privatisation of sports facilities such as swimming pools, including costs, risks to public interest, and possible national support for municipalities. The minister replied that sports facility policy is a municipal responsibility, that no form of management is inherently better, and that the ministry offers support mainly through the Buurtsportcoach scheme and knowledge bodies without new funding.
Sports facility policy is a responsibility of the municipality itself.
Sportaccommodatie beleid is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het pleidooi de uitleveringen aan Turkije te stoppen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Bommel asked whether extraditions to Turkey should be suspended given doubts about judicial independence, fair trial rights, long pre-trial detention and possible reintroduction of the death penalty after the failed coup. The minister said the government is seriously concerned and urges the rule of law, but that a blanket suspension of extradition and legal assistance would be undesirable, with each request assessed case by case under the treaties and ECHR.

Suspending all extradition and legal assistance to Turkey in advance would mean that all suspects or convicted persons, including for example in human trafficking, sexual or violent offences, could evade their punishment or prosecution.

Het op voorhand volledig opschorten van alle uitlevering en rechtshulpverlening aan Turkije zou tot gevolg hebben dat alle verdachten of veroordeelden, dus ook inzake bijvoorbeeld mensenhandel, zeden- of geweldsdelicten, hun straf(vervolging) kunnen ontlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over het bericht dat extreem rechtse milities de buitengrenzen van de Europese Unie bewaken

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether Pegida Nederland members are hunting asylum seekers at the Bulgarian-Turkish border, whether such participation is criminal, how it is monitored, how many Dutch nationals are involved, and whether Dutch and Bulgarian justice have been in contact. The minister said he has no overview of Pegida members there, that Dutch criminal law could apply under article 7 Sr while Bulgarian authorities have primary responsibility, that the Dutch OM decides on opportunity to investigate, and that no contact with Bulgarian justice has taken place.
I have no overview of Pegida Nederland members who may be guarding the external borders of the EU in Bulgaria.
Ik heb geen overzicht van leden van Pegida Nederland die mogelijkerwijs in Bulgarije de buitengrenzen van de EU bewaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het archaïsch taalgebruik door gerechtsdeurwaarders

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why bailiffs' legal notices (exploten) still use archaic language, whether it is required by law, and what can be done to make it clearer. The minister replied that debtors are entitled to clear explanation, pointed to the KBvG's plain-language legal guides made mandatory for bailiffs, and said the formal wording is largely required by law (e.g. Art. 475 Rv), with simplification of the beslagvrije voet as a further route.
The debtor has a right to clear explanation and information from the bailiff.
De schuldenaar heeft recht op een duidelijke uitleg en voorlichting van de kant van de gerechtsdeurwaarder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de langdurige en omvangrijke landelijke storing in de systemen van de rechtspraak

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the long, nationwide IT outage at the judiciary in May 2016, including its duration, consequences, costs, cause and prevention. The minister answered that the outage lasted until 24 May, caused hearings to be postponed and cases adjourned, cost about 1.8 million euros, was caused by an unstable central network component, and that the judiciary is taking technical and continuity measures to prevent recurrence.
From 23 May 2016 at 07:35, a large part of judiciary staff experienced problems using their IT resources.
Vanaf 23 mei 2016 07:35 uur heeft een groot deel van de rechtspraakmedewerkers problemen ondervonden met het gebruik van hun IT middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een Amerikaanse undercoveroperatie in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether a US undercover drug operation on Dutch soil was reported accurately to parliament, whether mutual legal assistance was needed, and how such activities are prevented. The minister rejects that earlier answers were incorrect, argues the online pseudo-purchases took place abroad so no Dutch consent was required, and states that foreign investigative activity without consent would be raised with the country concerned.
In the case of Marc W. there was therefore no undercover operation on Dutch territory for which Dutch permission was required.
In het geval van Marc W. was er dan ook geen undercoveroperatie op Nederlands grondgebied waarvoor Nederlandse toestemming vereist was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about enforcement of the rules on independence of bailiffs, their links to debt collection agencies, a discrepancy in reported DAS shareholdings, and action against collection agencies overstating their powers. The minister answered that the existing KBvG regulation still applies pending internal debate, that verification of links is left to the KBvG, Bureau Financieel Toezicht and disciplinary courts, and that the ACM, AFM and NVI are investigating or tightening controls, without giving figures on the DAS discrepancy.
In the interest of the investigation, the ACM will not make further statements about its progress.
In het belang van het onderzoek doet de ACM verder geen uitspraken over de voortgang daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over claimstichtingen van massaschades

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen (SP) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about oversight of claim foundations pursuing mass-damage claims, after reports that many lacked adequate safeguards against misuse of funds and conflicts of interest. The minister acknowledged the problems, said courts currently check only limited criteria, and announced a bill tightening rules for collective representatives, while rejecting a mandatory public annual accounts requirement and a separate Onderzoeksraad for mass damages.
In practice, the review against the criterion of sufficiently safeguarded interests has so far been limited.
In de praktijk blijkt de toetsing aan het criterium van de voldoende gewaarborgde belangen tot op heden beperkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Bommel over het schenden van mensenrechten in Brazilië in de aanloop naar de Olympische Spelen

Two SP MPs asked the ministers about police violence and erosion of protest and expression rights in Brazil ahead of the Olympics, and whether the Netherlands would raise these concerns with Brazilian authorities and the Olympic Committee. The minister acknowledged serious concern about urban violence and police conduct, said the Netherlands raises human rights issues in bilateral and EU dialogues and at the consulate, and said it would voice concern about the anti-terrorism law if it restricts protest or expression, but did not commit to a specific new initiative with the Olympic Committee.
If application of this law indeed leads to restriction of the right to peaceful protest or freedom of expression, the Netherlands will express its concern about this to the Brazilian authorities.

Indien toepassing van deze wet inderdaad leidt tot inperking van het recht op vreedzame protesten of vrijheid van meningsuiting, zal Nederland zijn zorg hierover uiten aan de Braziliaanse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Nispen over het artikel ‘Griffierecht hoort in het medisch tuchtrecht niet thuis’

MPs Leijten and Van Nispen asked whether the government still plans a 50-euro court fee for health-care disciplinary cases and whether that fee serves the public interest. Minister Schippers confirmed the plan, citing parallel fees for legal professions, argued it filters out unsuitable complaints while refunding founded ones, and said she will submit a bill to the Wet BIG.
I intend to submit a bill to parliament to include the court fee in the Wet BIG.
Ik ben voornemens om een wetsvoorstel voor te leggen aan het parlement om het griffierecht op te nemen in de Wet BIG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rechtsbijstand aan slachtoffers van ernstige gewelds- en zedenmisdrijven

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Justice Minister about legal aid for victims of serious violent and sexual crimes, including the LANGZS black book, referrals by Slachtofferhulp Nederland, Raad voor Rechtsbijstand fee points and budget cuts. The minister answered that referrals have been stimulated and fee points are under review with stakeholders, but largely pointed to existing policy and promised further consultation without committing to new structural changes.
My ministry has asked the organisations concerned to respond to the cases mentioned in the black book.
Mijn ministerie heeft de betrokken organisaties gevraagd om een reactie op de in het Zwartboek genoemde casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over nader onderzoek naar het verband tussen het gebruik van bepaalde medicijnen en agressie

Two MPs from the SP asked the Justice and Health ministers about research into links between antidepressant or benzodiazepine use and aggression, the Public Prosecution Service's stance on such research, and whether suspects should be tested for medication. The minister replied that pharmacovigilance via Lareb and the CBG already handles side-effect reporting, that no legal basis for mandatory blood tests of suspects should be created, and pointed to ZonMw research funding.
At present there is no legal basis for taking blood samples from suspects after a (violent) offence to determine whether medication has been used.
Op dit moment is er geen wettelijke grondslag om na een (gewelds)delict bloedmonsters af te nemen bij verdachten om te achterhalen of er sprake is van gebruik van geneesmiddelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het melden van verdachte of ongebruikelijke transacties door notarissen en de angst voor bedreigingen als gevolg daarvan

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether the notary's name in an unusual-transaction report later appears in criminal files, and about notaries who fear threats and therefore do not report or refuse cases. The minister replied that reports must be made under the Wwft, that threats can be reported to the national prosecutor and protected via anonymous-witness or witness-protection measures, and that anonymous reporting is not possible within current law because verification and follow-up are needed.
Anonymous reporting to the FIU of an unusual transaction is not possible within the current legal framework.
Anoniem melden bij de FIU van een ongebruikelijke transactie is binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders niet mogelijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de sterke afname van contacten bij het Juridisch Loket

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why contacts at the Juridisch Loket (legal aid desks) fell sharply, whether access to legal aid is threatened, and what the government will do to keep it accessible. The Minister attributes the fall partly to supply-side changes such as reduced opening hours and a shift to telephone service, denies a budget shortfall or a gap in legal aid, and says a monitoring report and reform reactions will follow.
The Juridisch Loket continuously adjusts its range of assistance to the volume of demand from people seeking legal help in relation to the available budget.
Het Juridisch Loket stemt zijn hulpaanbod voortdurend af op de omvang van de vraag van rechtzoekenden in relatie tot het beschikbare budget.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over strafrechtelijke boetes in de schuldhulpverlening

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked about a Rotterdam court ruling forcing the CJIB into a debt-settlement arrangement, the inability to include recent versus nearly-expired criminal fines in voluntary debt schemes, and whether this would lead to more forced settlements. The State Secretary defended the enforcement of criminal fines, citing installment options, clemency, and the statute of limitations extension, and said he finds widespread final debt relief undesirable.
For Wahv sanctions, as stated in the answer to question 2, since 1 January 2016 further collection of outstanding Wahv sanctions is ended after a successfully completed voluntary debt settlement.

Voor de Wahv-sancties geldt dat, zoals in antwoord op vraag 2 gemeld, sinds 1 januari 2016 de verdere inning van openstaande Wahv-sancties wordt beëindigd na een succesvol afgeronde minnelijke schuldregeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een toekomstig tekort bij het Nederlands Register Gerechtelijk Deskundigen

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how he views the NRGD's 2015 annual report on budget cuts (taakstelling) and the future of the forensic expert register. The minister replied that the NRGD must absorb the coalition-agreement cuts while keeping its statutory tasks, outlined his expectations for the register's expansion and cost review, and said he would not commit to more funding beyond the stated framework.
I expect that the NRGD, like other government organisations, will implement the efficiency cuts in its business operations as set out in the coalition agreement.
Daarbij verwacht ik dat ook het NRGD, net zoals andere organisaties van het Rijk, de in het regeerakkoord opgenomen taakstellingen op de bedrijfsvoering invult.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het halveren van de subsidie van de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Rechtspraak

An SP MP asks the Minister of Security and Justice why the subsidy to the judges' and prosecutors' association NVvR was halved, questioning its link to the association's critical stance on budget cuts and the planned loss of its consent right. The minister answers that budget constraints required cuts to non-statutory subsidies, denies any link to the association's positions, and says NVvR advice will continue to be requested and the subsidy will not be reversed.

There is no relationship whatsoever between this cut and the NVvR's activities and positions on any file, nor does this cut anticipate the outcome of a discussion yet to be held about the future powers the NVvR should receive as a trade association in the system.

Er is geen enkele relatie tussen deze korting en de activiteiten en standpunten van de NVvR op enig dossier, noch anticipeert deze korting op de uitkomst over een nog te voeren discussie over de toekomstige bevoegdheden die de NVvR moet krijgen als vakvereniging in het stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over samenwerkingsverbanden tussen notarissen en niet-notarissen

An MP asks the Minister of Justice and Security about the KNB's Interdisciplinary Cooperation (IDS) regulation 2015, which governs notaries working with non-notaries, and about related cases such as the Nationale Notaris and HEMA notary models. The Minister approves the regulation, says it is consistent with law and the public interest, and states that the BFT supervises compliance but does not specifically audit cooperation arrangements absent specific signals.
The BFT, as integral supervisor, follows developments with interest and will use its powers where necessary.
Het BFT, als integraal toezichthouder, volgt de ontwikkelingen met belangstelling en zal waar nodig gebruik maken van zijn bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het griffierecht voor onvermogenden en het recht op toegang tot het recht

MP Van Nispen asks the Minister of Justice about the consequences of a Supreme Court ruling that charging court fees to people without income or assets violates the right of access to court, and whether fee levels, a hardship clause or other measures will be considered. The minister answers that the ruling lets judges waive fees in cases of inability to pay, that individual assessment applies, that no generic fee reduction or express hardship clause is planned, and that applicants can raise inability to pay with the registrar or judge.
This ruling of the Supreme Court means that the judge can also exempt the litigant from paying court fees in civil proceedings in case of inability to pay.
Dit arrest van de Hoge Raad heeft tot gevolg dat de rechter ook in civielrechtelijke procedures de rechtzoekende kan vrijstellen van betaling van griffierecht in geval van betalingsonmacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de rechtszaak over hoge ontruimingskosten is gestopt

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that a disciplinary case over high eviction costs by bailiffs was withdrawn, and whether unnecessary costs will be prevented and refunded. The minister replied that the disciplinary ruling is now final, that bailiffs must assess case by case whether a second notice is necessary, and that the KBvG will issue guidance and reminders to members, but refused to decide individual cost disputes.
It is not for me, nor for the KBvG, to determine in individual cases whether costs were unnecessarily incurred.
Het is niet aan mij, noch aan de KBvG om in individuele gevallen te bepalen of kosten onnodig gemaakt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over de onthulling in de Panama Papers dat een Rotterdams notariskantoor mee heeft gewerkt aan dubieuze financiële constructies

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether a Rotterdam notary firm helping set up dubious financial structures, revealed by the Panama Papers, breached notarial duties and whether investigation is warranted. The Minister said he awaits the outcome of an investigation by the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, which the firm itself reported, and sees no reason yet for broader inquiry into Dutch notaries and lawyers, while stating that helping move money out of the tax authorities' view is not a notary's task and is criminal.
Pending the outcome of that, I refrain from judging the situation and for now see no reason to launch broader investigation into Dutch lawyers and notaries.

In afwachting van de resultaten hiervan onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de situatie en zie ik vooralsnog geen aanleiding om een breder onderzoek naar Nederlandse advocaten en notarissen in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de mogelijkheden de transparantie te vergroten bij rechterlijke zaakstoedeling

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister about the lack of transparency in how courts assign cases to individual judges and whether objective, publicly known criteria will be introduced. The minister agreed the current differentiated system is vulnerable and open to improvement, pointing to the Code zaakstoedeling and digitalisation programmes (KEI and Taskforce OM-ZM) expected to be completed in 2016-2017.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over mensenrechten in relatie tot grote sportevenementen

MP Van Nispen asked the minister how sports event awarding rules and criteria could protect human rights, how the EU guidelines might be strengthened, and what Dutch steps follow during the EU presidency. The minister answered that awarding is the responsibility of sports bodies, that the Netherlands will push for transparency and good governance via EU Council conclusions, and that the EU's limited competence and non-binding guidelines prevent binding rules.
It is not possible to make binding agreements within the EU on this theme, because the EU has only a supporting competence in the field of sport.
Het is niet mogelijk om binnen de EU bindende afspraken te maken over dit thema, omdat de EU op het terrein van sport alleen een ondersteunende bevoegdheid heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over de samenwerking tussen het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) en Belastingdienst in ontnemingskwesties

MPs Van Nispen and Gesthuizen asked why cooperation between the Public Prosecution Service (OM) and the Tax Authority on confiscating criminal assets was so weak for eighteen years and why the AAFD protocol came only in 2015. The minister replied that cooperation does exist, that the protocol is not a dead letter, and that the Prosecution Service and Tax Authority will tighten the rules and the Lower House will be informed later.
Following the recommendations of the Investigation Committee, the College of Procurators-General is revising the Aanwijzing and Instructie on asset confiscation.
Naar aanleiding van de aanbevelingen van de Onderzoekscommissie herziet het College van procureurs-generaal de Aanwijzing en de Instructie afpakken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de onafhankelijkheid van deurwaarders en de verwevenheid met incassobureaus

SP MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Minister of Justice about the independence of bailiffs (gerechtsdeurwaarders) and their ties to debt-collection agencies, including the role of legal insurer DAS and the use of 'incasso & gerechtsdeurwaarders' branding. The minister replied that the 49% third-party stake cap and participation ban in the current KBvG regulation adequately protect independence, that enforcement of these rules rests mainly with the KBvG and disciplinary court, and that misuse of the bailiff title will be addressed through the new register and criminal complaints.
It is primarily up to the KBvG to give form to independence in professional practice through its regulatory power.
Het is primair aan de KBvG om de onafhankelijkheid in de beroepspraktijk vorm te geven met haar verordenende bevoegdheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de benoeming van de topambtenaar die zich op het Ministerie bezig hield met de Raad van State tot staatsraad

An SP MP asked whether the senior official who handled the Council of State reform bill was appointed to the Council of State shortly afterwards, and whether this created a conflict of interest. The Minister answered that the appointment followed standard procedure, that the bill was only at the nader rapport stage when the appointment was made, and that there is no conflict of interest.
There is no question of an appearance of conflict of interest or a dubious transfer.
Van schijn van belangenverstrengeling en een dubieuze overstap is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Swinkels over het opheffen van drie onderzoeksgebieden bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

MPs Van Nispen and Swinkels asked whether the NFI has stopped handling new handwriting, paint and hair comparison cases in-house and outsourced them despite earlier assurances. The Minister confirms that since 1 January 2016 these cases are outsourced to accredited external labs, with about five extra working days and an estimated cost of EUR 150 per hour, and says the NFI retains archiving and quality oversight without checking results.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Twee keer per dag vergeet justitie verdachte op te halen’

MPs asked the Justice Minister about reports that suspects are often not transported to court hearings, with hundreds of cases where transport was never requested. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service, not DV&O, requests transport, that court-data figures cannot establish causes, that adjournment costs about 87,000 euro per year, and that DJI is exploring earlier notice of the right to waive attendance.
The figures show the number of cases the Council for the Judiciary reports as adjourned because a suspect did not appear on time for the hearing.
De cijfers geven het aantal zaken weer dat volgens uitvraag van de RvdR wordt aangehouden wegens het niet tijdig verschijnen van een verdachte op de zitting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de signalen dat DNA-onderzoeken door het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) zijn vertraagd

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why about 250 DNA investigations at the Netherlands Forensic Institute were delayed, whether the delays exceed three months, and how workload, sick leave, reorganisation and budget cuts will be addressed. The Minister attributes the delays to combined factors such as MH17 work, sick leave, reorganisation and year-end inflow, reports the backlog reduced to 74 cases, announces temporary extra capacity and €5 million extra budget, and commits to sending the triennial forensic signalering to parliament before the summer recess and to a study of management culture at the NFI.
Only after completion will I send the triennial signalering to the House.
Eerst na afronding zal ik de driejaarlijks signalering aan de Kamer doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht 'Onderzoek naar moord in gedrang volgens hoofdofficier justitie Breda'

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the Breda public prosecution service might stop investigating difficult murder cases due to capacity constraints and budget cuts. The Minister replied that no investigation is being stopped, that prioritisation is an ordinary part of operational decisions, and that budgets for the prosecution service are being increased.
The chief public prosecutor does not say in the interview that he is stopping difficult investigations into liquidations.
De hoofdofficier zegt in het interview niet dat hij stopt met lastige opsporingsonderzoeken naar liquidaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de noodkreet van verontruste rechters

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Justice about judges' concerns over the judiciary's Meerjarenplan, court-map reform, productivity pressure, and the relationship between management and staff, as raised in a Tegenlicht survey. The minister answered that the Raad voor de rechtspraak shares several concerns, points to ongoing talks and evaluation of the HGK law, and says funding will be addressed in price negotiations.
I do not want to anticipate the outcomes of this evaluation.
Ik wil niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten van deze evaluatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren, Swinkels en Van Nispen over de arrestatie van enkele demonstranten te Spijkenisse

MPs from GroenLinks, D66 and SP asked whether the arrest of demonstrators in Spijkenisse and the handover of one arrestee to the aliens police was lawful and compatible with freedom of expression. The Minister answers that the demonstrators defied repeated police orders to move to a designated location, that nine were released the same day, and that one was handed to the aliens police only to establish her identity, after which she was released without detention.
For that reason she was handed over on Sunday morning, in line with established policy, to the aliens police to establish her identity.
Daarom is zij zondagochtend, conform vastgesteld beleid, overgedragen aan de vreemdelingenpolitie om haar identiteit vast te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat de politie zelf drugs gaat testen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police will test drugs themselves, questioning the reasons, timelines, quality, training, capacity and future of the arrangement. The minister answered that pilots showed on-site police testing with NFI interpretation is quick (about 24 hours versus 19-21 days), equivalent in quality, needs only a two-day training for technical handling, and does not require extra police capacity, while noting extra NFI funding of 5 million euro from 2016.
The outcomes were in all cases the same.
De uitkomsten waren in alle gevallen gelijk.
