Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Swinkels over de nieuwe onthullingen rondom de Teevendeal

MPs Van Nispen and Swinkels asked the Justice Minister about new revelations in the Teeven deal, including whether he knew the search for a backup was halted in June 2014 and how this affected a debate. The minister answered that he was not aware during the December debate, was not informed of the Nieuwsuur publication before the January debate, and guarantees IT staff will not face negative consequences for speaking openly.

At the time of the parliamentary debate on the investigation into Professor Maat on 20 January 2016, I was not aware of the content of the Nieuwsuur publication, and therefore it did not influence my position in the debate.

Ten tijde van het Kamerdebat over het onderzoek naar professor Maat op 20 januari 2016 was ik niet op de hoogte van de inhoud van de publicatie van Nieuwsuur en heeft dit derhalve mijn houding in het debat niet beïnvloed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de overdracht van een tot levenslang veroordeelde aan Engeland

MP Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why a life-sentenced Englishman was to be transferred to England, what the reasons and agreements were, how dangerous detainees would be prevented from early release, and why victims' relatives were not informed. The minister answered that DJI initiated a proposed transfer, the public prosecutor advised negatively after relatives were consulted, the proposal was withdrawn on 20 January, and procedures for involving relatives have been tightened.
The OM has informed me that the arrangements for involving next of kin in such cases have been tightened.
Het OM heeft mij laten weten dat de afspraken met betrekking tot het betrekken van nabestaanden in dit soort gevallen zijn aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat sport voor kinderen onbetaalbaar wordt

MPs Van Nispen asked whether the rising cost of youth sports clubs, and the reported strain on club finances, is a concern and what the government will do. The minister says sport must be affordable, points to Jeugdsportfonds funding, notes that municipalities set their own sports spending and that club finances appear stable, and promises extra money for low-income children.
Yes, sport must be affordable for everyone.
Ja, sport moet betaalbaar zijn voor iedereen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Bashir over de weinig coulante houding van de Belastingdienst bij vermissingszaken

MPs Van Nispen and Bashir asked why the Tax Administration persisted with a payment order and showed little leniency toward the relatives of a missing taxpayer, and whether it follows a protocol for missing persons. The State Secretary acknowledged the handling was regrettable, described an ongoing protocol with Slachtofferhulp Nederland and a planned verification via the national missing persons register.

The letter the trustee sent to the Tax Administration should have led to immediately blocking all ongoing activities and pursuing settlement of outstanding tax matters in consultation with the trustee.

De brief die de bewindvoerder aan de Belastingdienst heeft gestuurd, had ertoe moeten leiden alle lopende activiteiten onmiddellijk te blokkeren en in overleg met de bewindvoerder afwikkeling van lopende belastingaangelegenheden na te streven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt c.s. over het politieonderzoek naar professor Maat, dat de minister keer op keer op keer weigerde om openbaar te maken

MPs Omtzigt and others asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the police investigation into professor Maat's MH17 role was kept confidential and heavily redacted under the Wob, and whether the termination of his cooperation was justified. The minister answered that the file was made available to parliament confidentially under article 68 of the Constitution, that redactions protected officials' personal policy views and witness cooperation, and that he apologised to Maat for reacting too emotionally.
the file, including the witness statements, has been made available for confidential inspection by your House since 2 December 2015.
het dossier, waaronder de getuigenverklaringen, vanaf 2 december 2015 ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd in uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over financiering van verhoorbijstand

An SP MP asked the Dutch government about the implementation of police interrogation assistance for suspects, including room adaptations, staffing of about 200 FTE, the basis of the 11.5 million euro estimate, interrogation durations, and whether lawyers would remain available. The minister answered that room assessments were due in Q1 2016, staffing would come from existing capacity pending an impact analysis, the cost estimate used 1-2 lawyer points, and no exact duration data exist, with no evidence yet of fewer available duty lawyers.
When this is completed, it will of course be shared with your House in the context of the treatment of the bill.
Wanneer deze is afgerond, zal deze in het kader van de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel uiteraard met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wachttijden bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI)

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security why the NFI's budget cuts supposedly do not affect core forensic output despite warnings of insufficient capacity, and whether NFI turnaround times have really fallen given changes in how they are measured. The Minister replied that he monitors NFI implementation, allocated an extra 5 million euros from 2016, explained the shifts in the turnaround-time definition, and declined to commission a separate study, citing an ongoing review by Professor Zouridis.
If substantial deviations occur, I am informed of this by the NFI.
Indien zich substantiële afwijkingen voordoen, word ik hierover door het NFI geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Nispen over de handelspraktijken van incassobureaus

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked about debt collection agencies' practices, including excessive pressure, threats of measures they cannot legally take, excessive collection costs and time-barred claims, and whether fines or consumer protection would follow the ACM report. The minister answers that no fines have yet been imposed, that the ACM and AFM will act jointly, that consumers can reclaim undue costs and seek legal advice, and that she rejects making excessive collection costs a tort, citing existing remedies.
At this moment, no fines have yet been imposed for the problems identified in the report.
Op dit moment zijn voor de in het rapport gesignaleerde problemen nog geen boetes opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over Brabantse veroordeelden die vrij rondlopen

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked about reports that about 1,600 convicted persons in Brabant walk free, and about how many outstanding prison sentences are actively sought and why the 120-day threshold applies. The Staatssecretaris agreed the situation is undesirable, reported 2,843 outstanding sentences subject to active search and about 10,000 not pursued actively due to likely foreign residence, and outlined investment in information sharing and fast-track sentencing.
I agree with you that this is an undesirable situation.
Ik ben het met u eens dat dat een onwenselijke situatie is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de integriteitsregels van de advocatuur

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about a disciplinary ruling on the professional integrity rules for lawyers in Article 10a of the Advocatenwet, including who may invoke those rules and whether lawyers may coordinate procedural steps with opposing parties with both parties' consent. The Minister answered that the core values codify existing practice, that complaints are open to anyone directly affected, and declined to comment on the individual case, leaving the assessment of coordination and conflicts of interest to the disciplinary judge.
I will not get involved in this individual case.
Ik zal niet treden in deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de verkeersboetes in Nederland te hoog zijn

SP MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister whether traffic fines raised in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high after a court ruling, why he did not intervene despite police criticism, and whether fines will only be raised to improve road safety and refunds given. The minister disagreed that the increases were excessive, said the Wahv sets only procedural requirements, argued fines deter offences, and stated the ruling has no consequences for fines or the 2016 budget.
I do not agree with the finding that the fine increases in 2008, 2011 and 2012 were too high.
Ik ben het niet eens met het oordeel dat er in 2008, 2011 en 2012 te hoge boeteverhogingen zijn doorgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de Nationale Politie meer aandacht moet hebben voor stalkingszaken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the police handle stalking cases, including capacity, expertise, the ZSM fast-track procedure, specialised prosecutors and central registration. The Minister answered that prioritisation and case-screening, cooperation with Veilig Thuis, a police work-process pilot in 2016 and existing specialised prosecutors are in place, while stalking is not always registered in a uniform way.
No new guideline is being developed. The police are, however, working on improving the stalking work process.
Er wordt niet gewerkt aan een nieuwe richtlijn. De politie werkt wel aan het verbeteren van het werkproces Stalking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat opsporingsdiensten witwasdossiers laten liggen

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that money-laundering case files are left unprocessed by investigative services, asking about FIU cooperation, reasons for not investigating signals, and capacity. The minister answered that FIU reports are not equal to case files, that signals are continuously weighed with the OM, that the FIU receives no feedback from the Belastingdienst, and that capacity is considered sufficient with time allocated to money laundering rising.
A suspicious transaction that FIU-Nederland passes on to an enforcement or investigative body cannot be equated with a money-laundering case file.
Een verdachte transactie die FIU-Nederland doorgeeft aan een handhavings- of opsporingsinstantie kan niet gelijk gesteld worden aan een witwasdossier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Berkelse ondernemer die schade heeft geleden als gevolg van nalatig handelen van het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister why a Berkel entrepreneur's administration and equipment were not returned after a criminal investigation, and why no compensation was paid despite admitted negligence by the Public Prosecution Service. The minister declined to discuss the individual case citing privacy, and explained that evidence is normally secured by forensic copy so that owners keep their original data.
For reasons of privacy of the persons involved, I will not make further substantive statements about this individual case.
Omwille van de privacy van betrokken personen doe ik verder geen inhoudelijke uitlatingen over deze individuele zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Voordewind en Krol over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

MPs from several parties asked whether the Netherlands should accept transfer of Mr Singh, a Dutch national serving a long US sentence, citing family ties, a municipal offer of reintegration support and humanitarian grounds. The Minister refused transfer under the Vogp and Wots, citing exceeded sentence maximum, insufficient remaining sentence and insufficient ties, while the Foreign Ministry said it would support parole and clemency requests on humanitarian grounds.
For the sake of completeness I note that I assess Mr Singh's ties to the Netherlands as insufficient.
Voor de volledigheid merk ik op dat ik de binding van de heer Singh met Nederland als onvoldoende beoordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het afbouwen van de subsidie voor de Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken

MP Van Nispen asks why the government is phasing out subsidy to the Stichting Geschillencommissies voor Consumentenzaken (SGC), whether this threatens EU-compliant consumer dispute resolution, and whether the Commissie-Wolfsen findings should be awaited first. The minister answers that budget priorities and private financing justify the gradual phase-out, that the SGC is expected to continue, and that no definitive decision will be taken before consulting the SGC.
As I have communicated to the SGC, I will turn the intention to phase out the subsidy into a definitive decision after a careful process in which the SGC's views will be taken into account.
Zoals ik aan de SGC heb meegedeeld zal ik het voornemen de subsidie af te bouwen omzetten in een definitief besluit na een zorgvuldig proces, waarin de zienswijze van de SGC zal worden betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de werkvoorraden in de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a large backlog of commercial civil cases at the 's-Hertogenbosch Court of Appeal, where hearings could only be held in 2017, and asked about backlogs elsewhere and planned budget cuts. The Minister explained the backlog stems from a 2012 pilot that sped up proceedings but increased caseload, says extra judges are being recruited with the backlog expected to be cleared in 2016, and says the other requested analyses will be reported to parliament early next year.
I have asked the Council for the Judiciary to inventory and analyse the necessary information and will report to your House on this early next year.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak gevraagd de benodigde informatie te inventariseren en te analyseren en zal uw Kamer daarover begin volgend jaar nader berichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Oskam over de financiële gevolgen van het voorgenomen besluit van de Raad voor de rechtspraak zeven rechtbanken te ontmantelen en de toekomst of leegstand van deze gebouwen

MPs Van Nispen and Oskam asked about the financial consequences of the Judiciary's plan to dismantle seven courthouses, including ownership, costs, reuse of vacant buildings, and effects on court users and regions. The Minister answered that the Judiciary projects savings of 6 to 15 million euros annually, that the State owns most buildings, and that he declined to ask the Judiciary to assess negative effects in advance because the Minister's oversight is ex post.
For this reason I do not consider it appropriate for me to ask the Judiciary Council in advance to map out all possible negative (financial) consequences of the Judiciary's proposed location policy.
Daarom acht ik het niet passend dat ik de Raad vooraf verzoek allerlei mogelijk negatieve (financiële) gevolgen van het voorgenomen locatiebeleid van de Rechtspraak in kaart te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen, Oskam, Swinkels en Van Der Staaij over de geruchten dat er extra geld vrijkomt om de gaten in de begroting van Veiligheid en Justitie te dichten en de door de bezuin

MPs from SP, CDA, D66 and SGP asked whether extra money is available for the Justice and Security budget for 2016, how it would be allocated across police, prosecution, judiciary, forensics, probation and prisons, and whether it should be decoupled from the Eerste Kamer risk on fee and legal aid measures. The answer refers the MPs to the government's budget letter for the 2016 Justice and Security budget (Kamerstuk 34 300 VI, nr. 23) rather than answering each question directly.

Further answer: the written questions from MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (both SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) and Van Der Staaij (SGP) have been answered by way of the letter 'Draft budget 2016 Security and Justice'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen (beiden SP), Oskam (CDA), Swinkels (D66) en Van Der Staaij (SGP) Van Oosten (VVD) vraagnummer 2015Z21968 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Ontwerpbegroting 2016 Veiligheid en Justitie»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het adopteren van kinderen uit Bulgarije

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about reports that children in Bulgarian institutions were adopted abroad although relatives might have cared for them, and about EU funding and safeguards in Bulgaria. The minister answered that re-checking about 30 adoption files found no reason to think children were moved irregularly, that a working visit and dialogue with Bulgarian authorities are planned, and that the Hague Convention's subsidiarity and mutual trust principles mean the Netherlands does not review Bulgaria's national determinations of adoptability.
For that reason I have had all about 30 files of children adopted from Bulgaria over the past two years reviewed again.
Om die reden heb ik alle circa 30 dossiers van kinderen die de afgelopen twee jaar uit Bulgarije zijn geadopteerd nogmaals laten bekijken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over de balans tussen veiligheid en rechtsstaat

Three SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the balance between security and the rule of law has tipped toward security, how he would restore it given budget cuts, and whether the police should return to the Ministry of the Interior. The minister denied any tipping, pointed to intensifications, and declined to change the police's ministerial placement, saying a future cabinet could decide that.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het splitsen van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie om de rechtsstatelijke taak en de veiligheidstaak weer uit elkaar te halen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Interior whether he would support splitting the Ministry of Security and Justice into separate rule-of-law and security tasks, including moving the national police back to the Interior Ministry, and whether preparations should start now. The minister replied that the previous cabinet placed political responsibility for police management with the Justice and Security Minister, the current cabinet kept that choice, and any future change is a matter for the next cabinet formation, so it sees no reason to anticipate.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over het onterecht in rekening brengen van informatie- en executiekosten door gerechtsdeurwaarders

MPs asked whether bailiffs wrongly charge information and execution costs, including unjustified bank attachments, and how often tax-authority attachments are pointless. The minister answered that the KBvG reported four disciplinary complaints and the BFT three investigations in five years, that no further consultation is needed, and that roughly 130,000 to 135,000 attachments are levied yearly with electronic information requests and the VISH index used to reduce pointless attachments.
In view of the information provided by the BFT and the KBvG, I see no reason to enter into additional discussions on this matter.
Gelet op de verstrekte informatie van het BFT en de KBvG zie ik geen aanleiding aanvullende gesprekken hierover aan te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het wel of niet verdwijnen van expertises bij het NFI

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister whether handwriting, paint and hair expertise would leave the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI) and how quality would be controlled after outsourcing, and about cost and reorganisation risks. The minister answered that these three areas will be outsourced with the NFI retaining responsibility via accredited partners, that staff will be moved under the Van Werk Naar Werk scheme, and that a follow-up review and budget consultation will take place.
The NFI's responsibility does not end when the research is carried out by other parties through cooperation, but it will be organised differently.
De verantwoordelijkheid van het NFI stopt niet op het moment dat het onderzoek via samenwerking door andere partijen wordt gedaan, maar zal wel anders worden ingevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over wachttijden bij het NFI

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about long waiting times at the Netherlands Forensic Institute (NFI), which cause distress to victims and relatives, and about the effect of budget cuts. The minister acknowledged long waits are undesirable, attributed the increase to the MH17 workload and reduced average turnaround to 14 days, said cuts will not affect core production, and noted a reserved budget for outsourcing to private bureaus.
In recent years the NFI has reduced investigation turnaround times from about 130 days in 2007 to an average of 14 days now.
De afgelopen jaren heeft het NFI de doorlooptijden van onderzoeken teruggebracht van ongeveer 130 dagen in 2007 naar gemiddeld 14 dagen nu.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het betalen van goodwill door notarissen die een kantoor willen overnemen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether paying goodwill when notaries take over a practice is acceptable, what limits exist, and whether there are integrity problems. The minister answered that paying reasonable goodwill is customary, that the Commission of experts assesses goodwill in the appointment procedure, and that no integrity damage from goodwill is known.
In that context, paying reasonable goodwill by (starting) notaries who want to take over an office is customary and not objectionable.
In dat kader is betalen van een redelijke goodwill door (startende) notarissen die een kantoor willen overnemen gebruikelijk en niet bezwaarlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Nispen over het bericht dat het aantal rechtszaken over zorg fors is gestegen

MPs Van Gerven and Van Nispen asked why lawsuits over municipal Wmo care decisions keep rising, whether the government will intervene, and whether higher court fees and cuts to legal aid endanger citizens' access to justice. The Secretary of State answered that the rise partly stems from the new Wmo 2015 and that municipalities should improve careful implementation, with the government able to use supervisory powers only in cases of structural non-compliance, while declining to register social costs and promising a decision on legal aid after a commission report.
It is up to municipalities to learn from these rulings where necessary and improve policy implementation.
Het is aan gemeenten om – waar nog nodig – lering te trekken uit deze uitspraken en de beleidsuitvoering te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over de omstandigheden bij het Europees octrooibureau in Rijswijk en de inzet van Nederland

SP MPs asked why the Dutch representative on the EPO Administrative Council supported 2013 strike restrictions and 2015 sick-leave rules, whether Dutch privacy and labour inspection apply to the EPO, and what Netherlands is doing about labour conflict. The State Secretary answered that the rules were modelled on ILO standards, that Netherlands pushed for safeguards and review, that the Netherlands joined the Supreme Court appeal on EPO immunity, and that the social dialogue has so far produced no concrete results.
However, if it turns out that intervention by a third party, for example through mediation, is indeed desirable, I would like to commit to that, in consultation with other countries.
Als echter blijkt dat interventie door een derde, bijvoorbeeld via mediation, inderdaad wenselijk wordt, dan wil ik mij daar graag, in samenspraak met andere landen, voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de Nederlander die mogelijk 31 jaar ten onrechte vastzit in de VS

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Netherlands refuses to support the transfer of Dutch national Singh, who may be wrongly imprisoned in the US, and whether consular support, his health and the Ombudsman's recommendation were considered. The Minister answered that Singh lacks sufficient ties to the Netherlands and no sentence remainder after transfer, so no exception to policy is justified, and that the Netherlands bears no responsibility for the US judicial process.

Based on a careful review of all available information, including that of the Dutch Consulate-General in San Francisco on Mr Singh's health and the information submitted by his lawyer, it appears he does not meet the conditions for transfer to the Netherlands and an exception to policy is not justified in this case.

Op basis van een zorgvuldige toetsing van alle beschikbare informatie, waaronder die van het Nederlandse Consulaat-Generaal te San Francisco over de gezondheidstoestand van de heer Singh en de informatie ingebracht door zijn advocaat, blijkt betrokkene niet te voldoen aan de voorwaarden om naar Nederland te worden overgebracht en is een uitzondering op het beleid in deze casus niet gerechtvaardigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Kooiman over het artikel ‘De 7 plagen van het ministerie van Veiligheid & Justitie’

The SP MPs Van Nispen, Gesthuizen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice to react to a NRC article describing dysfunction at the ministry, including image management and weak business operations. The minister disputes the article's characterisations, says the ministry manages its operations well and is open and transparent, and promises separate answers and reference to the Oosting inquiry.
I do not recognise the claim in the article that problems are taboo or that we operate in a hostile environment.
Ik herken mij bijvoorbeeld niet in de bewering in het artikel dat problemen «taboe» zijn of dat we in een «vijandige omgeving» opereren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de reddingsbrigade schoolzwemmen terug wil om te voorkomen dat er nog meer kinderen verdrinken

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the ministers whether the government will respond to the Reddingsbrigade's call to reinstate compulsory school swimming and to take action given rising drowning figures. The minister replied that parents are primarily responsible for children's swimming ability, supported by schools and municipalities, and that the government awaits a sector action plan before deciding on further school swimming initiatives.
Once this plan is in place, your chamber will receive a response, including whether talks with municipalities and schools about more school swimming initiatives are desirable.
Zodra dit plan er ligt, zal uw kamer een reactie ontvangen, inclusief het antwoord of gesprekken met gemeenten en scholen voor meer initiatieven voor schoolzwemmen wenselijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat deurwaarders ziedend zijn over het daltarief van het CJIB

An SP MP asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Minister of Finance about bailiffs' anger over falling CJIB fee rates, the price-setting of the CJIB tender, and possible concurrence distortion and fee cuts affecting bailiffs' finances. The government answered that fee structures changed little since 2012, defended the tender as normal market-based price setting within legal frameworks, and declined to answer many questions because the tender is subject to pending court proceedings.
Since these questions are directly related to matters that are before the court, I cannot answer these questions substantively at this time.
Aangezien dit direct verband houdt met de vraagstukken die onder de rechter zijn, kan ik deze vraag op dit moment niet inhoudelijk beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vertraging van de Dopingwet

An SP MP asks the health minister why the anti-doping law has been delayed since 2010, why the number of doping controls fell, and why the law is not a priority. The minister answers that the law is needed for a proper legal basis for processing personal data, that doping is mainly a matter for sports bodies, that she disagrees with the claim that Dutch credibility is at stake, and that advisory bodies are expected to advise soon.
I am in discussion with the Doping Authority and NOC*NSF about the lagging number of controls.
Ik ben in gesprek met de Dopingautoriteit en NOC*NSF over het achterblijven van het aantal controles.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het door het Openbaar Ministerie achterhouden van een rapport dat ontlastend was voor de veroordeelde in de Showbizzmoordzaak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice why the Public Prosecution Service withheld an exculpatory report in the Showbizz murder case, whether privacy of others justified this, and what investigation and safeguards exist. The minister declined to judge while the case is before the court, denied the privacy justification, explained the report was only shown in 2012 and that the reason for not referring the case to the CEAS cannot be established, and pointed to the successor advisory committee and the procureur-generaal.
Since the case is now before the court, it is not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the course of events and the investigation.
Nu de zaak onder de rechter is, past het mij niet een oordeel te geven op de gang van zaken en het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het op grote schaal frauderen met gesubsidieerde rechtshulp

The MP asks how supervision of lawyers suspected of fraud with subsidised legal aid (toevoegingen) has been intensified, how the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand and bar deans exchange information and handle complaints, how complainants are informed, and whether further research into the scale of fraud is needed. The State Secretary answers that enhanced supervision is too recent to show results, that information exchange and proactive file checks have been strengthened, that only a handful of lawyers were struck off in 2012-2014, and that no further research is planned.
This does not mean, however, that fraud has always actually occurred in such cases.
Dit betekent overigens niet dat er in dergelijke gevallen ook altijd daadwerkelijk sprake is van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over een uitzending van Brandpunt waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen aan EU-subsidies voor kwetsbare groepen niet goed terecht komen

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked, following a Brandpunt broadcast, why EU subsidies meant for Roma and Sinti were spent improperly, who checks such projects, and whether the EU should prevent this rather than create a European Public Prosecutor. The government answered that the Roemenian authorities and the Commission are responsible for spending and control, that a full audit chain exists, that new 2014-2020 rules stress performance, and that withdrawing subsidies and a European Prosecutor are distinct tools, while declining to judge specific projects before audits conclude.

Before the cabinet can make statements about a specific case or individual project, it is important to await further investigation by the responsible bodies (in this case the European Commission and European Court of Auditors).

Voordat het kabinet uitspraken kan doen over een specifieke casus of een individueel project, is het van belang om nader onderzoek door de verantwoordelijke instanties (in dit geval de Europese Commissie en Europese Rekenkamer) af te wachten.
Vragen van de leden Kooiman en VanNispen (beiden SP) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «OM trekt verklaring over dode arrestant in» (ingezonden 1 juli 2015).

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister why the Public Prosecution Service retracted its statement that a man who died after an arrest became unwell during transport, whether it had a basis for that claim, and whether video footage exists and is known to the OM and Rijksrecherche. The minister said the Rijksrecherche will investigate all events from the first report to the death, that he will await its results before commenting on the OM's statements, that the investigation will take months, and described police first-aid training.
The Rijksrecherche will investigate in this case all events from the first report up to and including the death.
De Rijksrecherche zal in deze zaak alle gebeurtenissen vanaf de eerste melding tot en met het overlijden onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Recourt, Berndsen-Jansen, Segers en Van Tongeren over de uitzending van Argos over de verdwenen tapgesprekken

MPs from five parties asked the Minister of Security and Justice about an Argos broadcast on missing wiretap recordings, including whether the ADR inquiry into the system failure was adequate, the role of the supplier, and whether the government controls the stored data. The minister replied that the broadcast revealed no new facts, that the ADR found no sign of deliberate human action, that the supplier withheld one detail for trade-secret reasons, and that the police manage the system and have taken additional measures.
It is true that the ADR investigation did not provide complete clarity on all points.
Het klopt dat het onderzoek van de ADR niet op alle punten volledige duidelijkheid heeft opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de weinig coulante houding van Zorginstituut Nederland bij vermissingszaken

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Zorginstituut Nederland was right to show no leniency toward the family of a missing woman, and what should be done about insurance, banks and care premiums for relatives of missing persons. The minister regretted the Institute's overly formal handling, reported an apology and internal measures, and pointed to a model protocol, ongoing sector talks and Slachtofferhulp Nederland's support.
The Zorginstituut positioned itself too formally in this emotional case.
Het Zorginstituut heeft zich in deze emotionele zaak te formeel opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat steeds minder kinderen hun zwemdiploma halen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how she views reports that fewer children are obtaining swimming diplomas, whether this is worrying, its causes, and measures to reverse the trend. The minister replied that she is awaiting the swimming sector's action plan, which will allow the government to monitor swimming ability, and promised to consult her OCW colleague and report back once it is available.
Once the action plan is in place, I will consult with my OCW colleague and inform you of the outcomes.
Zodra het plan van aanpak er ligt, zal ik met mijn OCW collega overleggen en u van de uitkomsten in kennis stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bestaan van verschillende uittreksels van justitiële documentatie

MP Van Nispen asked whether a parallel, unlawful system of criminal records exists alongside the official justitiële documentatie, and why different versions of one person's criminal record exist. The Minister answers that there is a single system, that differences arise from purpose-bound extracts, timing of mutations and corrections of sepot 01 entries, and that Justid will automate removal of sepot 01 decisions by 1 August 2015.
Justid is therefore aware of this phenomenon and will shortly proceed to automatically omit a sepot 01 decision from an extract, including in cases with multiple facts.
Justid is zodoende bekend met dit fenomeen en gaat op korte termijn over tot het – ook in zaken met meerdere feiten – automatisch weglaten van een sepot 01 beslissing uit een uittreksel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat een dj zelf zijn gestolen apparatuur via Marktplaats terughaalt

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police advising a DJ to arrange with the seller himself the return of stolen equipment via Marktplaats was desirable given the victim's risks, and who is responsible for evidence gathering. The minister answered that police, with the victim's help, chose this route given the case situation, that three suspects were arrested, and declined to judge the desirability while the case is before court; evidence gathering lies with police and prosecution.
As long as this case is still before the court, I refrain from judging the desirability of the course of events.
Zolang deze zaak nog onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij van een oordeel over de wenselijkheid van de gang van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over plankzaken bij de politie door drukte bij het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responds to reports that police cases are shelved because the Netherlands Forensic Institute is overloaded, and whether the service level agreement is exhausted. The minister answered that demand always exceeds NFI capacity, that the SLA is not exhausted over the year, that monthly overruns can be carried over, and that unexhausted SLA does not show the number of shelved cases; he will discuss the issue with the LFO.
No conclusions about the number of shelved cases can be drawn from whether the SLA is exhausted or not.
Uit het al dan niet uitputten van de SLA kunnen geen conclusies over het aantal plankzaken worden getrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de veiligheid bij sportevenementen

An SP MP asked the health minister why sports event organisers face no legal obligation to use the VoorZorg medical advice tool, who is primarily responsible for sports medical care and safety, and whether binding rules or an evaluation are planned. The minister answered that the organiser is primarily responsible, municipalities can attach safety conditions to permits, binding rules are not considered necessary, and the VSG will evaluate the tool in 2015 with a possible update and information to parliament.
Use of the instrument currently has no binding character.
Het gebruik van het instrument heeft op dit moment geen verplicht karakter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de ontoegankelijkheid van laagdrempelige juridische hulp voor middeninkomens

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Het Juridisch Loket's new systematic income check, which limits personal legal advice to those within Wrb income limits, leaves middle-income people without accessible help, and whether it is compatible with article 8(4) Wrb and could be reversed with funding. The State Secretary answered that the income test is required by the Wrb and the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand, that information referrals remain available to everyone, and that middle-income people can use free or low-cost alternatives, but refused to provide additional funding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat deurwaarders ziedend zijn over het daltarief van het CJIB

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether bailiffs' complaints about CJIB's low fixed fee (€0.87 to €10.33 per case) for collecting state debts are justified, and how the CJIB protects careful, independent enforcement and the bailiff's independence. The government defends the tender as a way to cluster state debt collection, says the fee is a fixed contribution and that monitoring after award will assess careful collection, and answers that bailiffs could not guarantee collection rates in the NS tender.
After definitive award, it will be monitored to what extent careful collection takes place and what the collection results are.
Na definitieve gunning zal worden gemonitord in hoeverre sprake is van een zorgvuldige incasso en wat de incassoresultaten zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de voorgestelde Voetbalwet en de mogelijkheden Nederlandse relschoppers te weren bij uitwedstrijden in het buitenland

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked whether the proposed football law and existing powers can stop Dutch hooligans from travelling to away matches abroad, and whether mayors should be given power to ban such supporters from away games. The minister answered that the proposal is creative but not simple, that existing tools (stadium bans, reporting duties, area bans under the amended Penal Code) already reach abroad, and that the pending bill should proceed without waiting for the mayoral proposal.

I am of the opinion that the handling of the bill on tightening measures against football vandalism and serious nuisance should not wait for that; the powers contained therein must become available as soon as possible.

Ik ben van oordeel dat de behandeling van het wetsvoorstel Aanscherping maatregelen ter bestrijding van voetbalvandalisme en ernstige overlast daarop niet moet wachten; de bevoegdheden die daarin zijn opgenomen, moeten nu zo spoedig mogelijk beschikbaar komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het tussenrapport over de kosten van de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice to react to an interim report by the Dutch bar association's commission, which found no uncontrolled rise in legal aid costs, and whether the reaction could be sent before a scheduled debate. The State Secretary declined to take a position before the separate government-appointed Wolfsen commission issues its final report, noting different cost definitions and periods, and promised to decide on new measures and inform parliament after that report.

Pending the final report, I consider it neither sensible nor opportune to take a position on the conclusions of the interim report, since this concerns a matter that directly falls within the remit of that commission.

In afwachting van het eindrapport vind ik het zinvol noch opportuun om, nu het een aangelegenheid betreft die rechtstreeks de opdracht van deze commissie aan gaat, een standpunt in te nemen ten aanzien van de conclusies uit het tussenrapport
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het geld voor sportblessurepreventie

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked whether sports injury costs remain about 1.5 billion euros a year and why funding for sports injury prevention is being cut to 675,000 euros. Minister Schippers answered that the figures are the most recent, denied any cut (previous spending of about 900,000 euros, now 675,000 plus 250,000 for knowledge and monitoring), and said sports knowledge would be bundled into a new knowledge centre.
This is not correct. Previously about 900,000 euros was spent annually on the prevention of sports injuries.
Dit is niet juist. Voorheen werd jaarlijks circa 900.000 euro uitgegeven aan de preventie van sportblessures
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het verrichten van gerechtelijke sectie bij zelfmoord

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about calls by a forensic pathologist for autopsies in all suspected suicides, about the availability of clinical pathologists, the criteria for judicial autopsies, and the Belgian comparison. The minister answered that judicial autopsies are ordered by the public prosecutor only when a criminal interest exists, that clinical autopsy is a matter for the treating doctor and relatives, and declined to commission further research into other pathologists' experiences.
From my responsibility as Minister of Security and Justice, I consider it important that an autopsy is ordered by the public prosecutor when this is necessary from a criminal-law interest.

Vanuit mijn verantwoordelijkheid als Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vind ik het van belang dat er sectie door de officier van justitie gevorderd wordt indien dit vanuit het strafrechtelijke belang noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de problemen van achterblijvers na de vermissing van een persoon

An SP MP asks the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the financial and practical problems facing relatives of missing persons, and whether a separate legal status for the missing should be created. The Minister replies that existing legal arrangements (bewindvoering, zaakwaarneming, declaration of presumed death), Slachtofferhulp Nederland support, and voluntary coulance by banks and insurers address the problems, and that a separate legal status is not a good solution.
Establishing a separate legal status for missing persons does not offer a good solution to this problem.
Het instellen van een aparte juridische status voor vermisten, biedt voor deze problematiek geen goede oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Leijten over de signalen dat de verplichting van DigiD met SMS notificatie tot problemen leidt

SP MPs asked the ministers whether mandatory DigiD with SMS notification harms access to services, notably for low-literate people and for trustees (bewindvoerders) unable to act for clients. The minister answered that DigiD is personal, that health insurers use various declaration options, and that the ministry is studying electronic support for trustees, without any concrete new commitment.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is studying, together with various ministries and implementing organisations, which forms of electronic support in situations of authorisation and (statutory) representation are desirable and possible.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties onderzoekt in dit kader – in samenwerking met diverse ministeries en uitvoeringsorganisaties – welke vormen van elektronische ondersteuning in situaties van machtiging en (wettelijke) vertegenwoordiging wenselijk en mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de lucratieve jacht op jeugdige voetbalspelers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport how the government views foreign clubs recruiting very young footballers, whether this amounts to child trafficking, and what is being done about FIFA rules and the age threshold. The minister said children should grow up in their familiar environment, that FIFA rules bar most under-18 international transfers, that the KNVB could not establish how many under-12 children moved abroad, that she supports extending approval to under-10s, and that the Netherlands cannot solve the problem alone given EU free movement.
The Netherlands cannot solve this problem independently.
Nederland kan zelfstandig dit probleem niet oplossen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het op grote schaal frauderen met gesubsidieerde rechtshulp

Van Nispen asks the State Secretary how the government reacts to reports that lawyers who defrauded legal aid can return as social lawyers, and whether such lawyers can be excluded from the system. The State Secretary answers that the disciplinary council imposed a 12-month suspension (9 months conditional) and that the tuchtrechter, not the government, judges sanctions; he also points to the existing removal powers, their modest use, and strengthened supervision since 2015.
It is for the independent disciplinary judge to decide on sanctioning the lawyer concerned.
Het is aan de onafhankelijke tuchtrechter te oordelen over sanctionering van de desbetreffende advocaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over misdaadgeld en de werkelijkheid van voordeelsontneming

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice and Security about a study claiming asset confiscation mainly targets petty offenders, and why reported confiscation figures differ from the study's data. The minister rejected the 'petty offenders' characterisation, explained the scope and data limits, and described the investment and capacity expansion in the enforcement chain.
The picture that mainly smaller cases are confiscated, I consider incomplete in light of the foregoing.
Het beeld dat voornamelijk in de kleinere zaken wordt afgepakt, vind ik gezien het voorgaande onvolledig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Merkies over bewindvoerders die door een lidmaatschapseis geen bankrekening kunnen openen

MPs Van Nispen and Merkies asked whether banks such as ABN AMRO may require court-appointed trustees (bewindvoerders) to belong to a trade association before opening a bank account, and what the earlier talks with associations and banks produced. The minister replied that the Wwft does not require membership, that banks may choose additional measures case by case, that the Wft and payment-account convention give access to basic accounts, and that talks with associations were constructive but did not resolve the problem.
The Wwft does not require banks to demand that trustees be members of a trade association.
De Wwft schrijft niet voor dat banken van bewindvoerders eisen dat zij lid zijn van een branchevereniging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht 'Wanbetalers niet meer de cel in'

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Justice Minister about reports that judges find the Public Prosecution Service too quick to seek imprisonment (gijzeling) of people who cannot pay fines. The state secretary responded that new procedures will require motivation of ability to pay, that data on requests and refusals are limited, and that the government will monitor the effects before deciding on further measures.
The Public Prosecution Service and the CJIB in some cases have a full picture of the debtor's financial situation, but in many cases they do not.
Het OM en het CJIB beschikken in sommige gevallen over een volledig beeld van de financiële situatie van betrokkene, maar in veel gevallen ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over het niet respecteren van de rechten van vakbonden

MPs Van Nispen and Ulenbelt asked whether the European Patent Organisation in The Hague violates union rights, and why Dutch bailiffs were ordered not to enforce a court ruling against it because of its immunity. The minister said he cannot confirm the alleged conflict, that immunity rules mean the court ruling cannot be enforced in the Netherlands, that internal appeal routes exist, and that the Netherlands will raise the matter with the organisation and its governing council.
The cabinet cannot make substantive statements about court rulings.
Het kabinet kan inhoudelijk geen uitspraken doen over gerechtelijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het bericht dat processen-verbaal het verdachtenverhoor niet goed weergeven

Two SP MPs asked the Justice Minister how to address research showing police interview reports (processen-verbaal) do not accurately reflect suspect interrogations, and whether judges and prosecutors are aware of these limits and can review recordings. The minister answered that legislation is being prepared to regulate interview reports, police and prosecution are improving report quality, audiovisual recordings remain a supplementary tool that judges can order played at trial, and the Inspectorate's ongoing study will determine whether further research is needed.
Audiovisual recording of interrogations cannot fully replace the written report and remains a tool that makes subsequent checking possible.
Audiovisuele vastlegging van verhoren kan daarvoor niet volledig in de plaats komen en blijft een hulpmiddel, waardoor controle achteraf mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over de rellende Nederlanders in Rome

MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Security and Justice about Dutch fans rioting in Rome before the AS Roma-Feyenoord match, whether preventive measures and information exchange were sufficient, and whether fans with stadium bans could be prevented from travelling. The minister answered that European information channels were used, Dutch police spotters were present, the investigation is ongoing, and the pending bill on area bans is considered sufficient without additional measures.
In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made about this.
In het belang van het onderzoek kunnen hierover geen verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over de Wet schuldsanering natuurlijke personen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the government about falling admissions to the debt rescheduling scheme (WSNP), rising use of guardianship (beschermingsbewind), and whether debt-assistance attempts should remain a precondition for admission. The state secretary answered that the decline reflects several factors, that a precondition of prior out-of-court effort will be kept, and that admission via guardianship is legally possible but subject to judicial assessment.
It is currently not known to what extent guardianship is imposed on people who do not qualify for debt assistance or are insufficiently helped by it.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend in hoeverre beschermingsbewind wordt ingesteld voor mensen die niet in aanmerking komen voor schuldhulpverlening of er niet voldoende door geholpen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de zorgen over de kwaliteitsontwikkeling van de forensische geneeskunde

An MP from the SP asks the Minister of Security and Justice about concerns raised by the Dutch Register of Forensic Experts over forensic medicine quality, including training adequacy for forensic doctors in criminal investigations and a proposed commission on future quality assurance. The minister replies that quality is primarily the profession's responsibility, that the tender requirements aligned with professional registration, and that no changes to the tender or a commission are currently planned.
Determining the requirements a forensic doctor must meet in light of the state of science is primarily a task for the profession of forensic doctors.
Het bepalen van de eisen waaraan een forensische arts gezien de stand van de wetenschap moet voldoen is bij uitstek een taak voor de beroepsgroep van forensische artsen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat burgers kansloos zijn bij een geldruzie met een bedrijf

An MP asked whether citizens are powerless in money disputes with companies, citing claims that most consumers, employees and tenants go to court without a lawyer, and asked about the effect of legal aid cuts. The minister disputed the 'hopeless' conclusion, gave the no-lawyer percentages from Raad voor de Rechtspraak research, said the link to legal aid cuts is not direct, and noted that the competence threshold rise and a WODC evaluation are ongoing.
The choice whether or not to engage a lawyer or other legal aid provider rests with the citizen, who thereby also has more control over the costs of the procedure.
De keuze om al dan niet een advocaat of andere rechtshulpverlener in te schakelen berust bij de burger, die daardoor ook meer grip heeft op de kosten van de procedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat deurwaarders veel te hoge nota’s sturen

MPs Van Nispen and Karabulut asked the Staatssecretaris whether bailiffs were sending excessive invoices for evictions and whether the practice was widespread. The Staatssecretaris said the KBvG had filed a disciplinary complaint, that the four firms had adjusted their practice, that the KBvG was surveying members, and that overcharged tenants would be repaid through the bailiff and client.
I am following this case closely and will await the outcome of the procedure.
Ik volg deze zaak nauwlettend en wacht de uitkomst van de procedure af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de steeds hogere drempels bij het vragen van extra uren door rechtshulpverleners bij bewerkelijke zaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether approved extra-hours requests for complex legal aid cases are counted as fully approved even when only part of the hours requested are granted, and whether a new 2015 guideline makes it harder to obtain extra hours. The State Secretary replied that approval of the request and approval of the hours are distinct, that the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand registers both (77% of requests approved in 2013, with 75% of requested hours granted), and that the policy and practice on extra hours is unchanged, so there are no consequences for applicants.

I am of the opinion that this way of recording gives a good picture of both the granting and rejection of cases in which extra hours are allocated, as well as the number of extra hours that are actually granted.

Ik ben van mening dat deze wijze van registreren een goed beeld geeft van de toekenning en afwijzing van zowel zaken waarin extra uren worden toegekend, als ook het aantal extra uren dat daadwerkelijk wordt toegekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het pleidooi van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten dat er een rechterlijke toets vooraf moet gaan aan het onderscheppen van telefoongesprekken en e-mails tussen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Dutch Bar Association's call for prior judicial review before intelligence services may intercept lawyer-client communications, and about the CTIVD finding that the AIVD wrongly processed some such conversations. The minister answered that protections for lawyers are sufficient, that the CTIVD found the AIVD's safeguards adequate, and that no prior judicial review is needed, while refusing to extend a judicial-review requirement from journalists to lawyers.
In view of the above, I see no need to introduce the proposed judicial review in this context.
Gelet op het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak tot het voorgestelde invoeren van een rechterlijke toets in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitzending met betrekking tot het gerommel met zwemdiploma’s

The SP MP Van Nispen asks the minister of Health about quality differences between Dutch swimming diplomas, the lack of clear rules allowing anyone to run swimming lessons and issue diplomas, and the implementation of a motion on a swimming-skills research programme. Minister Schippers acknowledges concerns shared by the sector, says a sector-wide consultation took place and that the sector will work on a common approach, with results to be reported to parliament by summer 2015.
I share your concerns about the increased variety of swimming diplomas and the lack of clarity about quality requirements.
Ik deel uw zorgen over de toegenomen verscheidenheid aan zwemdiploma’s en de onduidelijkheid rond de kwaliteitseisen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over zijn uitspraken dat binnen het Openbaar Ministerie extra officieren van Justitie zijn aangesteld

An MP asked the Justice Minister what was meant by claiming extra prosecutors had been appointed at the Public Prosecution Service, how many, and whether a 5 million euro intensification offsets an 80 million euro cut. The minister answered that seven experienced prosecutors were appointed above establishment for counter-terrorism and radicalisation, that the extra funding is not a correction to the cabinet's cuts, and that vacancies are being filled with new staff.

Since these are additional tasks for which extra staff are appointed, these additionally provided funds should not be seen as a correction to the earlier government-wide budget cut target of this cabinet.

Aangezien het hier extra taken betreft waarvoor extra personeel wordt aangesteld, dienen deze additioneel beschikbaar gestelde middelen niet te worden gezien als een correctie op de eerder genoemde rijksbrede taakstelling van dit kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de miljoenen van Bruinsma op een Zwitserse bankrekening

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Public Prosecution Service had failed to respond to Swiss mutual legal assistance requests about Klaas Bruinsma's money in a Swiss bank account, and whether a secret deal with Engelsma, Geerts and Cok explained this. The minister answered that Dutch authorities did provide information to Switzerland in 1998, 2005 and 2006, that no evidence of any such deal was found, and that the Public Prosecution Service's contacts on related matters cannot be disclosed.

No indication has been found of the existence of an agreement that money in a Swiss bank account would go to the persons named in question 3, that the Netherlands would not assist the Swiss prosecutor, or any agreement of similar content.

Van het bestaan van een overeenkomst, dat geld op een Zwitserse bankrekening aan de in vraag 3 genoemde personen toe zou komen en Nederland de Zwitserse officier van justitie niet zou helpen met zijn strafrechtelijke onderzoek, of een afspraak van soortgelijke strekking, is geen aanwijzing aangetroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat de helft van de sociale advocatuur verwacht te stoppen voor 2017

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how he responds to a survey showing half of social-law advocates expect to stop before 2017 due to legal aid cuts, including effects on supply, client refusals, and quality. The State Secretary questions the survey's representativeness, denies a realistic supply shortage, points to rising advocate numbers, promises a commission to study the measures, and says quality is adequately safeguarded.

I have since informed your House and the Senate that I will suspend the procedure for the measures I intend to bring into force in 2016, pending the results of the commission's study that I will set up.

Inmiddels heb ik uw Kamer en de Eerste Kamer geïnformeerd de procedure voor de maatregelen waarvan ik inwerkingtreding in 2016 beoog aan te houden, in afwachting van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek van de commissie die ik zal instellen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over uitlevering van personen aan landen met de doodstraf

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked whether extradition to Texas, a death-penalty state, was approved for a murder suspect and how extradition to death-penalty countries is handled. The government answered that Texas gave a guarantee via the US federal Justice Department that the death penalty would not be imposed, that the suspect was examined in person by a forensic psychiatrist, that Dutch law requires an unambiguous guarantee against the death penalty, and that it sees no conflict with ECHR Article 3.
Extradition to the United States is permitted after the authorities of the state of Texas guaranteed that the death penalty will not be imposed in this case.
De uitlevering aan de Verenigde Staten (VS) is toegestaan nadat de autoriteiten van de staat Texas hebben gegarandeerd dat het opleggen van de doodstraf in deze zaak niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt

MPs Van Nispen and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about reports that super-fast-track justice (supersnelrecht) fails around New Year's Eve, including sentencing gaps and appeal rates. Minister Opstelten rejected the claim of failure, defended the measure as a signal against public-space violence, and said the procedure is carefully applied under the prosecution menu, with appeal rates not notably different from other cases.
I do not share the claim that the use of super-fast-track justice around New Year's fails.
De stelling dat de inzet van supersnelrecht rond oud en nieuw faalt deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Segers en Berndsen-Jansen over de ontnemingsschikking met Cees H. en het bericht Teeven weer in opspraak

MPs Van Nispen, Segers and Berndsen-Jansen asked the Minister of Justice about a settlement with Cees H. (EUR 750,000 agreed), the unclear actual payment flows via Luxembourg, the exclusion of the tax authority, and a prosecutor's side agreement on a pardon. The minister replied that the actual financial settlement cannot be verified further, that the agreed amount stands, that no further investigation into the pardon matter is warranted, and that the Staatssecretaris was questioned by the investigator and by the minister.
After this investigation I informed the House by letter of 3 June 2014 that I unfortunately could not inform it further about the actual financial settlement of the agreement.
Ik heb uw Kamer na dit onderzoek bij brief van 3 juni 2014 laten weten dat ik uw Kamer helaas niet verder kon informeren over de feitelijke financiële afwikkeling van de schikking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de monopoliepositie van de Internationale Schaatsunie en de vrijheid van schaatsers en de zeggenschap over de invulling van hun wedstrijdseizoen

MP Van Nispen asked the health minister whether the International Skating Union may bar skaters from outside events under threat of lifetime exclusion, and whether this breaches EU or national law. The minister replied that competition law falls to the European Commission, which must first decide on the matter, and that sports federations must respect national law but skaters can seek review via the Commission.
The European Commission has the authority to investigate and fine possible infringements of the EU competition rules.
De Europese Commissie heeft de bevoegdheid om eventuele inbreuken op de EU-mededingingsregels te onderzoeken en te beboeten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Mensen met schulden zijn een melkkoe’

MPs Schouw and Van Nispen asked whether bailiff tariffs contain excess profit, whether the government exerts price pressure on bailiffs, and how the CAK tender requiring bailiffs to pay for contracts was handled. Minister Teeven answered that tariffs are cost-based and indexed annually, that the CAK withdrew the tender after being told it violated bailiff independence rules, and that a sample review of tariffs will be explored.

The bill also provides that where there is a serious suspicion of complaint-worthy conduct, the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, the Royal Professional Organisation of Bailiffs, or the Minister of Security and Justice can ask the disciplinary court to suspend the bailiff immediately.

Het wetsvoorstel voorziet er tevens in dat bij een ernstig vermoeden van klachtwaardig handelen, het Bureau Financieel Toezicht, of de Koninklijke Beroepsorganisatie van Gerechtsdeurwaarders of de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie, de tuchtrechter kan vragen de betrokken gerechtsdeurwaarder direct te schorsen.

Vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Nispen (beiden SP) aan de Staatssecretaris en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Man Ingabire in oorlog met justitie» en soortgelijke berichten (ingezonden 5 no

MPs Gesthuizen and Van Nispen asked whether reports of unfair trials and misuse of genocide charges against Rwandan opposition figures are true, whether the Netherlands checks them, and whether extradition or deportation to Rwanda is safe. The government answered that it raises suspected unfair trials with Rwanda, that extradition has safeguards including court review and detention guarantees, and that it declines to discuss an individual case, while describing the IND's Article 1F procedure and its verification of intelligence reports.
As your House is aware, I do not go into individual cases.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, ga ik niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Van Raak over het ontbreken van een geboortedatum op verblijfsdocumenten en in de basisregistratie personen

Four SP MPs asked why residence documents and the BRP carry placeholder birth dates such as 00-00 and whether a single fictitious date would be adopted. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Wet BRP article 2.17 now takes the fictitious date from the Justice Minister, and declined to retroactively assign dates to existing cases because of the consequences for acquired rights.
It was therefore decided, when article 2.17 of the Wet BRP was drafted, not to make such an arrangement for these existing cases.
Er is daarom bij de totstandkoming van artikel 2.17 Wet BRP besloten af te zien van het treffen van een dergelijke regeling voor deze bestaande gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Gesthuizen over het bericht ‘Straffen bankfraude-zaak fors lager door traag OM’

SP MPs asked the Minister of Justice whether lower sentences in a large bank fraud case resulted from the Public Prosecution Service leaving the case idle for two and a half years, and what caused any delay. The minister denied a two-and-a-half-year delay, said the case was reopened in late 2012 and scheduled for trial, that the prosecution applied a sentence reduction for the excessive length, has appealed the verdict, and that there is no lack of fraud-fighting expertise or capacity.
This transfer period, however, did not last two and a half years as the cited report claims.
Deze overdrachtsperiode heeft echter geen twee en een half jaar geduurd zoals in het aangehaalde bericht wordt beweerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over te weinig capaciteit bij politie en Openbaar Ministerie om mensenhandel aan te pakken

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police and the Public Prosecution Service have enough capacity to tackle human trafficking, including forced prostitution, and whether planned budget cuts will affect specialist staff. The minister replied that the approach is working, that specialist human trafficking officers and teams exist, and that budget cuts will not undermine the ability to prosecute trafficking cases.
As a result, it is not possible to indicate how much capacity is deployed specifically for human trafficking.
Hierdoor is het niet mogelijk om aan te geven hoeveel capaciteit specifiek alleen voor mensenhandel wordt ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het na geruime tijd alsnog seponeren van een dagvaarding kort voor de terechtzitting

An SP MP asked the Justice Minister how a minor charge against a party member over a 2012 demonstration could take over two and a half years and then be dropped shortly before trial, and whether this was linked to earlier procedural errors and to the prosecutor's earlier claim of a principled issue. The minister explained that the prosecution was abandoned because renewed prosecution after the court's ruling was not considered opportune given case law, denied any link to ICT problems, and called the case an exception while pointing to ongoing justice-system improvement efforts.
In this case there is an exception.
In deze zaak is sprake van een uitzondering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het Nederlands Forensisch Instituut (NFI) zeventig banen moet schrappen om de bezuinigingen te halen

MP Van Nispen (SP) asks the Justice Minister how the Netherlands Forensic Institute can cut 70 jobs to meet budget cuts, given recent capacity shortages and DNA mix-up errors, and whether outsourcing to private labs will rise. The minister answers that the core production will be kept, efficiencies and outsourcing safeguards are in place, the DNA error relates to a protocol changed in 2009, and compensation for errors over five years totals about 5,871 euro.
I do not agree that fewer staff will lead to more cases being outsourced.
Ik onderschrijf niet dat minder personeel ertoe zal leiden dat meer zaken zullen worden uitbesteed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de bezuinigingen op de gefinancierde rechtsbijstand die volgens strafrechtadvocaten tot klassenjustitie leiden

An MP asks whether cuts to state-funded legal aid for complex criminal cases, which criminal lawyers say will produce class justice, are acceptable and whether their effects will be studied. The State Secretary rejects the class-justice concern, says lawyers choose their own business models, defends the 4.5% cut to the per-point fee for complex criminal cases as a compensation measure, and declines to study the effects further.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs Van Nispen, Van Tongeren and Bruins Slot asked the ministers about reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and about the Health Council's findings on forensic medicine training and funding. The minister replied that existing registers and quality guidelines suffice for now, declined to fund the forensic physician training or a chair, and promised a further update in mid-2015.
Recent signals from the field and from your House are grounds to examine whether the quality of the body inspection should be tightened.
Recente signalen vanuit het veld en uw Kamer zijn aanleiding om na te gaan of de kwaliteit van de lijkschouw dient te worden aangescherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over het bericht dat de politie geen betrouwbare cijfers heeft over hennepacties waarbij geen kwekerij wordt aangetroffen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that police lack reliable figures on home entries where no cannabis grow is found, and about aftercare and damage compensation for residents. The minister agreed that reliable figures are important, noted that BVH was adjusted in September 2014 to generate such data, supported personal explanation to residents and prompt damage settlement, and said a national damage procedure is being developed.

In early September 2014 the police made an adjustment in the Basic Enforcement Facility (BVH) so that from that date figures can be generated on entries into premises where no cannabis grow was found.

Begin september 2014 heeft de politie een aanpassing gemaakt in de Basisvoorziening Handhaving (BVH), zodat met ingang van die datum cijfers kunnen worden gegenereerd over het binnentreden van plaatsen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht ‘Kantonrechter stomverbaasd over onkunde justitie’

MP Van Nispen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a court report of three innocent people wrongly fined and summoned because of a data-matching error, and whether this relates to budget cuts. The Minister acknowledged the errors, attributed them to human mistakes in linking personal data, said internal research found the regular checks were skipped after an objection, and denied a link to budget cuts.
In these cases, as the district judge established, errors were made.
In deze zaken zijn, zoals de kantonrechter heeft geconstateerd, fouten gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de steeds hogere drempels bij het vragen van extra uren door rechtshulpverleners bij bewerkelijke zaken

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that legal aid lawyers face ever-higher thresholds for extra hours on complex cases, and whether applications are routinely rejected. The State Secretary answered that the policy is unchanged since 2009, that rejection rates (around 39-46% in 2009-2013) are stable, and that lawyers can appeal rejections, while not explaining why lawyers perceive higher hurdles.
The policy for assessing a compensation claimed on the ground of case complexity is set out in the answer to question 1.
Het beleid voor beoordeling van een wegens bewerkelijkheid van de zaak aangevraagde vergoeding is in het antwoord op vraag 1 weergegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over beschermingsbewind en het toezicht daarop door de kantonrechter

An SP MP asked the government about the rising number of protective administration orders (beschermingsbewind), the strain on court supervision of professional administrators, the lack of a blacklist, bank account problems, and the funding of inspections. The Secretary of State answered that cases rose steadily, that the new quality rules are too recent to judge, that supervision workload is high but remains with the judge, and that no blacklist is planned for now while banks and sector bodies talk about account opening.
I see no reason to consider a black or white list.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om een zwarte of witte lijst te overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Van Nispen over diverse ontwikkelingen en reorganisaties in de strafrechtketen en de gevolgen hiervan voor de bestrijding van georganiseerde criminaliteit

MPs Kooiman and Van Nispen (SP) asked the Justice Minister about reorganisations in the criminal justice chain, including dissolving the interregional detective units in Brabant and Zeeland in favour of new undermining teams, reduced prosecutor availability, the practice of listing only a few offences on summons, and police detective attractiveness. The minister answered that the redistribution is deliberate, prosecutors' capacity will be increased, asset seizure remains a priority, and the ad informandum practice has long-standing procedural grounds.
There is no reorganisation. It concerns a deliberate redistribution of capacity.
Er is geen sprake van reorganisatie. Het betreft een weloverwogen herverdeling van capaciteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Kooiman en Gesthuizen over inzake het integriteitsbeleid bij het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie

SP MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice how he responded to a report finding the ministry's integrity policy was not in order, why the review was commissioned, which recommendations were accepted or rejected, and why no separate integrity unit was created. The minister rejected the negative picture, said several units manage integrity well, adopted two of three recommendations, and declined a separate integrity department because integrity should remain a line responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bijvoegen van een alimentatieberekening bij uitspraken over alimentatie

MP Van Nispen asked why alimony calculations are still not attached to court rulings on maintenance despite the minister's 2011 commitment, and whether this will change. The minister replies that the judiciary decided not to attach them routinely, that a well-reasoned ruling should allow recalculation without an attachment, and that no further legal provision is considered appropriate.
