Given the response of the Council for the Judiciary and the advice of the Council of State on the Bontes private member's bill, I do not consider a further statutory provision appropriate.

Gelet op de reactie van de Raad voor de rechtspraak en het advies van de Raad van State over bovengenoemd initiatiefwetsvoorstel van het Lid Bontes acht ik een nadere wettelijke voorziening niet opportuun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de vrije advocaatkeuze

An SP MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice how insurers are responding to the Supreme Court and EU Court of Justice rulings on the free choice of legal representative under legal expenses insurance, including scope, premiums, coverage limits and second-opinion procedures. The State Secretary answers that insurers have informed policyholders, adjusted work processes and some policy conditions, that premium effects are uncertain, that the scope of the rulings is limited to certain insurers, and that existing complaint and second-opinion routes remain available.
Furthermore, consultations have been held with the Ministry of Finance with a view to a desirable amendment of the Financial Supervision Act (Wft), which regulates legal expenses insurance.
Verder is met het Ministerie van Financiën overleg gevoerd met het oog op een wenselijke aanpassing van de Wet op het financieel toezicht (Wft), waarin de rechtsbijstandverzekeringen zijn geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat er achterstanden bij het NFI zouden zijn vanwege de werkzaamheden in het kader van MH17

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reported delays in forensic work for criminal cases at the NFI caused by MH17 identification work, how large the problem is, how the backlog will be cleared without harming quality, and why extra funds are not used to engage private forensic institutes. The Minister says delays are at most four weeks, that intake restrictions are lifted and overflow work will be outsourced to accredited private institutes, and that the extra funds are reserved for specific cases.
I want to stress that, as far as can be foreseen now, the delay effect on NFI delivery times for the relevant areas of expertise is at most four weeks.
Ik wil hierbij benadrukken dat, voor zover nu valt te voorzien, het vertragingseffect op de levertijden van het NFI voor de betreffende deskundigheidsgebieden maximaal vier weken bedraagt.

Vragen van de leden Smaling, Van Nispen, Bashir en Ulenbelt (allen SP) aan de Minister en de Staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie vanwege berichten «Inspectie kondigt be

SP MPs asked whether the Inspectie Leefomgeving en Transport announcing inspections in advance, and the resulting internal discontent, is acceptable, and about related questions on inspector status, coordination among inspectorates, budgets and merging supervision. The minister defended announcing routine inspections as efficient under a trust-unless approach, said unannounced inspections happen where warranted, attributed staff tensions to reorganisation, and rejected merging inspectorates for now.
Where there is reason to suspect that rules are repeatedly or deliberately violated, companies can be inspected unannounced.
Waar aanleiding bestaat om te veronderstellen dat regels herhaaldelijk of moedwillig worden overtreden, kunnen bedrijven onaangekondigd geïnspecteerd worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over de bezuiniging op de sportmedische zorg

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of Health why subsidies for preventive sports medicine and injury prevention were reported to be cut by 40% in 2015 and ended in 2016, and what the consequences would be. The Minister replied that subsidy to the Vereniging voor Sportgeneeskunde ends in 2016 following recognition of sports medicine as a medical specialty, that injury-prevention funding will be redirected rather than eliminated, and that she expects no increase in social costs or deterioration in care.
I am ending project funding to the Dutch Association of Sports Medicine (VSG) from 2016 because sports medicine was recognised as a medical specialty earlier this year.
Ik beëindig de projectfinanciering aan de Vereniging van Sportgeneeskunde (VSG) met ingang van 2016 vanwege de erkenning van de sportgeneeskunde als geneeskundig specialisme eerder dit jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het bericht dat het versneld afdoen van zaken door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) op gespannen voet staat met een eerlijk proces

MPs Van Nispen asked whether the OM's fast-track ZSM approach to criminal cases undermines a fair trial, including access to counsel, information for lawyers, and judicial review. Minister Teeven answered that ZSM respects defendants' rights (Salduz consultation, legal aid, right to object to a penalty order and go to court), that information is documented in writing, and that a separate government reply on the human rights report would follow.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Van Tongeren en Bruins Slot over het bericht dat lijkschouwers misdrijven missen door een gebrekkige opleiding

MPs asked the government how it responds to reports that medical examiners miss crimes due to inadequate training, and whether training should be publicly funded to prevent a shortage and quality problem. The minister said employers are responsible for staffing, a professional register safeguards quality, and no short-term measures or public funding are currently warranted.
I saw and see no reason to take measures in the short term.
Ik zag en zie daarin geen aanleiding om op korte termijn maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Gerven over het onderzoek naar het verband tussen medicijngebruik en agressie

MPs Van Nispen and Van Gerven asked whether the government will do more research into a possible link between certain medicines, such as antidepressants, and aggression, including taking blood samples from suspects after violent offences. Minister Opstelten answers that the existing drug safety system (CBG, Lareb) already monitors side effects, that the evidence on aggression is mixed and hard to establish in individual cases, that no registration of medicine-linked violence exists, and that there is no legal basis for blood testing of suspects for prescribed medication, which he considers undesirable.
I also do not consider it desirable to create such a legal basis.
Ik acht het ook niet wenselijk om een dergelijke grondslag te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Van Nispen en Oskam over de uitspraken en antwoorden op vragen over een slachtoffer van identiteitsfraude

MPs from SP and CDA asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether earlier answers on the compensation claim of identity-fraud victim Mr Kowsoleea were accurate, why the case remains unresolved despite earlier assurances, and whether the minister will personally arrange talks. The minister confirmed the earlier answers, said the state requested a further substantiation of the claim, and said he would like to see the case resolved soon without committing to a specific step.
Therefore the person concerned has been asked for a (further) substantiation of the alleged unlawfulness and of the causal link between the conduct attributed to the State and the claimed damage.
Daarom is betrokkene gevraagd om een (nadere) onderbouwing van de gestelde onrechtmatigheid en het causaal verband tussen het aan de Staat verweten handelen en de geclaimde schade.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over een teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar haar vader in de Verenigde Staten

MP Van Nispen (SP) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about the forced return of a 10-year-old girl to her father in the United States, questioning the facts, the Hague Abduction Convention practice, the enforcement protocol, the mother's denied access to counsel, and possible reforms. The government's reply is a bare notice that the answers were deposited for confidential inspection by members only, so the substance is withheld.
the answers to the written questions from MP Van Nispen (SP) on the return of a 10-year-old girl to the United States have been deposited for confidential inspection, for members only

de antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Van Nispen (SP) over de teruggeleiding van een 10-jarig meisje naar de Verenigde Staten ter vertrouwelijke inzage, alleen voor de leden, zijn gelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de onafhankelijkheid, onpartijdigheid en integriteit van de rechtspraak

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice how the government responds to a Leiden University study recommending disclosure of judges' financial interests, the regulation of ancillary positions, and other integrity safeguards in the judiciary. The minister replied that existing rules on ancillary positions and a public register are in place, that a working group is advising on financial interests, and that some recommendations on complaint handling are being taken up by the courts themselves.
It is important to continuously pay attention to integrity.
Het is van belang voortdurend aandacht te besteden aan integriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraken van de minister-president en zijn antwoorden op vragen over de rol van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de scheiding van machten

An SP MP asks the Prime Minister whether the Minister of Security and Justice's remark that a pending Public Prosecution Service investigation 'will come to nothing' was improper, given the separation of powers, and asks him to explain his own remark that the minister may speak more freely than other politicians. The government refers to a previous Handelingen answer instead of answering the questions directly.
For the answers to the questions, reference is made to the Appendix to the Handelingen, session 2013–2014, no. 1919.
Voor de beantwoording van de vragen zij verwezen naar Aanhangsel Handelingen, vergaderjaar 2013–2014, nr. 1919
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over het pleidooi voor een fonds om justitiële dwalingen te voorkomen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether wrongfully convicted people wait too long for compensation and whether a permanent fund for investigating judicial errors should be created. The minister acknowledged that past procedures were sometimes slow and that the 2012 Wet herziening ten voordele addresses the gap, but declined to create a permanent fund, citing existing state-funded investigation and legal aid mechanisms.
Against this background, I am of the view that there is no need to establish a permanent fund to prevent judicial errors.
Tegen deze achtergrond ben ik van mening dat de noodzaak ontbreekt om te komen tot een permanent fonds om justitiële dwalingen te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de uitspraken van de minister-president inzake de rol van de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie bij lopende onderzoeken van het Openbaar Ministerie

An SP member asked Prime Minister Rutte whether he said the Minister of Security and Justice did not go too far with remarks about an ongoing Public Prosecution Service investigation, and what he meant by the minister being entitled to speak as the link between separated powers. Rutte denied linking the remarks to the investigation and explained that the minister is politically accountable for the Public Prosecution Service and may be questioned on it, while the prosecution is not hindered by his statements.
The Minister of Security and Justice bears ministerial responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie draagt de ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid voor het Openbaar Ministerie.

m: Amendement van de leden Harbers en Plasterk over het regelen van diverse maatregelen uit het deelakkoord begroting 2013
Amends the 2013 budget-deal tax bill to introduce a work bonus for workers aged 60 to 64, indexation rules, and higher stamp/insurance tax rates to improve public finances.
Amendement van de leden Harbers en Plasterk over aanpassingen in verband met amendement Harbers/Plasterk op het Belastingplan 2013 over diverse maatregelen uit het deelakkoord begroting 2013
Amendment removes earlier tax bill provisions on vitality savings and a reduction of the insurance tax rate, as they are superseded by a later amendment.
The changes in article I, parts F and K, and article XXIII lapse under this amendment
De in artikel I, onderdelen F en K, en artikel XXIII opgenomen wijzigingen komen ingevolge dit amendement te vervallen
Amendement van de leden Harbers en Plasterk over onder meer het terugdraaien van het studentdeel en het bijbehorende gedragseffect van de langstudeerdersmaatregel
Amendment providing budget for education institutions to reverse the student share and behavioural effect of the long-student measure.
This amendment provides budget for fiscal year 2013 under article 6 and article 7 for reversing the student share of the long-student measure.
Dit amendement geeft voor begrotingsjaar 2013 budget op artikel 6 (Hoger beroepsonderwijs) en artikel 7 (Wetenschappelijk onderwijs)
Amendement van de leden Harbers en Plasterk over het invoeren van een overbruggingsregeling voor mensen die per 1 januari 2013 deelnemen aan een vut- of prepensioenregeling en zich niet hebben kunnen
Adds 30 million euros to the Oudedagsvoorziening budget to fund a bridging scheme for early-retirement participants hit by the AOW age increase.
In article 8 Oudedagsvoorziening the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 30,000 euros (x 1,000).
In artikel 8 Oudedagsvoorziening worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 30 000 (x € 1 000).
Motie van het lid Blanksma-van den Heuvel c.s. over een maximale en zo vroeg mogelijke betrokkenheid van het IMF
Asks the government to push for maximal and earliest possible IMF involvement in ESM operations and to inform parliament standardly on each ESM operation.
requests the government to inform parliament standardly about this for every ESM operation
verzoekt de regering, om het parlement hierover bij elke ESM-operatie standaard te informeren
Motie van het lid Plasterk c.s. over een de onderhandelingen over de "by-laws"
Asks the government to push in ESM by-laws negotiations for broad publication powers and an independent audit mandate for the ESM Board of Auditors.
an independent investigative mandate for the ESM Board of Auditors
een onafhankelijk onderzoeksmandaat van de Board of Auditors van het ESM
Motie van het lid Harbers c.s. over vooraf voor instemming voorleggen van een verhoging of wijziging van het maatschappelijk kapitaal
Asks the government to submit any planned increase or change of the ESM paid-in capital, and any call on Dutch uncalled capital, to the House for prior approval.
requests the government, when a capital increase or change of the ESM capital is planned, to submit this increase or change to the House of Representatives beforehand for approval
verzoekt de regering, bij voorgenomen verhoging of wijziging van het maatschappelijk kapitaal van het ESM deze verhoging of wijziging vooraf voor instemming aan de Tweede Kamer voor te leggen
Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 14 over een scheiding tussen audit en non-audit bij OOB's
Bars accounting firms that audit public-interest organisations from also providing non-audit services to them, with transitional rules.
For public-interest organisations (OOBs) there must be a separation between audit services and other work.
Voor organisaties van openbaar belang (OOB's) moet er een scheiding komen van controlediensten en andere werkzaamheden.
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Plasterk en Irrgang ter vervanging van nr. 12 over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar dagelijks beleidsbepalers
Extends the state-aid bonus ban for financial firms from board members to all daily policy-makers.
remuneration of daily policy-makers, other than board members, insofar as it concerns support granted to a financial undertaking before 7 February 2012
beloningen van dagelijks beleidsbepalers, niet zijnde bestuurders, voor zover het steun betreft die is verleend aan een financiële onderneming voor 7 februari 2012
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 9 over een scheiding tussen audit en non-audit bij OOB's
Requires accounting firms that audit organisations of public interest to provide no non-audit services to those organisations.
The accounting organisation that performs statutory audits at an organisation of public interest performs no other work for that organisation besides those audits.
De accountantsorganisatie die wettelijke controles verricht bij een organisatie van openbaar belang, verricht naast die controles geen andere werkzaamheden voor die organisatie.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. ter vervangign van nr. 8 over het opheffen van de chinese walls bij de AFM en het uitbreiden van bevoegdheden van de AFM in de onderzoeksfase
Amends the financial reporting supervision law to lift the internal Chinese walls at the AFM and to widen the AFM's investigative powers toward firms.
In addition, the AFM has only limited powers in the investigation phase.
Daarnaast heeft de AFM slechts beperkte bevoegdheden in de onderzoeksfase.
Amendement van het lid Plasterk c.s. over een scheiding tussen audit en non- audit bij OOB's
Prohibits accounting firms that audit organisations of public interest from also providing non-audit services to those organisations.
An accounting organisation responsible for the statutory audit ... performs no other activities for that organisation alongside those audits.
Een accountantsorganisatie die verantwoordelijk is voor de wettelijke controle ... voert naast die controles geen andere werkzaamheden uit voor die organisatie.
Amendement van het lid Van Vliet c.s. over het opheffen van de chinese walls bij de AFM en het uitbreiden van bevoegdheden van de AFM in de onderzoeksfase
Removes the Chinese walls within the AFM so information can be shared across supervision units, and extends the AFM's investigative powers in the financial reporting supervision.
Because of the so-called Chinese Walls in AFM supervision, information from other departments cannot be used
Door de zogenaamde «Chinese Walls» in het toezicht van de AFM kan de informatie van andere afdelingen niet gebruikt worden
Amendement van de leden Plasterk en Irrgang over het uitbreiden van het bonusverbod naar dagelijks beleidsbepalers
Extends the pay restrictions for bailed-out financial firms from board managers to all persons who determine daily policy.
This amendment provides that the pay restrictions on managers of supported financial firms also apply to all persons who determine daily policy.
Dit amendement regelt dat de beperkingen die aan de beloning van bestuurders van gesteunde financiële ondernemingen worden gesteld ook van toepassing zijn op alle dagelijks beleidsbepalers.
Amendement van het lid Harbers c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 3 inzake het structureel in de begroting verwerken van de door de Kamer ontvangen loonbijstelling voor 2010
Structurally adds the 2010 wage-indexation allowance to the budget of the States General (parliament), placing it on the same footing as the other colleges of state.
There is no rationale for treating the States General differently in this respect from the other colleges of state.
Er is geen ratio om de Staten-Generaal in deze anders te behandelen dan de overige colleges van Staat.
Amendement van de leden Plasterk en Koolmees over gelden voor onderwijstijdverlenging en cultuur
Shifts budget amounts from a reserve to primary education (time extension experiment) and to culture within the 2011 budget.
In article 01 Primary education the commitment and expenditure amounts are increased by 40,000 thousand euro.
In artikel 01 Primair onderwijs worden het verplichtingenbedrag en het uitgavenbedrag verhoogd met € 40 000 (x € 1 000).
Amendement van het lid Koolmees c.s. over het niet inzetten van een deel van de prijsbijstelling voor de dekking van het passend onderwijs en de langstudeerdersmaatregel
Reverses part of a budget reallocation, returning 100 million euro to education by drawing on the unallocated reserve.
With this amendment the submitters want to reverse € 100 million of that.
Met dit amendement willen de indieners daarvan € 100 miljoen terug draaien.
Amendement van het lid Harbers c.s. inzake het structureel in de begroting verwerken van de door de Kamer ontvangen loonbijstelling 2010
Amendment adding structural wage adjustment for the States General in the budget, equal to other high state colleges, bringing parliament's own budget in line with the cabinet's.
This amendment aims to also incorporate structurally in the budget the 2010 wage adjustment that the House of Representatives received.
Dit amendement beoogt de loonbijstelling 2010 die de Tweede Kamer heeft ontvangen ook structureel in de begroting te verwerken.
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over de afschaffing van de huurtoeslag voor bewoners van vakantiewoningen

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked how residents of holiday homes were informed about the abolition of rent allowance, why notices came late, and whether municipalities were informed. The Minister replied that holiday-home renters were not separately registered and could not be informed individually, that the VNG was asked to inform municipalities, and that the statutory notice period cannot be extended.
Following this recent reporting, it has become apparent that communication about the change in rent allowance rules for holiday homes on holiday-use businesses was not clear to everyone.

Naar aanleiding van deze recente berichtgeving is gebleken dat de communicatie over de wijziging van de regels voor huurtoeslag voor vakantiewoningen op vakantiebestedingsbedrijven niet voor iedereen duidelijk is geweest.
Antwoord vragen Mei Li Vos en Plasterk over strengere eisen aan het midden- en kleinbedrijf bij het verstrekken van kredieten

MPs Mei Li Vos and Plasterk asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Finance why SME credit is riskier and more expensive than large-firm credit, whether banks will tighten lending criteria, and what alternative financing and Innovation Fund instruments exist. The minister replied that SME rates reflect structural risk and transaction costs, that credit has broadly held up, and outlined existing and planned financing instruments, while declining to assign BNG a direct SME lending role and leaving the transformation of the Innovation Fund into a national investment bank to a future cabinet.
At the end of this year I will send you a new financing monitor, which will further shed light on developments regarding credit provision to businesses.
Eind van dit jaar zal ik u een nieuwe financieringsmonitor aanbieden, welke verder licht zal werpen op de ontwikkelingen omtrent kredietverlening aan het bedrijfsleven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk inzake mbo-instellingen en derivaten

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether vocational (mbo) institutions that traded interest rate derivatives, now costing them money, stayed within their tasks, and how such risky products could be prevented. The minister answered that institutions must follow the Beleggen en Belenen rules, that the Inspectorate is investigating derivative use with results expected in autumn, and that action will be considered if unacceptable risks are found.
I have asked the Inspectorate of Education to investigate the financial position of all publicly funded vocational education institutions.
Ik heb aan de Inspectie van het Onderwijs gevraagd om onderzoek te doen naar het financiële cijferbeeld van alle publiek bekostigde instellingen in het mbo.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk over het bericht dat het speculeren met derivatencontracten op de staatsschuld tot verliezen heeft geleid

MPs Groot and Plasterk asked the Finance Minister about a Parool report that derivative swaps on the national debt caused losses of around 100 million euro, and about the risk policy and controls. The minister said the state does not speculate, acknowledged about 11 billion euro of swaps taken early in 2011 with a market loss of about 100 million, explained the 7-year risk framework, called the 2.4 billion figure a misunderstanding, and said control procedures were tightened.
I would like to point out that the State does not speculate.
Ik hecht eraan erop te wijzen dat de Staat niet speculeert.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk over het bericht ‘Bank zet trouwe klant in de kou’

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked whether banks have substantially reduced mortgage financing for existing clients with stable incomes, whether banks interpret tightened rules too strictly, and whether high mortgage rates are justified given banks' cheap funding. The minister replied that LTI norms were tightened by recalculated Nibud norms and the Gedragscode Hypothecaire Financieringen, that exceptions and room for tailoring remain, that banks face funding and risk pressures, and that the NMa found margins had fallen back to pre-crisis levels by early 2011.
The banks, the AFM and I myself remain in discussion about this.
De banken, de AFM en ikzelf blijven hierover in gesprek.
Antwoord vragen Plasterk en Groot over het bericht dat een Mexicaanse telecomgigant een bod doet op 28% van de aandelen in KPN

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister about América Móvil's partial bid for 28% of KPN shares, whether the 30% mandatory-bid threshold should be lowered, and whether the minister could change it by decree. The minister declined to judge the bid, said the 30% threshold was chosen deliberately and remains in line with other EU states, and stated that changing it would require a change in the law.
In view of the above, I currently see no reason to change the threshold for the mandatory bid.
Gezien bovenstaande zie ik momenteel geen reden om de drempelwaarde voor het verplichte bod te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen Plasterk over het bericht dat ABN Amro kwijtschelding van leningen aan openbaar vervoerbedrijven in Griekenland weigert

Plasterk asks the Finance Minister whether he knew ABN Amro refused to waive loans to Greek public transport companies, whether the IIF negotiated on its behalf, and why uncertainty arose months after the Greek deal. The minister answers that the Dutch government knew of ABN Amro's position, that participation in voluntary haircuts is the institutions' own decision, and that ABN Amro lacked definitive clarity until February 2012.
Antwoord vragen Albayrak en Plasterk over consumentenvertrouwen en consumptie

MPs Albayrak and Plasterk asked why Dutch consumer confidence fell and why Dutch consumer spending diverged from Germany's after EU consumer spending stalled in Q4 2011. Minister Verhagen attributed the decline to stock prices, unemployment, inflation and housing prices, said the divergence reflects Germany's stronger recovery, and stressed the government's efforts to preserve confidence in public finances.
The cabinet is therefore working hard to safeguard confidence in the sustainability of public finances.
Het kabinet werkt daarom hard om het vertrouwen in de houdbaarheid van de overheidsfinanciën te borgen.
Antwoord vragen Smeets en Plasterk over de berichtgeving dat MVO-beleid bij grootbanken te wensen overlaat

Two Labour MPs asked the government whether banks' corporate social responsibility reporting and investment transparency, including of state-supported banks, should be strengthened after reports of slowing progress. The state secretary answered that banks are expected to be transparent, pointed to existing benchmarks and a forthcoming EU transparency proposal, and saw no need to change current transparency requirements.
I will inform your House about the implications for Dutch CSR policy.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de implicaties voor het Nederlandse MVO-beleid.
Antwoord vragen Monasch en Plasterk over de berichtgeving op 9 januari 2012 over de beperking van de hypotheekruimte voor tweeverdieners

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether major mortgage lenders are refusing to apply the looser Nibud borrowing norm for two-earner households and whether the AFM fines lenders who do so, and what the government will do for households earning up to 40,000. The minister replied that lenders signalled they will follow the AFM, that no fines can be assumed in advance, and that the existing borrowing capacity method is unchanged, with renting as an alternative.

The AFM has indicated that lenders cannot assume in advance that an expansion of borrowing capacity for consumers earning between average and one and a half times average income will be seen by the AFM as responsible lending.

De AFM heeft aangegeven dat de kredietverstrekkers er niet op voorhand vanuit kunnen gaan dat een verruiming van de leencapaciteit voor consumenten met een modaal tot anderhalf keer modaal inkomen door de AFM als verantwoorde kredietverlening wordt gezien.

Vragen van de leden Groot en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Financiën over het bericht dat Nederland € 1 miljard aan inkomsten van Zwitserse bankrekeningen misloopt (ingezonden 7 december

Labour MPs Groot and Plasterk asked whether a Swiss deal like those with Germany and the UK could yield about €1 billion one-off, and whether the government will pursue one. The state secretary answered that the amount seems unrealistic, that such deals keep bank secrecy and conflict with automatic information exchange, and that the government is exploring the figures and conditions with Switzerland.
The Netherlands has therefore entered into consultation with Switzerland to explore which amounts could be involved and under which conditions an agreement could be concluded.
Nederland is daarom in overleg met Zwitserland getreden om te inventariseren over welke bedragen het zou kunnen gaan en onder welke condities een akkoord zou kunnen worden gesloten.

Vragen van de leden Monasch, Plasterk en Groot (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de uitspraken van de President van de Nederlandse Bank over noodzakelijke a

PvdA MPs asked the finance and interior ministers whether they agree with the DNB president that mortgage interest deduction must be adjusted given high Dutch mortgage debt, and whether they will pursue a national housing accord and legislation. The government answered that it keeps the mortgage interest deduction, points to existing measures such as the new mortgage code limiting interest-only loans, and sees no need for a housing accord or a debate on changing the deduction.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat hedgefunds profiteren van de eurocrisis (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

Plasterk (PvdA) asked the Finance Minister whether hedge funds are avoiding the planned Greek bond haircut and profiting from the eurocrisis with taxpayer-funded rescue money, and what the government would do about it. The minister replied that hedge funds must join the bond exchange, that they will not make special profits, that free-riding is undesirable, and that the Eurotop mandate already accounts for it.
It is of course undesirable that some private parties could free-ride on the positive effects of the bond exchange without contributing to it.
Het is uiteraard niet wenselijk dat sommige private partijen zouden kunnen meeliften op de positieve effecten van de obligatie-omruil zonder daaraan een bijdrage te leveren.
Vragen van de leden Recourt en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over miljoenenfraude met levensverzekeringen (ingezonden 3 oktober 2011).

MPs Recourt and Plasterk asked the ministers of Justice and Finance about alleged large-scale fraud with life-insurance-linked products sold by Quality Investments, including the damage, seizures, earlier AFM oversight, and why the product fell outside AFM supervision. The government answered that ongoing criminal investigation limits disclosure, described the seizures and the AFM's earlier investigation and its correction of misleading information, and explained the prospectus threshold that exempted the product from AFM licensing.
Given the ongoing criminal investigation, no substantive statements can be made about the background of the suspicion.
Gelet op het lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek kunnen geen inhoudelijke mededelingen over de achtergrond van de verdenking worden gedaan.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de website van financiele woekeraars, zoals www.voorschotje.nl (ingezonden 13 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Finance Minister whether the website voorschotje.nl, which provides flash credit, is subject to credit regulation and whether it should be stopped. The minister says the AFM is competent to assess the concrete case, that evading credit rules is undesirable, that the Wet op het financieel toezicht leaves no room for it, and that any loopholes will be closed quickly.
Although I cannot go into concrete cases, I would like to note in general that circumventing the rules on credit is highly undesirable.
Hoewel ik niet kan ingaan op concrete gevallen, wil ik in het algemeen opmerken dat het ontgaan van de regels met betrekking tot kredieten hoogst ongewenst is.
Vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over hoogleraren accountancy (ingezonden 15 september 2011).

MPs Jadnanansing and Plasterk asked whether accountancy professors holding jobs at large accountancy firms are a conflict of interest and whether the sector's self-cleansing capacity and separation of oversight and advisory roles are adequate. The state secretary replied that combining chairs with business functions is acceptable if independence and transparency of side positions are guaranteed, that the matter is the universities' responsibility, and declined to investigate conflicts of interest.
It is the responsibility of the universities that appoint professors to ensure that no improper conflict of interest arises.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van universiteiten die hoogleraren benoemen om erop toe te zien dat van ongeoorloofde belangenverstrengeling geen sprake is.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat banken nog te weinig doen aan misstanden bij

MPs Van Dekken and Plasterk asked whether banks, as financiers, can and should push for more animal-friendly pig farming after a report that banks do too little about abuses, and whether the minister will engage the banking sector. The state secretary acknowledged banks' social responsibility, pointed to the Eerlijke Bankwijzer dialogue, and said existing talks via the Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij will address the findings.
Through the Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij (UDV) I am already in discussion with the banking sector.
Via de Uitvoeringsagenda Duurzame Veehouderij (UDV) ben ik al in gesprek met het bankwezen.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het bericht dat woekeraars de wet tegen flitskrediet omzeilen (ingezonden 7 juli 2011).

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether lenders evading the anti-flash-credit rules, with annualised rates up to 400%, are usury and whether he would intervene quickly. The minister said the 2011 amendments bring short-term credit under supervision with a 16% annual cap, that the AFM is the competent supervisor and is monitoring these lenders, and that consumers can go to court.
Naturally I cannot go into specific cases. The AFM, as supervisor, is the designated body to pass judgment on this.
Uiteraard kan ik niet op specifieke casussen ingaan. De AFM is als toezichthouder de aangewezen instantie om hier een oordeel over te vellen.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over steunverlening aan Griekenland (ingezonden 19 augustus 2011).

Plasterk asked whether Finland secured collateral from Greece as a condition of the Greek support package, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether it is acceptable for one euro country to receive collateral while others do not. The minister answered by letter of 22 August 2011, referring to a separate Kamerstuk rather than answering the questions in this document.
These questions have been answered in the letter of 22 August 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, no. 834).
Deze vragen zijn beantwoord bij brief van 22 augustus 2011 (Kamerstuk 21 501-07, nr. 834 ).

Vragen van de leden Dikkers, Timmermans en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken, en de ministers van Financiën en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over speculatie met grondstof

PvdA MPs asked the government about speculation in commodity markets, DNB's warning on leveraged commodity strategies, price volatility, effects on developing countries, and whether EU regulation should match the US. The ministers replied that DNB and AFM supervision is sufficient, that no additional measures are planned now, and that they await European Commission proposals on commodity derivatives regulation.
I consider the financial supervision carried out by DNB and AFM sufficient to address the risks. I do not currently intend to take additional measures.
Ik acht het financieel toezicht uitgevoerd door DNB en AFM voldoende om de risico's te adresseren. Ik ben momenteel niet van plan additionele maatregelen te treffen.
Vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over erfpachttarieven (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

MPs Monasch and Plasterk asked ministers about banks refusing mortgages on leasehold (erfpacht) land and steep leasehold rent increases by municipalities such as Bernheze. The minister answered that banks see no current problem with mortgages on municipal leasehold, that a roundtable has agreed criteria and model contracts to be developed over four months, and that rent-rise validity is a matter for other ministers and letters.
I cannot make a statement on the validity of proposed increases in leasehold rates.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de validiteit van voorgestelde stijgingen van erfpachttarieven.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over hogere kapitaaleisen aan banken (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

An MP (Plasterk, PvdA) asked the Finance Minister about recent calls for much higher bank capital requirements, including Bank of England, Vickers and Swiss proposals, and whether the Netherlands should follow Switzerland. The minister answered that studies give a wide range without a clear optimum, that the effect on lending is likely limited, that Basel III is a minimum the Netherlands can exceed, and that the government will inform parliament on systemically important banks.
Before I make a decision on the national application of the final agreements, I will of course inform your House about this.
Voordat ik een beslissing neem over de nationale toepassing van de uiteindelijke afspraken, zal ik uw Kamer hier uiteraard over informeren.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over Nederlandse garanties over buitenlands spaargeld (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

Plasterk asked the Finance Minister whether Dutch deposit guarantees covering foreign savers at Rabobank's Belgian branch serve Dutch interests, whether such internet savings should be excluded, and for totals by country. The minister explained the EU single passport and home-country rules, said the Rabobank Belgian webtext wrongly suggested advertising and was amended, and gave totals (about 487 billion eligible, 81 billion at EEA branches) without a country breakdown.
However, I have no data on how these deposits are divided per country.
Ik heb echter geen gegevens over hoe deze deposito's per land zijn verdeeld.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de invoering van de Code Banken (ingezonden 29 maart 2011).

Plasterk (PvdA) asks the finance minister whether the Monitoring Commission's delay in reporting on the Banking Code will obstruct implementation of the De Wit Commission recommendations, which parliament unanimously wanted before September 2011. The minister answers that the commission will report in September 2011 and that he has drawn parliament's motion to the banks' attention and will report to parliament before September.
I will inform the House about this before September 2011, in accordance with the motion.
Ik zal de Kamer hierover – overeenkomstig de motie – voor september 2011 berichten.

Vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport en van Financiën over de gedwongen winkelnering bij het kopen van tickets voor de Olympische Spelen in Londe

MPs Van Dekken and Plasterk asked whether requiring VISA credit cards for buying Olympic tickets on the London organiser's site was undesirable, whether it abused a monopoly position, and what action the government would take. The minister answered that the payment choice is the organiser's autonomous decision, that Dutch sales via ATP accept other payment methods so no one is forced to get a credit card, and that no action is planned because the responsibility lies with the organising committee.
That is an autonomous choice of this organisation.
Dat is een autonome keuze van deze organisatie.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de afwikkeling van de woekerpolisaffaire (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

Plasterk asks the Finance Minister about a court ruling that awarded more compensation than the ASR settlement in the woekerpolis affair, the number of unit-linked policies ASR sold, and the financial consequences for the State as shareholder. The minister declines to comment on the pending case, says the number of policies is not meaningful to estimate while the case is ongoing, and states the State's financial impact cannot be given, only the earlier settlement's expected impact of EUR 780 million before tax.
It therefore does not seem desirable to me to make statements about this now.
Het lijkt mij dan ook niet wenselijk dat ik daarover nu uitspraken doe.

Vragen van de leden Timmermans, Dikkers en Plasterk (allen PvdA) aan de ministers van Financiën, Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over banken die olie en mijnbouwbedrijven onvoldoende aa

MPs Timmermans, Dikkers and Plasterk asked ministers whether they share concern that Dutch banks insufficiently challenge oil and mining firms over human rights abuses, and whether banks report adequately on corporate social responsibility and how the minister holds them to account as shareholder. The minister replied that CSR is primarily the banks' own responsibility, pointed to the annual Transparency Benchmark (banks score best among sectors), cited the Code Banken with possible future legal measures if compliance lags, and said he raised transparency with ABN AMRO as shareholder.
In my capacity as shareholder I hold banks to account on the presence of concrete CSR policy and transparent communication in this area.
Zo spreek ik banken in mijn hoedanigheid van aandeelhouder aan op de aanwezigheid van concreet MVO-beleid en transparante communicatie op dit gebied.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over de koopkracht van mensen met lagere inkomens (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

Plasterk asks whether purchasing power for AOW and minimum-income households falls about 3% over two years and whether higher incomes lose less, and whether the burden of the recession and cuts can be shared more fairly. Minister Kamp answers that it is too early to judge the 2012 purchasing-power picture, that the policy is not yet decided, and that cuts are necessary, with the strongest shoulders still bearing the heaviest burdens.
Even after publication of the CEP, it is still too early to make statements about the purchasing-power picture for 2012.
Het is – ook na publicatie van het CEP – nog te vroeg om uitspraken te doen over het koopkrachtbeeld in 2012.

Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over verhoging van de EMU (Europese Monetaire Unie)-schuld door garantiestelling aan het Europees noodfonds (ingezonden 2 februari 2011).

The MP asks whether Eurostat's decision to count guarantees to the European rescue fund (EFSF) as EMU debt is known, who is politically responsible, and by how much Dutch EMU debt would rise, including effects on Stability and Growth Pact thresholds. The minister confirms knowledge, states Eurostat is an independent body applying agreed rules, and refers the quantitative questions to answers given to other MPs.
Eurostat is an independent organisation that, according to internationally agreed rules and procedures, weighed the consequences of the EFSF loan for the gross debt of the participating countries.

Eurostat is een onafhankelijke organisatie die volgens de internationaal afgesproken regels en procedures een afweging heeft gemaakt over de gevolgen van de EFSF-lening voor de bruto schuld van de in het EFSF participerende landen.

Vragen van de leden Monasch en Plasterk (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het effect van de aanscherping van de Nationale Hypotheek Garantie op starters (i

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Finance whether tighter Nationale Hypotheek Garantie income norms unfairly reduce borrowing capacity for lower and middle incomes and starters, and whether the government will reverse this. The minister answers that lower borrowing capacity follows from the 2011 purchasing-power decline, that the effects cannot be quantified, and that no additional government measures are planned.
I see no reason for the central government to take additional measures compared with the Coalition Agreement.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor het Rijk om, t.o.v. het Regeerakkoord, aanvullende maatregelen te treffen.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Monasch (beiden PvdA) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Financiën over het pleidooi van De Nederlandsche Bank het NHG-tarief te verhogen (ingezonden 29

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers whether DNB's call to raise the NHG mortgage guarantee premium to about 1.5% is justified and whether DNB is the right supervisor. The minister replied that the 0.55% premium is cost-covering over the long term, the guarantee fund's buffer is adequate for the scenarios tested, no premium increase is planned, and the fund is supervised by BZK rather than DNB.
In 2011 the Treasury and the WEW will conduct further research into the assumptions of the liquidity forecast.
In 2011 zullen het Rijk en het WEW verder onderzoek doen naar de uitgangspunten van de liquiditeitsprognose.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over hypotheekrentes (ingezonden 14 september 2010).

Labour MP Plasterk asked the Finance Minister about high mortgage margins, whether the four largest banks priced below cost, the length of fixed-rate periods and switching costs, and whether banks should give customers earlier notice of renewal. The minister answered that NMa research shows margins high since mid-2009 and a 75-80% market share for the top four, that further NMa study will examine switching barriers, and that he will consult parties on follow-up measures.
I do not want to wait until spring and will shortly consult with various parties to consider how these signals should be followed up.
Ik wil dan ook niet afwachten tot het voorjaar en zal op korte termijn in overleg treden met verschillende partijen om te bezien hoe er opvolging gegeven moet worden aan deze signalen.
Vragen van het lid Plasterk (PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over beloningsbeleid bij verzekeraars Aegon en ING (ingezonden 20 oktober 2010).

An MP asks the finance minister whether insurers Aegon and ING should be bound by the Dutch banking pay code and whether their pay policy meets public support. The minister says an insurers' code should follow the banks' pay principles, that both firms have adopted compliant pay policies, and that the sector's own insurers' code will integrate the banks' pay rules.
I am pleased that insurers have announced these steps and expect the code to be finalised in the short term.
Ik ben verheugd dat verzekeraars deze stappen hebben aangekondigd en verwacht dat de code op korte termijn tot stand zal komen.

Vragen van de leden Plasterk en Spekman (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Financiën over het online aanbieden van woekerleningen door een Fins bedrijf dat zich aan Nederlands toezicht en consumenten bescherming probeert

MPs Plasterk and Spekman ask the Finance Minister about online flash loans offered by a Finnish firm trying to avoid Dutch supervision and consumer protection, and about rising debt problems and other providers. The minister confirms awareness, says flash credit is a significant problem case, notes the planned Wet op het financieel toezicht and maximum credit cost rules, but declines a new survey of providers because no licensing register exists and the coming law will reshape the sector.
Given that there is not yet a licensing requirement, and therefore no register of all providers is kept, no overview of all providers can be given at this moment.
Gezien het feit dat er nog geen vergunningplicht is, en dus geen register van alle aanbieders wordt bijgehouden, kan op dit moment geen overzicht gegeven worden van alle aanbieders.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over erfpacht in Amsterdam

MPs Ronnes and Van den Berg (CDA) asked whether leaseholders in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands are adequately protected, whether the eternal-lease conversion scheme is understandable for consumers, and whether UK and Norwegian legislative developments should be followed, and asked about a request to annul Amsterdam council decisions. The minister answers that existing civil law (BW title 5.7, reasonableness and fairness, informational duties) and administrative law principles provide sufficient protection, that the Amsterdam scheme is transparent enough, that no change to Dutch law is needed, and that the annulment request was rejected.
For leasehold in Amsterdam and on the Wadden islands, the leaseholders are moreover generally bound by the general principles of good administration.
Voor de erfpacht in Amsterdam en op de Waddeneilanden geldt bovendien dat de erfverpachters veelal gebonden zijn aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht 'Russische whizzkid wordt rijk door jouw documentjes'

An MP asked about Dutch tax returns with citizen service numbers and an intelligence service newsletter appearing on a Russian-run document site, and about the risks of identity fraud, malware and Google's role. The State Secretary answered that such posting is not permitted without consent, that identity fraud risk is mainly from combining data, and that the Data Protection Authority can act but may lack jurisdiction over foreign operators.
The Ap therefore itself decides when it does so.
De Ap bepaalt dus zelf wanneer zij dat doet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat honderden rijken uit Rusland en Oekraïne een Cypriotisch paspoort hebben kunnen kopen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether Cyprus sold EU citizenship via its golden passport scheme to wealthy Russians and Ukrainians, including revenue, vetting, sanctions checks, money laundering and whether national parliaments can see recipients. The minister answered that Cyprus's individual naturalisation files are not visible, that the Netherlands does not act unless national law conflicts with international law, and that disclosure is a matter for member states.
No insight can be given into the individual naturalisation procedures actually followed.
Over de daadwerkelijk gevolgde individuele naturalisatieprocedures kan geen inzicht worden verkregen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aantasting van de positie van de Algemene Rekenkamer van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Dutch Minister of Interior Affairs whether the Curaçao government withdrew a pending cassation appeal, without the Audit Chamber's knowledge, that would have allowed audits at telecom company UTS, and whether the government would act to restore the Chamber's position. The state secretary answered that Curaçao's Audit Chamber and its powers are a matter for Curaçao itself, that the Dutch government will not interfere in court proceedings or the withdrawal, declined to speculate on gambling links, and refused to engage with the Curaçao government.
However, it is not for the Dutch government to interfere in the court's ruling in the UTS case or in the Curaçao government's withdrawal of the cassation appeal.
Het is echter niet aan de Nederlandse regering om zich te mengen in de uitspraak van de rechter ten aanzien van de zaak UTS of de intrekking van het cassatieberoep door de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat legionella doden blijft maken door de lakse bouwwereld

An MP asked the Minister whether the construction sector underestimates legionella risks, whether practice guidelines for hot and cold zones are applied, and how many deaths occur yearly. The Minister acknowledged that design and installation need attention, noted a new CUR guideline (June 2017), said municipalities enforce the Building Decree, and reported 8 to 20 deaths per year in 2005–2016.
I do not have concrete information that confirms this claim.
Ik beschik niet over concrete informatie die deze stelling bevestigt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hijink over het bericht dat gemeenten doorgaan met het ontwikkelen van een BRP-systeem

An SP MP asked whether the VNG tried to obtain BRP source code, whether the ministry will withdraw from VNG's work on a municipal alternative, and whether the BRP code will be released under the GPL licence. The State Secretary replied that requests for the code were deferred pending checks, that no components were shared in advance, that the ministry keeps its commitments and provides no funding to VNG, and that the choice of licence is still under study, with GPL one option.
I have informed the VNG by letter about the commitments my predecessor made to the House of Representatives on this file and that I uphold these commitments.
Ik heb de VNG per brief geïnformeerd (zie bijlage) 2 over de toezeggingen die mijn voorganger op dit dossier aan de Tweede Kamer heeft gedaan en dat ik deze toezeggingen gestand houd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van der Lee over het bericht ‘Subsidietermijn te kort voor VVE’s en andere besparingsblokkades’

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the short subsidy deadlines block homeowner associations (VvE) from energy-saving measures and whether they could be extended, and asked for single-measure subsidies and a one-stop information point. The minister acknowledged the obstacles, announced longer implementation deadlines for complex packages and an advice-subsidy extension, refused single-measure subsidies to limit free riding, and pointed to a campaign, an information toolkit and the new VvE law.
I intend, at least for VvEs carrying out complex measure packages (so-called very energy-efficient packages), to lengthen the deadlines for implementing the measures

Ik ben voornemens om in ieder geval voor VvE's die ingewikkelde maatregelpakketten (zogenoemde zeer energiezuinige pakketten) laten uitvoeren, de termijnen voor het uitvoeren van de maatregelen langer te maken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het vervolg van de sluiting en de ontruiming van Fort Oranje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the municipality of Zundert behaved properly in promising a temporary closure of Fort Oranje campsite and then fully evicting residents, denying compensation for structures, and restricting press access, and how vulnerable residents are protected. The minister answered that the municipality is responsible and accountable to its council, explained the eviction as a response to a sudden closure announcement and resulting disorder, said a rehousing solution was realised after a court case, described the compensation and valuation arrangements, and said vulnerable residents received GGD-based care plans.
It is up to the college/mayor to account for this to the municipal council.
Het is aan het college/de burgemeester om hierover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het dreigement van een politicus op Sint Eustatius om Europees Nederlandse militairen te vermoorden en te verbranden

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a threat by a Sint Eustatius politician to kill and burn Dutch military personnel, asking who 'they' are, the government's response, whether military remain on the island, and whether citizens are safe. The state secretary condemned the remarks as unacceptable, said the threat was not directed personally and the target was unclear, reported a police presence of three marechaussee and no planned expansion, and noted that the public prosecutor declined to start a criminal investigation while the complaint was still considered the right choice.
This threat was not made personally and in that manner.
Dit dreigement is niet persoonlijk en op die wijze geuit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bosman over het bericht ‘Sint-Maarten wijst voorwaarden hulp af’

MPs Van den Berg and Bosman asked whether Sint Maarten rejects the Dutch conditions attached to hurricane Irma reconstruction funds, how the lawful and efficient use of funds will be ensured, and whether conditions unrelated to transparency should be dropped. The State Secretary replied that Sint Maarten's parliament backed the conditions (an integrity chamber and stronger border control) on 2 November, that further safeguards will be elaborated, and that the conditions are directly related to integrity and effective use of funds.
The conditions set relate to the integrity of the use of financial resources for reconstruction.
De gestelde randvoorwaarden zien op een integere benutting van de financiële middelen voor de wederopbouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het onderzoek 'De schaduwzijden van Graniet'

MPs Sazias and Van Brenk asked the government about a report on modern slavery, child labour and dangerous conditions in South Indian granite quarries, including what the government is doing with importing firms, procurement and the multi-stakeholder natural stone covenant. The Minister says a covenant is being negotiated with the sector, will raise the issue in the EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, expects companies to carry out due diligence under the OECD guidelines, and notes that public procurement and decentralised governments are being engaged, though no mandatory transparency rules are planned.
Are you prepared to require companies to be fully transparent about their supply chain policy regarding their duty of care to promote human rights?
Bent u bereid bedrijven te verplichten volledig transparant te zijn over hun keten (beleid) op het gebied van hun zorgplicht voor het bevorderen van mensenrechten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht dat in Nederland dagelijks 30 terreurexperts uit Europa bijeenkomen

The MP asks whether the AIVD head's claim that 30 European terrorism experts meet daily in the Netherlands is accurate, and about the group's composition, legal basis, information shared and oversight. The minister confirms the statement, explains it refers to a physical platform set up under Dutch chairmanship of the Counter Terrorism Group, describes its operational intelligence sharing, and says oversight is multilateral with national supervisors such as the CTIVD able to review AIVD conduct.
Multilateral oversight by national supervisors of the Platform members applies to the multilateral cooperation.
Bij de multilaterale samenwerking is multilateraal toezicht door nationale toezichthouders van de Platform-leden van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht 'Geldverstrekkers huiverig bij nieuwe hypotheek ouderen'

An MP asked the Minister about reports that lenders are reluctant to give mortgages to older people and whether banks use the room for tailored exceptions to income norms. The Minister answered that lenders' use of exceptions varies widely, that some find tailored lending risky or unprofitable, and that the AFM has published clarifications; the government cannot oblige lenders to lend.
There is no obligation for lenders to provide credit or to use the exception possibilities in the Mortgage Credit Regulation.
Er bestaat geen verplichting voor kredietverstrekkers om krediet te verstrekken of gebruik te maken van de afwijkingsmogelijkheden in de Regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een keuringsplicht voor rookwering en balkons

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about fire safety in rented rooms after a fatal fire in Leeuwarden, the lack of a mandatory inspection regime for fire doors and balconies, and enforcement capacity of municipalities. The Minister said no inspection obligation has existed, rejected a mandatory periodic inspection, and pointed to existing Bouwbesluit rules, notification duties and municipal enforcement, while promising only a regulation on CO-monitor installers.
I do not have information on this. Municipalities can themselves determine and prioritise supervision and enforcement of building fire safety.
Ik beschik niet over informatie hierover. Gemeenten kunnen het toezicht en de handhaving op de brandveiligheid van gebouwen zelf bepalen en prioriteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Raak over het landsbesluit van Curaçao nr. 17/1922 van 5 september 2017

MPs Bosman and Van Raak asked the minister about a Curaçao decree creating a ministerial regisseur and supervisor for the new hospital project and its rising costs. The minister said the Curaçao hospital is a country matter, that Curaçao must cover any overruns itself, and that the Cft will assess the budget effects, while leaving the funding and staffing questions to Curaçao.
This is not known to me, but that is also not necessary since it concerns a country matter.
Dit is mij niet bekend, maar dat hoeft ook niet aangezien het een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat steeds meer woningen worden opgekocht door particuliere beleggers om duur te verhuren ('buy to let')

The SP MP Beckerman asks whether buy-to-let investors are squeezing housing affordability, pushing up prices for starters, and whether the government will act or research the trend. The minister answers that investor purchases are about 9-10% of sales, that only Amsterdam shows clear crowding-out of starters, that the government sees no need to discourage investment and rejects the claim that the landlord levy encourages it, and that municipalities hold enforcement tools while research is already ongoing.
About 9 to 10% of homes are bought not to be lived in by the buyer.
Circa 9 tot 10% van de woningen wordt gekocht om niet zelf in te wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de nieuwe terreurdreiging van rechts komt

An MP asked the ministers whether far-right extremist groups exist within the armed forces, whether the government downplays right-wing extremism, and how much capacity is devoted to countering it. The government answered that the MIVD investigates threats from extremists within defence, that right-wing extremism is addressed generically without separate capacity figures, and that the threat is not underestimated.
It is therefore not possible to provide an overview of deployed capacity or financial resources on extremism with a specific ideological background.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van ingezette capaciteit of financiële middelen op extremisme met een specifieke ideologische achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de exorbitante ontslagvergoeding van een ex-topman bij Alliander

An SP MP asked why the government tolerates an exorbitant severance payment to a former Alliander executive, why Alliander won a 2016 sustainability prize, and how the topsalary law and grid-operator rules were handled. The minister answers that the Wet normering topinkomens does not apply to the network company Alliander by deliberate choice, that the prize is judged on transparency, and that the Raad van Commissarissen introduced a pay ceiling and shareholders pressed for more moderation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over drempels bij het gebruik van de blijverslening

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the blijverslening (a municipal-backed loan for home adaptations for seniors) is excluding people with only a small AOW or pension who have home equity, and how many municipalities use the scheme. The minister answered that loan limits are set by income norms and that 59 municipalities offer the loan, and that the SVn is developing a new product for low-income seniors expected in mid-2018.
This product is expected to be offered to municipalities around mid-2018.
Dit product zal naar verwachting medio 2018 aangeboden worden aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Koerhuis over het onderzoek naar de oorzaken van het instorten van een parkeergarage in Eindhoven

MPs Ronnes and Koerhuis asked the Minister of Interior about the causes of a parking garage collapse at Eindhoven Airport, the division of building-quality responsibilities, the status of related buildings, and the scope of inspections on breedplaatvloeren. The minister answered that builders remain responsible under current rules, that the planned Wet kwaliteitsborging shifts checks to a private quality assurer, that NEN finds the norm clear but may clarify it, and that inspections were started at government buildings and gemeenten with buildings from 1999 onward.
I do not know which buildings these are.
Ik weet niet welke gebouwen dit zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Futselaar over het bericht dat de kamernood onder studenten in veel steden hoog is

MPs Beckerman and Futselaar asked ministers about reports of severe student housing shortages, growth of international students, possible homelessness and displacement of Dutch students, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledged shortages mainly in the Randstad, argued the government does not steer international student numbers for financial reasons, said it cannot confirm homelessness data, and deferred funding and levy changes to a future cabinet.
No specific figures are available on any displacement of Dutch students searching for a room by international students.
Er zijn geen specifieke cijfers beschikbaar over eventuele verdringing van Nederlandse studenten die op zoek zijn naar een kamer door buitenlandse studenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Özdil over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse studenten slapen noodgedwongen in azc's, op campings of in hotels’

Green Left MPs asked ministers about reports that foreign students were sleeping in asylum centres, campsites and hotels due to a shortage of student housing. The government attributes the problem to rising international and Dutch student numbers and tight housing markets, says institutions and municipalities are responsible, and promises ongoing consultations and monitoring without concrete new measures.
We are already in discussion with various knowledge institutions, Kences, the VH and the VSNU to gain more insight into the specific task regarding housing for international students

Wij zijn reeds in gesprek met verschillende kennisinstellingen, Kences, de VH en de VSNU om meer inzicht te krijgen in de specifieke opgave die er ligt voor de huisvesting van internationale studenten
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Studeren vanuit een camper’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government recognises that housing shortages affect Dutch as well as international students in student cities, asked for per-city shortage and construction figures, and asked whether the problem is addressed beyond city boundaries. The minister acknowledges shortages in many student cities, gives a 2016 monitor table and construction projections per city, and says only that some cities look beyond their boundaries (Amsterdam via a coalition appeal).
No exact figures per student city can be given.
Er zijn geen exacte aantallen per studentenstad te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de ontruiming van Fort Oranje

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the eviction of Fort Oranje campsite, the minister's responsibility, costs, relocation, and whether other campsites face similar issues. The minister replied that municipalities bear primary responsibility, that the state will support mayors and provides €5.3 million of an estimated €15 million cost via a deduction from a grant, and that no national overview of similar campsites exists yet.
For now there is no national overview of the number of campsites with the same accumulation of problems as Fort Oranje campsite.
Vooralsnog is er geen landelijk overzicht van het aantal campings waar sprake is van eenzelfde probleemcumulatie als op camping Fort Oranje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over het bericht dat slechts 3% van de huurprijzen van sociale huurwoningen ‘in balans is’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a Deloitte finding that only 3% of social rental homes have rent, market value and tenant income in balance, and about the policy response. The minister said the finding is expected given that housing associations charge rents below market level, pointed to measures such as income-dependent rent increases and passend toewijzen, and noted that data on oversized social housing are no longer current.
I share the analysis that the stock of social rental housing can be used more optimally.
Ik deel de analyse dat de voorraad sociale huurwoningen optimaler benut kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diks en Özütok over het bericht dat het bedrijf Fox-IT de zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the Defence and Interior ministers whether negotiations with Fox-IT over state control of its cryptographic subsidiary were still unfinished, why the state dropped its first right to buy shares, what safeguards protect state secrets, and whether other vital-company takeovers caused problems. The government replied that talks are constructive and near conclusion with no plan B, that dropping the first right of purchase poses no risk because other measures exist, that ABDO security requirements and state supervision apply, and it referred to earlier letters for the remaining questions.
Dropping the first right of purchase has no consequences for the cryptographic protection of state secret information.
Het afzien van het eerste recht van koop heeft geen consequenties voor de cryptografische bescherming van staatsgeheime informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Hijink over het bericht dat Fox-IT zeggenschap van de staat afhoudt

MPs Van Raak and Hijink asked whether Fox-IT, now owned by UK-based NCC Group, has met its agreements on protecting state secrets and why it will not write the state's demands into its articles of association. The minister replied that additional conditions under the ABDO security framework are being negotiated constructively and are near completion, and that contractual security requirements and state supervision mitigate risks.
The discussions on this between Defence and Fox IT are proceeding constructively and are in a concluding phase.
De gesprekken hierover tussen Defensie en Fox IT verlopen constructief en bevinden zich in een afrondende fase.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de minister gemeenten en provincies een brief heeft gestuurd naar aanleiding van het vonnis van de rechtbank Midden-Nederland in een zaak van een raadslid uit

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior how he consulted the VNG and IPO about a court ruling on a councillor's allowance in Noordoostpolder and his letter to municipalities and provinces, and whether those bodies agreed with his conclusions. The Minister replied that the letter's content was coordinated at official level with IPO and VNG on his behalf, and noted that the VNG and Noord-Holland were communicating in line with the ruling.
I had the content and structure of the letter extensively coordinated with the IPO and VNG through the Director-General.
De inhoud en opzet van de brief heb ik door de Directeur-Generaal uitgebreid laten afstemmen met IPO en VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Wörsdörfer over het op straat belanden van gevoelige gegevens van 1800 kwetsbare leerlingen

MPs Becker and Wörsdörfer asked the State Secretary for Education and the Interior Minister about leaked personal data of 1,800 vulnerable pupils via unanonymised municipal school-transport tenders, and about municipal privacy compliance, other risky tenders, pseudonymisation law and digital security standards. The government answered that municipalities are responsible for compliance and accountable to their councils, pointed to PIANOo and school-sector awareness measures, and said pseudonymisation targets digital learning tools rather than municipal tenders.
The municipalities are accountable to the municipal council for this.
De gemeenten zijn daarover verantwoording verschuldigd aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over de Wet normering topinkomens 3

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the documents for the planned Wet normering topinkomens 3 (extending the WNT pay cap to all public and semi-public staff) would be sent to the House by 28 September 2017. The minister declined, explaining the bill was not pursued and that the Council of State advice, explanatory note and bill would be published by the next cabinet as required by law.
As I have informed the House on several occasions, I am leaving the decision on whether to submit the bill extending the personal scope of the WNT to the next cabinet.
Zoals ik de Kamer bij diverse gelegenheden heb gemeld 3 laat ik het besluit om het wetsvoorstel uitbreiding personele reikwijdte WNT in te dienen over aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat orkaan Irma de zwaarste orkaan is die de Bovenwindse Eilanden ooit heeft getroffen

DENK MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the damage from hurricane Irma on Sint Maarten, Saba and Sint Eustatius, Dutch support for reconstruction, and whether authorities were prepared. The minister answered that damage is still being assessed, reconstruction funding is not yet determined, and military assistance was prepositioned before the storm.
It is still too early to say how the Dutch government will support the reconstruction of buildings and infrastructure on the islands and how much funding the government will allocate.

Het is nu nog te vroeg om aan te geven op welke wijze de Nederlandse overheid de wederopbouw van de gebouwen en de infrastructuur op de eilanden gaat ondersteunen en hoeveel middelen de regering hiervoor vrijmaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over een speech van de minister-president van Aruba

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about a YouTube video and a speech by Aruba's Prime Minister promising passports within three years, asking when passports are available, what requirements apply, and whether passports could be given as a re-election gift. The Minister confirmed knowing the video, explained that nationality and passport are distinct and that Dutch nationality requirements (five years legal residence, three years for stateless persons, three years marriage for partners) cannot be waived, so a passport cannot be handed out as a gift.
These requirements prevent a passport of the Kingdom of the Netherlands from being provided as a gift.
Deze eisen staan eraan in de weg dat een paspoort van het Koninkrijk der Nederlanden als cadeautje kan worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Premier Sint-Maarten: mariniers deden niks tegen plunderingen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of the Interior whether the Sint Maarten premier's claim that Dutch marines did nothing against looting was accurate and whether that claim undermines the relief effort. The minister answered that the premier expressed regret, that military assistance was requested and limited to shelters, damage assessment and police support under local civil authority, and that Dutch aid remains needed.
The assistance approved concretely involved staffing shelters, carrying out damage assessments and supporting the police in maintaining public order.
De geaccordeerde bijstand betrof concreet het bemannen van shelters, uitvoeren van damage assessment en ondersteunen van de politie bij het handhaven van de openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Camelia Romer boos op SONA en de pers'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports of Curaçao's minister criticising SONA and the business case for the Hospital Nobo Otrobanda, and about SONA's conduct and financial risks for the Netherlands. The minister answered that the Cft monitors the project, responsibility for execution lies with Curaçao/SONA, the business case is provisionally sound pending an update, and Curaçao bears any cost overruns under its own budget.
Responsibility for executing the business case lies with the country Curaçao/SONA.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de uitvoering van de business case ligt bij het land Curaçao/SONA.
