Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onnodige regeldruk voor kleine evenementen en festivals

The MP asks the government about excessive regulatory burden for small events and festivals, citing an Actal advisory report, and asks whether it will harmonise local rules, shift regulation toward small events, improve municipal service and simplify volunteer allowances and permits. The minister answers that municipal autonomy is important, points to a new national Besluit brandveilig gebruik that will replace many local rules from 1 January 2018, rejects several proposals as unnecessary, and says recommendations to municipalities are for them to adopt, with VNG playing a facilitating role.
At the outset, municipal policy freedom is of great importance in order to do justice to local circumstances and needs and to provide local tailor-made solutions.
Voorop staat dat de beleidsvrijheid van gemeenten van groot belang is om daarmee recht te doen aan de plaatselijke omstandigheden en behoeften en om te voorzien in lokaal maatwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berg en Bruins Slot over nationale veiligheidseisen bij aanbestedingen van cruciale communicatiediensten van de overheid

MPs Van den Berg and Bruins Slot asked about national security requirements in government tenders for critical communications services, including the IWR2017 mobile communications tender won by CM Telecom and privacy safeguards. The minister answered that the tender concerns public-network SIM services without classified communication, that privacy is protected by the Wbp and Telecommunicatiewet, and that the new security risk instruments could not yet be applied to this tender.
IWR2017 Mobile Communication Services concerns a tender for telephony services (SIM cards) for use on the public telephone network.
IWR2017 Mobiele Communicatiediensten betreft een aanbesteding van telefoniediensten («simkaarten») voor gebruik op het publieke telefonienetwerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers about reports that Salafists were standing watch during New Year's Eve in The Hague's Schilderswijk and about cooperation between the city and the as-Soennah mosque, including whether a Chamber motion to end such cooperation would be implemented. The government replied that local triangle bodies decide on cooperation with organisations, pointed to a normative framework sent to Parliament, and said police and municipality maintain a dialogue with a wide range of organisations.
In the local context, it remains up to the municipality to organise the involvement of organisations when shaping its integrated security policy.
In de lokale context blijft het aan de gemeente om bij de vormgeving van haar integraal veiligheidsbeleid betrokkenheid van organisaties te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked ministers whether the Hague mayor's use of volunteers for New Year's Eve, reportedly including salafist-linked actors, breaches public order, whether they will prevent a 'sharia police', and whether the mayor should be dismissed. The government answered that volunteers have no special powers and are supervised by police, and that judging the mayor's performance is a matter for the municipal council.
The judgement on the functioning of the mayor of The Hague is a matter for the municipal council.
Het oordeel over het functioneren van de burgemeester van Den Haag is aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Beckerman over het bericht dat er een sterke groei is van het aantal gezinnen dat bij de noodopvang belandde

MPs Kooiman and Beckerman (SP) asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of the Interior about a sharp rise in families ending up in emergency shelter in 2016, its causes, and possible structural fixes. The government answered that it is improving monitoring, that data on homeless families are incomplete, that debt rules are not a legal barrier to renting, and that it supports a Amsterdam-style approach while leaving most solutions to municipalities.
I do not know whether, and if so how often, this happens with homeless families.
Het is mij niet bekend of en zo ja, hoe vaak dit gebeurt bij dakloze gezinnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat verhuurmakelaars een manier hebben gevonden om huurders extra op kosten te jagen

MP Kops asked the Minister of Interior whether rental agents were relabelling banned intermediary fees as contract or administration costs and passing them on to tenants, and for what amounts. Minister Plasterk confirmed such practices occur, stated the law clearly prohibits these fees under any name, said no figures on frequency are held, and pointed to existing information for tenants and ACM enforcement against structural violations without proposing new rules.
I do not have figures on the number of intermediaries who wrongly charge disguised intermediary fees.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers van de aantallen bemiddelaars die onterecht verkapte bemiddelingskosten in rekening brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wassenberg over Nederlandse pensioenfondsen die beleggen in de kerncentrales van Tihange en Doel

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked whether Dutch pension funds, including ABP which civil servants must join, should stop investing in the Belgian nuclear plants Tihange and Doel, and about iodine tablets sent to civil servants in the south. The government replied that ABP's investment policy is for the fund's board, that employee representatives and the accountability body can influence it, and that ABP raises safety with the operator Engie as a shareholder without committing to divestment.
The ABP board is responsible for implementing the pension scheme, including investment policy.
Het ABP-bestuur gaat over de uitvoering van de pensioenregeling, inclusief het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Stoelendans binnen Eilandsraad en BC nog niet voorbij’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior about frequent changes in the Bonaire Island Council and Executive Council, their effect on governance, the relationship with the Netherlands and the island's finances. The minister answered that the changes are a point of concern that weakens stable policy and public service, may widen the gap with citizens and affects trust with the Netherlands, while no signs yet show a worsened financial position, though financial management must improve.
So far I have no signals that the many changes are leading to a worsened financial position of the island.
Tot nu heb ik geen signalen dat de vele wisselingen leiden tot een verslechterde financiële positie van het eiland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Diertens over de gebrekkige beschikbaarheid van uitzendingen van NPO in het buitenland en op de BES-eilanden

MPs Paternotte and Diertens asked why NPO programmes are often unavailable abroad and on the Caribbean Netherlands islands, and whether residents there can watch NPO websites. The State Secretary answered that availability depends on broadcast rights, that geo-blocking has been relaxed for the BES islands where rights and technology allow, and that distribution agreements were made with providers there.
Geo-blocking of NPO websites based on the user's location is no longer applied to the BES islands, insofar as broadcast rights allow and it is technically possible.

Het blokkeren van toegang tot websites van de NPO op basis van de geografische locatie van de gebruiker wordt, voor zover uitzendrechten dat toestaan en het technisch mogelijk is, niet meer toegepast voor de BES-eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het passief kiesrecht

MP Van Raak asked whether politicians convicted of fraud or corruption should be barred from office and why passive voting rights are rarely removed, and whether the law should be tightened. The minister agreed integrity is essential, said vetting is primarily a party responsibility and cited a handreiking for parties, and stated that the parliamentary amendment replacing loss of voting rights with an aggravating circumstance means no legislative change is planned.
Against this background, I see no reason to propose amending the legislation.
Ik zie tegen deze achtergrond geen aanleiding voorstellen te doen tot wijziging van de wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Hoofd toelatingsorganisatie aangehouden om ambtelijke corruptie'

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that the head of Curaçao's admission organisation was arrested for official corruption, including how residence permits were manipulated, whether Dutch passports could wrongly be issued, and Dutch involvement. The minister replied that details beyond press reports are unknown, that naturalisation on Curaçao is assessed by the Dutch IND after a five-year legal stay requirement, and that the criminal investigation is a matter for Curaçao with no Dutch involvement.
The criminal investigation currently underway is a matter for the Country of Curaçao.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat nu loopt is een aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon, De Graaf en Wilders over beschermde identiteit voor teruggekeerde Zweedse jihadisten

MPs De Roon, De Graaf and Wilders asked whether returning Swedish jihadists receive protected identities to aid reintegration, whether they could travel and settle in the EU and Netherlands, and whether Dutch services know of them. The ministers replied that the reports are incorrect, that Sweden only offers privacy-data protection for threatened citizens and not new identities, and that the other questions therefore do not apply.
No, this report is not correct.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over activiteiten van de Turkse inlichtingendienst in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether the Turkish intelligence service operates from The Hague, including compiling kill-lists of Kurdish activists, and what the government will do about it. The ministers declined to comment on the French prosecution and said they cannot publicly discuss investigations into foreign intelligence activity, only that the government takes measures when unauthorised activity is found.
No public statements can be made about investigations into such activities by foreign intelligence and security services.
Over onderzoek naar dergelijke activiteiten van buitenlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over twijfelachtig recherchewerk brengt brugwachter aan de afgrond

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about municipalities and provinces hiring private investigation firms for integrity probes, including a case where private investigators allegedly placed tracking devices on a government employee's car, and whether central government does the same. The minister answered that local authorities decide themselves whether to use private bureaus for reasons of capacity, expertise and independence, that such bureaus must be licensed under the WPBR with conduct rules, that the tracking device practice is only allowed for business-used vehicles within the relevant period, and that central government sometimes outsources such investigations while preferring in-house work.
Municipalities and provinces are themselves responsible for deciding whether or not to use an external private bureau to carry out an integrity investigation.
Gemeenten en provincies zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het besluit al dan niet gebruik te maken van een extern particulier bureau voor de uitvoering van een integriteitsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over een buitensporige ontslagvergoeding voor een ziekenhuisdirecteur en beloningen van medisch specialisten in het Noorden

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked about a severance payment of over a quarter million euros to a hospital department head at Nij Smellinghe, whether the WNT pay cap allows buying out waiting-benefit entitlements, and why medical specialists in the north earn above the Balkende norm. The minister answered that the individual severance cases fall to the accountant and the WNT supervisor (CIBG), that no change to the WNT is planned, and that medical specialists were removed from the WNT's scope from 1 July 2017, so their pay is no longer published.
A severance payment to a non-top official is not capped under the WNT, because the WNT only caps the pay and severance of top officials.
Een ontslagvergoeding aan een niet-topfunctionaris wordt niet genormeerd in het kader van de WNT, omdat de WNT alleen de bezoldiging en ontslagvergoedingen van topfunctionarissen normeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de permanente bewoning op vakantieparken

An MP asked the ministers about permanent residence on holiday parks, including whether residents are being steered there, whether municipal enforcement in the Veluwe leaves people homeless, and whether arbeidsmigranten get new housing while other residents do not. The minister says there is no national overview, that referrals were individual and temporary, that enforcement and housing are local matters coordinated through a municipal programme, and that gemeenten are responsible for their own housing policy.
At national level there is no overview of holiday parks where people live permanently in breach of the applicable zoning, or of the reasons they live there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van vakantieparken waar mensen permanent en in strijd met de geldende bestemming verblijven en om welke redenen zij hier verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over camping Fort Oranje

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the municipality of Zundert handled the closure of camping Fort Oranje, and the residents affected, adequately, including whether earlier, firmer action against criminality could have prevented it. The minister answered that the municipality, which is accountable to its council, concluded the situation was untenable and that it is not for the minister to comment on its policy; the municipality is now assessing individual solutions for residents.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to go further into the policy of the municipality of Zundert; the municipality accounts for this to the municipal council.
Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om verder op het beleid van de gemeente Zundert in te gaan, hierover legt de gemeente verantwoording af aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over angst op werkvloer van Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports of fear among staff at the Waarborgfonds Sociale Woningbouw (WSW), its governance and culture, the risks to its guarantee function, and its director capacity. The Minister answered that the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) has flagged trust and culture problems and that WSW is taking steps, with the Aw monitoring follow-up and the Minister informed and responsible for the housing system.
The Aw, as supervisor, will closely monitor the follow-up of the recommendations and their effects in the coming period, and can where necessary independently give instructions to WSW.
De Aw volgt als toezichthouder de follow-up van de aanbevelingen en de effecten daarvan in de komende periode nauwgezet en kan daarbij indien nodig zelfstandig aanwijzingen geven aan WSW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Eijs over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs asked the government about people living permanently in holiday parks, including the size of such groups, the blacklist of landlords, and solutions for people without housing. The minister said there is no national overview of permanent residents, that the government is studying the housing need for temporary housing, and that municipalities are responsible for housing supply and enforcement.
At national level there is no overview of the number of people who permanently live in a holiday park and the reasons why they stay there.
Op landelijk niveau is er geen overzicht van het aantal mensen dat permanent op een vakantiepark verblijft en om welke reden zij er verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Laçin en Beckerman over de permanente bewoning van vakantieparken

MPs Laçin and Beckerman asked the government about permanent residence on holiday parks, including the number affected, the burgemeester of Putten's call for a national approach, reviving a withdrawn bill, and provincial housing shortages. Minister Plasterk answered that no national count exists, that municipalities hold the primary responsibility, that the bill will not be revived, and gave provincial statistical housing shortage figures while noting affordability and elderly-suitable housing cannot be precisely quantified.
The municipality is responsible for its own enforcement and housing policy and therefore holds the lead role in giving shape to a solution.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor haar eigen handhaving- en woonbeleid en heeft daarmee de regierol in handen om invulling te geven aan een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked whether personal data held by UWV and other government bodies, including data stored abroad, can be guaranteed to stay out of reach of the US government after reports that Google must hand over user data. The government answered that it cannot give such a guarantee because legal bases such as mutual legal assistance treaties allow transfers to the US, and it does not plan extra measures against foreign storage beyond case-by-case risk assessment.
No, I cannot give that guarantee.
Nee, die garantie kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Van den Berg over het bericht dat een huurkorting van 170 euro niet wordt toegestaan in Zeeland

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties (Aw) may block a one-off rent reduction of 170 euro agreed in a housing merger in Zeeland, and why it approved the merger containing it. The Minister answered that the Woningwet bars corporations from providing such financial means outside listed exceptions, that the Aw had not objected at merger approval but could have earlier, and that structural rent reductions remain possible.
Because this specific point is not part of the assessment of merger proposals, the Autoriteit woningcorporaties gave permission for the merger.
Omdat dit specifieke punt geen onderdeel van beoordeling van fusievoorstellen is, heeft de Autoriteit woningcorporaties toestemming gegeven voor de fusie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Groothuizen, Buitenweg en Jasper van Dijk over tralies bij de vluchtelingenopvang in de voormalige Bijlmerbajes

MPs asked whether the former Bijlmerbajes prison, used as a refugee shelter until December 2017, should have its bars removed given its detention character and the trauma of residents. The State Secretary answered that detention features were largely removed, the bars remain as external shading serving climate control, and COA sees no reason for further changes.
The bars now serve only as external shading and have not been removed, because they play an important role in climate control in the building.
De tralies dienen nu nog louter als externe zonwering en zijn niet verwijderd, omdat deze een belangrijke functie vervullen bij de klimaatbeheersing in het gebouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over een toename van meldingen over verwarde huurders

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister about a rise in reports of disturbance by confused tenants at housing corporations and police, and whether decentralisation and GGZ cuts are causes and whether every municipality has a coordinated approach. The minister answered that the figures are not conclusive, that police incident codes do not show whether persons are tenants, that the national Schakelteam aims for a working approach in every municipality by October 2018, and that housing corporations and municipalities bear responsibility for prevention.
Responsibility for realising a coordinated approach lies with all involved chain partners, both local and regional, under the lead of the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het realiseren van een sluitende aanpak ligt bij alle betrokken ketenpartners, zowel lokaal als regionaal, onder regie van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de filmrollen van de geheime dienst die mogelijk betrekking hebben op de 'affaire Sanders'

An SP MP asked why microfilm rolls transferred from the intelligence service to the National Archives in 2001 have not been digitised, whether their quality is deteriorating, and whether they will be digitised and their contents made public. The minister replied that digitisation is not required unless the material condition demands it, that microfilms can last 200 to 500 years, that AIVD and the Archives are now studying how to digitise them, and that public access is restricted until 2025 for privacy reasons.

When the archive of the Bureau Nationale Veiligheid was transferred to the National Archives, a restriction on public access to the entire archive until 2025 was imposed to respect the privacy of those involved.

Bij het overbrengen van het archief van Bureau Nationale Veiligheid naar het Nationaal Archief is, met het oog op de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkenen, een beperking aan de openbaarheid van het hele archief gesteld tot 2025.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de huisvesting van vergunninghouders

An MP asked the Minister of Interior why the figures on rejected housing offers for refugee permit holders were given only for 2016, how rejections are judged as justified or not, and why COA rather than a court assesses refusals. The Minister answered that 2016 is the latest full year of data, that COA does not record reasons for rejections in general terms, that COA applies set criteria and can end reception, and that the Minister has no supervisory powers over COA.
The reason why a housing refusal is declared justified or unjustified is not registered by COA.
De reden waarom een woningweigering terecht of onterecht wordt verklaard wordt door het COA niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat het woningtekort nijpend wordt

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of a worsening housing shortage, how many households cannot buy a home, how the price spiral will be stopped, whether municipalities should build more, and why new homes go to refugees. The minister said regional differences exist, that responsibility for matching demand and supply lies with local government, that housing production is expected to average about 70,000 units a year, and that the government will report on regional talks this autumn.
I have therefore taken various measures to support local parties in realising more rental homes in the middle segment.
Ik heb daarom diverse maatregelen genomen om lokale partijen te ondersteunen om meer huurwoningen in het middensegment te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over sociale huurhuizen in de regio Rotterdam

MP Beckerman asks about the financial trouble of Stichting Humanitas Huisvesting in Rotterdam, its possible merger with Woonbron, lack of performance agreements with Rotterdam, broken lifts at Havensteder and a Capelle aan den IJssel public-space deal. Minister Plasterk confirms a sanitation request is under WSW review with the clock restarted, says a merger would not affect tenants, explains performance-agreement rules and the lift problem handling, and defends the corporations' contributions without substantive new commitments.
A possible merger has no consequences for sitting tenants; the existing tenancy agreement will pass to the merged organisation.
Een eventuele fusie heeft geen gevolgen voor de zittende huurders, de bestaande huurovereenkomst zal overgaan op de fusieorganisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Bergkamp over de financiering van bijzondere woonvormen.

Two D66 MPs asked the Interior and Health ministers about financing options for collective self-build and supported living projects, including mortgage terms, municipal support, land acquisition and loan-to-value rules. The minister answered that details are largely unknown or case-specific, pointed to municipal subsidies and a Expertteam Eigenbouw review, and described no binding obligations for the executive.
I do not have an overview of how often this happens, which types of projects are involved, or what conditions are attached to such financing.
Ik beschik niet over een overzicht van hoe vaak dit gebeurt, om welke type projecten het gaat, en welke voorwaarden aan een dergelijke financiering gesteld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Engelshoven over het bericht “Nederland langs de mensenrechtenmeetlat”

An MP asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers about reports of ethnic profiling by police, including a new anti-profiling code, a handling framework for proactive checks, and an app feature for recording stops. The minister answered that a draft proactive-control framework was tested and will be finalised later this year, and that the MEOS app will allow recording of stops with pilots expected in autumn 2017.
After adoption, the handling framework will be shared with your House.
Na vaststelling zal het handelingskader met uw Kamer worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de sluiting van camping Fort Oranje

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior about the municipality of Zundert's closure of camp Fort Oranje, where some 600 vulnerable residents including 120 children live, and about rehousing, funding, similar problems elsewhere, and whether municipalities have enough legal powers to close campsites. The Minister defers most matters to the municipality, notes existing enforcement tools, says he is not yet convinced new powers are needed, and promises an evaluation and a CCV handbook.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to go further into the policy of the municipality of Zundert.
Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om verder op het beleid van de gemeente Zundert in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de onwenselijkheid van beleggingen van pensioenfondsen in de kerncentrale Tihange

An SP MP asked why Dutch pension funds, including ABP, hold shares in Engie, owner of the Tihange nuclear plant, and whether the government will press them to divest given safety concerns and municipal and parliamentary motions to close the plant. The state secretary answered that pension funds decide their own investment policy under OECD and UN guidelines, that the accountability bodies can pressure the boards, and that the government does not intervene in those decisions.
Pension funds themselves decide on their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen gaan zelf over hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'CAft adviseert opnieuw algehele verplichtingen- en vacaturestop'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about the CAft advice for an immediate hiring and spending freeze in Aruba, the government's stance on that advice, and consequences if Aruba does not follow it. The minister said Aruba decides its own measures, CAft will test them later in the year, and he has no grounds to assume Aruba will not heed the advice.
CAft will later in the year check whether the measures taken are sufficient.
Het CAft zal later in het jaar toetsen of de getroffen maatregelen voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Laatste bezoek vertrekkend voorzitter CAft'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the end of the Caribbean financial oversight board's term, whether permanent financial oversight for the former Netherlands Antilles limits Dutch financial risk, and how the Chamber will be involved in the 2018 evaluation. The minister defended the oversight as beneficial, said responsibility for public finances lies with the countries, and said the 2018 evaluation timing and content still need to be set, with the Chamber to be informed in time.
The Chamber will of course be informed in good time about developments in this area.
De Kamer zal uiteraard tijdig worden geïnformeerd over de ontwikkelingen op dit terrein.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de afkoop van het regresrecht waardoor letselschadeslachtoffers gedupeerd raken

MPs Van Nispen (SP) asked whether the buyout of the Wmo regress right via the VNG-Verbond van Verzekeraars convenant harms personal injury victims, who may be sent to municipalities first and face delays. The State Secretary replied that regress is a matter between insurer and municipality, that the victim is not affected, that the Gedragscode Behandeling Letselschade is not breached, and that no talks with stakeholders are planned.
Regress takes place in the relationship between insurer and regress claimant.
Regres speelt zich af in de verhouding tussen verzekeraar en regresnemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat de woningbouw in de knel komt door gebrek aan bouwgrond

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior about reports that housing construction is constrained by a shortage of building land, including the size of the shortfall and the expected number of homes. The Minister answered that national plan capacity is sufficient but some regions fall short, that the responsibility lies locally and regionally, and that he will report on regional talks in the autumn.
At the General Consultation of 7 June 2017 I committed to your House to report on the regional talks this autumn.
In het Algemeen Overleg van 7 juni 2017 heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd dit najaar verslag uit te brengen van de regiogesprekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Madlener over het bericht dat de ombouw naar gasloze woningen al snel € 60.000 per woning kost

MPs Kops and Madlener asked the minister whether the reported cost of around EUR 60,000 per home to convert a Nijmegen neighbourhood to gas-free was acceptable, what infrastructure costs and payback period to expect, how residents would be protected from these costs, and whether the money would be better spent on housing. The minister answered that the municipality of Nijmegen is responsible for weighing acceptable costs, that cost predictions are not yet possible, and that a labelling obligation for housing corporations will be explored, leaving final choices to a future cabinet.
At this moment it is not possible to predict when converting to gas-free neighbourhoods will become profitable.
Het is op dit moment niet mogelijk om te voorspellen wanneer het ombouwen naar gasloze wijken rendabel is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens, Van Eijs en Van Veldhoven over de brand bij de olieraffinaderij Isla op Curaçao

MPs from D66 asked the government about the fire at the Isla refinery on Curaçao, including health risks from smoke, the cause of the fire, past safety incidents and the refinery's non-compliance with permit requirements per an inspection report. The minister replied that responsibility for the Isla refinery lies with Curaçao, so he cannot answer the substantive questions, though he notes Curaçao has commissioned an inspection and audit and that the Netherlands stands ready to continue assistance on request.
Because responsibility for the Isla refinery rests with the country of Curaçao, the questions have not been answered individually.
Omdat de verantwoordelijkheid voor de Isla-raffinaderij bij het land Curaçao berust, zijn de vragen niet afzonderlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat artsen via hun pensioenfonds verplicht in tabak beleggen

An MP asked whether the government, as employer, can influence ABP's investment policy on tobacco and how participants can have more say over it. The state secretary replied that ABP's board and accountability body govern investments, that employer and employee representatives are involved, and that the government does not directly steer the policy.
The central government is one of the many public and education employers affiliated with ABP.
De rijksoverheid is één van de vele overheids- en onderwijswerkgevers die is aangesloten bij het ABP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat bedrijven het convenant Werk en Kanker ondertekenen

An MP asked whether the government will sign the Werk en Kanker covenant, what it will do about stigma and discrimination against former cancer patients, and about D66's proposals. The minister said the covenant is a private initiative, the government as employer already ensures equal treatment, and the minister will wait for the results of the no-risk policy experiment and the AFM review of insurers' claim assessment.
I want to await the outcomes of this.
Ik wil de uitkomsten hiervan afwachten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Özütok over het bericht 'Waarnemers: maak stembiljet verkiezingen gebruiksvriendelijker'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government about an OSCE report criticising the Dutch ballot for the March 2017 elections, including accessibility for voters with disabilities, poll worker training, assistance inside voting booths, and larger print or party logos. The Minister answered that assistance inside booths is restricted by the Electoral Act and the UN convention reservation, that a ballot-experiment bill was rejected but may be reintroduced, and that only about a quarter-threshold of accessibility criteria is unmet, with no polling station fully compliant.
I will ask the municipalities to pay more explicit attention to this rule next time when training their staff.
Ik zal de gemeenten vragen om daarbij de volgende keer nadrukkelijker aandacht te besteden aan deze regel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Eijs over de brandveiligheid van Nederlandse gebouwen

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior, after the Grenfell Tower fire in London, how fire safety in Dutch buildings is ensured, who checks compliance, and whether gevel and insulation rules are adequate. The minister answered that the Bouwbesluit 2012 sets requirements, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement and the provinces for supervision of municipalities, that he would await the English investigation report before considering additional measures, and that rules for buildings above 70 metres are set through the Bouwbesluit and a technical guidance document.
I do not have this information. As answered under question 3, each municipality can shape its own supervision of fire safety.
Ik beschik niet over deze informatie. Zoals geantwoord bij vraag 3 kan iedere gemeente zelf invulling geven aan het toezicht op brandveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over de aanbesteding van mobiele telefonie

MPs Hijink and Van Raak asked how government data, including phone traffic of civil servants, is stored and protected against foreign access such as under the USA Freedom Act, and what contract conditions apply to the new mobile telephony tender. The minister answered that data location is assessed per case, that EEA-only processing, notification duties and termination rights were included in the new contract, and that the Vodafone-Ziggo joint venture did not trigger termination.
To prevent data being processed or shared by the contractor in breach of Dutch law, requirements have been included in the contract.
Om te voorkomen dat in strijd met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving gegevens door de opdrachtnemer worden verwerkt of gedeeld, zijn eisen in het contract opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Minister ontkent vertraging en onzekerheid rehabilitatie CITGO-raffinaderij'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about reports that reopening of the CITGO refinery on Aruba was delayed, and about the effects on Aruba's finances, unemployment, debt and the Netherlands. The minister confirmed media reports of a delay of several months, said it may reduce growth and tax revenue for Aruba to be taken into account in its 2018 budget, and said a delay has no effect on the Netherlands.
Figures on the consequences for employment are not known to me.
Cijfers over de gevolgen voor werkgelegenheid zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “Problemen olieraffinaderij loodsen Aruba richting krimp”

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about refinery delays on Aruba, their effect on growth, employment, the PdVSA/CITGO financing, possible Rosneft involvement, and Chinese interest in Curaçao's refinery. The minister answered most questions by pointing to Aruban responsibility, the Centrale Bank and CAft, and by saying the government monitors developments without committing to new steps.
This question concerns a subject that falls under the responsibility of the country of Aruba.
Deze vraag heeft betrekking op een onderwerp dat tot de verantwoordelijkheid behoort van het land Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de olievervuiling aan de oostkust van Bonaire

An MP asked the ministers about oil pollution on Bonaire's east coast, its risks, frequency, economic effects, the adequacy of local capacity, spillover to other islands and existing regional cooperation. The minister answered that the tar balls posed limited risk, most oil was removed, local authorities were capable with Dutch support, and regional cooperation exists under the Cartagena Convention.
The public body Bonaire informed the population about this and took appropriate measures to prevent contact and ingestion.
Het openbaar lichaam Bonaire heeft de bevolking hierover geïnformeerd en passende maatregelen getroffen om contact en opname te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Middendorp en Hermans over de controle van topinkomens in zorginstellingen

MPs Middendorp and Hermans asked whether the detailed WNT rules on top-income control in healthcare institutions cause high compliance costs and asked for a quick remedy. The minister acknowledges complexity and admin burden, agrees to consult the NBA on reducing the audit protocol burden, and will review controls in the WNT evaluation.

I am happy to consider, together with the parties involved, whether there are possibilities within the aim and framework of the WNT to reduce the audit burden on accountants and thereby the costs for all WNT institutions.

Ik ben graag bereid om samen met betrokken partijen te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om binnen het doel en de kaders van de WNT de controlelast voor accountants en daarmee de kosten voor alle WNT-instellingen te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken over het bericht dat Brabantse criminelen in buitengebieden vrij spel zouden hebben

An MP asked the ministers whether they agreed with researchers that municipal anti-crime action in rural areas of Brabant rarely leads to concrete steps, and about their proposed solutions. The minister said the WODC study shows growing awareness and institutional anchoring but a fragile, information-poor cycle in smaller municipalities, and announced extra funding for RIEC/LIEC, public-private cooperation and support for political office holders while leaving effectiveness of local measures to local authorities.
The assessment of that is primarily a matter for the local authorities.
De beoordeling daarvan is primair aan de lokale autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het uitsluiten van laagopgeleiden door Havensteder

An SP MP asks the Minister of Interior whether housing corporation Havensteder may exclude low-educated applicants from social rental homes, what legal basis exists for selecting on education level, and how Rotterdam's experiment is legitimised. The Minister answers that the municipality says the exclusion claim is incorrect, that education cannot be a allocation criterion outside the Wbmgp, and that Havensteder has changed its communication.
For this reason, Havensteder has since adapted its communication about the letting of this complex.
Mede hierom heeft Havensteder de communicatie rondom de verhuur van dit complex inmiddels aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de Gemeenteraad in Leiden in actie komt tegen de verschraling van de lokale journalistiek

An MP asked the Dutch government about the decline of local and regional journalism and whether municipalities or the national government should fund it, and how this affects local democratic oversight. The government answered that local media play an important role in oversight, pointed to financial pressure on local public broadcasters, mentioned a structural funding line, a guide for councillors and a forthcoming research outline, and said municipalities are responsible for funding local public media.
The importance of these roles only increases with the decentralisations in the social domain and the transfer of over €10 billion to the Municipal Fund.
Het belang van deze rollen neemt met de decentralisaties in het sociaal domein en de overheveling van ruim € 10 miljard naar het Gemeentefonds, alleen maar toe.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk, Azarkan en Kuzu over hoe de vrijheid van meningsuiting, de vrijheid van demonstratie en de vrijheid van vereniging zich verhouden tot de openbare orde

MPs Öztürk, Azarkan and Kuzu asked how freedom of expression, assembly and association relate to public order, including the bans on Eritrean and Turkish-minister-linked events, the Rotterdam police handling, and the expulsion of a Turkish minister. The government defended the mayors' powers under the Wet openbare manifestaties, declined to assess the mayors' conduct against human rights treaties (leaving that to courts), and said it could not judge mayoral decisions that fall to municipal councils.
It is for the court to form a judgement on that, if and insofar as such legal questions are submitted to a court in any procedure.
Het is aan de rechter om zich daarover een oordeel te vormen indien en voor zover aan de rechter in enigerlei procedure dergelijke rechtsvragen worden voorgelegd
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het bericht dat nieuwbouwwoningen nog steeds op gas worden aangesloten

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they accept that stopping new homes from being connected to gas is vital for Groningen and climate goals, how the many already-built homes will switch later, and how municipalities wanting gas-free building can be supported. The minister agreed the step is important, said the gas-connection obligation will be replaced by a connection right via amendment and the Omgevingswet would let municipalities set their own rules, and pointed to the Green Deal and a transition path, without giving a firm timeline.
The bill on progress of the energy transition (Kamerstuk 34 627) is pending before your House, with amendments submitted on the right to a gas connection.
Bij uw Kamer is aanhangig het wetsvoorstel voortgang energietransitie (Kamerstuk 34 627 ) waarop amendementen zijn ingediend met betrekking tot het recht op een gasaansluiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Vereniging Eigen Huis wil regeling restschuld behouden’

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the tax-deductible residual mortgage debt scheme (restschuldregeling), expiring end 2017, should be extended, given that many homeowners remain underwater. The government answered that the crisis measure has served its purpose, the housing market has recovered, and it sees no reason to extend the scheme with its associated tax loss.
I therefore see no reason to extend this scheme, which was introduced as a crisis measure, with the additional tax loss that would result.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om deze regeling, die geïntroduceerd is als crisismaatregel, te verlengen met bovendien een fiscale derving als gevolg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat accountants willen stoppen met de controle van topinkomens

MP Gijs van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether the complexity of auditing top public-sector salaries under the WNT could reduce oversight or weaken the norm, whether non-top officials and interims should be capped at a minister's salary, and whether non-accountants should perform the checks. The minister agreed oversight must not be lost or the norm weakened, said he would explore with the profession ways to reduce audit burden, left the WNT-3 extension decision to the next cabinet, and rejected replacing accountants as auditors.
I share the view that the complexity of the audit must not deprive oversight of top incomes in the (semi-)public sector.
Ik deel de mening dat de complexiteit van de controle het zicht niet mag ontnemen op de topinkomens in de (semi-)publieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Engelshoven over het bericht dat het toezicht op de topinkomens te complex is geworden

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that accountants want to stop auditing top incomes under the WNT because oversight has become too complex, and what concrete steps the ministry will take. The minister acknowledged complexity, said he will consult the accountants' professional body to reduce audit burden within the law's framework, and said a legislative change is not expected to be needed for now.
I am indeed willing to consider, together with the professional group among others, whether there are possibilities within the aim and framework of the WNT to reduce the audit burden for accountants.
Ik ben inderdaad graag bereid om samen met onder meer de beroepsgroep te bezien of er mogelijkheden zijn om binnen het doel en de kaders van de WNT de controlelast voor accountants te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Kwint over de kwaliteit van lokale media

MPs Van Raak and Kwint asked the government about the decline of local journalism, its role in democratic oversight of municipalities, the funding of local media, and municipal communications staff. The state secretary answered that declining advertising revenue drives media cuts rather than the 2017 public broadcasting cut, that a separate fund for local journalism is not warranted given existing subsidies, and that municipalities may communicate as they wish.
You will receive the research outline before the summer recess.
U ontvangt de onderzoeksopzet voor het zomerreces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over particuliere verhuurders die massaal van vaste huurcontracten af willen ten gunste van tijdelijke huurcontracten en de huren fors verhogen

Gijs van Dijk (PvdA) asked the Minister of the Interior whether private landlords in Amsterdam are using temporary contracts and periodic rent increases to push out tenants with fixed contracts, and whether this misuses the 2015 temporary-lease law and was promised against. Minister Plasterk answered that fixed contracts cannot simply be terminated, that rent can be harmonised at re-letting, that the government will monitor temporary lease use and report in the autumn State of the Housing Market, and that he is willing to talk with Amsterdam.
It is therefore not possible for a landlord to terminate the rent of a dwelling in order to then only conclude temporary contracts.
Het is dus voor een verhuurder niet mogelijk om de huur van een woning te beëindigen teneinde vervolgens alleen nog maar tijdelijke contracten af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over filmrollen van de geheime dienst die mogelijk betrekking hebben op de 'affaire Sanders'

An MP asked whether the AIVD deposited film reels at the National Archives relating to the 1946 'Sanders affair', whether they are in poor condition and inaccessible, and whether the AIVD must pay for restoration and how public access will be ensured. The minister confirmed the archive transfer in 2001, said the material is only partly public and not yet digitised, and said the National Archives and AIVD are jointly examining how to digitise the reels.
The National Archives and the AIVD are jointly examining how, given the fragility of the material, the film reels can be digitised.
Het Nationaal Archief en de AIVD bezien in gezamenlijkheid op welke manier, gelet op de kwetsbaarheid van het materiaal, de filmrollen gedigitaliseerd kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Beckerman over het geld dat de oud-topman van woningcorporatie Rochdale aan de Staat moet betalen

Beckerman (SP) asked how money ordered by the court to be paid by the former Rochdale housing corporation executive and staff could flow back to the tenants and corporation harmed by their mismanagement. The minister explains the money is a criminal confiscation (ontneming) payable to the State, that victims could claim as injured parties or in civil proceedings, and that Rochdale's civil claim is paused because the former director was declared personally bankrupt.
Persons who have suffered direct harm from a criminal offence can join the criminal proceedings as an injured party to obtain compensation.
Personen die rechtstreeks schade hebben geleden door een strafbaar feit kunnen zich voor het verkrijgen van schadevergoeding als benadeelde partij voegen in het strafproces
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Ziekenhuis Curaçao bezorgt NL strop'

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations whether the Netherlands faces a financial burden from its loan for the Curaçao hospital, and about the loan terms and a PwC report. The minister replied that Curaçao is autonomously responsible for the hospital's business case, that loan repayments are on schedule, and that he has no knowledge of a PwC report and no role in project management.
For the project management, Curaçao as an autonomous country is fully responsible itself.
Voor het projectmanagement is Curaçao als autonoom land volledig zelf verantwoordelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Groningen de ICT-voorzieningen privatiseert

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Groningen's plan to privatise generic ICT services, despite expert objections, could guarantee data safety, why the BIT could not review the project, and whether national rules are needed. The Minister answered that outsourcing decisions and data protection responsibilities lie with municipalities, that BIT has no remit over municipal projects, and that no national rules are planned.
The bureau has no authority to advise on ICT projects at municipalities.
Het bureau heeft geen bevoegdheid om te adviseren over ICT-projecten bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Google must hand over user data stored in foreign data centres to the US, and whether Dutch government data and citizens are protected from foreign surveillance. The Minister of the Interior answered that location decisions are left to each responsible body within existing rules, that full protection and an overview of data locations cannot be guaranteed, and that US court ruling and Judicial Redress Act issues apply only in limited ways.

It is not appropriate for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to have an up-to-date overview of where the data of all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions are stored.

Het is niet aan de orde dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties moet beschikken over een actueel overzicht van de locatie waar de data van alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semipublieke instellingen zijn opgeslagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het voorkomen van koolmonoxidevergiftiging

An MP asked the ministers about carbon monoxide detectors that failed NVWA safety tests, whether sales would be banned, why periodic inspections of home installations are not mandatory, when licensing rules for gas appliance work will take effect, and how installer competence will be guaranteed. The minister answered that banned products were withdrawn or prohibited, that periodic inspections will not be mandated but a licensing scheme for installers is being pursued with an expected entry into force in 2019, and that progress will be reported to parliament in autumn 2017.
I do not intend to introduce a mandatory periodic inspection for combustion installations.
Ik ben niet voornemens om een verplichte periodieke keuring voor verbrandingsinstallaties in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Diertens over het berichtgeving ten aanzien van een Politieacademie op Curaçao

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations whether one person both investigated the Curaçao police academy and was tasked with setting up a new police bachelor programme, and how this fits with the justice chain strengthening and the Progress Committee's oversight. The Minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility of the Curaçao Minister of Justice, that the Kingdom countries share a legal duty for police education under common quality standards, and that the Progress Committee did not cover the choice of training institution and has now ended its work.

The report concerns the (financial) establishment and organisation of a police academy on Curaçao, which is a local matter under the political responsibility of the Minister of Justice of the country of Curaçao.

Het bericht richt zich op de (financiële) op- en inrichting van een politieacademie van Curaçao hetgeen een locale aangelegenheid betreft onder de politieke verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van Justitie van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over enorm hoge vertrekpremies bij woningcorporaties

An SP MP asks the Minister of the Interior about very high departure premiums paid to former managers at housing associations such as Ymere and De Alliantie, questioning their justification and whether they can be clawed back. The minister answers that moderate pay policy is expected of such institutions, that accountants and the Autoriteit woningcorporaties check legality, that clawback is only possible for payments made contrary to regulations, and that the WNT extension may cover non-top officials.
It is up to the accountants of the housing associations concerned to check whether the institutions' departure premiums comply with the applicable laws and regulations.
Het is aan de accountants van de betreffende woningcorporaties om te controleren of de instellingen met de vertrekpremies voldoen aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tony van Dijck en Kops over het bericht “Banken rekenen nog steeds te veel boeterente bij hypotheek”

PVV MPs asked the Finance Minister whether banks still charge excessive early-repayment penalties on mortgages despite the AFM guidance, how many people are affected, what compensation is planned, and what measures will be taken. The minister acknowledges possible overcharging since July 2016, says lenders have pledged proactive compensation, and sees no need for further measures on competition and mobility.
I consider it important that all customers who after 14 July 2016 paid too high a fee under the new rules and the AFM guidance are compensated with retroactive effect.

Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle klanten met terugwerkende kracht worden gecompenseerd die na 14 juli 2016 op grond van de nieuwe regels en de leidraad van de AFM een te hoge vergoeding hebben betaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Middendorp over de internationale cyberaanval en de ICT van de Overheid

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether government ICT systems were infected by the Wannacry ransomware attack, whether they are sufficiently secure, what lessons are drawn, and for an overview of systems under the ministry. The minister reported no known infections, described existing patching and NCSC support, noted Court of Audit findings on information security shortcomings, and promised to inform parliament on progress.
The House will also be informed about the progress.
De Kamer zal eveneens over de voortgang worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Beertema over het bericht dat studenten te veel huur betalen

MPs Kops and Beertema asked the minister whether 73% of students overpay rent and how many landlords ignore the housing valuation system, and whether the government will act against this. The minister answered that the 73% figure comes from an LSVb survey of self-selected users that is not representative, that rent is freely negotiable, that the government is improving awareness of the rent-tribunal route and will inform parliament before summer.
It is not known in how many rentals the rent deviates from the rent based on the housing valuation system.
Het is niet bekend bij hoeveel verhuringen de huurprijs afwijkt van de huurprijs op basis van het WWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te dure studentenkamers en studentenhotels

The SP MP Beckerman asks the Minister of Interior about student rooms rented above the WWS rent-point standard, regional differences, sanctions on landlords, a longer complaint window, and studentenhotels. Minister Plasterk answers that contractual freedom allows rents above the standard, that fines do not apply to such overcharging, that a higher leges tariff for repeat losers is planned, and that the publicity of Huurcommissie review and a further report on enforcement instruments will follow.
I intend to inform the House about this before the summer.
Ik ben voornemens uw Kamer voor de zomer hierover te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Özdil en Voortman over het bericht dat veel studenten een te hoge huur betalen

GroenLinks MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether sanctions should apply to landlords who charge students rents above the points-based maximum, whether the Autoriteit woningcorporaties should investigate, and how tenant rights could be improved. The minister replied that rent above the points-based level is not a violation, that contractual freedom and the Huurcommissie route apply, and that a differentiated legal fee for repeatedly losing landlords and more publicity about tenant review are planned.
When a tenant and a landlord conclude a rental agreement, the principle of freedom of contract applies.
Als een huurder en een verhuurder een huurovereenkomst sluiten, geldt het principe van contractsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over het steeds opnieuw naar de Huurcommissie moeten voor dezelfde kamer

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why tenants must repeatedly go to the Rent Tribunal to win rent reductions for the same dwelling, and whether landlords could be obliged to follow tribunal rulings and the points system. The minister replied that new contracts allow new rents under contractual freedom, that the tribunal is not equipped to enforce such an obligation, and pointed to a proposed graduated fee and more public information instead.
Landlord and tenant are free to agree a new rent.
Het staat de verhuurder en de huurder vrij om een nieuwe huurprijs overeen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Raemakers over het al dan niet verplicht aanbesteden in de zorg

Two MPs asked the State Secretary of Health and the Minister of the Interior whether public tendering of care in the social domain is mandatory, given conflicting reports, and what will be done to clarify it. The government answered that tendering is not always required, depends on whether the arrangement is a procurement or a subsidy, and that a working group and PIANOo support center have been set up to clarify the rules for municipalities.
Public tendering in the social domain is not by definition and in all cases mandatory.
Een openbare aanbesteding in het sociale domein is niet per definitie en in alle gevallen verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vraag of de wet iemand verplicht de hypotheekrenteaftrek te gebruiken of niet

Omtzigt (CDA) asks whether the law obliges taxpayers to claim mortgage interest deduction, whether a net tax increase can arise for small mortgages, and how the Hillen rule and the 2013 letter should be read. State Secretary Wiebes answers that the rules are unchanged, that claiming deductions is effectively mandatory for correct returns, and that the 2013 letter's passage was unclear, though the law will be applied as written.
It has come to my attention that the passage in the letter of 11 November 2013 is being read as a standalone choice to claim or not claim interest and costs as deductions.
Antwoord 5 Mij is gebleken dat de passage in de brief van 11 november 2013 5 wordt uitgelegd als een losstaande keuze om rente en kosten al dan niet in aftrek te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat de luxe reizen van ambtenaren leiden tot miljoenen euro’s extra kosten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether civil servants fly business class on official trips and what it costs, given the government's sober-government policy. The minister confirmed that flights of 6 hours or more allow business class under the harmonised travel rules, gave only partial cost data for 2012–2016, and declined to compare costs or foreign policy.
Unfortunately, the requested overview can only be provided in part.
Helaas is het gevraagde overzicht maar gedeeltelijk te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koerhuis over het bericht 'Erfpachtkorting 'groene' woning'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs whether housing corporations receive ground-price discounts or special erfpacht conversion terms from municipalities, how this fits EU state-aid rules, and how any benefit is recovered when homes are sold on the free market. The minister confirms the discounts can apply to DAEB social housing, says conversion to perpetual erfpacht is open to private buyers so no corporation advantage arises, knows of no other municipalities with such exceptions, and states that proceeds from DAEB sales stay within the DAEB arm, with Amsterdam having specific erfpacht payment arrangements.
Because the private owner is given the opportunity to convert to perpetual erfpacht, there is no advantage for corporations in the European legal sense.
Omdat de particuliere eigenaar in de gelegenheid wordt gesteld om over te stappen naar eeuwigdurende erfpacht, is geen sprake van een voordeel voor corporaties in Europeesrechterlijke zin.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Knops, Ten Broeke, Martin Bosma en Van der Staaij over de verboden stille tocht van Christenen voor Israël in Rotterdam

Six MPs asked why Rotterdam's mayor banned a silent march by Christians for Israel, questioning the security rationale given the comparable treatment of a Palestinian Return Centre congress and the impact on Jewish residents. The minister replied that maintaining public order is the mayor's responsibility and accountable to the municipal council, that the organisation itself chose to cancel the march, and that police capacity decisions in similar future cases rest with the mayor.
Maintaining public order in Rotterdam is the responsibility of the mayor of Rotterdam.
De handhaving van de openbare orde in Rotterdam is de verantwoordelijkheid van de burgemeester van Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de weigering van gemeenten om te stoppen met de ontwikkeling van een stemapp

MP Van Raak asked the Interior Minister why municipalities, including Molenwaard, refuse to stop developing a voting app despite no legal basis, which municipalities are involved, the total cost, and how they will be stopped. Minister Plasterk replied that electronic voting in legal elections is not permitted, that the app is only for consulting residents on local matters rather than testing election voting, and that he will work with the ministry on digital participation expertise.
Municipalities likewise have no room to make their own choices regarding statutory elections.
De gemeenten komt ook geen ruimte toe om ten aanzien van de wettelijke verkiezingen eigen keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het rapport ‘De woningmarkt in de grote steden’ van De Nederlandsche Bank

MP Kops asked the Minister of Interior about DNB's report on the big-city housing market, including its recommendations to expand the mid-rent segment and speed up the phase-out of mortgage interest relief. The minister agreed with the need for more mid-rent housing, said it is a local responsibility supported by national measures, and declined to commit to accelerating the mortgage interest relief phase-out, leaving that to a future cabinet.
Whether acceleration is desirable is a matter for a future cabinet.
De afweging of een versnelling wenselijk is, is aan een volgend kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Diertens over de schade aan het koraal voor de kust van Curaçao

MPs De Groot and Diertens asked about coral damage off Curaçao, whether the permit was breached, enforcement, compensation, Dutch assistance and treaty compliance. Minister Plasterk answered that investigations are ongoing, that permitting and enforcement are matters for Curaçao's own government, and that nature protection there is not the Kingdom's responsibility.
Permit granting and construction work on Aruba, Curaçao and Sint Maarten are matters for the countries themselves.
Vergunningverlening en bouwwerkzaamheden op Aruba, Curaçao en Sint Maarten zijn landsaangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Totale vernietiging van zeer groot oppervlakte gezond koraal'

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior about the destruction of nearly 3.7 hectares of healthy coral near Curaçao's port works, how it fits the permit's coral-saving obligation, its effects on research, tourism and liability, and Dutch support. The minister answered that the damage is still under investigation, that some planned damage was budgeted with 4 million ANG compensation, that liability is a matter for Curaçao, and that the Netherlands is open to cooperation on coral protection.
Nature protection is a responsibility of the countries.
Natuurbescherming is een verantwoordelijkheid van de landen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat het voor starters steeds moeilijker wordt een “goedkoop” huis te krijgen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that starter homes under 200,000 euro are becoming scarce, the size of the shortage, price rises and the government's plans for starters. The Minister acknowledged the reports, said the shortage estimate is not broken down by segment, pointed to existing schemes (NHG, gift exemption, municipal starter loans) and to talks with housing market regions, and agreed more building is needed.
A good flow of movement in the housing market is important for starters.
Voor starters is een goede doorstroming op de woningmarkt van belang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Geurts over voedsel- en landbouwbeleid voor Caraïbisch Nederland

Two CDA MPs asked about food and agriculture policy for the Caribbean Netherlands, given trade deficits and high food prices, and whether UPG status could help. The government answered that agriculture is primarily the islands' own responsibility, supported by a modest EUR 150,000 per year fund, and that UPG status would bring limited benefits and substantial burdens.
It is therefore primarily up to the islands themselves to give substance to this.
Het is daarmee primair aan de eilanden zelf om hier invulling aan te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diertens en Van Weyenberg over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

MPs Diertens and Van Weyenberg asked why the new financial assessment framework (nFTK) was not applied to the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, what the effects of its introduction would be, and about pension cuts, the court case with the State, income effects and flanking policy. The government answered that the nFTK cannot be transplanted directly, that it would not improve PCN's financial position, that a 3.5% cut has been applied with income effects of up to 1.4%, that no compensation is planned, and that talks with employers and PCN are ongoing.
In short, adapting the supervisory framework for the Caribbean Netherlands requires a separate assessment and separate legislation.
Kortom, een aanpassing van het toetsingskader voor Caribisch Nederland vraagt om een eigenstandige afweging en aparte wetgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over huurders die huisuitzetting riskeren door trage gemeente

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about Rotterdam tenants risking eviction due to long waiting times for housing permits under the Rotterdam Act, and about related information, evaluation and possible changes to the law. The minister answered that eviction should not follow from permit delays, that current data are unavailable pending an evaluation due October 2017, that no legal change on information provision is needed, and that the Rotterdam Act's segregation goal is being met, while the municipality is considering measures to shorten waits.
At this moment these figures are not available.
Op dit moment zijn deze cijfers niet beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat hypotheken met een lange rentevaste periode misleidend zijn bij verhuizing

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that long fixed-rate mortgages with NHG guarantee can be a trap when moving to a home above the NHG limit, and whether the NHG-based portability restriction is misleading and should be ended. The minister answered that NHG rules do not prevent porting the base rate, that some individual lenders impose such restrictions, that most have since relaxed them, and that consumers can complain to Kifid.
To mortgage providers who have not clearly stated such restrictions on porting a mortgage in their terms, I call on them to nonetheless allow mortgages to be ported.

Aan hypotheekaanbieders die dergelijke beperkingen op het meenemen van een hypotheek niet duidelijk in hun voorwaarden hebben vermeld, doe ik de oproep om het meenemen van hypotheken alsnog toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Voortman over het bericht ‘Energielabel is waardeloos’

MPs Van der Lee and Voortman asked whether the minister shares FedEC's criticism that the home energy label is unreliable, whether he will strengthen it and engage stakeholders, and how this relates to the EU infringement procedure. The minister rejects the criticism, cites studies showing 86-92% consistency, notes the EU procedure is ongoing, and promises follow-up research reports after the summer.
I do not share the criticism from FedEC.
De kritiek van FedEC deel ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over te hoge huurprijzen in de vrije sector

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about high rents in the private rental sector, the size of the middle-income group pushed into it, and whether rent protection or liberalisation limits should change. The minister answered that middle-rent supply should be arranged locally with new coordination tables and planning tools, that the Huurcommissie distinction for corporations is still under study, and that the liberalisation threshold stays frozen at 710.68 euro.
Before the summer I will inform the House, as already promised, about the state of affairs regarding the cooperation tables.
Voor de zomer zal ik uw Kamer, zoals reeds toegezegd, informeren over de stand van zaken rondom de samenwerkingstafels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Koerhuis over hypotheken, echtscheiding en maatwerk

Two VVD MPs asked whether mortgage lenders can and do provide case-by-case flexibility (maatwerk) after divorce or relationship breakdown, and how NHG, AFM rules and debt release work in such cases. The minister answers that the Platform Maatwerk has found no new bottlenecks, that the rules already allow justified deviations, that lenders vary in practice, and promises to inform the House before summer.
I will inform you before the summer about the outcomes of this.
Ik zal u voor de zomer informeren over de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Turkse regering die campagne voert in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would act against Turkish ministers campaigning in the Netherlands, including by pressing the Turkish government and preventing municipalities from hosting such events, as Germany had done. The answer refers to a separate letter to the House on the campaign visits and the events around 11 March 2017, rather than answering the questions on substance.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes ... have been answered by way of the letter 'Campaign visits by Turkish ministers and the events that took place around 11 March 2017'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes ... zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Campagnebezoeken van Turkse ministers en de gebeurtenissen die daaromtrent plaatsvonden rond om 11 maart 2017»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Azarkan over het bericht dat de Algemene Rekenkamer het kabinet steeds minder goed kan controleren

MPs Öztürk and Azarkan asked whether budget cuts threaten the Algemene Rekenkamer's ability to check the executive, including financial functions in ministries and other Hoge Colleges van Staat. The minister replied that the colleges manage their own budgets under agreements, that finance capacity has fallen about 30% since 2009 with programmes to strengthen it, and that no current review of ministry finance departments is needed, while agreeing to a further analysis of the colleges' finances.
In the period 2009–2015 the capacity of the financial function fell by almost 30%.
In de periode 2009 – 2015 is de capaciteit van de financiële functie met bijna 30% afgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman en Van Nispen over het bedonderen van ontevreden huurders in Groningen

MPs asked whether it is acceptable that legal advisers are paid by landlords not to take on tenant cases, and how the government will prevent this and protect tenants' access to the Huurcommissie. The minister said such contracts are disapproved of but depend on the case and are for courts to judge, that the Huurcommissie is accessible without legal aid, and that the number of such contracts is unknown.
In principle, citizens and businesses are free to decide with whom they enter into an agreement, when they do so, and what the content of the agreement is.
Het staat burgers en bedrijven in beginsel vrij om zelf te bepalen met wie zij een overeenkomst aangaan, op welk moment zij dat doen en om te bepalen wat de inhoud van de overeenkomst is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen in de basisregistratie personen (BRP)

MP Bergkamp asked the ministers about progress on ICT changes and legal amendments needed to register stillborn children in the BRP, following a petition and a prior letter. Minister Plasterk answered that a recalibration of Operatie BRP revealed major delays and costs, and he will inform the Chamber after receiving a BIT advisory report and deliberating on the matter.
I can therefore only inform you of the manner and timing of registering stillborn children after that.
Ik kan u derhalve pas daarna informeren over de wijze en het moment van registreren van levenloos geboren kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de ‘Woonagenda 2017-2021’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the planned expansion of social rental housing would go to Dutch citizens on waiting lists rather than being allocated to refugees, and whether municipalities would give refugees priority. The minister answered that waiting lists stem mainly from housing shortages, that the corporation sector can invest more, and that the mandatory priority for refugees was abolished from 1 July 2017 while the municipal refugee-housing quota remains, leaving urgency decisions to municipalities.
Ultimately it is up to municipalities to weigh whether or not to grant urgency status to refugees, based on local circumstances.
Het is uiteindelijk aan gemeenten om tot een afweging te komen over het al dan niet toekennen van de urgentiestatus aan statushouders, uitgaande van de lokale omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kops en Markuszower over het bericht dat werklui inbreuk zouden hebben gemaakt op de ‘huisvrede’ van krakers

MPs Kops and Markuszower asked the Minister of Home Affairs why workers were sent away from a squatted building for trespass, and why squatting is apparently not enforced, arguing owners should be protected. The Minister declined to comment on the specific Amsterdam case as a local matter, explained that squatters can be protected against trespass when residence is factual, and stated the existing instruments suffice to protect owners.
The way the squatting ban is enforced is a local matter.
De wijze waarop het kraakverbod wordt gehandhaafd is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over schimmel in huurhuizen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about mould and damp in rented housing, including calls for action in The Hague, serious leaks in housing for vulnerable elderly, a national inventory, compensation and fines data, municipal enforcement, the Wkb quality-assurance bill, and abolishing the landlord levy. The minister answered that landlords must maintain housing, that The Hague has a mould action plan, that a national survey (WoON 2018) will cover the issue, that no data exist on compensation, fines or municipal orders, and that the levy leaves corporations enough room to invest.
