I am not aware of any data on the number and amounts of compensation related to damp and mould problems, nor of penalty payments imposed in the past five years for this problem.

Mij zijn geen gegevens bekend over aantallen en bedragen schadevergoeding verbandhoudend met vocht- en schimmelproblemen en evenmin over dwangsommen die in de afgelopen vijf jaar zijn opgelegd vanwege deze problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er in Almelo per app gestemd kan worden

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the government was involved in a municipal trial of app-based voting in Almelo and how the secret ballot would be guaranteed. The minister replied he was not involved, that internet voting carries serious risks, that the law only permits paper voting in booths, and that any future trial would need transparent, verifiable state requirements.
I am not involved in the plans that the municipalities of Almelo, Emmen, Hollands Kroon, Molenwaard and Lingewaard have to trial internet voting with an app.
Ik ben niet betrokken bij de plannen die de gemeenten Almelo, Emmen, Hollands Kroon, Molenwaard en Lingewaard hebben om proeven te doen met het stemmen per internet
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat er binnen de gehele overheid informatieveiligheid nodig is

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government as a whole needs investment in information security, faster adoption of modern security standards and a legal obligation for them, following reports on 700 critical vulnerabilities in Rotterdam's systems. The minister answered that the government will consider the Digital Commissioner's study group advice, cites ongoing standardisation efforts and a planned GDI bill, and says no overall data exists on municipal security incidents.
There is therefore no comprehensive overview with the depth of a local audit office investigation.
Er is dus geen allesomvattend overzicht met de diepte van een lokaal rekenkameronderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Beckerman over de uitverkoop van slecht geïsoleerde corporatiewoningen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether housing corporations are deliberately selling poorly insulated rental homes with low energy labels to raise their average label, and how they will meet the 2021 average label B target. The minister denied a deliberate strategy, noted corporations' rising energy investments, and acknowledged that further investment and legislation will be needed, with an update promised before summer.
I have no indication that corporations pursue a strategy in which they only sell homes with low energy labels in order to bring their stock to an average label B.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat corporaties een strategie hanteren waarin zij enkel door verkoop van woningen met lage energielabels hun voorraad naar gemiddeld label B willen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van staatsbank Fortis bij omkoping van Italiaanse politici

An MP asked whether state-owned Fortis Bank failed to report unusual transactions by Francesco Corallo that may have funded bribery of Italian politicians, and what role KPMG and supervisor DNB played. The Minister of Finance explained the Wwft reporting duties, said compliance is assessed by DNB and the Bureau Financieel Toezicht, and declined to comment on individual institutions.
It remains the institution's own responsibility to report all unusual transactions.
Het blijft de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van een instelling om alle ongebruikelijke transacties te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Gemeente 'viert' islamitische feestdagen'

Three PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Almelo's promotion of Islamic holidays, through lighting a bridge, is objectionable and whether the minister would advise the mayor against it. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected like others, that municipalities decide how to reflect pluralism within the law, and that the choice of lighting days is for Almelo to decide.
In this case it is therefore up to the municipality of Almelo to decide on which days the lighting on the bridge is switched on.
In dit geval is het daarom aan de gemeente Almelo om te bepalen op welke dagen de verlichting op de brug aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Van Meenen over de berichten ‘Turkse spionage in Duitsland’ en ‘Terrorist vanwege interview met Rutte’

Two D66 MPs asked whether Turkish intelligence espionage reported in Germany also occurs in the Netherlands, including watch lists, whether Turkish-Dutch citizens are warned, whether Dutch services have enough Turkish language capacity, and how the government responds to threats against a journalist after an interview with PM Rutte. The government declined to say publicly whether such activity occurs or what services know, citing that no public statements can be made about investigations or service expertise, condemned threats against press freedom, and urged the journalist to file a police report.
No public statements can be made about investigations into activities these services might carry out without Dutch government permission, or about any resulting course of action.

Over onderzoek naar activiteiten die deze diensten zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse overheid zouden uitvoeren en over het eventuele handelings-perspectief dat uit een dergelijk onderzoek zou voortvloeien, kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ronnes en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat aardbevingsbestendig bouwen niet hoeft in Groningen

MPs Ronnes and Agnes Mulder asked whether construction firms in Groningen are building non-earthquake-resistant homes, how many, why NPR 9998 was not designated in the Bouwbesluit, and whether NAM compensation could be made mandatory. Minister Kamp answered that professional firms should apply the NPR, that its application is not mandatory, that a solution for NAM covering reasonable extra costs is being explored with a result expected by end 2017, and that the NPR will be designated once clarity exists.
Nor are there exact figures on the numbers.
Ook zijn er geen exacte inzichten in aantallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over de berichtgeving dat in Groningen nog steeds niet aardbevingsbestendig wordt gebouwd (Herdruk)

An MP asked the ministers why the earthquake-resistant building standard NPR 9998 is still not written into the Bouwbesluit, whether buildings are still being erected without it, and who is liable for damage. The minister agrees residents must be safe, says the NPR will be designated once legal clarity exists with an options study due by end 2017 to keep reasonable extra costs with NAM, and states NAM's strict liability under Article 6:177 BW applies to quake damage.
The NPR will be designated in the building regulations once there is clarity on this.
De NPR zal worden aangewezen in de bouwregelgeving, zodra hierover duidelijkheid bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over het bericht dat in Amsterdam €2 miljoen subsidie wordt uitgetrokken, te verstrekken aan projectontwikkelaars, voor de huisvesting van statushouders

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether he would stop favouring status holders over ordinary Dutch citizens in housing, and whether he would reprimand Amsterdam for a subsidy scheme of EUR 2 million for developers housing status holders, and how the scheme avoids distorting the market. The Minister replied that the scheme converts vacant offices into affordable homes, that half of units are for status holders and half for youth, that the municipality, not the national government, decides, and that subsidies are inherently market-distorting but subject to state-aid rules.
These frameworks also apply to decentralised governments.
Deze kaders gelden ook voor de decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Albert de Vries over de aankoop van een huis zonder financieringsvoorbehoud of bouwtechnische keuring

MPs Nijboer and De Vries asked whether buyers are increasingly dropping financing and building-inspection conditions to compete for homes, and what risks and remedies exist. Minister Plasterk answered that such conditions are advisable, that data is limited, that brokers should advise against risky bids, and that the government will research the scale of the problem before considering further steps.
The cabinet will therefore conduct research into the scale of this problem and will consider follow-up steps based on the outcomes.
Het kabinet gaat daarom onderzoek verrichten naar de omvang van deze problematiek en zal aan de hand van de uitkomsten vervolgstappen overwegen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Albert de Vries over het op de website van de Stichting IBK geplaatste memo met een reactie van de minister op aangenomen amendementen en moties bij het wetsvoorstel kwaliteitsborging voor

An MP asks the Interior Minister why an internal, non-agreed ministry memo interpreting amendments and motions on the construction quality bill appeared on the Instituut voor Bouwkwaliteit website and was then removed, and whether its reading conflicts with the Chamber's intent and reflects industry lobbying. The minister answers that the memo was an internal draft posted by mistake, that he will implement the amendments and motions as debated, that municipalities keep their enforcement role without assuming an independent quality judgement, and that he will extend the protected-monument motions to all protected monuments.
As indicated, I intend to implement the amendments and motions as I discussed them with your Chamber.
Zoals aangegeven ben ik voornemens de amendementen en moties uit te voeren, zoals ik deze met uw Kamer hebt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat topinkomens blijven stijgen

An MP asked whether municipalities may not cut subsidies when top salaries are paid, and why the transitional rules of the WNT are not being applied as intended amid reports of rising top incomes. The minister answered that subsidy conditions may not be disproportionate, that the transitional regime is not being breached as far as he can tell, and that the WNT-3 extension bill is awaiting Council of State advice.
After receiving the advice, I will take up the bill again.
Na ontvangst van het advies zal ik het wetsvoorstel weer ter hand nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over inspectie van gevaarlijk RVS in zwembaden

An MP asked the Interior Minister about municipalities failing to enforce the inspection duty for dangerous stainless steel in swimming pools, and whether dwangsom should be imposed and which steel types are allowed. The minister said the enforcement issue is being investigated with results due in June 2017, that municipalities have discretion in supervision, that enforcement including dwangsom is reasonable but a municipal decision, and listed the permitted stainless steel grades.

If this research also shows that the research obligation has been insufficiently complied with, I will hold municipalities and provinces accountable for their responsibility to enforce the research obligation at swimming pools.

Mocht uit dit onderzoek ook blijken dat de onderzoeksplicht onvoldoende is nageleefd, dan zal ik gemeenten en provincies aanspreken op hun verantwoordelijkheid om de onderzoeksplicht bij zwembaden te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kops over de toegenomen gemiddelde wachttijd voor een sociale huurwoning

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior Affairs whether it is fair that status holders receive priority for social rental housing while the average waiting time for Dutch applicants in the Haaglanden region has risen by a year, and whether the priority will be banned. The minister replies that the mandatory priority was lifted from 1 July 2017 so municipalities decide themselves, that rapid housing of status holders remains a priority, and that the government will stimulate construction of cheap rental housing and urges municipalities and housing corporations to use the available measures.

With this legal amendment the mandatory priority position for permit holders has been abolished and municipalities can themselves decide whether they wish to include permit holders as an urgency category in the housing ordinance.

Met deze wetswijziging is de verplichte voorrangspositie voor vergunninghouders opgeheven en kunnen gemeenten zelf bepalen of ze vergunninghouders als een urgentiecategorie wensen op te nemen in de huisvestingsverordening.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Paternotte over een gemeentelijke meldplicht voor verhuur van woningen via digitale platforms

MPs Van Eijs and Paternotte (D66) asked the Minister of the Interior whether a planned consultation with Amsterdam on a municipal reporting obligation for platform rentals would take place, whether results would be shared with Parliament and other municipalities, and whether a reporting duty would reduce the enforcement burden. The minister replied that no consultation is scheduled yet because Amsterdam must first add its day-count criterion to its housing ordinance, that existing law suffices and enforcement is a municipal matter, and that a reporting obligation would be disproportionately burdensome and ineffective, promising to inform Parliament only if concrete steps are taken.
If concrete steps have been taken, I will inform your House about this.
Als er concrete stappen zijn genomen, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het grote tekort aan betaalbare huurwoningen op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked whether the government will provide the guarantee needed for the Bonaire housing association FCB's plan to build 500 social rental homes, and whether a national mortgage guarantee will be introduced for Bonaire. Minister Plasterk answered that FCB lacks the financing for a viable project, that his ministry is still exploring options including with NIA before deciding on any state guarantee, and that the Waarborgfonds Eigen Woningen is preparing a temporary mortgage guarantee for Caribbean Netherlands with an operational scheme targeted for mid-2017.
Before the (im)possibility of a guarantee from the central government is on the table, I want to complete that exploration.
Voordat de (on)mogelijkheid van een garantie door het Rijk aan de orde is, wil ik die verkenning afronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over het artikel “Vergeefse zoektocht naar stemmen per bureau”

MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about reported counting errors in the 2017 election, the restricted inspection and non-copying of polling-station records, retention and publication of those records, and handmade counting. The minister answered that the procedures follow the Kieswet, that the credentials committee found no grounds for a recount, that an evaluation will be completed before summer recess, and that the records are retained for three months, though he could not publish or collect them himself.
The Kieswet does not allow the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to collect or publish the polling-station records.
De Kieswet staat niet toe dat de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties de processen-verbaal verzamelt of publiceert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Engelshoven en Raemakers over het publiceren van uitslagen per stembureau

MPs Van Engelshoven and Raemakers asked why the Kiesraad did not collect polling-station-level results after the 2017 election, and whether municipalities published them. The minister explained that digital transfer was banned for security reasons, so only municipal totals were transferred, that municipalities could publish station results, and that inspection rights had lapsed; he will include the issue in the evaluation.
That return (article N11 Kieswet) contains only the totals per party and per candidate for the whole municipality, not per polling station.
In die opgave (artikel N11 Kieswet) staan alleen de totalen per partij en per kandidaat voor de hele gemeente en niet per stembureau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de toestroom van Venezolaanse vluchtelingen naar Curaçao

Sjoerdsma (D66) asked about the sudden influx of Venezuelan refugees to Curaçao, whether the government had informed parliament, its earlier claims of no mass migration, the number of registered and unregistered refugees, reception capacity, crisis scenarios, support given, and asylum legislation gaps. The government answered that there is no mass migration flow, that about 20 asylum applications were registered on Curaçao and 2 on Aruba, that the islands lack capacity for thousands, that crisis scenarios and planning exist with the islands primarily responsible, and that asylum law is an autonomous matter for Curaçao and Aruba.
There is no question of a mass migration flow towards the Caribbean part of the Kingdom.
Er is geen sprake van een massale migratiestroom richting het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanstaande Hamas-conferentie in Rotterdam

Two MPs asked the Justice and Home Affairs ministers whether a Palestinian conference in Rotterdam organised by the Palestinian Return Centre, alleged to be linked to Hamas, should be stopped, and whether the mayor should be pressed to cancel it. The minister replied that the conference was not established as Hamas-organised, that no threat or legal breach was indicated, that public order lies with the municipality, and that action would follow if laws were broken.
However, from the information known to us it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas, so there is also no reason to exclude the organisation of the conference.

Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan echter niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas, waardoor er ook geen reden is om de organisatie van de conferentie te weren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over de conferentie georganiseerd door een aan Hamas verbonden organisatie in Rotterdam

An MP asked the ministers whether a Rotterdam conference organised by a Palestinian Return Centre, allegedly linked to Hamas, should be banned, and about its links, funding and ECOSOC status. The government answered that it cannot be concluded from known information that Hamas organises the conference, that funding of terrorism is monitored via FIU-NL, and that banning would require a threat to public order, which is not present.
From the information known to us, it cannot be concluded that the conference in Rotterdam is organised by Hamas.
Uit de bij ons bekende informatie kan niet geconcludeerd worden dat de conferentie in Rotterdam georganiseerd wordt door Hamas.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Raak over het bericht dat de CIA kwetsbaarheden in met het internet verbonden apparaten misbruikt

MPs Voortman and Van Raak asked whether the CIA uses smartphone and smart TV vulnerabilities to spy on people, including Dutch citizens, whether it withholds vulnerabilities from developers, and whether Dutch services will gain similar powers under the new intelligence law. The government said it has no concrete evidence of unlawful intrusion on Dutch citizens, referred to earlier letters on vulnerability handling, declined to judge the CIA's conduct on the basis of leaked material, and saw no reason to raise the matter with US authorities.
Based on the information published by Wikileaks, the cabinet cannot conclude that the American authorities have been negligent.
Op basis van de door Wikileaks gepubliceerde informatie kan door het kabinet niet worden geconcludeerd dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten nalatig zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over de dood van een agent op Bonaire

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Interior Affairs about the 2016 shooting death of a police officer on Bonaire, its impact on the force, and whether insurance and employer benefits differ between locally recruited and seconded officers. The Minister acknowledged the death and its effects, confirmed that terms of employment and employer arrangements differ for Caribbean Netherlands civil servants, and said a suitable employer provision for death in service is being examined.
Currently it is being examined how a suitable employer provision in case of death from a service accident can be created for (all) civil servants in the Caribbean part of the Netherlands.

Op dit moment wordt bezien op welke wijze een passende werkgeversvoorziening bij overlijden door een dienstongeval voor (alle) rijksambtenaren in het Caribisch deel van Nederland kan worden gecreëerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt, Van Laar en Kerstens over korting van het pensioenfonds Caribisch Nederland

Three PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior and the State Secretary of Social Affairs about planned pension cuts at the Caribbean Netherlands pension fund PCN, including a 3.5% cut in April 2017 and possible further cuts in 2018 under DNB supervision rules, and the reduced recovery period. The government confirmed the 3.5% cut and that further cuts depend on funding levels, explained the different recovery rules for Caribbean Netherlands, said it will work on targeted support measures, and declined to answer the question on PCN's 2010 capitalisation because the matter is before the court.
The cabinet, as an employer, is one of the social partners and is involved in talks about PCN's financial situation in that role.
Het kabinet is als werkgever één van de sociale partners, en is vanuit die rol betrokken bij de gesprekken over de financiële situatie van PCN.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de gang van zaken in de nasleep van de moord op drie vrouwen in Parijs

The MPs Gesthuizen and Van Bommel asked whether Dutch authorities knew that suspect Ömer Güney had died, what information was exchanged with France and Turkey about the Paris murders, whether he was a Turkish infiltrant, and how information misuse can be prevented. The government answered that it did not know of his death until media reports, declined to discuss the information exchange or the French indictment, said it had no information about an infiltrant, and deflected questions on Turkish use of shared information.
I do not make statements about ongoing criminal investigations.
Over lopende strafrechtelijke onderzoeken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het bericht 'Plasterk: laat links gecombineerde fractie vormen met Klaver als voorman'

An MP asked the Interior Minister how his call for left-wing parties to field joint lists in municipal elections fits with his bill abolishing list combinations. The minister replied that there is no conflict: list combinations only pool surplus votes for seat allocation, he never advocated them, only single lists, and he will support the bill in the Senate as he did in the House.
There is therefore no connection between the aforementioned bill and my plea in the Volkskrant.
Er is dus geen verband tussen voormeld wetsvoorstel en mijn pleidooi in de Volkskrant.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Agnes Mulder over het bericht ‘Nieuwe generatie IT-bedrijven klaagt over gebrek aan opdrachten van overheid’

MPs Amhaouch and Mulder asked whether government awards few contracts to Dutch web and digital agencies, and whether consultants should be encouraged to partner with them. The minister replied that 65 DDA member firms received about 112 million euro in Rijk contracts over 2010-2015, that no European ICT tender in 2016 was awarded to DDA members, and that a meeting with DDA would be organised to discuss possible barriers.
The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, together with the Ministry of Economic Affairs, organise a conversation with DDA to discuss any possible barriers.
Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal in samenwerking met het Ministerie van Economische Zaken een gesprek met DDA organiseren om eventuele blokkades te bespreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Albert de Vries, Leenders en Kuiken over balkons in Breda, die ook zonder belasting af zouden kunnen breken

MPs asked whether balconies of 160 flats in Breda could collapse without warning, the risks to residents, and whether mandatory inspections for gallery flats should extend to balconies. The minister said the defect was a too-deep reinforcement placement, the corporation acted promptly by closing balconies, the risk was judged small, and he sees no reason to extend the inspection duty, leaving enforcement to municipalities.
I therefore see no reason at this time to extend this inspection obligation.
Ik zie daarom thans geen aanleiding om deze onderzoeksplicht uit te breiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over verspilling van belasting- en premiegeld voor een afkoopsom van een directeur van een zorginstelling die nooit als zodanig heeft gewerkt

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a 65,000 euro severance payment to a care-institution director who never actually worked there was acceptable, and whether such payments should be banned. The minister called it regrettable but an isolated incident, said the WNT supervisor found no similar cases, and rejected a statutory ban, leaving such disputes to the parties or courts.
I regard it as an incident.
Ik beschouw het als een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ronnes over erfpacht in Amsterdam

The MP Ronnes (CDA) asks the ministers whether Amsterdam's municipal erfpacht buy-out offers and its residual land-value method warrant extra protection for homeowners, and what the tax revenue effects are. The minister replies that erfpacht is a private property right governed by the Civil Code with recourse to civil courts and general principles of good governance, that the Wft cannot apply, that the revenue effects cannot yet be estimated, and that no consultation with Amsterdam on revenue effects took place because the matter is municipal.
For municipal erfpacht, the municipality is moreover bound by the general principles of good governance.
Voor gemeentelijke erfpacht geldt bovendien dat de gemeente gebonden is aan de algemene beginselen van behoorlijk bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Vliet inzake de late publicatie van het accountantsprotocol woningcorporaties 2016

An MP asked why the 2016 accountant protocol for housing associations was published late, its consequences for associations, and whether it will be published earlier and a lighter control regime introduced. The minister defended the February publication as within the usual window, said publication timing depends on the dVi model, and promised to explore earlier publication with sector parties and evaluate dVi data requests.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ontslaguitkeringen voor NS-managers

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether the 565,956 euro in termination payments for two NS managers was justified, on what criteria, and whether the state as sole shareholder could approve, limit or prevent such payments. The minister answered that the payments were agreed individually due to the loss of suitable posts, that the shareholder only has powers over appointment, dismissal and pay of board members, and that the WNT does not apply to NS.
Under company law, as shareholder I only have powers regarding the appointment, dismissal and remuneration of the members of the executive board and supervisory board.

Op basis van het vennootschapsrecht komen mij als aandeelhouder alleen bevoegdheden toe op het gebied van benoeming, ontslag en beloning van de leden van de raad van bestuur en de raad van commissarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Monasch over de voorgenomen gemeentelijke herindeling van Haren, Ten Boer en Groningen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the province of Groningen's postponement decision on Haren's 2017 budget should delay the assessment of the proposed municipal merger and the preparation of a merger bill, and whether a second opinion from COELO should be requested. The minister answered that there is no link between the provincial postponement and the merger timetable, that the four-month deadline for sending a merger proposal to cabinet will be kept, and that there is no indication the province will assess the budget inadequately, so no second opinion is planned.
In my view there is no link between the provincial postponement decision on approval of the municipal budget 2017 and the progress of any possible merger.
Naar mijn oordeel ontbreekt een relatie tussen het verdagingsbesluit van de provincie omtrent de goedkeuring van de gemeentelijke begroting 2017 en de voortgang van een eventuele herindeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over zandwinning onder het Markermeer

An MP asked whether sand extraction under the Markermeer is being made unprofitable by the clay layer and the abolished domain-fee discount, and whether the government will reconsider and create instruments to make it as profitable as IJsselmeer extraction. The minister replied that the clay layer does not make extraction unprofitable, that no discounts have been granted for regular sand extraction since 2014, and that no new instrument is planned.
Given what has been stated in the answers to questions 1, 3 and 5, the Real Estate Agency sees no reason to revise its decision.
Het Rijksvastgoedbedrijf ziet gezien het gestelde in de beantwoording van vraag 1, 3 en 5 geen reden haar besluit te herzien.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de problemen die Nederlanders in het buitenland ondervinden bij het uitoefenen van hun stemrecht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about delays and problems in postal voting for Dutch citizens abroad for the 2017 election, including late ballot dispatch and the return envelope procedure. The minister referred most questions to a letter sent on 9 March 2017 and answered the dispatch-timing question by describing staggered mailing dates and the registration process.
In the evaluation of the upcoming election I will take into account the signals received from Dutch citizens abroad and also look at the suggestions made for possible improvements.

Ik zal in de evaluatie van de komende verkiezing de signalen meenemen die zijn ontvangen van Nederlanders in het buitenland en ook kijken naar de suggesties die zijn gedaan voor mogelijke verbeteringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de veiligheid van gevangenis Pointe Blanche op Sint Maarten

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior about security at Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten, including the risk of escape and riot, the Kingdom's responsibility for human rights, and measures to improve the situation. The minister shares the concerns, notes Sint Maarten bears primary responsibility, says the Dutch side is willing to help if asked, but makes no concrete new commitment beyond the existing improvement plan.

I am of the view, as also follows from the letters referred to above, that the government of Sint Maarten should keep its agreements and that the executive services, including the prison, should be enabled to carry out the necessary improvements.

Ik ben, zoals ook volgt uit de brieven waar hiervoor naar wordt verwezen, van mening dat de regering van Sint Maarten haar afspraken dient na te komen en dat de uitvoerende diensten – de gevangenis inbegrepen – in staat dienen te worden gesteld om de noodzakelijke verbeteringen door te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een Brits bedrijf het IT-beveiligingsbedrijf dat Nederlandse staatsgeheimen beveiligt, heeft overgenomen

MPs Van Raak and Jasper van Dijk asked why the state relies on a private firm to secure state secrets, whether the UK takeover of Fox-IT endangers them, and why the NCTV and MIVD were not informed or able to block the deal. The ministers answered that the state needs specialised private expertise, that contractual and legal security requirements guard against unwanted access, that no notification duty existed and Dutch law offers no grounds to restrict such takeovers, and that the MIVD lacks power to block them.
Under the existing contractual arrangements with the company concerned, there was no obligation to inform the NCTV of a proposed takeover.
Op grond van de bestaande contractuele afspraken met het betreffende bedrijf bestond niet de verplichting om de NCTV op de hoogte te stellen van een voorgenomen overname.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over het bericht ‘Overheid eist invloed bij cyberbeveiliger FOXIT’

An MP asked ministers whether the takeover of Fox-IT by NCC Group risks state secrets reaching foreign intelligence, why the government was informed only after the sale, and how dependent it is on private encryption firms. The government answered that existing secrecy law and contractual security requirements, with state supervision, cover the risk, that ministries were informed beforehand, and that alternative Dutch suppliers exist only in limited form.
Before the takeover, the ministries of the Interior and Defence were informed about it.
Voorafgaand aan de overname zijn de ministeries van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Defensie ter zake ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak over stembureaus op MBO-scholen

MPs Van Dijk and Van Raak asked whether the government supports placing polling stations at MBO schools, universities of applied sciences and universities to increase youth turnout, and whether it will consult education bodies and the VNG before the 15 March election. Minister Plasterk agreed in principle that accessible polling locations help youth turnout, noted that most municipalities had already designated polling stations and printed passes, and said he will encourage municipalities to pay attention to school-based polling stations for the 2018 municipal elections.

However, I am willing to suggest to municipalities that they give extra attention to the possibility of setting up polling stations in educational institutions for the municipal elections of 21 March 2018.

Ik ben echter bereid om gemeenten in overweging te geven om voor de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen van 21 maart 2018 extra aandacht te besteden aan de mogelijkheid van het inrichten van stembureaus in onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de berichten ‘Datalekken bij gemeenten; het is een beetje een zooitje’ en ‘Organisaties worstelen met nieuwe privacy wetgeving’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports of weak data-breach handling by municipalities, low notification to data subjects, and low GDPR readiness among organisations, and whether ENSIA accountability and procurement rules would be tightened. The Minister answered that municipalities and organisations are themselves responsible, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens decides on enforcement, and described ENSIA reporting from 1 July 2017 and existing procurement terms without committing to new mandatory measures.
It is for the AP and not for me to decide whether a fine or another intervention is appropriate.
Het is daarom aan de AP en niet aan mij om te besluiten of een boete of een andere interventie op zijn plaats is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een afkoopsom voor een directeur van een zorginstelling die daar nooit gewerkt heeft

An MP asked the minister whether a 65,000 euro severance payment to a care-institution director who never actually started work is permitted under the WNT pay-cap law, and whether the regulator would investigate. The minister answered that the WNT caps severance at one year's salary (max 75,000 euro), that the regulator sees no reason to investigate, that the payment is a wasteful but legal settlement under the employment contract, and that no general anti-abuse provision is needed.
I consider the whole course of events a regrettable waste of care money.
Ik acht de hele gang van zaken een betreurenswaardige verspilling van zorggeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bijklussende burgemeesters

An MP asks why mayors hold commercial side jobs, whether this endangers local governance, and why the ministry did not check mayors' and aldermen's disclosed side income. The minister answers that the mayor's post is a task-based function, that side jobs are permitted and disclosed under municipal law, that municipal boards are responsible for assessing and offsetting side income while the ministry only facilitates, and that an evaluation of the offsetting system will be sent around summer.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations is solely responsible for calculating the amount that may need to be offset and facilitates the offsetting process by providing a web application and a helpdesk.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties draagt uitsluitend zorg voor de berekening van het eventueel te verrekenen bedrag en faciliteert het verrekenproces door middel van het beschikbaar stellen van een webapplicatie en een helpdesk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold en Belhaj over de berichten over de situatie bij de luchtvaartmaatschappij Insel Air

MPs Belhaj and Pechtold asked the government about safety concerns and the financial crisis at Insel Air, the Caribbean airline, including why action came late, why civil servants were barred from flying with it, and what happens to connectivity if it fails. The State Secretary answered that signals were received late 2016, inspections by ILT and cooperation with Curaçao and Aruba followed, a travel precaution for civil servants was adopted, and an expert group on regional connectivity was set up.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Wilt u tekenen voor de democratie”

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about municipalities' poor service in letting voters sign support statements for party candidacies, including closed counters, untrained staff, and appointment-only policies, and about the timing of the statement window. The Minister acknowledged complaints, said he informed municipalities twice and will discuss improving service with the VNG-affiliated association and evaluate whether the law needs amendment after the election.
I regret this, and will discuss with the Dutch Association for Civil Affairs how municipal service on this point can be improved at a next election.
Ik betreur dit, en zal in overleg met de Nederlandse Vereniging voor Burgerzaken bespreken hoe bij een volgende verkiezing de dienstverlening van gemeenten op dit punt kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de veiligheid van onze verkiezingen

Two MPs asked the Interior Minister why OSV election software was not examined earlier, what safeguards exist, and whether votes will be counted on paper before the result is final. The minister answered that OSV will not be used at the next election out of precaution, that the next election will be evaluated including how the Kiesraad handled earlier warnings, and that there are no indications of past election manipulation.
In the evaluation I will also closely examine the process of calculating the result and the tools used, to determine how this process should be organised in future.

Ik zal in de evaluatie ook het proces van het berekenen van de uitslag en de hulpmiddelen die daarbij worden gebruikt goed onder de loep nemen om na te gaan hoe dit proces in de toekomst moet worden ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat 1 op de 5 gemeenten geen informatie op de website heeft over de locatie van stembureaus

An MP asked whether one in five municipalities lacks online information about polling station locations and whether the minister will urge them to publish it. The minister says he knows of no data beyond the cited website, agrees online publication is a good supplement to legal notification duties, and will ask municipalities to add the information.
I will soon ask municipalities (well before the election) to include information on their websites about polling station locations, insofar as they have not already done so.
Ik zal gemeenten binnenkort (nog ruim vóór de verkiezing) vragen om, voor zover zij dat nog niet gedaan hebben, informatie op hun website op te nemen over de locaties van de stembureaus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de MH17

Dutch MPs Omtzigt asked the Justice, Foreign Affairs and Interior ministers about withheld MH17 documents (interview transcripts, the JIT agreement), the unfinished internal police evaluation, deleted emails under the Archiefwet, and Russian radar data. The minister refused disclosure of the interview records and JIT agreement on grounds of confidentiality and ongoing criminal investigation, and gave partial, procedural answers on the other points.
The JIT agreement is not suitable for disclosure because it records operational arrangements for an ongoing criminal investigation.
De JIT-overeenkomst leent zich niet voor openbaarmaking omdat hierin operationele afspraken over een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek zijn vastgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Albert de Vries en Brouwer over het bericht ‘Geef grenswerkers belastingkorting’

MPs Albert de Vries and Brouwer asked whether the government would tackle tax and social security differences that create uncertainty for cross-border workers and would adopt expat-style tax relief for them. The ministers answered that the government relies on information provision and existing compensation schemes, that harmonisation is not feasible, and that the action team's agenda will be followed up.

The cabinet and the border regions are strongly focusing on optimising information provision for cross-border workers on tax and social insurance differences, so that the differences become transparent.

Het kabinet en de grensregio’s zetten voor fiscale verschillen en verschillen in sociale verzekeringsstelsels fors in op het optimaliseren van de informatievoorziening voor grenswerkers, zodat de verschillen inzichtelijk worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Raak over Russische hackers die gebruikmaken van Nederlandse server

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Russian hackers used a Dutch server, and whether such attacks can be prevented and how Dutch email vulnerabilities are addressed. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the government will keep parliament informed through general threat reports, and stated that political parties are primarily responsible for their own information security while the government raises cybersecurity awareness.
The cabinet does not make public statements about specific cases.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over specifieke casussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Groot over het bericht 'Cashen met valse scheiding populair'

MPs Omtzigt and Groot asked about reports that 'false divorces' to claim benefits are popular, and about the scale of address fraud and single-parent household trends. The State Secretary answered that address registration fraud combined with divorce is illegal and prosecutable, that married couples keep fiscal partner status unless formally divorced, gave income calculations, and described the Landelijke Aanpak Adreskwaliteit, which is continued until 2023.
If a couple does not actually separate but registers at two different addresses to obtain financial benefit, that is fraud and therefore punishable.
Als een stel niet daadwerkelijk uit elkaar gaat, maar zich op twee verschillende adressen inschrijft om financieel voordeel te genieten is dat fraude en dus strafbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het oppakken van een politicus die gebruik maakt van zijn vrijheid van meningsuiting

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why SP chair Theo Coskun was arrested while flyering at a Rotterdam RET transit area, whether RET security staff may detain politicians in public space, and whether freedom of expression requires no permit. The Minister explained the arrest followed refusal to leave after two fines under the Passenger Transport Act, and confirmed freedom of expression is constitutionally protected but restrictable, with no permit requirement possible.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that the arrest was made on the basis of article 184 of the Criminal Code, failure to comply with an official order.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij bericht dat de aanhouding is verricht op grond van artikel 184 van het Wetboek van Strafrecht, het niet opvolgen van een ambtelijk bevel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Gemeente profiteert van gedraal Plasterk’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that municipalities profit from delayed abolition of the precario levy on underground utility networks, which shifts costs onto non-residents and rose sharply in 2016. The minister acknowledged the cross-subsidy effect, called the levy indirect and democratically opaque, said the 10-year transition gives municipalities enough time, and refused any extra municipal fund compensation.
The indirect nature of the precario levy on utility networks, in my view, obscures the democratic weighing that should legitimise the imposition of taxes.
Het indirecte karakter van de precariobelasting op nutsnetwerken vertroebelt naar mijn mening de democratische afweging die de heffing van belastingen dient te legitimeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Veldman inzake het bericht Technieklokaal Winterswijk bang voor sluiting door te weinig geld

MPs Straus and Veldman asked whether the government would close the funding gap threatening the Winterswijk technology classroom, which faces closure without it. The state secretary said schools decide how to spend funds, that the classroom can continue under school choice through 2020, and that the national government does not give individual grants to support organisations.
The national government does not give individual contributions to supporting organisations; this runs via the schools themselves.
De rijksoverheid geeft geen individuele bijdragen aan ondersteunende organisaties, dit loopt via scholen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over de schimmigheid omtrent teruggekeerde jihadisten

An MP asked the ministers of Justice and Security and of the Interior about the status of 31 returned jihadists, how many are free or convicted, and whether all should be preventively detained. The minister said seven have been convicted and a prosecution decision has been taken on about eight more, withholding further detail to protect ongoing investigations, and rejected administrative detention as incompatible with the rule of law under Article 5 ECHR.
Providing further criminal-law information about persons designated as returnees, including any pending prosecution decisions, could possibly harm ongoing investigations.

Het verstrekken van nadere strafrechtelijke informatie over als terugkeerder aangemerkte personen, inclusief eventuele op handen zijnde vervolgingsbeslissingen, kan mogelijk lopende onderzoeken schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het reviseren van een ingezonden stuk voor Computable door een topambtenaar van het ministerie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a senior civil servant from the ministry revising an op-ed critical of MPs before it was submitted to Computable, and whether this was acceptable and what measures would follow. The minister confirmed a fact-check was done at the author's request, described the revisions as minor, and said no measures would be taken.
In this case a check for factual inaccuracies was carried out; there was no co-writing.
Er is in dit geval een check op feitelijke onjuistheden gedaan, er is niet meegeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over het gebruik van de Ondersteunende Software Verkiezingen (OSV)

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the Ondersteunende Software Verkiezingen (OSV), whether election results published as open data on data.overheid.nl are incomplete, and what would be done about missing municipal results. The minister answered that using software is optional and the Kiesraad's database receives municipal data via OSV, with the Kiesraad able to request missing data directly and the minister willing to urge municipalities to share data.
I am of course willing to urge municipalities to make election data available to the Kiesraad, insofar as they do not already do so via OSV.
Ik ben vanzelfsprekend bereid om gemeenten daarin aan te sporen om verkiezingsdata aan de Kiesraad beschikbaar te stellen voor zover zij dat al niet doen via OSV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het artikel 'Veel overheidssites hebben geen beveiligde verbinding'

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a news report that many government websites lack secure connections. The minister said security depends on whether sensitive data is exchanged, outlined TLS adoption targets and monitoring, and noted that the Data Protection Authority supervises compliance.
The picture painted in the media that connections to many government websites are not well secured deserves some nuance.
Het in de media geschetste beeld dat de verbindingen naar veel overheidswebsites niet goed beveiligd zijn, verdient enige nuance.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Helft websites overheid onveilig’ en ‘Veel overheid websites onnodig onveilig’

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked the ministers whether government websites are insecure, whether over half lack encrypted connections, and what risks this poses, and whether UWV's sites are affected. Minister Plasterk answered that organisations are responsible for securing their sites, that agreed targets require HTTPS on sensitive pages by end 2017, that progress is being measured, and that UWV sensitive data is adequately protected.
Each government organisation is ultimately itself responsible for securing its own government websites.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beveiligen van de eigen overheidswebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht 'Nieuwe opwinding over GIEL-salaris'

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked whether a reported salary of 560,000 euros for a public broadcaster's radio presenter is reasonable and whether non-top staff in the public sector should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT). The State Secretary called such a salary unreasonable and said the WNT-3 bill extending the pay norm to non-top staff, including presenters, is expected to go to the Council of State for advice soon.
The cabinet also wants the statutory pay norm to apply to non-top officials in the (semi-)public sector, including presenters, programme makers and radio DJs at the public broadcaster.
Het kabinet wil daarnaast dat de wettelijke bezoldigingsnorm ook op niet-topfunctionarissen in de (semi)publieke sector van toepassing wordt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het topinkomen van een radiomaker

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a public broadcasting radio presenter earns about 560,000 euro a year, and whether public-broadcaster staff should fall under the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) salary cap of 181,000 euro. The government says it cannot verify the reported salary from WNT disclosures, finds such pay undesirable, has demanded concrete follow-up from the broadcaster, and says a WNT-3 bill extending the cap to non-top officials is in preparation.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me shortly which concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding a more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de topsalarissen bij de publieke omroep

An MP asked the government about reported high salaries at public broadcasters, including a radio DJ allegedly earning about three times the WNT norm, and asked for greater transparency. The state secretary said such pay above the WNT norm is undesirable, that the NPO was ordered to announce concrete steps on hiring and pay policy, that the WNT is being extended to non-top officials via a draft bill, and that the broadcasters must provide information to the minister on request.
I have ordered the public broadcaster to inform me in the short term of the concrete follow-up steps it intends to take regarding more responsible hiring and remuneration policy.
Ik heb de publieke omroep gesommeerd mij op korte termijn te laten weten welke concrete vervolgstappen zij voornemens is te zetten op het terrein van een meer verantwoord inhuur- en beloningsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Wolbert over de Wet Normering topinkomens voor de zorgsector

MPs Kerstens and Wolbert asked whether the WNT pay cap applies to self-employed healthcare professionals such as GPs, dentists and pharmacists, and about the CIBG questionnaire. The minister answered that the WNT applies by law based on organisational form, that CIBG designates no institutions, that the questionnaire was halted to allow consultation, and that medical specialists will be excluded from the WNT via a bill in preparation.
The CIBG does not designate any institutions.
Het CIBG wijst geen instellingen aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de inmenging in kerkelijke vieringen door de gemeente Eindhoven

An SGP MP asked whether the municipality of Eindhoven was pressuring the Catharina church parish over its services by tying organ maintenance to changes in worship, and whether this breached the state's duty to stay out of church affairs. The minister answered that the 1974 loan agreement governs use of the church, that maintenance is a statutory duty of the owner independent of the agreement, that government must not interfere in internal church matters, and that he will not intervene in the parties' agreements.
Every owner of a national monument is required under the Heritage Act to carry out the maintenance necessary for its preservation.
Iedere eigenaar van een rijksmonument is in het kader van de Erfgoedwet verplicht het voor de instandhouding noodzakelijke onderhoud te plegen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over chakra-cursussen voor ambtenaren in Heemskerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the chakra-based training courses bought by the municipality of Heemskerk for its civil servants, at over EUR 422,000, should be halted or recovered from the municipality. The Minister replied that municipalities set their own training budgets, that the municipal council is responsible for judging this, and that recovering funds from the municipal fund would not fit the constitutional relationship between central and local government.
Municipalities themselves determine the training budget and training policy for their civil servants.
Gemeenten stellen zelf het opleidingsbudget en het opleidingsbeleid vast van hun ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de aanslag op Theo van Gogh

MP Van Raak asked whether the CTIVD saw the 152 wiretap passages withheld from journalist Wierenga, whether the Chamber can be given confidential access to them, and whether the lone-actor conclusion on Bouyeri is convincing. Minister Plasterk confirmed the CTIVD reviewed all wiretap transcripts, declined to provide the passages, and maintained that the CTIVD found no concrete evidence of accomplices.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het Paleis op de Dam symposium “Caribische koraalriffen”

Parliamentarian Bosman asked the Interior Minister about the state of Caribbean coral reefs, their value, whether enough attention is paid to them within the Kingdom, and whether the issue can be put on the agenda of the next Kingdom Conference. The minister acknowledged the reefs are in worrying condition, said natural protection is mainly a responsibility of the constituent countries and the Ministry of Economic Affairs rather than the Interior Ministry, offered to discuss a task force, and agreed to put the topic on the Kingdom Conference agenda and the Caribbean Sustainable Development Forum.
Nature protection is a responsibility of the countries, not of the Kingdom and not of the Minister of the Interior.
Natuurbescherming is een verantwoordelijkheid voor de landen, en geen verantwoordelijkheid van het Koninkrijk en evenmin van de Minister van BZK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over vervuilende afvalstort op Sint Eustatius

MP Van Laar asked whether a storm on Sint Eustatius washed a large part of the landfill into the sea, whether the landfill still sits on the coast, and why the new waste installation is not yet operational. Minister Plasterk answered that only a small part slid onto Zeelandia beach with limited environmental damage, that the Island Government is responsible for operating the new installation and is working on a budget solution, and that the Rijksvertegenwoordiger will keep discussing the timeline with the island.
The Island Government is currently looking for a solution.
Het OL is op dit moment bezig met het zoeken naar een oplossing.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Bosman over het bericht "Op Sint Eustatius spoelen koelkasten de zee in"

An MP asked the minister about press reports that refrigerators were washing into the sea on Sint Eustatius and about the waste separation installation built by the central government. The minister denied large-scale washing-out, said the island's government lacks funds to staff and operate the installation, and listed the investment of over EUR 1.3 million paid by the ministry.
The image that large amounts of waste, including refrigerators, have been washed into the sea is not correct.
Het beeld dat er op grote schaal afval, inclusief koelkasten, in de zee zijn weggespoeld, klopt niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Vliet en Houwers over de schadeloosstelling van Kamerleden toekomen

Two MPs asked whether SP requirements that MPs assign their parliamentary pay to the party, with the party paying back a lower salary, and tax-deductible giving, compromise MPs' independence, the oath, and the free-mandate principle. The Minister answers that such assignment is not in itself incompatible with independence, but that the appearance of financial dependence is undesirable, and defers further judgment to a pending court case.
I do not consider it useful to make general statements on this in advance of that ruling.
Ik acht het niet zinvol om, vooruitlopend daarop, hier in algemene zin uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Grashoff over het arrest van het Europees Hof van Justitie inzake het achterhouden van milieu-informatie in het kader van bedrijfsbelang

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the government how it would respond to two 2016 CJEU rulings on withholding environmental information for business interests, and whether it would prioritise disclosure of environmental information over companies' commercial interests under the Dutch FOI law. The government answered that the rulings require awaiting the national court's follow-up, that disclosure is the rule under the Aarhus Convention but commercial-interest exceptions still apply to non-emission data, and that the Ctgb operates an 'open unless' policy and is already disclosing pesticide dossiers, while promising to await the CBb ruling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over het bericht dat jaaropgaven van 1712 cliënten van enkele Groningse sociale diensten per ongeluk aan een andere cliënt zijn toegestuurd

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked about the misdirected sending of 1,712 income statements of clients of Groningen social services, the data leak risk, the number of municipal data leaks, security of municipal systems and readiness for the new GDPR. Minister Plasterk answered that the incident is a data leak reported to the Dutch Data Protection Authority, that municipalities remain responsible for their own information security, and that VNG and KING provide support, while the DPA does not comment on investigations.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority does not make statements about possible investigations.
De Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens doet geen mededelingen over eventuele onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Bergkamp over het uitvoeren van het VN-Vrouwenverdrag

MPs Dijkstra and Bergkamp asked several ministers about implementing the UN Women's Convention (CEDAW), covering reporting, the 2005 self-employed maternity compensation case, stereotyping in advertising, domestic violence, care for trans and intersex people, sex work registration, and Caribbean Netherlands. The government answered that it will inform parliament in January 2017, rejects the committee's recommendation on maternity compensation pending a Supreme Court-level ruling, and pledges several follow-up actions but declines to investigate some concerns.
The committee recommended that the Dutch government (financially) compensate self-employed women who gave birth in that period. The government decided not to follow this recommendation.

Het comité heeft de Nederlandse regering aanbevolen om vrouwelijke zelfstandigen, die in die periode zijn bevallen, (financieel) te compenseren. De regering heeft besloten om deze aanbeveling van het Comité niet op te volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over het artikel ‘Een skelettransplantatie voor de BRP’.

The MP De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior whether the phasing out of code generators in the BRP population-register software amounted to replacing its entire skeleton, and why this was presented as a mere improvement rather than a material change, including questions on budget, schedule and code quality. The Minister answered that refactoring changes no functionality, that the step was a routine part of development following consultation with the interbestuurlijke stuurgroep, that KPMG reports improved maintainability, and that a fuller assessment of the effects on planning will follow in the next progress report.

I informed you in the progress letter that I asked the programme and the inter-administrative steering group to take the necessary steps in the coming months to complete the validation of the integrated planning.

Ik heb u in de voortgangsbrief gemeld dat ik het programma en de interbestuurlijke stuurgroep heb gevraagd in de komende maanden de nodige stappen te ondernemen om de validatie van de integrale planning af te ronden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Nispen over beperkingen van het demonstratierecht

MPs Van Raak and Van Nispen asked whether a mayor may require only 'positive messages' at demonstrations, as the mayor of Geleen did, and how this fits constitutional rights and controls on emergency measures. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wom bars content-based restrictions, that the mayor's conduct can be reviewed by the council and courts, and that local authority is responsible, while the Minister lacks instruction powers.
Imposing a demonstration ban based on the content of the thoughts or feelings to be expressed is not permitted.
Het opleggen van een demonstratieverbod op grond van de inhoud van de te openbaren gedachten of gevoelens is niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

MP Taverne asked the ministers whether their earlier answer on the EU Electoral Act negotiations meant the government would accept the proposal in the Council even if Parliament rejected it, and asked them to confirm they would implement the Taverne motion requiring prior Parliament approval before a Council vote. The minister confirmed the motion is being implemented, noting it is not a formal parliamentary reservation under the Lisbon treaty approval law but will have that effect in substance.
In substance, however, it will have this effect. The motion is therefore being implemented.
Materieel zal het echter wel deze werking hebben. De motie wordt derhalve uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder, Van Helvert en Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Andere zorgen over kerncentrale Tihange’

MPs from the CDA asked whether it is alarming that safety plans of the Tihange nuclear plant were publicly accessible online, whether the minister will raise this with Belgium, and what cyber-security rules apply. The minister agreed it is alarming, said the ANVS has discussed it with Belgium's FANC and will raise it with his Belgian counterpart, and described existing nuclear cyber-security rules and reporting obligations.
I will also do so when I am in contact with my Belgian colleague Jambon.
Ik zal dit ook doen als ik contact heb met mijn Belgische collega Jambon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over het dispuut rondom Oyster Pond

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether French authorities inspected a construction site on the Dutch side of Oyster Pond, whether the border there is settled, and whether this is a territorial dispute and what its consequences are. The minister confirms a disagreement over the land border, says the status quo agreed in 2014 was breached by the French inspection, notes that border negotiations will start soon, and says relations with France are not affected.
The land border negotiations will be started as soon as possible.
De landgrensonderhandelingen zullen zo spoedig mogelijk worden aangevangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat 200 mensen aangehouden zijn bij de intocht van Sinterklaas

MP Kuzu asked the Justice and Interior ministers about the arrest of about 200 anti-Zwarte Piet demonstrators, the Rotterdam city-centre demonstration ban, the emergency order, police conduct and the broader Zwarte Piet debate. The minister answered that the police offered to escort the group to Maassluis but they chose to go to central Rotterdam, that the mayor's ban was justified for public order, and that complaints about police force can be filed with the police or courts, while the Zwarte Piet tradition is a matter for society and broadcasters.
The mayor of Rotterdam committed in the council debate of 17 November 2016 to evaluate the events surrounding the arrests for the council.
De burgemeester van Rotterdam heeft in het raadsdebat van 17 november 2016 toegezegd aan de raad de gebeurtenissen omtrent de aanhoudingen te evalueren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het ontbreken van schoolboeken op een school in Bonaire

An MP asked whether the VWO school Liseo Bonairiano on Bonaire still lacked textbooks for several subjects, what caused it, whether other schools were affected, and how equal education standards are guaranteed across the Dutch Caribbean. The Staatssecretaris answered that late sea delivery of books caused shortages, teachers used self-made materials so no lesson time was lost, all books are now present, no other schools report problems, and a second education agenda for Caribbean Netherlands is being signed.
The board of the Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is responsible for ordering and keeping the books in stock.
Het bestuur van de Scholengemeenschap Bonaire (SGB) is verantwoordelijk voor het bestellen en op voorraad hebben van de boeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de campagne ‘zet een streep door discriminatie’

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether he will remove Giel Beelen from the government anti-discrimination campaign spot after Beelen's racist remarks, and whether the government's refusal condones discrimination. The minister answers that discrimination is unacceptable, the spot is no longer broadcast, Beelen has apologised, and the matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
The matter is not for the cabinet to decide.
De zaak is niet ter beslissing voor het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel “Kandidaten 50plus beloven hun zetel niet te roven”

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the written pledge 50Plus requires candidates to sign (to give up their seat if they leave the party faction) is legally enforceable and whether it conflicts with the Constitution and Electoral Act. The minister answered that the pledge is not legally enforceable, that MPs vote without instruction under Article 67 of the Constitution, and that he saw no reason for further information or consultation with the Electoral Council.
Under Article 67, third paragraph, of the Constitution, members vote without instruction.
Ingevolge artikel 67, derde lid, van de Grondwet stemmen de leden zonder last.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat moslims steeds vaker slachtoffer zijn van discriminatie vanwege hun geloof

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the ministers about reports that Muslims are increasingly victims of religious discrimination, including the rise in reported incidents, the effects of terrorism and rhetoric by politicians, possible measures, and a registry of cases and sentences. The government answered that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to the 2015 discrimination report and the Nationaal Actieprogramma, and gave incident counts for 2013-2015 while declining a separate racism police force and taking no firm new measures beyond awaiting a study on triggers.
On the basis of this report, I want to examine, after consulting relevant partners, where efforts to combat Muslim discrimination can be further strengthened.
Op basis van deze rapportage wil ik, na overleg met betrokken partners, nagaan waar de inzet op het bestrijden van moslimdiscriminatie verder versterkt kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Pechtold over het bericht dat er geen aidsremmers meer in Curaçao beschikbaar zijn

MPs Dijkstra and Pechtold asked the ministers about reports that HIV/AIDS medication was unavailable in Curaçao, including how many patients were affected and what Nederland would do. Minister Schippers answered that Curaçao is responsible for its own healthcare, declined to provide patient figures, and said she is not currently in talks with Curaçao's government.
In this case it is not for the government of another country, the Netherlands, to judge and intervene in what I regard as internal affairs of the country of Curaçao.
Het is in dit geval niet aan de regering van een ander land, Nederland, om te oordelen over en te interveniëren in wat ik als, interne aangelegenheden van het land Curaçao beschouw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Kerstens over het recht op een werkloosheidsuitkering voor Nederlanders die in Caribisch Nederland werkzaam zijn geweest

Two MPs asked whether Dutch nationals whose last job was on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba can claim unemployment benefit under the Werkloosheidswet, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirmed that such workers are excluded from the European-Dutch unemployment insurance, pointed to the one-off Cessentiawet BES benefit on the islands, and refused to change the rules.

No. Employees whose last work was in Caribbean Netherlands can claim a one-off benefit under the Cessentiawet BES, if they become unemployed through no fault of their own and meet the other conditions.
Nee. Werknemers die laatstelijk werkzaam zijn geweest in Caribisch Nederland kunnen aanspraak maken op een eenmalige uitkering op grond van de Cessentiawet BES
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Van Oosten over het bericht 'OM kan aangiften discriminatie niet aan, slechts kwart behandeld'

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about a report that prosecutors cannot handle discrimination complaints and only a quarter are processed, and how this fits the government's call to report discrimination. The minister confirmed the figures, said police must record all discrimination complaints under the Aanwijzing Discriminatie, admitted no verified explanation exists for the decline, and pledged to keep discrimination prosecution a priority while noting measures to raise reporting rates.
Yes, I share that view and I have also expressed my concerns about this to the Chair of the College of Procurators-General.
Ja, die mening deel ik en ik heb hierover ook mijn zorgen geuit aan de voorzitter van het College van Procureurs-Generaal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de aangiften van discriminatie in behandeling wordt genomen door het openbaar ministerie

An MP asked the ministers about reports that only a quarter of discrimination complaints reach the public prosecution service, and what is being done to raise reporting and improve handling, including online discrimination. The government denies the figures as stated, says it shares concern about reporting and is reviewing the Discrimination Directive with police and OM, but refuses a racism register, a racism police unit, and dedicated extra budget, pointing to existing action programmes.
For an explanation of this, I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from Member Marcouch.
Voor een verklaring hiervoor verwijs ik naar het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Marcouch
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de test met internetstemmen voor kiezers in het buitenland

MP Taverne asked the Minister of Interior about how many participants the internet voting test for voters abroad needs, how many have signed up, what is being done to boost participation, and when codes will be sent. The minister answered that no fixed number of participants is required, that over 9,000 people had signed up after a mailing by The Hague municipality, and that codes are expected at the end of November with the test running 7 to 13 December.
No specific number of participants is necessary for this.
Hiervoor is niet een bepaald aantal deelnemers noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over discriminatie van autochtonen door een Haagse wethouder

Two MPs asked the ministers whether a The Hague alderman's plan to give preference to candidates of migrant background in hiring, when equally qualified, amounts to discrimination against natives and whether the alderman should be called to account. The minister answered that such preferential policy is permitted under strict conditions of the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling, that municipalities bear their own responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene for now, while promising to inform the House on follow-up action after an anti-discrimination monitor.
A municipality has in principle its own responsibility, and the municipal executive must account for this to the municipal council.
Een gemeente heeft in beginsel een eigen verantwoordelijkheid en het gemeentebestuur dient hierover rekenschap te geven aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de voortgang van de besprekingen inzake de Kiesakte betreffende de verkiezingen van de leden van het Europees Parlement

An MP asked the ministers about progress on the EU Electoral Act revision for European Parliament elections, including which proposals were gaining Council support and whether the government would inform parliament before Council votes. The government replied that member states are sorting provisions into acceptable, unacceptable and undecided groups, that Dutch positions stay anchored in its 2015 standpoint, and that it will inform parliament of emerging majorities and not agree to a Council position parliament rejects.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over de berichten ten aanzien van de nieuwe gouverneur van Aruba

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the appointment of Aruba's new governor followed the 2001 appointment protocol and whether the candidate was screened for conflicts of interest under the governor regulations. The minister answered that the protocol has no legal status, the usual procedure was not followed because Aruba issued no recommendation, and no screening under articles 6 and 7 by Aruba's Prime Minister took place, though a similar check occurred before the candidate was made Minister Plenipotentiary.
In this case the procedure as described in the note, whereby a written recommendation is made by the Council of Ministers, was not followed.
In dit geval is de procedure zoals beschreven in de notitie, waarbij een schriftelijke aanbeveling door de Raad van Ministers wordt gedaan, niet gevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Lespakketten over Zwarte Piet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a municipality (Maassluis) was distributing controversial lesson packs on Zwarte Piet to primary schools, including a quiz with racist-tinged questions, and whether the mayor should be urged to stop. The state secretary replied that the municipality only helped connect schools with an outside foundation, that schools decide their own teaching materials, that the government takes no position on the origins of Piet, and that it would not intervene.
No lesson packs are distributed to primary schools from the municipality of Maassluis.
Vanuit de gemeente Maassluis worden geen lespakketten onder basisscholen verspreid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de gemeenten de WOZ-inzage op orde heeft

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why only about a quarter of municipalities publish WOZ property values via the national WOZ portal, and when all will comply with the legal duty. The minister attributes delays to technical and capacity problems in connecting to the national facility, points to an appointed facilitator and a March 2017 deadline, and says municipalities must communicate interim ways for residents to access values.
Responsibility for connecting to the national WOZ facility lies with the municipalities in this matter.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de aansluiting op de Landelijke Voorziening WOZ ligt in dezen bij de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het door derden onttrekken van gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket

Gesthuizen (SP) asked whether third parties are harvesting WOZ property valuation data from the WOZ-waardeloket for commercial purposes, whether this is allowed under Article 40a Wet WOZ, how it is monitored and prevented, and whether access could be restricted via DigiD.
