Minister Plasterk answered that automated bulk extraction is not permitted, that anti-scraping safeguards and monitoring by the Kadaster are in place, but that full prevention is not feasible without undermining transparency, and that the government will decide on bulk provision after evaluation and a working group is examining further openness.
It is indeed not permitted to extract data from the WOZ-waardeloket in an automated manner.
Het is inderdaad niet toegestaan om op geautomatiseerde wijze gegevens aan het WOZ-waardeloket te onttrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat dat de Kinderombudsman wordt bedreigd vanwege haar mening over Zwarte Piet

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about reports that the Children's Ombudsman was threatened over her views on Zwarte Piet, and about discrimination children experience and whether the tradition breaches the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government condemned the threats, said security measures are taken when needed without detailing them, declined to take a cabinet position on Zwarte Piet, and offered facilitation of dialogue plus a planned new research study.
However, I cannot provide information about the content of any security measures.
Ik kan echter geen informatie verstrekken over inhoud van eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “Gemeenten boos om tariefstijging Vicrea”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior about reports that municipalities face steep price increases from software vendor Vicrea, and whether the vendor's justification and municipalities' ability to switch providers are acceptable. The minister answered that about 195 municipalities use Vicrea software with increases of 40 to 1,150 percent in a sample, left the vendor's claim to the vendor, and pointed to open-standards agreements, guidance tools and existing monitoring as the means of preventing vendor lock-in.
I consider it a matter for the supplier and the customer to determine whether there is a business risk or whether the costs should be passed on.
Ik acht het een zaak van leverancier en afnemer om te bepalen of er sprake is van een ondernemersrisico of dat de kosten moeten worden doorbelast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over een vermeende geheime fiscale compensatieregeling voor het Koninklijk Huis

An MP from 50PLUS asked the ministers of Interior and Finance about an alleged secret tax compensation arrangement for the Royal House, covering ten questions on its legitimacy, legality, parliamentary knowledge and possible recovery of benefits. The government's answer, given by Prime Minister Rutte, refers the MP to an earlier letter answering a related request from another MP, rather than answering the questions on substance.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Botsing Aruba en Nederland over gouverneur’

An MP asked whether the Rijksministerraad appointed a governor of Aruba without a nomination from Aruba, and whether the nomination followed the legal and administrative framework. The minister answered that the appointment followed the Statute and procedures, that no Aruban recommendation with support had emerged after the term expired, and that Aruba's government accepts the appointment for the sake of Kingdom relations.
The appointment decision was therefore lawfully made.
Het benoemingsbesluit is aldus rechtmatig tot stand gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Acuut behoefte aan meer bewakers en cellen'

An MP asks the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that the Pointe Blanche prison on Sint Maarten urgently needs more guards and cells, and about who is responsible for the situation. The minister says the conditions match the Voortgangscommissie picture, that the Sint Maarten government must implement improvement plans with Dutch help conditional on effectiveness, and that the Sint Maarten government is responsible for the prison while he will press for compliance with the agreed plans.
Once the new government of Sint Maarten is installed, I will speak with them about progress on the action plans for the police and the prison.
Zodra de nieuwe regering van Sint Maarten is geïnstalleerd, zal ik met hen spreken over de voortgang inzake de plannen van aanpak voor de politie en de gevangenis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwéover het artikel ‘Gluren in privégegevens’

The VVD MP De Caluwé asked the Minister of the Interior about civil servants looking at and sharing private data without authorisation, how this is registered, prevented and checked, and how online citizen services will be secured. The Minister answered that organisations register breaches themselves (34 of 557 Rijk breaches in 2015 were in the broad leaking/misuse category), that confidentiality duties and sanctions apply, that only targeted checks on logs are allowed, and that a government-wide information security baseline (BIO) and email security standards are being introduced.
Logging data must first show whether there is a justified suspicion of unauthorised actions.
Uit logginggegevens moet eerst blijken of er sprake is van een gerechtvaardigd vermoeden van niet-geautoriseerde handelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “parlement krijgt ‘slechts enkele dagen’ voor goedkeuring Citgo-deal’’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of the Interior whether Aruba's parliament had enough room to scrutinise the Citgo/Valero refinery purchase, and whether the purchase was submitted to the CAft oversight college. The minister said the parliament's role is a matter for Aruba's own Staten, that the purchase is a national affair not submitted to CAft, and that CAft will assess the budget effects later.
Based on the Aruba Financial Supervision Ordinance, the CAft has the authority to advise on Aruba's budget and budget amendments.
Het CAft heeft op basis van de Landsverordening Aruba financieel toezicht (LAft) de bevoegdheid om te adviseren op de begroting en begrotingswijzigingen van Aruba.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het sluiten van een school op Curaçao als gevolg van uitstoot van gevaarlijke stoffen van de ISLA raffinaderij

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why a Curaçao school was again evacuated due to emissions from the ISLA refinery, and what steps were taken to implement a motion to cut emissions within three months. The minister declined to answer the facts and causes questions, saying the matter is Curaçao's responsibility, but said an inspection of the refinery is being assisted and results are expected by year-end.
These questions relate to a matter that falls under the responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Onderhavige vragen hebben betrekking op een onderwerp dat tot de verantwoordelijkheid behoort van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over gelukscursussen voor ambtenaren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior how many municipal civil servants attended a happiness course ('Sturen op geluk in het publieke domein'), its cost, how many municipalities have happiness coordinators or budgets, and why such funds are not spent on care or re-integration. The Minister replied that municipalities set their own training budgets and that the ministry does not monitor participation, costs, happiness coordinators or budgets, so most questions could not be answered; the course price was referenced at EUR 4,995 and the Minister declined to judge municipal spending choices.
Decentralised governments (including municipalities) themselves determine the training budget and training policy for their civil servants.
Decentrale overheden (waaronder gemeenten) stellen zelf het opleidingsbudget en het opleidingsbeleid vast van hun ambtenaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Marcouch over het rapport van de Nationale ombudsman

MPs Servaes and Marcouch asked ministers to respond to the National Ombudsman's report on unintended loss of Dutch nationality, including whether government informed citizens adequately and whether nationality law should change. The government largely rejects the claim of inadequate information, pointing to past campaigns and its website, promises to examine how outreach can be more active, and says it cannot yet judge the report's findings on nationality law.
On the basis of the recommendations in this report, I will examine whether that information can be made even more active and targeted.
Aan de hand van de aanbevelingen van dit rapport zal ik onderzoeken of die voorlichting nog actiever en gerichter kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Kerstens over het bericht dat miljoenen euro’s in zakken van zorgdirecteuren verdwijnen

MPs Van Dijk and Kerstens asked the government about reports that millions of euros of public care funds flow to care directors as dividends, and how this is permitted and controlled. The State Secretary answered that the WTZi bans profit distribution in institutional care but allows it in some outpatient care, that internal supervisors, insurers and municipalities oversee this, and that existing rules are sufficient, while promising to fight abuse via the governance code and inspections.
In the first instance, it is up to the supervisory body of the care provider concerned to assess whether paying out dividends is in the interest of the provider's continuity and patient care.

Het is in eerste instantie aan het toezichthoudend orgaan van de betreffende zorgaanbieder om te beoordelen of het uitkeren van dividend in het belang is van de continuïteit van de aanbieder en de zorgverlening aan patiënten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over verzekeraar Ennia op de Antillen

MP Van Raak asked the ministers of Finance and Interior about the Ennia insurer in the Caribbean: the valuation of the Mullet Bay resort, conflicts of interest, auditing by KPMG, remedies for policyholders, and who screened Hushang Ansary. The ministers declined to answer the valuation and conflict questions citing DNB's confidentiality duty, answered the audit and screening questions only partly by pointing to the former Bank Nederlandse Antillen and the CBCS, and referred to earlier answers on policyholder remedies.
For these reasons I do not have the information to answer these questions.
Om die redenen beschik ik niet over informatie om deze vragen te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Maij en Marcouch over het bericht “Frontman Pegida Nederland jaagt in Bulgarije op vluchtelingen”

MPs Kuiken, Maij and Marcouch asked whether a Dutch Pegida frontman hunting refugees in Bulgaria is a matter for private citizens, whether his conduct is punishable, whether a private army is criminal, and whether a passport ban could apply. The minister replied that border control is for the competent authorities, he has no knowledge beyond media reports, Dutch criminal law may apply extraterritorially under article 7 Sr, and he sees no current grounds for passport revocation.
I am not aware of the activities of the Dutch man mentioned in the report, other than what emerges from media coverage.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de activiteiten van de in het bericht genoemde Nederlandse man, anders dan uit de berichtgeving in de media naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over ‘Toezichthouders MCL gaan er fors op vooruit’ (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Wet normering topinkomens, which raised the maximum pay for supervisory board members, invites supervisors to rush to the new maximum, especially in healthcare, and whether the stated reason for the increase (compensating for lower executive pay) was accurate. The minister answered that the increase reflects broader supervisory roles and greater actual time spent, that individual agreements must stay within the law, and that the increase was separately motivated in the legislative process.
Any increases in remuneration must also be seen in the context of this broadening of roles, responsibilities and time commitment.
Eventuele verhogingen van de bezoldiging moeten ook in het kader van deze verruiming van de rollen, verantwoordelijkheden en tijdsbesteding worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over topinkomens bij Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (HERDRUK)

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked how top-salary rules (WNT) apply to top officials at Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland after the organisation's management team structure was changed, and whether the rules can be circumvented. Minister Blok answered that the WNT applies based on actual leadership rather than formal structure, that the supervisor is the Eenheid toezicht WNT, that a legislative extension to all employees is in preparation, and that enforcement will follow if formal changes do not reflect actual practice.
Only if it is established that the officials concerned in practice have continued to provide leadership will enforcement action be taken.
Alleen indien komt vast te staan dat de betrokken functionarissen in de praktijk gewoon leiding zijn blijven geven, kan en zal handhavend worden optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over oproep van een Arubaanse minister om een visumplicht voor Venezolanen in te voeren

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Interior about an Aruban minister's call for a visa requirement for Venezuelans, and whether the issue had been discussed among the Kingdom countries. The government answered that there is currently no reason or request from Aruba for a temporary Caribbean visa requirement, that the issue has been raised in consultations and videoconferences, and that screening measures are preferred.
There is currently no request to that effect from the Aruban government or other Kingdom countries.
Er ligt op dit moment geen verzoek daartoe van de Arubaanse regering of andere Koninkrijkslanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over online-casino’s vanuit Curaçao in Nederland

An SP MP asked the Interior and Justice ministers about online casinos licensed from Curaçao operating in the Netherlands, including ownership, oversight, a telecom provider's role, and the gambling sector's revenue. The minister answered that the Dutch Gambling Authority has investigated such operators and ended violations through informal enforcement, but that online gambling oversight on Curaçao is a matter for Curaçao's government and Public Prosecutor, won't answer questions on individual companies, and will raise concerns with Curaçao's Justice Minister.
It is not possible to answer questions about individual Curaçao companies, business structures and citizens.
Het is niet mogelijk om vragen over individuele Curaçaose bedrijven, bedrijfsconstructies en burgers te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over grootschalige illegale gokactiviteiten vanuit Curaçao en de rol van KPMG

An MP asked the government about large-scale illegal online gambling run from Curaçao, the telecom company UTS's role, and KPMG's ties to UTS and other state-owned companies. The minister answered that Curaçao's gambling oversight is a Curaçao matter, that the Dutch gambling authority lacks enforcement powers there, and declined to answer questions about individual companies and citizens.
It is therefore a matter for the government and the Public Prosecution Service of Curaçao to properly regulate the oversight of online gambling.
Daarmee is het een aangelegenheid van de regering en het Openbaar Ministerie van Curaçao om het toezicht op online-kansspelen goed te regelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en Arno Rutte over het bericht dat de gemeente Heerhugowaard gedeeld eigenaar van een ziekenhuis wil worden

MPs Veldman and Rutte asked whether Heerhugowaard may co-own a hospital under the Fido Act, how the province supervises the financial risk, and whether a municipality could have an incentive to weaken WMO care to fill beds. The minister answered that the municipal council must judge whether co-ownership serves the public interest, that the province exercises only repressive supervision and cannot block the investment in advance, and that the WMO concern is not realistic.
Heerhugowaard is currently subject to repressive supervision, so its structural and real budgetary balance is assessed only afterwards.
Voor de gemeente Heerhugowaard geldt momenteel het repressieve toezicht, waardoor het structurele en reële begrotingsevenwicht alleen achteraf wordt beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Kerstens over het verkrijgen van raadsinformatie via een Wob- verzoek (Wet openbaarheid van bestuur)

Members Leijten and Kerstens asked why two parties in Oude IJsselstreek must file a Wob request to obtain information on contracts for home-visit (keukentafel) assessments, and whether bonus-malus arrangements tied to outcomes are acceptable and used elsewhere. The state secretary said council information rights under the Gemeentewet are broader than Wob, rejected bonus-malus arrangements as inconsistent with the Wmo 2015, and reported that no other municipalities are known to use them.
That accountability and information duty is broader than the disclosure duty arising from the Wob, because the Wob regulates citizens' right to government information.

Die verantwoordings- en informatieplicht is breder dan de openbaarmakingsplicht die uit de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob) voortvloeit, omdat de Wob het recht van burgers op overheidsinformatie regelt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de racistische en discriminatoire gebeurtenissen in de weken 22 en 23

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about racist incidents in Geesteren and elsewhere, victim support, police reporting practices, specialisation in discrimination cases, rising racist violence, and non-implementation of ECRI recommendations. The Minister said victim support follows standard procedure, the motorcop case is under investigation so no comment is possible, police reporting uses a multichannel approach, discrimination training is being strengthened, and the ECRI recommendations are partly addressed through the National Action Programme with a progress report due January 2017.
This case is currently being investigated. While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about it.
Deze zaak wordt momenteel onderzocht. Lopende het onderzoek kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Verhoeven over de eenheid van regeringsbeleid ten aanzien van het raadgevend referendum

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether she agreed with Prime Minister Rutte's remarks calling the Ukraine referendum disastrous and opposing referenda on multilateral agreements, and how this fits the government's neutral advice on the advisory referendum law. The minister answered that the PM's remarks were a personal view, that the cabinet gave neutral advice and later signed the law, and that individual ministers may comment on long-term general matters without threatening policy unity.
He also noted that his remark about referenda (in general terms) is a personal opinion.
Daarnaast heeft hij opgemerkt dat zijn uitlating over referenda (in algemene zin) een persoonlijke opvatting is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de aankoop van een olieraffinaderij door het land Aruba

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior Affairs and Kingdom Relations about Aruba's purchase of the Citgo refinery, including who signs, Dutch involvement, liability for debts, environmental clean-up and gas supply. The minister answered that the purchase is an Aruban national matter with no Dutch involvement, that Nederland cannot be held liable, and promised a letter before the recess with the available information.
The purchase of the refinery by the government of Aruba is a matter for the country. For that reason the Netherlands has no involvement in it.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij door de regering van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid. Om die reden heeft Nederland hierbij geen betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de regels ten aanzien van deeltijdwethouders

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about part-time alderman arrangements that may be used to avoid offsetting side income, including the Reusel case, minimum time-allocation norms, and appeal timelines. The Minister answers that such arrangements are not prohibited by law, that the council is responsible for setting time norms, and that the ministry checks offset figures against tax data, while declining to set a statutory minimum.
Appointing aldermen is pre-eminently a local, autonomous matter and a power and responsibility of the council.
Het benoemen van wethouders is bij uitstek een lokale, autonome aangelegenheid, en wel een bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht Aanleg gasleiding Venezuela door internationaal consortium

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports of a Venezuelan gas pipeline and the reopening of the Citgo refinery on Aruba, covering timing, fuel supply, contracts and Aruban expertise. The minister said Aruban affairs are a national matter with no Dutch involvement, promised a letter with available information on the Aruban agreements, and referred the contract question to that letter.
The purchase of the refinery is a national affair of the country of Aruba. The Netherlands has had no involvement in this.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij betreft een landsaangelegenheid van het land Aruba. Nederland heeft hierbij geen betrokkenheid gehad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht Aruba schikt met Valero over milieuschade

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that Aruba settled with Valero over environmental damage at the refinery, Nederland's role in the negotiations, Valero's liability for decommissioning, a timeline of the purchase, and whether Aruba had sufficient expertise. The minister replied that the refinery purchase is a matter for Aruba, that Nederland was not involved, and that the negotiations with Valero are not concluded and details are unknown to him.
The purchase of the refinery by the government of Aruba is a country matter.
De aankoop van de raffinaderij door de regering van Aruba is een landsaangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Schouten over Driezorg in Zwolle en de Wet normering topinkomens

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked about a 426,113 euro severance payment to the former director of Driezorg in Zwolle and whether it complies with the WNT pay cap. The state secretary answered that the amount exceeds the WNT limit but that pre-WNT agreements apply until four years after 2013, that the accountant found no violations, and that the CIBG will nonetheless investigate.
Nevertheless, the CIBG will carry out an investigation to ensure there is no question of violations.
Desondanks zal het CIBG een onderzoek uitvoeren om zeker te stellen dat er geen sprake is van overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het inkomen van een directeur bij Delta

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the reported €400,000 salary offered to a new director of Delta, far above the WNT norm, is inappropriate and whether the minister will contact Delta's supervisory board as he did with Alliander. The minister answered that pay at government-owned companies outside WNT scope is for shareholders and supervisory boards to decide, and that he sees no reason to convey his views to Delta.

Given the existing scope of the WNT, however, it is not the task of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to convey this message separately each time to government holdings that fall outside the scope of this act.

Gegeven de bestaande reikwijdte van de WNT is het echter niet de taak van de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om deze boodschap telkens afzonderlijk over te brengen aan overheidsdeelnemingen die buiten de reikwijdte van deze wet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koolmees en Kerstens over de uitspraak van de Raad van State dat Haagse subsidieregels die topsalarissen verbieden in strijd zijn met de wet

MPs Koolmees and Kerstens asked the Minister of the Interior how he responds to the Council of State ruling that The Hague's subsidy rules banning top salaries violate the General Administrative Law Act, and whether he will amend the law. The minister says the ruling limits subsidy conditions to the purpose of the subsidy, that the Awb already allows conditions on top incomes, and that a legal basis for municipal salary caps would not resolve municipalities' objections because the WNT transitional rules would still apply.
Therefore the objections of municipalities cannot be met by creating a legal basis for top income caps by local governments in any law.
Er kan dus niet aan de bezwaren van gemeenten tegemoet worden gekomen door in enige wet een wettelijke basis te creëren voor topinkomensnormering door decentrale overheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Gevangenen Curaçao in de val’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about reports that prisoners on Curaçao were trapped by welded-shut fire doors, whether the evacuation plan works, who is responsible for injuries, and when the doors will be replaced. The minister said a fire-brigade inspection found the evacuation plan adequate, replacement quotes have been requested, and responsibility for prison safety lies with Curaçao's justice minister as an autonomous matter.
The management of the prison on Curaçao is an autonomous matter for the country of Curaçao.
Het beheer van de gevangenis van Curaçao betreft een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over toezichthouders in de zorg die hun vergoeding verhogen

An SP MP asked whether it is morally objectionable that care-sector supervisors raised their own pay sharply, and whether the government foresaw this after loosening the pay norm. The minister explained that the WNT norm was raised to match the actual time spent on supervision and defended the increases as part of expanded responsibilities, while declining to track total public spending on these pay packages.
Remuneration exceeding the pay maxima will, subject to transitional law, have to be brought back down to the norm.
Bezoldigingen die de bezoldigingsmaxima te boven gaan zullen, met inachtneming van het overgangsrecht, teruggebracht moeten worden naar de norm.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de topinkomens in de zorg

Two PvdA MPs asked whether it is troubling that healthcare executives earn above the minister's salary, and whether executives should voluntarily forgo pay above the WNT norm, and whether they are paid in line with the WNT. The minister answered that pay limits are set by the WNT, that institutions and supervisors make a societal assessment within those limits, that pay is a recurring topic with employer organisations, and that CIBG supervises WNT compliance and enforces where needed.
CIBG, the supervisory body in healthcare, monitors compliance with the WNT and enforces it where necessary.
Het CIBG, de toezichthouder in de zorg, ziet toe op de naleving van de WNT en treedt, indien nodig, handhavend op.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over eisen die aan pasfoto’s worden gesteld

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about passport photo requirements under the Fotomatrix 2007, including municipalities applying inconsistent rules on glasses, hair, face coverings and temporary tattoos, and about automated photo booths and information provision. The Minister said the Fotomatrix is binding and based on ISO/EU standards, that inconsistencies in application are possible given thousands of officials, that applicants can object and appeal, and that he will keep informing municipalities and photographers, but he declined to tighten the rules or ban tattoos.
That does not prevent me from continually drawing municipalities' attention to the correct application of the acceptance criteria.
Dat laat onverlet dat ik de juiste toepassing van de acceptatiecriteria voortdurend onder de aandacht breng bij gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een racistische aanval in Zwolle

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a racist attack in Zwolle, victim support, rising racist violence, stronger penalties such as an educational sentence for discrimination, police specialisation in discrimination complaints, and budgets for combating discrimination and radicalisation. The government replied that victim support follows the regular procedure, existing sentencing options suffice, police already have discrimination contact persons, and gave the budget figures, but declined to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het inroepen van hulp van de Marokkaanse consul bij rellen Ede

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether calling in the Moroccan consul to restore order among rioting youths in Ede undermined Dutch authority, and what the government would do to restore order. The minister replied that the consul only sought talks at the mayor's request, that Dutch authorities alone hold authority, and that maintaining public order is a local responsibility with no further central measures announced.
Maintaining public order is a local responsibility.
Het handhaven van de openbare orde is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat volksvertegenwoordigers worden bedreigd

An MP asked the government how it responds to reports that elected officials are being threatened, whether figures show a trend, what protective and preventive measures exist, and how threats are prosecuted. The minister answered that threats are unacceptable, that reported incidents fell from 38% to 23% of local officials between 2012 and 2014, that a new monitor is pending, and that existing measures and prosecution practice are sufficient.
It cannot be clearly established what the effectiveness of these measures and instruments is individually.
Het is niet eenduidig vast te stellen wat de effectiviteit van deze maatregelen en instrumenten afzonderlijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de stijging van externe inhuur bij gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why municipalities increasingly hire external staff, whether this is undesirable, and whether the government will work with the VNG to apply the 'Roemernorm' cap to municipalities. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous and responsible for their own operations, that the increase stems from decentralisation tasks, and declined to take the initiative.

Given the own responsibility of the decentralised governments, I will not take over your request to work together with the VNG on proposals for how the 'Roemernorm' can also be applied to municipalities.

Gegeven de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de decentrale overheden zal ik uw verzoek om samen met de VNG, met voorstellen te komen hoe de «Roemernorm» ook bij gemeenten toegepast kan worden, niet overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht “Een op de vijf gemeenten archiveert website niet”

MP Veldman asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether he was alarmed that one in five municipalities does not archive its website as legally required, and whether he would act to ensure compliance. The minister acknowledged the concern, said municipalities are responsible for their own information under the Archiefwet and that enforcement falls under interbestuurlijk toezicht, and pointed to broader advice on information management rather than announcing concrete new steps.
Every government is responsible for managing its own information and for applying the Archiefwet.
Iedere overheid is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van zijn eigen informatie en voor de toepassing van de Archiefwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “Gemeentelijke e-mail slecht beveiligd”

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the Interior Minister about a report that municipal email is poorly secured, asking about compliance with mandatory email security standards, enforcement, and a proposed privacy baseline for municipalities. The minister replied that standards are mandatory only for new purchases, that municipalities are responsible for their own supervision with national intervention possible but not yet used, and that a privacy baseline is a matter for the VNG to decide.
Nevertheless, the national government can, under the Municipalities Act and within interadministrative supervision, supervise the municipal executive.
Desalniettemin kan het Rijk op grond van de Gemeentewet – in het kader van interbestuurlijk toezicht – toezicht houden op het gemeentebestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat een Curaçaose loterij het ook goed doet in Nederland

MPs Bosman and Van Wijngaarden asked whether illegal sales of Curaçao lottery tickets in the Netherlands are undesirable, whether kansspelbelasting should be paid, and what enforcement exists and is used. The government agrees the sales are undesirable and that tax should be paid, describes administrative and criminal enforcement tools, says the Kansspelautoriteit so far used only informal measures such as warnings because cases were not large-scale, and says the minister will raise internet gambling oversight with Curaçao at the JVO.
The investigation by the Kansspelautoriteit led to intervention and to the ending of the violations.
Het onderzoek van de Kansspelautoriteit heeft geleid tot interventie en tot het beëindigen van de overtredingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een gesubsidieerd haatfeest

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether The Hague municipality sponsors a Ramadan festival that allegedly features gender segregation and glorification of terrorists, and whether the government will stop such support or cut the municipal fund. The minister answered that The Hague gave no sponsorship or other support to the event, that the municipality has a policy of not subsidising religious gatherings, that subsidy decisions are a local matter, and that cutting the municipal fund is not possible.
Furthermore, the decision whether or not to subsidise initiatives is a local matter.
Voorts is het zo dat de afweging om wel of niet over te gaan tot het subsidiëren van initiatieven een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Zowel bajes van Curaçao als Sint Maarten afgekeurd’

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about press reports that prisons on Curaçao and Sint Maarten failed inspection and whether the Kingdom should help them meet CPT standards. The minister said enforcement is primarily the responsibility of the countries themselves, that the Netherlands supports detention facilities only on request, and that he has no reason to think the evaluation report does not reflect reality.
On that basis, it is primarily up to the governments of the countries to act.
Op basis daarvan is het primair aan de regeringen van de landen om te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de voortgang van het openbaren van nieuwe categorieën overheidsinformatie

MP Voortman asks the Minister of Interior when the AEF study and cabinet appraisal on publishing new categories of government information will reach parliament, and what 'scaling up' of the pilots means. The minister replies the report and cabinet response will be sent before the summer recess, and describes ministry pilots on publishing research reports and open spending data at local level.
The report 'Steen voor steen de rivier over' by Andersson Elffers Felix and the cabinet response to that report will be sent to the House of Representatives before the summer recess.
Het rapport «Steen voor steen de rivier over» van Andersson Elffers Felix (AEF) en de kabinetsreactie op dat rapport, verzend ik voor het zomerreces aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een jihad-prediker naar de As Soennah moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Belgian imam who allegedly preaches violent jihad could speak at the As Soennah mosque in The Hague, and whether the mosque should be closed or dissolved and the municipality should stop cooperating with it. The minister answered that the imam showed no incitement to violence, that as an EU national he cannot be barred, that the prosecutor has seen no grounds to seek dissolution, and that cooperation with the mosque is a municipal matter.
Based on the facts and circumstances, the prosecution service has so far seen no reason to ask the court to close a mosque.
Op basis van feiten en omstandigheden heeft het OM tot op heden geen aanleiding gezien om de rechter te verzoeken een moskee te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Ronnes over het bericht in De Telegraaf van 6 april 2016 ‘Platteland eist groter deel rijksuitkering’

MPs Amhaouch and Ronnes asked about a Telegraaf report that rural municipalities demand a larger share of the state fund, and about AEF's recommendation to redistribute EUR 88 million toward smaller municipalities. Minister Plasterk answered that the fund managers adopted only one third of the new formula for 2016, that full implementation would shift funds toward rural municipalities, and that a decision will follow after consulting the Rfv and VNG without giving a firm date.
In deciding how the fund managers handle the study's results, the advice received from the Rfv and VNG will be taken into account.
Bij de besluitvorming over hoe de fondsbeheerders met de resultaten van het onderzoek omgaan worden de ontvangen adviezen van de Rfv en VNG betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf over de weigerburgemeester van Weert

Two PVV MPs asked whether the Minister had requested a factual account from the Commissioner of the King on the 'refusal mayor' of Weert, when it would be ready, whether it would be shared with parliament, and whether maatregelen would be taken if the mayor broke the law. The Minister confirmed requesting the account, received it on 26 May, discussed it with the mayor on 2 June, sent parliament a letter with a factual overview on 16 June, and said no breach of law was found.
On 16 June 2016 I informed your House in writing, based on the Commissioner of the King's factual account and the conversation with the mayor, about the course of events in Weert.

Antwoord 3 en 4 Op 16 juni 2016 heb ik uw Kamer, op basis van het feitenrelaas van de commissaris van de Koning en het gesprek met de burgemeester, schriftelijk 1 geïnformeerd over de gang van zaken in Weert.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over €10.000 aan shoptegoed voor asielzoekers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why refugee families in Oisterwijk receive EUR 10,000 in shopping credit from the municipality without repayment, whether a national guideline with lower costs and loans should be set, and whether Australian-style regional-only reception should be adopted. The State Secretary answered that individual special assistance is a municipal competence accountable to the municipal council, the ministry has no overview of municipalities above EUR 2,000, and regional reception is part of the cabinet's migration approach.
The granting of special assistance is decentralised both in policy and financially to the mayors and aldermen (colleges of B&W).
De verlening van bijzondere bijstand is zowel beleidsmatig als financieel gedecentraliseerd aan de colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Aruba koopt Valero raffinaderij met vervuilde grond en al’

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that Aruba is buying the Valero refinery with contaminated soil, including the business case, costs, cleanup, dependence on Venezuela, sustainability and fiscal risk. The minister answered that the purchase is a national Aruban matter, that the CAft oversight body will assess fiscal consequences, and that the cleanup fund and other details are not known to the Kingdom government.

About the business case for the purchase and lease structure of the refinery and the economic value of reopening it, I have no further information beyond media reports, as this is a national Aruban matter.

Over de businesscase voor de aankoop en leaseconstructie van de raffinaderij en de economische meerwaarde van de heropening van de raffinaderij is mij geen nadere informatie dan uit mediaberichtgeving bekend, aangezien het hier een landsaangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht over de wankele fundamenten van de e-overheid

MP Van Raak asks the Minister of Interior about press reports that the e-government's foundations are fragile, including ICT project risks, reliance on external contractors, the BRP operation's budget and timing, and the powers of the Digital Commissioner. The Minister rejects the 'dream machine' framing, agrees early risk signalling matters, says in-house ICT capacity and reduced external hiring are being pursued, gives no guarantee against further budget overruns, and says the Digital Commissioner's role does not cover specific projects.
I will keep your House informed of the programme's progress through semi-annual reports and interim reports where necessary.
Ik houd uw Kamer op de hoogte van de voortgang van het programma via halfjaarlijkse rapportages en indien nodig tussentijds
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht “beveiliging tientallen gemeentesites lek: persoonsgegevens niet veilig”

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked whether municipalities can securely handle citizens' confidential data via websites, after reports that some did not use https; the minister said the BIG is being implemented, that 10 of 390 municipalities were fixed, and that municipalities are responsible for security and accountable to councils. The minister rejected a separate audit, declined a single national website for now, and said privacy-BIG talks are ongoing with no firm commitment.

An investigation such as you describe would, in my view, as a snapshot of the application of a single technical measure, offer insufficient added value compared with the current accountability system.

Een onderzoek zoals u dat schetst zou als momentopname van de toepassing van een enkele technische maatregel mijns inziens onvoldoende meerwaarde bieden ten opzichte van het huidige verantwoordingsstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht ‘Dat salaris is nu eenmaal afgesproken’

Mr Van Raak (SP) asked the minister whether it is improper that the director of HVC, a public-task company owned by municipalities and water boards, earns above the WNT pay norm, and whether the minister will contact HVC or its shareholders about lowering the salary. The minister replied that HVC falls outside the WNT, that extending the WNT to decentralised public companies is being studied, and that it is for shareholders and supervisory boards to set pay, so he sees no reason to convey his views to HVC's shareholders.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Amhaouch over het bericht ‘Afschaffen gebruikersdeel OZB blijkt sterk nadelig voor 270 eigenaren van niet-woningen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether abolishing the user component of the municipal property tax (OZB) for non-residential properties, as done in Lelystad, unfairly burdens owners of business premises with a residential part, and whether this conflicts with a 2006 parliamentary amendment. The minister confirmed the abolition is a local choice, that the burden shift is a consequence of how municipalities finance it, and that municipalities are autonomous and may mitigate the effect, but did not commit to new measures.
They are autonomous in this and can best decide what suits local needs.
Zij zijn daarin autonoom en kunnen het best besluiten wat aansluit bij de lokale behoeften.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de verzending per post van persoonsgegevens in combinatie met het Burgerservicenummer

An MP asked the Interior Minister and State Secretary of Finance whether sending letters by post that combine names, addresses and the citizen service number (BSN) risks misuse if lost, and what measures will prevent it. The minister answered that the Postwet provides reliability guarantees, that the BSN aids identification and no legal ban exists on combining these data, and that no new measures are planned, while declining to implement a motion on separating the VAT number from the BSN for self-employed persons due to administrative risks.
There are no legal restrictions prohibiting the use of a combination of these data in correspondence from or with the government.
Er zijn geen wettelijke beperkingen die het gebruik van een combinatie van deze gegevens in correspondentie van of met de overheid verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Curaçao bij een gokschandaal in Australië

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether Curaçao licensed EmuCasino, linked to illegal Australian gambling, and about its ownership structure, sublicensing and accountant. The Minister declined to answer all seven questions, saying they concern a country matter (landsaangelegenheid) of Curaçao.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a country matter of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van Curaçao bij een gokschandaal in Australië

The MP asks the Minister of Interior Affairs about Curaçao's regulation of internationally operating online casinos, including the legislation, the number and identity of master-licence holders, the supervising body, and who oversees the sublicensed operators. The Minister declines to answer, stating these are matters for Curaçao as a country within the Kingdom and referring to earlier questions.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a national affair of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een Curaçao's online casino dat zich richt op de Nederlandse markt

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Bellmark Casino, a Curaçao online casino targeting the Dutch market, is legal, who supervises it, and about its Curaçao licensing structure and turnover. The minister declined the Curaçao questions as a matter for Curaçao and said the Dutch Gambling Authority is responsible for supervising foreign operators active in the Netherlands.
I cannot comment on these questions because they concern a country matter of Curaçao.
Ik kan mij over deze vragen niet uitlaten omdat het vragen zijn die een landsaangelegenheid van Curaçao betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over niet meer internationaal bellen vanuit Venezuela

MPs Bosman and Ten Broeke asked whether Venezuela's mobile operators stopping international calling, the end of international post, and its effects on opposition and migration reflect a repressive escalation affecting the Kingdom. The government answered that the cut stems from foreign-currency shortages linked to the economic crisis, that opposition risks are not shown to rise, and that it monitors migration closely without expecting large-scale flows.
The government closely monitors developments in Venezuela.
De regering monitort de ontwikkelingen in Venezuela nauw.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ulenbelt en Van Raak over riante beloning van de top van UWV

MPs Voortman, Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked why UWV top officials earn above the WNT pay cap, whether transitional rules and side jobs can be stopped, and whether the transitional arrangement should end. Minister Asscher answered that UWV complies with the WNT, that remaining above-cap pay is protected by transitional law and European property rights, and that side functions are permitted if done in own time.
UWV has informed me that it will enter into discussion with the non-top officials concerned about their remuneration relative to the WNT maximum.
UWV heeft mij laten weten met betrokken niet-topfunctionarissen het gesprek aan te gaan over hun bezoldiging in verhouding tot het vastgestelde bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over veranderingen ten aanzien van het Besluit Gegevensverstrekking Gemeentelijke Belastingheffing

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the decree on data provision for municipal taxation will be amended to require modern online booking intermediaries to supply landlord and tenant data for tourist and residence taxes, and what the effects on foreign-based platforms would be. The Minister confirms the amendment is being investigated, that it would extend reporting duties to such intermediaries if adopted, and that he acknowledges the risk of platforms relocating abroad but gives no firm commitment and needs more time.
This will be taken into account in the mentioned investigation into the need for an amendment.
Bij het genoemde onderzoek naar de noodzaak van een wijziging zal dit worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het vermelden van de naam van een levenloos geboren kind op het verlof tot begraven

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the name of a stillborn child may be explicitly shown on the burial permit, and whether the model form and the announced review of regulation for stillborn children will allow this. The minister expressed understanding for the parents but only committed to examining, within the announced review, whether and how registration of stillborn children under the Burial Act needs changing.
I will also consider in the review announced in the letter of 26 April 2016 whether and how the registration of stillborn children under the Burial Act needs to be changed.

Ik zal bij het in de brief van 26 april 2016 aangekondigde onderzoek tevens betrekken of en op welke wijze de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen in het kader van de Wet op de lijkbezorging wijziging behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de berichtgeving in verschillende media inzake de veiligheid van persoonsgegevens bij gemeenten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about media reports on personal data security at municipalities, including a data leak in Amersfoort and an Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens report on consent in social domain. The minister answers that the Amersfoort incident was a human error handled openly, disputes that the report shows a general problem, and points to existing guidance and support for municipalities.
The Amersfoort incident was due to human error, not to a fault in the technology or procedures.
Het incident in Amersfoort berustte op een menselijke fout, niet op een fout in de techniek of procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Grashoff over Israëlische dreigementen tegen aanhangers van de boycot, desinvesteringen en sancties (BDS)-beweging

MP Grashoff asked the Dutch government about Israeli ministers' statements calling for targeted measures against BDS activists, Israeli anti-boycott legislation, and possible sanctions against Dutch or EU citizens. The government said it cannot interpret foreign ministers' remarks, noted the Israeli minister's clarification that he meant no physical measures, described the anti-boycott law and a visa bill as not yet having led to cases, and stated that supporting BDS falls under freedom of expression.
It is not for the cabinet to explain what ministers of another state precisely mean by their statements.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uit te leggen wat bewindspersonen van een andere staat met hun uitspraken precies bedoelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Gemaskerd protest tegen ‘asielfabriek’

Two MPs asked whether the Kameraadschap Noord-Nederland demonstrations against an asylum centre were legally notified, whether masked participants can be restricted, and whether they can be asked for ID. The minister answered that the group is extreme-right, that Oldambt required notice for one demonstration, that the mayor could impose mask bans and issued an emergency order, and that police may request ID when there is a good reason.

This emergency order requires demonstrators wearing face-covering clothing in Winschoten to keep away from, or be removed on first police instruction from, the gathering before, during and after the event, until 23.00.

In dit noodbevel is voorzien in een verplichting voor demonstranten met gezichtsbedekkende kleding die zich in Winschoten bevinden om zich voor, tijdens en na de bijeenkomst op eerste aanzegging van de politie verwijderd te houden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Van Bommel over de situatie van Bhutanese vluchtelingen in Nederland

Two SP MPs asked whether the Netherlands had promised to resettle 500 Bhutanese refugees from Nepal, whether resettlement missions continue, how illiterate refugees can complete integration, whether naturalised refugees can travel to Bhutan, and how many political prisoners Bhutan holds. The government said no numerical promise was made, resettlement missions ran 2008–2011 and were halted after Nepal and Bhutan failed to act, integration allows extended deadlines, refugee travel documents exclude the home country, and no reliable information on political prisoners exists.
There is no unambiguous, reliable information about the presence of political prisoners in Bhutan.
Er is geen eenduidige, betrouwbare informatie over de aanwezigheid van politieke gevangenen in Bhutan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat in Nederland om beledigingen van Erdogan te melden

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Turkish consulate in Rotterdam was right to call on Turkish organisations in the Netherlands to report insults of Erdogan, and how the government would respond. The answer is a cross-reference to a letter on a related request from MP Karabulut, so the substance of the government's position is not set out in this document.
The written questions from MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes, question number 2016Z08377, have been answered by means of the letter
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes (beiden Groep Bontes/Van Klaveren), vraagnummer 2016Z08377 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Mishandeling Surinamer in vreemdelingenbarak’

MP Bosman (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs whether he knew of similar abuses in Curaçao's prison, whether he agreed they were unacceptable, and whether the Netherlands risked UN criticism over the situation. The Minister replied that the matter falls within Curaçao's autonomy, that Curaçao is responsible for preventing abuses, that the Netherlands gives only incidental, limited support, and that the Kingdom is legally responsible under international treaties.
The prison in Curaçao is an autonomous matter of the country of Curaçao.
De gevangenis van Curaçao betreft een autonome aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de Belastingdienst die in publiekscontacten in Friesland niet in het Fries communiceert

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the Tax Authority refuses to speak Frisian on its public phone line in Friesland and whether it must comply with the Frisian Language Use Act. The government answered that Leeuwarden tax office can communicate in Frisian in person and in writing, that the national Tax Telephone Service is not obliged to offer Frisian, and that it will discuss the DINGtiid advice on a language officer before deciding on follow-up.
It is true that taxpayers are not spoken to in Frisian on the Tax Telephone Service.
Het klopt dat belastingplichtigen bij de Belastingtelefoon niet in het Fries te woord worden gestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat senioren de digitalisering van de overheid te snel vinden gaan

An MP asked the Interior Minister about reports that seniors find government digitalisation too fast, covering internet access, digital skills support, usability testing, the Digitaal Hulpplein, preferred contact channels and evaluation timing. The minister answered that internet access is rising, support initiatives such as volunteer training and the Digitaal Hulpplein exist, and the Digitaal Hulpplein will be evaluated before summer, with the wider 'Digitaal 2017' structure reviewed in that evaluation.
The Digitaal Hulpplein is currently being evaluated and based on the evaluation I will look at further steps.
Het Digitaal Hulpplein wordt momenteel geëvalueerd en op grond van de evaluatie kijk ik naar verdere stappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inmenging in de rechtszaak tegen Van Rey

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior why he tweeted about the ongoing criminal case against politician Van Rey, how this fits the separation of powers, whether he can rule out influence on the proceedings, and whether he would act similarly again. The minister replied only that he testified in court as a witness on 18 April 2016 and had nothing to add.
I have nothing to add to this testimony at this time.
Aan dit getuigenis heb ik op dit moment geen zaken toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het privacybeleid bij de gemeente Amsterdam

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the ministers about a report finding that privacy of Amsterdam citizens was not adequately protected, including unauthorised staff access, unsecured email and non-anonymised data use. The minister answered that such access is unacceptable, that municipalities are themselves responsible for privacy compliance, that the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens rather than the ministries supervises, and that support and campaigns are ongoing.
Information on this is not systematically collected by the ministries of Justice and Security or of the Interior and Kingdom Relations.
Informatie hierover wordt niet systematisch verzameld door de ministeries van Veiligheid en Justitie of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert, Fokke en Oosenbrug over de situatie dat niet elke gemeente een overlijdensakte van een doodgeboren baby aan de ouders verstrekt

MPs Wolbert, Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether it is acceptable that some municipalities, unlike Amsterdam, do not issue a death certificate for stillborn babies, and how the law's wording (a stillborn child is deemed never to have existed) can be reconciled with parents' recognition needs. The minister said Amsterdam's practice fits existing rules and a 2006 official communication, promised to examine additional forms of registration and wording changes, and to inform parliament before summer.
The Minister of the Interior is willing to examine the possibilities of registration both within and outside the BRP.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties is bereid de mogelijkheden te onderzoeken van registratie zowel binnen als buiten de BRP
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat een doodgeboren kindje niet wordt erkend

An SP MP asks why stillborn children cannot be recorded in the personal records database and whether the legal wording that a child stillborn is deemed never to have existed can be changed. The minister explains that stillborn children get a civil registry act but no BRP entry, promises research into registration options and forwards the wording question to the Minister of Justice and Security for advice.
Yes, I will investigate the possibilities for registration both within and outside the BRP.
Ja, ik ga onderzoek doen naar de mogelijkheden van registratie zowel binnen als buiten de BRP
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Wetgeving hoeft niet te worden veranderd om voor levenloos geboren kinderen een geboorteakte op te maken’

Two D66 MPs asked whether stillborn children can be registered and whether parents are informed of the option to receive a birth record, and whether a national register is possible. The ministers answered that a death-register record is made under art. 1:19i BW without a gestation minimum, that such children are not entered in the BRP, that the minister will study registration options and report before summer, and that the government has improved information for parents.
I would point out that the record of a stillborn child is kept in the civil registers and is therefore findable and consultable.
Ik wil erop wijzen dat de akte van een levenloos geboren kind wordt bewaard in de registers van de burgerlijke stand en daardoor vindbaar en raadpleegbaar is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu inzake de stigmatiserende video van Powned over inwoners van de Bijlmer

An MP asked the government whether a PowNed video portraying Bijlmer residents as stigmatised was acceptable, and whether public funding should be reconsidered. The state secretary answered that public broadcasters have editorial autonomy under the Mediawet, the government does not judge individual programmes, and complaints can go to anti-discrimination bodies or the courts, while an NPO-wide ombudsman is being pursued.
It is not for the government to pass judgement on the media offering of public media institutions.
Het is niet aan de overheid om een oordeel uit te spreken over het media-aanbod van de publieke media-instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het misbruik van privégegevens door apps

An MP asked the ministers whether apps such as Facebook and Tinder violate privacy rules by sharing sensitive health data and by relying on broad user consent via terms and conditions. The minister declined to judge specific conduct, which he left to the Autoriteit persoonsgegevens, but stated that existing law (Wbp art. 16) already protects health data and that users bear some responsibility for consenting to terms.
It therefore does not befit me to pass judgment on whether Facebook and Tinder are violating the applicable regulations.
Het past mij dan ook niet een oordeel uit te spreken over de vraag of Facebook en Tinder de geldende regelgeving schenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over het bericht dat het slecht gesteld is met de online vindbaarheid van beleidsstukken van de gemeente Maastricht

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked ministers about reports that online findability of Maastricht municipal policy documents was poor, and whether this affects other municipalities, what municipalities and the government are doing to improve access, and how the Open Government bill and archive programme relate. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own web presentation, no monitoring of this specific issue takes place, and he supports open government but does not favour the information register proposed in the initiative bill.
Municipalities are themselves responsible for the way they present themselves on the internet.
Gemeenten zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de wijze waarop zij zich op internet presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Neder-Betuwe wil geld zien voor stroomkabels’

An MP asked whether the municipality of Neder-Betuwe may levy precario tax retroactively on power cables and whether the minister would act against it. The minister answered that the council motion was not being pursued, that the 2014 ordinance already contained the basis so no retroactivity arises, and that no action is needed.
There are no actual intentions to carry out this motion.
Er zijn geen daadwerkelijke voornemens om deze motie ook uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Koser Kaya en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Politicus Bonaire werd onterecht bespioneerd’

MPs Pechtold, Koşer Kaya and Van Laar asked whether the AIVD unlawfully collected data on former Bonaire minister Jopie Abraham and other Bonairean politicians, and how access refusals were tested. The Minister declined to discuss the CTIVD's non-public ruling or operational matters, stated that access refusals are tested under the Wiv 2002 on knowledge-protection grounds, and saw no reason to request further investigation.
The CTIVD's assessment of the complaint by Mr Jopie Abraham is not public.
Het oordeel van de CTIVD inzake de klacht van de heer Jopie Abraham is niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Kosten opruimen drugsafval Brabant in kaart gebracht’

CDA MPs asked the Minister of Interior about rising drug waste dumping in Brabant and Limburg, the costs for municipalities, and how national funds are allocated. The Minister confirmed rising dumpings, said municipalities' costs are several million euros per province, committed €1 million a year for cofinancing cleanup in 2015–2017, and explained the provincial allocation convenant.
To ease the cost problem, the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment makes available €1 million annually in 2015–2017 for cofinancing the cleanup of drug waste dumpings (maximum 50% of costs).

Om het probleem van de kosten te verzachten stelt het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Milieu in de periode 2015–2017 jaarlijks € 1 miljoen beschikbaar voor cofinanciering van de opruiming van drugsafvaldumpingen (maximaal 50% van de kosten).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over de belemmeringen voor personen met een visuele beperking om als raadslid te kunnen functioneren

MPs Oosenbrug, Van Dijk and Fokke asked whether visually impaired councillors are forced to resign because of inadequate support, and what support exists and whether digital democracy is accessible. The Minister says the government is reviewing barriers via a stakeholder inventory and the Dijkstal law evaluation, notes existing financial support for structural impairments, and says digitalisation can help while accessibility is an ongoing process.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many political office holders have a visual or other impairment or have had to resign for that reason.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel politieke ambtsdragers een visuele of andersoortige beperking hebben dan wel om die reden hebben moeten aftreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over politiebezoek na een tweet over juichende leerlingen vanwege aanslagen België (Herdruk)

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police visits to a Breda resident after a tweet about students cheering the Brussels attacks were intimidating, what the police meant by a quoted remark, and what the government thought of cheering students. The minister said wijkagents may judge such conversations part of normal policing under local authority responsibility, that the quoted remark was not used by police, and that teachers should be equipped to handle such reactions.
I therefore see no reason to change the police's approach on this point.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om de werkwijze van de politie op dit punt te veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Bosman over het verschil in schuldpositie van Aruba tussen de rapportages van de Centrale Bank van Aruba en de rapportages van het College Aruba financieel toezicht

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about differences between the Central Bank of Aruba and the CAft figures on Aruba's deficit and debt, and about Aruba's financial management and borrowing. The minister answered that the CAft advised approval of an Aruban foreign loan which the Kingdom Council of Ministers approved, reported a 2015 deficit of AWG 98 million (2.0% of GDP) with incidental factors, and explained the figure differences by different accounting bases.
Het CAft zal hier op toezien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de leegloop bij het ministerie van BZK als gevolg van de reorganisatie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about staff departures at the Interior Ministry after its reorganisation, including effects on the Democracy and Citizenship directorate and the capacity plan. The minister answered that 110 staff left over nine months, vacancies are being filled, the reorganisation strengthens external orientation, and the Agenda Lokale Democratie continues on schedule.
In December your House received a progress report on the Agenda Lokale Democratie.
In december heeft uw Kamer een voortgangsbericht van de Agenda Lokale Democratie ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat de gemeentelijke BOA de rol van de agent overneemt

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) are taking over police tasks, whether weapons and assaults on BOAs are a concern, and about neighbourhood watch groups. The minister replied that BOAs take over no police tasks, that the police remain primarily responsible for public order, and that the issues raised are local matters or outside the government's direct remit, while committing to further consultation and to answer questions before the police debate.
Municipal enforcement officers (BOAs) take over no tasks from the police.
Gemeentelijke Buitengewoon Opsporingsambtenaren (hierna: boa's) nemen geen taken over van de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over inmenging in de rechtszaak tegen Van Rey

Opposition MP Van Raak asks why Minister Plasterk tweeted about the ongoing court case against politician Van Rey, how this fits with separation of powers, and whether he will answer by a set deadline. The minister declines to answer any further questions before appearing in court, as the court has invited him to testify.
Now that the court has decided to invite me, I will not answer any further questions in this case beforehand.
Nu de rechtbank heeft besloten mij uit te nodigen, beantwoord ik voordien geen nadere vragen in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over bedreigingen van raadsleden

An MP asked the ministers about threats against municipal councillors, the reporting rate to police, and whether police take such complaints seriously. The minister answered that survey figures are not directly comparable, that police treat these complaints seriously under national agreements, and that most recommendations of the Periklesinstituut are already being implemented or will be pursued with associations.
The police take these reports extremely seriously.
De politie neemt deze aangiften uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bosman over mogelijke betrokkenheid van KPMG bij (illegale) gokpraktijken op Curaçao en Sint Maarten

MPs Van Raak and Bosman asked about reports of illegal online sports betting on Curaçao, possible links to the US market, and KPMG's alleged role auditing casino owner Francesco Corallo on Sint Maarten. The minister replied that gambling oversight is primarily a local matter for the Public Prosecution Services, pointed to a 2015 protocol and the Bientu conviction, and declined to comment on individual companies.
The gambling world and the handling of possible abuses within it is primarily a local matter.
De gokwereld en de aanpak van mogelijke misstanden daarbinnen is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Miltenburg en Tellegen over het bericht "Asielzoekers randden 18-jarige aan tijdens stapnacht

MPs Van Miltenburg and Tellegen asked the government how it responds to reports of sexual assaults on a young woman by asylum seekers, how victims are supported and given copies of reports, and whether police register and prosecute such assaults. The minister answered that all sexual offences are condemned and pursued, victims receive support through Slachtofferhulp Nederland and forthcoming sexual violence centres, and police and prosecutors treat all reports without distinguishing by origin of offenders.
I see no reason to change this approach as a result of the events in Cologne.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze werkwijze als gevolg van de gebeurtenissen in Keulen aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de voorlichting aan Nederlandse ondernemers over problemen met kinderarbeid in Oekraïne

The MP Thieme asks why RVO.nl removed a warning to Dutch entrepreneurs about child labour in Ukraine's agriculture and construction sectors shortly before the April 2016 referendum, and whether the government will pressure Ukraine on child labour. The minister answers that the text was outdated (dating from 2009), removed autonomously by RVO during routine updating ahead of a trade mission, with no political pressure, and that the text has since been updated and republished while Ukraine will be engaged on labour standards through the Association Agreement and OECD channels.
In an update round for the CSR texts it was found that the information dates from 2009.
In een actualisatieronde voor de MVO-teksten is geconstateerd dat informatie dateert uit 2009.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nispen over de benoeming van de topambtenaar die zich op het Ministerie bezig hield met de Raad van State tot staatsraad

An SP MP asked whether the senior official who handled the Council of State reform bill was appointed to the Council of State shortly afterwards, and whether this created a conflict of interest. The Minister answered that the appointment followed standard procedure, that the bill was only at the nader rapport stage when the appointment was made, and that there is no conflict of interest.
There is no question of an appearance of conflict of interest or a dubious transfer.
Van schijn van belangenverstrengeling en een dubieuze overstap is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Otwin van Dijk over de toegankelijkheid van Mijnoverheid.nl en apps van de overheid

MPs Oosenbrug and Otwin van Dijk asked the Minister of Interior whether MijnOverheid.nl and government apps are accessible to people with disabilities, and what steps will be taken to guarantee this. The minister acknowledged complaints, said the portal meets WCAG 2.0 level and that accessibility is a priority, but noted that existing web standards do not fully cover native apps and that a new European standard is being explored.
Once the standard for non-web-based apps is established at international or European level, I will be able to take measures to make this standard mandatory for the Dutch government as well.

Zodra de standaard voor niet webgebaseerde apps in internationaal dan wel Europees verband is vastgesteld, zal ik maatregelen kunnen nemen om deze standaard ook voor de Nederlandse overheid verplicht te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht dat een drugskoerier uit Curaçao, Curaçao niet meer in mag

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether it is undesirable that a convicted drug courier from Curaçao, a Dutch-resident woman, is barred from returning to Curaçao, shifting the problem to the Netherlands, and whether she should serve her prison sentence. The minister answered that the entry ban is a supplementary penalty imposed under Curaçao law to protect potential couriers, denied that it burdens the Netherlands, said enforcement of the sentence is for Curaçao's justice minister, and noted the Dutch law has no equivalent provision.
Enforcement of the sentence imposed by the court in Curaçao falls under the responsibility of the Minister of Justice there.
De tenuitvoerlegging van de door de rechter op Curaçao opgelegde straf valt onder verantwoordelijkheid van de Minister van justitie aldaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de relatie tussen openbaarmaking van interne tijdschriften van de MIVD en het geheimhouden van de AIVD-tapstatistieken

An MP asked whether publishing MIVD internal magazine content reveals its working methods, and why AIVD wiretap statistics cannot be published. The government answered that the MIVD publications gave no insight into working methods and that the Minister of Interior will take a new decision on AIVD wiretap statistics after a Council of State ruling, so nothing more can be said until then.
Until this assessment has been completed, nothing can be added to the earlier answers to the written questions from MP Koşer Kaya.
Tot het moment waarop deze beoordeling is afgerond, kan er niets worden toegevoegd aan de eerdere beantwoording van de schriftelijke vragen van het lid Koşer Kaya.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over aangifte van belastingen in het buitenland

A VVD MP asks the Interior Minister why Dutch citizens abroad must collect their DigiD in person at a counter, which is burdensome, and whether this conflicts with the digital government ambition. The minister says the digital tax filing exemption for expats stays for now, that a face-to-face check is needed for reliability, and that research into an easier procedure has been started.

That is why I am currently having research done into whether and to what extent it is possible to facilitate a simpler and less burdensome issuing procedure while maintaining the necessary level of reliability.

Daarom laat ik momenteel onderzoeken of en in hoeverre het mogelijk is om met behoud van het noodzakelijke betrouwbaarheidsniveau een eenvoudiger en minder bezwarende uitgifteprocedure te faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verminderde aantal verkiezingsborden voor het referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why a January 2016 ministry circular told municipalities that election boards were unnecessary for the referendum, in contrast to the 2005 campaign that used A2 posters on election boards. Minister Plasterk answered that extra funds were used in 2005 at parliament's request, that information for this referendum is now provided via a digital toolkit, abri posters, newspaper ads and websites, and that the government will not deploy extra funds to get municipalities to place boards, though municipalities may do so.
The cabinet is not deploying extra funds to encourage municipalities to place election boards.
Het kabinet zet geen extra middelen in om gemeenten ertoe te bewegen verkiezingsborden te plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over niet (tijdig) verstuurde stempassen voor het referendum
