MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether voting passes for the 6 April 2016 referendum were sent late to voters in several municipalities, and what measures would ensure voters receive them. Minister Plasterk answered that the deadline was 23 March, that passes were sent in time in the named municipalities, that individual non-receipt can occur and is handled by reissue on request, and that no late dispatches are known so no measures are planned.
Enquiries have informed me that the voting passes in each of the named municipalities were sent before this deadline.
Navraag heeft mij geleerd dat de stempassen in elk van de genoemde gemeenten vóór deze deadline zijn verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agnes Mulder en Amhaouch over onterechte reputatieschade van bestuurders van het Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire

MPs Agnes Mulder and Amhaouch (CDA) asked the ministers whether the SEO report on governance at Water- en Energiebedrijf Bonaire unjustly damaged the reputations of its board members, and questioned the handling of the tender and the decision to build the wind-diesel plant. Minister Kamp answers that the SEO conclusions on governance shortcomings were confirmed by the Landsadvocaat and Mazars, that the tender produced one bid, that no criminal referral is warranted, and that no apology is due.
As appears from the answer to question 9, the investigations were not carried out unjustly.
Zoals uit het antwoord op vraag 9 blijkt, zijn de onderzoeken niet onterecht uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Overheden nog niet klaar voor Wet hergebruik overheidsinformatie’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch authorities are ready for the Open Government Information Reuse Act, after a report that most bodies postpone reuse requests and rarely register open data on the national portal. The minister answered that responsibility lies with authorities, cites a handbook and information sessions, and says it is too early to draw conclusions, with evaluation after three years.
As for the conclusion that they would not yet be ready, as the Open State Foundation sample would suggest, I think it is too early.
Voor de conclusie dat zij daar nog niet klaar voor zouden zijn, zoals dat uit de steekproef van de Open State Foundation zou blijken, vind ik het te vroeg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het besluit van de gemeente Zutphen om geld voor het referendum aan andere dingen uit te geven

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Zutphen municipality spent less than the full referendum budget on the referendum, whether this breaks the rules, and whether the minister raised the national referendum budget for municipalities from 20 to 30 million euro. The minister confirmed the increase, said municipalities decide how to spend the general fund allocation within existing rules, and stated that municipalities do not have to account to the national government for such spending, so no overview is available.
Municipalities do not have to account to the national government for how they spend funds from the municipal fund.
Gemeenten hoeven over de besteding van de middelen uit het gemeentefonds geen verantwoording af te leggen aan het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Amhaouch over de voorlopige toepassing van het associatieverdrag tussen de EU en Oekraïne

MPs Omtzigt and Amhaouch asked how long the EU-Ukraine association agreement could stay provisionally applied if it never enters into force, which parts fall under exclusive EU competence, and whether a narrower EU-only agreement is being considered. Minister Koenders answered that non-ratification is uncharted territory, outlined the EU competence rules in general terms without a definitive list of articles, and said no such overlegs on an EU-only alternative had taken place while the agreement remains the best basis for cooperation.
The association agreement does not specify which provisions fall under the exclusive competences of the EU.
Het associatieakkoord specificeert niet welke bepalingen vallen onder de exclusieve bevoegdheden van de EU.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Maij en Segers over het gebruik door GeenPeil van de subsidieregeling referendum

MPs Verhoeven, Maij and Segers asked the Minister of the Interior whether the referendum subsidy scheme was being misused by GeenPeil, where natural persons applied for subsidies while a legal entity stood behind them and purchased services from it. The Minister replied that the independent Referendum Commission assesses applications only against the scheme's criteria, that over 40 applicants bought services from GeenPeil and disclosed this, and that he cannot judge the application himself.
It is not for me to comment on the extent to which subsidy applications and related circumstances are acceptable and permissible.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over de mate waarin subsidieaanvragen en/of met die aanvragen samenhangende omstandigheden acceptabel en geoorloofd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman, De Caluwé en Oosenbrug over het bericht “beveiliging tientallen gemeentesites lek: persoonsgegevens niet veilig”

MPs Veldman, De Caluwé and Oosenbrug asked the Minister of Interior about a reported security flaw (DROWN/SSL) exposing dozens of municipal websites and whether municipalities protect personal data, and what sanctions and oversight apply. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own information security under the BIG framework, that the Dutch DPA can impose instructions, fines or penalties, and that the government is preparing legislation on digital government services.
Information security of municipalities is a local responsibility.
Informatiebeveiliging van gemeenten is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ‘de stempassen van PostNL’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs why the government did not disclose during Question Time that PostNL, a printer of polling cards, had written voting advice on them, and pressed on municipal responsibility, referendum-commission warnings, and foreign observers. The minister answered that municipalities choose whether to use PostNL's offered flyer text and are responsible for it, that the Referendum Commission had asked municipalities to use its information, that the summary was not cause for alarm, and that ODIHR declined the invitation to send observers.
Municipalities do not print and send the polling cards themselves, but outsource this.
Gemeenten verzorgen het drukken en verzenden van de stempassen niet zelf, maar besteden dat uit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermue en Albert de Vries over het inkomen van de algemeen directeur van energiebedrijf Delta

PvdA MPs asked whether the salary increase for Delta's general director, which staff opposed, is acceptable given losses and public ownership, and whether shareholders should intervene. The government answered that Delta is exempt from the WNT pay cap because it is a company, that shareholders should act, that the WNT scope will be revised, and that the company's network split leaves WNT application unchanged.
Government shareholdings in NVs and BVs have been kept outside the WNT by the legislator, on the reasoning that the government could sufficiently influence pay policy through its shareholding.

Overheidsdeelnemingen in NV's en BV's zijn door de wetgever (in algemene zin) buiten de WNT gehouden op grond van de overweging dat de overheid via de lijn van het aandeelhouderschap het beloningsbeleid voldoende zou kunnen beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over onverwachte rekening mortuariumkosten voor nabestaanden

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of hospital mortuary charges unexpectedly billed to bereaved families, whether these charges are clearly disclosed, and what remedies and complaint routes families have. The minister answered that responsibility lies primarily with mortuary operators who must conclude explicit agreements, that complaints should go to the mortuary operator, and that the ministry has no data on whether information has improved.
Bereaved relatives should primarily direct complaints to the mortuary operator.
Nabestaanden dienen klachten primair te richten aan de mortuariumbeheerder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma over “de implementatie van de sharia in de stembureaus bij het referendum op 6 april”

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a City of Amsterdam instruction for polling station staff at the 6 April 2016 referendum, which reportedly directed that only women check burqa-wearing voters, and whether this was acceptable. The minister replied that the instruction did not come from his ministry but from Amsterdam, pointed to a pending bill on partial face-covering bans, and noted that voters must be identified, with the method left to the municipality.
The instruction does not come from my ministry, but from the municipality of Amsterdam.
De instructie komt niet van mijn ministerie, maar van de gemeente Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de proef met het publiek middel voor online inloggen bij de overheid

The Kamervragen from MP De Caluwé ask the Minister of Interior about delays and inconsistencies in the pilots of a public online login means (DigiD replacement via eID card), including timing, the commission's evaluation, and privacy risks of commercial providers knowing login behaviour. The minister answers at length, largely reaffirming the commitment to a public means by 2017, explaining the pilot timelines and privacy safeguards, though some answers restate policy without fully resolving the concerns.
I am having it examined whether and, if so, how this exchange period can be shortened.
Ik laat onderzoeken of en zo ja hoe deze omwisselingstermijn kan worden verkort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de lopende pilots eID

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why no complete overview of the running eID pilots had been provided, including public and private pilots, and requested details per pilot. The Minister said he disagrees that the situation is odd, explains participation is open to registered parties, and provides an overview of public-domain pilots in an annex while noting the authentication means may change.
Annex 1 contains the overview of the pilots that fall under my responsibility.
In de bijlage 1 vindt u het overzicht van de pilots die onder mijn verantwoordelijkheid vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Ozb stijgt nog harder dan gedacht met 2,5 procent’

The MP Veldman asks the Minister of the Interior whether he is shocked that homeowners face a 2.5% rise in the local property tax (OZB) and whether he will act now that municipalities have exceeded the agreed macro norm for five years running. The Minister says the COELO figures show a 2.32% total OZB increase, that the norm is adjusted downward after overshoots by agreement, that he will discuss it with the VNG, and that setting rates is a municipal council responsibility he will not interfere with.
The proactive role in setting OZB rates, for both homes and non-residential property, lies with the municipal councils.
De proactieve rol bij het vaststellen van de OZB tarieven, voor zowel woningen als niet-woningen, ligt bij de gemeenteraden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat er aanhoudingen zijn gedaan bij de ontruiming van het gemeentehuis van Winterswijk

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why the Winterswijk town hall was cleared during a protest, whether this fits with party group meetings, whether the clearance was justified, and whether care workers may protest over their pay conditions. The minister said the mayor ordered the clearance because protesters did not follow imposed conditions, that party group meetings are unaffected, that justification is for the mayor to assess and account for to the council, and that care workers may protest with conditions set by the mayor.
The assessment of whether this clearance was justified falls to the mayor concerned.
De beoordeling van de gerechtvaardigdheid van deze ontruiming komt toe aan de betrokken burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat senioren de digitalisering van de overheid te snel vinden gaan

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether citizens without internet access or digital skills can still reach government services, and what measures will guarantee this. The minister replied that responsibility lies with individual agencies, pointed to existing alternative channels, assistance points and a Digital 2017 programme, and promised only to keep parliament informed.
Responsibility for the accessibility of services and information lies with the relevant government organisations.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor de toegankelijkheid van diensten en informatie ligt bij de desbetreffende overheidsorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een aanbesteding van software

MP Oosenbrug asks about the EASP2015 software tender won by Protinus IT and Comparex, including its strategic importance, whether the winners' lack of open-source references and fraud reporting was weighed, how vendor dependence and open-source preference are protected, how oversight will be exercised, and how this fits earlier parliamentary motions. The minister answers that the tender is coordinated by VenJ with open-source use built in, that exclusion on the reported fraud was not legally possible in advance, and that oversight runs through departmental contract management with periodic overviews.
Under procurement law it is not possible to exclude a bidder in advance on the basis of the attached media reports.
Aanbestedingsrechtelijk is het niet mogelijk om op basis van bijgevoegde berichtgeving vooraf een inschrijver uit te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over bedreigingen van raadsleden

An MP asked whether threats against local councillors, which may lead some to quit, are concerning and what protection and reporting measures exist. The minister acknowledged the seriousness, pointed to a Veilig bestuur toolkit with new security and psychosocial support, said councillors should report threats, and admitted police and prosecution do not register such cases separately.
Numbers of reports and complaints by councillors are not known to the police.
Aantallen van meldingen en aangiften door raadsleden zijn bij de politie niet bekend
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over een rapport over import door IS van onderdelen voor de productie van IED’s (Improvised Explosive Devices- geïmproviseerde bommen)

Parliamentary member Jasper van Dijk asked the ministers whether the government shares concern about a report showing IS imports components for IEDs from many countries including the Netherlands, and what export controls could stop this. The ministers answer that most goods have civilian uses and are not export-controlled, that the Dutch-origin hydrogen peroxide was legally sold, and they point to new EU and national precursor rules and talks with other EU countries.

Therefore, within the National Counterterrorism Strategy and the Integrated Approach to Jihadism Action Programme, measures have been taken to limit the availability of raw materials for explosives and to oblige companies to report suspicious transactions.

Daarom zijn binnen de Nationale Contraterrorisme strategie en het Actieprogramma Integrale Aanpak Jihadisme maatregelen genomen om de beschikbaarheid van grondstoffen voor explosieven te beperken en bedrijven te verplichten om verdachte transacties te melden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat de Geen Peil-campagne voor een referendum over het samenwerkingsverdrag met Oekraïne mogelijk onterecht met Europees geld is betaald

An MP asked whether an anti-referendum-campaign group's signature drive on the Ukraine association agreement was possibly paid for with misused EU subsidy, and what would be done. The minister said the matter is for the European Parliament and the EU subsidy provider to judge, that the referendum decision is final, and that safeguarding EU subsidies is primarily the EU provider's task.
Safeguarding the proper use of European subsidies is primarily a task of the European subsidy provider.
Het waarborgen van de zuivere besteding van Europese subsidies is primair een taak van de Europese subsidieverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken van een Gemeenteraadslid in Den Haag

An MP asked the Interior Minister to respond to a Hague councillor's statement that Islam may be wiped out, asking whether the minister condemns it, whether the councillor should resign or be removed, and whether PVV representatives' statements should be analysed. The minister replied that free speech is protected, that the councillor's removal is not within his power under the Kieswet, that whether the statements constitute a crime is for the courts, and that other matters are for the mayor or individuals.
There is no power on my part to dismiss the councillor from her position.
Van enige bevoegdheid mijnerzijds het betreffende raadslid uit haar functie te ontheffen, is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over plannen om het referendum te verstoren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Interior and Foreign Ministers about reports of plans to disrupt the Dutch referendum on the EU-Ukraine Association Agreement through intimidation and other pressure, and whether these threats are serious. Minister Plasterk answered that reports are investigated by relevant bodies and security measures taken where risk warrants, noting Ukrainian authorities say the documents are forged and referring to a separate answer on militia threats.
Reports of possible attempts to disrupt the referendum are investigated by the relevant authorities where necessary.
Meldingen van mogelijke pogingen om het referendum te verstoren, worden waar nodig onderzocht door de relevante instanties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de uitspraken van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC Groep over het inkomen boven de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) en geld verdienen in de zo

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the Slotervaart hospital board's remarks on earnings above the WNT pay cap, personal investments, loans to the hospital at attractive rates, and volume growth. The minister answered that the CIBG supervisor must assess individual WNT compliance, that the Antoni van Leeuwenhoek loans were ordinary commercial arrangements, that the profit-distribution ban is not known to be breached, and that new patient volume reflects healthy competition rather than inflation, with supervision by NZa and insurers.
It is the task of the supervisor to check whether the WNT has been complied with in an individual case.
Het is de taak van de toezichthouder om te toetsen of in een individueel geval de WNT is nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de technocraten van het CPB het financiële lot van gemeentes bepalen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether the CPB's budget projections for municipal cuts were reliable and whether municipalities would be compensated for a larger-than-expected cut of about 759 million euros. The minister answered that the cumulative downward revision is about 500 million, half from lower wage and price growth and half from extra cuts, that the CPB made no calculation error, and that no compensation is planned under the existing 'samen de trap op, samen de trap af' norm.
There is no question of erroneous calculations by the CPB.
Er is geen sprake van foutieve berekeningen van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de financiële puinhoop in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Interior about the financial mess in Amsterdam and whether it warranted measures, and whether Deputy PM Asscher could responsibly manage the SZW budget. The minister said the municipal council and provincial supervisors must judge Amsterdam's finances, that the city is financially sound, and that the Tweede Kamer assesses ministerial spending through the annual accountability process.
It is up to the Amsterdam municipal council to pass judgment on this.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam om hierover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Sjeikwatch: Osama-fan en 9/11-verheerlijker Anas Noorani Siddiqui in 020’

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a preacher they called an incitement-to-violence figure was allowed into the Netherlands and whether he would be expelled. The ministers did not discuss the individual case, stated that visa-required and visa-free preachers spreading hatred or violence can be refused or confronted, and pointed to the three-track approach and a recent Eindhoven mosque ban as examples.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het wachtgeld voor de oud-burgemeester van Maastricht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about the transition allowance of the former Maastricht mayor, its job-search obligations, holiday rules, sanctions and whether the scheme should be cut to match unemployment benefit rules. The Minister said the individual case is a municipal matter, explained the general rules and sanctions by analogy to the WW, and pointed to earlier reforms, rejecting further alignment because political office holders have a distinct legal position.
Moreover, for privacy reasons I in principle never provide information on the benefit entitlements of individual political office holders, even if I were to have such information.
Overigens geef ik uit privacyoverwegingen in beginsel nooit informatie over de uitkeringsrechten van individuele politieke ambtsdragers als ik daar al over zou beschikken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en  Bontes over het doorgaan van een bijeenkomst met een islamitische geweldsprediker

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would bar an Islamist preacher of violence from a planned gathering in Almere, in line with their motion. The Minister of Security and Justice said visa-required speakers who spread anti-integrative or anti-democratic messages are not welcome, that individual cases are assessed on their merits, that EU-national access can only be refused for a current, serious threat, and that criminal law and mayoral area bans remain available.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens

Two PvdA MPs asked about the executive pay of boards at the Slotervaart hospital and MC Groep, the Balkenende-norm style WNT cap, delayed repayment of municipal and provincial loans, profit distribution and NZa oversight. The minister answered that no ministry had approved the salary, that CIBG will investigate deeptime fraction issues within about eight weeks, that the WNT will be tightened in future legislation, and that the IGZ sees no quality risk.
The cabinet is currently preparing new legislation following the evaluation of the law to sharpen its effectiveness where necessary.
Het kabinet bereidt thans in vervolg op de wetsevaluatie nieuwe wetgeving voor om de effectiviteit van de wet waar nodig aan te scherpen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pechtold over het verslag van de referendumcommissie Bonaire 2015

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the referendum commission's finding that the Bonaire island council and executive interfered in the referendum information, causing confusion and undermining the outcome, is worrying and how the government reacts. The minister replied that the referendum was an autonomous competence of the island authorities, that he cannot intervene in their choices, and that he took no action because such matters fall under local autonomy as in European Dutch municipalities.

Decisions on holding an advisory referendum, the question asked, the information provided and the entire organisation of the referendum are in principle all part of the autonomous task of the public bodies.

Beslissingen over het houden van een raadplegend referendum, de vraagstelling, de voorlichting en de gehele organisatie van het referendum, behoren in beginsel alle tot de autonome taak van de openbare lichamen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over racistische uitingen van de supporters van ADO Den Haag tijdens de wedstrijd tegen Ajax

MPs Kuzu and others asked ministers about racist chants by ADO Den Haag supporters against Ajax players and whether the government would act, including on investigation, prosecution and the KNVB's handling of such incidents. The government replied that clubs, KNVB and Eredivisie CV agreed to act faster against offensive chants, that prosecution is considered in provable cases, and that existing monitoring and action plans are sufficient, declining new investigations.
Professional football clubs, the KNVB and Eredivisie CV have agreed to act faster and more firmly against offensive chants in football.
Betaald voetbalclubs, KNVB en Eredivisie CV hebben afgesproken sneller en kordater op te treden tegen scheldkoren in het voetbal.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Raad vaak buitenspel bij opvanglocaties vluchtelingen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether councils are being excluded from decisions by municipal executives on refugee reception locations, and what effect this has on public support. The minister said most councillors were informed in time, that councils may have delegated authority or lacked time in emergencies, and that a support-team handbook for municipalities on decision-making involving councils was due in February 2016.
I do offer municipalities support in reaching a careful decision-making process.
Ik biedt gemeenten hierbij wel ondersteuning om te komen tot een zorgvuldig besluitvormingsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Overbetuwenaar betaalde jarenlang teveel rioolbelasting’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about a court ruling that the municipality of Overbetuwe improperly moved sewer-tax reserves into general funds, and whether this is lawful and what the government will do. The Minister answered that the court ruling is not yet final, that the national government does not track such reserve transfers, that citizens may legitimately appeal to courts, and that he has no direct role since the courts decide and municipalities are autonomous.
I have no role in this, as the court judges as an independent power.
Ik heb geen rol in deze, daar de rechter als onafhankelijke macht oordeelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht “Thierry Baudet’s Forum voor Democratie lanceert manipulatieve stemwijzer voor referendum Associatieverdrag Oekraïne”

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a voting aid for the Ukraine association referendum, allegedly linked to Forum voor Democratie and possibly funded by neutral-campaign subsidy, is biased and who runs it. The minister said he has no information on the initiators, that the Referendum Commission subsidised Forum voor Democratie's 'against' campaign but cannot confirm the funding of this tool, and that neutrality is for the public and the Referendum Commission to judge.
I do not have information about the initiators of this website.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de initiatiefnemers van deze website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Omtzigt over “de puinhoop bij het toekennen van subsidies voor het referendum op 6 april 2016”

CDA MPs Amhaouch and Omtzigt asked why only three subsidy applications for the 6 April 2016 advisory referendum had been granted despite a three-week decision deadline, and sought data on delays, form errors, costs and fairness. Minister Plasterk answered that 73 applications had been granted, that the independent Referendum Commission is responsible for the subsidy scheme and will evaluate it after the summer recess, and that he has full confidence in its decision-making.
The Referendum Act chose to entrust this task to an independent Referendum Commission.
In de Wet raadgevend referendum is er voor gekozen deze taak in handen te geven aan een onafhankelijke Referendumcommissie.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het intrekken van een subsidieaanvraag voor het referendum door de handelswijze van de referendumcommissie

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether unclear forms, poor communication and an unsupportive attitude by the Referendum Commission caused applicants, including the initiators of a referendum, to withdraw subsidy requests, and whether this obstructs the democratic process. The Minister answered that withdrawing is applicants' own responsibility, that the forms and procedure were clear to most applicants, that subsidy statistics show many applicants did receive funds, and that he does not share the view that the process amounts to obstruction.
It is the applicants' own responsibility to withdraw a subsidy application.
Het is de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van aanvragers om een aanvraag voor een subsidie in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het bericht dat veel gemeenten de beveiliging van persoonsgegevens in Suwinet niet op orde hebben

MPs Oosenbrug asked whether municipalities' weak security of personal data in Suwinet is worrying, whether the Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens should be needed for enforcement, whether officials misusing Suwinet data are sanctioned, and whether the Autoriteit has enough sanctioning powers and staff. The government acknowledges the concern, describes an escalation protocol, the VNG self-test, Inspectie SZW investigations with possible binding instructions, Security Officer controls, and states the Autoriteit has sufficient powers and capacity.
At this moment the State Secretary is sending the first letters announcing a binding instruction to municipalities that do not meet all 7 norms.
Op dit moment verstuurt de Staatssecretaris de eerste brieven met een aankondiging tot een aanwijzing aan gemeenten die niet voldoen aan alle 7 normen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het ontslaan van leden van Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs (OMG)

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities can dismiss civil servants who belong to Outlaw Motorcycle Gangs, and whether membership is incompatible with public employment. The minister answered that dismissal requires concrete conduct linked to the function and prior dialogue, that the government considers such membership undesirable, and that a civil-law ban on OMGs is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service.
Before imposing a disciplinary measure or initiating a dismissal procedure, it is reasonable for the employer to talk with the civil servant about membership and about keeping distance from the OMG.

Alvorens over te gaan tot het opleggen van een disciplinaire maatregel of het in gang zetten van een ontslagprocedure, ligt het overigens in de rede dat de werkgever met de ambtenaar in gesprek gaat over het lidmaatschap en over afstand houden van de OMG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over consulaten die geen registratieformulieren voor het referendum hebben ontvangen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether consulates abroad failed to receive pre-printed registration forms for the 2016 advisory referendum, whether this frustrated expatriate voters, and whether all consulates would be sent forms. The minister answered that one case was known, that posts were told to point voters to the Den Haag website and print forms on request, and that registration procedures match those for regular elections.
All embassies and consulates-general have since been reminded of this once more.
Inmiddels zijn alle ambassades en consulaten-generaal hier nogmaals op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat de Al Fitrah-moskee dubieus geld heeft ontvangen

MPs Karabulut and Van Raak asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque's funding from Kuwait, including ties to an entity once on a US sanctions list, was checked by intelligence and tax authorities, what the municipality knew, and what action the government would take. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the municipality had known of the Kuwaiti funding since 2014, and deferred the mosque-funding question to a forthcoming letter on salafism.
In general, I do not make statements about specific cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Taverne en Azmani over het bericht dat de ‘persvrijheid is beknot bij azc-informatieavonden’

MPs Taverne and Azmani asked whether excluding journalists from municipal information meetings on asylum centres amounts to prior censorship under Article 7 of the Constitution. The minister answered that press freedom is a great good protected by law, that only specific reasons such as safety or limited space could justify excluding the press, and that municipalities must judge this, with the issue to be raised at the national asylum taskforce including the VNG.
Only specific reasons, such as safety or limited venue space, can be grounds for excluding the press or not admitting everyone.
Alleen specifieke redenen, zoals veiligheid of beperkte locatieruimte, kunnen aanleiding zijn de pers te weren of niet iedereen binnen te laten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het weren van journalisten bij een informatieavond over een asielzoekerscentrum (azc) in de Noord-Oostpolder

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether police barring journalists from an information evening on an asylum centre in Noordoostpolder, and home visits to critical residents, unduly restrict press freedom and intimidate citizens. Minister Plasterk said press freedom is protected, noted the matter is before the court and so declined to judge the case, and placed responsibility for proportionate decisions with municipalities accountable to their councils.
The specific situation in Noordoostpolder has now been submitted to the court. For that reason I will not make a further statement on it.
De specifieke situatie in de Noordoostpolder is inmiddels voorgelegd aan de rechter. Om die reden doe ik hierover verder geen uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Verhoeven over het bericht 'Regering negeert referendumstem vanuit het buitenland'

MPs Sjoerdsma and Verhoeven asked the Interior Minister how the government mobilises Dutch citizens abroad to vote, including in the Ukraine association referendum, and why postal voting and repeated registration are used. The minister answered that information was provided via websites, banners, social media, embassies and municipal registers, that internet voting was shelved for security and cost reasons, and that a bill for permanent registration is pending.
I am of the view that everything necessary is being done to enable Dutch voters abroad to vote.
Ik ben van oordeel dat al het nodige wordt gedaan om stemgerechtigde Nederlanders in het buitenland in de gelegenheid te stellen om te gaan stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel “Wie houdt gemeenten in toom”

MP Klein asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about municipalities raising property tax (OZB) and precario levies to fill budget gaps, linked to decentralised social-domain tasks with a 25% budget cut, and the burden on non-resident business owners. The Minister replied that municipal budgets are sufficient, that local councils decide tax rates, and that a bill abolishing precario on utility networks will be sent to parliament this spring with a ten-year transition.
The bill provides for abolition, but gives municipalities a further ten years to charge at most the rate in force in their municipality on 1 January 2016.
Het wetsvoorstel gaat uit van afschaffing, maar biedt gemeenten nog tien jaar de mogelijkheid om maximaal het op 1 januari 2016 in hun gemeente geldende tarief te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten en Segers over de BTW-plicht van gemeenten bij ambtelijke fusies

MPs Schouten and Segers asked why municipalities merging their civil service must pay VAT on services from the joint organisation, and whether an exemption would be introduced. The Staatssecretaris confirmed awareness, explained the cooperation exemption's conditions, and announced a policy change extending the exemption to services used 70% or more for non-taxed municipal activities, largely solving the problem.
I will publish this policy change in the usual way, whereby under the Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht the past will not be revisited ex officio.
Ik zal deze beleidswijziging op de gebruikelijke wijze publiceren, waarbij conform het Besluit Fiscaal Bestuursrecht ambtshalve niet op het verleden wordt teruggekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de samenwerking van de AIVD in Europees verband via de Counter Terrorism Group

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the AIVD's cooperation in the Counter Terrorism Group (CTG) versus the EU's IntCen, the new CTG platform, and oversight of it. The minister explained that CTG is an intelligence-service cooperation outside EU institutions, that the CTG oversight commission (CTIVD) covers AIVD's participation, and that national security remains a national competence, so a democratically legitimised EU intelligence service is not pursued.
This therefore also applies to international cooperation, such as the AIVD's participation in the CTG.
Dit geldt dus ook voor de internationale samenwerking, zoals de AIVD deelname in de CTG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ‘het tekort aan stembureaus’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior why fewer polling stations were set up for the Ukraine referendum in some municipalities, whether villages lost their stations, and why municipalities were not funded to keep all regular polling places. The minister said municipalities decide on polling stations, that some reversed cuts after council pressure, that no national overview exists, and that the government added up to 10 million euros, with the evaluation of the referendum to address accessibility.
I do not have a national overview of the number of polling stations that municipalities will set up for the upcoming referendum.
Ik beschik niet over een landelijk overzicht van het aantal stembureaus dat gemeenten voor het aanstaande referendum zullen inrichten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de sluiting van stembureaus voor het komende referendum over Oekraïne

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether reduced polling station numbers for the Ukraine referendum in several municipalities had been reversed, and for full figures per municipality and any cost compensation. The minister said polling station designation is a municipal council matter, referred back to his earlier answers on the same points, and gave no new figures.
As long as I have no indications to the contrary, it is not for me to have views on the decision-making process on this matter at local level.
Zolang ik geen aanwijzingen heb voor het tegendeel, is het niet aan mij om opvattingen te hebben over het besluitvormingsproces ter zake op lokaal niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over de inhuur van een interimmer door Rijkswaterstaat

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about the hiring of an interim director by Rijkswaterstaat at a rate above the Balkenende norm, covering reimbursed living costs, non-publication in annual reports and the absence of a tender. The minister acknowledges the rate exceeded the norm for five months in 2013 and that it was not reported in the 2013 annual report, but defends the arrangement as a justified exception and promises stricter reporting of deviations.
I will monitor more strictly that such deviations are consistently reported to the House of Representatives.
Ik zal strakker toezien op het consequent melden van dergelijke afwijkingen aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten onderzoek doen naar onder meer het GeenPeil-initiatief

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether US intelligence services are investigating Russian influence on European initiatives including the GeenPeil referendum initiative, whether the Dutch government will check on US monitoring of its initiators, how Dutch intelligence is involved, and whether this is worrying. The minister answered that US services may not conduct operations in the Netherlands without Dutch government consent, that the cited article is insufficient evidence of such activity, and that the government cannot publicly comment on alleged activities of Dutch intelligence services.
The cabinet cannot publicly address (alleged) activities of the Dutch intelligence services.
Het kabinet kan niet in het openbaar ingaan op (vermeende) activiteiten van de Nederlandse inlichtingendiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een politiek onderzoek in Nederland door de Amerikaanse geheime dienst

The SP MP asked whether the Dutch government shares the US intelligence view that Russia orchestrated the Ukraine association referendum and Corbyn's Labour election, and how the US had informed the government of a political investigation in the Netherlands. The minister denied both claims, said the press article does not show them, and stated that foreign intelligence services may not operate in the Netherlands without government permission while declining to comment publicly on any Dutch intelligence investigations.
It is well known to the American intelligence services that it is not permitted to carry out intelligence operations in the Netherlands without the permission of the Dutch government.
Het is de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten genoegzaam bekend dat het niet toegestaan is inlichtingenoperaties in Nederland uit te voeren zonder toestemming van de Nederlandse regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het oordeel van de Raad van State dat de weigering tapstatistieken van de AIVD te verstrekken onvoldoende gemotiveerd is

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD's wiretap statistics and CTIVD report 40 would be published after the Council of State ruled the refusal insufficiently reasoned, and what lessons would be drawn. The minister confirmed awareness of the ruling and said he will take a new decision on the request as the Council of State ordered.
In the cited ruling the Council of State orders that I must take a new decision on the request submitted by the appellant. I will do so.
In de genoemde uitspraak bepaalt de Raad van State dat ik een nieuw besluit op het door appellant ingediende verzoek moet nemen. Dit zal ik doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Kerstens over de topinkomens van het bestuur van het Slotervaartziekenhuis en de MC groep in relatie tot de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT)

MPs Bouwmeester and Kerstens asked about executive pay at Slotervaart hospital and the MC group in relation to the WNT pay cap, including dual board roles, part-time factors above full time and governance concerns. The minister said the WNT supervisor CIBG and the accountant are responsible for assessing compliance, referred the matter to them, and said the IGZ found no grounds for stricter enforcement.
As part of its regular supervision under the WNT, the CIBG will examine this case.
In het kader van zijn reguliere toezicht op de WNT zal het CIBG deze casus onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘PAR fractie eist duidelijkheid over begroting HNO’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports of a cost overrun at the Curaçao hospital HNO and whether the Financial Supervision Office (Cft) had overstepped its role in the loan, and who pays the overrun. The minister answered that the hospital is an autonomous matter for Curaçao, that the Cft acts only as executor of the consensus law with safeguards, and that he stands by his earlier letter.
The construction of the hospital is and remains an autonomous matter of the country Curaçao.
De bouw van het ziekenhuis is en blijft een autonome aangelegenheid van het land Curacao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over het bericht dat de nieuwe korpschef van de Nationale Politie € 75.000 compensatie voor salarisverlies krijgt

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Marcouch asked about the reported €75,000 compensation for salary loss given to the new national police chief, and why it was paid as a severance under the civil service rules rather than a WNT exception. The ministers answered that it is a discretionary payment under the civil service regulation capped at €75,000 by the WNT, justified by the public interest in filling the post quickly, with any further compensation to be arranged within police employment rules.
In order to remove this obstacle, it was examined whether there was a possibility to compensate.
Ten einde deze belemmering weg te nemen, is bezien of er een mogelijkheid was te compenseren.

Vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Netbeheerder Alliander gunt top een graaisalaris» (ingezonden 18 augustus 2015)

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked the Minister of Interior whether grid operator Alliander's top salaries, arranged via a split with Liander, circumvent the WNT pay cap and what the government would do about it. The minister answered that after the 2014 separation Liander's management is formally and materially separate, so the WNT is not breached there, while Alliander falls outside the WNT as a shareholder-owned company, and he will address concern-related scope in the planned WNT revision.
I would therefore consider it desirable for the decentralised governments as shareholders to state their position explicitly on this point.
Ik zou het dan ook wenselijk vinden dat de decentrale overheden zich als aandeelhouders op dit punt expliciet uitspreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over visumvrij reizen voor staatsburgers Oekraïne

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether visa-free travel for Ukrainian and Georgian citizens is planned for mid-2016, whether the Commission recommended approval, and how the Association Agreement's visa provisions relate to the referendum and EU competence. The minister replied that both countries have a perspective on visa liberalisation, that the Commission found all conditions met and will propose list changes in 2016 subject to Parliament and Council decision, and that provisional application of Article 19 does not require suspension and does not remove the need for a separate EU decision.
Once that proposal has been received, your House will be informed in accordance with the usual procedure and within the applicable deadlines.
Zodra dat voorstel is ontvangen, zal uw Kamer hier volgens de gebruikelijke procedure en binnen de geldende termijnen over worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Van Raak over het bericht dat er ruim zes ton is betaald aan een ex-topman van een woningcorporatie

MPs Bashir and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that a former housing corporation executive received over six hundred thousand euros, and whether this was a sham consultancy arrangement harming tenants. The minister replied that the severance was allowed under a court ruling, that no sham arrangement was found since a real change of board occurred, and that the government will consider WNT extension and tackle such constructions in the evaluation process.

A sham construction exists when a top executive of an organisation falling under the WNT changes function and in name no longer acts as executive but de facto still leads the organisation, in order to obtain a higher salary than allowed.

Van een schijnconstructie is sprake als een topbestuurder van een organisatie die onder de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) valt, van functie wisselt en in naam niet meer als bestuurder optreedt maar de facto nog steeds leiding geeft aan de organisatie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jacobi en Yücel over het voornemen van het waterschap Delfland de kwijtschelding van de afvalwaterzuiveringsheffing in twee stappen geheel af te schaffen

MPs Jacobi and Yücel asked whether the Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission (kwijtschelding) of the wastewater treatment levy would hurt low-income households and whether national government should intervene. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards are autonomous in remission policy, that consultations with the Unie van Waterschappen took place, and that social minimum safety nets such as bijstand and municipal compensation exist, with no national intervention planned.

At the same time it was established that the individual water boards are themselves responsible for their own remission policy and account for it to the general board of the water board, which is democratically elected.

Tegelijkertijd is vastgesteld dat de individuele waterschappen zelf verantwoordelijk zijn voor hun eigen kwijtscheldingsbeleid en dat zij hierover verantwoording afleggen aan het algemeen bestuur van het waterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het krantenartikel ‘Misschien Arabische verkeersborden Oranje’

Two MPs asked the minister whether Arabic traffic signs were being seriously considered for introduction in the Netherlands, following a newspaper report. The minister answered that there are no plans to add Arabic signs to the official traffic sign regulation and that local road managers handle site-specific safety issues.
There are no plans to include Arabic traffic signs in it.
Er zijn geen plannen om hier Arabische verkeersborden in op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Gerven over het bericht dat de VNG een pilot ‘reguleren mengvormen winkel/horeca’ start

An MP asked whether the VNG pilot allowing shop-catering hybrids, which would tolerate breaches of specific Drank- en Horecawet articles, is lawful and whether the state would act against it. The state secretary said the law leaves no room for such tolerance, that he expects the VNG to adjust the pilot, sent a letter to the VNG, and will address participating municipalities if experiments go beyond legal limits.
I then stated that the Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) leaves no room for the pilot in which prohibitions under the DHW are tolerated.
Ik heb toen gemeld dat de Drank- en Horecawet (DHW) geen ruimte biedt voor de pilot waarbij verboden uit de DHW worden gedoogd.

Vragen van het lid Schouw (D66) aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afkopen van een bestuurder voor negen ton door een openbaar lichaam van waterschappen (ingezonden 3 juni 2015).

The MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a nine-ton severance payment to a former Hefpunt director was compatible with the Wet normering topinkomens, how the general board and participating authorities were involved, and whether such arrangements should be more transparent. The Minister's follow-up answer says the arrangement largely follows from the sectoral collective agreement and a legal rule, so the WNT does not cover most of it, except a loonsuppletie component that breaches the WNT and has been flagged to the parties, and new rules from 2016 prevent similar long arrangements.
I have meanwhile pointed out in writing to Hefpunt and the person concerned that this is the case.
Ik heb Hefpunt en de betrokkene hier inmiddels schriftelijk op gewezen.

Vragen van het leden Kerstens en Fokke (beiden PvdA) aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat een oud-directeur van een belastingkantoor voor waterschappen bijna 9 ton als afkoop

Opposition MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior about reports that a former director of the Hefpunt tax office for water boards received a severance of nearly 9 million euro, and whether it complied with the WNT pay-cap law. The minister's follow-up answer says the severance mostly follows from sector collective rules and is largely outside the WNT, that one component (loonsuppletie) breaches the WNT and the parties have been warned, and that the regime is nonetheless costly and not activating, with rules since changed.
I have already pointed this out to Hefpunt and the person concerned in writing.
Ik heb Hefpunt en de betrokkene hier inmiddels schriftelijk op gewezen.

Vragen van het lid Smaling (SP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat een falende directeur van een waterschap bijna een miljoe

MPs Smaling (SP) and others asked the ministers about a near-million-euro severance arrangement for the departing director of Hefpunt, a regional tax collection body for water boards, and whether it complied with the WNT pay-cap law. The follow-up answer by Minister Plasterk reports that the review found most components follow from binding law (SAW and WW rules) and fall outside the WNT, that a €75,000 severance and a wage-supplement payment do count under WNT, with the supplement being non-compliant though no enforcement is needed yet, and that new rules were adopted for 2016.
I have already pointed out in writing to Hefpunt and the person concerned that this is the case.
Ik heb Hefpunt en de betrokkene hier inmiddels schriftelijk op gewezen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Oosenbrug en Vermeij over de relatie tussen het UWV en IBM

MPs Oosenbrug and Vermeij asked about the relationship between UWV and IBM, including reported failures of the werk.nl platform, whether UWV considered switching vendors, and whether open standards would give UWV more freedom in choosing suppliers. Minister Asscher answered that UWV is broadly satisfied with IBM, that switching vendors was considered but rejected for cost and continuity reasons, that open standards help but do not by themselves determine switching ease, and listed planned open-standards measures.
UWV decided to continue the cooperation with IBM and other involved suppliers.
UWV heeft besloten de samenwerking met IBM en andere betrokken leveranciers te continueren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgadviseur” strijkt 68.000 euro op’

MPs Kerstens, Owtin van Dijk and Tanamal asked whether a former board chair of care institution Reinier van Arkel received about 368,000 euro as an adviser after leaving in 2013, whether this complied with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT), and whether the arrangement amounted to a disguised continuation of the top role. The minister confirmed the pay figures in the annual accounts, said the WNT does not cap pay of former top officials, referred the case to the regulator CIBG for routine supervision, and stated no sham arrangement had been established.
The WNT regulator for the care sector, the CIBG, will examine this case within the regular supervision of the WNT.
De toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorgsector, het CIBG, zal deze casus in het kader van het reguliere toezicht op de WNT onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Monasch over het bericht “Salaris bobo's Friese thuiszorg verdubbeld”

MPs asked the government about reports that supervisory board pay at home-care organisation Patyna had doubled and whether this complies with the Wet Normering Topinkomens. The minister answered that the board pay was reversed, stays at prior levels, falls within WNT limits as far as applicable, and that setting pay and consulting staff are the organisation's own responsibility.
Within the limits set by law, in particular the WNT, it is for the institution and the top official to determine what constitutes appropriate remuneration.
Binnen de grenzen die de wet, in het bijzonder de WNT, stelt is het aan de instelling en de topfunctionaris om te bepalen wat een passende beloning is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht dat 900 gemeentelijke verordeningen niet rechtsgeldig zijn

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a report that about 900 municipal ordinances, including tax ordinances, were not validly published, with 163 municipalities affected. The minister acknowledged three shortcomings, said the report was self-initiated and not formally shared, noted that oversight is a municipal matter with no interbestuurlijk toezicht possible, and promised a bill requiring centralized electronic publication plus renewed contact with the VNG.
It is for the court to judge whether a shortcoming in a publication is such that the provisions concerned are therefore not binding.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of een tekortkoming in een bekendmaking zodanig is dat de betreffende bepalingen daardoor niet verbindend zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de Syrische zelfmoordterrorist die via Griekenland naar Europa kwam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether a Syrian suicide bomber in Paris entered Europe via Greece as a refugee, how this fits with the NCTV's statement that no jihadists were known to enter via the refugee flow, and whether the government will stop admitting asylum seekers. The Minister replies that the French investigation is ongoing but two attackers likely came through the migration flow, that the NCTV considers such abuse conceivable, that asylum seekers are screened, and that he is not willing to stop admitting people fleeing war.
The French investigation into the circumstances of the attacks and the events leading up to them has not yet been concluded.
Het Franse onderzoek naar de toedracht van de aanslagen en de aanloop daarnaartoe is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Europese oproep extra maatregelen te treffen tegen chemische of biologische terreuraanvallen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the government reacts calmly to an EU call for extra measures against chemical or biological terror attacks, whether the Netherlands has taken new steps such as producing an antidote, and whether the public will be informed preventively as in France and the UK. Minister Van der Steur answers that the Netherlands has long been alert to misuse of CBRN substances, has taken precautionary measures, and has already provided information to the public on how to act in a crisis, referring to earlier answers.
The Netherlands has been alert for years to the threat posed by misuse of chemical, biological, radiological and nuclear substances and has taken the necessary precautionary measures.
Nederland is al jaren alert op de dreiging die uitgaat van misbruik van chemische, biologische, radiologische en nucleaire stoffen en heeft daarvoor de nodige voorzorgsmaatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koser Kaya en Van Weyenberg over DigiD in het buitenland

Two D66 MPs asked whether a German resident of Belgium with a former Dutch business cannot obtain a DigiD, and so cannot access his pension and health insurance data online, and how this squares with EU free movement. Minister Plasterk confirmed that DigiD requires Dutch nationality for non-residents, justified as identity-fraud prevention, and said this may change once the EU eIDAS regulation takes effect, while stating that EU free movement rights do not include a right to digital communication with foreign authorities.
That will probably become possible in the near future.
Dat zal in de nabije toekomst wel tot de mogelijkheden kunnen gaan behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzoek om OVSE/ODIHR-waarnemers te laten observeren bij het aanstaande referendum

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government would invite OSCE/ODIHR observers to the April 2016 advisory referendum on the EU-Ukraine association agreement, which is the first referendum under the Wrr and does not regulate observers. The minister replied that observers may attend with consent of the mayor and polling board chair, that the government will invite ODIHR, but that ODIHR decides independently whether and how to observe.
Although the Wrr does not require it, the cabinet will invite OSCE/ODIHR to send observers to the upcoming referendum so they can be present when the votes are cast.
Hoewel de Wrr daartoe niet verplicht, zal het kabinet OVSE/ODIHR uitnodigen bij het aankomende referendum waarnemers te zenden om aanwezig te kunnen zijn bij het uitbrengen van de stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Visumplicht Venezuela

Two MPs asked whether a visa requirement for Venezuelans, floated by Aruba's tourism minister, should be considered, and about risks to Bonaire. The minister confirmed the remarks, said visa requirements affect bilateral relations and reduce bona fide tourism, noted Aruba and Curaçao's stricter entry controls, and said a visa requirement is not currently warranted but would be decided jointly for all Caribbean parts of the Kingdom.
Aruba and/or Curaçao cannot unilaterally decide to introduce the visa requirement.
Aruba en/of Curaçao kunnen niet eenzijdig beslissen tot het instellen van de visumplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug, Kerstens en Van Dekken over de exorbitante gouden handdruk voor de vertrekkend directeur van Buma

MPs Oosenbrug, Kerstens and Van Dekken asked whether the large severance payment to the departing Buma/Stemra director, who refused to moderate pay under the WNT, is acceptable, and whether the rules could prevent such payments. The minister answered that pre-WNT contracts fall under transitional law, that the College van Toezicht examined the arrangement, that the contract's content is a matter between private parties, and that no change to transitional rules is planned.
Beyond that, it is not for me to disclose the content of the employment contract between two private parties.
Het is voor het overige niet aan mij om mededeling te doen over de inhoud van de arbeidsovereenkomst tussen twee private partijen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het bericht ‘Gemeenten verdienen grif aan ‘spookleges’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities unlawfully charge leges (fees) for permits where the underlying zoning plan is outdated, and whether unlawfully obtained fees must be refunded. The minister agreed it is undesirable, but said municipalities and their councils are responsible, promised only to raise the issue with the VNG, and left refunds to the municipalities.
However, it is the municipalities that are responsible for the leges assessments they impose, and it is up to the relevant municipal councils to act against this.
Het zijn echter de gemeenten die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de legesaanslagen die zij opleggen en het is aan de betreffende gemeenteraden om hier tegen op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Groot over het artikel ‘Toeristenbelasting is een melkkoe’

MPs Monasch and Groot asked about a report that municipal tourist tax is a cash cow, with hotels and bungalow parks charging guests more than the municipal rate, and whether this breaches advertising rules and is lawful. The minister confirms hoteliers may pass on the tax under article 224 Gemeentewet, says overcharging would be undue payment and misleading, and leaves enforcement to the consumer authority ACM and courts while declining to judge specific conduct.
It is not correct to withhold more tourist tax than the municipality in question charges.
Het is daarbij niet juist om meer in te houden aan toeristenbelasting dan dat door de desbetreffende gemeente in rekening wordt gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een wethouder die zijn inkomen aanvult met wachtgeld

An SP MP asked why a Albrandswaard alderman supplements his part-time salary with transitional allowance (wachtgeld), and whether the law allows this and could be changed. The minister replied that this is a legal consequence of the Appa offset rules, intended by the legislature in 2001, that the municipality is responsible for applying, and that he has no power to annul the municipal decision.
The application of the Appa for aldermen is a municipal responsibility.
De toepassing van de Appa voor wethouders is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht 'Plasterk deelt kritiek De Telegraaf niet'

An MP asked Minister Plasterk whether a newspaper article quoting him on criticism of De Telegraaf's reporting on Aruba's government was accurate, and about allegations against Aruban ministers. The minister confirmed the opening remark but declined to take a position on the substance, stating that the matters fall outside the Kingdom's competence and are for Aruba's prosecutor and courts.

Having established this, I can only point out in general terms that the cabinet is known to be very active in the area of integrity in government, both in the Netherlands and elsewhere in the Kingdom.

Dit vastgesteld hebbende, resteert mij er in algemene zin op te wijzen dat bekend is dat het kabinet zeer actief is op het terrein van integriteit in het bestuur in Nederland en elders in het Koninkrijk
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over flexwerkers in dienst bij DUO, het UWV en de Belastingdienst

MP Van Raak asked about the share of temporary agency workers at DUO, UWV and the Belastingdienst, including call centre staff, and whether they receive the same conditions as permanent staff. Minister Blok answered with percentages and conversion figures, explained the inlenersbeloning principle, and said a flexpool for call centre staff is not appropriate.
Obtaining the information needed to answer the questions took some time and made it impossible to send the answers to the House before the plenary debate on the 2016 Interior budget.

Het verkrijgen van de benodigde informatie voor beantwoording van de vragen vergde enige tijd en maakte het niet mogelijk de antwoorden aan uw Kamer te sturen voor de plenaire behandeling van de begroting 2016 van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke integriteitsschendingen op Aruba, in het bijzonder rondom een aanbesteding voor een ziektekostenverzekering voor Arubaanse studenten in Nederland

The MP asks whether the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations shares concerns about possible integrity violations on Aruba in a tender for health insurance for Aruban students in the Netherlands, citing a 2015 Aruban court ruling questioning the insurer's capacity and the conduct of the responsible minister's circle, and asks why no investigation is planned. The minister answers that the matter is an Aruban autonomous affair outside Article 3 of the Statute, that the ruling was a provisional summary-proceedings judgment, and that any suspicion of crimes is for the Aruban Public Prosecution Service.
The underlying matter (the conduct of the tender for health insurance for Aruban students in the Netherlands) is not named in Article 3 of the Statute as a Kingdom affair.
De onderliggende aangelegenheid (de gang van zaken rondom de aanbesteding voor een ziektekostenverzekering voor Arubaanse studenten in Nederland) wordt niet genoemd in artikel 3 van het Statuut
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops inzake nieuwe onthulling over wapenleveranties Turkije aan jihadisten in Syrië

An MP from CDA asked the ministers whether they recognised a leaked German intelligence finding that Turkey supplied weapons to rebel groups in Syria, whether those groups are jihadist, and whether the Netherlands would raise this with Turkey and Germany or confirm it through AIVD/MIVD. The government answered that it is aware of reports of Turkish support to jihadist groups but that the situation is complex, that it has regular contacts with Turkey and Germany, and that AIVD and MIVD do not publicly comment on their findings.
No public statements are made about the subjects or the results of investigations by the AIVD and MIVD.
Over de onderwerpen of de resultaten van onderzoek door AIVD en MIVD worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Oosenbrug over de registratie van levenloos geboren kinderen

MPs Wolbert and Oosenbrug asked whether stillborn children, who by law are deemed never to have existed, could be entered in the Basisregistratie Personen, and how other EU countries register them. The minister answered that stillborn children are not entered in the BRP because it only holds data needed by government bodies, that a special civil-status deed is issued instead, and that practice differs across EU states.

Recording in the BRP of data on a stillborn child that is not necessary for the performance of government bodies' or designated third parties' tasks is not consistent with the purpose and principles of the basic personal records registration.

Opname in de BRP van gegevens over een levenloos geboren kind, die niet noodzakelijk zijn voor de vervulling van de taken van overheidsorganen of aangewezen derden, is niet in overeenstemming met het doel en de uitgangspunten van de basisregistratie personen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg, Agnes Mulder en Van Helvert over de subsidieregeling van OP Zuid

Three CDA MPs asked the Minister why the OP Zuid subsidy scheme's conditions were changed after the application deadline to exclude projects already started, and how many applications were affected. The Minister replied that the change followed EU state-aid rules on incentive effect, that the managing authority had earlier interpreted the rules too loosely, and that he sees no way to reverse the change.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over winstuitkeringen aan bestuurder/eigenaar van een thuiszorginstelling

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether dividend payouts to the owner of a home-care provider (Breederzorg) comply with the WNT pay-cap and other rules, and whether tighter rules are needed on owner-managers and profit distributions in publicly funded care. The state secretary replied that dividends are not governed by the WNT, that CIBG will examine the case under routine supervision, and that existing law and the governance code provide sufficient safeguards.
CIBG will, as the responsible supervisor, examine this further within regular WNT supervision of the institution.
Het CIBG zal dit als verantwoordelijk toezichthouder nader onderzoeken in het kader van het reguliere WNT-toezicht op de instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bashir over staatssteun en woningcorporaties

An MP asked whether the European Commission's growing influence over Dutch social housing (via state aid rules, competition rules and the European Semester) is undesirable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the Commission only checks compliance with EU rules, that the Dutch housing law already uses the discretion granted under Protocol 26, and that the government will raise housing and poverty themes during the Dutch EU presidency without a specific intervention.

The European Commission checks whether member states comply with the rules and, when this leads to outcomes undesirable for the member state, enters into discussion to reach agreements that minimise market distortion.

De Europese Commissie toetst of lidstaten aan de regels voldoen en gaat, wanneer dit leidt tot voor de lidstaat ongewenste uitkomsten, in gesprek om te komen tot afspraken om zo veel mogelijk marktverstoring te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het verstrekken van persoonsgegevens van niet-kerkgangers aan de Stichting Interkerkelijke Ledenadministratie

An MP asked the Interior Minister about personal data of non-churchgoers passed from the population register to the church membership body SILA, including how it is checked that a person is a church member, safeguards, and the opt-out system. The minister answered that data flows only for registered church members without objections, that confidentiality is legally required, and that he sees no reason to switch to opt-in.
I see no reason to adapt the current options as regulated for the BRP into an opt-in system
Ik zie geen aanleiding om de huidige mogelijkheden zoals geregeld voor de BRP aan te passen in een opt-in systeem
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Kooiman over het splitsen van het ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie om de rechtsstatelijke taak en de veiligheidstaak weer uit elkaar te halen

SP MPs Van Nispen and Kooiman asked the Minister of Interior whether he would support splitting the Ministry of Security and Justice into separate rule-of-law and security tasks, including moving the national police back to the Interior Ministry, and whether preparations should start now. The minister replied that the previous cabinet placed political responsibility for police management with the Justice and Security Minister, the current cabinet kept that choice, and any future change is a matter for the next cabinet formation, so it sees no reason to anticipate.
The cabinet sees no reason to anticipate this.
Het kabinet ziet geen aanleiding hierop vooruit te lopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over een test met internetstemmen bij het referendum over de associatieovereenkomst tussen de EU en Oekraïne

An MP asked whether the minister would test internet voting for Dutch citizens abroad at the Ukraine association agreement referendum, and whether he would accelerate the timeline. The minister answered that the government is making voting easier abroad, that internet voting is not yet suitable, and that a security-focused test will be held in late 2016 rather than alongside the referendum to avoid confusion.
That is why I have promised your House to organise a test to examine how reliable voting services are that are used (in other countries) for elections to representative bodies.

Daarom heb ik uw Kamer toegezegd een test te zullen organiseren om na te gaan hoe betrouwbaar stemdiensten zijn die (in andere landen) zijn of worden gebruikt voor verkiezingen van vertegenwoordigende organen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Caluwé en Neppérus over de pilots voor het eID (elektronische identiteit) stelsel

MPs De Caluwé and Neppérus asked whether a bank-login pilot with the Tax Administration could start before evaluation criteria for the eID pilots were discussed with the House, and whether it would wait for that discussion. The minister confirmed the criteria would be sent in time for the 25 November consultation, but said the bank pilot starts mid-December, after that meeting, with a small group and wider use from 1 March.
The State Secretary for Finance will inform you in a separate letter in more detail about the evaluation criteria for the bank pilot.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën zal u in een separate brief nader informeren over de evaluatiecriteria voor de bankenpilot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van Bommel, Tellegen, Van der Staaij en Oskam over een hooggeplaatst lid van ISIS

Six MPs asked ministers whether a report that a senior ISIS member was en route to the Netherlands or Germany was credible and how intelligence services had examined it. The government answered that the report closely resembles earlier media reports, that services remain vigilant, and that it cannot publicly discuss the nature of its investigations.
The cabinet cannot make public statements about the nature of the services' investigations.
Het kabinet kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de aard van onderzoek door de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar een gemeenteraadslid

Two MPs asked whether a criminal investigation into a Haarlemmermeer council group leader, reportedly filed by the mayor, is real, and what action will be taken after a police officer's alleged remarks in a café. The minister confirmed a criminal investigation exists but withheld further details citing the investigation's interests, referred the officer's conduct to the police internal affairs unit, and said notifying a suspect early depends on the case.
In the interest of this investigation, I cannot currently provide any further information.
In het belang van dit onderzoek kan ik op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Wolbert over het monopolie van softwareleveranciers van gemeenten

MPs Oosenbrug and Wolbert asked the Minister of Interior about a near-duopoly in municipal central software, price increases, vendor lock-in and possible cheaper alternatives. The Minister acknowledged a dominant two-supplier market but said KING and VNG convenants address interoperability, declined to investigate prices, and will only assist if municipalities take the initiative.
It is in any case a task of the municipalities themselves, with the help of VNG/KING, to prevent through standardisation and good client management that suppliers are able to do so.
Het is overigens een taak van de gemeenten zelf om, met behulp van VNG/KING, door standaardisatie en goed opdrachtgeverschap te voorkomen dat leveranciers hiertoe in staat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over campagnebrieven van de AK-partij aan Turkse Nederlanders

An MP asked whether foreign-party campaign letters from the AKP sent to Turkish Dutch residents had used Dutch government or consulate data, and whether the CBP is investigating. The government answered that political activity by foreign parties is lawful unless legal limits are crossed, that the CBP has requested information and its outcome will be awaited, and that it will consult Belgian and German counterparts on experiences there.
The Data Protection Authority (CBP) has sent a request for information.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft een verzoek om inlichtingen uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over Venezolanen die Curaçao weigeren te verlaten

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Venezuelan holidaymakers refusing to leave Curaçao were a problem, whether Curaçao's controls at sea and on arrival were adequate, and whether the Kingdom government had pressed for monitoring under a motion, plus what it knew of a Curaçao taskforce. The minister confirmed a modest rise in overstays, said Curaçao has autonomous control over entry and that sea controls were tightened, and stated that close contact with Aruba and Curaçao is maintained without giving precise figures.
Admission is a competence of Curaçao. It is up to Curaçao to organise the process of entry and exit.
Toelating is een bevoegdheid van Curaçao. Het is aan Curaçao om het proces rondom in- en uitreis in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over FNV referendum over Loonruimteakkoord

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister to respond to the FNV referendum rejecting the public-sector wage deal and to detail how the other unions consulted their members.
