The minister regretted FNV's rejection but said union consultation procedures are internal matters and gave only general statements about a majority in favour.
The procedure for consulting the membership is an internal matter for the unions, and as usual the cabinet and employers do not interfere in it.
De procedure van achterbanraadpleging is een interne aangelegenheid van de bonden, zoals gebruikelijk mengen kabinet en werkgevers zich daar niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over de vermelding van de geboorteplaats op de geboorteakte

An MP asked why birth records must state the municipality of birth, questioning its relevance and whether the place of residence or parents' wish should be recorded instead. The Minister defended the current rule as preserving authenticity and legal certainty and declined to change it, while noting officials' verification powers.
Under these circumstances, there is no reason for me to change the current statutory arrangement.
Onder deze omstandigheden bestaat er voor mij geen aanleiding om de huidige wettelijke regeling te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de voortgang van de actieve openbaarmaking van onderzoeksrapporten

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the progress of proactive publication of research reports and where published reports can be found, plus 2014 pilot figures for BZK and OCW, reasons for delays, and disclosure of contractors and costs. The minister answered that reports are findable on rijksoverheid.nl, gave pilot counts (most published within 28 days, a few delayed or unpublished, with reasons such as interdepartmental coordination), said contractor names are usually disclosed and cost data will be published as open data, and noted the general meeting was postponed.
The costs of research fall under procurement information. This information will be published as open data in November.
De kosten voor onderzoeken vallen onder inkoopinformatie. Deze informatie zal november aanstaande gepubliceerd worden als open data.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de uitkomst van het Europese fraudeonderzoek naar een moskeeverzamelgebouw

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about OLAF's finding of no irregularities in an EU-subsidised multifunctional building in Amsterdam that houses prayer rooms, and whether Amsterdam asked OLAF to drop the case. The minister replied that no EU subsidy went to the religious part, no fraud was found, and Amsterdam never asked OLAF to drop the case.
In this case there is no question of fraud or irregularity.
Er is in dit geval geen sprake van fraude of onregelmatigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Caluwé over de eID Pilots

MP De Caluwé asked the Interior Minister about the e-ID pilots: whether the evaluation criteria would be made SMART and tied to the entry conditions, and what the status of the pilots is. Minister Plasterk answered that the criteria will be sent before the November committee meeting, that evaluation criteria and entry conditions are distinct, and that 14 e-ID providers are in the accession process with pilots expected to start around year-end.
You will receive the criteria in good time before the committee meeting of 25 November.
U ontvangt de criteria tijdig voor het Algemeen Overleg van 25 november aanstaande.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind en Segers over de mogelijkheid in een handomdraai aan een vals Syrisch paspoort te komen

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the government about a press report that a forged official Syrian passport could be obtained easily, and whether Dutch services detect such documents and cooperate with intelligence services. The government answered that Syrian documents are checked extra thoroughly, that the damaged document cannot be examined for detection purposes, and that the IND cooperates with the AIVD and MIVD and with European partners.
The document described in the article was rendered unusable by the journalist.
Het document waar in het artikel over wordt geschreven is door de journalist onbruikbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over het afschaffen van de kwijtschelding van de heffing voor de zuivering van afvalwater door het waterschap Delfland

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked about Delfland water board's plan to phase out remission of its wastewater treatment levy, its consistency with the Unie van Waterschappen advice and interbestuurlijke cooperation, and effects on low incomes and municipal debt and poverty policy. Minister Plasterk answered that water boards decide on remission democratically, that the Waterwet cooperation is unaffected by levy remission, and that the Staatssecretaris will invite the Unie van Waterschappen for a discussion.
The starting point is the freedom of each water board to shape and determine its remission policy in a democratic deliberative process.
Voorop staat de vrijheid van elk waterschap om zijn kwijtscheldingsbeleid in een democratisch afwegingsproces vorm en inhoud te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de Isla-raffinaderij

An MP asked whether ISLA refinery emissions on Curaçao are rising, exceed permit limits and WHO guidelines, and why the Dutch government has not acted to protect the population. The minister confirmed emissions rose over 2011-2014 but said exceedance is hard to establish because several installations contribute, and that responsibility for enforcement and action lies with Curaçao.
This concerns an autonomous responsibility of the country of Curaçao.
Het gaat hier om een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van land Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Boer over het bericht “Krimpbeleid Oost-Groningen zorgwekkend”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the 2.24 million euro population-decline grant for East Groningen carries conditions, and whether regional rather than Gemeentefonds-based approaches should lead on shrinkage policy. The government answered that the funds are unconditional Gemeentefonds money, favours an integrated cross-municipal approach encouraged by designating one centre municipality per shrinkage region, and says it already works with the province and region on shrinkage policy.
The funds are part of the municipal fund and are therefore not tied to any conditions.
De middelen zijn onderdeel van het gemeentefonds en daarmee niet aan voorwaarden gebonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Veldman over het door de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie afgewezen verzoek van YAZULA om de berichtgeving van NL Alert als open data ontsloten te krijgen

Rep. Veldman (VVD) asks why the Ministry of Security and Justice rejected app developer YAZULA's request to receive NL Alert messages as open data under the reuse of public sector information act, whether any statutory exception applies, and what will be done to ensure departments comply. Minister Plasterk answers that the request is assessed on its merits by the ministry, that the applicant need not have a stated interest, that implementation support such as information sessions and guidance is being provided, but does not explain the specific rejection.
In principle, every institution entrusted with a public task is responsible for the correct application of this act.
In beginsel is iedere met een publieke taak belaste instelling verantwoordelijk voor een juiste toepassing van deze wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de duizenden fraude-gevallen bij het generaal pardon

Two MPs asked how many of the roughly 28,000 asylum seekers under the 2007-2008 general pardon committed identity fraud, which municipalities helped amend identity data, and what action would be taken against them. The State Secretary denied large-scale identity fraud, reporting only ten residence permits revoked for personal-data fraud in two years, and said municipalities apply the BRP law on their own, so no measures against them were needed.
The picture painted in the reporting, namely that foreigners are seeking to change their personal details on a large scale, is not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat in de berichtgeving wordt geschetst namelijk dat vreemdelingen op grote schaal hun persoonsgegevens willen wijzigen herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Berndsen-Jansen over de berichten dat de Nederlandse Politie Sint Maarten te corrupt vindt

MPs Hachchi and Berndsen-Jansen asked about reports that the Dutch police consider the Sint Maarten police too corrupt to cooperate with, and about the rules, powers and remedies around the Recherche Samenwerkingsteam. The government answered that the team's reinforcement is planned for 24 months, that an Integrity Chamber law was adopted in Sint Maarten, and that cooperation with the Sint Maarten police will be intensified under the 24 May 2015 protocol.
The Integrity Chamber Ordinance was adopted by the Estates of Sint Maarten on 18 August 2015.
De Landsverordening Integriteitkamer is op 18 augustus 2015 door de Staten van Sint Maarten vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat het Hoogheemraadschap Delfland stopt met het kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelasting aan minima

MPs asked the government whether it supports municipalities' calls for Hoogheemraadschap Delfland to keep waiving water board charges for low-income residents, and about waterschap waiver policy generally. The state secretary answered that waiver decisions belong to each water board's democratically elected general board, that all water boards currently grant waivers, and that he plans to invite the Unie van Waterschappen to discuss poverty and debt.
Setting the level of water board charges and whether to waive them in whole or in part is decided in a democratic process.
Het vaststellen van de hoogte van de waterschapsbelastingen en het al dan niet (gedeeltelijk) kwijtschelden van waterschapsbelastingen wordt in een democratisch proces bepaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Merkies over uitzondering WNT bij salaris AFM-bestuurslid de Vries

An MP asked why the minister used the WNT individual exception to set a higher salary for the new AFM board member Femke de Vries, and how the decision was made and communicated. The minister answered that the unique combination of knowledge, experience and labour-market conditions justified the exception, that the decision was published in the Staatscourant, and that the salary would be reduced to a non-excessive level, while declining to disclose the content of candidate negotiations.
The content of the discussions with a candidate is not public.
De inhoud van de gesprekken met een kandidaat zijn niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over de reis van de voltallige directie Koninkrijksrelaties naar Curaçao

An MP asked why the entire 28-member directorate for Kingdom Relations travelled to Curaçao for its annual meeting, what justified full attendance, and what the trip cost and achieved. The minister answered that the meeting enabled strategic consultation and site visits, that full attendance was needed for network maintenance across the Kingdom, that the total cost was €56,326.75 for 54 participants, and that the minister will continue to monitor sober travel policy.
Also in the future I will continue to monitor a sober implementation of the policy on business travel.
Ook in de toekomst blijf ik toezien op een sobere uitvoering van het beleid inzake dienstreizen.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Raak over een reis van de top van het ministerie naar Curaçao

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations for the precise costs of a trip by the top of the Kingdom Relations directorate to Curaçao, broken down by cost type and average per participant. The Minister answered with total costs of €56,326.75 for 54 participants (about €1,043 per person), itemised by travel, accommodation and programme costs, with a supporting table.
The costs of this trip for 54 participants are: – travel costs €21,992.31 – accommodation costs (lodging and meals) €27,810.53 – programme costs €6,593.91 Total costs €56,326.75
De kosten van deze reis voor 54 deelnemers zijn: – reiskosten € 21.992,31 – verblijfskosten (logies en voeding) € 27.810,53 – programmakosten € 6.593,91 Totale kosten € 56.326,75
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het snoepreisje van de gehele directie Koninkrijksrelaties naar Curaçao

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations why tens of officials from the Kingdom Relations directorate were allowed a trip to Curaçao, calling it a taxpayer-funded perk, and whether such trips will stop. The minister refers to his answers to earlier questions from MPs Van Raak and Van Laar, giving no substantive answer in this document.
For the answer I refer you to my answers to the questions from MPs Van Raak and Van Laar.
Voor het antwoord verwijs ik u naar mijn antwoorden op de vragen van de leden Van Raak en Van Laar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Koser Kaya over het bericht ‘Een risico omdat hij homo’s sprak’

An MP asked whether a security clearance was wrongly not renewed because the AIVD treated a Muslim friend of a gay man as a partner, and whether prejudice played a role. The minister said the Council of State ruled the partner concept was interpreted too broadly, denied any role for sexual orientation, described existing safeguards, and declined to discuss individual cases or compensation.
Following this ruling, it is still being considered whether this definition should be adjusted.
Naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak wordt nog bezien of deze definitie aangepast dient te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Bosman over drugssmokkel van Venezuela naar het Caribisch deel van het Koninkrijk

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a July 2015 interception of 125 kilos of cocaine on a Venezuelan boat, the scale of drug smuggling from Venezuela to the Caribbean part of the Kingdom, and whether Aruba and Curaçao have enough capacity to fight it. The government confirmed the interception (later put at 150 kilos, handed to the Venezuelan navy), said reliable data on the scale of smuggling do not exist, and stated that the Caribbean authorities have adequate tools and cooperate with international partners.
There are no reliable data on the scale and origin of drug smuggling in or via the Caribbean region.
Er zijn geen betrouwbare gegevens over de omvang en herkomst van drugssmokkel in of via het Caribisch gebied.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht dat de buurtonderneming MidWest in Amsterdam West mogelijk de deuren moet sluiten

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the closure of the Midwest neighbourhood enterprise in Amsterdam West, possibly due to a Wet markt en overheid issue, was undesirable and how it relates to EU state aid rules. The minister declined to judge the Amsterdam case, deferring to local democracy and the municipality, and said he would inform parliament later on neighbourhood rights.
It is not the role of the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to pronounce on the state aid aspects of local matters.
Het is niet de rol van de Minister van Binnenlandse zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om een uitspraak te doen over de staatssteunaspecten in lokale kwesties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht dat het kabinet Sint Eustatius boycot voor verdere werkbezoeken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the cabinet agreed not to visit Sint Eustatius while it is under enhanced financial supervision, and what the purpose and precedent were. The minister confirmed a coordinated approach to visits, said the Governor and Ministry would continue dialogue with the island's board, and stated a meeting with the island's leadership was planned for mid-September.
The island executive council has sufficient opportunity to engage in dialogue with the Netherlands, in the person of the Governor.
Het bestuurscollege heeft voldoende gelegenheid om het gesprek met Nederland te voeren, in de persoon van de Rijksvertegenwoordiger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Schippers: hogere kiesdrempel om kleine partijen uit Kamer te weren’

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a remark by Minister Schippers about making it harder for small parties to enter parliament, and a possible 5% electoral threshold, reflected cabinet policy and how it would affect democracy and coalition formation. The minister replied that there is no cabinet policy on this, the cabinet has no plans to introduce a threshold, and he answered no to whether decision-making without opposition matters more than democratic faction formation.
There is no question of cabinet policy, as Minister Schippers herself also indicates in the interview.
Van kabinetsbeleid is, zoals Minister Schippers zelf ook aangeeft in het interview, geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het watertekort op Saba

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a water shortage on Saba, high water prices, threats to businesses and tourism, and whether the navy would again supply water. The minister answered that the government and the island authority are working on storage and supply upgrades, that navy assistance would be considered only if a formal request came, and that no such emergency exists currently.
Since 2012 the cabinet has worked with the Saba island executive on both temporary measures and more structural solutions to the water problem during severe drought.
Het kabinet werkt sinds 2012 samen met het bestuurscollege van Saba om zowel tijdelijke maatregelen als meer structurele oplossingen voor het waterprobleem in tijden van grote droogte te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde en De Caluwé over het inzicht van verhuurders in adresinschrijvingen

MPs Van der Linde and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior how landlords can access information on who is registered at their properties, and whether this helps reduce fraud and nuisance. The Minister answered that systematic access is not possible under BRP and data protection law, and pointed to municipal cooperation and landlords' own responsibilities as alternatives.

This is contrary to legislation (BRP and Wbp) and would open the door to the undesirable situation that personal data under government responsibility could be provided to all commercial organisations and private individuals.

Dit is in strijd met wetgeving (BRP en Wbp) en zou de deur openzetten naar de onwenselijke situatie dat persoonsgegevens die vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid, verstrekt kunnen worden aan alle commerciële organisaties en particulieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de afkoopsom voor een oud-bestuurder van ggz-instelling Rivierduinen

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the ministers whether a severance payment equal to half a year's salary given to a former Rivierduinen mental health board member, despite few years of service, was justified and whether the WNT tightening should apply. The minister said CIBG will examine whether the arrangement complied with the WNT, that the WNT's severance cap does not apply to pre-existing contracts under transitional law, and that dismissals follow the CAO GGZ.
The CIBG will investigate whether this severance arrangement was implemented in accordance with the Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT).
Het CIBG zal onderzoeken of deze ontslagregeling conform de Wet Normering Topinkomens (WNT) is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het weigeren van nabestaanden bij een begrafenis

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether relatives should always be able to attend a funeral, whether municipalities may refuse relatives who cannot pay, and what rules govern municipal funerals. The minister replied that relatives should in principle be able to attend, that municipalities may recover costs from the estate or obligated relatives, and that the matter is a municipal responsibility under local autonomy.
This is otherwise not a matter of concern for the national government.
Dit is verder geen voorwerp van zorg voor het Rijk.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over de enquête onder architecten en de toepassing van de Europese regels bij aanbestedingen

An SP MP asks about a survey of architects who say EU procurement rules disadvantage them: unpaid design phases, strict reference requirements and unexplained decisions. The Minister of Economic Affairs replies that the 2012 Procurement Act's proportionality measures are working but need better application, that unpaid preliminary designs are contrary to the Gids proportionality guidance unless justified, and that a bill to be sent to parliament in autumn will allow longer reference periods.
As announced in the letter, I am focusing on promoting better procurement.
Zoals aangekondigd in de brief zet ik in op het stimuleren van beter aanbesteden.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Smaling over het beter aanbesteden van architectuuropdrachten

An MP asks whether selection criteria in architecture tenders should be monitored independently, whether the Proportionality Guide can be evaluated, whether tenders can be made fully public, and whether structural funding for the Architectuur Lokaal/PIANOo advisory support should be restored. The minister declines independent monitoring and binding sanctions, notes the Commission of Tender Experts is non-binding by design, refuses to publish submitted bids, and routes the funding question to PIANOo.
Publishing submitted tenders is not permitted under Article 2.57 of the Public Procurement Act 2012 and is undesirable from a competition-law standpoint.
Het openbaar maken van ingediende offertes mag op grond van artikel 2.57 van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 niet en is vanuit mededingingsrechtelijk oogpunt onwenselijk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht 'Netbeheerder Alliander gunt top een graaisalaris'

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander's arrangement, which may have a top executive earning above the WNT pay cap, amounts to a scheme to circumvent the Wet normering topinkomens and what the minister will do about it. Minister Plasterk answered that the WNT applies to grid operators, that suitable candidates exist within the cap, that the WNT supervisor is investigating who actually led Alliander in 2014, and that the broader law evaluation and the outcome of that investigation will determine any further action.
For that reason the WNT supervision unit of my ministry has started further investigation into who actually led the organisation during 2014 and must be regarded as a top official under the WNT.

Daarom is de Eenheid toezicht WNT van mijn ministerie nader onderzoek gestart naar wie gedurende het jaar 2014 feitelijk leiding gaf aan de organisatie en voor de WNT als topfunctionaris moet worden aangemerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de politieke controle op grote hervormingen in de zorg faalt

Leijten (SP) asks how the government views reports that municipal councillors are too poorly informed to control the three major decentralisations in care, and what will be done about it. Minister Plasterk replies that colleges of mayor and aldermen are responsible for informing councils, points to the Wgr and guidance for councillors, and says the Rob advice on democratic legitimacy is pending, with more measures possibly to follow.
It is the responsibility of each college of mayor and aldermen to inform its own municipal council in such a way that it can properly carry out its control task.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van ieder college van burgemeesters en wethouders om de eigen gemeenteraad zodanig te informeren dat zij hun controletaak goed kunnen uitvoeren
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Oproep tot ‘jihadbendes’ in Europa

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the ministers of Interior, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs about a report of calls for Muslim 'jihad gangs' in Europe, including calls to arm, attack police and recruit children, and whether the NCTV's dismissal of the material was adequate, and asked whether Islam is a problem requiring 'de-Islamisation'. The government answered that it takes jihadist violence seriously under its integrated action programme, that the NCTV rightly labelled the material jihadist propaganda with no reason to revise that view, and that Islam enjoys the same constitutional and human rights protection as other religions.
The cabinet takes the threat posed by violent jihadism extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de dreiging die van het gewelddadig jihadisme uitgaat uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het Rapport van bevindingen Jaarrekening 2013 Curaçao van de Algemene Rekenkamer Curaçao

An MP asked the minister about the Curaçao Audit Chamber's finding of seriously deficient financial management in 2013, the status of Cft reports, and the risks to Dutch loans such as to the hospital. The minister answered that the next Cft inventory comes after summer, that Cft reviews loans partly using Audit Chamber reports, that debt risks exist, and that financial management still needs development.
The inventory on the 2013 annual accounts, the 2014 budget execution and the 2015 budget preparation will become available after the summer.
De inventarisatie over de jaarrekening 2013, de begrotingsuitvoering 2014 en de begrotingsvoorbereiding 2015 komt na de zomer beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het energielabel van woningen dat volgens makelaars niet werkt

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior about reports that the new home energy label is not working, including sector complaints, low uptake of Nationaal Energiebespaarfonds loans, and problems with DigiD and letter delivery. The minister rejects the critique, cites industry sources and uptake figures, and says he will keep monitoring the system and fix remaining problems.
Of course I am monitoring where the system can still be improved.
Uiteraard monitor ik waar het systeem nog kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de gemeente Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude zichzelf in de verkoop zet

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal cuts and decentralisations are forcing Haarlemmerliede en Spaarnwoude to seek merger with neighbouring municipalities, and whether the government will help solve its financial problems. The minister replied that the municipal council decides on mergers and budgets, that no municipalities are known to have run into financial trouble from the recent task transfers, and that the province, not the ministry, judges compliance with the balanced-budget rule.
It is primarily for the municipal executive, and not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, to judge whether administrative independence is desirable.
Het is primair aan het gemeentebestuur en niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om te oordelen over de wenselijkheid van bestuurlijke zelfstandigheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en De Graaf over een in 2004 verhinderde aanslag

Two PVV MPs asked whether reports that the Netherlands escaped an attack in 2004 were correct, whether two men filming the Israeli embassy were prosecuted, their nationality, and whether they were handed to Israeli authorities. The Minister answered that the attack claim cannot be confirmed, that four men were arrested but prosecution for preparing an attack failed for lack of evidence, that two were convicted on lesser charges (one later acquitted on appeal), that one man of Saudi nationality was expelled, that the nationality of the others cannot be established, and that there was no reason to hand them over to Israel.
The criminal investigation did not, however, lead to prosecution for preparing an attack, because insufficient evidence was found for that.
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft evenwel niet geleid tot een vervolging ter zake van het voorbereiden van een aanslag, omdat daartoe onvoldoende bewijs werd gevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de integriteit van een lobbyist

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether former minister Bot, lobbying the Public Prosecution Service in a criminal case involving a Libyan businessman, gave the appearance of seeking a favour, whether he should have disclosed himself as a lobbyist, and what measures will ensure lobbyists disclose themselves and whether mandatory membership of a trade association would help. The minister declined to comment on the specific case given the prosecution's independence, said former office-holders should be mindful of their position, and said he would look at transparency options but considered mandatory disclosure hard to enforce and mandatory membership not a solution.
Given the independent position of the Public Prosecution Service, I do not consider it appropriate to enter into this specific case.
Gelet op de onafhankelijke positie van het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet passend om in deze specifieke casus te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over subsidievoorwaarden ten aanzien van topinkomens

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether municipalities may attach income caps for executives of subsidised institutions to subsidy conditions, and whether the law should change given a Council of State ruling on Eindhoven and Novadic-Kentron. The minister answers that existing law already offers options, that no legislative change is needed, and that a model approach with VNG and IPO is in draft and will be sent shortly.
As indicated, there are possibilities within existing legal frameworks to impose such subsidy conditions.
Zoals aangegeven zijn er binnen bestaande wettelijke kaders mogelijkheden om dergelijke subsidievoorwaarden te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over het bericht dat de inwoners van Curaçao bezorgd zijn over de rookgassen uit de raffinaderij in Willemstad

An MP asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about residents of Curaçao worried about emissions from the Isla refinery and asked for research, openness and protection measures. The minister answered that the matter is an autonomous responsibility of the Curaçao government, that independent research is underway with results expected in August, and that the Defence Ministry will measure air quality in Julianadorp from January 2016.
However, this is an autonomous matter of the Curaçao government; on behalf of the Dutch cabinet I have regular contact with the Curaçao government about it.
Het betreft echter een autonome aangelegenheid van de Curaçaose regering, namens het Nederlandse kabinet heb ik hierover regelmatig contact met de Curaçaose regering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebruik van een softwarefout door de Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten

An MP asked whether the NSA exploited the LogJam weakness in encryption protocols to intercept secure communications and how the Dutch government handles discovered vulnerabilities. The government declined to confirm or assess the NSA hypothesis, citing intelligence source protection, said it supports responsible disclosure and will inform stakeholders of significant vulnerabilities subject to legal and operational limits, and judged no major impact on government systems requiring further investigation.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Hachchi over het bericht dat kwetsbaarheden in encryptiesoftware door Amerikaanse inlichtingendiensten zijn gebruikt

Two D66 MPs asked whether a research article on Diffie-Hellman weaknesses, which suggests the NSA may have used them to read VPN, SSH and TLS traffic, is credible, whether other states or non-state actors have used such weaknesses, and whether the government wants access to encrypted data or a uniform policy on zero-day vulnerabilities. The government declined to say whether the researchers' hypothesis is correct because intelligence services do not disclose their collection methods, advised longer key lengths and stronger configuration, and said it supports encryption and responsible disclosure, referring to a forthcoming letter on encryption.
Intelligence and security services do not give insight into how they collect their intelligence, in connection with protecting sources, modus operandi and current knowledge level.
Inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten geven geen inzicht in de wijze waarop zij hun inlichtingen verzamelen in verband met de bescherming van bronnen, modus operandi en actueel kennisniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht dat een oud-topman van een zorginstelling na zijn vertrek nog 235.000 bij dezelfde instelling verdiende

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a former Pleyade care-institution director received €235,000 after leaving in 2013, including a six-month continued salary and a €75,000 severance, and whether this circumvented WNT rules, while 200 staff were dismissed. The ministers said the figures in the annual accounts show a 2013 salary of €125,393 plus €75,000 severance and a 2014 project-role salary of €59,793, that the WNT supervisor CIBG will examine the case, and that they lack detailed insight into staff severance.
This case will be assessed against the WNT by the WNT supervisor for care, the CIBG.
Deze casus zal aan de WNT worden getoetst door de toezichthouder van de WNT voor de zorg, het CIBG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Voordewind over de aanpak van huiselijk geweld in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Segers and Voordewind asked whether the government would adopt preventive, family-centred approaches to domestic violence in Caribbean Netherlands instead of a mainly justice-based response, and whether they would fund and roll out a pilot run by the Bonaire youth and family centre. The government answered that an integrated approach covering prevention, care and justice is needed, pointed to existing measures and funding, and said it would support a Bonaire Eigen Kracht pilot and share results if successful, without committing to a rollout.
If the conference proves successful, the results will be shared with the other islands.
Mocht de conferentie een succes blijken te zijn, dan zullen de resultaten gedeeld worden met de andere eilanden
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over de buitenlandse financiering van islamitische instellingen

MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked ministers about foreign funding of Islamic institutions, the AIVD's remit, and ANBI transparency obligations for mosques and churches. The government answered that the RAND study revealed nothing new, that it will apply ANBI publication rules from 2016 and revoke status where obligations are unmet, and that intelligence services investigate foreign influence only where serious suspicions arise.
No public statements can be made about how the AIVD concretely organises its investigations.
Over de wijze waarop de AIVD concreet onderzoeken inricht, kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Omtzigt over het benutten van wettelijke mogelijkheden om uitreizen naar IS-gebieden te voorkomen

CDA MPs Oskam and Omtzigt asked the government why local authorities do not use passport measures to prevent jihadist departures to IS territory, and about information provision to mayors and the monitoring of departures. Minister Van der Steur answered that passport signalling is one useful tool within a broader package, that mayors and municipal councils have been adequately informed, that about seventy passports were flagged for invalidation, and that the government will not publish per-municipality departure figures, which remains the responsibility of each municipality.
As indicated, it is not for the cabinet to communicate about individual departing persons or the number of departures per municipality.
Zoals aangegeven is het niet aan het kabinet om over individuele uitreizigers of het aantal uitreizigers per gemeente te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Helvert over het boetebeleid dat gemeenten hanteren middels de buitengewoon opsporingsambtenaren en over het overnemen van een parkeerkaartje

MPs Oskam and Van Helvert asked about inconsistent municipal fining policy by enforcement officers (boa's), whether boa's should take on more police fining powers, and the legality of transferring a parking ticket. The government replied that local enforcement differences are a municipal matter, it opposes extending boa fining powers into police territory, and it will not change the fiscal parking rules, while noting that no administrative fine but a tax assessment is imposed for ticket transfer.
Given local circumstances and differences in the nature and extent of nuisance, there is no need for national uniformity in government action against local nuisance.
Gelet op de lokale omstandigheden en verschillen in de aard en omvang van overlast is er geen noodzaak tot (landelijke) eenheid in overheidsoptreden bij de aanpak van lokale overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Smaling over het bericht dat een falende directeur van een waterschap bijna een miljoen euro heeft meegekregen

An SP MP asked ministers about a Hefpunt water-board tax-collection director receiving a severance package of about EUR 950,000 despite WNT pay-cap rules, including prior suspension, the timing of informing the water board, the legality of in-house unemployment benefits, and possible reclaim. The minister answered that the severance (EUR 905,000 provision) is under WNT investigation, that the WNT was reported as not exceeded, that nullity and reclaim are possible if non-compliant, and that no separate policy for water boards will be pursued.
I am currently having it examined whether all these components, assessed under the WNT, were rightly and on the correct basis granted, and will inform you once this examination is completed.
Ik laat momenteel nader onderzoeken of al deze componenten – beoordeeld in het kader van de WNT – terecht en op de juiste grondslag zijn toegekend en zal u informeren zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het afkopen van een bestuurder voor negen ton door een openbaar lichaam van waterschappen

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a severance payment of nine million (about €905,000 provisioned) to a director of the Hefpunt joint regulation of water boards was consistent with the WNT pay-cap law, how the general board was involved, and why such payments can stay secret for a year. The minister answered that the payment was a provision with components under sectoral rules, that a WNT enforcement unit is investigating its legal basis, that disclosure is required annually, and that the Raad voor het openbaar bestuur is advising on democratic legitimacy of joint regulations.

I am having the WNT supervision unit of my ministry further examine whether all these components were rightly and on the correct basis granted, and will inform the House once this examination is completed.

Ik laat momenteel door de met het toezicht op de naleving van de Wet normering topinkomens (WNT) belaste Eenheid toezicht WNT van mijn ministerie nader onderzoeken of al deze componenten terecht en op de juiste grondslag zijn toegekend en zal de Kamer informeren zodra dit onderzoek is afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht dat een oud-directeur van een belastingkantoor voor waterschappen bijna 9 ton als afkoopsom heeft gekregen

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked whether a former director of the Hefpunt tax office for water boards could keep receiving large annual payments and a 9 million euro severance, and about the timing, contract basis, job-search obligation, and transparency under the WNT pay-cap law. Minister Plasterk replied that negotiations took place in early 2014, that the legality of the severance is still under investigation by the WNT supervision unit which has access to the contract, and that he will report back on the outcome without yet giving a verdict.
If the investigation shows that the severance arrangement is wholly or partly in breach of the WNT, it is - for the non-compliant part - void by operation of law.
Als het onderzoek uitwijst dat de vertrekregeling geheel of gedeeltelijk in strijd is met WNT, is deze – voor het niet-conforme deel – van rechtswege nietig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over re-integratie in Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports that re-integration practice in Rotterdam amounted to intimidation of benefit recipients, and whether the state would act on the ombudsman's recommendations. State Secretary Klijnsma answered that under the Participatiewet implementation is a municipal responsibility, the municipal council is the proper overseer, no contact with the Rotterdam ombudsman is planned, and the issue is being handled locally.

Given the decentralisation of responsibilities under the Participatiewet, it is for the municipality to decide how it shapes its policy on the Participatiewet, labour market reintegration and the counter-performance.

Gezien de decentralisatie van verantwoordelijkheden in de Participatiewet is het aan de gemeente om te bepalen op welke wijze zij hun beleid met betrekking tot de Participatiewet en daarmee de arbeidstoeleiding van werkzoekenden en de tegenprestatie willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Terreurverdachte gepakt in Limburg’

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about reports of a terror suspect arrested in Limburg, whether terror suspects should be kept out of the Netherlands, whether this should be treated as a security warning, and whether the Netherlands should leave Schengen and reintroduce border controls. The government confirmed the arrest, said suspects can be arrested, prosecuted or extradited, noted the threat requires vigilance, and rejected leaving Schengen while defending its policy of preventing departures of foreign terrorist fighters.

The Cabinet is of the view that persons about whom there is a well-founded suspicion that they will travel to Syria and Iraq with the intention of joining a terrorist organisation must be prevented from departing.

Het Kabinet is van mening dat personen ten aanzien waarvan het gegronde vermoeden bestaat dat zij naar Syrië en Irak zullen uitreizen met de intentie om zich aan te sluiten bij een terroristische organisatie, het uitreizen moet worden verhinderd.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Omstreden haatsjeik donderdag naar Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a cleric calling for throat-cutting and skull-smashing should receive or keep a visa, and whether the Al Fourqaan mosque should be closed for hosting him. The government answered that Italy issued and then withdrew the visa so the speaker may not stay in the Netherlands, and that closing a building is only possible for building-safety violations, drug trade, or if the organisation's aims breach public order, while criminal incitement is prosecuted by the Public Prosecution Service.
This speaker therefore may not reside in the Netherlands.
Deze spreker mag dan ook niet in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bezoek van weer een haatsjeik, ditmaal aan een moskee in Helmond

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether a preacher who allegedly called for violence against Jews, Christians and Shiites should be allowed to speak at a Helmond mosque and whether his visa and the mosque should be blocked. The government answered that free speech is limited when incitement to hatred or violence threatens public order, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hatred, and that after local consultation the mosque cancelled the invitation.
By refusing visas to preachers from visa-requiring countries who call for hatred and violence, the government seeks to temper polarisation and radicalisation.
Door middel van het weigeren van visa aan predikers uit visumplichtige landen, die oproepen tot haat en geweld, tracht de overheid polarisering en radicalisering te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over de berichtgeving inzake het verhinderen van de arrestatie van Desi Bouterse door toenmalig minister Van Mierlo

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether the blocking of Desi Bouterse's arrest in 1997 relates to Dutch involvement in the 1980 February coup and to a state-secret classification of Suriname files, and whether that classification should be lifted. The government denies any known link, says it aims for maximum openness balanced against third-party interests, and notes that the Tweede Kamer restricted some 1984 report annexes until 2060.
The cabinet strives for maximum openness.
Het kabinet streeft maximale openheid na.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de noodkreet van Artikel 1 Overijssel

An MP asked ministers whether anti-discrimination services (ADVs) in other municipalities are at risk due to budget cuts, whether all 393 municipalities ensure their ADV has adequate resources, and why municipal ADVs are hard to find on websites. The minister acknowledged some municipalities receive less funding and said a 2015 study will examine ADV functioning, while stating that the day-to-day execution is a municipal responsibility and declining to set new binding national rules now.
I do not yet have a more recent inventory of the municipal implementation of the Wga.
Ik beschik nog niet over een recentere inventarisatie van de gemeentelijke uitvoering van de Wga.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over de toegankelijkheid van gemeentelijke websites

MPs Oosenbrug and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a College voor de Rechten van de Mens report finding that few municipal websites meet the accessibility guidelines, and about the effectiveness of the new compliance model. The minister disputes the report's 7% figure as not reflecting his registers, notes progress with 166 municipal sites verified, admits too many bodies remain insufficiently accountable, and commits to new monitoring, supplier convenants and legislation expected mid-2016.
I published this application framework for the web guidelines and the accountability model for governments in 2013.
Ik heb dit toepassingskader voor de webrichtlijnen en het verantwoordingsmodel voor overheden in 2013 gepubliceerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het bericht dat de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties tijdens het Nederlandse EU-voorzitterschap in wil zetten op stedelijke ontwikkeling ten

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the Minister of Interior intends to shift CAP funds toward urban development during the Dutch EU presidency, and questioned the claims about urban green areas and regulation. The minister denied any plan to move CAP budget, pointed to existing EU urban funds (EFRO, ESF) and a planned European Urban Agenda, and did not commit to reconsidering.
The intention is not to take decisions during the Dutch presidency on shifting CAP or other European fund budgets to urban development.
De inzet is niet om tijdens het Nederlands voorzitterschap besluiten te nemen over het verschuiven van budget van het GLB of andere Europese fondsen naar stedelijke ontwikkeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Oosenbrug over de inhuur door gemeenten van externe bureaus op no cure no pay basis voor onderzoek naar uitkeringsfraude

MPs Kerstens and Oosenbrug asked about municipalities hiring external firms on a no-cure-no-pay basis to investigate benefit fraud, including the 'unpaid civil servant' arrangement and the Central Appeals Tribunal ruling. The State Secretary said she lacks data on how widely the practice is used, rejects it, holds that core benefit-investigation tasks cannot be outsourced, and promises a letter to municipalities and possible instructions under article 76 of the Participatiewet.
The implementation practice as addressed in the broadcast is something I reject.
De uitvoeringspraktijk zoals die in de betreffende uitzending aan de orde is gekomen wijs ik af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Roon en Bosma over Cyberdreiging vanuit Iran

Two MPs asked the ministers about a rise in Iranian cyberattacks on the West that exploit Western IT systems, and whether sanctions are failing to prevent Iranian access to such systems. The government answered that Dutch sanctions target Iran's nuclear programme rather than internet services in general, that providers bear responsibility for their customers, and that new cyber-specific sanctions are not currently under consideration.
The cabinet is of the view that the existing sanctions instruments are flexible enough to address cyber threats where desired.
Het kabinet is van mening dat het bestaande sanctie-instrumentarium flexibel genoeg is om desgewenst ook cyberdreigingen te kunnen ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw, Hachchi en Bergkamp over de waarschuwing voor digitale dementie bij decentrale overheden

MPs Schouw, Hachchi and Bergkamp asked the ministers about warnings from local and regional officials that digital records risk being poorly preserved, and whether archive law and powers are sufficient. The government says existing archive law shows no gaps, points to a Ictu baseline study and to strategic information consultation (SIO) as the remedy, and declines to accelerate the AIDO project for lack of resources.
There are indeed no indications that the legal frameworks in archive regulations lead to shortcomings.
Er zijn inderdaad geen indicaties dat de wettelijke kaders in de Archiefregelgeving tot tekortkomingen leiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Veldman en De Caluwé over digitale dossier- en archiefvorming

MPs Veldman and De Caluwé asked the Minister of Interior about a warning letter from local officials on poor digital record-keeping and its consequences for openness of government, and what steps follow. The minister says the warning is taken seriously, points to existing archiving standards, metadata schemas and projects such as AIDO and Archief 2020, and notes that all government documents fall under the Wob regardless of medium.
Every document held by the government in principle falls under the Wob (Freedom of Information Act).
Elk document dat bij de overheid berust, valt in principe onder de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Monasch over de dreigende 'digitale dementie' in het openbaar bestuur

MPs Oosenbrug and Monasch asked whether the government shares mayors' concerns about 'digital dementia' in public administration, meaning the risk that digital records of government action are poorly archived and lost, and what oversight and responsibility exist for archiving at all levels. The minister acknowledged the concern, described archiving initiatives (e-depot, Archief 2020, AIDO) and said provinces oversee municipalities' and water boards' archiving under the Gemeentewet, while the ministers' responsibility is limited to the legal framework.
The management of digital documents is not arranged in such a way that their findability is guaranteed.
Het beheer van digitale documenten is niet dusdanig geregeld dat de terugvindbaarheid daarvan gegarandeerd is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Arib en Recourt over de roep om een aparte juridische status voor vermisten

MPs Arib and Recourt asked ministers whether a separate legal status for missing persons should be created, given practical and financial problems for relatives who cannot act on behalf of a missing family member. Minister Van der Steur answered that a separate official document would have the same legal effects as a declaration of presumed death and could cause confusion, preferring practical solutions such as protocols, case managers, a central register and existing guardianship arrangements.
I am of the opinion that introducing an official document confirming that someone is missing, alongside the existing declaration of presumed death, is not a good solution.

Ik ben echter van mening dat het invoeren van een officieel document, waarin bevestigd wordt dat iemand is vermist naast de bestaande verklaring van rechtsvermoeden van overlijden geen goede oplossing biedt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

PVV MPs asked why a Belgian sheikh with alleged terrorist links and torture-related convictions was offered a visa for an Utrecht event, and whether the Al Fitrah foundation and its mosque should be dissolved or closed and a blacklist of hate preachers created. The government answered that the sheikh did not attend and held lawful residence in Belgium, that no visa was issued to him, that dissolution or closure is not warranted given free speech limits enforced through criminal law, and that no blacklist exists though an NCTV alert list and Schengen alerts are used.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorgdirecteuren weigeren hulp aan loonsverlaging’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked why the sector association NVZD refuses to cooperate on a ministerial salary-cap regulation (staffel) for healthcare executives under the WNT, and whether the government will act despite this. The minister regrets the NVZD's stance, says consultation continues with the NVTZ and VWS so unilateral action is not needed, and commits to publishing the sector regulation in November 2015.
For that reason, unilateral adjustment of the regulation is not currently on the table.
Om die reden is eenzijdige aanpassing van de regeling op dit moment niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de WNT-staffel voor de sector woningcorporaties

Two MPs asked the government about the WNT pay-cap staffel (salary scale) for housing corporations, including whether talks with Aedes had taken place and whether the staffel would be published by 1 June. The minister answered that the sector bodies had submitted a proposal within the lowered WNT norm and that the Chamber would be informed in June, with formal adoption in November.
For the housing corporations, I expect to be able to give your Chamber and the sector clarity on the staffel for 2016 in June.
Voor wat betreft de woningcorporaties, zal ik uw Kamer en de sector naar verwachting in juni duidelijkheid kunnen bieden over de staffel voor 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Segers over het bericht ‘Gezamenlijke ketenactie tegen arbeidsuitbuiting en mensenhandel’

MPs Van Laar and Segers asked about a joint enforcement action against labour exploitation and trafficking on Bonaire, including how few addresses were checked, why action came only now, victim shelter, and prostitution policy. The minister reported no arrests and no finding of underpayment or exploitation, promised recurring joint checks at least four times a year, and said a revised MoU is expected in June 2015.
Agreements have been made to act jointly at least four times a year, with prostitution being one of the sectors that will regularly be checked.
Er zijn afspraken gemaakt om ten minste vier keer per jaar gezamenlijk op te treden waarbij prostitutie een van de sectoren is die regelmatig zullen worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de voortgang in het gebruik van open data door de Nederlandse overheid

An MP asked the Interior Minister about open data use by government, including broken links on data.overheid.nl, incomplete datasets, and plans to centralise publication and mandate open data. The minister replied that link problems were largely fixed, that centralisation is aimed for but limited by resources, that publication is facilitated rather than mandatory, and promised an inventory of open and closed datasets before summer.
I have agreed with your House to inventory government-wide which data is available, which of it can be actively made available and which will remain closed.
Ik heb met uw Kamer afgesproken om rijksbreed te inventariseren welke data er beschikbaar zijn, welke daarvan actief beschikbaar kunnen worden gesteld en welke daarvan gesloten zullen blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitspraken van het hoofd van de AIVD over Edward Snowden

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the AIVD director-general's remarks calling Snowden's claims 'absolute bullshit', possible AIVD help to the NSA, the 'Nine Eyes' relationship, whether the AIVD isolates Snowden, and why he is not granted asylum. The Minister refused to discuss the AIVD's cooperation with foreign services in public, referred to earlier CTIVD reports finding no systematic unlawful data acquisition, denied any strategy to isolate Snowden, and explained that an asylum request can only be made in person in the Netherlands, so Snowden's request could not be treated as an asylum application.
No public statements can be made about how cooperation between Dutch and foreign services is arranged.
Over de invulling van de samenwerking tussen Nederlandse en buitenlandse diensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht ‘Wel begraven maar nog niet overleden, hoe kan dat?’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether Dutch citizens who die abroad can be registered as deceased in the municipal personal records when no death certificate is available, and how this is handled. The minister answered that registration follows a hierarchy of source documents, that a lesser document can suffice with no doubt about death, that the case was an incident, and that he will raise the issue with the responsible officials.
As stated in the answer to question 3, I regard the event that prompted these questions as an incident.
Zoals vermeld in het antwoord op vraag 3 zie ik de gebeurtenis die aanleiding was voor het stellen van deze vragen als een incident.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over extra administratiekosten door decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether the decentralisations in the social domain cause extra administrative costs of around 100-150 million euros, and what the government will do about standardising information flows. The minister says the figure is a VNG estimate without a substantiated calculation, that a temporary rise was partly foreseen, and points to ongoing work on standards and funding models with gemeenten and care providers.
The figure cited is an estimate by the VNG, based on signals from municipalities and care providers.
Het genoemde bedrag betreft een inschatting van de VNG, op basis van signalen vanuit gemeenten en zorgaanbieders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het verzwijgen van het aantal Syriëgangers door de burgemeester van Amersfoort

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the mayor of Amersfoort withholds the number of Syria travellers and whether a national public register of returned jihadists should be created. The Minister replied that municipalities decide whether and how to publish such figures, that the national approach is in place, and that a public list conflicts with the rule of law.
In line with the division of responsibilities in the Dutch system, it is up to municipalities themselves to decide how to communicate with residents.
Conform de verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling in het Nederlandse stelsel is het verder aan gemeenten zelf om te bepalen op welke wijze te communiceren met de inwoners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de discriminerende uitspraak van de burgemeester van Gilze-Rijen

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the mayor of Gilze-Rijen, who made discriminatory remarks about the Turkish-Dutch community, should be sanctioned or should step down. The minister defended the mayor's crime-fighting role, noted the mayor apologised and that the dialogue was resumed, and saw no reason for intervention, saying the mayor is accountable to the municipal council.
I see no reason for further intervention regarding the mayor's position.
Ik zie geen reden tot een nadere interventie met betrekking tot de positie van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Toorenburg over de uitzending van Rambam met de ‘portemonneetest’

A CDA MP asked the Interior Minister whether a TV test showing lost wallets mishandled by municipalities and police undermines trust in local government, whether the lost-and-found registration is adequate, and whether the rules should be changed. The minister acknowledged registration is not always well run, pointed to disciplinary action taken in Ede and by the police, but said the Civil Code rules are adequate and no legal amendment is needed, while raising the issue with the police and the VNG.
Where it becomes clear that this does not happen, action should be taken.
Daar waar duidelijk wordt dat dit niet gebeurt, dient dan ook actie te worden ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de televisieuitzending over de ‘portemonneetest’

Rep. Krol asked the Interior and Justice ministers how the government views a TV test in which wallets handed in to police or municipal offices went missing, with 640 euros gone from five of them. The minister said the government expects careful conduct, reports that a municipal employee was dismissed and a police investigation is ongoing, but declined to commission nationwide research, saying municipalities are responsible for their own operations.
It is therefore up to the council to judge how the task is carried out in its own municipality.
Het is derhalve aan de raad om een oordeel te vellen over de wijze waarop in de eigen gemeente uitvoering wordt gegeven aan deze taak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Helvert over het bericht ‘Limburgse gemeenten in de fout met bewaren agenda’s

MPs Van Toorenburg and Van Helvert asked the minister about reports that most Limburg municipalities delete wethouders' digital agendas when they leave office, contrary to the seven-year Archiefwet term. The minister did not dispute the findings, said there is no systematic oversight of municipal compliance, and pointed to digital archiving programmes and a letter sent to the VNG.
The ministry keeps no systematic records of how sub-national governments carry out their tasks, and therefore also not of how municipalities comply with the Archives Act requirements.
Het ministerie houdt geen systematische administratie bij van de naleving van taken door medeoverheden en derhalve ook niet van de wijze waarop gemeenten de voorschriften van de Archiefwet naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over de toegang van Nederlanders in het buitenland tot DigiD

An MP asked the Interior Minister why DigiD access for Dutch citizens abroad remains limited to few municipalities and why the Antwerp consulate pilot was stopped, and whether consultations and evaluations took place. The minister replied that the pilot was redesigned, will end on 31 May 2015 and become regular service, municipalities and selected embassies will be added in phases, and agreed that access to DigiD for citizens abroad should be facilitated.

The new process provides for a digital application (integrated in the website www.digid.nl) and a one-time visit to a participating issuing desk where the identity of the Dutch non-resident is checked and verified.

Het nieuwe proces voorziet in een digitale aanvraag (geïntegreerd in de website www.digid.nl ) en een eenmalig bezoek aan een deelnemende uitgiftebalie waarbij de identiteit van de Nederlandse niet-ingezetene wordt gecontroleerd en vastgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een verbod op het doorgeven van nog geldige parkeerkaarten

An MP asked the government about a court ruling that transferring a still-valid paid parking ticket is not allowed, whether this should be changed, and whether parking tariff increases should be capped. The minister replied that parking tax is a per-vehicle fiscal obligation under the Gemeentewet, that a printed ticket is only proof of payment, that no change is planned, and that municipalities set their own tariffs so no cap is needed.
This is a consequence of the fact that parking tax and the supplementary assessment fall under fiscal legislation.
Dit is het gevolg van het feit dat parkeerbelasting en de naheffingsaanslag onder de fiscale wetgeving vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Visser over het bericht ‘Doorgegeven parkeerkaartje ongeldig.’

An MP asked whether fining drivers who passed on a parking ticket is fair, and whether enforcement is consistent across municipalities after a Gelderland court ruling. The minister answered that passing on a ticket is not valid payment of parking tax, that the ruling only applies to this case, and that such misuse is not normally detectable.
Passing on a parking ticket can never lead to paying that parking tax; it is merely a proof of payment.
Het doorgeven van een parkeerkaartje kan nimmer leiden tot het voldoen van die parkeerbelasting, het is slechts een betaalbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de kosten voor promotiecampagnes van de waterschappen

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister why water boards spend very different amounts on promotional campaigns for their elections, whether the national government steers this, which budget lines fund it, and whether such campaigns are worth the roughly 4 million euros spent. The minister answered that each water board decides its own campaign and budget under its autonomous powers, that the costs come from a separately approved elections budget line, and that the effects are not yet known pending an evaluation.
The national government does not steer this, given the water boards' autonomous powers of regulation and administration.
De landelijke overheid voert hier geen regie op gelet op de autonome bevoegdheid van de waterschappen tot regeling en bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de megamoskee in Gouda

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a Gouda mega-mosque: a reported refusal to host a crèche due to women, the planned layout, foreign financing, and whether democratic local decision-making is being bypassed. The government answered that the layout plan keeps the school and daycare on site, that foreign financing was checked (0.05% from other Schengen countries), that property decisions are a local responsibility, and that foreign financing of places of worship is not to be banned in principle.
This is and remains a local responsibility.
Dit is en blijft een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘IS ziet immigrant als wapen’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that IS sees migrants as a weapon, and possible jihadist infiltration via the Libya-Italy route, mean a security emergency at the borders, and whether the government can guarantee no terrorists will arrive. The government answered that it is alert to signals of misuse of the refugee flow, describes existing reporting structures, awareness efforts and coordination bodies, but does not guarantee that no terrorists will arrive.
The Netherlands and the EU, including the implementing organisations, are alert to signals that ISIS or other jihadist organisations are misusing the refugee flow to reach the Netherlands or Europe.
Nederland en de EU, inclusief de uitvoeringsorganisaties, zijn alert op signalen van misbruik van de vluchtelingenstroom door ISIS of andere jihadistische organisaties naar Nederland of Europa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Zorginstelling betaalt 3 ton voor interimmer’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether a care institution's interim director, placed via agency Boer&Croon, was paid above the WNT pay cap by signing a contract in December 2012 before the law took effect. The minister confirmed the pay exceeded the norm but said transitional law applies, so no recovery is possible, and that the CIBG has looked into the case.
There is an excess over the maximum pay norm of the WNT, but because the pay was agreed before the law entered into force, it falls under transitional law.
Er is sprake van een overschrijding van de maximum bezoldigingsnorm van de WNT, maar omdat de bezoldiging voor de inwerkingtreding van de wet is overeengekomen, valt deze onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Van Toorenburg over de afschaffing van de opbrengsten van de proces verbaal-vergoeding voor gemeenten

CDA MPs asked whether the WODC study on abolishing the proces-verbaal fee for municipalities will examine effects on neighbourhood liveability, police workload, BOA dismissals, municipal budgets and use of administrative fines. The minister answered that the study focuses on registration and spending of the fees rather than direct effects, that no signals of BOA dismissals or budget cuts have been found, and that no VNG inventory is needed for now.
The short time elapsed since the abolition of the fee scheme, as well as the period made available for the study, currently make it impossible to map the effects of the abolition.

De korte tijd die is verstreken sinds de afschaffing van de vergoedingsregeling, alsmede de voor het onderzoek beschikbaar gestelde periode, maken het op dit moment niet mogelijk de effecten van de afschaffing in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van Toorenburg over hogere rentepercentages bij gemeentelijke samenwerkingsverbanden ten opzichte van rentepercentages bij individuele gemeenten

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the reported finding that municipal joint arrangements pay higher interest rates than individual municipalities warrants measures. The minister saw no reason for measures, noting the difference is small (4%), and said he would raise the matter in updated treasury guidance.
I see no reason to take measures now.
Ik zie geen reden om nu maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat het aantal instromende discriminatiezaken bij het OM op het laagst gemeten aantal is

Two D66 MPs asked why reported discrimination cases reaching the Public Prosecution Service fell to a record low despite thousands of police reports, and whether police and prosecutors are adequately resourced. The minister explains the gap through registration differences and lack of perpetrator indicators, says capacity is sufficient, and promises a broader report from 2016 while declining to publish the current figures report now.
No. The discrimination figures of the Public Prosecution Service have already been made public with the sending of the progress letter on discrimination.
Nee. De discriminatiecijfers van het OM zijn reeds bekend gemaakt met de toezending van de Voortgangsbrief discriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belangenverstrengeling in verband met de megamoskee in Gouda

An MP asked whether two PvdA council members' ties to the Gouda megamosque (fundraising, a school directorship, a board member brother) amount to conflict of interest, and whether an inquiry should be requested. The minister replied that council members may choose their own contacts, that the Gemeentewet's rules were not breached, and that any inquiry is a matter for the Gouda municipal executive.
The question of whether it is necessary to launch an inquiry into the case outlined lies with the Gouda municipal executive.
De vraag of het al dan niet noodzakelijk is om een onderzoek in te stellen naar de geschetste casus ligt bij het gemeentebestuur van Gouda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over foto's van Shabir Burhani waarop hij met wapens poseert

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers how the state acts against radicalised people photographed with weapons, including Shabir Burhani, and whether training with the Taliban and a statement endorsing the Charlie Hebdo attack constitute a threat. The Justice Minister declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to general criminal provisions and the Integrated Jihadism Action Programme, and said whether the statement is a threat is for the courts to decide.
As stated, I cannot make any statements about investigations into individual cases.
Zoals gemeld kan ik over onderzoek naar individuele zaken geen uitlatingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de nauwe banden op Curaçao tussen het bestuur en de (illegale) gokindustrie

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about close ties on Curaçao between the government and the illegal gambling industry, including criminal investigations, party funding and KPMG's role with the state telecom firm, and about the government's responsibility. The minister answered that law enforcement, including supervision of gambling, is an autonomous matter of Curaçao and that Curaçao's prosecution priorities show it takes responsibility, without addressing the specific questions.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het bericht over valse inschrijvingen in de Basisregistratie Personen

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked whether false registrations in the Basisregistratie Personen were used to obtain a citizen service number or Dutch driving licences, how many cases and municipalities were involved, and what measures would block this. Minister Plasterk answered that six municipalities suspect about 125 improper registrations, that no benefits were claimed in those cases, and that municipalities will now run address checks when foreign licences are exchanged for Dutch ones.

I will ask all municipalities to always carry out an address investigation if someone applies, within four weeks of registration in the BRP, to exchange a still-valid foreign driving licence for a Dutch one.

In aanvulling hierop zal ik alle gemeenten vragen om altijd alsnog een adresonderzoek in te stellen als iemand binnen vier weken na inschrijving in de BRP een aanvraag doet voor de omwisseling van een nog geldig buitenlands rijbewijs naar een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over de ANBI-status van Stichting Rohamaa

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why the ANBI status of Stichting Rohamaa was granted, whether it complies with transparency rules and international law, and whether it should be revoked and the ANBI list cleaned up. The government answered that the status was granted in 2011 under neutral criteria, declined to discuss the specific case citing legal confidentiality, said status can be revoked if an entity no longer serves the general interest, and stated the Tax Administration conducts risk-based supervision of about 65,000 ANBIs.
I cannot make any statements about the specific aspects of granting the ANBI status to Stichting Rohomaa on the basis of the statutory duty of confidentiality.
Over de specifieke aspecten van het verlenen van de ANBI-status aan Stichting Rohomaa kan ik geen mededelingen doen op grond van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat door een solidariteitsheffing de belastingen voor middeninkomens worden verhoogd

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether it is unjust that middle-income earners pay a solidarity levy to fund water board tax exemptions for people on low incomes, and whether water boards should be abolished. The government answered that water board costs, including exemptions, are shared by all taxpayers, that exemption policy is a Rijk responsibility, and that efficiency targets are on track, but it did not answer the question on abolishing the water boards.
So it is not the case that the exemption costs are borne by one particular category or by a particular group of persons within a category.
Het is dus niet zo dat de kwijtscheldingskosten door één bepaalde categorie of door een bepaalde groep personen binnen een categorie worden opgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Linde, Neppérus en Van Oosten over het bericht dat de gemeenten de macronorm voor OZB-stijging weer overschrijden

MPs Van der Linde, Neppérus and Van Oosten asked whether municipalities again exceed the 3% macro norm on OZB property tax increases and how this can be prevented. Minister Plasterk answered that the figures are not yet confirmed (COELO data due end March), that the norm was exceeded in four of the past seven years with limited cumulative effect, and that the matter is a shared municipal responsibility discussed in the annual Bofv consultation without committing to new measures.
Whether or not the macro norm is exceeded is a responsibility of the municipalities together.
Het al of niet overschrijden van de macronorm is een verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenten tezamen.

Vragen van het lid Oosenbrug (PvdA) aan de Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en de Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht dat de overheid gegevens van miljoenen burgers aan de Mormonen h

An MP asked the Justice and Education ministers about reports that the government gave Mormon church FamilySearch copies of millions of Dutch civil records, raising privacy, legal liability, recovery of data and the Church's ongoing custody. The Interior Minister's follow-up reports a 2015 agreement with FamilySearch and the CBG restricting access to the filmed records, with penalties and a no-transfer clause, which he considers a durable solution.
Nevertheless, I did pursue agreements, by means of an agreement with FamilySearch and the CBG, on restricting access to these personal data.
Desalniettemin heb ik toch ingezet op het maken van afspraken door middel van een overeenkomst met FamilySearch en het CBG over de beperking van de toegang tot deze persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het rapport ‘Tackling intolerance and discrimination in Europe with a special focus on Christians’

An SGP MP asked the government about a Council of Europe report on intolerance and discrimination against Christians and whether it accepts the report's findings and the concept of reasonable accommodation. The government rejects the picture of rising anti-Christian intolerance for the Netherlands, says it is committed to combating discrimination on any ground, and notes that reasonable accommodation is mainly used for disability rights.

The cabinet assumes that the national delegations to the Parliamentary Assembly of the other Council of Europe member states will themselves bring this report, and its conclusions and recommendations, to the attention of their governments.

Het kabinet gaat ervan uit dat de nationale delegaties naar de Parlementaire Assemblee van de overige lidstaten van de Raad van Europa dit rapport, en de conclusies en aanbevelingen daaruit, zelf onder de aandacht van hun regeringen zullen brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van Toorenburg over het maken van pasfoto’s op gemeentehuizen
