MPs Bisschop and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities offering passport photos at town halls, such as Amsterdam, conflicts with earlier assurances and the Knops motion, and whether this is a municipal task and unfair competition with the photo trade. Minister Plasterk answered that it is not prohibited, that municipalities are not making passport photos themselves but are responsible for photo quality via the fotomatrix, and that he sees no reason to discuss it with municipalities, though his ministry is examining how to improve photo quality.
I therefore see no reason to enter into discussion with municipalities about this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden hierover in gesprek met gemeenten te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht ‘De vulkaan van Saba kan bezig zijn te ontwaken’

An MP asked the government about the risk of a volcanic eruption on Saba, the state of its seismograph monitoring, which ministry is responsible for safety there, and how evacuation and emergency response are organised. The Minister answered at length, explaining the monitoring setup, the legal responsibilities under the Veiligheidswet BES, the emergency protocols and exercises, and that new seismographs and GPS equipment will be installed.
Measures will be taken to increase the availability of the measurement data.
Maatregelen zullen genomen worden om de beschikbaarheid van de meetgegevens te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hulp stelt DNA-bank enigszins teleur’

An MP asks whether about half of Dutch municipalities failed to respond to the Landelijk Bureau Vermiste Personen's requests to identify where unknown dead are buried, and why, and what will be done. The minister confirms the non-response, attributes it largely to unfamiliarity and incomplete records, and says he will consider with the VNG how to improve municipal cooperation.
Yes, given the great importance of identifying missing persons, I want to examine together with the VNG how municipal cooperation can be further encouraged.
Ja, gelet op het grote belang van identificatie van vermiste personen wil ik samen met de VNG bezien hoe de medewerking door gemeenten nog verder bevorderd kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inhuur van externe voorzitters door de gemeente Dordrecht

An SP MP asked why Dordrecht hired external 'gespreksleiders' to chair council committee meetings, what they cost, and whether the minister would reverse the decision as contrary to the law. The minister agreed the arrangement is de facto chairing contrary to the spirit of the law, said the municipality must comply, and reported he had already asked the council to bring the arrangement in line with the law after receiving a request for annulment.

I have already received a request for annulment from several council members (factions) in Dordrecht. In response, I have written to the municipal council requesting that the arrangement for chairing the council committees be brought into line with the law.

Ik heb reeds een verzoek om vernietiging ontvangen, afkomstig van enkele raadsleden (fracties) uit Dordrecht. In reactie daarop heb ik de gemeenteraad aangeschreven met het verzoek de invulling van het voorzitterschap van de raadscommissies in overeenstemming met de wet te brengen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Omtzigt, Bontes, Van Bommel, De Roon, Van Ojik en Voordewind over het vermeende ongemak van politie en Openbaar Ministerie over de rol van de AIVD bij het onderzoek naar de ramp

MPs asked whether the AIVD is obstructing the MH17 investigation by withholding information from police and prosecutors, and whether ministers have signals of friction and will meet the organisations. The ministers reject the claim, say cooperation is good, report frequent ministerial and ministerial-commission contact, and decline further talks as unnecessary.
In response to the report "AIVD frustrates MH17 investigation", the cabinet strongly denies that the AIVD is withholding information in the investigation into the MH17 air disaster.
In reactie op het bericht «AIVD frustreert MH17-onderzoek» weerspreekt het kabinet met klem dat in het onderzoek naar de vliegramp met de MH17 door de AIVD informatie wordt achtergehouden.

Vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis (beiden PvdA) de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en de Staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «burgemeester «geeft» Omroep W

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked whether regional broadcaster Omroep West paid its director a bonus of about 13,844 euro, whether this was lawful under the WNT pay-cap law, and whether the government would investigate similar practices elsewhere. The minister reports that the ministry's supervisory unit found bonuses at four regional broadcasters, including Omroep West, that breached the WNT in form but were covered by transitional law, so no enforcement is needed.
At four regional public broadcasters (Omroep West, L1, RTV Rijnmond and RTV Noord), bonus payments were found in 2013.
Bij vier regionale publieke omroepen (Omroep West, L1, RTV Rijnmond en RTV Noord), zijn bonusbetalingen aangetroffen in 2013
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gemeente Dronten, die ‘vergat’ de premies voor de WAO en de WIA af te dragen voor haar personeel

MP Van Raak asked why the municipality of Dronten failed for years to remit mandatory WAO/WIA social premiums for its staff, why internal controls and Belastingdienst supervision did not catch it, and which other municipalities were affected. The minister replied that the matter falls within municipal autonomy and is accounted for to the municipal council, that the error dates from July 2011 and appears to be an isolated human error, and that the Belastingdienst is investigating whether broader action is needed but cannot disclose specifics.
This matter falls within the autonomy and own responsibility of the municipality and its internal bodies.
Deze kwestie behoort tot de autonomie en eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente en haar interne organen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de stelselmatig onzorgvuldige manier van onderzoek doen door BING (Bureau Integriteit Nederlandse Gemeenten)

An MP asked the Interior Minister about alleged careless integrity investigations by the private firm BING, which has been sanctioned by the disciplinary court, and about its monopoly-like position with local governments, compensation, regulation and ex-politicians working there. The minister answered that BING is a private company responsible for its own conduct, that municipalities choose and supervise investigators, that regulation is not warranted, and that the government has instead strengthened client guidance and set up an advisory point, while declining to provide several figures.
I do not have such data. These are matters that concern the local governments themselves.
Ik beschik niet over dergelijke gegevens. Dit zijn aangelegenheden die de lokale overheden zelf betreffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over langdurige onbereikbaarheid van overheidswebsites

An MP asked why rijksoverheid.nl and other government websites were unreachable for hours on 10 February 2015, what caused it, its impact, and what technical measures and actions are planned. The minister answered that a DDoS attack caused the outage, which lasted because the supplier first diagnosed it as a technical fault, and that a supplier improvement plan involving the NCSC is being prepared.
The supplier will draw up an improvement plan, with the Ministry of General Affairs and the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) closely involved.
De leverancier zal een verbeterplan opstellen, waarbij het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken en het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) nauw betrokken zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Rijksoverheid.nl was dupe van DDoS-aanval’

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked whether the government websites rijksoverheid.nl and others were taken offline by a DDoS attack, its motives, whether such sites are critical infrastructure, and how citizens were informed. The minister confirmed the attack, said motives are unknown and a report was filed, said the sites are not critical infrastructure but important for citizens, and described the backup, a planned improvement plan, and information channels used.
A backup facility exists for the affected sites, but it also turned out to be affected.
Voor de getroffen sites bestaat een back-upvoorziening, die echter ook getroffen bleek.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Raak over het pleidooi van de Nederlandse Orde van Advocaten dat er een rechterlijke toets vooraf moet gaan aan het onderscheppen van telefoongesprekken en e-mails tussen

Two SP MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about the Dutch Bar Association's call for prior judicial review before intelligence services may intercept lawyer-client communications, and about the CTIVD finding that the AIVD wrongly processed some such conversations. The minister answered that protections for lawyers are sufficient, that the CTIVD found the AIVD's safeguards adequate, and that no prior judicial review is needed, while refusing to extend a judicial-review requirement from journalists to lawyers.
In view of the above, I see no need to introduce the proposed judicial review in this context.
Gelet op het bovenstaande zie ik geen noodzaak tot het voorgestelde invoeren van een rechterlijke toets in dit kader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het Nedersaksisch

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about recognition of Low Saxon under Part III of the European Charter for Regional Languages, the timing of the Council of Europe visit, and state support for regional languages. The minister said the fifth periodic report will be finalised this spring, that the Council of Europe visit may offer a chance to review Low Saxon's position but he will not pre-judge it, and that talks with SONT on a concrete national contribution will continue.
I do not consider it opportune to make any statements on this in advance of the Council of Europe visit.
Ik acht het niet opportuun om hier vooruitlopend op het bezoek van de Raad van Europa al uitspraken over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeente Dronten vraagt geld voor politiek flyeren’

An MP asked whether the municipality of Dronten may charge fees for political flyering, which its bylaws restrict in certain shopping areas, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister answered that the restriction is a permissible, limited regulation under Article 7 of the Constitution and that the fee is lawful, so no intervention is planned.
In my view, there is therefore no question of an impermissible restriction of freedom of expression.
Naar mijn oordeel is hier dan ook geen sprake van een ontoelaatbare beperking van de uitingsvrijheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Tilburg dreigt zorgbedrijven met topinkomens’

Two MPs asked whether Tilburg will stop subsidising care institutions with staff paid above a minister's salary from 2016, and what central government is doing to support local pay caps. The minister confirmed Tilburg's plan, said the WNT norm of 178,000 euro is decent, and reported an interbureaucratic network with VNG and IPO preparing model approaches due by 1 June 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de nauwe banden op Curaçao tussen het bestuur en de (illegale) gokindustrie

An SP MP asked the Dutch ministers about the scale of legal and illegal gambling on Curaçao, alleged money laundering, weak oversight by the Gaming Control Board and the lottery foundation, possible party financing from the gambling industry, and whether the Kingdom will investigate party financing. The minister answered that gambling oversight and law enforcement are autonomous matters of Curaçao, that the Curaçao Public Prosecution Service handles money laundering suspicions, and that the Duradero project with Curaçao strengthens enforcement capacity.
Supervision of casinos and lotteries is an autonomous matter of the Country of Curaçao.
Toezicht op casino's en loterijen is een autonome aangelegenheid van het Land Curaçao.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over een bijeenkomst in Rijswijk op 8 maart 2015

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the ministers about a planned March 2015 event in Rijswijk featuring preachers linked to extremist views, including visa revocations, whether the organiser's ANBI status could be withdrawn, and the list of speakers. The government answered that visas for three speakers were revoked on public order grounds, that the event was scaled back, and that the tax authority could investigate ANBI status if signals warranted, but gave no commitment to a specific investigation.
Without going into individuals, it can be said that seven preachers had been invited to give lectures on 8 March.
Zonder in te gaan op individuen kan verteld worden dat zeven predikers waren uitgenodigd voor het geven van lezingen op 8 maart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het onderzoeksrapport van Unie KBO ‘Ruim half miljoen senioren verloren voor internet’

An MP asked ministers how they would address the finding that about 600,000 seniors want to learn internet skills and that many seniors will never use the internet, and how offline seniors can keep contact with government. The minister responded that internet access among seniors is improving, pointed to subsidised digital-skills programmes and alternative offline channels, and said digital government services will continue to be developed toward 2017 with a measurement to be reported later this year.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de tot nu toe verstrekte informatie over de omvang en aard van (legale) identiteitswisselingen en mogelijke fraude met reisdocumenten

Three MPs (Omtzigt, Gesthuizen, Schouw) asked the Dutch State Secretary and Minister about the scope and nature of legal identity changes and possible passport/identity fraud, including why Parliament was not informed earlier of NVIK/police signals from 2011 and 2013 and of the April 2014 meetings. The government answered that the signals were operational, not quantified, that duplicate registrations were largely legal name changes or data-entry errors, and that several measures and studies are underway.
It is not customary to inform the Chamber while an investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet gebruikelijk om lopende een onderzoek de Kamer te informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Keijzer over het bericht “Aanvraag bij Wet Langdurige Zorg stagneert, omdat oudere geen paspoort of ID heeft”

An MP asked why residents of care institutions must submit a copy of their passport or ID for Wlz applications from 1 January 2015, whether this delays applications, and how elderly or demented people can apply for identity documents without visiting the town hall or signing. The state secretary explained the statutory identity check, acknowledged the requirement will be amended since a citizen service number suffices, and said municipalities can use mobile equipment and home visits at their discretion.
Article 9.1.1, sixth paragraph of the Wlz will therefore be amended.
Artikel 9.1.1, zesde lid van de Wlz zal daarom worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Europese Commissie grootschalig data van vliegtuigpassagiers wil opslaan

An SP MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports that the European Commission wants to store passenger (PNR) data broadly, raising privacy and proportionality concerns under EU case law. The minister replied that no new Commission proposal has been adopted yet, that the Commission intends to add data protection safeguards, that the Netherlands welcomes stronger fundamental-rights protection, and that the Chamber will be kept informed before any step is taken.
As agreed with the Chamber, we are awaiting the process and will not take any step without informing the Chamber.
Zoals afgesproken met de Kamer wachten wij het proces af en zetten geen stap zonder de Kamer te informeren.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Steur en Van Oosten over het artikel ‘Geheimen mee in het graf’ dat oproept onder omstandigheden DNA-onderzoek te doen na een niet natuurlijke dood en omtrent een landelijk protoco

Two VVD MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether DNA of deceased persons who died unnaturally should be compared with the police DNA database and whether a national autopsy protocol is needed. The minister said such DNA sampling is not generally justified, that sampling from a deceased suspect is limited by article 69 Sr, and that the legal basis will be addressed in the Criminal Procedure Code modernisation, plus a working group on a national protocol.

In setting the rules for taking cell material for DNA research from a deceased suspect or victim, the fundamental right to bodily integrity is currently insufficiently taken into account, and an intrusion on that right must be provided for by or under law.

Bij de normering voor het afnemen van celmateriaal voor DNA-onderzoek bij een overleden verdachte of slachtoffer van een strafbaar feit is op dit moment onvoldoende verdisconteerd dat het grondrecht op de onaantastbaarheid van het lichaam daarbij een rol speelt
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat Nederland totaal niet voorbereid is op een terreuraanval

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the Netherlands is unprepared for a commando-style terrorist attack, whether the police, defence and intelligence services should be heavily funded, whether the Marechaussee should guard sensitive sites, and whether administrative detention, a public jihad register and a ban on return for departed jihadists should be adopted. The Minister rejected the claim of unpreparedness, pointed to extra funding, Marechaussee redeployment and planned exit-ban and citizenship-revocation measures, but declined administrative detention and a public register as unnecessary or incompatible with the rule of law.
The Cabinet is of the view that a public list is not in line with the principles of our rule of law.
Het Kabinet is van mening dat een openbare lijst niet in overeenstemming is met de beginselen van onze rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de geheime dienst van Curaçao

The MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about the acquittal of a former Curaçao security service head, the appointment and vetting of his successor, the theft of VDC data, AIVD information exposure, and whether the CTIVD would investigate. The minister declined to judge court rulings or Curaçao government decisions, neither confirmed nor discussed AIVD cooperation, and said the CTIVD lacks the legal basis, pointing to Curaçao's own oversight commission.
The CTIVD does not have the legal basis necessary to conduct an investigation into the VDC.
De CTIVD beschikt niet over de wettelijke basis die nodig is om onderzoek naar de VDC te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over de waterrekening

MP Klein asked the Minister of Interior about high precarious levies (precarioheffing) on water and energy bills, the government's view on their fairness, and why the promised bill abolishing precario on utility networks has been repeatedly delayed. The minister answered that levies vary by municipality, water companies pass them on only to residents of the levying authority, energy network costs are spread nationally, and that the government intends to inform the House soon, while weighing competing interests and noting that abolition without compensation is undesirable.
Of course I intend to inform your House about this subject as soon as possible, in which I take all interests into account as far as possible.
Uiteraard ben ik voornemens uw Kamer over dit onderwerp zo spoedig mogelijk nader te informeren, waarin ik zoveel mogelijk met alle belangen rekening houd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de uitlatingen van Snowden over Nederland en de NSA

An MP asked why Snowden's asylum request was not processed, how the government views claims that Dutch intelligence services are subordinate to US services, why promised new cooperation criteria with the US have not appeared, and whether intelligence services should cooperate on equal terms. The government answered that asylum cannot be applied for abroad under the Vreemdelingenwet, that the Wiv 2002 and CTIVD oversight govern cooperation, that new criteria are being addressed in a planned Wiv amendment, and that it agrees services should not be a proxy for foreign services.
On the content of those talks we can only inform the House through the appropriate channels.
Over de inhoud van die gesprekken kunnen wij de Tweede Kamer alleen via de daartoe geëigende kanalen informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Oostenrijkse islamwet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Dutch law should restrict foreign funding of mosques and imams, and whether Austria's Islam law elements should be adopted to curb Turkish state influence. The government answered that foreign funding of worship is not to be banned in principle, that Austria's model does not transfer to the Dutch church-state context, and that talks with Turkish authorities on transparency are ongoing.
Banning foreign funding of religious practice as such is not at issue, except where it finances violence or unlawful or criminal practices.

Het als zodanig verbieden van buitenlandse financiering van geloofsuitoefening is niet aan de orde, behalve voor zover er sprake is van financiering van geweldsuitoefening of onrechtmatige dan wel criminele praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de ARGOS-uitzending ‘Ik keer terug!’

An MP asked the government about problems Dutch nationals face returning from abroad with a foreign partner, loss of nationality, and the lack of a one-stop-shop for emigrants. The state secretary acknowledged some IND cases on the income-sustainability requirement, promised to report on talks with expats, refused to drop loss of nationality on voluntary acquisition of another nationality, and said no one-stop-shop exists but pointed to existing web information.
As I promised in the General Consultation with your House on 14 January, I will inform the House of the outcomes of the talks I intend to have with expats
Zoals ik in het Algemeen Overleg met uw Kamer op 14 januari jl. heb toegezegd zal ik de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het gesprek dat ik voornemens ben te hebben met expats
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren van journalisten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dutch journalists or researchers could have been intercepted by British intelligence, how the Dutch procedure for surveillance of journalists works, and whether such surveillance has occurred in the past 25 years. The minister said interception cannot be excluded, that intelligence services do not disclose working methods, and described the legal framework and the pending amendment requiring judicial approval for surveillance aimed at journalistic sources, without giving concrete cases.
Pending the legislative amendment, in practice the government is working in accordance with the ECHR ruling.
In afwachting van de wetswijziging wordt in de praktijk gewerkt in overeenstemming met de uitspraak van het EHRM.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over onderscheppen correspondentie van journalisten door GCHQ

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether Dutch journalists' communications could be intercepted by the UK's GCHQ and whether Dutch services intercept journalists' communications. The minister said journalists' source protection is a basic condition for press freedom, that Dutch services may use special powers against journalists only under strict conditions, and that a law amendment requiring prior judicial authorisation is pending following an ECtHR ruling; he would not rule out that Dutch journalists' emails were intercepted abroad.
No one is excluded from the possible application of special powers.
Van de mogelijke toepassing van bijzondere bevoegdheden is niemand uitgezonderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw over extra maatregelen tegen terreur

The MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (D66) asked the ministers about France's terrorism funding, Dutch security measures after the Paris attacks, intelligence staffing at the AIVD, and cooperation with neighbouring countries. The government answered by referring to its letter to Parliament (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288) on additional counter-terrorism measures, rather than answering the questions directly.

The written questions from MPs Berndsen-Jansen and Schouw (both D66), question number 2015Z01185, have been answered by letter 'additional counter-terrorism measures and following the debate of 14 January 2015 on the Paris attacks' (Parliamentary paper 29 754, no. 288).

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Berndsen-Jansen en Schouw (beiden D66), vraagnummer 2015Z01185 , zijn beantwoord middels brief «extra maatregelen terrorismebestrijding en n.a.v. debat op 14 januari 2015 over de aanslagen in Parijs» (Kamerstuk 29 754, nr. 288 ).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de voortgaande misstanden bij moskee-internaten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether three Rotterdam mosque boarding schools still fail national quality standards, whether other schools comply, and whether they should be closed. The minister said the Rotterdam schools do not yet meet all standards but are working on improvement, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement, closure is not justified, and a bill giving municipalities supervision powers has been submitted.
It is primarily the responsibility of municipalities to assess whether individual boarding schools meet the required standards.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te beoordelen of individuele internaten voldoen aan de gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Zorgbestuurder vangt twee ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about a report that a mental-health care board member received about 200,000 euros for one month of work in 2013, and how this fits the WNT pay-cap law. The minister disputes the figure, states the total remuneration was 181,722 euros, explains the former top official was not subject to the 2013 cap beyond January, and says the interim-norm decree will come in mid-2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Gemeenten koersen af op miljardentekort’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a COELO forecast that municipalities face a large deficit by 2018 driven by decentralised social-domain tasks, and whether cuts and reserve use would follow. The Minister rejected the deficit projection, said municipalities have sufficient budgets and discretion, and pointed to existing financial indicators and monitoring, while leaving local tax expansion for a separate study.
I have every confidence that municipalities will make the right choices regarding their local circumstances.
Ik heb er het volste vertrouwen in dat gemeenten de juiste keuzes maken met betrekking tot hun plaatselijke omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Polderjihadisten ‘oer-Nederlands’

An MP asked the government whether the AIVD has enough funding and capacity to handle returning jihadists, why it was reportedly overwhelmed, and how border controls on departing youths can be improved. The government replied that the AIVD is adequately resourced with extra funding for research capacity, that the surge in travelers was foreseen rather than unexpected, and it outlined existing passport-signalling and EU information-sharing measures.
There was no question of being overwhelmed.
Er was geen sprake van overrompeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Oosenbrug over het artikel ‘Beveiligingslek banken maakte phishing mogelijk’

MPs Nijboer and Oosenbrug asked whether a web security flaw in major Dutch banks enabling phishing was known, whether victims would be fully compensated, and whether banks invest enough and share vulnerabilities. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that banks follow a responsible disclosure policy, that DNB has tightened IT-risk requirements, that banks say they know of no attacks exploiting the flaw, and that liability for victims applies unless gross negligence is involved.
Given the development of cyber threats, DNB has tightened the requirements it imposes on supervised institutions regarding the analysis and control of IT risks from this year onward.
Gezien de ontwikkeling van cyberdreigingen heeft DNB de eisen die zij stelt aan onder toezicht staande instellingen wat betreft de analyse en beheersing van IT-risico's vanaf dit jaar verzwaard.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Hoogland over voortdurende agressie tegen NS-personeel

Two MPs asked the government about persistent aggression against NS rail staff, including survey figures, prosecution rates and measures taken. The minister acknowledged the problem, gave differing incident figures, said police and prosecutors do not register NS-specific cases, and listed existing and planned measures.
In the judicial systems, aggression and violence against NS staff are not registered separately; they fall under the category of qualified victims.
In de justitiële systemen wordt agressie en geweld tegen NS-personeel niet apart geregistreerd, zij vallen onder de categorie gekwalificeerde slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de zaak Spijkers

An MP asks ministers about the Spijkers settlement, including whether medical records were ordered destroyed without the claimant's explicit consent, who may access the archived file, and whether it was improperly kept secret. The government denies any destruction decision was taken, states the digital record was deleted by the former occupational health provider with a destruction statement, says the file was transferred to the National Archives under access rules, and refuses to open the full file to the Chamber or researchers on the grounds set out in earlier letters.
Otherwise a check of what was transferred would not have been possible.
Een controle van hetgeen werd overgedragen was anders niet mogelijk geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkhoff en Tellegen over het bericht ‘Sabotage Belgische kerncentrale Doel mogelijk terreurdaad’

Two VVD MPs asked the government whether the reported sabotage of the Belgian Doel nuclear plant was a possible terrorist act, how it assesses security near the Dutch border, whether it has contacted Belgian counterparts, and whether Dutch nuclear plants need a security review. The minister answered that cooperation with Belgium is intensive and that Dutch nuclear installations meet existing rules, declined to disclose intelligence-level information, and saw no need for a new review.
I do not make public statements about the knowledge level of the Dutch security services.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen mededelingen over het kennisniveau van de Nederlandse veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Monasch over de salarissen van bestuurders van woningcorporaties

MPs Kerstens and Monasch asked the government about housing corporation executive salaries exceeding WNT norms, salary increases in 2013, transitional rules, and whether bonuses were paid unlawfully. The Minister answered that 44 of 728 top officials exceeded the 2013 norm, that the 2013 regulation was set aside so some pay rises were lawful under transitional rules, that no unlawful bonuses are known, and that the government will not interfere with transitional rights but welcomes voluntary restraint.
I have received no information showing that there are unlawful bonuses.
Mij heeft geen informatie bereikt waaruit blijkt dat er sprake is van onrechtmatige bonussen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Omtzigt over fraude door middel van legale naamwisselingen

MPs Gesthuizen and Omtzigt asked the ministers how the government responded to RTL reports on fraud through legal name changes, which signals from abroad and the police it received, whether the Matching Autoriteit was consulted, and whether databases should be cross-matched. The government answered that no overview of signals is kept, that operational services act on signals as needed, that no separate report was required on the police signal, and that after investigation no evidence of fraud through double registration was found, so no further cross-matching is planned.
No overview is kept of all signals exchanged in the course of regular operational work.
Er wordt geen overzicht bijgehouden van alle signalen die in het kader van de reguliere taakuitvoering worden uitgewisseld.

Vragen van het lid Gesthuizen (SP) aan de Ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Financiën over banken die hun cliënten dwingen niet-geoormerkte kopieën van hun identit

An MP asks ministers whether banks may require clients to hand over unmarked copies of identity documents and retain them, and whether this conflicts with government advice to mark copies with purpose and date. The ministry only sends an interim notice that the answers are not yet available and will follow by end of January.
Unfortunately, not all information is yet available to answer the questions posed carefully.
Helaas is thans nog niet alle informatie beschikbaar om de gestelde vragen zorgvuldig te kunnen beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over het bericht “Burgemeester 'geeft' Omroep West-baas bonus”

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about reports that a mayor approved a 13,844 euro bonus for the director of regional broadcaster Omroep West, which may breach the WNT pay-cap law, and about related questions on the L1 case, oversight and subsidy conditions. The minister says the Commissariaat voor de Media found the bonus was paid, that a fuller WNT compliance investigation is underway with results expected within six weeks, that bonuses are generally barred under the WNT, and that proactive checks at other regional broadcasters will follow.
It is expected that the entire investigation can be completed within six weeks.
Naar verwachting kan het hele onderzoek binnen zes weken worden afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat gemeentelijk dualisme in Vianen doorbroken wordt

An MP asked whether it is undesirable under dualism for a councillor to attend municipal executive (college) meetings in Vianen, and whether the minister would intervene. The minister agreed it is inherent in the dualist system that councillors do not attend college meetings, noted no other municipalities use this, and said the mayor is seeking a solution in dialogue with the council, province and ministry.

Under the letter of the law a councillor could perhaps participate, but it is inherent in the dualist system, which is based on a separation of functions and powers, that councillors do not take part in college meetings.

Naar de letter van de wet zou wellicht een raadslid kunnen deelnemen, maar het is inherent aan het dualistisch stelsel, dat uitgaat van een scheiding van functies en bevoegdheden, dat raadsleden niet deelnemen aan de vergaderingen van het college.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht “Dualisme in Vianen in het geding”

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior whether a Vianen party lacking an alderman may have its faction leader structurally attend college meetings, and what tools exist if municipalities deviate from the dualist model. The Minister said the Gemeentewet reserves such attendance mainly for officials and experts, that council members attending would undermine dualism, that he would first address the mayor, and that inter-governmental supervision is the last resort.
If council members were to attend college meetings, whether structurally or not, this would fundamentally undermine the dualist system.
Indien raadsleden al dan niet structureel zouden deelnemen aan de vergaderingen van het college, zou dit op een principieel punt afbreuk doen aan het dualistisch stelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het bericht dat een Nederlandse columnist met de dood bedreigt wordt

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about reports that a Dutch columnist was threatened with death and what protective measures and knowledge of the threatener existed. Minister Opstelten said he is deeply concerned and had contacted journalists and columnists after the Paris attack, but declined to disclose protective measures or whether the threatener is known to police, citing ongoing investigation.
While the investigation is ongoing, I will not make any statements on this.
Lopende het onderzoek doe ik hier geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over mogelijke vertraging rondom de inwerkingtreding van de nieuwe Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen publieke en semipublieke sector

MP Kerstens asks the Minister of Interior whether the delayed entry into force of the new WNT salary cap for top officials will let executives raise salaries before the cap applies, and what measures will prevent this. The government answers only by referring to a separate letter on the Wet verlaging bezoldigingsmaximum WNT, with no substantive answer in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de nieuwe transparantieregels van de Commissie

Two Labour MPs asked the Foreign and Interior Ministers about the European Commission's new rules requiring Commissioners and senior staff to publicly report meetings with lobbyists, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister supported the Commission's rules, said the Netherlands pushes for Council participation in the transparency register, and said Dutch ministers and officials are bound by integrity rules with consultation reported in explanatory memoranda, promising to further strengthen transparency of the legislative process.

The Cabinet encourages the growing use of internetconsultatie.nl and is examining how the visibility and predictability of the legislative process and the accountability for it can be further strengthened.

Het Kabinet stimuleert de groeiende inzet van internetconsultatie.nl en beziet op welke wijze de kenbaarheid en de voorspelbaarheid van het wetgevingsproces en de verantwoording daarover verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het hoofdkwartier van Hamas in Turkije

CDA MP Knops asked the ministers whether Turkey hosts a Hamas headquarters from which attacks on Israel are organised and whether the Netherlands will press Turkey, the EU or NATO on this. The government could not confirm the reports, saw no need for an independent investigation, declined to put the matter on the NATO ministerial agenda, and said it is critical of Turkey where necessary.
The cabinet cannot confirm this reporting.
Het kabinet kan deze berichtgeving niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over de houdgreep waarin makers van closed source software gemeenten houden

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the municipality of Arnhem was forced by a software vendor to pay 600,000 euros for licences as a fine for past unlicensed use, creating lock-in that deters open source migration. The minister answered that no fine was imposed; the cost arose from unbudgeted home-workstation licences and higher replacement costs, and that municipalities bear their own procurement responsibility while government promotes open standards.
There is no question of a fine having been imposed.
Er is geen sprake van een boete die zou zijn opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over uitlevering van personen aan landen met de doodstraf

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked whether extradition to Texas, a death-penalty state, was approved for a murder suspect and how extradition to death-penalty countries is handled. The government answered that Texas gave a guarantee via the US federal Justice Department that the death penalty would not be imposed, that the suspect was examined in person by a forensic psychiatrist, that Dutch law requires an unambiguous guarantee against the death penalty, and that it sees no conflict with ECHR Article 3.
Extradition to the United States is permitted after the authorities of the state of Texas guaranteed that the death penalty will not be imposed in this case.
De uitlevering aan de Verenigde Staten (VS) is toegestaan nadat de autoriteiten van de staat Texas hebben gegarandeerd dat het opleggen van de doodstraf in deze zaak niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over de richtlijn aangaande registratie van het geboorteland van in Palestina geboren personen

MPs Van Bommel and Sjoerdsma asked why the civil registry directive records people born in East Jerusalem and the Gaza Strip or West Bank after 14 May 1948 as birthplace 'Onbekend' rather than Palestine, and whether this causes problems. The Minister replied that the Palestine mandate ended on 14 May 1948, the territories are treated as occupied under international law, and the Netherlands has not recognised a Palestinian state, while acknowledging no problems are known and that other EU states use different practices.
For that reason, the birthplace 'Unknown' was chosen.
Om die reden is gekozen voor geboorteland «Onbekend».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over winterse illegalenopvang in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Amsterdam's winter night shelter for rejected asylum seekers rewards illegal residence, whether the state should cut the municipality's fund, and how the government will enforce return. The State Secretary answered that only rejected asylum seekers qualify for a basic night shelter, that the government will not compensate or cut municipal funds, and that it will stress return in dialogue with municipalities and use detention where removal is feasible.
In my discussions with the municipality of Amsterdam I will continue to emphasise the importance of return.
Ik zal in mijn gesprekken met de gemeente Amsterdam het belang van terugkeer blijven onderstrepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het stopzetten van een project voor sociale huurwoningen op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked whether the minister shares enthusiasm for housing corporation Woonlinie's social rental projects on Saba and Sint Eustatius, why the Statia island government withdrew from agreements, and whether discrimination, fraud or cronyism should be investigated. The minister praised Woonlinie's commitment, explained that the Statia island executive unilaterally put the agreed renovation and reorganisation cooperation on hold, and said the Eilandsraad is primarily responsible for questioning the executive, without announcing an investigation.
In the first instance, it is up to the Island Council to question the Sint Eustatius executive about the motives for its conduct.
Het is in eerste instantie aan de Eilandsraad om het bestuur van Sint Eustatius te bevragen op de motieven voor zijn handelwijze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over gebrekkige controle door gemeentelijke rekenkamers

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior about municipal audit offices (rekenkamers) being under-resourced or dormant, and whether this undermines council oversight amid decentralisation. The Minister confirmed the concern, said 26 municipalities have dormant audit offices, promised an enquiry into budget cuts and a proposal to improve the position of audit offices, and committed to report before the summer recess.
As I reported in answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Fokke, I intend to come forward with proposals on how the position and functioning of audit offices can be improved.
Zoals ik in antwoord op Kamervragen van het lid-Fokke heb gemeld, ben ik voornemens om met voorstellen te komen over hoe de positie en het functioneren van rekenkamers kan worden verbeterd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het ontslag van een leerkracht vanwege de wisseling naar een ander kerkgenootschap

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether a teacher may be dismissed for switching church affiliation despite respecting the school's founding principles, who granted any dismissal permit, and whether this ground is compatible with the proposed bill on the single-fact construction. The minister answered that the Netherlands Institute for Human Rights found no prohibited discrimination, no dismissal permit was required under the BBA, and that the proposed bill would still permit such religious-based distinctions for religious schools.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Taverne en Van Oosten over een nieuwe vorm van paspoort-fraude gepleegd door Oost-Europeanen

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a newly discovered form of passport fraud by Eastern Europeans, including its mechanics, scale, damage, when the government learned of the police report, and measures taken. The government referred to its separate letter on the report on legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe, which is the answer to these questions.

The written questions from MPs Taverne and Van Oosten (both VVD), question number 2014Z19791, have been answered by means of the letter 'Response to the report legal identity changes in the Balkans and Eastern Europe'.

Mededeling De schriftelijke vragen de leden Taverne en Van Oosten (beiden VVD), vraagnummer 2014Z19791 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op het rapport «legale identiteitswisselingen in de Balkan en Oost-Europa»» (Kamerstuk 17 050, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over het aantal jihadisten

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD chief's figure of a few hundred jihadist participants was consistent with the government's figure of about 160 departed jihadists, and why the AIVD spoke of this in Washington rather than to parliament. The minister replied that the AIVD chief spoke of a few hundred potential participants, that parliament had been informed of the same figures in earlier letters, and that there is no discrepancy or difference in message between the two.
The head of the AIVD, Mr Bertholee, therefore did not disclose any figures in Washington other than those already known to your House.
Het hoofd van de AIVD, de heer Bertholee, heeft in Washington dus geen andere cijfers bekend gemaakt, dan die reeds bekend zijn bij uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Van Veldhoven over de Isla raffinaderij in verhouding tot internationale milieuverdragen

MPs Hachchi and Van Veldhoven asked how the government's position that the Isla refinery's pollution and CO2 emissions are a purely Curaçao matter fits with Kingdom-wide treaty obligations, why the refinery is absent from the biodiversity report, and why some environmental treaties apply to the whole Kingdom and others only to the European part. The government answered that each country within the Kingdom is responsible for implementing environmental policy and its treaty obligations, that the refinery was excluded from the CBD report because it concerns green environment and little data exists, and that treaty application depends on extension requests and implementing legislation.
However, within the Kingdom each country is itself responsible for implementing environmental policy.
Echter binnen het Koninkrijk is elk land zelf verantwoordelijk voor de uitvoering van het milieubeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Pestcultuur onder ambtenaren komt door gouden kooi’

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked about a report attributing bullying among civil servants to job security and a 'golden cage', and about mobility, top-down anti-bullying measures and financial sanctions for bullies. Minister Plasterk answered that bullying is a workplace matter for individual employers, cited survey figures, outlined mobility initiatives and existing disciplinary options, but declined a top-down approach.
It is primarily up to employers to ensure the safety and health of employees.
Het is primair aan de werkgevers om zorg te dragen voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de geheime malware die aangetroffen is binnen de systemen van de Europese Unie en bedrijven in Europese lidstaten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the ministers whether the government knew of the Regin malware reportedly found in EU and Belgian systems, whether Dutch systems are safe and whether the US or UK were involved. Minister Plasterk said the AIVD found no direct Dutch targeting in 2013, gave no guarantees against foreign malware, declined to confirm details publicly, and pointed to general cyber security initiatives and EU cooperation.
No public statements can be made about that.
Daarover kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Pensioenpot gemeenten komt half miljard tekort’

An MP asks why the ministry sat on a Deloitte report about the underfunded pension pot for local politicians (Appa) and whether the state and provinces failed to act, and asks about legal compliance and provincial oversight. The minister confirms receipt in April 2013, says the report was withheld pending cabinet decision-making, rejects a standalone fund as unviable, and says provinces are not obliged to reserve for these pensions, while committing to no concrete new action beyond ongoing deliberation.
For this reason, before the WOB request there was no reason to make the results of the study public.
Om deze reden was er voorafgaand aan het WOB-verzoek geen aanleiding de resultaten van het onderzoek kenbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked whether pension contributions for top officials at health insurers fall within the sectoral pay norm, and how their size is kept in check. The minister answered that the employer pension contribution is normed qualitatively, matched to the sector pension fund's standard entitlements, and declined to add a quantitative cap.
One quantitative norm for the employer share of the pension premium could therefore not be laid down in a generic regulation.
Eén kwantitatieve norm voor het werkgeversdeel van de pensioenpremie was hierdoor niet in een generieke regeling vast te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over discriminerende opmerkingen op internet over Nederlandse profvoetballers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked ministers whether they would act on racist online comments about Dutch professional footballers and whether the victims had filed reports. Minister Opstelten answered that the Public Prosecution Service has opened a preliminary fact-finding inquiry, that MiND has forwarded five reports, and that he sees no need to direct the players or the KNVB to file complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service is opening a preliminary fact-finding inquiry to assess whether there are grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) stelt een oriënterend feitenonderzoek in om te beoordelen of er aanknopingspunten zijn voor een strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Gesthuizen en Van Raak over het ontbreken van een geboortedatum op verblijfsdocumenten en in de basisregistratie personen

Four SP MPs asked why residence documents and the BRP carry placeholder birth dates such as 00-00 and whether a single fictitious date would be adopted. The minister acknowledged the problem, said Wet BRP article 2.17 now takes the fictitious date from the Justice Minister, and declined to retroactively assign dates to existing cases because of the consequences for acquired rights.
It was therefore decided, when article 2.17 of the Wet BRP was drafted, not to make such an arrangement for these existing cases.
Er is daarom bij de totstandkoming van artikel 2.17 Wet BRP besloten af te zien van het treffen van een dergelijke regeling voor deze bestaande gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over criminaliteit veroorzaakt door “spookburgers”

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked the ministers about crime by 'ghost citizens' (unregistered residents) in Amsterdam and elsewhere, and about how to tackle it. The government answered that such crime exists in other municipalities, that the number of ghost citizens is at most 100,000 without indicating criminal involvement, that landlords have no duty to check registration, and that a RIEC Amsterdam project is being evaluated.
No (overview) information on this can be obtained from the existing registration systems.
Hierover is geen (overzichts-)informatie uit de bestaande registratiesystemen te halen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten ‘pensioenpot van gemeenten maar voor de helft gevuld’ en ‘pensioenpot gemeenten komt half miljard tekort: tikkende tijdbom onder toekomstige begrotingen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that municipalities, provinces and water boards underfund pensions of political office-holders, and why the Deloitte report was withheld until a FOI request. The minister confirmed the shortfall is a structural consequence of budget-financed pensions, said the Deloitte report was withheld while cabinet deliberations were ongoing, and committed to informing parliament on the outcome of cabinet talks on fund financing.
The findings of the study are part of the consultation on determining a cabinet position on fund financing.
De uitkomsten van het onderzoek zijn deel van het overleg over het bepalen van een kabinetsstandpunt over fondsfinanciering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hachchi en Sjoerdsma over de Isla raffinaderij in relatie tot de EU-sancties

Two MPs asked whether processing Russian crude at the Venezuelan-run Isla refinery on Curaçao complies with EU sanctions against Russia, and how the Curaçao government is held to EU sanctions. The minister replied that the energy sanctions do not ban imports of Russian oil, that the refinery's dealings fall under Curaçao's autonomy, and that Curaçao's cooperation is being pressed via the Kingdom's Rijkssanctiewet.
The Cabinet has no information on economic cooperation between the Isla refinery on Curaçao and Russian companies.
Het Kabinet heeft geen informatie over economische samenwerkingsverbanden tussen de Isla raffinaderij op Curaçao en Russische bedrijven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een illegale Marokkaan die een terreuraanslag wilde plegen

An MP asked the ministers whether the suspect in a planned terror attack acted alone, whether family members are being screened, what measures prevent his release, whether he will be expelled, and how intelligence services track illegal residents. The ministers declined to give details on the investigation, pointed to the prosecutor and judge on detention, described the rules for expelling criminal foreigners, and said illegal residence alone does not trigger AIVD investigation.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service and the judge to determine whether there is reason to extend the pre-trial detention of suspects or not.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie en aan de rechter te bepalen of aanleiding bestaat de voorlopige hechtenis van verdachten al dan niet te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot en Keijzer over het advies objectief verdeelmodel Wmo 2015 van de Raad voor de financiële verhoudingen

Two CDA MPs asked whether the government will adopt the Rfv's advice against introducing the objective Wmo 2015 distribution model for centre municipalities on 1 January 2015, given large redistribution effects and cuts, and about transition arrangements, contracts and GGZ-C criteria. The state secretary agreed the model should not be introduced in 2015, kept historical budgets for next year, committed to a transition path and consultation with the VNG and providers, but referred some matters to municipalities and the Zorginstituut.
I share this conclusion. It was never the intention to introduce an objective distribution model on 1 January 2015.
Ik deel deze conclusie. Het is ook nooit de bedoeling geweest een objectief verdeelmodel per 1 januari 2015 in te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de controle op Europese subsidies

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Interior about the burden of controls on EU subsidies, the risk of double enforcement, reclaiming of EU funds, and the trust principle. Minister Kamp answered that the Commission's rules differ from Dutch principles, that the government is working to balance controls and promote risk-based audits, and that it will prepare a new bill replacing the state-aid recovery bill.
To safeguard the lawfulness of expenditure, I am of the view that there must be a good balance between the control efforts of national and European control bodies and their efficiency.

Om de rechtmatigheid van de uitgaven te borgen ben ik van mening dat er sprake moet zijn van een goede balans tussen de controle-inspanningen door de nationale en Europese controle-instanties en de doelmatigheid daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over het verhalen van de kosten van het opruimen van drugsafval op de daders

An MP asked whether drug-dumping offenders are rarely traced, whether landowners such as the municipality of Landerd are kept informed of prosecutions, and whether victims should be compensated for cleanup costs. The ministers replied that dumping is not separately registered, landowners can join criminal proceedings as injured parties, and the government opposed a compensation scheme, referring to a parliamentary amendment.
Dumping of drug waste is as such not registered in the operational process systems of the public prosecution service (OM).
Het dumpen van drugsafval wordt als zodanig niet geregistreerd in de bedrijfsprocessensystemen van het openbaar ministerie (OM).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een asielzoekerscentrum in Winschoten of Scheemda

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether residents of Winschoten and Scheemda were consulted about a possible asylum reception centre, and what measures would reduce asylum inflow. State Secretary Teeven answered that municipalities decide on reception centres and on whether to hold referendums, and that migration flows cannot be fully steered, while stating measures from an earlier letter remain in force.
It is up to the municipalities to decide whether, and if so in which cases and under which conditions, a public consultation takes place on matters that fall within municipal autonomy.
Het is aan de gemeenten om te bepalen of en zo ja, in welke gevallen en onder welke voorwaarden, een bevolkingsraadpleging plaatsvindt over onderwerpen die tot de gemeentelijke autonomie behoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Mohandis en Segers over het bericht “Bonus directeur regionale omroep L1 onder de loep”

MPs Kerstens, Mohandis and Segers asked whether regional broadcaster L1 paid a director a bonus of over 26,000 euro, whether bonuses fall under WNT transitional law, and how unlawful bonuses are recovered and sanctioned. The Minister answered that the Commissariaat voor de Media is investigating, that bonuses agreed after 6 December 2011 are unlawful and must be recovered via a set procedure with penalty orders, and that he will consult VNG and IPO on model subsidy rules.
The Commissariaat voor de Media is currently investigating this.
Het Commissariaat voor de Media onderzoekt dit momenteel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn, Moors en Van Oosten over het bericht “Tweetal steelt AOW via DigiD-fraude”

MPs from the VVD asked the government about a report that two people stole old-age pensions via DigiD phishing fraud, and how victims were compensated and future fraud prevented. The state secretary answered that a criminal investigation found about 5,000 possibly misused DigiD accounts and total losses of about 50,000 euro, that victims were fully compensated, and that the government will try to recover the money and promote safer DigiD use, with a promised overview of further measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de vergelijking tussen joden en ISIS-jihadisten door de burgemeester van Hilversum

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether the Hilversum mayor's comparison of jihadist travel to Syria and Iraq with Jewish emigration after WWII was acceptable, and whether he should apologise. The minister said the mayor's intent was to argue for legal grounds to withdraw passports, that the mayor has explained himself to the council, and that the council is responsible for judging his conduct.
It is in the first place for the Hilversum municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Broertjes.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Hilversum om de handelwijze van burgemeester Broertjes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Bosma over het bericht ‘Ophef om uitspraak Broertjes’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior about a mayor's remark comparing Israel to ISIS and whether he should be suspended, claiming the remark was sickening and aided the enemy. The Minister answered that the mayor's intended meaning was about the legal grounds required for passport revocation, that the Hilversum council is responsible for judging the mayor's conduct, and that the mayor has already explained himself in a letter.
It is in the first place up to the Hilversum municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Broertjes.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Hilversum om de handelwijze van burgemeester Broertjes te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over indirecte investeringen van ambtenaren via pensioenfondsen in legbatterijen en megastallen in het buitenland

An MP asked whether civil servants' pension fund ABP indirectly invests in megastables and battery cages abroad, and whether the government would engage ABP or switch funds. The minister declined to monitor individual investments, stating pension funds and their boards decide investment policy under legal frameworks, and refused to engage ABP or change funds.
It is not the government's task to monitor and assess specific investments of individual funds, so I cannot comment on this.
Het is niet de taak van het kabinet om specifieke beleggingen van individuele fondsen te monitoren en te beoordelen, dus ik kan hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Fokke over een lek in DigiD

Two MPs asked the Minister of the Interior about a reported security flaw in DigiD, including which municipalities were affected, how it arose, when it was discovered and fixed, whether citizens were informed, and whether certificates were outdated. The minister answered that no DigiD security breach occurred, that 12 municipalities had a potential risk patched without any evidence of compromise, that informing citizens is up to the organisations themselves, and that the certificate used is modern (SHA256).
Logius did not disclose the names of the municipalities and other organisations concerned, because it is up to those organisations themselves whether to make any statements about it.
Logius heeft de namen van de betrokken gemeenten en andere organisaties niet bekend gemaakt omdat het aan de betrokken organisaties zelf is om daar wel of geen mededelingen over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat jihadist Jermaine W. een onderwijsorganisatie leidde

Two MPs asked whether a jihadist who reportedly left for Syria led an education foundation despite surveillance, whether extremist teachers are allowed to teach children, and whether such foundations receive subsidies or foreign funding and should be inspected. The government said it cannot comment on individual investigations, that private unrecognised education falls outside the Inspectorate's supervision, that foreign funding is not illegal, and that it will push for more transparency under its anti-jihadism action programme.
That does not alter the fact that we will intervene when there are signs of practices that are not acceptable.
Dat neemt niet weg dat wij zullen ingrijpen wanneer er tekenen zijn van praktijken die niet door de beugel kunnen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het voornemen van het vliegveld Princess Juliana International Airport en het havenbedrijf The Harbour Group of Companies van Sint Maarten om casino’s te bouwen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about casino plans by Sint Maarten's airport and harbour companies, alleged licensing despite a moratorium, integrity failures, and whether the Kingdom should intervene under Article 43 of the Statute. The minister denied a moratorium existed, said the integrity reports are taken seriously, and declined to order intervention now, pointing to a Sint Maarten action plan with Dutch assistance available.
Taking a measure becomes a consideration when the duty each country has under Article 43(1) of the Statute, including good governance, is structurally neglected and no internal remedy is provided.

Het nemen van een maatregel komt in overweging wanneer de zorgtaak die elk der landen op grond van het eerste lid van artikel 43 Statuut heeft met betrekking tot onder andere het deugdelijk bestuur, structureel verwaarloosd wordt en er intern geen redres wordt geboden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het terugtrekken van de Nationale Ombudsman uit het systeem ter preventie van de vernederende en onmenselijke behandeling van burgers die onder staatstoezicht van hun vrijheid z

An MP asked why the National Ombudsman withdrew from the National Preventive Mechanism against torture and ill-treatment, and whether the mechanism is functioning and sufficiently independent of the inspectorates and the minister. The state secretary regretted the withdrawal, argued the network functions adequately, and rejected concerns about ministerial influence over inspection priorities.
I therefore do not share the concerns of the National Ombudsman.
Ik deel de zorgen van de Nationale ombudsman dan ook niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het opvragen en het gebruik van het Burgerservicenummer door organisaties die daar niet bevoegd toe zijn

MP Oosenbrug asked the Minister of the Interior about organisations, such as schools, insurers and others, requesting citizens' BSN or ID copies without authority, and about sanctions and complaint routes. The minister admitted the official overview was outdated, pointed to alternative websites and the CBP, and said awareness campaigns and CBP sanctions are the response, while stating that the government has no obligation to disclose the BSN use of specific individuals.
There is therefore no obligation for the Minister of BZK to make available information about the use of a specific, person-identifiable BSN.
Er is dus géén sprake van een verplichting van de Minister van BZK om informatie ter beschikking te stellen over het gebruik van een specifiek, tot een persoon herleidbaar, BSN.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht ‘Staatsraden oneens met aanwijzing’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether the legal basis for the Governor of Aruba's directive on the 2014 budget is sound, after three Council of State members publicly questioned it, and whether such public opinions undermine independent advice. The Minister replies that the royal decree is lawful under the Governor's Reglement as a Kingdom organ safeguarding the Kingdom's interests, that the directive does not infringe Aruban autonomy, and that he will not comment on individual media statements, while noting advisory bodies are expected to act prudently.
If desired, they can and will be called to account on this by the chair of the Advisory Division.
Desgewenst kunnen en zullen zij hierop worden aangesproken door de voorzitter van de Afdeling advisering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jadnanansing over het bericht “Arcus College betaalt tonnen voor langdurige interimmer”

MPs Kerstens and Jadnanansing asked the Minister of Interior whether an interim manager paid over 300,000 euros by Arcus College, apparently beyond WNT pay limits under transitional rules, amounts to excessive pay or a sham construction. The minister answered that the Inspectorate of Education is still investigating compliance with the WNT, that transitional rules can apply if agreements predate 2013, that overpayment would have to be reclaimed, and that enforcement lies with the education minister and the inspectorate.

On the basis of further investigation of the annual report data and any notification from the institutional accountant, the Inspectorate of Education, on behalf of the Minister of Education, Culture and Science, supervises compliance with the WNT.

Op grond van nader onderzoek op basis van de gegevens in het jaarverslag, en een eventuele melding van de instellingsaccountant, oefent de Inspectie van het Onderwijs, namens de Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het toezicht uit op de naleving van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht «Salariseis bestuurder verboden in aanbesteding»

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked whether municipalities may impose salary limits in Wmo tenders, and how this relates to a parliamentary amendment and a motion on local top-income norms. The minister replied that salary demands must meet the proportionality principle under the Aanbestedingswet, that the WNT maxima apply in any case, and that talks with VNG and IPO on local top-income norms are ongoing.
Imposing salary requirements as such does not appear to meet this.
Het stellen van salariseisen als zodanig lijkt hier niet aan te voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over potentiële jihadisten op luchthavens

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether jihadists working at airports had been arrested in the Netherlands, whether Dutch and Belgian intelligence services were in contact, and whether airport staff should be screened like in Belgium. The minister answered that no such cases were known to the Public Prosecution Service, declined to comment on international intelligence cooperation, and explained that airport positions with national security risk are designated as trust positions requiring a security clearance from the AIVD.
No public statements can be made about international cooperation between intelligence and security services.
Over de internationale samenwerking tussen inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over ‘ICT-adviseur wil gemeenten helpen aan Big Brother 2.0’

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a report on an ICT adviser's vision of municipal data sharing ('Big Brother 2.0') and the privacy and oversight implications. The minister says the Wbp provides an adequate framework, municipalities are autonomous with no central oversight beyond the CBP, and a broader public debate is planned via a WRR advisory request.
Given the autonomy of municipalities, including in the field of information exchange, there is no supervision by the national government.
Gelet op de autonomie van gemeenten, ook op het gebied van informatie-uitwisseling, is er geen toezicht door de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over verdiensten voor bijbanen in publieke dienst

An MP asked the government about reports that former minister Uri Rosenthal received raised fees for his advisory council chairmanship and how much he earns from public-sector side jobs, and whether officials should earn no more than a minister. The government replied that the report was wrong, that the fee was actually lowered, that a calculation error in the published decision was corrected, and that the Remuneration Decree already caps combined fees at a minister's salary.
The internal checks on decisions sent to the Staatscourant have been tightened.
De interne controles op besluiten die naar de Staatscourant gaan, zijn verscherpt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over de maatschappelijke onrust over het vangen van wilde ezels op Bonaire

An MP asked about public unrest over the capture of wild donkeys on Bonaire, the current status of a sustainable solution, and whether the minister will play a role in protecting the donkeys' welfare. The State Secretary answered that mares and foals are sheltered, stallions are castrated and released, unsalvageable animals are euthanised, that the policy is the Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire's and is supported as addressing nature damage and traffic danger, and that the Openbaar Lichaam is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
The Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is primarily responsible for animal welfare.
Het Openbaar Lichaam Bonaire is eerstverantwoordelijke voor het welzijn van dieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Oosten en Van der Steur over de uitzending van Brandpunt over lijkschouwers

MPs Van Oosten and Van der Steur asked about a Brandpunt broadcast claiming forensic doctors miss crimes, and about standard protocols for death inspections (lijkschouw) including blood and urine testing. The minister replied that forensic doctors must be registered, that a national guideline exists requiring blood and urine sampling, that deviations are permitted if documented, and that no data on deviations is available.
There is no information available on whether, and if so how often, the guideline is deviated from.
Er is geen informatie beschikbaar over de vraag of, en zo ja, hoe vaak wordt afgeweken van de richtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het terugvorderen van decoraties

An SP MP asked why a motion calling for no active recovery of honours from deceased recipients's heirs has not been implemented, and how the government will ensure heirs are not pressured to return decorations. The minister replies that the settled practice (spontaneous or polite-reminder return, a year's grace, no active collection of deposits) already reflects the motion, which the Chamber had supported.
The starting point remains that heirs are asked to return the honour, if desired only after a year.
Uitgangspunt blijft dat van nabestaanden wordt gevraagd het onderscheidingsteken terug te sturen, desgewenst pas na een jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over digitale dienstverlening bij decentralisaties

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipal digital service delivery for the 2015 social-domain decentralisations is lagging and whether residents risk inadequate service. The minister answered that digital information provision is not essential to the transition, pointed to VNG support programmes, a national information point and planned digital-government agreements, and said access arrangements are up to municipalities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over beloningen bij zorgverzekeraars

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked ministers about executive pay at health insurers such as VGZ and Achmea, including whether the sectoral pay norm under the WNT is being respected, why severance payments and interim pension premiums are so high, and whether annual reports disclose pension costs. The ministers answered that pay falls within a sectoral norm with transitional rules, that a review of the sector regime has only just started, that the severance was contractually based, and that a data error in Menzis reporting is being corrected.
On the impact of WNT-2 on pay in the second WNT regime, VWS has asked the health insurance sector for attention.
Over de impact van WNT-2 voor de beloningen in het tweede WNT-regime heeft VWS aandacht gevraagd aan de sector zorgverzekeraars.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over duurzame energie in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about renewable energy in the Caribbean Netherlands, including reported postponement of geothermal energy on Saba and the Sint Maarten green energy strategy. The government answered that it supports renewable investment, funds Saba and Sint Eustatius utilities for wind or solar, consulted Saba's government on geothermal, and says it does not block geothermal exploration but has no budget for multi-year losses.
Furthermore, it must be noted that the cabinet does not place any obstacle in the way of any party setting up geothermal energy in the Caribbean.
Voorts moet opgemerkt worden dat het kabinet geen enkele partij iets in de weg legt om geothermie in de Caribben op te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Groot over mogelijkheden de Wet Normering Topinkomens te omzeilen

MPs Kerstens and Groot asked whether topfunctionarissen could exceed the WNT pay norm by shifting pay into tax-free work expenses, and whether such schemes should be made unlawful. The minister replied that no gap exists, citing the gebruikelijkheidscriterium and a practical €2,400 threshold, and promised to examine tightening the criterion and clarifying the WNT framework.
The State Secretary of Finance has committed to examining whether the customary-practice criterion needs further tightening in this context.
De Staatssecretaris van Financiën heeft toegezegd te onderzoeken of het gebruikelijkheidscriterium in dit kader nadere aanscherping behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jacobi over de financiële verplichtingen voor het grensoverschrijdend Park De Zoom –Kalmthoutse heide

An MP asked whether the national government's withdrawal of structural funding for the cross-border De Zoom-Kalmthoutse Heide park, despite the 2011 extension of a ministerial decision, breaches informal financial commitments and harms relations with Flanders. The minister replied that the decision only provides a formal basis for a commission and no funding, that structural national funding ended as part of budget cuts and decentralisation, that the province of Noord-Brabant is responsible, and that he is willing to consult Flanders if needed.
The decision provides no basis for financial support to the commission itself.
De beschikking geeft geen grondslag voor financiële steun aan de commissie zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het niet vervolgen van massale verkiezingsfraude op Sint Maarten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a court's 'class justice' finding about unprosecuted vote-buying on Sint Maarten, allegations about a party leader's donations and his re-election, and concern about the lack of investigation were justified. The Minister declined to comment on court rulings and on the unverified allegations, noting that vote-buying is a rule-of-law concern for the Kingdom.
It is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to comment on court rulings and judgments.
