Het is niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om gerechtelijke uitspraken en vonnissen van commentaar te voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony Van Dijck en Bosma over het bericht ‘Terrorisme wordt vanuit Nederland gesteund met geld’

PVV MPs asked whether terror groups in Pakistan and Afghanistan received money from the Netherlands over 100 times, why money transfers flagged by exchange offices were not stopped sooner, and what action would be taken against those involved. The government answered that the press report misrepresented the figures: 108 dossiers in 2013 were reported to the authorities after analysis, none yet shown to involve terrorist financing, and prosecution decisions rest with the Public Prosecution Service.
Under the statutory duty of confidentiality, no further details can be given about the amounts involved.
Uit hoofde van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen geen nadere gegevens vermeld worden omtrent de in het geding zijnde bedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het burgerservicenummer

An MP asked whether the citizen service number (BSN) appears on the data page of the new passport, despite a promise to move it to the reverse, and how this squares with identity-fraud prevention. The Minister confirmed the BSN is on the reverse and in the machine-readable zone and chip, arguing removal from the zone is infeasible, while acknowledging the need for careful handling and that the information page could not be updated.
I therefore stated that I consider it unfeasible to no longer include the BSN in the machine-readable zone.
Ik heb daarom gesteld dat ik het onhaalbaar acht om het BSN niet meer in de machine leesbare zone op te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het uitblijven van de rechtszaak tegen een parlementariër op Sint Maarten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the delayed prosecution of parliamentarian Patrick Illidge on Sint Maarten (bribery, facilitating prostitution, illegal weapons) undermines public trust, whether the case is serious enough to be prioritised, whether other politicians were heard as suspects, and whether Illidge could claim the generous severance scheme after elections. The Minister answered that it is not for him to judge the timing of Sint Maarten prosecutions, that he has no information on who was heard as suspects, and that the severance question is for the competent authority on Sint Maarten.

It is not for me as Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to judge the period within which criminal cases in Sint Maarten are handled by the Public Prosecution Service and the Joint Court of Justice

Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om een oordeel te vellen over de termijn waarop strafzaken in Sint Maarten door het OM en het Gemeenschappelijk Hof worden afgedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Ten Broeke en Verheijen over de Sanctiewet van Curaçao

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers how the Curaçao parliament's rejection of the Kingdom sanctions law affects implementation of EU sanctions against Russia and whether a national Kingdom sanctions law (Rijkssanctiewet) is needed. The government answered that EU sanctions must apply across the Kingdom, that Aruba and Sint Maarten have adapted their rules, that work on a national law continues because Curaçao has not yet adapted its ordinance, and that Curaçao's autonomous legislative competence cannot be overridden.
The draft national sanctions law does allow each country to determine separately which parts of the law enter into force.
De concept Rijkssanctiewet voorziet overigens in de mogelijkheid om voor elk Land afzonderlijk te bepalen welke onderdelen van de wet in werking treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht «Ziekenhuis betaalt fop-adviseur vier ton»

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked the minister about a report that a hospital paid a consultant 382,400 euros via a fee-avoiding interim construction to evade the WNT pay cap. The minister, on behalf of the health minister, answered that the CIBG found the person was a top official but that no actual breach occurred in 2013 due to transitional rules, while the hospital is asked to report the pay correctly.
Following the report, this matter was examined by the CIBG in line with the supervisory procedure.
Naar aanleiding van het bericht is deze kwestie conform de toezichtprocedure door het CIBG onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over de beloning van interim-adviseur van het Kennemer Gasthuis

An SP MP asks ministers whether a hospital's interim adviser paid above the WNT pay cap, and whether consultancy firms are evading the WNT, is acceptable and should be investigated. The minister replies that the WNT applies, that oversight tools exist, that her ministry does not audit hospital management or consultancies, and that she will review the audit protocol for annual reports.
It is not my task to audit the business operations of healthcare institutions.
Het is niet mijn taak om de bedrijfsvoering van zorginstellingen door te lichten.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over "gemeente mag subsidie niet korten om topinkomens"

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities should be able to weigh executive pay norms when contracting providers, given a Council of State ruling that municipalities may not use subsidy cuts to enforce income limits. The minister said such norms are desirable and can be weighed at the front end of subsidy decisions, but he will not amend the legislation and will send the VNG and IPO a letter with conclusions.
I therefore do not intend to amend the legislation.
Ik ben daarom niet voornemens de wetgeving aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Ex-manager ziekenhuis krijgt 3,4 ton mee’

An MP asked ministers whether a hospital manager's €340,000 severance payment falls under the Wet normering topinkomens, why it exceeds the usual cantonal-judge formula, and what steps will be taken against the hospital and the sector. The minister confirmed the payment, said the manager is not a top official under the Wnt so the pay cap does not apply, pointed to a planned extension of the cap to all (semi)public-sector staff with a conclusion expected in 2015, and said no rules were broken so no action is needed.
The cabinet is currently carrying out a policy exploration in preparation for that bill.
Het kabinet voert op dit moment een beleidsverkenning uit als voorbereiding op dat wetsvoorstel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Woede om gouden handdruk manager'

Two PvdA MPs asked the Interior and Social Affairs ministers about a reported €294,476 severance payment to a unit manager of the Amersfoort sheltered-work body, whether municipal aldermen knew, and whether it breaches the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the manager was not a top official under the WNT so the cap did not apply, the payment was reported and explained, the board was only informed afterwards and is discussing it with management, and no action to reclaim the payment was announced.
Strictly speaking, this question should not be directed at the ministers of BZK and SZW.
Deze vraag hoort strikt genomen niet te worden gericht aan de bewindspersonen van BZK en SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Half miljoen vertrekregeling voor bestuurder VUmc’

MPs Kerstens and Bouwmeester asked about a severance arrangement of over 300,000 euro, plus eight months of continued pay, for a former VUmc board member, and whether it breaches the WNT, who will recover it, and why it was not published earlier. The government answers that the arrangement was agreed before the WNT entered into force, so transitional law applies, that it is reported in the annual report as required, and that it does not intend to reopen the transitional rules.
Because the agreements were made before this law entered into force, they probably fall under the transitional law.
Omdat de afspraken hierover voor de inwerkingtreding van deze wet zijn gemaakt, vallen deze waarschijnlijk onder het overgangsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over experimenten waarbij Facebookgebruikers betrokken zijn en de privacy van social mediagebruikers

An MP asked the government about Facebook's 2012 experiment on 689,000 users that manipulated news feeds, whether consent, transparency of selection criteria, protection of minors and third-party data sharing comply with the Dutch data protection act. The state secretary declined to give a substantive ethical judgment, pointed to the Wbp consent and information rules, and left specific compliance questions to the independent CBP data protection authority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Rebel over de sponsoring van provincies en gemeenten door de tabaksindustrie

MPs Fokke and Rebel asked whether municipalities and provinces sponsored by the tobacco industry breach FCTC Article 5.3 and its guidelines, and what the government will do to stop it. The State Secretary answered that the convention binds local authorities but leaves implementation open, that the guidelines are non-binding, that the two campaigns do not stem from tobacco control policy, and that a letter reminding municipalities and provinces of their obligations has been sent.
That said, I consider it important that municipalities and provinces become better acquainted with the obligations arising from the FCTC convention and the Tobacco Act.
Dit neemt niet weg dat ik het belangrijk vind dat gemeenten en provincies beter bekend worden met de verplichtingen die voortvloeien uit het FCTC-verdrag en de Tabakswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rutte over financiering en eigendom Ommelander Ziekenhuisgroep Groningen

An MP asked the Health and Interior ministers about the OZG hospital group becoming a subsidiary of UMCG, a provincial loan of 50 million euro for new building, possible state aid issues, and effects on neighbouring hospitals. The minister answered that competition authorities NZa and ACM are reviewing the takeover, that the province has not yet decided on the loan and state-aid compliance is the province's responsibility, and that insurers decide their own contracting under their duty of care.
In principle it is not prohibited for the UMCG to take over other care providers.
Het is in beginsel niet verboden voor het UMCG om andere zorgaanbieders over te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over botresten op de begraafplaats in Bladel

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether it is unacceptable that visitors to the Bladel cemetery were confronted with bone remains, whether this violates the dignity of the dead, and why the cemetery did not follow the national handbook on exhumation and clearance. The minister agreed visitors should not encounter remains, said clearance must be done respectfully, and explained that cemetery managers decide on clearance and methods.
In principle it is up to the manager of a cemetery, municipal or private, to decide whether graves are cleared and, if so, which method is used.
Het is in beginsel aan de beheerder van een begraafplaats, gemeentelijk dan wel bijzonder, om te bepalen of graven worden geruimd en zo ja welke werkwijze daarbij wordt gehanteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over het artikel “Brabantse gemeenten zitten financieel aan de grond”

An MP asks whether Brabant municipalities in financial distress can meet the promised soft landing for the 2015 social domain decentralisations and what the government will do to prevent escalation. The minister replies that the provincial analysis is less negative than presented, that 9 municipalities nationally are under preventive financial supervision, and that a Transitiecommissie Sociaal Domein will monitor municipalities from September 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, De Graaf en Helder over de anti-Israëldemonstratie

PVV MPs asked whether police failed to act against Nazi and terror symbols and a Hitler salute at a July 2014 anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and whether the mayor failed and suspects should be arrested, stripped of Dutch nationality and expelled. The minister refers to earlier answers, says criminal punishment is for the judge, and explains that Dutch nationality can only be revoked for terrorism convictions after 1 October 2010 and that residence can be ended only after a final conviction.
If someone has committed a criminal offence, it is for the judge to assess what punishment is appropriate, given the offence, the perpetrator(s) and the harm caused.
Indien iemand een strafbaar feit heeft begaan, is het aan de rechter om te beoordelen welke straf passend is, gelet op het delict, de persoon van de dader(s) en het aangedane leed.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de antisemitische demonstratie door moslims in Den Haag

Three PVV MPs asked why police and the mayor did not act against alleged criminal speech (calls to violence, a Hitler salute) at an anti-Israel demonstration in The Hague, and why a journalist was removed rather than her harassers arrested. The minister answered that two people were arrested and will be prosecuted, no Hitler salute was found, the mayor lacks legal power to ban a demonstration for its content, and the journalist's treatment aimed to prevent escalation.
The mayor also has no power to act against a demonstration solely to prevent or end criminal offences.
De burgemeester heeft ook geen bevoegdheid tegen een demonstratie op te treden enkel ter voorkoming of beëindiging van strafbare feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Van der Staaij en Omtzigt over de Gaza-demonstratie van 24 juli 2014 in Den Haag

Three MPs asked the ministers about the Gaza demonstration in The Hague on 24 July 2014, including whether it was properly notified, whether police and prosecutors acted on antisemitic chants, threats to journalists, and display of ISIS flags. The government answered that the demonstration was notified as required with 50 expected participants, referred to answers given to related questions, and stated the prosecution's position that displaying IS and Hamas flags is punishable under the Penal Code.

The position is that IS (formerly ISIS/ISIL) and Hamas, banned as terrorist organisations by the EU and UN aiming at violence against certain population groups, public display of their flags constitutes a criminal offence in the prosecution's view under Articles 137d and 137c of the Penal Code.

Het standpunt houdt in dat nu IS (voorheen ISIS/ISIL) en Hamas (door de EU en de VN) verboden, terroristische organisaties zijn die tot doel hebben geweld te plegen tegen bepaalde bevolkingsgroepen, het in het openbaar tonen van deze vlaggen van deze organisaties naar het oordeel van het Openbaar Ministerie strafbaarheid oplevert
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over beloningen bij netbeheerder Liander

MPs Kerstens and Jan Vos asked the ministers about reports that 34 Liander staff, including eleven large severance payments, exceeded the WNT pay norm in 2013. Minister Plasterk answered that seven top officials and 17 others exceeded the maximum, that the top officials fall under transitional law, and that the sector will be judged on the WNT, with a report to parliament by end 2014.
The number of salaries above the WNT norm at present is a consequence of the historical development of salaries in the public and semi-public sector.
Het aantal salarissen boven de WNT-norm op dit moment is een gevolg van de historische ontwikkeling van salarissen in de publieke en semipublieke sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het onderzoek ‘Spookjongeren: quickscan naar uitgeschreven jongeren in Amsterdam Nieuw-West’

Van Toorenburg asked about a quickscan on 'ghost youths' who deregister from the municipal population register in Amsterdam Nieuw-West, including whether this is a deliberate way to evade bailiffs and justice and whether benefit rules contribute. Minister Plasterk answered that the study is only a quickscan needing further research, that the number of ghost citizens nationally is estimated at 100,000 (over 10,000 aged 18–26), that municipalities have tools to question registrations, and that the childcare-cost rule may raise but is not expected to greatly increase the phenomenon.
This report concerns a quickscan. The researchers indicate that further investigation is necessary.
Dit rapport betreft een quickscan. De onderzoekers geven aan dat nader onderzoek noodzakelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Öztürk en Fokke over het betaalgedrag van gemeenten

Opposition MPs Öztürk and Fokke asked ministers about municipalities paying invoices late, despite the 30-day statutory term, and what the government would do. The minister acknowledged the Ombudsman's findings, said a public monitor on municipal payment terms will be set up with the VNG and KING, and declined to send a circular or to suspend Municipality Fund payments.
You will be informed about this by the end of October at the latest, as promised in the aforementioned letter.
U wordt hierover uiterlijk eind oktober geïnformeerd, zoals toegezegd in voornoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het anti-Israëlbeleid van de gemeente Eindhoven

An MP asks the Interior Minister whether Eindhoven's street names with inscriptions referring to 'Palestina' (e.g. Tiberiasstraat) wrongly suggest Israeli cities lie in Palestine, and asks the minister to ask the municipality to change the signs. The minister replies that the inscriptions refer to the Biblical Palestine background of the names, that street naming is a local matter, and that the municipality has decided to remove the inscriptions during regular sign replacement.
Street names and the placement of signs belong par excellence to local autonomy.
Straatnamen en de plaatsing van borden behoren bij uitstek tot de lokale autonomie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het Ontwerpbesluit tot wijziging van het Besluit personenvervoer 2000 en andere besluiten in verband met de Wet afschaffing plusregio’s

MP Van Raak asked why the draft decree implementing the abolition of the plusregio's was submitted for consultation during the summer recess, whether this conflicts with the rules on consultation periods, and why it was not postponed until the Senate had dealt with the underlying bill. The Staatssecretary answered that the consultation period was extended to 30 September 2014 under the rules for recesses, that the earlier letter is supplemented rather than withdrawn, and that the draft could be submitted before the Senate finished the bill because the delegation scope is fixed once the House has adopted it.
The letter of 14 July 2014 is supplemented with this letter and not withdrawn.
De brief van 14 juli 2014 wordt met deze brief aangevuld en niet ingetrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Van der Staaij over het verbieden van festivals waar niet krachtig tegen drugsgebruik wordt opgetreden

MPs Bisschop and Van der Staaij asked whether festivals with drug problems should keep receiving permits and what legal grounds exist to refuse or revoke them. The government answered that no national rules set permit conditions, that municipalities may refuse permits only where drug use would likely cause public order or health problems, and that some municipalities already attach anti-drug conditions.
The suspicion of drug use in itself is not a ground for refusal.
Het vermoeden van drugsgebruik op zich is geen weigeringsgrond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Amerikaanse spionage

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government shares the German Chancellor's view that US espionage breaks trust, which spying cases since 1945 are known, whether US spies were expelled, whether Dutch parliament was spied on, and whether the US embassy near the Binnenhof should be closed. The minister declined to judge the German-US relationship, said the AIVD investigates foreign espionage but will not publicly disclose results, found no indication of spying on the Tweede Kamer, and refused to close the embassy.
No statements can be made publicly about the content and results of this investigation.
Over de inhoud en de resultaten van dit onderzoek kunnen in de openbaarheid geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de voorgenomen nieuwbouw van de Tevhit-moskee in Venlo-Zuid

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government knows of the planned new Tevhit mosque in Venlo, its links to the Turkish Diyanet foundation, its financing, and whether it will block construction. The government confirmed the plan, noted the mosque appears on the foundation's list of branches, said it does not interfere in financing of religious buildings absent suspicion of illegal acts, and pointed to freedom of religion under Article 6 of the Constitution while stating construction is allowed if Dutch law is respected.
The construction of new mosques or other places of worship is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën of andere gebedshuizen is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van de Rijksvertegenwoordiger voor de BES- eilanden

MPs Fritsma and Wilders asked the minister why the Sint Eustatius island council distrusts the appointed Rijksvertegenwoordiger Isabella and whether his appointment is credible, and demanded assurances he stay off the islands. The minister regretted the council's doubts, stated the appointment followed a transparent procedure with an independent commission and consultation of island executives, and refused to restrict Isabella's future work.
Mr Isabella was appointed through a transparent procedure and on the nomination of an independent committee.
De heer Isabella is benoemd door middel van een transparante procedure en op voordracht van een onafhankelijke commissie.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de motie waarin de Eilandsraad van Sint Eustatius unaniem uitspreekt geen vertrouwen te hebben in de nieuw benoemde rijksvertegenwoordiger voor Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the government would respond to a unanimous Sint Eustatius island council motion expressing no confidence in the newly appointed Rijksvertegenwoordiger, and whether the consultation procedure had been followed. The Minister regretted the council's doubts, stated that the island councils had no formal role under the WOLBES appointment procedure (only the island executives were consulted), and said the procedure was carefully followed and the new representative would take office on 1 September 2014.
For the island councils, the WOLBES does not provide a role in the appointment procedure.
Voor de eilandsraden is in de WOLBES geen rol weggelegd in de benoemingsprocedure.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Hachchi over het bericht: ‘Aruba boos over trage benoeming Raad van State’

Two MPs asked why Aruba's seat on the Council of State remains unfilled, whether a nomination was pulled from the Council of Ministers agenda, and when Aruba will be represented. The minister confirmed the report, cited confidentiality of Council of Ministers deliberations on nominations, and explained that the nomination requires agreement with the Aruban government but not automatic approval, promising only to announce any appointment.
Under Article 26 of the Council of Ministers' Rules of Procedure, there is a duty of confidentiality regarding what is discussed or takes place at the meeting.
Krachtens artikel 26 van het Reglement van orde voor de Ministerraad bestaat ten aanzien van hetgeen ter vergadering wordt besproken of geschiedt, een geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Ten Broeke over de recente ontwikkelingen omtrent de arrestatie van de Venezolaanse consul op Aruba

Two VVD MPs asked how the accreditation of Venezuelan consul-general Carvajal on Aruba went wrong, who grants consular approval, and whether the US contacted Dutch ministries before requesting his arrest. Minister Timmermans answered that the nota was not sent through proper diplomatic channels, so no exequatur was granted, that Venezuela could reasonably assume provisional admission and immunity, that only the Foreign Minister decides on such matters, and that the US did not inform the Netherlands and the reason is unknown.
It is not known why the US did not inform the Netherlands.
Het is niet bekend waarom de VS Nederland niet heeft ingelicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de zorgsector een goede markt is voor interim-managers

An MP asked the health minister for a reaction to a report that hourly rates for interim managers in healthcare rose from €112 to €145, and how this squares with layoffs and the WNT pay norms. The minister declined to answer substantively, arguing the study's small healthcare sample (11% of 484 respondents) and mixed methodology make the findings unreliable.
Therefore it is impossible for me to give a good answer to your questions.
Derhalve is het voor mij onmogelijk op uw vragen een goed antwoord op te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht “VS willen meer veiligheid luchthavens Europa”

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the US is pressing for tighter security at European airports with direct flights to the US, whether Dutch airports are affected, and whether explosives without metal are a threat to Schiphol. The government confirmed that only Schiphol is affected, that the threat of non-metal explosives is known and monitored with the US and partners, and that additional security measures for US-bound flights took effect on 8 July.
Schiphol is the only Dutch airport to which this applies.
Schiphol is de enige Nederlandse luchthaven waarop dit van toepassing is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf , Helder en Wilders over het bericht “Gevaarlijke jihadist vaak buiten beeld’

PVV MPs asked whether the government will reintroduce border controls, detain and expel returning jihadists and impose an immigration stop from Islamic countries after a report that foreign jihadists move freely in Europe unknown to the services. The Staatssecretaris answered that European intelligence cooperation is intensified, rejected the listed measures as incompatible with the constitution and treaties, and pointed to a national action programme on travel-data collection for later this autumn.
Concrete public statements cannot be made about the nature of cooperation between intelligence services.
Over de aard van de samenwerking tussen inlichtingendiensten, kunnen in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over gevaarlijke jihadisten die buiten beeld zijn

An MP asked why European intelligence services exchange few jihadist names, whether open borders enable jihadists to move unnoticed, when border controls will be reintroduced, and what steps will improve data sharing. The Staatssecretaris answered that cooperation is improving, that reintroducing border controls is not proportionate now and is a last resort, that a national action programme will follow, and referred to earlier answers for data sharing.
At this moment, deploying these extreme measures is not proportionate to their effectiveness.
Op dit moment staat het inzetten van deze uiterste maatregelen niet in verhouding tot de effectiviteit daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Recourt over plannen voor het aanbesteden van forensische zorg en onderzoek door de Nationale Politie

MPs Marcouch and Recourt asked the Ministers of Justice and Security, Health, and Interior about the planned tendering of forensic medical care and examination by the National Police, including quality, fragmentation, and ministerial responsibility. The government answered that the tender is in its preparatory phase under the light regime of the Aanbestedingswet, that existing providers may bid, and that it rejects a single-ministry responsibility, while declining to disclose some preparatory information.
For the second part of your first question, answering it would release information that may not be disclosed during the preparation of this tender.
Voor het tweede deel van uw eerste vraag geldt dat antwoord geven op deze vraag leidt tot het vrijgeven van informatie die tijdens de voorbereiding van deze aanbesteding niet vrijgegeven mag worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over de onduidelijke antwoorden van de regering inzake de hongerstaking van minister-president van Aruba

MPs from D66 and CDA asked the government how it prevented escalation with Aruba over the budget dispute, whether the College Financieel Toezicht was explicitly assigned the investigation, what solution it intends, whether a mediator should be appointed, and whether the Raad van State should rule on the lawfulness of the Rijksministerraad decision. The minister answered that the joint press statement clearly pointed to Cft staff, that a quick interim report and a final report within six weeks are expected, and that the royal decree was adopted lawfully, so no Raad van State ruling is sought.
With a view to the process of finding an acute solution, I do not consider it useful to make that communication public now.
Met het oog op het proces van het vinden van een acute oplossing, acht ik het niet dienstig die communicatie nu publiek te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Hachchi, Van Haersma Buma en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat de Arubaanse premier Mike Eman in hongerstaking gaat

MPs from D66 and CDA asked whether Aruba's prime minister's hunger strike was caused by a Council of Ministers decision instructing the Governor not to sign Aruba's 2014 budget, and whether that decision was lawful. The minister replied that the Council acted lawfully, that the budget right remains with Aruba, and that the Governor's instruction is a temporary suspension pending an independent review.
The decisions of the Council of Ministers are taken carefully and lawfully.
De beslissingen van de Rijksministerraad komen zorgvuldig en rechtmatig tot stand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over het bericht van “EU-onderzoek naar fraude op Bonaire”

An MP asked why the OLAF report on possible fraud in Bonaire subsidies was confidential, whether it would be published, and how the Chamber would be informed about prosecution decisions. The minister answered that the report was given confidentially by the European Commission, that a preliminary criminal investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is underway which publication could harm, and that no communication about such an investigation is normally given.
Publication of the report could harm this preliminary investigation.
Openbaarmaking van het rapport zou dit oriënterend onderzoek kunnen schaden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bespioneren van Nederlanders door de NSA

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior whether US section 702 of FISA allows the NSA to collect communications of non-Americans abroad, whether Dutch citizens are being spied on, and what the government will do to protect Dutch privacy, including whether the AIVD uses PRISM-derived or GCHQ-style methods. The Minister answered that the NSA reports the Netherlands is not a target but certainty cannot be given, that the AIVD and MIVD monitor foreign intelligence activity, that concerns were raised with the US and European norms are being negotiated, and that the CTIVD found no structural unlawful acquisition of data by the AIVD.
The AIVD and MIVD also conduct structural research into intelligence activities of foreign powers in the Netherlands and against Dutch interests.
De AIVD en MIVD verrichten daarnaast structureel onderzoek naar inlichtingenactiviteiten van buitenlandse mogendheden in Nederland en tegen Nederlandse belangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een veroordeelde pedofiel

MPs asked how a convicted sex offender was able to obtain housing above a childcare centre in Amersfoort and whether such offenders could be barred from child-rich areas. The State Secretary said the municipality did not allocate the home, the offender arranged it himself and the mayor was informed only after the move, and that barring offenders from all child-rich areas is not practically feasible, while pointing to a bill on longer supervision.
The mayor of Amersfoort informed me that there was no allocation of a home by the municipality.
De burgemeester van Amersfoort heeft mij gemeld dat er geen sprake was van toewijzing van een woning door de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de asielaanvraag van klokkenluider Snowden

MP Van Raak asked why whistleblower Snowden received no reply to his asylum request in the Netherlands, why the Chamber was not informed about it, and whether the request will be processed. The State Secretary answered that a Dutch asylum request can only be filed in person in the Netherlands, so it was not treated as an asylum application, that there is no practice of proactively informing the Chamber about individual protection requests, and that the request will not be taken up.
There is no practice whereby the cabinet proactively informs the Chamber about individual protection requests.
Er bestaat geen praktijk waarbij het kabinet de Kamer proactief informeert over individuele beschermingsverzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de trage beantwoording van digitaal verstuurde vragen en klachten door gemeenten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the Minister of Interior about slow responses by municipalities to emails and contact-form questions, as reported by the Consumentenbond. The Minister says he relies on ombudsman signals, points to service standards and the VNG quality charter, and states that digital-only service is a goal under the Digitaal 2017 programme, while the National Commissioner for Digital Government will not cover email responses.
I interpret the signals as an incentive to further develop and fill in the Digitaal 2017 programme with extra energy and attention to quality.
Ik vat de signalen op als een aansporing om met extra energie en aandacht voor kwaliteit het programma Digitaal 2017 verder uit te werken en in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het gebrek aan open data bij de overheid

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of the Interior about the poor state of open government data, including broken links and few new datasets on data.overheid.nl. The minister acknowledged the problem, explained that dataset counts fluctuate and that many files are only available on request, and promised a fuller plan by end of September.
The Cabinet will inform you further about the approach at the end of September.
Het Kabinet zal u eind september over de aanpak nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en De Liefde over het bericht «Geen progressie in open data»

MPs Moors and De Liefde asked the Minister of the Interior about reports of no progress on open data, the steps taken since November 2013, dataset counts per ministry, and how open data becomes the default. The minister listed actions taken (top-50 dataset list, portal upgrade, cost study, projects), said exact per-ministry counts are not available until a portal upgrade, and promised a cabinet proposal by end of September.
This is not known. Via data.overheid.nl there is not yet the possibility to monitor exact figures per ministry or other governments.
Dit is niet bekend. Via data.overheid.nl bestaat nog niet de mogelijkheid om exacte cijfers per ministerie of andere overheden te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Wilders over de benoeming van een omstreden PvdA-wethouder als Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES

MPs Fritsma and Wilders questioned the appointment of a controversial PvdA alderman as Rijksvertegenwoordiger BES, asking about selection criteria and whether the nomination would be withdrawn. The minister replied that a selection committee made a unanimous nomination which he adopted, that island councils were consulted, and that he considers the appointee fully qualified.
This committee made a unanimous nomination to me. I adopted this nomination.
Deze commissie heeft aan mij een unanieme voordracht gedaan. Deze voordracht heb ik overgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Otwin van Dijk en Fokke over het bericht «Venlo eist salarisverlaging top Zorggroep»

MPs Kerstens, Van Dijk and Fokke asked about a 5% salary increase for the chair of the Zorggroep Noord- en Midden-Limburg board, its link to the Venlo council's demand for a salary cut, and whether the government would back the executive's stance and coordinate with VNG and IPO on local pay norms. Minister Plasterk answered that the increase was lawful under the WNT transitional rules, that voluntary pay cuts are encouraged, and that the case will be raised with VNG and IPO, which are still in talks.
I will include the case in the consultation with VNG and IPO.
Ik zal de casus betrekken bij het overleg met VNG en IPO.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Moors, Dijkhoff en Litjens over de opslag van vertrouwelijke data door overheidsorganisaties en semi-publieke instellingen

MPs from the VVD asked whether foreign intelligence services should be able to access confidential government data and where that data is stored by government and semi-public bodies. The minister answered that the central government is building a Rijkscloud within Dutch data centres, that subnational and semi-public bodies are responsible for their own security, and that a complete overview of storage locations cannot be given.

It is not possible to provide such an overview for all ministries, provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions, and as regards provinces, municipalities and semi-public institutions it falls outside my responsibility.

Het is niet mogelijk om een dergelijk overzicht voor alle ministeries, provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen te geven en valt wat betreft provincies, gemeenten en de semi-publieke instellingen buiten mijn verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat de bewoners van Oudenhoorn kiezen voor Hellevoetsluis

MP Van Raak asked whether residents of Oudenhoorn choosing to join Hellevoetsluis should be respected and why Bernisse has not started a boundary correction. Minister Plasterk answered that Bernisse and Spijkenisse deliberately excluded the correction from the merger procedure, that a correction can only follow identical council decisions by Nissewaard and Hellevoetsluis (earliest 1 January 2016), and that it is not for the minister to bring it about.
In this case it is not for the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations to bring about a boundary correction.
Het is in dit geval niet aan de Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties om een grenscorrectie te bewerkstelligen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Neppérus en Litjens over fraude met vertrouwelijke gegevens die per reguliere post verzonden worden

MPs De Liefde, Neppérus and Litjens asked about fraud with confidential data sent by regular post, how often it occurs, who is liable, whether government letters should omit identifiers like BSN and bank numbers, and whether separate or courier delivery could reduce risk. Minister Plasterk answered that the postal law and regulator do not track misuse, liability is set by contracts or the universal service, identifiers are necessary for communication, and no new agreements or mandatory changes are planned, pointing to existing measures and digital channels.
It is therefore not possible to establish how often confidential data sent by post is misused.
Het is dan ook niet mogelijk te achterhalen hoe vaak er misbruik wordt gemaakt van vertrouwelijke gegevens die met de post worden verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het aanhoudende misbruik van de Wet openbaarheid bestuur

An MP asked the Interior Minister about recurring abuse of the Freedom of Information Act (Wob), where requests are filed mainly to extract penalty payments under the Dwangsom law, and whether excluding the Wob from that regime should be pushed through faster. The minister confirmed the abuse is not incidental, said the initiative bill Open overheid's articles 8.3 and 8.4 are an adequate remedy, and announced a narrower bill this autumn to stop the abuse sooner.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Knops over het bericht dat woningcorporatie WoningNet Holland Rijnland sinds 1 mei 2014 alle informatie uitsluitend per e-mail laat verlopen

MP Knops asks whether housing corporation WoningNet Holland Rijnland may end registrations of applicants without an email address, and how digital-only service fits government policy on accessibility for less digitally skilled people. Minister Plasterk answers that corporations are not obliged to use particular channels, that a fallback exists for applicants without email, and that digitalisation is government policy, leaving support to the corporations.
Housing corporations are not obliged under the regulations to communicate with their tenants and applicants in any particular way.
Corporaties zijn op grond van de regelgeving niet verplicht om op een bepaalde wijze met hun huurders en woningzoekenden te communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke bedreiging en poging tot omkoping van een eilandsraadslid op Bonaire

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether an investigation would follow the complaint by Bonaire island councillor Santana about threats with a revolver and an alleged 120,000-dollar bribe offer aimed at toppling the executive, and whether politicians' financing and his safety would be examined. The Minister replied that police found insufficient support for the threat complaint, the Public Prosecution Service saw no indication for a bribery investigation or other financial links to politicians, and protection of local officials is a local responsibility, while declining to discuss security measures taken.
The Public Prosecution Service has no other signals of possible criminal financial transactions or services by the named person in relation to politicians or political parties.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft geen andere signalen van mogelijk strafbare financiële transacties of dienstverlening door de genoemde persoon in relatie tot politici of politieke partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht “Nepdokteren in Kenia wordt beloond met ridderorde in Nederland”

MPs Van Laar and Kuzu asked ministers about a Dutch homeopath whose non-profit distributes the homeopathic remedy Iquilai as a substitute for antiretrovirals in Kenya, and about his knighthood. The minister says such substitution is harmful, will ask the Dutch embassy to inform Kenyan authorities and asks the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine options, but states she has no power to revoke the honour and no action is possible abroad.
I have therefore asked the Inspectorate for Healthcare to examine what options there are to investigate this matter further.
Ik heb daarom de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg gevraagd om na te gaan wat de mogelijkheden zijn om deze zaak nader te onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht «Gefuseerde gemeente niet efficiënter»

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a study finding that merged municipalities are not more efficient, and whether it would be sent to parliament with a government response. The minister replied that the study is being examined, that efficiency is broader than costs alone, and cited other studies and Danish evidence suggesting service and governance gains and some administrative cost savings after mergers.
I will study it further and provide Parliament with a response.
Ik zal het nader bestuderen en voorzien van een reactie aan Uw Kamer aanbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over de dreiging van een artikel 12-status voor de gemeenten Oldambt, Pekela en Bellingwedde

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether Oldambt, Pekela and Bellingwedde risk an article 12 financial-supervision status, what causes it, and what the new municipal fund and participation budget models mean for them. The minister answered that the province sees no current basis for the concern, pointed to efficiency cuts and the new participation budget, and listed existing support measures for weak labour-market regions.
Once there is insight into the effects of the objective models in the social domain, the need for a possible transitional arrangement will be considered.
Als er zicht is op de effecten van de objectieve modellen binnen het sociaal domein, wordt de noodzaak van een eventuele overgangsregeling bezien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Raak over de uitkering voor voormalig politici

MPs Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior about the Appa pension benefit for former political office holders, covering numbers, regional differences, re-employment times, job-search exemptions, total payments, and enforcement of the job-search obligation. Minister Plasterk answered that much of the data is held decentrally or is not broken down as requested, gave central-contract figures for 2011–2013, and said evaluations are forthcoming.
The Ministry of the Interior does not keep track of how many Appa benefits there are at provinces, municipalities and/or water boards.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt niet bij hoeveel Appa-uitkeringen er zijn bij provincies, gemeenten en/of waterschappen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de onwil van de gemeente Amsterdam om duidelijkheid te geven over de inhuur van externen

MP Van Raak asked the Interior Minister why Amsterdam will not clarify its spending on expensive external hires, whether accounting tricks hide it, and whether medeoverheden should adopt the Roemer norm and cut external staffing. The minister replied that Amsterdam's spending is an internal matter for the municipal council, that BBV rules are transparent, and that medeoverheden are autonomous and responsible for their own cuts and staffing choices.
For this reason, the central government does not keep figures on external hiring.
Om deze reden houdt het Rijk geen cijfers bij over externe inhuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat diverse wethouders in Helmond, Asten, Gemert-Bakel en Eersel het inkomen aanvullen met wachtgeld

MP Van Raak asked whether wethouders in four municipalities who took part-time posts topping up their income with wachtgeld (Appa benefits) was acceptable, which municipalities use this, and how the perceived gap would be closed. Minister Plasterk answered that there is no top-up but a consequence of the Appa offsetting rules, that the 2001 amendment deliberately allowed this, that the government does not track cases, and that no legal gap exists.
The Ministry of BZK does not keep such data.
Het Ministerie van BZK houdt dergelijke gegevens niet bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over de instructietaal in het onderwijs op Sint Eustatius

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about a reported plan to replace Dutch with English as the language of instruction on Sint Eustatius, the feasibility study behind it, who decides the language, and the next steps after the island council's motion. The Secretary of State referred to a letter and attached reports, said the statutory language regime is set by legislation, and noted the council motion did not disrupt the ministry's decision-making, though the ministry said it would follow up with the council.
The legislator therefore ultimately determines what the language of instruction in education on this island is.
De wetgever bepaalt dus uiteindelijk wat de instructietaal in het onderwijs op dit eiland is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over misstanden bij crematies

MP Van Raak asked whether incomplete cremation and mixing of ashes at a commercial crematorium was acceptable, why the public prosecutor's investigation relied on the company and paper checks, and whether this related to an earlier case. The minister replied that the OM investigated, heard witnesses and gas data, found no suspected crime, and that the NRC case is unrelated to the earlier column.
The public prosecution service (OM) did in fact launch an investigation following the report that incomplete combustion and mixing of ash remains had occurred at crematorium Maaslanden.

Door het openbaar ministerie (OM) is naar aanleiding van de melding dat er bij crematorium Maaslanden sprake zou zijn van onvolledige verbranding en vermenging van asresten wel degelijk een onderzoek ingesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw en het lid Van Raak over het bericht dat ‘de marechaussee niet wilde dat Brenno de Winter over NSS-top schreef’

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked the ministers about reports that military police wanted to stop journalist Brenno de Winter from writing about the NSS summit, including why journalists are observed and registered in public space and whether this restricts press freedom. The minister denied any policy of observing or registering journalists, said registration rests on the Politiewet 2012 and Wet Politiegegevens, and said no measures were taken to restrict investigative journalism.
It is therefore not police policy to observe and register journalists in public space.
Het is dan ook geen beleid bij de politie om journalisten in de publieke ruimte te observeren en te registreren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over stijging van de inkomens van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether top executive pay in elderly care rose 19% in 2013, whether the WNT transitional rules allow this, and how to prevent further rises during the reform. The government said it cannot yet confirm the figure, that no accountant has reported a WNT breach, that it agrees top pay should not outpace sector wages, and that it will act through supervision and reclaim undue payments if needed.
Moreover, I have not received any reports from the accountants that the WNT has been breached.
Overigens heb ik op dit moment geen meldingen binnen gekregen van de accountants dat de Wnt zou zijn overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het plan van het platform Bewust moslim om op de dag van dodenherdenking een symposium te houden over een zogenoemde schaduw Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would try to stop a planned symposium on a so-called 'shadow Holocaust' and what powers the municipality had to prevent it. The Minister replied that the municipality and mosque cancelled the event, that ministers do not intervene in municipal matters or judge organisers' views, and that mayors may act only on public order grounds, not on the content of the meeting.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in municipal affairs, nor is it for me to judge the views of people organising a meeting such as the questioners describe.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in gemeentelijke aangelegenheden te treden noch is het aan mij om de opvattingen te beoordelen van mensen die een bijeenkomst organiseren als door de vragenstellers bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hilversumse moskee tart herdenking’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares their revulsion at a Hilversum mosque comparing the Holocaust to the Arab attempt to prevent Israel's creation, and whether the mosque should be closed and its land rezoned. The minister confirmed awareness and said closure or dissolution is only possible under narrow legal conditions (public order, fire/safety violations, drug trade) and that zoning is a municipal responsibility, none of which apply here.
The zoning of land is a municipal responsibility.
De bestemming van gronden is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over integriteitsschendingen door ambtenaren

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked the Minister of Interior about a survey finding that about a quarter of civil servants perceived a misconduct, and about the actual extent and trend of integrity violations. The Minister said the survey is perception-based and a useful signal, that Rijk registrations (around 500 to 650 confirmed violations a year since 2010) show no significant rise, and pointed to existing integrity policy and the Ambtenarenwet obligations, promising continued encouragement of integrity efforts.
Organisations in the public administration are themselves responsible for registering integrity violations.
Organisaties in het openbaar bestuur zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het registreren van integriteitsschendingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veen zijn gesteld over het artikel ‘Geld nodig voor oorlogsgraven’

MP Van Veen asked the minister about reports that the Oorlogsgravenstichting needs more money for war graves upkeep, rising costs, its thin equity and whether government will take long-term responsibility and separate memorial centre operations. The minister said the upkeep is fully covered by subsidy, the foundation is seeking external funds, equity is being restored, and that the separation of memorial centres from grave work already exists.
For additional expenses the Oorlogsgravenstichting is looking for income other than subsidy funds.
Voor extra uitgaven is de Oorlogsgravenstichting op zoek naar andere inkomsten dan de subsidiegelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de verwarring omtrent het publiceren van namen door gemeenten

An MP asked the ministers whether municipalities may publish citizens' names and addresses in objection submissions, and whether privacy is adequately protected. The minister answered that municipalities must weigh privacy against publicity case by case, that the Groningen case involved only a list sent to parties rather than internet publication, and that an ombudsman investigation is ongoing.
The aforementioned investigation by the municipal ombudsman is partly aimed at establishing whether in this case the personal privacy of the submitters of objections was adequately safeguarded.
Het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van de gemeentelijke ombudsman is er mede op gericht vast te stellen of in dit geval de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de indieners van de zienswijzen goed is gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about Dutch nationals who became suicide bombers abroad, the victims, their dual nationality, whether AIVD budget cuts should be reversed, and whether the threat level will be raised. The minister confirmed two Dutch suicide attacks, declined to give victim or nationality details for operational reasons, said jihadist investigations were prioritised through internal reprioritisation, and stated the threat level remains substantial with no direct change.
For operational reasons I cannot publicly address matters that could reveal the identity of the two Dutch suicide bombers.
Ik kan om operationele redenen niet in het openbaar ingaan op zaken die de identiteit van de twee Nederlandse zelfmoordterroristen kunnen prijsgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Nederlandse zelfmoordjihadisten in martelarenvideo's

An MP asked the ministers whether Dutch suicide jihadists are glorified in martyrdom videos, whether distributing such videos is punishable, whether intelligence services' budget cuts are wise, whether administrative detention and deprivation of nationality for returning jihadists are warranted. The government answered that such videos are not punishable per se, that NCTV asks providers to act under their own terms, that the AIVD reprioritised internally, that existing criminal tools suffice instead of administrative detention, and that deprivation of nationality is possible only for dual nationals after a final terrorism conviction.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moors en van Oosten over een trust framework en eID

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about trust frameworks and personal data stores that give citizens control over their data, and about the government's role in e-identity initiatives. The minister answered that the government follows and partly supports such initiatives, that supervision is still being studied, and that legislation may be needed depending on the framework.
The cabinet set out in its e-privacy letter of 24 May 2013 several conditions for protecting personal data in the customer-business relationship.
Het kabinet heeft in haar e-privacybrief van 24 mei 2013 4 een aantal randvoorwaarden gesteld voor de bescherming van persoonsgegevens in de relatie klant-bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘NVRR wil normbedrag voor rekenkamers’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about reports that the NVRR wants a standard minimum budget for municipal audit committees, and about budget cuts, small-scale organisation, and inactive audit bodies. The minister acknowledged the risk that cuts impair audit functions, said he opposes a fixed norm amount because budgeting is a municipal prerogative, and promised to monitor developments and ask inactive municipalities for progress reports.

It is of great importance that every municipal council in the Netherlands has an active audit committee sufficiently equipped to examine the effectiveness, efficiency and lawfulness of the administration conducted.

Het is van groot belang dat elke gemeenteraad in Nederland beschikt over een actieve rekenkamer die voldoende is geëquipeerd om onderzoek te doen naar de doeltreffendheid, doelmatigheid en rechtmatigheid van het gevoerde bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Bosma over een nieuwe pro-EU-oproep bij de stempas, ditmaal van de burgemeester van Bergen, NH

PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior whether a municipal letter sent with EP election polling cards, which mentioned EU regulation, was unacceptable and whether the mayor of Bergen should be called to account. The minister replied that the letter does not argue for more or less EU involvement, saw no need for a talk with the mayor, and knew of no signals of other municipalities trying to influence voters, so no investigation was planned.
I therefore see no reason to carry out the investigation you requested.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om het door u gevraagde onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosma en Wilders over verkapt stemadvies van de gemeente Sittard

PVV MPs asked whether it is unacceptable that the municipality of Sittard sent residents a pro-EU letter that they considered covert voting advice, and whether the mayor should be made to retract it. The minister answered that the letter describes the EU's importance and does not amount to voting advice for any party, that voters are free to choose, and that a conversation with the mayor is not necessary.
The mayor's letter describes the importance of the EU and therefore cannot reasonably be regarded as voting advice for or against any party contesting the European Parliament election.
De brief van de burgemeester beschrijft wat het belang van de EU is en kan daarmee redelijkerwijs niet worden beschouwd als stemadvies voor of tegen enige partij
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Jadnanansing over het bericht ‘Taalbarrière stremt Sabaanse Studenten’

MPs Van Laar and Jadnanansing asked about reports that Saban students struggle with language barriers in Dutch higher education and about barriers to studying in the United States. The minister said the data do not show most Saban students failing in the Netherlands, acknowledged language and cultural difficulties, pointed to extra Dutch lessons, a preparatory programme and an inventory of study options due to be completed in August 2014.
From the DUO data above it cannot be concluded that the majority of Saban students run into problems when studying in the Netherlands.
Uit de hierboven weergegeven gegevens van de DUO kan niet worden opgemaakt dat het merendeel van de Sabaanse studenten bij studie in Nederland in de problemen komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten dat de overheid op Brenno de Winter jaagde

An MP asked whether a police alert flagging activist Brenno de Winter was still active after a correction letter, and why a prior request was ignored. The minister answered that the alert was removed on 10 March 2014, all police units were told to delete any such flags, and a national protocol on disclosure of data is being developed.
Within the force, all police units were instructed, as a precaution, to remove and destroy any alerts concerning him.
Binnen het korps is volledigheidshalve aan alle politie-eenheden opgedragen om eventuele aandachtsvestigingen hem aangaande te verwijderen en te vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘Netbeheerder Alliander wil hoger loon topman dan nu is toegestaan’

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked whether grid operator Alliander, which falls under the WNT pay cap, should be exempt, why state-owned TenneT and Gasunie are outside the WNT, and whether Alliander's German expansion is a loophole. The minister replied that Alliander remains under the WNT, that the draft bill keeps regional grid operators covered, that state holdings follow a separate pay framework, and that international activity is not a loophole.
Alliander falls under the WNT. As a result, it is not permitted to offer a salary above the WNT pay maximum.
Alliander valt onder de WNT. Daardoor is het niet toegestaan om een bezoldiging boven het bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT aan te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het Grondwetfestival en de openstelling van overheidsgebouwen

An MP asked whether the Grondwetfestival and opening of government buildings such as parliament, ministries and the Catshuis should be seen as a success, and whether such buildings should be open to the public at least annually, including Het Torentje. The minister agreed it was a success and said the ministry will take the initiative, with The Hague and partners, to explore a suitable follow-up to public openings of constitution-related buildings.

Following the findings of the National Committee 200 Years Kingdom on the Grondwet Festival, the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will take the initiative, in consultation with The Hague municipality and other partners, to examine how a suitable follow-up can be given to attention for the Constitution and the opening of related buildings.

Mede naar aanleiding van de bevindingen van het Nationaal Comité 200 jaar Koninkrijk over het Grondwet Festival zal het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties het initiatief nemen om in overleg met de gemeente Den Haag en andere partners te bezien op welke wijze een passend vervolg kan worden gegeven
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Segers over de stijging van de grafrechten

Two MPs (Bisschop and Segers) asked the Interior Minister about sharp rises in municipal grave fees and price differences of up to 7,500 euro, and asked whether the state checks that fees do not exceed actual costs, whether it will require transparency and tariff moderation, and why grave costs were omitted from the COELO study. The minister answered that fee-setting is an autonomous municipal competence, that objections and appeal to the courts are the available remedy, that a 2010 handbook on fees is being updated, and declined to act on moderation or additional monitoring.
Setting municipal grave fees is an autonomous competence and responsibility of the municipal council.
Het vaststellen van de gemeentelijke grafrechten is een autonome bevoegdheid en verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de berichten ‘Stadsbestuur let onvoldoende op de centen’ en ‘We zijn geen applausmachine van het college’

MP Fokke asked the Minister of Interior about reports that municipal boards pay insufficient attention to finances and that councils are not a rubber stamp for the executive, including how many municipalities lack a sound annual account and how responsibilities are divided among municipal board, auditor and audit office. The Minister answered that most municipalities receive unqualified auditor opinions, that councils take their oversight role seriously, that a follow-up survey will report in autumn, and that legislation strengthening audit offices is pending in the Senate.
Because of the expansion of municipal tasks in the social domain from budget year 2015, I will again map in the coming years the nature of the auditor statements issued.

Vanwege de uitbreiding van de gemeentelijke taken voor het sociaal domein per begrotingsjaar 2015 zal ik de komende jaren opnieuw in kaart laten brengen wat de aard van de afgegeven accountantsverklaringen is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over stijging van de Onroerende Zaak Belasting (OZB) boven de door overheden vastgestelde en aanvaarde ‘Macronorm’, en de gevolgen hiervan voor de individuele burger

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Interior about OZB property tax increases exceeding the agreed macro-norm, the COELO findings on the sanction mechanism, and protection for individual homeowners. The Minister confirmed the 2014 overshoot, said municipal tariffs are an autonomous council decision, and deferred substantive answers on the norm and sanctions to an ongoing evaluation discussed with the VNG.
The analysis of the 2014 macro-norm overshoot will be discussed with the VNG in the administrative consultation on financial relations (BOFv) on 19 May.
De (analyse van de) overschrijding van de macronorm 2014 wordt besproken met de VNG in het bestuurlijk overleg financiële verhoudingen (BOFv), dat op 19 mei plaats zal vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Rijk koopt XPocalypse af via extra support van Microsoft’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the central government signed a multi-million contract with Microsoft for custom support on Windows XP, why municipalities are excluded, and what measures prevent dependence on one software vendor. The minister confirmed a 2.48 million euro custom support agreement until April 2015, denied that Microsoft required migration to Windows 7 or 8, and said municipalities are responsible for their own ICT contracts while dependence is managed through open tendering.
The total amount for this custom contract is 2,480,000 euros, excluding VAT.
Het totaal bedrag voor dit maatwerk contract is 2.480.000 Euro, exclusief BTW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Rebel over jongeren die identiteitskaarten vervalsen om aan alcohol te komen

MPs Oosenbrug and Rebel asked about young people forging or borrowing ID cards to buy alcohol, including whether scanners make forgery easy, whether prosecution occurs, and whether bar owners check authenticity. The minister said the Dutch ID card is hard to forge, that police act on reported cases, and that bars should check security features more carefully, while noting the survey's representativeness is unclear and committing to no new concrete measures.
The NOS report shows that more attention is needed in the hospitality sector here.
Het NOS-bericht laat zien dat hier in de horeca meer aandacht voor moet zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over over het weigeren meerjarige tapstatistieken van de AIVD openbaar te maken

Thieme (PvdD) asked whether Minister Plasterk was right to refuse public release of multi-year AIVD wiretap statistics, despite CTIVD's view that they are not state secret. The minister confirmed the refusal, arguing that long-run tap figures would reveal the service's modus operandi and that disclosure breaches the secrecy duty in article 15 WIV 2002, while noting the exact figures are shared confidentially with the parliamentary committee and the CTIVD.
Publicly disclosing that data would violate the secrecy obligation laid down in article 15 of the Intelligence and Security Services Act (WIV2002).
Het openbaar maken van die gegevens is in strijd met de geheimhoudingsplicht, zoals vastgelegd in artikel 15 van de Wet op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (WIV2002).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Van Hijum over het bericht ‘Overheveling van taken treft vooral zwakste gemeenten’

Two CDA MPs asked the government whether the decentralisation of youth care, elderly care and Wajong to municipalities hits the financially weakest municipalities hardest and whether municipalities can carry these tasks. The minister answered that the claim is not supported by the comparison made, that a historical distribution model applies for 2015, and that municipalities will get budget clarity in the May circular, while largely restating existing policy.
There is no question of a trial calculation.
Van een proefberekening is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘Minister Plasterk kort noordelijke provincies ten gunste van Randstad’

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about reports that the planned 2015-2016 municipal fund revision cuts northern provinces in favour of the Randstad, including the Rfv's criticism and the use of 2010 cost data. The minister answered that the redistribution is cost-based, that only one municipality faces a 6% cut, that the 2010 patterns were checked and found comparable, and that a transition arrangement applies.
The distribution of the municipal fund is based on the costs municipalities incur and their opportunities to generate own revenue.
De verdeling van het gemeentefonds is gebaseerd op de kosten die gemeenten maken en de mogelijkheden om eigen inkomsten te verwerven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over de loonverdubbeling bij het overheidsbedrijf Enexis

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked the government about a reported salary doubling for the Enexis board, whether Enexis faces competition, whether it is a fully public company, and whether the WNT pay cap applies. The minister answered that Enexis falls under the 130% WNT cap, that the board letter was a consultation response on lowering the cap that some read as a pay-doubling proposal (which Enexis denies), that the grid operator is a regulated monopoly with tariffs set by the ACM, and that the company is a regular private-law NV owned by provinces and municipalities.
In any case, under the WNT it is not possible to set a salary increase that exceeds the maximum remuneration norm.
Het is op basis van de WNT in ieder geval niet mogelijk om een loonsverhoging vast te stellen waarmee de maximale bezoldigingsnorm wordt overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosma over de berichten ‘PvdA Zuid-Holland: Geen functies meer voor PVV'ers’ en ‘D66 en SP Brabant willen PVV'er weg als voorzitter’

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Interior whether it is acceptable that PvdA, SP and D66 seek to exclude PVV members from committee chairs and provincial functions, and how this can be prevented. The Minister answered that he does not intervene in party choices unless they breach the law, and that committee composition and chairmanship fall within the autonomy of provincial states and councils.
Since the composition of such committees, including the chairmanship, falls within the autonomy of subnational governments, it is not for the Minister of the Interior to intervene.
Aangezien de samenstelling van dergelijke commissies, met inbegrip van het voorzitterschap, tot de autonomie van decentrale overheden behoort, is het niet aan de Minister van BZK om hierin te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over de toekomst van het Openbaar Ministerie en de landsrecherche op Sint Maarten

MPs Van Laar and Bosman asked about Dutch responsibility for the Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten, the temporary reinforcement of the Landsrecherche, mediation with the Rijksrecherche, the Aruba/Curaçao cooperation convenant, and whether prosecution capacity is sufficient. The government answered that law enforcement is an autonomous competence of the countries, that the temporary capacity boost has ended, that Sint Maarten's request for extra capacity is under review, and that capacity is considered adequate.
The Public Prosecution Service on Sint Maarten falls under the consensus national ordinance on the public prosecution services of Curaçao, Sint Maarten and Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Sint Maarten valt onder de consensus-Rijkswet «Rijkswet openbare Ministeries van Curaçao, van Sint Maarten en van Bonaire, Sint Eustatius en Saba».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Van Raak en Sjoerdsma (D66) over het bericht dat Nederlandse data mogelijk zijn gebruikt bij drone-aanvallen

MPs from SP and D66 asked whether Dutch intelligence from MIVD, shared for antipiracy operations off Somalia, may have been used for US drone targeted killings, and about the legal basis and data-sharing arrangements with the US. The government answered that it does not work with illegal targeted killings, cannot confirm or deny the specifics of partner use or the number of drone strikes, will not comment publicly on NSA or partner-service cooperation, and sees no indication that the shared intelligence was used in breach of international law.

If it were shown that a foreign partner demonstrably carries out illegal targeted killings for which Dutch information is also used, this will lead to a renewed assessment of whether such intelligence is shared with that partner.

Als zou blijken dat een buitenlandse partner aantoonbaar illegale targeted killings uitvoert, waarvoor ook Nederlandse informatie wordt gebruikt, zal dit leiden tot het opnieuw beoordelen van de vraag of dergelijke inlichtingen met die partner worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het afluisteren door de NSA van alle telefoonnummers in een land

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of the Interior whether the government knew of the NSA's MYSTIC program, which reportedly recorded all phone calls in a country, and whether Dutch citizens, telecom providers or Dutch intelligence services were involved. The minister answered that the cabinet is not aware of a program under that name and has no indications that Dutch citizens were targeted, and agreed to answer before the plenary debate.
The cabinet is not aware of an NSA program under the name Mystic.
Het kabinet is niet op de hoogte van een NSA-programma onder de naam Mystic.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over strafbare feiten begaan door ambtenaren

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether reported cases of possible criminal offences by civil servants are rarely reported to police or prosecutors, and how reporting obligations and integrity enforcement work. The Minister answered that 53 criminal complaints were filed in 2011-2012 in the central government sector, that internal disciplinary enforcement is primary, that existing law already covers reporting duties, and that no additional regulation is considered necessary.
The data concern the central government sector, excluding the Ministry of Defence and zbo's (independent administrative bodies).
Het betreft de registratie in de sector Rijk, exclusief het Ministerie van Defensie en zbo's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Madlener en Wilders over gesjoemel met EU-subsidie voor moskeeën

MPs asked whether Amsterdam and the Interior Ministry obtained EU subsidy for two mosques by misdescribing a building as a multicultural centre, and asked about a mosque construction halt and punishment of those responsible. The minister answered that the mosque part was excluded from subsidy, that the subsidy went to Amsterdam Groot-Oost rather than the ministry, that the OLAF investigation outcome is pending, and rejected a construction halt and a withdrawal of EU involvement.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het aantal computers bij gemeenten die nog op basis van Windows XP werken

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about municipal computers still running Windows XP, the security risks, and the government's responsibility for citizen cybersecurity.
