The Minister answered that responsibility lies with each government body, that partial inventory exists, that CSA arrangements and advisories were issued, and that the government is encouraging migration without committing to a firm mandatory deadline.
Central government bodies, municipalities, provinces and water boards are and remain themselves responsible for how they appropriately shape their ICT replacement policy.
Overheidsorganisaties bij het Rijk, gemeenten, provincies en waterschappen zijn en blijven zelf verantwoordelijk voor de wijze waarop zij passend invulling geven aan hun ICT- vervangingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Raak over het bericht dat staatsraden nevenfuncties hebben bij loterijen

MPs Schouw and Van Raak asked whether two Council of State councillors holding side positions at lottery organisations, and councillors with close ties to lottery bodies in the advising section, create a conflict of interest and undermine the Council's advisory authority. Minister Plasterk answered that the side positions are public, no councillors with lottery ties sit in the section handling the online gambling bill, and that appointments are vetted under the Council of State Act and recusal rules.
In the section of the Advisory Division currently handling the bill amending the Betting and Gaming Act, there are no councillors with side positions at lottery organisations.

In de sectie van de Afdeling advisering die momenteel het voorstel van wet tot wijziging van de Wet op de kansspelen ... in behandeling heeft, zitten geen staatsraden met nevenfuncties in loterijorganisaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Hoeder privacy: gemeente laks met veiligheid data’

MP Van Toorenburg asked the Minister of Interior about reports that many municipalities still run Windows XP after Microsoft ends support, and about privacy risks as municipalities take on more sensitive social-domain data. The Minister says migration away from Windows XP is under way and responsibility lies with municipalities, points to the Taskforce BID, a planned Privacy Impact Assessment and a forthcoming policy vision, and states that municipalities are actively working on information security.
Citizens must be able to trust at all times that personal data is handled carefully.
Burgers moeten er te allen tijde op kunnen vertrouwen dat er zorgvuldig wordt omgegaan met persoonsgegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het opmerkelijke aantal ‘spookstemmen’ uitgebracht bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen

MP Klein (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Interior about the large gaps between counted ballots and counted voters in the 2014 municipal elections, which could affect final results. Minister Plasterk answered that the gaps stem from many causes including counting and procedural errors, that the ministry evaluates each election, that a recount is possible only in limited circumstances, and that voting machines would not fully remove the problem.
For the municipal council and European Parliament elections, my ministry has made a new instruction available to the municipalities.
Voor de verkiezing van de gemeenteraden en het Europees Parlement is door mijn ministerie een nieuwe instructie aan de gemeenten beschikbaar gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over ‘spookstemmen’ en onregelmatigheden bij de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2014

An MP asked the Interior Minister about discrepancies in 235 municipalities between voter turnout and counted ballots in the 2014 municipal elections, and whether electronic voting should be reintroduced sooner. The minister confirmed the discrepancies, referred to earlier answers on the cause of the counting errors, and said no faster timeline than the cabinet's stated plan for electronic voting is possible.
I see no possibility to follow a different timeline than the one set out in the cabinet position
Ik zie geen mogelijkheid om een ander tijdpad te volgen dan is weergegeven in het kabinetsstandpunt

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Taverne over de storing op de website van de gemeente Den Haag waardoor Nederlandse kiezers uit het buitenland zich niet konden registreren voor de verkiezingen van het Europees Parlement

MP Taverne asked the Minister of Interior about a website fault in The Hague that prevented Dutch voters abroad from registering online for the European Parliament elections, asking how long it lasted, how to prevent recurrence, and whether the registration deadline should be extended. The minister answered that the form was unusable for a short period, a PDF alternative was posted, monitoring was intensified, and no extension was deemed necessary.
The municipality of The Hague has intensified monitoring of the web form on its website so that any new fault can be detected and resolved more quickly.
De gemeente Den Haag heeft de monitoring van het webformulierde website geïntensiveerd om zo een eventuele nieuwe storing sneller te kunnen detecteren en op te lossen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Adviespunt Klokkenluiders: de ambtenaar is niet goed beschermd’

MPs Fokke and Kerstens asked whether many Dutch municipalities lack public whistleblower schemes, whether weak scheme visibility reflects poor integrity, and what happened to around a hundred whistleblowers who contacted the Expert Group. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities must have a procedure by law, that public visibility is desirable though not tracked, and that the government has no insight into the individual cases while pointing to existing support bodies and an evaluation planned for 2014.
The cabinet has no insight into the fate of the hundred whistleblowers who reported to the Expert Group Whistleblowers over the past two years.
Het kabinet heeft geen inzicht in de lotgevallen van de honderd klokkenluiders die zich de afgelopen twee jaar bij de Expertgroep Klokkenluiders hebben gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een ernstige misstand bij het ruimen van een graf

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about a reported grave-clearance error in which a second, male set of remains was cremated with a woman's body, and whether the Handleiding opgraven en ruimen should be made mandatory. The minister said the facts are still being investigated and a fuller reply will follow by mid-May, and declined to make the handbook mandatory because municipalities already act carefully.
At this moment it is still being investigated what happened here and what the exact course of events was.
Op dit moment wordt nog uitgezocht wat hier is gebeurd en wat de exacte gang van zaken is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het wetsvoorstel afschaffen precariobelasting voor nutsbedrijven

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipal precario tax revenues are rising, whether utility network operators bear the highest burden in a way that spreads costs to all users, and why a bill exempting utilities from precario tax, drafted since 2011 with a Council of State advice in 2012, has not yet been sent to parliament. The minister confirmed rising precario revenues, estimated about 70 municipalities levy it on utility networks, and said the Council of State advice required further study, with a decision on the chosen variant expected in the first half of 2014.
Your House is expected to be informed about this in the first half of 2014.
Uw Kamer zal daarover naar verwachting in de eerste helft van 2014 worden geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over de ophef die is ontstaan sinds het nieuws dat de veroordeelde pedoseksueel Benno L. in Leiden huisvesting heeft gekregen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior and Justice about public outcry over housing a convicted sex offender in Leiden, including whether mayors and councils should be informed and whether citizens should have more say. The minister acknowledged residents' concerns, said mayors decide case by case with partners and need not inform the council beforehand, and announced a joint VNG/OM/reclassering meeting in March 2014 without committing to new structural powers.
Based on the risk analysis, the mayor will decide how and with whom to communicate in order to safeguard the neighbourhood's safety, the victim and the returning sex offender.

Op basis van de risicoanalyse zal de burgemeester beslissen op welke manier en met wie gecommuniceerd dient te worden om de veiligheid van de wijk, het slachtoffer en de terugkerende zedendelinquent te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Afvalboete blijft bij gemeenten’

MP Van Toorenburg asked whether Brabant municipalities face fines from waste processor Attero for under-delivering residual waste because residents separate their waste, and why Attero has not fined them. The minister answered that the contracts are private-law matters between municipalities and Attero outside his remit, that the province has no direct role, and that the clause causing the perverse incentive will be dropped in a new contract from 2017.
As Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, I cannot intervene in the underlying agreements.
Ik kan als Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties niet treden in onderliggende overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Oosenbrug over het afwijzen van een geboorteakte van het geadopteerde kind van een homostel

MPs Recourt and Oosenbrug asked about a Florida birth certificate for an adopted child of a same-sex couple that omitted the biological mother, which the civil registry office Landelijke Taken did not register. State Secretary Teeven answered that there is no flaw in the law since the mother is the legal parent, that no formal application or refusal was made so no court appeal arose, and that the registry checks for conflict with Dutch public order.
In my view there is no flaw in the law.
Er is in mijn optiek geen sprake van een weeffout in de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Van Laar over het bericht ‘Nibud bevestigt dat Bonaire ver onder de armoedegrens leeft’

MPs Kuzu and Van Laar asked about a report by the Nibud finding that Bonaire lives well below the poverty line, and whether the government has the report and how it compares to the CBS study and the social minimum in the European Netherlands. The State Secretary answered that Bonaire commissioned the report for its own poverty policy, that the Nibud figures are reference amounts not norms, that the CBS study is a separate economic study, and that the government will engage with the island's executive but will not base national minimum wage or benefit levels on the Nibud report.
The Nibud study cannot be the basis for national policy on the levels of the statutory minimum wage and benefits.
Het Nibud-onderzoek kan niet de basis zijn voor het rijksbeleid ten aanzien van de niveaus van het wettelijk minimumloon en de uitkeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de berichten dat de overheid jaagde op Brenno de Winter

An MP asked whether the government tracked and warned about journalist Brenno de Winter, and whether sharing his personal data was lawful. The minister confirmed internal security warnings were sent, admitted that personal data including his address was shared improperly, and said a protocol on sharing personal information within the state security domain will be drafted and sent to parliament.
To prevent this in the future, a protocol will be drawn up on sharing personal information within the state security domain.
Om dit in de toekomst te voorkomen zal een protocol worden opgesteld over deling van persoonsinformatie binnen het beveiligingsdomein van het Rijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bouwmeester over het bericht ‘Groeiende kritiek op medische uitzendingen ZVK’

MPs Van Laar and Bouwmeester asked about criticism of the medical referral system (ZVK) for patients from Caribbean Netherlands, including an open letter from Han de Bruijne that the minister says never reached her ministry. The minister partly accepts the criticism, citing complexity and bureaucracy, notes satisfaction survey results, and lists improvements under way, with a Coomeva study expected by year end.
The ZVK is currently undertaking a major improvement effort, which should be completed during 2014.
Het ZVK is momenteel met een flinke verbeterslag bezig, die in de loop van 2014 zijn beslag moet krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over voorlichting voor kiezers buiten Nederland

MP Sjoerdsma asked how voter registration for the 2014 European Parliament election among Dutch citizens abroad is being promoted, including direct outreach and EU-national outreach. Minister Plasterk answered that registration numbers are lower than in 2009 mainly due to the absence of local campaigning in Aruba, that information campaigns are comparable to 2012, and that municipalities were advised to actively approach EU nationals in the Netherlands.
Organising the elections is a national matter, and so is informing voters about the voting process.
Het organiseren van de verkiezingen is een nationale aangelegenheid en daarmee ook het informeren over het stemproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Neppérus en Van der Linde over het bericht dat criminelen zich laten uitschrijven uit de GBA en daarmee belasting ontduiken

Two VVD MPs asked whether criminals deregister from the GBA population register to evade tax, what revenue is lost, whether the new BRP accounts for this, how data is exchanged with other countries, and how emigration of Dutch non-residents is tracked. The minister said losses cannot be quantified since criminal activity is hidden by definition (FIOD research ongoing), explained the BRP's new fines for false registration and non-resident registration, and described limited direct data exchange abroad and municipal verification and reporting mechanisms.
For that reason it is by definition not possible to give concrete figures on this.
Daarom is het per definitie niet mogelijk om hierover concrete cijfers te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mei Li Vos over topinkomens bij goede doelen loterijen

MPs Kerstens and Mei Li Vos asked about top incomes at lottery operators for good causes, whether lottery revenue flows to founders, whether licensing imposes pay conditions, and the enforcement against an unlicensed British lottery and illegal operators. The Secretary of State answered that the statutory 50% pay-out to good causes is met, that the regulator sets no pay conditions yet, that the British site could not be verified, and that persistent illegal operators will be excluded from licences.
The gambling authority has informed me that, when granting licences, it currently sets no requirements regarding the remuneration policy of lotteries that finance good causes.

De kansspelautoriteit heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten bij het verlenen van vergunningen momenteel geen eisen te stellen ten aanzien van het beloningsbeleid van loterijen die goede doelen financieren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Hachchi over het verschuiven van de waterschapsbelasting van boeren naar burgers

MPs Schouw and Hachchi asked about a TV report claiming water board levies shifted from farmers to citizens, and whether reserved seats on water boards misrepresent interests. The minister says the figures cover the whole 'Ongebouwd' category, not just farmland, are not directly comparable over time, and that the reserved seats are a deliberate balance of interests, with evaluation planned alongside the 2015 elections.

As I promised in debate with your House on the bill amending the water board elections, the system of reserved seats will be included in an evaluation of the upcoming provincial elections combined with the water board elections in 2015.

Antwoord 7 Zoals ik heb toegezegd in debat met uw Kamer over het wetsvoorstel Wet aanpassing waterschapsverkiezingen ( Tweede Kamer, 2013–2014, 33719 ), wordt het systeem met geborgde zetels betrokken in een evaluatie van de komende statenverkiezingen gecombineerd met waterschapsverkiezingen in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Hijum over het artikel ‘Gemeente verhult grondverliezen met dubieuze boekhoudtrucs’

Van Hijum (CDA) asked the ministers of Finance and Interior whether municipalities hide land-development losses through accounting tricks, including reclassifying investments, low interest charges, stretched sale horizons, off-balance PPS risks and the size of write-downs. Minister Plasterk answered that municipalities appear to act within the BBV rules as far as provincial supervisors can judge, referred to Deloitte figures, and saw no reason for further action.
As far as I can judge, based on information we receive from the provincial supervisors, municipalities act within the framework of the regulations.
Voor zover ik kan beoordelen – op basis van de informatie die wij verkrijgen van de provinciale toezichthouders – handelen gemeenten binnen de kaders van de regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Van Raak over de verandering in de wijze van bekostiging van de waterschapslasten

MPs Van Gerven and Van Raak asked the ministers whether the shift of water board charges from agriculture to households is real, and whether the Delfland-inspired tariff differentiation and cost-allocation changes are consistent with the principle that charges are paid in proportion to benefit. The minister confirmed the shift is linked to water boards' growing urban role, that the 2012 amendment widening tariff differentiation was used by seven boards with provincial approval, and provided a table of cost shares for 2010 and 2013.

It is indeed the case that the water boards' task performance has changed substantially over the past decades and that they have taken more measures that serve the interests of urban areas and therefore of households.

Het is inderdaad zo dat de taakuitoefening van de waterschappen de laatste decennia ingrijpend is veranderd en dat zij meer maatregelen zijn gaan treffen die in het belang van het stedelijk gebied en daarmee van de huishoudens zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over uitsluiting van autoverzekering op grond van leeftijd

An MP asked the government about insurers refusing car insurance to older drivers on age grounds, whether this is age discrimination, what is being done about insurers' poor communication, the status of the EU equal treatment directive, and whether national anti-discrimination law will be introduced. The minister answered that age criteria may be justified by risk, that the AFM will watch insurers' information duties, that the EU directive negotiations are stalled, and that no national legislation is planned.
Unjustified distinction, on whatever ground, is not acceptable.
Ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid, op welke grond dan ook, is niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik en Hachchi over brandende vaten zwavelijzer bij de ISLA-raffinaderij

Two MPs asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about a fire involving drums of iron sulphide at the ISLA refinery on Curaçao, the resulting sulphur dioxide peak, health risks, how the drums ended up on a waste heap, and whether the refinery should be closed. The minister confirmed the fire, said the SO2 peak was higher than earlier hourly averages, described health effects, and said the refinery and any investigation are the autonomous responsibility of the Curaçao government.
The ISLA refinery is an autonomous responsibility of the government of Curaçao.
De Isla raffinaderij is een autonome verantwoordelijkheid van de regering van Curaçao.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat stemgedrag van raadsleden praktisch niet te achterhalen is

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether council members' voting records and council minutes should be publicly accessible and whether a national model for publishing them should be created. The minister answered that municipalities are autonomous, the Gemeentewet does not regulate disclosure of individual voting behaviour, municipalities should improve transparency themselves, and no national model is planned for now.
The municipalities form an autonomous tier of government.
De gemeenten vormen een autonome bestuurslaag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat bij de Olympische Spelen grootschalig gegevensopslag plaatsvindt van aanwezige sporters en andere geaccrediteerden

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the government whether Dutch Olympic visitors' communications data stored by Russia (three-year retention, accessible to the FSB and other unnamed agencies) could reach Dutch intelligence services and what was being done to inform and protect Dutch citizens. The government answered that Dutch intelligence services have no access to the database, that Dutch visitors are covered by a travel advisory and the Oranje Boekje, and that it cannot exclude storage of delegation members' data for security reasons.
Dutch intelligence and security services have no access to the said database.
Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten hebben geen toegang tot de genoemde database.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Bouwmeester over de transparantie van de lobbypraktijken van Nederlandse banken

MPs Nijboer and Bouwmeester asked whether the government would adopt SOMO's recommendations on transparency of Dutch banks' lobbying, including a 'lobby paragraph' in each bill, and whether similar transparency should apply to business generally. The minister replied that banks should implement recommendations themselves, that the government supports transparent accountability of stakeholder influence, and that consultation reports already function as such a lobby paragraph.
The cabinet therefore endorses the importance of transparent accountability for the influence of stakeholders on the policy process.
Het kabinet onderschrijft derhalve het belang van transparante verantwoording over die invloed van belanghebbenden op het beleidsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een brief van de provincie Noord-Holland

MP Van Raak asked the Minister of Interior whether he would send the Noord-Holland Commissioner of the King's letter and report on the taken and powers of the new-style province. The Minister answered yes, enclosing the letter, which relates to ongoing government discussions on the instruments of a merged northern-wing province.
Yes, enclosed I send you the relevant letter from the Commissioner of the King of the province of Noord-Holland including the annex.
Antwoord 1 Ja, bijgaand 1 stuur ik u de desbetreffende brief van de Commissaris van de Koning van de provincie Noord-Holland inclusief bijlage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak, Schouw, Segers en Klein over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur betreffende het satellietcomplex in Burum

MPs asked whether US forces have their own installation, SGS equipment and communication networks (USGNA, SIPRNet, JWICS, Blue Force Tracking, BGAN) at the Inmarsat teleport in Burum, and how the Dutch government supervises this. The minister answered that Inmarsat is a commercial operator subject to Dutch law, that the government has access to the site, that AIVD and MIVD found no indications of foreign intelligence activity there, and that the military part of Burum hosts only Dutch government equipment.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Eijsink en Recourt over de inlichtingenvergaring in Burum naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Nieuwsuur op 13 januari 2014

MPs Eijsink and Recourt asked the Defence and Interior ministers about signals intelligence activities at Burum after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, including US equipment, oversight, and payments. The minister replied that Inmarsat provides commercial telecom services under Dutch law supervised by the Agentschap Telecom, that AIVD and MIVD have no indications of intelligence activity at Burum, and gave general answers on cooperation with partner services and US Government Network questions.
No public statements can be made about the partner services.
Over de partnerdiensten kunnen in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat de presentatie van het door de Kamer verzochte CTIVD-onderzoek wordt uitgesteld

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether reports of a delayed CTIVD intelligence oversight report were accurate and why parliament was not informed, and asked for the report to be sent immediately. The minister denied the delay, said the CTIVD chair will hand over the report on 7 February, and committed to sending it to parliament within four weeks of receipt.
My aim is to do this within four weeks of receiving the adopted investigation report.
Mijn streven is om dit binnen vier weken na ontvangst van het vastgestelde onderzoeksrapport te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het subsidiëren van een aan Milli Gorus gelieerde islamitische stichting

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a Milli Gorus-affiliated youth foundation (MGT) receiving municipal subsidy should lose its funding after its annual report was written 'in the name of Allah', and what measures the government would take. The minister answered that the Amsterdam-West district is responsible for subsidy decisions, that MGT received about EUR 21,725.50 in 2013 for two project subsidies with no 2014 subsidy so far, and that the subsidies do not violate church-state separation, so no further measures were announced.
In this case it is up to the Amsterdam-West district to weigh the granting of subsidies.
Het is in dit geval aan het stadsdeel Amsterdam-West om een afweging te maken ten aanzien van het verstrekken van subsidies.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Liefde, Bosman en Aukje De Vries over het bericht dat de aanleg van glasvezel in Caribisch Nederland twee keer duurder is dan begroot en volledig door de Nederlandse belastingbetaler wo

MPs from the VVD asked why the Caribbean Netherlands submarine fibre cable cost roughly double its budget, why the state took on extra costs, and why it became a shareholding in SSCS B.V. without prior parliamentary approval. The minister replied that costs exceeded the original estimate by about EUR 8.9 million (not a doubling), that the extra funds covered redundancy and protection, that the shareholding was a transitional choice under the Comptabiliteitswet, and that the company is non-profit with cost-based tariffs.
With my letter of 9 December I aimed to align as closely as possible, albeit retrospectively, with the normal procedure of Article 34.
Met mijn brief van 9 december jl. heb ik beoogd zoveel mogelijk, zij het achteraf, aan te sluiten bij de normale procedure van artikel 34.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat het waterschap Aa en Maas aan Heineken subsidie verstrekt

An MP asks whether a water board's confidential handling of an anti-disconnection subsidy to Heineken, and the limited public information on such schemes, undermines voters' ability to be informed. The minister replies that the scheme is an approved, publicly documented mechanism, that the decision was taken in public session with the criteria available, and that no action is needed.
No current data are available on the number of companies per water board receiving subsidies under the scheme.
Over het aantal bedrijven per waterschap dat op grond van de regeling subsidie ontvangt zijn geen actuele gegevens beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked ministers about postal delivery in the Caribbean Netherlands, including e-commerce access, postcodes, whether the ACM supervises the islands, and the change of ownership of concession holder Flamingo Communications. Minister Kamp answered that e-commerce is a market matter outside the postal concession, that postcode costs are unknown, that the ACM's tasks are set by the Wet post BES with no general competition oversight on the islands, and that the ownership change did not affect Flamingo's assessment.
In the Caribbean Netherlands the ACM has no tasks in general competition supervision, as laid down in the Mededingingswet in the European Netherlands.
In Caribisch Nederland heeft de ACM geen taken in het kader van generiek mededingingstoezicht, zoals dat in Europees Nederland is neergelegd in de Mededingingswet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van persoonsgegevens uit de Gemeentelijke Basis Administratie (GBA) aan de Stichting Interkerkelijke Ledenadministratie (SILA)

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the systematic supply of GBA population-register data to the SILA church membership foundation is lawful, given a Council of State advice that the historical justification was insufficient. The Minister said the justification was supplemented after that advice, declined to predict court outcomes, and saw no reason to end the data supply.
In the supplementary report of 25 November 2013, following the Division's advice, the justification for the data supply to SILA was supplemented in the explanatory note to the draft decree.

In het nader rapport van 25 november 2013 is, naar aanleiding van het advies van de Afdeling de motivering van de gegevensverstrekking aan de SILA in de nota van toelichting van het ontwerpbesluit aangevuld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Dijkhoff, Elias en Litjens over het artikel ‘Onderzoek naar corruptie KLM werd vroegtijdig gestaakt’

MPs from the VVD asked whether a Caribbean corruption investigation into KLM-linked bribery was stopped early after a judge-commissioner imposed a four-month time limit, and why. The minister answered that the time limit was set under the reasonable-time rules, the prosecution prioritised two of eight files, the Oil Trading Bonaire file was dropped, and a later court complaint was only partly upheld.
The Public Prosecution Service on Bonaire has informed me that neither the Oil Trading Bonaire file nor other investigation has shown any free business-class flights.
Het Openbaar Ministerie op Bonaire heeft mij bericht dat noch uit het dossier «Oil Trading Bonaire», noch uit overig onderzoek, is gebleken over gratis businessclassvluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het rapport ‘Metamonitor veilige publieke taak 2013’ inzake geweld en agressie tegen hulpverleners

Member Bontes asked the ministers about a 2013 report showing high rates of violence and aggression against public-sector workers in police, care and education, and whether the government would act. The minister states the government finds this unacceptable, points to a zero-tolerance policy and improved reporting, and says existing measures and municipal-led efforts will continue with six-monthly progress reports to parliament.
From the programme and the Safe Public Task expertise centre (VPT), all employers and employees involved are encouraged and supported to implement the eight VPT measures down to the shop-floor level.

Vanuit het programma en het expertisecentrum Veilige Publieke Taak (VPT) worden alle betrokken werkgevers en werknemers gestimuleerd en ondersteund om de acht VPT-maatregelen 3 tot op het niveau van de werkvloer te implementeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Segers over de negatieve verevening voor gemeenten waar windmolens worden gebouwd

MPs Dik-Faber and Segers asked whether municipalities hosting wind turbines lose much of the extra OZB revenue to negative equalisation in the Gemeentefonds, and whether this undermines local support and benefit-sharing. The ministers answered that wind turbines are equalised only at 70% of the notional OZB base, that 58% of turbine value falls under the machinery exemption and is excluded from the WOZ base, and that OZB is not an instrument for building local support, which rests on participation and financial participation schemes.
I do not recognise the problem you describe, because equalisation only concerns OZB revenues insofar as the windmill does not fall under the machinery exemption.
Het door u geschetste probleem herken ik niet omdat de verevening alleen ziet op de OZB-opbrengsten voor zover de windmolen niet onder de werktuigenvrijstelling valt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Rebel over de handhaving van de Drank- en Horecawet voor 16- en 17-jarigen

An MP asked whether municipalities may deviate from the new alcohol age limit of 18 through transitional arrangements tied to public order, and how the government views the enforcement consequences. The state secretary answered that municipalities set enforcement priorities but may not deviate from the statutory age limits or create transitional periods, and that the government trusts local balancing of interests.
However, this does not mean that one may deviate from the age limits as laid down by law, nor that a transitional period may be created for a certain group of young people.
Dit betekent echter niet dat mag worden afgeweken van de leeftijdsgrenzen zoals die bij wet zijn vastgelegd en ook niet dat een overgangsperiode mag worden gecreëerd voor een bepaalde groep jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de methode datamining

An MP asks two ministers whether the ARGO II intelligence processing system amounts to data mining, given that the Interior Minister in 2010 rejected data mining while Defence was preparing ARGO II. The Defence Minister answers that ARGO II only processes SIGINT already collected within the 2002 intelligence law and does not exploit databases indiscriminately, so the two positions are reconcilable.
ARGO II replaces ARGO I, the MIVD's current processing system for SIGINT (Signals Intelligence).
ARGO II vervangt ARGO I, het huidige verwerkingssysteem van SIGINT (Signals Intelligence – verbindingsinlichtingen) van de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over vertrouwelijke bijlages bij CTIVD-rapporten

An MP asked whether Snowden's revelations warrant publishing the secret annexes to several CTIVD oversight reports on the AIVD and MIVD, and why those annexes should stay secret. Minister Plasterk answered that the Wiv 2002 requires methods, sources and knowledge levels to be kept out of public reports, so the annexes cannot be published or shared beyond the CIVD, which already received them.
I therefore see no possibility to make the secret annexes public, nor to make them available for confidential inspection to any other part of your House than the CIVD
Ik zie dan ook geen mogelijkheden om geheime bijlagen openbaar te maken, noch om deze vertrouwelijk ter inzage te leggen aan enig ander onderdeel van uw Kamer dan de CIVD
Antwoord op vragen van het lid lid Van Raak over wachtgeld voor een ex-gedeputeerde van Noord-Holland

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether former Noord-Holland deputy Hooijmaijers, convicted by a court, should have his severance (wachtgeld) stopped and reclaimed, and whether the Appa pension law should be amended. The minister answered that benefits can only be stopped once a person is actually deprived of liberty by a final judgment, that the benefits received so far cannot be reclaimed, and that no legal amendment is planned.
Since Mr Hooijmaijers is entitled to the Appa benefit, I see no possibilities to reclaim the benefit granted so far.
Aangezien de heer Hooijmaijers recht heeft op de Appa-uitkering, zie ik geen mogelijkheden om de tot nu toe toegekende uitkering terug te vorderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het onderzoek naar activiteiten van inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten tegen Roel van Duijn

MP Voortman asks about the status of the CTIVD investigation into intelligence services' intrusion into Roel van Duijn's private life, whether the minister agreed to widen it to other bodies such as the Amsterdam police Groep IJzerman, and whether he will ask the CTIVD to include them. Minister Plasterk answers that the CTIVD investigation is ongoing and independent, that he asked it to examine the BVD's conduct toward Van Duijn, and that the CTIVD's remit covers only the AIVD, so other police conduct falls outside it unless acting on BVD orders.
However, it is not the task of this committee to investigate the police other than where they fall under the responsibility of the AIVD or BVD.
Het is echter niet de taak van deze commissie om onderzoek te doen naar de politie anders dan vallend onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de AIVD of BVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Groot over de uitzending ‘Caribisch Nederland, Drie jaar later, Bonaire’

Two MPs asked the government about a broadcast on Bonaire's high prices, falling real incomes, electricity and produce costs, and competition, and whether the 2010 tax reform and the switch to the US dollar caused price rises. The minister answered at length, acknowledging strong price rises and partly attributing them to global factors and dollarisation, citing indexation, tax relief and planned electricity and price regulation, while admitting gaps in data.
The Statistics Netherlands has started a study into, among other things, income developments on the islands.
Het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek is een onderzoek gestart naar, onder andere, (bewegingen in) de inkomenssfeer op de eilanden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht “Hulp mentor bij studiekeus allochtone jongere”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Link2Work project for jongeren, which they described as aimed at allochtone youth, discriminates against autochthonous youth, and demanded an apology and its termination. Minister Asscher replied that Link2Work is open to all youth needing extra help in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, makes no distinction by ethnicity or origin, and that many participants are expected to have a migrant background due to the population of those cities.
No distinction is made on the basis of ethnicity or origin.
Er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar etniciteit of afkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Bosman over het advies van de SER van Sint Maarten om de Antilliaanse Gulden in te ruilen voor de US Dollar

Two MPs asked the Dutch ministers about the Sint Maarten SER advice to dollarize the Antillean guilder, including the Curaçao-Sint Maarten current account deficit, devaluation risks, and effects on BES islands. The government replied that dollarization is not currently planned, that the matter is for the countries themselves, and that it will share Dutch experience with Sint Maarten.
The peg between the Antillean guilder and the US dollar is a matter for the countries themselves.
De koppeling tussen de Antilliaanse gulden en de US Dollar is een aangelegenheid van de landen zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Baay-Timmerman over onduidelijkheid omtrent de gehandicaptenparkeerkaart

An MP asks the Interior Minister about inconsistent local parking rules for disabled parking card holders, the status of talks promised under an earlier motion, and whether national rules should be introduced. The minister states that the matter is a municipal competence, that talks have led only to requests to municipalities and operators, and that clear on-site signage is the preferred remedy rather than national rules.
Municipalities have an autonomous power to set the parking policy applying locally and the parking tax to be levied.
Gemeenten bezitten een autonome bevoegdheid tot het vaststellen van het ter plaatse geldende parkeerbeleid en de daarbij behorende te heffen parkeerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over tegenstrijdige uitspraken van de minister betreffende het NSA afluisterschandaal

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior to reconcile three of his earlier statements on the NSA wiretapping affair, including that data collected by the NSA should not have been collected or used and that he could not technically rule out intelligence based on NSA-derived information. The minister confirmed the statements, denied they contradict each other, explaining that the Wiv 2002 forbids untargeted bulk collection of cable metadata and that inter-service tips share only specific information without disclosing sources, so a tip could in theory have partly derived from such collection.
No, those statements do not contradict each other.
Nee, die uitspraken spreken elkaar niet tegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over berichten dat het makkelijker wordt om fraude te plegen als de Registratie niet-Ingezetenen ingevoerd wordt

An MP asks whether the Registratie Niet-Ingezetenen makes it easy for short-stay EU citizens to obtain a BSN and claim benefit allowances, and how the government handles fraud risk, municipal concerns and fraud prevention. The minister says a BSN confers no entitlement to benefits, that municipalities were consulted and a pilot is being developed, and that a new fraud-prevention bill lets the tax authority withhold allowance advances where fraud risk is high.
The citizen service number gives no right to benefits or subsidies.
Het burgerservicenummer geeft geen recht op uitkeringen of subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Mei Li Vos over het bericht ‘BTW-nummer moet wel op de website, ook voor de ZZP-er’

MPs Oosenbrug and Mei Li Vos asked the government about conflicting Tax Authority guidance on whether sole traders must publish their VAT number online, and about the use of the citizen service number (BSN) as the basis for VAT numbers. The State Secretary answered that no tax rule requires a VAT number on a website, but civil law (Article 3:15d BW) requires easy, direct and permanent access to it for online services, and that a motion asking for VAT numbers not linked to the BSN is being assessed with a letter to follow.
I am currently having the consequences of this motion mapped out and will inform the House about this in a separate letter.
Ik laat op dit moment in kaart brengen wat de consequenties van deze motie zijn en zal uw Kamer hierover bij separate brief informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Segers over de capaciteit van de antennes op het dak van de ambassade van de Verenigde Staten

MPs Van Raak and Segers asked whether antennas on the US embassy roof in The Hague could intercept and decode nearby communications, including those around the Binnenhof and the Prime Minister's office, and whether the government would check this with the US. The minister confirmed interception is technically possible but could not confirm it occurs, said foreign intelligence operations in the Netherlands require prior authorisation, and committed to contacting the US embassy and reporting back.
The Ministry of BZK will contact the American embassy. I will inform your House of the outcome.
Het Ministerie van BZK zal contact opnemen met de Amerikaanse ambassade. Ik zal uw Kamer over de uitkomst hiervan informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Raak en Bisschop over het ontslag van de Gezaghebber op Bonaire

MPs Van Raak and Bisschop asked whether the resignation request of the Island Governor of Bonaire serves integrity, whether a no-confidence motion filed by a UPB faction leader suspected in a corruption case is appropriate, whether the governor should be supported, and whether dismissal will be granted or deferred until trial ends. The minister answered that the Island Council's no-confidence vote is primarily its own matter, reaffirmed integrity principles and the presumption of innocence without judging the motion, and noted the governor will resign on 1 March 2014 respecting the council's wishes.
The Island Council of Bonaire adopted a motion of no confidence against the Island Governor on Tuesday 26 November 2013.
De Eilandsraad van Bonaire heeft op dinsdag 26 november 2013 een motie van wantrouwen tegen de Gezaghebber aangenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het bericht ‘Rekenkamer vreest slechte controle geld gemeentetaken’

Fokke (PvdA) asked the Minister of Interior whether local audit committees (rekenkamers) are strong enough to oversee decentralisation funds and whether they should get stronger investigative powers over joint arrangements. The minister answered that well-functioning audit bodies are essential, that 15 inactive committees were contacted, and that rekenkamercommissies will receive the same investigative powers as rekenkamers, with a further review of private-law partnerships pending.
The intention is that these powers also fully apply to a municipal audit committee.
Het voornemen is dat deze bevoegdheden ook onverkort toekomen aan een gemeentelijke rekenkamercommissie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Moslimextremist bedreigt Elsevier-blogger Afshin Ellian’

An MP asked the ministers whether a call by a blogger against columnist Afshin Ellian constitutes a threat, whether Ellian filed a complaint, whether the university should act, and whether existing tools to counter such threats suffice. The government answered that the courts decide what counts as a threat, that no complaint had been filed, that police protective measures were taken, and that existing criminal and administrative instruments are sufficient, so the proposed national security bill is not needed.

I have concluded that the Public Prosecution Service has sufficient legal instruments to act criminally, together with the police and in coordination with the AIVD, where possible, against threats and calls to violence.

Ik ben tot het oordeel gekomen dat het OM over voldoende wettelijk instrumentarium beschikt om samen met de politie en in afstemming met de AIVD, daar waar mogelijk, strafrechtelijk op te treden tegen bedreigingen en oproepen tot geweld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over de activiteiten en het toezicht op de Europese geheime dienst IntCen

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked how the EU intelligence body IntCen receives and shares intelligence, its legal basis and status, and what oversight applies, including whether it processes personal data. Minister Plasterk answered that IntCen only produces strategic analyses from voluntary member-state contributions, now sits within the EEAS under the same legal controls as other EU institutions (Ombudsman, Court of Justice, data protection supervisor), and that Dutch oversight of its AIVD input rests with the CTIVD.

Given that SitCen produces only strategic analyses, processes no personal data, acquires no intelligence of its own and receives information from member states only on a voluntary basis, the Council considered that no special legal basis was required to establish SitCen.

Gelet op het feit dat SitCen uitsluitend strategische analyses opstelt, geen persoonsgegevens verwerkt, geen eigen inlichtingen verwerft en dat informatie uit de lidstaten slechts op basis van vrijwilligheid wordt verstrekt, was de Raad van mening dat voor de oprichting van SitCen geen bijzonder rechtsbasis was vereist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Albert De Vries over de financiële gevolgen van gemeenten met hun grondpositie

MPs Albert de Vries and Fokke asked ministers whether the financial crisis hitting municipal land companies is worse than the 2012 study showed, whether the minister will allow longer write-downs, support provinces' plans to help municipalities, and agree to renegotiate Rijk-subsidised building contracts to cut building capacity. The minister replied that current rules suffice, longer write-down periods are possible only under enhanced provincial supervision, and that the Rijk no longer has partner status in the remaining housing subsidies, with a further report promised in December.
As I already reported in my letter of 14 October and as promised in the VAO of 12 November, this report will be sent to your House in December on behalf of my colleague of the Interior Ministry.

Zoals ik al in mijn brief van 14 oktober heb gemeld en zoals ook in het VAO van 12 november heb toegezegd, zal dit rapport in december mede namens mijn collega van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties aan uw Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin Van Dijk over het korten van topinkomens in de zorg

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether the government supports Rotterdam's plan to cap top salaries at care providers through subsidy conditions, and how municipalities can be encouraged to do so. Minister Plasterk answered that excessive pay is undesirable, that the WNT does not prevent stricter subsidy conditions but may conflict with transitional law, and that he will consult the VNG to align central and local policy and report on the model subsidy regulation.
Although I do not wish to restrict the freedom of local government to make its own choices, it seems sensible to align the policies of central and local government.
Hoewel ik niet de vrijheid van het lokaal bestuur wil beperken om eigen keuzes te maken, lijkt het mij verstandig om het beleid van de centrale en de decentrale overheden op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het ontslag na melding misstanden moskee-internaten

An MP asks the ministers how they view the dismissal of a civil servant who reported serious misconduct at a mosque boarding school, and whether that employee deserves reinstatement and action against the responsible administrator. The minister declines to comment on individual employment decisions, says the dismissal is the responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam and a matter for the courts, and states no intention to intervene.
I do not intend to interfere in a matter that falls under the own responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam.
Ik ben niet voornemens te interfereren in een zaak die tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Rotterdam moet worden gerekend.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman, Azmani en Van der Linde over signalen dat Sint Maarten zich bij het verlenen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit niet houdt aan de Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap

MPs Bosman, Azmani and Van der Linde asked whether signals exist that Sint Maarten grants Dutch nationality in breach of the Rijkswet op het Nederlanderschap, and whether the Sint Maarten Justice Minister wants to ease passport grants for immigrants, along with related questions. The state secretary answered that such signals are unknown, that the Sint Maarten minister disavowed the newspaper report and said only the Kingdom government may grant nationality, and that the rules should remain uniform across the Kingdom.
Signals as referred to in the first question are not known to us.
Signalen als bedoeld in de eerste vraag zijn ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over de berichten ‘Dode door brand in windmolen in Ooltgensplaat’ en ‘Tweede dode bij brand windmolen Ooltgensplaat’

An MP from the PVV asked whether the regional fire brigade was equipped to fight a turbine fire at height, how municipalities account for fire height when granting permits, and whether emergency plans exist for rescuing people from turbines. The government answered that the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire service considers itself generally equipped, that an investigation is underway into the cause and firefighting options, that permits account for collapse and blade-failure risks, and that no turbine-specific emergency plans exist, relying instead on general working-at-height procedures and specialist rescue teams.
The Rotterdam-Rijnmond Safety Region is launching an investigation into the fire at the wind turbine in Ooltgensplaat.
De Veiligheidsregio Rotterdam-Rijnmond stelt een onderzoek in naar de brand van de windturbine in Ooltgensplaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over het bericht ’Ambtenaar verdacht van lekken over moskee-internaten ontslagen’

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the dismissal of a whistleblowing civil servant in Rotterdam who had reported misconduct, including a BING report finding improper governance, and about provincial supervision and the whistleblower regime. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, pointing to the courts, noted the anti-detriment provision applies, and said the BING report will be considered by the prosecutor.
It does not befit me as minister to comment on the factual complex in this case.
Het past mij als minister niet om commentaar te geven op het feitencomplex in deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mei Li Vos over postbezorging in Caribisch Nederland

MPs Van Laar and Mei Li Vos asked about the new postal concession for Caribbean Netherlands, including the tender outcome, service changes, the 10-year term, enforcement tools, price rise and street addressing. The minister answered that Flamingo Communications was designated concessionaire, that the government can enforce via ACM orders, fines or withdrawal, and that addressing and postcode plans are progressing, without promising new oversight mechanisms.
The Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) supervises whether the concession holder complies with its obligations.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) ziet er op toe dat de concessiehouder zijn verplichtingen naleeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Van Laar over het bericht dat de AIVD politici op Bonaire heeft bespioneerd

MPs Recourt and Van Laar asked the Minister of the Interior whether the AIVD secretly spied on Bonaire politicians between 2005 and 2010, whether the operation was legal, who ordered it and whether it influenced constitutional negotiations and led to criminal investigation. The minister's supplementary answer refers the MPs to a separate letter on the NRC reporting, so the substance is not given in this document.

The written questions from MPs Recourt and Van Laar (both PvdA), question number 2013Z22947, have been answered by way of the letter 'Response to the reporting in NRC on AIVD investigation on Bonaire'.

Nader antwoord De schriftelijke vragen van leden Recourt en Van Laar (beiden PvdA), vraagnummer 2013Z22947 , zijn beantwoord middels de brief «Reactie op de berichtgeving in het NRC over onderzoek van de AIVD op Bonaire» (Kamerstuk 30 977, nr.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het efficiënt omgaan met Wob-verzoeken door gemeenten

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked whether municipalities can refuse Wob requests by pointing to already public information, whether requesters must first search themselves, and how the Hoogeveen request for all permits since 1988 (apparently aimed at collecting a dwangsom) will be addressed. Minister Plasterk answered that public information falls outside the Wob and can be referred to, that requesters should first search for it, and that the misuse of the Wob will be tackled on a short timeframe based on a study of recent administrative law instruments.
Based partly on the results of this study, I am considering how to curb, in the short term, improper use (also called abuse or manifestly unreasonable use) of the Wob.

Mede op basis van de resultaten van dit onderzoek bezie ik op welke wijze op korte termijn paal en perk kan worden gesteld aan oneigenlijk gebruik (ook wel misbruik of kennelijk onredelijk gebruik) van de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over een bezoek van klokkenluider Snowden aan de Tweede Kamer

An SP MP asked whether the government would enable a visit by whistleblower Snowden to the Tweede Kamer, and whether it would guarantee his safety from extradition. The minister answered that the Kamer may speak with Snowden without him travelling to the Netherlands, that his passport was revoked so he cannot enter, and that an extradition treaty with the US prevents ruling out extradition requests, so no assurance letter is appropriate.
The Kamer is of course free to speak with Mr Snowden.
Het staat de Kamer uiteraard vrij om met de heer Snowden te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de gevolmachtigde minister van Curaçao

An SP MP asked the Minister-President and the Minister of Interior about reports that Curaçao's plenipotentiary minister hired family and friends without the usual recruitment procedures, and whether her CV was verified. The minister replied that it is not for the Dutch government to assess recruitment procedures in another country and referred back to that answer for the CV questions.
It is not for the Dutch government to assess the recruitment procedures for posts in other countries.
Het is niet aan de regering van Nederland om de sollicitatieprocedures voor functies in andere landen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het bericht «Overheid doet zaken met pornoboer»

An MP asked whether a social-media monitoring firm contracted by nine ministries and the police was linked to adult internet services, and how it was vetted given sensitive data. The minister confirmed the link was via a former stake of WiseGuys in an adult search service, which was divested after a security assessment, and pointed to integrity screening rules under the 2012 Aanbestedingswet.
In tenders, under the Aanbestedingswet 2012, the integrity and suitability of the entrepreneur to be awarded the contract are checked on the basis of mandatory official evidence.

Bij aanbestedingen wordt op grond van de Aanbestedingswet 2012 de integriteit en de geschiktheid van de ondernemer die de opdracht zal worden gegund, gecontroleerd aan de hand van de verplicht te overleggen officiële bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Mohandis over de mogelijke sluiting van de Saint James School of Medicine op Bonaire

Two MPs asked whether the Saint James School of Medicine on Bonaire must close by 2015 because it fails Dutch inspection requirements, and what efforts and options exist to prevent closure. The minister answered that the school never received Dutch accreditation, withdrew its higher-education procedure, and therefore lost ECFMG recognition, while acknowledging some economic impact and noting that the government had already extended the deadline.
The medical school chose, after the investigation under the new programme assessment, to withdraw its application for that assessment.
De medical school heeft ervoor gekozen na het onderzoek in het kader van de toets nieuwe opleiding, de aanvraag voor die toets in te trekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Segers, Ten Broeke, Servaes, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Van Bommel en Sjoerdsma over mogelijke financiering van Al-Shabaab via het consulaat van Eritrea

MPs from several parties asked whether money from the Eritrean consulate's diaspora tax in the Netherlands may fund Al-Shabaab, whether the OM investigated, and whether the consul should be expelled or the consulate closed. The government answered that the OM has received no complaints and started no investigation, that the tax is not per se contrary to Vienna Conventions or sanctions, that there are no concrete indications the funds financed terrorism, and that no measures are warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has not started an investigation into the so-called diaspora tax because it had received no reports on this matter.
Door het Openbaar Ministerie is geen onderzoek begonnen naar de zgn. diaspora taks omdat het Openbaar Ministerie dienaangaande geen aangiften had ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bontes over het bericht ‘Nederlander onder daders Nairobi’

An MP from the PVV asked the ministers whether a perpetrator of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national, how the AIVD missed him, whether Al-Shabaab should be put on the terror list, and whether he should be denaturalised. The government answered that it has no information showing any perpetrator is Dutch, that the AIVD annual report notes support activities for Al Shabaab in the Netherlands, and that denaturalisation is therefore not applicable.
The cabinet has no information showing that one of the perpetrators of the Nairobi attack is a Dutch national.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over informatie waaruit blijkt dat een van de daders van de aanslag in Nairobi een Nederlander is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de staatsrechtelijke problemen met betrekking tot het kort na elkaar houden van Provinciale Statenverkiezingen in Noord-Holland, Utrecht en Flevoland

An MP asks whether the Constitution requires new Eerste Kamer elections within three months of Provincial States elections, and whether postponing or splitting the provincial term extensions creates constitutional problems. The Minister replies that Articles 52 and 55 do not require the Eerste Kamer term to change when only some provinces are merged, citing commentators, and that postponing all provincial elections is undesirable because of time pressure.

By settled interpretation, the composition of the Eerste Kamer, except in case of dissolution, is meant to be determined by the newly elected states in all provinces and not partly by newly formed states and partly by states in their old composition.

Naar vaste uitleg is het de bedoeling dat de samenstelling van de Eerste Kamer, behoudens in geval van ontbinding, wordt bepaald door de nieuw gekozen staten in alle provincies en niet deels door nieuw gevormde staten en deels door staten in oude samenstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de acties van de regering van Sint Maarten om een onafhankelijk onderzoek naar goed bestuur te dwarsbomen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether he disapproved of the Sint Maarten prime minister barring civil servants from cooperating with an integrity investigation ordered by the Kingdom Council of Ministers. The minister answered that he expects Sint Maarten to cooperate, points to the Kingdom's responsibility to address governance concerns, and declined to comment on requests not made by the Sint Maarten government.
I assume that the government of Sint Maarten will cooperate with the investigation in accordance with the decision of the Kingdom Council of Ministers.
Ik ga er van uit dat de regering van Sint Maarten zal meewerken aan het onderzoek conform besluit van de Rijksministerraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bosman en Van Ark over het op het laatste moment verplaatsen van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

Two VVD MPs asked why the Curaçao Gay Pride venue was changed at the last moment, whether this affects freedom of assembly, and how LGBT safety and expression are guaranteed on Curaçao. The minister answered that public order is an autonomous Curaçao matter whose considerations are unknown to him, that only one MP's letter was received, and that no signals of unsafety were received.
It is up to the Curaçao government to weigh whether additional requirements for organizing the Gay Pride are necessary to maintain public order and safety.

Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride om daarmee de openbare orde en veiligheid te handhaven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Van Laar over het niet doorgaan van de Gay Pride op Curaçao

MPs Yücel and Van Laar asked about the cancelled first Gay Pride on Curaçao, whether the government imposed last-minute conditions, whether police deemed flags and demonstration items dangerous, and whether Raveneau's letter to church leaders influenced this, and asked the government to press Curaçao on LHBT rights. The minister replied that public order and emancipation policy on Curaçao are autonomous matters, the reasons behind the police conditions are not known to him, and he has received no signals that LHBT rights are not respected, while pointing to the Curaçao government's stated support and the Pink Orange Akkoord funding.
It is up to the government of Curaçao to weigh to what extent additional requirements are needed for organising the Gay Pride in order to maintain public order and safety.
Het is aan de overheid van Curaçao om een afweging te maken in hoeverre het nodig is om aanvullende eisen te stellen aan de organisatie van de Gay Pride
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de peildatum van de automatische kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether automatic municipal tax remission uses a uniform national reference date (31 December of the prior year), and whether the government would move that date earlier so residents are not forced into objection procedures or individual applications. The minister confirmed the uniform date stems from technical limits and external data availability, said it does not appear to cause major problems, and declined to change it since individual applications and handmatige toetsing remain available.
I therefore do not intend to request that the assessment date for automated remission be adjusted.
Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens te verzoeken het toetsmoment van geautomatiseerde kwijtschelding aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en van Hijum over het bericht “Leugens en bedrog bij burgerzaken”

MPs Omtzigt and Van Hijum asked about a report on tax nomads who deregister from the municipal population register (GBA) to evade the state, including how many emigrants filed final tax returns, whether data is exchanged with foreign tax authorities, and whether passports are denied. The government answered that the report was shared confidentially, outlined the Taskforce VOW and an FIOD investigation, gave deregistration and filing figures, and said about 40 persons were flagged for passport refusal, with a broader anti-fraud approach promised for December 2013.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations sent you this report by letter for confidential handling.
De minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties heeft u dit rapport bij brief ter vertrouwelijke behandeling toegezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Schouw over de signalen dat de Amerikaanse NSA ook topmensen uit het bedrijfsleven afluistert

MPs Verhoeven and Schouw asked whether the US NSA also spies on Dutch business leaders and Dutch companies for economic purposes, and what the risks and government response would be. Minister Plasterk answered that intercepting metadata for counterterrorism is acceptable within legal limits, that the AIVD cannot publicly discuss its methods or examples of corporate espionage, and that the government will send a signal to the US, referring to a letter of 28 October 2013.
No public statements can be made about the working methods and knowledge level of the AIVD, including examples of corporate espionage.
In het openbaar kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan over de werkwijze en het kennisniveau van AIVD, inclusief voorbeelden van bedrijfsspionage.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over de gestegen tarieven voor bouwleges

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a reported 5% rise in building permit fees and large variation between municipalities, and whether the government will impose a uniform cost model or cap on increases. The minister answers that municipalities set their own fees subject to courts' 100% cost-recovery test, that transparency should improve through VNG appeals and an updated guidance, but that no national maximum or mandatory model will be imposed.
The rights of citizens and businesses are guaranteed because objection and appeal are open against the levying of fees.
De rechten van de burger en het bedrijfsleven zijn gewaarborgd doordat er bezwaar en beroep open staat tegen de legesheffing.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het besluit van de gemeente Amsterdam om door te gaan met exorbitante vergoedingen voor leden van bestuurscommissies

MP Van Raak asks the minister whether he remembers distancing himself from Amsterdam's plan to pay district committee members €1,500 per meeting and whether the city followed up after consultation. The minister replies that he rejected an AWVN-based proposal, that the city's draft ordinance differs (€500 per regular meeting, capped at €1,500 gross per month) and complies with the law, so no further measures are planned.
I note that the college did not adopt the AWVN advice in the draft ordinance.
Ik constateer dat het college in de ontwerp-verordening het AWVN-advies niet heeft overgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Koolmees over het bericht dat de servers van de Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) mogelijk zijn afgetapt door de NSA

MPs Schouw and Koolmees asked ministers whether the NSA tapped SWIFT servers, including any server in the Netherlands, and what the government would do about it, including the EU-US TFTP programme. The government said it cannot confirm the report, SWIFT found no evidence of unauthorised access, the Commission has asked US authorities for clarification, and it sees no reason to suspend the TFTP agreement for now.
However, I cannot confirm the accuracy of that report.
Ik kan de juistheid van dat bericht echter niet bevestigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het gevaar dat het Amsterdamse internetknooppunt AMS-IX gegevens moet afstaan aan de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA)

MP Van Raak asks whether AMS-IX, if it expands into the United States, risks being forced under US law to hand data to the NSA, and whether he can be assured Dutch citizens' data stays safe before any US activity. Minister Plasterk answers that US law applies to activities on US soil with court-supervised compelled cooperation, that AMS-IX is seeking legal advice, that the NCSC will not advise on this, and that Dutch firms may establish abroad but must meet Dutch data-transfer rules, so no such assurance is given.
No. Dutch companies are free to establish themselves abroad.
Nee. Het staat Nederlandse bedrijven Vrij om zich in het buitenland te vestigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Toorenburg over het bericht dat gemeenten de volle mep betalen voor het onderzoek naar de decentralisaties

MPs Schouw and Van Toorenburg asked whether municipalities in practice fully pay for the CPB multi-year research agenda on decentralisation, via the Gemeentefonds. The minister answers that the Rijk pays its half from the Rijksbudget (administratively placed in the Gemeentefonds), so the cost is shared equally, and that the €2 million also funds the Schouw motion research.
Given the distribution of costs, there is no question of the research agenda being fully financed by the municipalities.
Gelet op de verdeling van de kosten geldt dat er geen sprake is van een volledige financiering van de onderzoeksagenda door de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse National Security Agency (NSA) via telecomaanbieders het internationaal telefoonverkeer afluistert

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked the government about reports that the US NSA was intercepting international telephone traffic via Belgian provider Belgacom, and whether Dutch telecom providers had been similarly breached or approached. The minister said there is no indication of a comparable breach in the Netherlands, that providers are responsible for their own security under the Telecommunicatiewet, that the government does not know whether foreign services approached Dutch providers, and that EU-US expert group work and the JBZ-Raad addressed the issue.
No public statements are made about contacts between the Dutch intelligence and security services and foreign services.
Over contacten tussen de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en buitenlandse diensten worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over het wachtgeld van de burgemeester van Groningen, de heer Rehwinkel

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the transition allowance (wachtgeld) of Groningen mayor Rehwinkel under the Appa, including the job-search obligation, how it is enforced, sanctions, and whether it applies to those living abroad. The Minister confirmed the job-search obligation applies, explained the individual reintegration plan and withholding-based sanctions up to 100%, and said no cases of non-compliance had arisen in the Minister's remit.
The administrative body responsible for paying the Appa benefit is also responsible for reintegration.
Het bestuursorgaan dat verantwoordelijk is voor de uitvoering van de Appa-uitkering is ook verantwoordelijk voor de re-integratie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Zorgconsultant Humanitas kreeg ton voor maand werk’

MPs Kerstens and Otwin asked whether a care consultant hired by Humanitas DMH who declared about 95,000 euro for one month's work, and an assistant declaring over 35,000 euro per month, could be curbed under the Wet normering topinkomens (Wnt), and whether rules on consultant rates should follow. The minister answered that the case will be enforced under the Wnt, that the consultant's excessive remuneration is not justified, and that a separate bill extending the pay cap to all staff is planned, but declined to set rate limits or provide a registry of such contracts now.
In this case, enforcement will take place in accordance with the law.
In deze casus zal conform de wet worden gehandhaafd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het  misbruiken van de Wet openbaarheid van bestuur (Wob)

Two MPs asked the Interior Minister about abuse of the Dutch Freedom of Information Act (Wob) to claim penalty payments for late decisions, and whether the Wet dwangsom or the Wob itself should be changed. The minister acknowledged the abuse, said research on the 'versnellingsinstrumenten' is underway with results expected soon, and said the Wob itself needs no full revision, while promising to consider measures after that research.
I am of the view that something must be done quickly about the improper use of the Wob.
Ik ben van oordeel dat er snel iets moet gebeuren aan het oneigenlijk gebruik van de Wob.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over bezuinigingen als gevolg van niet-aangenomen wetten

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether the planned €18 million cut to the municipal fund from 2015 follows from the rejected Heijnen bill on reducing council seats, and how municipalities should compensate. The minister replied that the cut stems from the coalition agreement rather than the bill, that the agreed savings targets remain binding, and that municipalities must find savings themselves.
It is correct that €18 million will be withdrawn from the municipal fund from 2015.
Het klopt dat er een uitname van € 18 miljoen uit het gemeentefonds plaatsvindt vanaf 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid  Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard instructed the Kabinet der Koningin to request BVD information on De Roy van Zuydewijn in 2000, why the 2003 government did not disclose this, and for comment on a journalist's account of the prince's remarks. The government answers that the 2003 letter and parliamentary debates contain its position, that the earlier answers were given in good faith, and that statements by the former editor-in-chief are his own responsibility.
Statements by the former editor-in-chief are for his own account.
Uitlatingen van de voormalig hoofdredacteur komen voor diens rekening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over de opbrengsten van gemeenten voor textielinzameling en de fijnsortering van het ingezamelde textie

An MP from the ChristenUnie asked the state secretary about municipal fees charged to charitable textile collectors, whether textile collection is at risk from falling market prices, and the role of retail chains and permits. The state secretary replied that municipalities have autonomous responsibility for textile collection and lack data on fees, said it is not appropriate to charge fees that cover other municipal costs, noted a Green Deal study due in 2014, and reported that inspections found export textiles correctly sorted.
I therefore cannot assess whether the fees have doubled, nor whether they are as high as the amount left for the charitable purpose.
Ik kan dus niet beoordelen of de vergoedingen zijn verdubbeld en ook niet of deze net zo hoog zijn als het bedrag dat overblijft voor het goede doel.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat de subsidieboekhouding van de Nederlandse Antillen aan alle kanten rammelt

Fritsma (PVV) asks why subsidies to the former Netherlands Antilles continued despite warnings about accounting failures, and whether funds should be recovered and ties severed. Minister Plasterk replies that the final cooperation funds were transferred in 2012 to foundations running programmes until 2013-2015, that Saba, Sint Eustatius and Bonaire now form part of the Netherlands, and that independence decisions lie with Aruba, Curacao and Sint Maarten.
I refer you gladly to my letter to the Speaker of the House of Representatives, dated 27 August 2013.
Ik verwijs u graag naar mijn brief aan de voorzitter van de Tweede Kamer, gedateerd 27 augustus 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Toorenburg over het bericht ‘Oppositie Oegstgeest: Wob-verzoek om integriteitsrapporten’

An MP asks whether the Oegstgeest council was refused access to two reports on integrity violations, and how the 'public interest' exception in the Gemeentewet should be read. The minister replies that the council did receive a summary memo, that the public-interest exception must be read narrowly and is for the council itself to assess, and that the Wob grounds are not the test.
The right to information belongs to individual council members.
Het inlichtingenrecht komt toe aan de raadsleden individueel.
Vragen van het lid Van Raak (SP) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het afluisteren van Kamerleden (ingezonden 6 augustus 2013).

MP Van Raak asks whether foreign intelligence services can access Dutch MPs' phones via Vodafone and how Vodafone is prevented from passing data abroad, and when the government will seek clarification from the US about mass surveillance of Dutch citizens. The minister says Vodafone shares data only after formal requests under Dutch law, and that the EU has already raised the matter with US authorities and experts are examining it jointly.
Vodafone has confirmed to me that data is only provided to Dutch investigative and security services after a formal request, within the framework of Dutch laws and regulations.
Vodafone heeft mij bevestigd dat gegevens alleen na formeel verzoek daartoe binnen de kaders van Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving aan Nederlandse opsporings- en veiligheidsdiensten worden versterkt.
