Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Oskam over het bericht “13 duizend euro voor cursus ‘Digitaal leiderschap’”

MPs Van Toorenburg and Oskam asked whether a 13,000-euro social media course for civil servants, taught partly by a member of the 'Project X Haren' commission, is a fitting follow-up to that commission's recommendations and how the government will build social media skills without relying on this course. The minister answered that the commission has finished and its knowledge may be spread further, that civil servants are not obliged to take such a course, and that social media training is part of the regular education offer.
It is up to the government and the civil servants concerned themselves to decide which courses should be followed and by whom.
Het is aan de overheid en betrokken ambtenaren zelf om de afweging te maken welke cursussen gevolgd (dienen) te worden en door wie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Segers over gewetensbezwaren bij het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens

Segers (ChristenUnie) asked the Minister of Interior about conscientious objectors who refuse to give fingerprints for passports and ID cards, their consequences, and whether an alternative will be offered. The Minister said the group size is unknown, current law does not allow issuing documents without fingerprints, and a bill to remove fingerprints from ID card applications is pending, with a possible stop soon after adoption.
A bill amending the Passport Act is pending before the House of Representatives, which among other things provides that fingerprints will no longer be taken when applying for a Dutch identity card.

Bij de Tweede Kamer is een wetsvoorstel tot wijziging van de Paspoortwet 2 aanhangig waarin onder meer wordt geregeld dat bij de aanvraag van een Nederlandse identiteitskaart geen vingerafdrukken meer worden opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het bericht “minister wil maatregelen tegen sensatiejournalistiek’

Dutch MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior about a Sint Maarten minister's plan for phased press accreditation rules that could restrict press freedom, and whether this conflicts with the constitution's free-expression guarantee. The minister answered that press freedom is a very high good, that any restriction must respect the constitution and treaties, and that fundamental rights are a matter for Sint Maarten's own government, which is accountable to its Staten.
Compliance with fundamental rights is a matter for the country.
De naleving van grondrechten is een landsaangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het evaluatierapport over Aruba van het IMF

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about the IMF evaluation of Aruba, including the 8.5% deficit, rising debt, and whether Aruba should cut its deficit and who is responsible if its finances fail. The minister replied that Aruba is autonomous and responsible for its own fiscal policy, that the Dutch PM raised concerns during a visit, and that Aruba plans to anchor budget rules in its constitution and create an advisory college.
It is therefore the responsibility of the Aruban government to ensure sustainable public finances, with the Staten as the controlling body.
Het is daarmee de verantwoordelijkheid van de Arubaanse regering om toe te zien op houdbare overheidsfinanciën, met de Staten als controlerend orgaan.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over de toegenomen exitpremies van zorgbestuurders

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked about rising severance payments to healthcare executives and whether pay rose before the WNT pay-cap law took effect, and whether the government would act faster or retroactively. The minister answered that 2012 pay data will come in the December 2013 report, that the WNT transition period is kept as adopted, and that retroactive changes are undesirable given property rights and legal certainty.
For the public and semi-public sectors it will not be possible to answer this question and similar questions on actual developments in top incomes for the year 2012.
Voor de publieke en semipublieke sectoren zal het niet mogelijk zijn over het jaar 2012 deze vraag en vergelijkbare vragen over feitelijke ontwikkelingen in verband met topinkomens te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over Amerikaanse financiering van Nederlandse geheime diensten

An MP asked whether US or other foreign intelligence services or organisations have ever financed Dutch intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD or predecessors) over the past 68 years, with amounts and agreements. The ministers answer that there is currently no such financing, that the former BVD received direct CIA financial support from 1950 to 1966 with ministerial approval, and that cost-sharing in joint operations cannot be detailed publicly.
More concretely, no public statements can be made about this.
Meer concreet kunnen daarover in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bosman over de begroting van Sint Maarten

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about Sint Maarten's budget, including whether a deficit of 2-3% should be tolerated and who is responsible if its finances are not brought in order. The minister rejected any flexibility beyond the zero-deficit norm, acknowledged the late budget and the CFT's concerns, and stated that responsibility lies with Sint Maarten itself while noting the Kingdom could intervene if governance is jeopardised.
It is the responsibility of Sint Maarten itself. That responsibility cannot be shifted onto others.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van Sint Maarten zelf. Die verantwoordelijkheid kan niet worden afgeschoven op anderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Recourt over onduidelijke regels omtrent identificatieplicht voor zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Recourt asked whether self-employed workers (zzp'ers) face unclear and contradictory identification rules when accepting assignments, and how their privacy is protected. Minister Kamp replied that identification is only required when a client demands a Verklaring Arbeidsrelatie, that the client must keep copies for seven years, and that the Chamber of Commerce only shares business addresses unless legal exceptions apply.
Self-employed workers are not obliged to identify themselves when accepting assignments.
Zzp'ers zijn niet verplicht zich te identificeren bij het aannemen van opdrachten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Laar over berichten over de jeugdreclassering op Curaçao

An MP asks whether the Dutch government cooperates with Curaçao to improve youth probation after a Raad voor de Rechtshandhaving report, and whether it will offer cooperation. The minister answers that there is no structural cooperation, only incidental case-level contacts, that Curaçao has not requested it, and that youth probation will be considered for the March 2014 Koninkrijksconferentie.

No. On behalf of the minister and state secretary of Security and Justice, I inform you that the government in European Netherlands does not cooperate structurally with Curaçao in the area of youth probation.

Nee. Mede namens de minister en staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie, bericht ik u dat de overheid in Europees Nederland niet in structurele zin samenwerkt met het land Curaçao op het gebied van jeugdreclassering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Heijnen over de hoofdelijke aansprakelijkheid van volksvertegenwoordigers

Two Labour MPs asked the Interior Minister whether elected councillors and MPs can be held personally and jointly liable for democratic decisions, such as zoning changes causing planning damage. The minister answered that such personal liability is excluded by immunity provisions, that liability for damage rests with the public body, and that regress against representatives for voting is not possible.
That is not possible. Representatives must be able to speak and decide in their meetings without fear or threat of being personally involved in legal proceedings for doing so.

Dat is niet mogelijk. Volksvertegenwoordigers dienen in hun vergaderingen te kunnen spreken en besluiten zonder de vrees of dreiging daarvoor persoonlijk te worden betrokken in gerechtelijke procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het voornemen in Amsterdam om leden van bestuurscommissies exorbitante beloningen te geven

An SP MP asked the Interior Minister whether he would distance himself from Amsterdam's plan to pay members of district committees between 1,373 and 1,555 euros per meeting, why the city hired AWVN, what the study cost, how this fits with social spending cuts, and whether the plans comply with the law abolishing sub-district councils. The minister said he would discuss the matter with the city and report back, but declared the city's choices about advisers, costs, budget priorities and the legal-status regulation to be local matters.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to decide whether and by whom it has itself advised.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om te bepalen of en door wie zij zich laat adviseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Toorenburg over het bericht 'Raad Hoogezand zet Maagd voet dwars'

The MP Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether the Hoogezand-Sappemeer council blocked a party's nominee as faction representative despite a committee finding that he met the ordinance criteria, and whether the Minister would act on it. The Minister confirmed the facts, said appointment of faction representatives is a purely municipal matter outside the Municipalities Act, and declined to intervene or consult the municipality or VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het aanbieden van overheidsinformatie

An MP asked the ministers whether the government would adopt the G8 Open Data Charter, including its open-by-default principle, a priority list of high-value datasets and data quality standards. The minister supports open-by-default in principle and cites the Open Data Next project and a forthcoming Open Government action plan, but declines to adopt the Charter integrally and sees no need for a general data quality benchmark.
I support the principle of open by default, open unless...
Ik ondersteun het principe « Open by default», open tenzij....
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de ISLA-raffinaderij

An MP asks why two reports on the future of the ISLA refinery in Curaçao have not been published, whether SMOC's request for access can be accelerated, and whether the Dutch government will press Curaçao to prevent emissions and activate the guarantee function. The minister replies that health and environmental policy are Curaçao's responsibility, that the reports belong to the Curaçao government, that some reports have been made available to the Staten, and that the Netherlands stands ready to assist on concrete request but will not raise the matter in the Rijksministerraad.
However, it is the responsibility of Curaçao to shape the policy regarding the refinery.
Het is echter de verantwoordelijkheid van Curaçao om het beleid aangaande de raffinaderij vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het PvdA-cliëntelisme inzake Rotterdamse moskee-internaten

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about alleged clientelism in Rotterdam Feijenoord district linked to mosque boarding schools, including whether the city board should be placed under supervision and whether a national investigation should follow. The minister accepted the integrity agency's findings, endorsed the imposed supervision of the district board, and said signals of clientelism would be examined, but declined to comment on the employment position of the official who exposed the matter.
Following the BING report, the Rotterdam municipal executive has taken far-reaching measures.
Naar aanleiding van het rapport van BING zijn door het gemeentebestuur van Rotterdam ingrijpende maatregelen getroffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over het onderzoek van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) naar een politicus

The SP MP Van Raak asked why the AIVD's use of special powers against a former politician, the decision not to notify, and whether parliament's intelligence committee was informed must remain secret. The minister confirmed the target was a former member of a party's representative body, noted the CTIVD found the lawfulness not disputed, said the non-notification decision will be reconsidered following the CTIVD's finding it should not have been taken, and declined to comment in public on the period and on committee briefings.
As I wrote in my letter of 17 July 2013, I will reconsider the concrete notification decisions named in the report, including the decision mentioned above.

Zoals ik heb geschreven in mijn brief van 17 juli 2013 (kamerstuk 29 924, nr. 99 ), zal ik de in het rapport genoemde concrete notificatiebesluiten, waaronder het hierboven genoemde besluit, heroverwegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Tongeren over de publiek-private aanbesteding van een nieuw te bouwen penitentiaire inrichting te Zaanstad

Van Tongeren (GroenLinks) asked whether the Rijksgebouwendienst will award the PPS prison project in Zaanstad to consortium Pi2, when the PPS trajectory started relative to the DJI Masterplan, what risks the state bears, and whether the award should be suspended pending consultation with parliament. Minister Plasterk answered that the award is planned for 22 July 2013, that the project followed existing ministerial policy and was reported in annual progress reports, that risks are allocated to the party best able to control them, and that suspending the award would cost about 30 million euro.
Do you think it would have been more logical to start such a trajectory only after consulting the House of Representatives?
Bent u van mening dat het meer voor de hand had gelegen om pas met een dergelijk traject te beginnen nadat met de Tweede Kamer was overlegd?
Antwoord vragen Ouwehand over bewegende lasers aan windmolenwieken in vogelgebied

An MP asked whether planned moving lasers on wind turbines at the Tweede Maasvlakte bird area had been studied for effects on migratory birds and protected colonies, and whether the state land owner would prevent nature disturbance. The state secretary answered that no such study exists yet, that the operator must show no significant harm to protected nature, and that any permit would be assessed later.
No, no research has been done on that.
Nee, daar is geen onderzoek naar gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Terugvorderen opbrengst belastingfraude moeilijk”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance and other ministers about reports that recovering proceeds of tax and benefit fraud is difficult, including fraud amounts and fines in a Deventer case, foreign childcare allowances, unregistered persons receiving allowances, Polish recipients, and EU residence and coordination rules. The government answered in detail, providing figures, explaining controls, and acknowledging some untraceable recipients and data limitations, while promising maatregelen to improve pre-payment checks and a later overview.
The correct amount cannot be given.
Het juiste bedrag is niet te geven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘2 miljoen Nederlanders slachtoffer identiteitsfraude’

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked the ministers of Interior and Justice about reports that two million Dutch citizens had fallen victim to identity fraud, including difficulties victims face in reporting and resolving cases. Minister Plasterk answered that a cabinet vision and an identity monitor would follow by year-end, that the intake and handling of reports is being improved, and that victim satisfaction is reported at 85%.
That is why I committed in the committee meeting of 10 April to inform the House before the end of the year about a broad, coherent cabinet vision on tackling identity fraud

Daarom heb ik in het AO van 10 april j.l. de toezegging gedaan uw Kamer voor het eind van het jaar te berichten over een brede, samenhangende kabinetsvisie met betrekking tot de aanpak van identiteitsfraude
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Recourt over verschillende berichten over het bestuur op Bonaire

MPs Heijnen and Recourt asked about reports of strained relations between the Bonaire governor, executive councillors and the Rijksvertegenwoordiger, alleged loss of trust over integrity, the removal of the supervision directorate from the governor's portfolio, and officials under criminal investigation remaining in office. The minister answered that reports are not always accurate, that portfolio allocation is a political matter for the college, that the governor informed the Rijksvertegenwoordiger in writing, and that integrity measures such as BIOS support and codes of conduct are underway.
It is and remains difficult to make statements with exact certainty about the motives of those involved on Bonaire.
Het is en blijft lastig om met exacte zekerheid uitspraken te doen over motieven van de betrokkenen in Bonaire.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel 'Gemeenten mikpunt van Russische spionage'

The MP asks the Minister of the Interior about a newspaper report that Dutch municipalities are targets of Russian espionage, including whether civil servants and local officials are sufficiently aware of information security risks. The Minister confirms that municipal data such as GBA records interest foreign intelligence services, describes safeguards in the design of the BRP and an information-security taskforce, and lists AIVD awareness publications and presentations.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hachchi over Nederlandstalige beleidsplannen die niet vertaald worden voor Bonaire, St. Eustatius en Saba

An MP asked why the Natuurbeleidsplan for Caribbean Netherlands was published only in Dutch, and whether policy plans for Bonaire, Sint Eustatius and Saba are standardly translated into English or Papiamentu. The minister answered that an English version will appear in August, no Papiamentu version will be made, and there is no legal duty to translate policy plans, leaving that choice to each department.
There is therefore no legal obligation that policy plans applying to Caribbean Netherlands must be translated into English or Papiamentu.
Er bestaat dus geen wettelijke verplichting dat beleidsplannen die gelden voor Caribisch Nederland in het Engels of Papiaments moeten worden vertaald.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven en Voortman over nieuwe fraudemogelijkheden met DigiD en gebrekkige dienstverlening van DigiD bij incidenten

MPs Verhoeven and Voortman asked the Interior Minister about DigiD fraud, where intercepted activation codes let perpetrators hijack accounts and obtain benefits, and about DigiD's handling of victims. The minister replied that misuse requires intercepting the postal code, that accounts are blocked on suspicion of fraud, that 118 fraudulent cases were found, and that a future eID issued in person is planned.
An investigation by the Public Prosecution Service into the use of the unlawfully obtained DigiDs is currently ongoing.
Op dit moment loopt een onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie naar het gebruik van de onrechtmatig verkregen DigiD's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over het doodmaaien van vogels en verwoesten van nesten

An MP from the Party for the Animals asked the government how it reconciles mowing during the breeding season and destroying nests with the Flora and Fauna Act, whether it will ban maintenance and hunting during breeding season, and how it will improve enforcement and a code of conduct for mowing. The state secretary answered that the Act already protects nesting sites, rejected a general breeding-season ban as disproportionate, saw the Rhenoy case as an incident with local enforcement working well, and reported that an agricultural code of conduct lacked sufficient support.

No, such a ban would constitute too severe an intrusion on practice in the agricultural and timber sectors, would have only a very minimal added value compared with the current legal protection, and would therefore overshoot its goal.

Nee, een dergelijk verbod zou een te zware inbreuk vormen op de praktijk van onder andere de agrarische en de houtsector, slechts een zeer minimale meerwaarde hebben ten opzichte van de huidige wettelijke bescherming en daarmee zijn doel voorbij schieten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over afgeluisterde EU-diplomaten

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked the ministers whether the government would raise with the US the reported NSA surveillance of EU diplomats in Washington, Brussels and New York. The government said it had raised the matter at high level, that European and American experts will examine intelligence gathering and data protection together, and that next steps will follow from their findings.
European and American experts will jointly examine the issues of intelligence gathering and data protection.
Europese en Amerikaanse experts zullen zich gezamenlijk buigen over de problematiek van inlichtingenvergaring en dataprotectie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over de vermogensgrenzen bij kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belastingen

An SP MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether it is desirable that the extended municipal power to grant remission of local taxes is not applied to people receiving benefits, whether the asset test for remission should be aligned with the Wet werk en bijstand test, and whether a poorly timed asset assessment date should block remission. The minister replied that cabinet is still deliberating, declined to impose the Wet werk en bijstand asset test on decentralised governments as this would unduly limit their policy freedom, and explained that the reference date is the date the request is filed, which the taxpayer chooses, with no deadline set.
I do not intend to make the asset test for remission equal to the asset test used in the Wet werk en bijstand by imposing it as binding on decentralised governments.

Ik ben niet voornemens om een gelijkstelling van de vermogenstoets bij kwijtschelding aan de vermogenstoets die wordt gehanteerd in de Wet werk en bijstand, dwingend aan de decentrale overheden voor te schrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heijnen en Oosenbrug over het verstrekken van een internationale huwelijksakte aan partners van hetzelfde geslacht

MPs Heijnen and Oosenbrug asked whether the existing international marriage extract model can be used for same-sex marriages and whether Dutch municipalities have a uniform document for this purpose. The state secretary answered that the ICBS revised convention (Convention 34) will include a model form for same-sex marriages, the NVvB has developed a uniform model, and EU-level work is at an early stage.
The intention is to adopt this revised convention at the ICBS General Assembly this coming autumn.
Het voornemen is om deze herziene conventie het komend najaar vast te stellen op de Algemene Vergadering van de ICBS.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop en Van Klaveren over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur van 11 mei 2013 inzake een klokkenluider

MPs Bisschop and Van Klaveren asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on a whistleblower alleging safety and permit failures and clientelism in Rotterdam. The minister said fire safety was in order, the zoning and permit issue was resolved in April 2013, whistleblower channels exist via the municipal ombudsman and the Adviespunt Klokkenluiders, and he welcomed an independent Rotterdam culture investigation while declining to comment on an individual employee's employment situation.
No statements can be made about the employment situation of individual civil servants and the considerations involved.
Over de rechtspositionele situatie van individuele ambtenaren en de afwegingen daarbij kunnen geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen Thieme over de openbaarheid van jachtgegevens

Parliamentary questions from MP Thieme ask whether the government will ask provinces to publish hunting-area data after the Council of State ruled in a Gelderland case, and whether AIVD reports support the claim that disclosure enables disruption of wildlife management. Minister Plasterk declines to judge the province's conduct, says the Council of State's reasoning concerns only the specific parties, and states that the AIVD will publish an extremism report in September 2013 which will be shared with parliament.
I expect this publication to appear in September 2013 and will therefore share it with the House.
Ik verwacht dat deze publicatie in september 2013 zal verschijnen en zal haar dan ook delen met de Kamer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Otwin van Dijk en Heijnen over de vertrekregelingen van enkele bestuurders in de gezondheidszorg

MPs Van Dijk and Heijnen (PvdA) asked about severance arrangements for hospital executives, including a VUmc executive's pay and whether the WNT top-income cap and transitional rules allow loopholes such as special leave, advisory roles and salary top-ups. The minister replied that the reported figures were incorrect, that the supervisory board is the employer and no rules were judged broken, that the EUR 75,000 cap applies with a four-year transitional regime for pre-2013 agreements, and that top-ups depend on circumstances while paid special leave without work is not allowed.
Articles 2.10 and 3.7 of the WNT prohibit employers in the public and semi-public sector from agreeing a severance arrangement with a top official exceeding EUR 75,000.
In artikel 2.10 en 3.7 Wnt wordt het werkgevers in de publieke en semipublieke sector verboden een vertrekregeling met een topfunctionaris overeen te komen die hoger is dan € 75.000.
Antwoord vragen Bosman, Leegte en Litjes naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over de overname van energieproducent Ecopower op Bonaire door het Amerikaanse energiebedrijf Contour

MPs Bosman, Leegte and Litjens asked the ministers of Interior and Economic Affairs about the electricity price rise on Bonaire caused by the dispute between Ecopower and the utility WEB, including subsidies, integrity investigations, and the role of the island government. The minister replied that prices are now cost-covering, payments are per invoice, an audit was done, the island executive is commissioning a governance review, and the Onderzoeksraad Integriteit Overheid does not cover these bodies.
I will ask the island executive of Bonaire to include this subject in that investigation.
Ik zal aan het bestuurscollege van Bonaire verzoeken om dit onderwerp bij dit onderzoek te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Toorenburg over het artikel ‘Den Bosch wil snel duidelijkheid verkiezingen’

Van Toorenburg (CDA) asked the Minister of Interior whether the Den Bosch/Maasdonk merger is voluntary and broadly supported, whether Den Bosch council elections will move to November 2014, which other municipalities face merger procedures, and whether a bill will extend council terms. The minister said he cannot yet judge support without the merger advice and provincial view, listed the other municipalities in merger procedures, and said a postponement bill is with the Council of State and will be submitted soon, covering municipalities with a proposal filed by end 2013.
At this stage of the merger procedure I cannot answer that, as I have not yet received the merger advice and the provincial view.
In deze fase van de herindelingsprocedure kan ik daar geen antwoord op geven, aangezien ik het herindelingsadvies en provinciale zienswijze nog niet heb ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen Van Raak over het afluisteren van internetverkeer

An MP asked about Argo II, Symbolon and AMS-IX, and why a commercial firm was contracted to tap internet traffic at AMS-IX, including links to Israeli intelligence and use of data mining. The minister explained the projects, stated the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2002 does not permit untargeted tapping of AMS-IX, and refused to disclose the functional specifications and supplementary briefing as state secret.
The functional specifications for the new platform give insight into the MIVD's modus operandi and are therefore classified as state secret.
De functionele specificaties voor het nieuwe platform geven inzage in de modus operandi van de MIVD en zijn derhalve staatsgeheim gerubriceerd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over het artikel ’Schuld Aruba enorm’

MP Bosman asked the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations about a report that Aruba's public debt is rising to 71.2%, whether the Netherlands should subscribe to Aruban bond loans, and whether the Netherlands is financially ultimately responsible under the Statute. The minister acknowledged the worrying financial trend, said Aruba's autonomy means oversight lies with Aruban institutions, noted a 2013 protocol under which the Netherlands may refuse subscription if Aruba fails sustainability criteria, and denied that the Netherlands bears ultimate financial responsibility.
The Netherlands reserves the right not to subscribe if Aruba does not meet the criteria.
Nederland behoudt zich het recht voor niet in te schrijven indien Aruba niet voldoet aan de criteria.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over intimidatie en beïnvloedingspraktijken van buitenlandse overheden bij asielzoekers en migranten

An MP asked whether the AIVD has signs that Russia, like Iran and China, intimidates migrants and asylum seekers in the Netherlands, how the immigration chain handles such reports, whether asylum centres are approached by foreign intelligence services, whether staff are screened, how many people are intimidated and how their safety is ensured, and whether the Dolmatov case was investigated. The minister answered that there are no such signs at present, described the referral procedure to the AIVD and MIVD, said there are no concrete indications of foreign services approaching asylum centre residents, explained screening via VOG and security investigations, declined to give numbers publicly, and said the Dolmatov case was examined without leading to measures, while refusing further detail on current knowledge.
I cannot make any public statements about numbers.
Over aantallen kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en en Van Raak over Nederlandse jihadisten

MPs Van Bommel and Van Raak asked whether the AIVD contacted a Dutch jihadist returnee codenamed 'Salem', whether he was turned away by the Tripoli embassy, and what the government does to gather information from returning jihadists. The minister declined to give concrete public information on AIVD contacts, said the embassy inquiry could not be resolved given the anonymous source, and stated the AIVD prioritises research into jihadist travel and return.
I cannot make any concrete public statements about AIVD contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over contacten van de AIVD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid De Wit over de bureaucratische procedures na de vermissing van een persoon

MP De Wit asked ministers about bureaucratic obstacles faced by partners of missing persons with banks, insurers and municipalities, and whether a central desk or mayoral support could help. The government replied that the 2002 Civil Code changes already shorten the procedure, insurers and banks are encouraged to be accommodating, a helpline and information folder exist, and no central desk or new rules are needed.
It does not suit me to assess an individual case.
Het past mij niet om een individueel geval te beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over de laatste politieke ontwikkelingen op Sint Maarten

An MP asks the Dutch minister about political developments on Sint Maarten, including alleged vote-buying by the UP leader, the integrity of proposed ministers, and the status of a vote-buying investigation. The minister says Sint Maarten's judiciary and ministerial screening are autonomous matters, declines to comment on individuals' integrity, and states that strict integrity screening is desirable.
Law enforcement falls under the autonomous powers of the countries.
Rechtshandhaving valt onder de autonome bevoegdheden van de landen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Heijnen en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht ‘Ophef over vergoeding zorgdirecteur’

MPs Heijnen and Van Dijk asked whether a former Cordaan director received a 300,000 euro severance payment despite already having a new job, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary answered that the contractual severance (about 3 million, rounded) was legally binding, that the director has agreed to repay just over two months' salary, and that no legal basis exists to reclaim the full amount since the WNT did not apply at the time; the full scheme will not be disclosed.
This arrangement is an arrangement between employer and employee and as such is not public, not even for VWS.
Deze regeling is een regeling tussen werkgever en werknemer en als zodanig niet openbaar, ook niet voor VWS.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiële positie van gemeenten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities can spread losses of EUR 4.4 billion on land purchases over several years, and about unclear BBV accounting rules affecting Breda. The minister answered that losses must be booked immediately under the BBV and that municipalities should apply the BBV notes of 2012 and 2013 in their 2012 accounts.

The regulations, namely the Decree on budgets and accounts for provinces and municipalities (BBV), clearly establish that losses may not be capitalised and must therefore be recognised immediately when the losses become known.

In de regelgeving, te weten het Besluit begroting en verantwoording provincies en gemeenten (BBV), is duidelijk vastgelegd dat verliezen niet mogen worden geactiveerd en dus direct moeten worden genomen wanneer de verliezen bekend worden.
Antwoord op vragenvan het lid Van Tongeren over de Haagse spionagekastjes

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about hidden camera and recording cabinets found in The Hague's Schilderswijk, who placed them, whether the city was informed, and whether other such cabinets exist. The Justice minister replied that police placed them with prosecutor approval for an observation in a property-crime investigation, the city was not informed as no legal duty exists, and no overall inventory is available.
No overall overview is available of the cabinets and/or recording equipment placed in that context.
Er is geen algeheel overzicht beschikbaar van de in dat kader geplaatste kasten en/of opnameapparatuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de benoeming van Marco van Kalleveen in een commissie voor goed bestuur

An SP MP asked why Marco van Kalleveen, a former Bain Capital vice-president, was appointed to a commission drafting a governance code for the semi-public sector, and whether his role contributed to misconduct there. The minister replied that the commission was balanced and that Van Kalleveen's private-sector experience in advising boards on strategy and oversight is valuable, without addressing the misconduct question directly.
When composing the commission, the aim was a balanced distribution of experience and expertise on governance and oversight in the (semi-)public and private sectors.
Bij het samenstellen van de commissie is gezocht naar een evenwichtige verdeling van ervaring en expertise op het terrein van bestuur en toezicht in de (semi)publieke en private sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “de onkostenvergoeding voor gemeenteraadsleden en de gevolgen hiervan voor mensen met een wajong-uitkering "

An MP from GroenLinks asked whether council members' expense allowances count as taxable income, which can reduce income-linked benefits such as Wajong-related supplements, making council membership difficult for people with disabilities. The State Secretary answered that under the work-cost scheme (werkkostenregeling) the allowance can be kept outside taxable income, removing the financial obstacle, while noting the transition is not yet complete in all municipalities.
With the introduction of the work-cost scheme, the expense allowance of council members classed as fictitious employees can be kept outside the individual taxable wage of a council member.

Met de invoering van de werkkostenregeling kan de onkostenvergoeding van raadsleden die als fictief werknemer worden aangemerkt buiten het individuele belastbaar loon van een raadslid worden gehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heijnen over de gevolgde procedure inzake herbenoeming van de burgemeester van Assen

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the procedure for reappointing the mayor of Assen, in particular why the council voted by secret ballot when the circular prescribes a roll-call vote. The minister acknowledged the deviation from the circular, argued that council votes on such recommendations should be roll-call under the general rule, and announced a legislative amendment to clarify the rules and a wetsvoorstel with procedural improvements.
The procedure followed does not comply with the circular.
De gevolgde procedure is niet in overeenstemming met de circulaire.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Jadnanansing over de onnodige verstrekking van GBA-uittreksels voor de leerlingenadministratie op scholen

MPs Oosenbrug and Jadnanansing asked why schools still demand unnecessary GBA extracts from parents for enrolment, citing cost and municipal workload figures. The minister says the figures are a modelling exercise not verified by government, that some schools still ask for extracts, and that he will contact schools, accountants and parents and recheck with municipalities at year-end.
The government itself has not researched the number of GBA extracts issued for school enrolment, so the correct figures are not known to me.
Er is door de overheid zelf geen onderzoek gedaan naar het aantal verstrekte GBA-uittreksels ten behoeve van inschrijving in het onderwijs, derhalve zijn de juiste cijfers mij niet bekend.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkhoff over het bericht dat de Verenigde Staten al langer zuchten onder cyberaanvallen

Dijkhoff (VVD) asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior about reports of cyberattacks on US financial institutions by the group Cyber Fighters of Izz ad-Din al-Qassam, its links to Iran, funding, sanctions, and DDoS attacks on Dutch banks. Minister Opstelten answered that the group is not on any terrorism list, that investigations into origin and DDoS attacks are ongoing and no conclusions can yet be given, and that concrete measures such as a liaison at the NCSC and a strengthened cyber strategy are being taken.
At present the police High Tech Crime Team, on the orders of the Public Prosecution Service, is conducting an investigation into the DDoS attacks.
Op dit moment voert het Team High Tech Crime van de politie op last van het Openbaar Ministerie een onderzoek uit naar de DDos-aanvallen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Schouw en Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Russische spionnen erg actief zijn in Nederland

MPs Schouw and Sjoerdsma asked whether Russian and Chinese espionage in the Netherlands, including targeting of military-technological knowledge, is adequately understood and countered. The minister answered that intelligence services (AIVD, MIVD) investigate, disrupt operations, advise on security and screen defence contractors, while acknowledging that not all operations can be detected and no further public details can be given.
No further information on this can be provided publicly.
In het openbaar kunnen hierover verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht ‘Gemeente mag instellingen geen salarisnorm opleggen’

MP Heijnen asked the minister of Interior about a court ruling that a municipality may not impose a salary cap on subsidised institutions, and how this relates to the WNT pay-cap law. The minister answered that the WNT does not preclude municipalities from attaching stricter pay conditions to subsidies, that the court found Eindhoven's subsidy conditions contrary to the Awb, and that the appeal is being pursued, with the VNG working on a model subsidy regulation and talks with the VNG planned.
The WNT does not preclude decentralised public bodies from imposing, through subsidy conditions, additional or stricter restrictions on the pay of staff and directors of institutions they subsidise.

De WNT verzet zich niet tegen het door decentrale bestuursorganen door middel van de subsidievoorwaarden stellen van aanvullende of verdergaande beperkingen aan de bezoldiging van medewerkers en bestuurders van door deze bestuursorganen gesubsidieerde instellingen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het onzorgvuldig handelen van de overheid waar het gaat om het verzamelen en aan elkaar koppelen van persoonsgegevens

An MP asks the State Secretary and Interior Minister about government data linking and purpose limitation, citing the Dutch privacy regulator's warning of growing overreach and declining citizen transparency. The government answers that data linking is a deliberate choice within existing law, supports purpose limitation and the 'select before you collect' principle, points to MijnOverheid and access rights as transparency tools, and declines to give a substantive response to the regulator's annual report.
The cabinet therefore endorses the 'select before you collect' principle advised by the Advisory Committee on Security and Personal Privacy to avoid creating a 'digital haystack'.

Het kabinet onderschrijft dan ook het door de Adviescommissie veiligheid en persoonlijke levenssfeer gehanteerde uitgangspunt van «select before you collect» om te vermijden dat een «digitale hooiberg» ontstaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over het ongewenst toekennen van dubbele nationaliteiten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Interior whether municipalities automatically register Turkish nationality for children with a Turkish parent, bypassing the Turkish family register and making renunciation difficult. The minister answered that registration merely reflects foreign law, that municipalities do not grant nationality, and that the Brp bill will end registration of foreign nationality alongside Dutch nationality once in force.
It is not correct that children with at least one Turkish parent automatically acquire Turkish nationality as a second nationality upon registration in the municipal personal records database (GBA).

Het is niet juist dat kinderen, van wie in ieder geval één van de ouders een Turkse nationaliteit heeft, bij inschrijving in de gemeentelijke basisadministratie persoonsgegevens (GBA) automatisch de Turkse nationaliteit als tweede nationaliteit verkrijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de Verhoeven over het uitvallen van DigiD vanwege DDoS-aanvallen

An MP asked the Interior Minister about the DDoS attacks that made DigiD hard to reach, including the attack's modest scale, the comparison with the DigiNotar incident, and single points of failure. The minister answered that DigiD was never fully offline, that no hacks occurred, that the eID design will avoid single points of failure, and that Logius strengthened measures with NCSC support.
Given the economic and social importance of DigiD, Logius has taken additional and tightened measures following the attacks to continue monitoring and securing DigiD's continuity and availability.

Gelet op het economisch en maatschappelijk belang van DigiD heeft Logius naar aanleiding van de aanvallen additionele en verscherpte maatregelen getroffen om de continuïteit en beschikbaarheid van DigiD, te kunnen blijven bewaken en te borgen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bouwmeester over de subsidieverlening aan Jellinek Curaçao

An MP asked the minister how a 90,000 euro subsidy to Jellinek Curaçao came about, whether it was a rejected hotel cost shifted on civil servants' advice, and whether the subsidy should be reclaimed given reports of poor care and links to hotel Kura Hulanda. The minister explained that the amount was freed budget from hardware costs, that quality of care is not monitored by the executing agency, and that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed because the procedure was correct.
I cannot make any statement about the period after the subsidy process under PSNA was ended.
Ik kan geen uitspraak doen over de periode nadat het subsidietraject onder PSNA werd beëindigd.
Antwoord vragen Dijkhoff over het bericht ‘Angst on lot jihadtieners’

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports of parents worried about children leaving for jihad in Syria, including whether signals were investigated and whether recruitment occurred. The minister answered that signals are taken seriously and part of ongoing investigations, that no organised recruitment is evident, and pointed to existing counter-terrorism measures, without giving case-specific detail.
Signals from society about support for jihadism are taken seriously and are included in ongoing investigations.
Signalen vanuit de samenleving over ondersteuning van jihadisme worden serieus genomen en worden betrokken bij lopende onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Berndsen-Jansen over het bericht dat gratis trouwen uit de hand loopt

MP Berndsen-Jansen asked the Interior Minister about reports that free civil marriages are overloaded and whether the 1897 rule enabling them is outdated, and whether an income test should be introduced. Minister Plasterk replied that municipalities set the free-marriage slots, that the rule should stay so marriage remains open to all, and that income-related fees are reserved to the national government, so no change is planned.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de betrokkenheid van de Algemene Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdienst (AIVD) bij een onderzoek naar de heer De Roy van Zuydewijn

An SP MP asked the Prime Minister whether Prince Bernhard in 2000 had instructed the Queen's Cabinet to request information from the BVD about Mr De Roy van Zuydewijn, why the 2003 cabinet did not disclose that the initiative came from the Prince, and why an intelligence service inquiry beyond a standard security check was considered justified. The government answered by referring to the 10 March 2003 letter to parliament and the earlier debate and motions, without restating the substance.
The letter of 10 March 2003 contains the cabinet's position on this subject and the grounds on which it rests.
De brief van 10 maart 2003 bevat het kabinetsstandpunt over dit onderwerp en de gronden waarop het berust
Antwoord vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Recourt over mogelijke verspilling van belastinggeld door het Openbaar Ministerie

MPs Oosenbrug and Recourt asked whether the Public Prosecution Service pays an IT provider for 11,000 accounts, including accounts with no employee attached, and whether other government bodies do the same. The minister replied that billing is currently a fixed price rather than per account, that talks are underway on per-account billing, and that no central register of accounts exists across government.
There is no central register of accounts within central government.
Er is binnen het Rijk geen centraal register van accounts.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Fokke en Oosenbrug over het bericht «Gemeenten vrezen toename verloedering door bezuinigingen Rijk»

MPs Fokke and Oosenbrug asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior whether the planned end to municipal reimbursement for enforcing nuisance fines (bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast, such as littering and illegal parking) would weaken local enforcement, and whether they had consulted the VNG. Minister Opstelten answered that consultations with the VNG on the reimbursement scheme are ongoing and that the Chamber will be informed once more is known.
I am still in consultation with the Association of Dutch Municipalities (VNG) about the reimbursement scheme for municipalities concerning the administrative penalty order for nuisance.
Ik ben nog in overleg met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten (VNG) over de vergoedingsregeling voor gemeenten met betrekking tot de bestuurlijke strafbeschikking overlast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over een vergunning voor de omstreden geitenstal in Landerd

An MP asked the ministers whether the controversial goat stable in Landerd may proceed despite a provincial construction stop and the Health Council's report on livestock health risks, and whether the Crown should annul the building permit. The government answered that annulment is discretionary, that no conflict with law or the general interest was found, that the permit was lawfully granted, and that it will not further suspend or annul the permit or await the cabinet response.
In this case it has become clear to me that no conflict with the law or the general interest has been shown.
In deze zaak is het mij duidelijk geworden dat er niet van strijd met het recht of het algemeen belang is gebleken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Wilders over 100 Nederlandse Jihadisten die vechten in het buitenland

MPs Bontes and Wilders asked whether Dutch jihadists fighting abroad should be detained on return in a special terrorist wing, how many hold dual nationality or residence permits, and whether dual nationals should be denaturalised and expelled. The minister answered that suspects would be placed in the existing Terrorist Wing, declined to give numbers or individual cases, said most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and described immigration measures and the possibility of revoking Dutch nationality after a terrorism conviction where statelessness does not result.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fokke over gemeenten zonder rekenkamer(functie)

An MP asked the Interior Minister about municipalities without an active audit committee (rekenkamer), citing an NVRR study, and whether such non-compliance with the Gemeentewet should have consequences and how to activate them. The minister answered that municipalities must have a rekenkamer, will discuss the study with VNG and IPO, but rejects coercive or sanction measures and is not in favour of amending the Arhi law to mandate audit functions during municipal mergers.
Municipalities must have a rekenkamer. Not only because it is in the law, but because it is important.
Gemeenten moeten een rekenkamer hebben. Niet alleen omdat dit in de wet staat, maar omdat het belangrijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Verhoeven over de marktverstorende overheid en herintredende overheidsdiensten

MPs Schouw and Verhoeven asked why the government takes back in-house activities it had outsourced, whether this distorts markets under the Wet markt en overheid, and how it squares with the compact civil service goal. The minister answered that the state may freely choose between outsourcing and in-house work, that in-house activities fall outside the market-conduct law, and that employment considerations will be presented in May.
I consider it desirable that government service providers assess per activity whether it is sensible to put an assignment on the market or to carry out the activity themselves.
Ik vind het wenselijk dat overheidsdiensten per activiteit beoordelen of het verstandig is om een opdracht in de markt te zetten of om de betreffende activiteit zelf uit te voeren.

Vragen van het lid Omtzigt (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de ministers van Financiën, van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, en van Vol

MP Omtzigt asked whether the derivative position of Groningen Seaports, which holds derivatives without underlying loans, complies with current law, and whether an accounting arrangement that pays derivatives early masks the company's real position. The minister answered that an open position arose from tender gains and lower investment volume without breaching the Wet financiering decentrale overheden or its regulation, and that the temporary restructuring fits within accountant rules and was noted by the auditor.
There is no violation of applicable laws and regulations (Wet financiering decentrale overheden and Regeling uitzettingen en derivaten decentrale overheden).
Er is geen sprake van overtreding van geldende wet- en regelgeving (Wet financiering decentrale overheden en Regeling uitzettingen en derivaten decentrale overheden).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de verwaarlozing van ezels op Sint Eustatius

An MP asked the government about reports that dozens of stray donkeys on Sint Eustatius were held in a fenced area without adequate food and water, and whether national authorities should intervene and harmonise animal welfare rules. The state secretary answered that a drought caused a temporary feed shortage now resolved, that the public body is responsible and has acted with a stakeholder action plan, and that legislative restraint toward Caribbean Netherlands applies until the 2015 evaluation.
Ensuring animal welfare is a responsibility of the public body.
Het waarborgen van het welzijn van dieren is een verantwoordelijkheid van het openbaar lichaam.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosman over hulp van Nederland bij de herfinanciering van de staatsschuld van Aruba

MP Bosman (VVD) asks the minister whether the Netherlands should subscribe to Aruba's sovereign bond issues, citing concerns about Aruba's deficits and debt, and asks about oversight, the advisory college and why Aruba is not under financial supervision. Minister Plasterk answers that any subscription will be assessed against sustainability and repayment criteria, that Aruba bears responsibility for its own finances and oversight, and that the detailed procedure is still being worked out.

The Netherlands will (have) assess(ed) the possibilities for a subscription requested by Aruba against criteria of sustainable public finances and repayment capacity used in the Kingdom and internationally.

Nederland zal de mogelijkheden voor een door Aruba gevraagde inschrijving (laten) beoordelen op in het Koninkrijk en internationaal gehanteerde criteria van houdbare overheidsfinanciën en terugbetalingcapaciteit.
Antwoord vragen Vermeij over beleggingen van het ABP in Hospira

An MP asked whether the government, as employer and sector representative, could influence ABP pension fund investments in Hospira, a supplier of drugs used in US executions, and what it would do about human-rights concerns. The government replied that the fund's board is responsible for investment policy, that the state has no direct influence over the privatised fund, and that ABP is engaging Hospira, which has imposed distributor restrictions.
ABP is a privatised pension fund. This means the government/cabinet exercises no direct influence over it.
Het ABP is een geprivatiseerd pensioenfonds. Dat betekent dat de overheid/het kabinet daar geen directe invloed op uitoefent.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over het bericht dat Sint Maarten haar deel van de rekening voor de kustwacht weigert te betalen

An MP from the PVV asked the Interior Minister whether Sint Maarten refuses to pay most of its share of the coast guard costs, what the government will do about it, and whether Sint Maarten can be separated from the Kingdom. The minister answered that Sint Maarten has not refused to pay, the payment was late but has now been made, its 2012 share is about 680,000 euros, and any separation is for Sint Maarten to decide.
There is no question of Sint Maarten refusing to pay.
Er is geen sprake van een weigering tot betaling door Sint Maarten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over het bericht dat de Amerikaanse autoriteiten onderzoek doen naar de mogelijke corruptie bij Microsoft

An SP MP asked the ministers whether they know of Microsoft bribing or approaching Dutch officials for software contracts, whether they contacted foreign authorities, and what influence Microsoft had on the NOiV open-standards programme. The minister answered that no bribery is known, that contact between officials and companies is normal, that no information was sought abroad given the ongoing US inquiry, and that Microsoft did not sign the open-standards manifesto.
I am not aware of any bribery.
Van omkoping is mij niets bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Heijnen en Bosman over berichten dat de politiek op Sint Maarten corruptieonderzoek torpedeert

MPs Heijnen and Bosman asked whether Sint Maarten's government would cut the police, prosecution and criminal investigation services, potentially disrupting the corruption probe into a Member of Parliament and a minister, and whether MPs' salaries were rising. Minister Plasterk answered that Sint Maarten is financially autonomous and its budget is not yet final, that the prosecution has sufficient capacity so the probe can continue, that he will raise the cuts and the action plans with Sint Maarten's Prime Minister, and that MPs' allowances are about 30% higher than in Aruba and Curaçao, which he has objected to informally.
I would however consider it worrying if the announced cuts were indeed to affect the quality of law enforcement, investigation and prosecution of (cross-border) crime

Ik zou het echter zorgelijk achten als de aangekondigde bezuinigingen inderdaad gevolgen zouden hebben voor de kwaliteit van de rechtshandhaving, onderzoek en vervolging van (grensoverschrijdende) criminaliteit
Antwoord vragen van het lid Kooiman over agenten die Twitter gebruiken

An SP MP asked whether individual police officers' Twitter accounts were banned from 1 April 2013 and whether they would be replaced by team accounts, and asked about their added value. The minister denied any ban, said individual accounts such as neighbourhood officers' accounts are encouraged, and described the use of Twitter as a valuable complement to traditional police-citizen communication.
No, on the contrary: individual accounts are actually encouraged.
Nee, integendeel: individuele accounts worden juist gestimuleerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Oosenbrug over het verwisselen van identiteitspapieren

MPs Marcouch and Oosenbrug asked about a RamBam broadcast showing identity documents being swapped, enabling bank accounts, car rentals, Schiphol border passage and an ID card with another person's photo. The ministers confirm the facts, describe the Marechaussee's checks and planned training, and announce a review of the reisdocument application process.
This also applies if a photo of someone else is accepted when applying for an identity card.
Dit geldt ook als een foto van iemand anders wordt geaccepteerd bij de aanvraag van een identiteitskaart.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over "de dagelijkse imperialistische moskeeoproep"

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether daily mosque calls to prayer are harmful to integration and whether mosques should be prevented from broadcasting them. Minister Asscher answered that religious freedom and church-state neutrality protect such calls, that municipalities may set rules on duration and volume under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that no ground exists for banning them.
There is no ground for that.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum, Schouw, Segers, Leijten, Klaver, Tony van Dijck, Dijkgraaf, Ouwehand en Klein over het bericht “VNG wil overleg kabinet over bezuinigingen”

MPs asked whether the government would commission research, with the VNG, into whether the decentralisations and cumulative efficiency cuts are feasible for municipalities, and how risks and cumulative effects on vulnerable groups are monitored. The minister declined a separate CPB study for now, pointed to monitoring commitments and a motion-based independent study to be scoped with the VNG, and said the minister of Social Affairs would map cumulative effects.
Your House has since, in a motion by MP Schouw, asked the government to have an independent party investigate the financial and implementation risks of the decentralisations.

Uw Kamer heeft inmiddels in een motie van het lid Schouw aan de regering verzocht door een onafhankelijke partij een onderzoek te laten doen naar de financiële risico's en uitvoeringsrisico's van de decentralisaties
Antwoord vragen van het lid Omtzigt betreffende derivaten

Deputy Omtzigt asked the Interior and Finance ministers about derivative positions of the central government, local authorities and their participations, including whether regional and municipal participations hold derivatives and what rules apply, and asked about specific cases such as Slibverwerkingsbedrijf Noord-Brabant and PWN. Minister Plasterk answered that participations are privately organised and fall outside the Fido and Ruddo regimes, that accountability for them lies with the local councils and shareholder governance, and promised a separate letter on Groningen Seaports and a later inventory of central government derivative positions.
I am not responsible for supervising these private-law organisations.
Ik ben niet belast met het toezicht op deze privaatrechtelijke organisaties.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de benoeming van een commissaris van de Koningin in de provincie Utrecht

MP Van Raak asks why the minister intends to appoint Rosenmöller as interim commissaris van de Koningin in Utrecht without a formal selection procedure, without support from the provincial states, and before a concrete merger plan exists. The minister replies that the appointment is a temporary (waarnemend) one under article 76 Provinciewet, that the provincial states will be heard, that confidentiality applies to the name, and that the merger procedure is at an early, consultative stage.
Before doing so, it shall hear the provincial states, unless serious reasons oppose this.
Alvorens daartoe over te gaan hoort zij provinciale staten, tenzij gewichtige reden zich daartegen verzetten.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over de voorgenomen benoeming van maoïst Rosenmöller tot commissaris van de Koningin in Utrecht

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior about the planned appointment of Paul Rosenmöller as Queen's Commissioner in Utrecht, citing his past Maoist and Khmer Rouge-related activities and his stated lack of regret. The minister confirmed the reported plan in general terms but declined to discuss the named individual, citing full confidentiality in the appointment procedure.
In the procedure to appoint (acting) Queen's Commissioners, full confidentiality is always observed.
In de procedure om te komen tot de benoeming van (wnd.) commissarissen van de Koningin wordt altijd volledige vertrouwelijkheid betracht.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Heijnen over het ontslaan van Hells Angels in dienst van de overheid

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers whether dismissing civil servants who belong to outlaw motorcycle clubs such as Hells Angels fits the criminal-justice approach, and whether central government employs such people. The government answered that membership is undesirable for civil servants, that existing integrity and employment law allows measures including dismissal, and that it will promote the norm to other governments and update the integrity code, without a separate investigation.
Since the procedure within the municipality is still ongoing, no further comment can be made on the specific status and functions of the employees.
Aangezien de procedure binnen de gemeente nog loopt, kan verder niet op de specifieke stand van zaken en de functies van de medewerkers worden ingegaan
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bouwmeester en Heijnen over de sluiting van Jellinek Curaçao

MPs Bouwmeester and Heijnen asked whether the closure of Jellinek Curaçao, a rehab clinic funded under a Dutch subsidy programme, shows the project failed its aims, whether the subsidy should be reclaimed, and what lessons follow. The minister replied that the subsidy cannot be reclaimed after final settlement, that the clinic contributed while active, and that the programme's sustainability focus will be strengthened.
Reclaiming after final settlement is inconsistent with the conditions under which the subsidy was granted and is therefore legally impossible.
Terugvordering na vaststelling strookt niet met de voorwaarden waaronder de subsidieverlening is verstrekt en is dus juridisch niet mogelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Knops over het bericht verstandelijk beperkt echtpaar in de vrieskou

MPs Van Toorenburg and Knops asked about a couple with intellectual disabilities evicted from a Dordrecht senior flat over rent arrears, and about cooperation to prevent evictions. The minister answered that the eviction followed a court ruling, that prevention is mainly the landlord's responsibility, that a new prevention covenant with Dordrecht was signed, and that the government will underline the importance of prevention in consultations.
Preventing evictions is a responsibility of landlords.
Het voorkomen van huisuitzettingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van verhuurders.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw betreffende de gevolgen van de door de medeoverheden verstrekte hypothecaire leningen voor de schuldpositie

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the Chamber should be informed about the effects on debt positions of mortgage loans that municipalities, provinces, water boards and ZBOs gave to their staff, and whether an inventory should be made. The minister replied that such loans are an autonomous matter with no specific reporting duty, that existing budget and supervision mechanisms suffice, and that he sees no realistic chance of an information request.
Providing mortgage loans to one's own staff is an autonomous matter for which there is no specific reporting obligation.
Het verstrekken van hypothecaire leningen aan eigen personeel is een autonome aangelegenheid waarover geen specifieke rapportageplicht bestaat.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over het optreden van de AIVD in de zaak Sabir K.

The SP MP Van Raak asked whether the AIVD investigated the Sabir K. case early on, whether it acted for the CIA or also examined CIA conduct, whether evidence obtained through torture in Pakistan can be excluded, and why the Netherlands does not prosecute K., a Dutch national, itself. The ministers declined to say publicly whether the AIVD investigated early, said the AIVD does no work on behalf of other services, relied on US court findings and treaty obligations on torture evidence, and explained that prosecution in the US is most logical given the location of the offence, evidence and extradition request.
I cannot make any public statements about this.
Ik kan hierover in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht “veel overheden missen integriteitsplan”

MP Heijnen asked whether it is concerning that about a third of public bodies lack or have a deficient integrity policy plan, and how the minister would respond given the legal and administrative framework. Minister Plasterk answered that the BIOS study covered 30 bodies with about 10 found deficient, that this is a signal rather than representative, that integrity duties under the Civil Servants Act and agreed basic norms apply, and that he will bring the findings to the umbrella organisations without prescribing how bodies fulfil the framework.
I will therefore also bring this research to the attention of the relevant umbrella organisations.
Ik zal dit onderzoek daarom ook bij de betreffende koepelorganisaties onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over het verstrekken van gegevens van gedecoreerde inwoners aan gemeenten

An MP asked the Interior Minister why municipalities no longer receive data on decorated residents from the BPR agency, and whether this should be reversed. The minister explained the data transfer moved to a central facility and that a privacy balance was struck, then said that after reconsidering municipalities' legitimate interest, the data will be made available before Koninginnedag without a law change.
I will inform the municipalities of this and ensure that the necessary data is made available before the upcoming Koninginnedag.
Ik zal dit aan gemeenten berichten en zorgen dat vóór de aanstaande Koninginnedag de benodigde gegevens ter beschikking worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Oskam over het bericht dat de voormalige wethouder van Roermond de documenten die door het Openbaar Ministerie zijn gevorderd bij de gemeente Roermond heeft ingezien

MP Oskam asked ministers about a former Roermond alderman who obtained documents seized by the Public Prosecution Service from the municipality, including building project files, and whether rules exist for such requests. The government answered that the municipality handled his requests as Wob requests, that the decision is for the municipality and reviewable in court, that no specific rules exist, and that he must pay fees.
It is up to the municipality to take a decision on the requests.
Het is aan de gemeente om een besluit te nemen naar aanleiding van de verzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de nieuwe salafistische moskee van imam Fawaz

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked how the AIVD monitors imam Fawaz after his departure from the As Soenna mosque, whether they agree that a new salafist mosque is unwelcome, whether he should be denaturalised and expelled for calls to violence, and what measures will prevent the mosque opening. The minister declined to comment on individual AIVD investigations, defended religious freedom, explained that calls to violence alone are not grounds for losing Dutch nationality, and said the opening of a prayer house is a municipal zoning matter for The Hague.
No public statements are made about AIVD investigations in individual cases.
Over onderzoek van de AIVD in individuele zaken worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over de grondverliezen van gemeenten

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether municipal land-exploitation losses and the limited provincial supervision threaten municipal capacity, and whether new rules are needed. The minister answered that losses are being absorbed by municipalities under existing norms, that provincial supervision is not marginal, and that no new accountant instructions are currently needed.
The intention exists to carry out a follow-up study again this year, in consultation with the provincial supervisors.
Het voornemen bestaat om ook dit jaar en in overleg met de provinciale toezichthouders, weer een vervolgonderzoek te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Bosman, Van Raak en Heijnen over het artikel “Patrick Illidge seen in tape apparently accepting bribe”

Three MPs asked the Interior Minister whether a reported video showing a Sint Maarten official apparently accepting a bribe linked to prostitution, and whether the Kingdom's guarantee function should be invoked. The minister replied that the Sint Maarten Public Prosecutor is investigating and has seized material, that the Dutch Rijksrecherche can only act on Sint Maarten at its request, and that the guarantee function does not apply.
It is for the Public Prosecutor's Office of Sint Maarten to conduct further investigation and determine whether and who should be prosecuted.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie van Sint Maarten om nader onderzoek te verrichten en te bepalen of en zo ja wie vervolgd zou moeten worden.
Antwoord vragen Bisschop over berichtgeving dat het gemeentebestuur Rotterdam jarenlang willens en wetens lakse moskee-internaten tolereerde

An SGP MP asked the ministers whether Rotterdam's municipal government knowingly tolerated unsafe mosque boarding schools, whether officials' warnings were ignored, and how oversight and whistleblowers are protected. The ministers answered that fire safety was adequate, no failed supervision or integrity breach by officials or administrators was found, and that the municipality has a whistleblower scheme and the burgemeester will speak with officials who felt political pressure.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de aangifte tegen een klokkenluider

An MP asked the Interior Minister about Rotterdam filing a criminal complaint against an official who leaked information on a mosque boarding-school meeting, and whether whistleblowers are protected. The minister answered that officials must report misconduct through the whistleblower procedure, which carries a non-retaliation rule, but that leaking information to the press is a criminal offence and does not fall under that protection.
Reporting misconduct in accordance with the applicable whistleblower scheme must be distinguished from leaking information.
Het melden van een misstand overeenkomstig de daarvoor gelden klokkenluidersregeling dient onderscheiden te worden van het lekken van informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Fritsma over de komst van de winnaar van de verkiezingen op Curaçao die Nederlanders bodybags in het vooruitzicht heeft gesteld

An MP asked whether Curaçao election winner Wiels, who reportedly said body bags were ready for Dutch nationals, should be barred from entering the Netherlands. The minister replied that the government values Wiels's constructive relations with the Netherlands and that the Kingdom has no power to bar Dutch nationals from entry.
In the Kingdom there is no possibility of 'denying access' to persons with Dutch nationality.
In het Koninkrijk bestaat geen mogelijkheid tot «ontzeggen van toegang» aan personen met een Nederlandse nationaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het bericht dat zijn ‘fusiebonus’ om gemeentelijke herindelingen te stimuleren, in strijd is met de wet

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about press reports that his proposed financial 'fusion bonus' to encourage municipal mergers conflicts with the Financial Relations Act, and about claims that no negative incentive against mergers exists. The Minister acknowledged a negative incentive from losing the fixed amount, said he is researching a positive incentive system and would propose legislation if needed, and rejected the claim that the fixed amount is unimportant.
At present I am researching the desired system of financial incentives. Should the outcome mean that a legislative amendment is necessary, you will of course receive a proposal to that effect.

Op dit moment doe ik onderzoek naar het gewenste systeem van financiële prikkels. Mocht de uitkomst hiervan betekenen dat wetswijziging noodzakelijk is, dan zult u vanzelfsprekend een daartoe strekkend voorstel ontvangen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het uitschrijven van mensen uit de GBA wanneer zij langer dan zes maanden elders verblijven

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior whether people who spend more than six months a year elsewhere can stay registered in the municipal population register, what the consequences of deregistration are, how many people are deregistered for this reason, and whether an investigation into keeping such people registered at home is planned. The minister explained the two-thirds-abroad criterion for deregistration and its importance for residence-linked obligations, said central figures are not available, and stated that the rules will carry over into the proposed Wet basisregistratie personen.
The number of persons per year who are deregistered ex officio for this reason cannot be determined at central level.
Het aantal personen dat per jaar om deze reden ambtshalve wordt uitgeschreven, is op centraal niveau niet te achterhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van bijzondere bevoegdheden door de geheime diensten tegen politici, in het bijzonder tegen Roel van Duijn

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the secret services' use of special powers against politician Roel van Duijn was improper, as the National Ombudsman suggested, and whether further investigation and rules are needed. The minister said the case concerns the pre-2002 BVD, that the CTIVD has no remit for it, that he will meet Van Duijn, and that politicians receive notification under the same rules as others, while declining to give operational details.
The Review Committee on the Intelligence and Security Services (CTIVD) has no task or powers to conduct an investigation in this case.
De Commissie van Toezicht voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (CTIVD) heeft in dit geval geen taak en bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de mogelijke komst van een moskee op de Pier in Scheveningen

Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a mosque on the Scheveningen pier was being planned by a foundation called Al Sahab, and whether such a mosque should be prevented. The government answered that the foundation does not exist (the report was a joke by a broadcaster) and that municipalities decide on building permits within zoning rules.
It is up to municipalities to judge possible applications for building permits; these must in any case fit within the zoning plan.
Het is aan gemeenten om te oordelen over mogelijke aanvragen voor bouwvergunningen; deze dienen in ieder geval te passen binnen het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een petitie tegen de mogelijke bouw van een moskee in Enschede

PVV MPs asked whether the government received a petition against a mosque in Enschede, whether growing opposition should halt construction, and whether the Turkish state controls the Islamic Stichting Nederland. The minister acknowledged the petition, said citizens' wishes matter but that the municipality must judge them, and explained that the mosque will join the ISN network founded under Turkish religious authority, which is permitted within Dutch law.
Everyone in the Netherlands has the right to freedom of religion.
Iedereen in Nederland heeft het recht op vrijheid van godsdienst.
