Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van hypothecaire leningen aan medewerkers door de overheid

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of the Interior about municipalities and other public bodies providing mortgage loans to their staff, including amounts involved, effects on debt, and whether such loans should end. The Minister agreed it is not a government task, noted that since 2009 the Wet FIDO bars public bodies from such contracts, but said he does not know the total outstanding loans and that decentralised governments need not report them.
I am not aware of the total of ongoing mortgage loans that were entered into before 2009.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van het totaal aan lopende hypothecaire leningen die voor 2009 zijn aangegaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de verkiezingen voor het fusiewaterschap Vechtstromen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked whether the planned autumn 2013 elections for the merged water board Vechtstromen are lawful given the postponement of water board elections to 2015 and the transitional rules for mergers. The minister answered that the Water Board Act requires elections before a merger, that the board's term is extended to January 2019 by skipping the November 2014 elections, and that differing provincial decisions on guaranteed seats require a joint provincial decision under article 6.
Under article 29, fourth paragraph, the Vechtstromen board skips these elections and its term ends together with the end of the following term (January 2019).

Op grond van het bepaalde in artikel 29, vierde lid, slaat het bestuur van Vechtstromen deze verkiezingen over en eindigt de zittingsperiode gelijk met het einde van de hierop volgende zittingsperiode (januari 2019).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over de hermelijnen koningsmantel die zou worden gedragen t.b.v. staatsieportretten en de kroning

An MP asked whether the royal ermine-lined coronation mantle would be worn at the 2013 inauguration and state portraits, and whether this conflicts with protected-species and anti-fur-farming rules, and asked for the 1980 decree to be amended. The government answered that the historical mantle uses ermine fur, no fur has been added since 1980, wearing it follows existing rules and tradition, and it declined to amend the decree.
Wearing the mantle by the King is in accordance with the applicable regulations, the Flora and Fauna Act and historical custom.
Het dragen van de mantel door de Koning is in overeenstemming met de hiervoor geldende voorschriften, de Flora- en Faunawet en het historisch gebruik.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over stijgende lokale lasten

An MP from D66 asked the Interior Minister about sharp rises in local property tax (OZB) and waterschap charges, including whether the 2013 macronorm would be exceeded and how the motion on capping water board charges is being implemented. The minister answered that tariff-setting is an autonomous municipal and water board competence within the macronorm framework, that definitive figures await the uniform monitor due in March, and that any overshoot would be raised in the Bofv consultation where sanctions could be considered.
If the actual macronorm is exceeded, the central government will raise this in the regular Bofv consultation with subnational governments in spring.

Als er sprake is van een overschrijding van de feitelijke macronorm dan zal dit door het Rijk aan de orde worden gesteld in het reguliere Bestuurlijke overleg financiële verhoudingen (Bofv) met medeoverheden in het voorjaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever, Bosma en Wilders over het bericht “Graaiers moeten inleveren”

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Interior and Health why top salaries in the public and semi-public sector keep rising, whether pay rises before the WNT pay-cap took effect were improper, and whether executives who sued to escape the cap should be pursued. The minister defended the WNT and its transitional rules, said there is no evidence of pre-emptive pay rises, and stated that challenging government decisions in court is a right.
Anyone is free to have government decisions reviewed by the court.
Het staat een ieder vrij om beslissingen van de overheid door de rechter te laten toetsen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Fritsma over het bericht dat Eindhoven een miljoen verspilt bij verplaatsing woonwagenkamp

MPs Van Klaveren and Fritsma asked the Minister of Interior whether Eindhoven's municipal government could account for 2.2 million euros in relocation compensation paid for a caravan camp, and what would be done to limit the damage and prevent such excesses. The Minister replied that the money was paid on suspected forgery, that the municipality has filed a criminal complaint and commissioned an internal review, and that accountability rests locally, so no generic national measures are planned.
Accountability for this matter must take place at the local level, and I therefore see no reason for generic measures on my part.
De verantwoording over deze kwestie dient op lokaal niveau plaats te vinden, en ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding voor generieke maatregelen van mijn kant.

Antwoord vragen van het lid Arib over de gevolgen van de oorlog in Syrië voor de mogelijkheden van Nederlandse statushouders om te naturaliseren en voor de gezinsleden van vluchtelingen om naar Nederland na te reizen

An MP asked about the consequences of the Syrian war for Syrian status holders' naturalisation eligibility and for family reunification, including document requirements and processing times. The state secretary answered that most naturalisation requirements still apply, that document evidence of hardship is assessed case by case, and that family reunification processing averages 22 weeks with no commitment to fast-track or early entry.
This information is not available. The IND does not record this data.
Deze informatie is niet beschikbaar. De IND legt deze gegevens niet vast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de enorme groei van het aantal salafisten aan de Nederlandse grens

An MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Interior about reports of a rising number of radical salafists near the German-Dutch border, including possible Dutch targets, contacts with German intelligence, and mosques under monitoring. The state secretary replied that there are no indications of a threat to Dutch targets, declined to detail contacts with German services citing confidentiality, and said no mosque leaders are currently known to threaten public order.
I cannot make further public statements about the content of these contacts.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen nadere mededelingen doen over de inhoud van deze contacten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fokke en Jacobi over de gestegen waterschapsbelastingen

MPs Fokke and Jacobi asked the Minister whether rising water board charges in 2012 were consistent with the efficiency gains agreed in the Bestuursakkoord Water, and about regional differences. The Minister replied that charges rose about 2% on average, that the efficiency targets moderate rather than reduce charges, and that the rise is expected to fit the agreements, attributing regional differences to area characteristics and local policy choices.

As the answers to questions 3, 4 and 5 show, contrary to what the Vereniging Eigen Huis appears to assume, the Bestuursakkoord Water did not agree that the efficiency gains would lead to lower charges, but to a moderation of the increase in charges.

Zoals uit de beantwoording van de vragen 3, 4 en 5 blijkt is, anders dan de Vereniging Eigen Huis lijkt te veronderstellen, in het Bestuursakkoord Water niet afgesproken dat de te realiseren doelmatigheidswinsten gaan leiden tot lagere lasten, maar dat ze leiden tot een matiging van de lastenstijging.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht dat de heer van der V. op interim-basis toetreedt tot de raad van bestuur van het Kennemergasthuis

Two MPs asked the government whether the interim appointment of Mr. van der V. to the Kennemergasthuis board, his pay, and the related merger and reorganisation were acceptable and whether he falls under the Wet normering topinkomens. The minister said the supervisory boards are responsible for appointments and pay, that the WNT applies to interim directors after six months, and declined to disclose individual income or comment on the reorganisation and the merger.
The supervisory boards are responsible for appointing directors, including in the case of the Kennemergasthuis.
De Raden van Toezicht zijn verantwoordelijk voor het aanstellen van bestuurders, ook in het geval van het Kennemergasthuis.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over ministers die meer verdienen dan het ministersalaris

MP Van Raak asked why ministers may exceed the ministerial salary norm without appearing on the top-earners list, and whether their total incomes will be published. The minister says the 2011 and 2012 income overviews have been made public in a letter to the Chamber, and explains that some Commissioners of the Queen appear on the list only because of the fiscal addition for a private-use car.
In the letter sent to the Chamber today (Kamerstuk II 30 111, no. 58), the cabinet has made the income overviews for 2011 and 2012 public.
In de heden aan de Kamer gezonden brief (Kamerstuk II 30 111, nr. 58 ) heeft het kabinet de inkomensoverzichten over 2011 en 2012 openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over mogelijke financiële chantage van gemeenten

An MP asks the Minister of the Interior whether offering financial incentives for municipal mergers amounts to financial blackmail, and questions whether mergers solve municipal financial problems. The minister says he wants to encourage consolidation to at least 100,000 inhabitants, that positive financial incentives such as the Gemeentefonds allocation criteria may be used, and that he will not engage in financial blackmail.
I will not engage in financial blackmail.
Ik zal geen financiële chantage plegen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Thieme over topsalarissen op de ministeries

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about top salaries at ministries, including whether officials at the Education, Culture and Science ministry exceed the government norm, and whether a hourly rate cap for external advisers should be introduced. The minister confirmed two Wopt-reported cases, explained the WNT norm and the existing maximum hourly rate of 225 euros for external advisers, and stated no new hourly norm is planned, while agreeing that uncapped rates could fuel outsourcing.

For the ministries it has been agreed that they report annually in their departmental annual reports to the House of Representatives how often and on what grounds this maximum hourly rate has been exceeded.
Voor de ministeries is afgesproken dat zij jaarlijks in hun departementale jaarverslag aan de Tweede Kamer rapporteren hoe vaak en op grond van welke noodzaak dit maximumuurtarief is overschreden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Oosenbrug over een app die bewoners attendeert op vergunningaanvragen in hun buurt

MP Oosenbrug asked whether residents can better use their legal objection rights if they learn of permit applications in their area, and whether municipalities should be encouraged to publish these digitally and join the OmgevingsAlert app. Minister Plasterk answered that digital publication is the future and that he welcomes the app as a good development, while municipalities decide themselves whether to join.
Municipalities can themselves decide to join the initiative.
Gemeenten kunnen zelf besluiten om bij het initiatief aan te sluiten.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over het openen van een Islamitische gebedsruimte in pretpark Walibi.

Two PVV MPs asked whether Walibi amusement park would open an Islamic prayer room and whether the government would act against Islamisation. The minister replied that it is a quiet room open to all faiths, that the government does not oppose it, and that the park is a private company whose activities are not for the cabinet to comment on.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on activities that take place there, as long as they stay within the bounds of the law.
Het is niet aan het kabinet zich uit te laten over activiteiten die zich daar voltrekken, zolang deze binnen de grenzen van de wet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Raak over de financiering van Europese politieke partijen

The SP MP Van Raak asks the Interior Minister whether, despite broad Dutch parliamentary criticism, a majority of EU states could force the Commission's proposal on European political parties on the Netherlands, and whether the Luxembourg Accord and democratic safeguards should apply. The minister replies that the Netherlands cannot block the measure alone under qualified majority voting, that the cabinet will still lobby to amend the disputed parts (including a visit to Strasbourg), and that the Luxembourg Accord has lost practical value after the Lisbon Treaty.

That nevertheless leaves unaffected that the cabinet, strengthened by the broad support in the House of Representatives, will fully endeavour to amend the parts of the proposal against which the Dutch objections are directed.

Dat laat echter onverlet dat het kabinet zich, gesterkt door de brede steun in de Tweede Kamer, ten volle in zal spannen om de onderdelen van het voorstel waar de Nederlandse bezwaren zich op richten, te wijzigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Bosma over de explosieve stijging van lokale lasten

The MP Bosma asks whether the minister will limit local tax increases, especially the OZB property tax rising above 5% while house prices fall, and whether municipalities should be forced to stop spending on aid, sustainability and arts subsidies. The minister replies that the OZB macro norm (effectively 2.7% for 2013) will be checked against the uniform monitor and raised in the Bofv consultation if exceeded, but that further limits are not opportune, municipalities have autonomy over budgets, and tariff setting is their own competence.
Further limiting local levies does not seem opportune to me at this time.
Een verdere begrenzing van de lokale lasten lijkt mij op dit moment niet opportuun.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over het wetsvoorstel dat de pensioenen voor politieke ambtsdragers moderniseert

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked why the bill modernising pensions for political office holders, announced for 1 January 2013, had not yet been submitted, and when it went to the Council of State. The minister explains that adjusting the Appa pension to a flexible retirement age is complex and that the bill will be sent to Parliament around 1 March 2013.
Yes, the bill will be sent to you around 1 March 2013.
Ja, het wetsvoorstel ontvangt u omstreeks 1 maart 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Gemeente verdient aan kledinginzamelaars’

An MP asked whether municipalities profit from charity clothing-collection containers by charging fees that exceed costs and using the proceeds to balance municipal budgets. The government answered that municipalities are autonomous in organising textile collection and it lacks an overview of fees and revenues, but agreed that fees should not cover other municipal costs and will consult the VNG.
I am of the view that a municipality may charge third parties a fee that is necessary to cover the costs the municipality must incur.
Ik ben van mening dat een gemeente aan derden een vergoeding in rekening mag brengen die noodzakelijk is voor het voldoen van de kosten die de gemeente moet maken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het verstrekken van biometrische gegevens aan de Verenigde Staten

An MP asked whether US authorities could access biometric data held by Morpho in the Netherlands under the Patriot Act, and whether the agreed solution with Morpho prevents this. The minister answered that the US law remains in force and has extraterritorial reach, but that Morpho reports no data requests and the agreements are a proportionate safeguard, while refusing to guarantee that foreign authorities will never use extraterritorial powers to access personal data.
I cannot make any statements about requests from US authorities to other companies.
Over vragen van de Amerikaanse autoriteiten bij andere bedrijven kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Fokke over controle op uitgaven door gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about weak oversight of municipal spending of decentralisation grants and whether the legal obligation for local audit committees (rekenkamers) should be scrapped. The minister answered that local accountability is horizontal, that the national government can only request policy and supervisory information, and that he considers the planned abolition of the periodic evaluation premature and wants to keep an active rekenkamer, with consultation planned on dormant audit bodies.
Control over efficient and lawful spending takes place at the local level.
Controle op doelmatige en rechtmatige besteding vindt op lokaal niveau plaats.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het bericht dat de provincie Noord-Brabant een meerdaagse vergadering in het Italiaanse Parma gaat organiseren

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a multi-day Brabant provincial States meeting in Parma, Italy, is a wasteful junket, its purpose, costs and funding, and whether a Dutch venue would suffice. The Minister replied that travel decisions are a provincial matter to be accounted for in the provincial States, that costs reportedly are around 50,000 euro, and that suitable venues exist in the Netherlands.
That said, it should be noted that this is a provincial matter.
Vooropgesteld zij dat dit een provinciale aangelegenheid betreft.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het manipuleren van burgemeestersbenoemingen en het lekken van geheime stukken

An MP asked whether reconstructions of past mayoral appointments were accurate, whether ignoring selection committee recommendations was common, and how secret appointment files leaked to a journalist. The government answered that the former procedure gave the minister room for its own judgment, declined to assess the historical appointments, and said access was blocked after a misplaced disclosure affecting eight persons' files.
The restrictions on public access to the files transferred to the National Archives were imposed to respect the personal privacy of those concerned.
De beperkingen op de openbaarheid van de dossiers die zijn overgedragen aan het Nationaal Archief zijn gesteld vanwege de eerbiediging van de persoonlijke levenssfeer.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van de Amsterdamse Westermoskee

An MP from the PVV asked ministers about the Westermoskee in Amsterdam: whether construction will resume, who finances it, which organisations are involved, whether links exist to Milli Gorus, and what measures could block it. The answer states construction resumes in Q1 2013 financed by Manderen BV, that the AIVD has no information indicating threats, and that the municipality cannot stop the mosque because a permit and leasehold contract already exist.
Manderen BV holds an irrevocable building permit issued in 2007.
Manderen BV beschikt over een onherroepelijke bouwvergunning die is afgegeven in 2007.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het schrappen van de registratie van de dubbele nationaliteit voor in Nederland geborenen

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of the Interior whether removing dual-nationality registration in the GBA affects other bodies, how many people face problems with it, who would need the data for denaturalisation, and how dual nationals would be tracked. The minister answered that other bodies' use depends on their work processes and no major impact is expected, that a 2009 quickscan found around 10% of municipalities received complaints, that the IND would use its own case files for denaturalisation, and that tracking would depend on each body's procedures.
No quantitative research has been carried out into how many people experience problems with the current registration of multiple nationality.
Er is geen kwantitatief onderzoek gedaan naar hoeveel mensen problemen ondervinden met de huidige registratie van de meervoudige nationaliteit.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heijnen over het verzet van zorgbestuurders tegen maximering van hun salaris door de overheid

An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether he knows about care-sector executives' legal challenge against the government's cap on their salaries under the WNT, whether he will talk to their association, and what the legal risks and remedies are. The minister said the WNT takes effect on 1 January 2013 and the care sector falls under it, with a transitional regime, and that he will not meet the association, while agreeing to consider sector-specific differentiation later.
No. The issue is not so much the cabinet's position on top incomes, but the content of the Act on the remuneration of top officials in the public and semi-public sector (WNT).
Neen. Het gaat nu niet zo zeer om het standpunt van het kabinet ten aanzien van topinkomens, maar om de inhoud van de Wet normering bezoldiging topfunctionarissen
Antwoord vragen Van Toorenburg en Omtzigt over de tegenstrijdige berichtgeving over het schrappen van de buitenlandtak van de AIVD

MPs Van Toorenburg and Omtzigt asked the Interior Minister about conflicting reports on scrapping the AIVD's foreign intelligence branch, what the government would do to prevent its abolition, and whether the cut would be fully reversed. The minister replied that the coalition agreement footnote was read as a suggestion, the full AIVD task set was kept intact including foreign intelligence, but the budget cut still requires reprioritisation, with a concrete proposal promised in the first half of 2013.

The constituent meeting then decided, on the proposal of the Minister of the Interior, to keep the AIVD's full set of tasks, A through E, intact as the service's field of work, thus including the foreign intelligence task.

Vervolgens heeft het constituerend beraad op voorstel van de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties besloten het volledige takenpakket van de AIVD, van taken A tot en met E, intact te laten als het werkterrein van de dienst, dus inclusief de buitenlandtaak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Schouw over het niet door de Kroon vernietigen van de programmabegroting 2012 van de gemeente Haaksbergen

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether the 2012 budget of Haaksbergen municipality should be annulled by the Crown, given it may not comply with the BBV budget rules and may be unrealistic. The minister agreed the budget does not fully meet BBV requirements but deferred to the provincial supervisor (Gedeputeerde Staten of Overijssel), which judged the budget materially balanced and agreed improvement commitments for 2013, declining to intervene himself.
I see no reason to take the place of the province.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om op de stoel van de provincie te gaan zitten.

An MP asked whether it is the public broadcaster VARA's task to advertise in an advertisers' weekly to win advertising for its magazine Kassa, and whether this distorts competition. The minister replied that magazine sidelines must be market-conform and self-financing, that no public money may be involved, and declined to act himself because supervision of public broadcasters lies with the Commissariaat voor de Media.
It is not my task to supervise the activities of the public broadcaster. That task is legally assigned to the Commissariaat voor de Media.
Het is niet mijn taak toezicht uit te oefenen op de activiteiten van de publieke omroep. Die taak is wettelijk opgedragen aan het Commissariaat voor de Media.

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether he has read a newspaper column criticising the new public broadcasters PowNed and WNL, and whether he agrees with its claims about associations with 'Deutschland Erwache' and a possible charismatic leader. The minister confirms he read it, but declines to comment on the broadcasters' content, stating that the Mediawet guarantees their editorial independence and that programme autonomy belongs to the broadcasters themselves.
The government does not interfere in this. It is therefore not for the Minister of Education, Culture and Science to give his opinion on it.
De overheid bemoeit zich hier niet mee. Het is dus ook niet aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om er zijn mening over te geven.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Plas over scholen in de regio's en in Caribisch Nederland voldoende ruimte geven voor eigen invulling van het curriculum
Asks the government to ensure schools in the regions and Caribbean Netherlands keep room for regional and local content in the curriculum.
requests the government to ensure that schools in the regions and Caribbean Netherlands keep sufficient room for their own curriculum content
verzoekt de regering te borgen dat scholen in de regio's en in Caribisch Nederland voldoende ruimte houden voor eigen invulling van het curriculum
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ceder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 24 over voorhang van de algemene maatregelen van bestuur waarbij de kerndoelen worden vastgesteld
Adds a four-week waiting period before AMvB setting core objectives may be submitted after the draft is sent to both chambers, a light pre-consultation for parliament.

The proposal for a general administrative order to be established under the second paragraph is not made earlier than four weeks after the draft has been submitted to both chambers of the States General.

De voordracht voor een krachtens het tweede lid vast te stellen algemene maatregel van bestuur wordt niet eerder gedaan dan vier weken nadat het ontwerp aan beide Kamers der Staten-Generaal is overgelegd.
Motie van het lid Grinwis c.s. over fiscale knelpunten in de samenwerking tussen melkveehouders en akkerbouwers wegnemen
Motion asks the government to remove tax obstacles to cooperation between dairy and arable farmers and to inform the House before summer 2026.
requests the government to remove tax bottlenecks in cooperation between dairy farmers and arable farmers
verzoekt de regering fiscale knelpunten in de samenwerking tussen melkveehouders en akkerbouwers weg te nemen
Amendement van het lid Van der Plas over het handhaven van de nahangbepaling
Amends the bill to delete the repeal of the nahang provision, so that parliament can replace a general administrative order (AMvB) on core objectives in education with a bill.
which gives parliament the right to have a general administrative order (AMvB) with new or amended core objectives replaced by a bill to that effect
die het parlement het recht geeft om een algemene maatregel van bestuur (AMvB) met nieuwe of gewijzigde kerndoelen te doen vervangen door een daartoe strekkend wetsvoorstel
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Plas ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het handhaven van de nahangbepalingen
Keeps parliament's power to block a general administrative order (AMvB) setting core curriculum goals by turning it into a bill if a fifth of members object.
The possibility to block an AMvB with core goals is necessary
De mogelijkheid om een AMvB met kerndoelen tegen te houden is noodzakelijk
Amendement van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Van der Plas over dekking voor structureel aanvullende middelen voor de politie
Reallocates structural police funding by cutting development aid budget lines for 2026 and later years, a budget shift with no clear bearing on executive checks.
This amendment serves to cover the amendment on the Justice and Security budget
Dit amendement dient ter dekking van het amendement van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Van der Plas op de J&V-begroting
Amendement van de leden Yesilgöz-Zegerius en Van der Plas over structureel aanvullende middelen voor de politie
Increases structural police budget by 75 million euro, funded by cutting non-legally-committed reserved funds in the BHO budget.
This is covered by a cut in the policy-reserved, not legally committed funds in the BHO budget.
Dit wordt gedekt vanuit een korting van de beleidsmatig gereserveerde, niet-juridisch verplichte middelen op de BHO-begroting.
Motie van het lid Van der Plas c.s. over de stikstofruimte van beëindigingsregelingen reserveren voor het legaliseren van PAS-melders
Asks the cabinet to reserve nitrogen space from recent and future buy-out schemes primarily for legalising PAS-melders and forgoing enforcement against them, and to lock this in formally.
requests the cabinet to primarily reserve the nitrogen space of recent and future buy-out schemes for legalising
verzoekt het kabinet de stikstofruimte van recente en toekomstige beëindigingsregelingen primair te reserveren voor het legaliseren van
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over een overgangstermijn van minimaal vijf jaar en volledige compensatie voor vuurwerkondernemers
Asks the government, if the fireworks ban passes, to set a minimum five-year transition period and fully compensate fireworks businesses.
to set a minimum transition period of five years and after those five years fully compensate fireworks businesses
een minimale overgangstermijn van vijf jaar in te stellen en na deze vijf jaar vuurwerkondernemers volledig te compenseren
Motie van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over niet overgaan tot een totaalverbod op consumentenvuurwerk
Asks the government not to introduce a total ban on consumer fireworks, arguing it conflicts with the coalition agreement's no-extra-national-rules principle.
requests the government not to proceed with a total ban on lighting consumer fireworks
verzoekt de regering niet over te gaan op een totaalverbod op het afsteken van consumentenvuurwerk
Motie van de leden Eerdmans en Van der Plas over een vuurwerkverbod sowieso niet voor 2026 laten ingaan
Asks the cabinet not to let a possible fireworks ban take effect in any case before 2026, given the trade's large stock.
requests the cabinet not to let a possible fireworks ban take effect in any case before 2026
verzoekt het kabinet een mogelijk vuurwerkverbod sowieso niet voor 2026 in te laten gaan
Motie van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over uitspreken dat een totaalverbod op siervuurwerk geen oplossing biedt voor het maatschappelijke probleem van geweld tegen agenten
Declares that a total ban on ornamental fireworks is no solution for violence against police officers.
states that a total ban on ornamental fireworks offers no solution to this societal problem
spreekt uit dat een totaalverbod op siervuurwerk geen oplossing biedt voor dit maatschappelijke probleem
Motie van de leden Eerdmans en Van der Plas over met de vuurwerkbranche een raming voor schadecompensatie opstellen
Asks the cabinet to share with the Chamber, before summer, a concrete damage estimate for fireworks retailers drawn up with the industry, to compensate them if a fireworks ban is introduced.
requests the cabinet to share a concrete damage estimate with the Chamber before summer
verzoekt het kabinet nog voor de zomer een concrete schaderaming met de Kamer te delen
Motie van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over uitspreken dat een totaalverbod op siervuurwerk averechts zal werken
Declares that a total ban on ornamental fireworks would backfire by increasing cross-border purchases and crime.
states that a total ban on ornamental fireworks will backfire
spreekt uit dat een totaalverbod op siervuurwerk averechts zal werken
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over de strafvorderingsrichtlijnen voor vuurwerkdelicten ophogen
Asks the government to talk with the Public Prosecution Service about raising sentencing guidelines for firework offences.
requests the government to enter into discussion with the Public Prosecution Service to raise the prosecution guidelines
verzoekt de regering om met het Openbaar Ministerie in gesprek te gaan om de strafvorderingsrichtlijnen op te hogen
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over een onafhankelijke externe partij een compensatieregeling laten opstellen
Asks the government to have an independent external party draw up a compensation scheme for a total fireworks ban.
requests the government to have an independent external party draw up a compensation scheme for a total ban on fireworks
verzoekt de regering een onafhankelijke externe partij een compensatieregeling bij een totaalverbod op vuurwerk op te laten stellen
Motie van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over uitspreken dat het immaterieel erfgoed in Nederland beschermd en gekoesterd dient te worden
Motion declares that intangible heritage in the Netherlands should be protected and cherished, referring to the fireworks tradition and the government's refusal of a ban.
declares that intangible heritage in the Netherlands should be protected and cherished
spreekt uit dat het immaterieel erfgoed in Nederland beschermd en gekoesterd dient te worden
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over factoren en motieven voor een abortusverzoek voortaan registreren
Asks the government to have reasons and motives for abortion requests registered and published in aggregate through the IGJ annual reports.
requests the government to ensure that factors and motives for an abortion request are henceforth registered
verzoekt de regering om te bewerkstelligen dat factoren en motieven voor een abortus(verzoek) voortaan worden geregistreerd
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over extra maatregelen om onbedoelde zwangerschappen te voorkomen
Motion asking the government to examine additional measures to prevent unintended pregnancies and report on costs to the House.
asks the government to examine promptly which additional measures could be taken to prevent unintended pregnancies
verzoekt de regering om op korte termijn te bezien welke extra maatregelen genomen kunnen worden om onbedoelde zwangerschappen te voorkomen
Motie van het lid Diederik van Dijk c.s. over een onderzoek naar de afschaffing van de verplichte bedenktijd
Asks the government to study whether abolishing the mandatory abortion waiting period contributed to the rise in abortions.
requests the government to investigate whether abolishing the mandatory waiting period on 1 January 2023 contributed
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of het afschaffen van de verplichte bedenktijd per 1 januari 2023 heeft bijgedragen
Amendement van het lid Van der Plas over het verder verkorten van de bewijslasttermijn van zes naar drie maanden
Shortens from six to three months the period in which the seller bears the burden of proof for defects in animals sold by non-private sellers to consumers.
This amendment aims to reduce the reversal period of the burden of proof from the proposed six to three months.
Dit amendement strekt ertoe om de termijn van omkering van de bewijslast terug te brengen van de voorgestelde zes naar drie maanden.
Motie van de leden Kamminga en Van der Plas over met voorstellen op het gebied van handel en export komen om de regel- en verantwoordingsdruk te verminderen
Asks the government to map existing export support measures and propose ways to reduce regulatory and accountability burdens on businesses, especially SMEs.
come up with proposals to reduce the regulatory and accountability burden
met voorstellen te komen om de regel- en verantwoordingsdruk te verminderen
Motie van het lid Teunissen c.s. over de Europese Commissie en de Europese Raad laten weten dat Nederland het EU-Mercosur-verdrag niet zal ondertekenen
Asks the government to tell the European Commission and Council that the Netherlands will not sign the EU-Mercosur agreement and to work with France against its approval.
requests the government to inform the European Commission and the European Council that the Netherlands will not sign the EU-Mercosur agreement
verzoekt de regering om de Europese Commissie en de Europese Raad te laten weten dat Nederland het EU-Mercosur-verdrag niet zal ondertekenen
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over de maatregelenpakketten bij terreinbeherende organisaties combineren met en in dienst stellen van de budgetten voor agrarisch natuurbeheer
Asks the government to combine agri-environment measure packages with nature managing organisations and channel the agricultural nature management budget to farmers.
requests the government, where useful for agricultural nature management, to combine measure packages with TBOs
verzoekt de regering om daar waar het zinvol is voor het agrarisch natuurbeheer, maatregelenpakketten bij TBO's
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over zo snel mogelijk in gesprek gaan met de werknemersvakbonden over een transitieplan voor werknemers in de voedsel- en agrisector
Asks the government to quickly consult trade unions on a transition plan for workers in the food and agri sector affected by nitrogen measures.
requests the government to enter into talks as soon as possible with the trade unions to jointly develop a transition plan
verzoekt de regering om zo snel mogelijk in gesprek te gaan met de werknemersvakbonden om gezamenlijk tot een transitieplan te komen
Motie van de leden Van der Plas en Flach over afzien van generieke visserijvrije zones voor beroepsvissers en in plaats daarvan komen tot visserijvrije zones op maat
Asks the government to refrain from generic fishing-free zones for professional fishers at fish migration points and instead agree tailored zones with fishers.
requests the government to refrain from establishing generic fishing-free zones for professional fishers
verzoekt de regering af te zien van het instellen van een generieke visserijvrije zones voor beroepsvissers
Motie van het lid Van der Plas over in een onderzoek naar het onvruchtbaar maken van wolven kosten, uitvoerbaarheid, milieueffecten, gedragseffecten en de veiligheid van mensen meenemen
Asks that a government study on sterilising wolves include costs, feasibility, environmental effects, behavioural effects and public safety.
requests the government to explicitly include in the study the costs, feasibility, environmental effects of hormones entering nature, wolf population behaviour and safety of people

verzoekt de regering in het onderzoek nadrukkelijk de te vragen kosten, de uitvoerbaarheid, de milieueffecten van hormonen die terechtkomen in de natuur, het gedrag bij de populatie wolven en de veiligheid van mensen
Motie van de leden Van Campen en Van der Plas over meer differentiatie in toezichtskosten en bestuurlijke kosten bij zelfslachtende slagers en grotere slachthuizen
Asks government for a fixed NVWA contact point for small slaughterhouses and differentiated supervision fees and fines favouring self-slaughtering butchers, budget-neutral.
requests the government to differentiate more in supervision costs and administrative fines

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about shortages of qualified pyrotechnicians, long permit procedures, and the practical feasibility and legal details of the planned exemption regime for associations under the Wet veilige jaarwisseling. The State Secretary answered that professional shows are a market matter, that the exemption does not require a pyrotechnician qualification, and deferred most detailed questions (storage, requirements, registration) to a Besluit expected in early 2026.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het verdwijnen van programma’s bij de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO) en de aangekondigde bezuinigingen

MP Van der Plas asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about programme cuts at the NPO tied to planned 2027 budget reductions, questioning the framing of cuts, NPO efficiency, management layers and luxury facilities, and asks for a meeting. The minister confirms the EUR 156.7 million cut, says the public mandate can still be met, notes unavoidable programme-budget cuts and organisational savings, and says the NPO and broadcasters decide how to implement them, with the minister discussing progress with the NPO.
It is up to the NPO and the broadcasters to absorb the cuts to the state media contribution within the current legal framework.
Het is aan de NPO en de omroepen om binnen de huidige wettelijke kaders de bezuinigingen op de rijksmediabijdrage op te vangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het Commissiedebat Raad Buitenlandse Zaken Handel van 19 november

An MP asked the State Secretary for Foreign Affairs to reconsider refusing compensation for the Dutch pig sector hit by Chinese anti-dumping duties, and to list sectors where compensation was similarly withheld. The government replied that it will not compensate affected firms, cites EU trade-defence tools and WTO routes, and says it will keep raising the issue with China and the Commission.
This does not change that the cabinet will not proceed with compensatory measures for this or other sectors affected by anti-dumping or anti-subsidy duties.
Dit laat onverlet dat het kabinet niet overgaat tot compenserende maatregelen voor deze of andere sectoren die te maken krijgen met antidumping of antisubsidie heffingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Duitse politie dumpt tientallen migranten aan de Nederlandse grens

MP Van der Plas asked whether German police abandon migrants without valid papers at the Dutch border without formal handover, and whether the Minister will raise this with Germany and tighten controls. The Minister replied that 690 persons were formally transferred from Germany between December 2024 and September 2025 under bilateral agreements, that warm and cold handovers both count as formal, and that the practice was discussed with border regional authorities.
In the period from 9 December 2024 to 8 September 2025, a total of 690 foreign nationals were transferred from Germany to the Netherlands.
In de periode van 9 december 2024 tot en met 8 september 2025 zijn in totaal 690 vreemdelingen door Duitsland aan Nederland overgedragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de humanitaire situatie van de Druzen in Syrië

An MP asked the government about reported mass violence against Druze communities in Suwayda, Syria, including sieges, alleged sexual violence and possible ethnic cleansing, and asked what the Netherlands would do about international law, investigations and humanitarian aid. The minister condemned the violence, pointed to the UN Commission of Inquiry and a Syrian national commission, reported 46 aid convoys reaching Suwayda, and said the Netherlands will keep pressing for independent investigation and unhindered access.
The Netherlands continues to press for the publication of the outcomes of this investigation.
Nederland blijft aandringen op het belang van openbaarmaking van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Vermeer, Pierik, Van Zanten, Rikkers-Oosterkamp, Wijen-Nass, Oostenbrink en Joseph over optredens van de haatprediker Bob Vylan in Nederland

MPs from BBB asked whether a Bob Vylan concert in Paradiso calling for violence against Zionists and whether such performances should be allowed, and asked about criminal liability, entry bans and municipal responsibility. The minister said prosecution is for the Public Prosecution Service and courts, declined to comment on individual cases, and noted that municipal mayors decide on events and that entry refusal is possible under Schengen rules but depends on available information.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to investigate exactly what was said. The police investigation into this is still ongoing.
Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te onderzoeken wat er precies is gezegd. Het politieonderzoek hiernaar loopt nog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de terroristische brandstichting bij kippenslachterij Plukon en het openlijk dreigen met nieuwe aanslagen

An MP from BBB asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about an arson attack on the Plukon poultry slaughterhouse, the ALF's implied threat of more attacks, and whether the group should be designated terrorist, plus questions on firefighter risks, prosecution and prevention. The government condemned the violence, said police and the prosecution are investigating and it cannot anticipate outcomes, explained the NCTV's terrorism definition and that the threat picture does not currently show a demonstrable violent threat from animal rights activism, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
The police and the Public Prosecution Service (OM) are currently investigating the incident.
De politie en het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) doen op dit moment onderzoek naar het incident.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Plas over het bericht dat een oud-AIVD’er waarschuwt dat brandstichtingen door dierenextremisten “weer terug dreigen te komen”

An MP asked the Justice and Interior ministers about reports of animal-rights extremist occupations of slaughterhouses in Apeldoorn and warnings of renewed arson, asking about arrests, threat assessments, prosecution, sanctions listing, and protection of food-chain firms. The government answered that the investigation is ongoing, declined to share intelligence or assess specific groups, reported that 42 people were arrested for trespass but not detained, and promised to invite sector organisations for talks.
At this moment the police, under the authority of the Public Prosecution Service, are investigating these incidents. We cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Op dit moment doet de politie onder gezag van het OM onderzoek naar deze incidenten. Wij kunnen niet vooruitlopen op de uitkomsten hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het opiniestuk 'Er is geen verband tussen geitenboerderijen en longontstekingen bij omwonenden'

Christianne van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Health about a published opinion piece claiming no consistent link between goat farms and pneumonia in residents, and about the limited access to VGO-III study data and the number of patients included. The minister answered that the data were made available to MPs in anonymised form subject to privacy law, that the pneumonia conclusion rests on large electronic patient record studies, and that the independent Health Council will assess the full VGO-III report.
Sharing data of individual patients, however, is bound by privacy legislation, which is why the database was not simply made public.
Het delen van data van individuele patiënten is echter gebonden aan privacywetgeving en daarom is de database niet zondermeer openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de ‘ongelijke toegang tot het Europees Fonds voor Maritieme Zaken, Visserij en Aquacultuur (EMFAF) voor visserijbedrijven met een EU-Vlagregistratie’

An MP asks why fishing firms established in the Netherlands but flagged to other EU states are excluded from Dutch EMFAF fisheries subsidies, and whether the criteria can be changed. The Secretary of State answers that the Dutch programme targets Dutch-flagged vessels by design, that data on foreign-flagged vessels is not available, and declines to change the criteria or to commit to new talks beyond being open to conversation.
The choice was made that the funds are intended for fishing vessels flagged in the Netherlands and not for vessels that form part of a foreign fleet.
De keuze is daarbij gemaakt dat de middelen bestemd zijn voor vissersvaartuigen die Nederlands gevlagd zijn en niet voor vaartuigen die deel uitmaken van een buitenlandse vloot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het onderzoek 'Geen bewijs dat de Atlantische zwaardschede (Ensis leei) profiteert van de garnalenvisserij'

An MP asked the state secretary about a WUR study finding no evidence that the Atlantic jackknife clam benefits from shrimp fishing, its implications for the annulled Belgian shrimp fishing permits and the court ruling, and whether measures would be reconsidered. The state secretary acknowledged the study and court history, said the study is consistent with prior findings in the Passende Beoordeling, stated that no specific restrictive measures rest on the contested study, and committed to planning new permits for Belgian shrimpers and to sharing the report with Rijkswaterstaat.
I will bring this new report to the attention of Rijkswaterstaat (as manager of various marine Natura 2000 areas).
Ik zal dit nieuwe rapport bij Rijkswaterstaat (als beheerder van diverse mariene Natura 2000-gebieden) onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Van Campen en Van der Plas over het binnendringen van stallen

MPs Van Campen and Van der Plas asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers how a court ruling allowing a demonstration exception to unlawful entry (art. 138 Sr) affects prosecution of activists occupying livestock barns, and whether laws should change. The minister declined to comment on the ruling, said the law already covers entry without forced entry, and pointed to a WODC study due in summer 2025 that may inform possible legal changes.
I understand the discomfort the ruling will cause for some. At the same time, it is an independent judicial ruling that we must respect, and as Minister I will not comment on its substance.

Ik heb begrip voor het ongemak dat het vonnis bij sommigen zal opleveren. Tegelijkertijd is er wel sprake van een rechterlijk en onafhankelijk vonnis dat we hebben te respecteren en dat ik als Minister ook niet inhoudelijk zal becommentariëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onafhankelijkheid en transparantie van de review op het VGO-III-onderzoek

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the peer review of the VGO-III goat-farm health study was independent and transparent, and whether a new independent review will be commissioned. The minister answers that the study was peer reviewed in journals, two independent epidemiologists reviewed it in 2020, the Gezondheidsraad is advising on its evidence, and no new independent review is planned.

As indicated in the letter to Parliament accompanying the VGO-III final report, the Health Council has been asked to provide further interpretation of the evidence on health effects for residents near goat farms.

Zoals in de Kamerbrief bij het eindrapport VGO-III is aangegeven, is de Gezondheidsraad gevraagd om een nadere duiding te geven van de bewijslast met betrekking tot gezondheidseffecten voor omwonenden van geitenhouderijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de door het Ministerie van I&W uitgezette enquête over geur van veehouderijen

MP Van der Plas asked why a ministry-run survey on livestock odour uses leading questions, offers VVV vouchers as an incentive, and was distributed to residents in six municipalities, and whether it should be suspended. The State Secretary defended the survey as part of a standard participation process, said an external bureau designed it, that responses are weighted equally, and that the research will be reported in Q3 2025, but refused to suspend it.
I will therefore not suspend the survey.
Ik zal de enquête daarom niet opschorten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Diederik van Dijk, Bikker, Krul en Van der Plas over abortus vanwege geslacht

MPs from SGP, ChristenUnie, CDA and BBB asked whether sex-based abortion after prenatal sex disappointment is discriminatory, whether it conflicts with the Embryowet ban on sex selection, and whether verification or regulation of pre-technical sex-determination ultrasounds is possible. The state secretary answered that such abortions are rare and multi-motivated, that a study of reasons would be unreliable and undesirable, and that private ultrasounds fall outside state regulation and cannot be influenced by law.
I have made inquiries with the professional groups of midwives (KNOV), sonographers (BEN) and abortion doctors (NGvA) on this.
Ik heb hierop navraag gedaan bij de beroepsgroepen van verloskundigen (KNOV), echoscopisten (BEN) en abortusartsen (NGvA).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Stoffer en Van der Plas over de actualisatie van de Beleidslijn grote rivieren

Two MPs from SGP and BBB asked the ministers how the update of the Beleidslijn Grote Rivieren would affect farms in flood-overflow areas such as the Kampereilanden, including investment room, stable renewal and manure use. Minister Madlener replies that grounded agricultural firms keep development options under exceptions, that the update is not seen as a significant obstacle to Kampen, that the government will study boundaries for specific areas and that compensation is available under the Omgevingswet.
For agricultural businesses located in the former flow-carrying regime, almost nothing changes.
Voor agrarische bedrijven, die in de voormalige stroomvoerende regime liggen, verandert er nagenoeg niets.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de vrijspraak van dierenactivisten voor de stalbezetting in Boxtel

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the acquittal of animal activists for a pig-barn occupation in Boxtel, and the lack of firm sanctions, weakens protection of farmers and businesses, and whether a legal proposal treating stable occupations as trespass is needed. The minister answered that existing law (art. 138 and 461 Sr) already allows prosecution, that the OM decides on prosecution and the courts judge independently, and that no new legislation is needed; the answer also states the reply came late.
I cannot go into individual criminal cases, but in general I can say that the judge will assess each case on the basis of its specific circumstances.
Verder kan ik niet ingaan op individuele strafzaken maar kan ik in zijn algemeenheid wel zeggen dat de rechter elke zaak op basis van de specifieke omstandigheden van die zaak zal beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de slacht van 28 Konikpaarden uit het Lauwersmeer

An MP from BBB asks why 28 Konik horses moved from the Oostvaardersplassen to Lauwersmeer were sent to slaughter, how much public money the Oostvaardersplassen has cost, whether the horses count as kept animals subject to welfare and registration rules, and why they could not be placed elsewhere. The State Secretary replies that the horses could not be rehomed, defends population management and nature-area rules, states the grazers are not kept animals, and gives a detailed cost breakdown of about 15.5 million euros since 2016.
However, I aim for more accountability to be provided by all recipients of SNL subsidies, beyond merely meeting current SNL subsidy obligations.
Echter streef ik ernaar dat meer verantwoording wordt afgelegd door alle ontvangers van SNL-subsidie, dan alleen het voldoen aan huidige SNL subsidieverplichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de garnalenvisserij in de Voordelta

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asks why shrimp fishing ecological hour limits in Natura 2000 areas were exceeded, whether they can be made more flexible and compensated, and what sanctions apply. The State Secretary explains the hour caps are tied to the appropriate assessment, that current allocation is already flexible per area, that compensation does not fit the permit system, and that exceeding hours leads to closure and enforcement.
When exceeded, intervention follows and the Natura 2000 areas concerned are closed to further shrimp fishing for the rest of the year.
Bij een overschrijding wordt daarom ingegrepen en worden de betreffende Natura 2000-gebieden gesloten voor verdere garnalenvisserij voor de rest van het jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Rikkers-Oosterkamp over het bericht 'Einde van het melktappunt’

MPs Van der Plas and Rikkers-Oosterkamp (BBB) asked the state secretary for Health why raw milk must now be tested monthly for Salmonella, Campylobacter and STEC from 1 January 2025, arguing the costs threaten farm milk-tap sales. The state secretary answered that the testing protects consumer health, that costs are proportionate, that frequency can be halved after six months of compliant results, and that the measure will be evaluated after two years.

In addition, given the concerns raised by MPs Van der Plas and Rikkers (both BBB), I intend to evaluate this measure after two years, with attention also to the burden on (milk) farmers in relation to the public health interest to be protected.

Daarnaast ben ik, gezien de geuite zorgen van de leden Van der Plas en Rikkers (beiden BBB), voornemens om deze maatregel na twee jaar te evalueren waarbij ook aandacht zal zijn voor de lasten van (melk)veehouders in relatie tot het te beschermen volksgezondheidsbelang.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Pierik en Van der Plas over de handhaving op de huis- en hobbydierenlijst

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked whether the Minister is aware of a commitment made in court to suspend enforcement of the breeding ban for animals on the pet list and whether enforcement could be paused for all non-listed species until six weeks after the ruling. The Minister confirmed awareness but declined to suspend enforcement broadly, citing risk-based supervision and animal welfare, while pointing to reversible contraception and a practical solution pending the objection phase.
So I cannot commit to temporarily refraining from enforcement altogether.
Dus ik kan niet toezeggen om voorlopig helemaal af te zien van handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht Ministerie stopte acht ton subsidie in verlieslijdend festival: 'Zeer kwalijk’

An MP asked why the health ministry gave a one-off subsidy of about €597,000 to the Tong Tong Fair despite legal warnings, whether the decision was transparent, and why Indies war widows' backpay remains unresolved. The state secretary answered that the subsidy was lawful under the block exemption, that the irregularity was only in the payment schedule, that the Chamber was informed via the 2020 letter and annual report, and that backpay is a separate matter to be addressed in a written consultation.
Accepting an irregularity falls within the competence of ministers.
Het accepteren van een onrechtmatigheid behoort tot de bevoegdheid van bewindspersonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het incident waarbij een hond aangevallen is door een wolf

Two MPs from BBB asked the State Secretary for Agriculture, Fisheries, Food Security and Nature about a dog killed by a wolf in Leusden, including whether a 'problem wolf' label applies, whether interventions are possible, and how to protect people and pets. The State Secretary answered that the province of Utrecht could not yet license action against the parent pair because the individual wolf was not identified, that the Interprovincial Wolf Plan and possible changes to the wolf's protection status are being pursued, and that he will raise the issue with European counterparts.
I want to work with the provinces to create more possibilities to act more quickly against wolves showing problematic behaviour.
Ik wil me samen met provincies inzetten voor meer mogelijkheden om sneller op te treden bij wolven met problematisch gedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Artsentekort Zeeland groeit, ook huisartsenspoedpost Oostburg dicht'

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Medical Care about the closure of the Oostburg out-of-hours GP post and the neurology ward in Terneuzen due to staff shortages, including the continuity of care, the risks to patient safety and possible incentives for doctors in Zeeland. The Minister answered that a continuity plan and accessibility analysis (92% within half an hour) are in place, that acute neurology patients will be referred to Ghent or other Belgian hospitals, and that she is willing to discuss solutions with local providers and authorities.

Yes, I am willing to engage in discussion with local care providers and authorities to see how we can further support the path taken in Zeeland through the ZZC transformation plan and cooperation with the social domain.

Ja, ik ben bereid het gesprek aan te gaan met lokale zorgaanbieders en overheden om te zien hoe we de ingeslagen weg in Zeeland via het transformatieplan van de ZZC en de samenwerking met het sociale domein verder kunnen ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Vermeer over Huisarts waarschuwt voor negatieve gezondheidsgevolgen van windturbines

MPs Van der Plas and Vermeer asked the ministers about a GP's warning on health effects of wind turbines, including whether noise limits and distance norms adequately protect residents. Minister Dijkstra answered that RIVM monitors the evidence, that sleep and hinder effects are documented but other health effects lack sufficient evidence, and that new environmental rules are being prepared through a plan-MER with a decision expected after summer 2024.
As long as the process is still ongoing, I cannot anticipate the outcomes.
Zolang het traject nog loopt, kan ik niet op de uitkomsten vooruitlopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Diederik van Dijk, Krul en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minstens 172 mensen overleden door het innemen van zelfdodingspoeder middel X’

MPs from ChristenUnie, SGP, CDA and BBB asked the government how it will protect vulnerable people from suicide powder Middel X, given a study finding at least 172 deaths and 70% with a psychiatric history, and why the substance is not banned. The minister says access is limited via an industry code, that a ban is legally complicated and of limited effect, and that additional forensic powers and follow-up research are planned.
A change to the Burial and Cremation Act is currently being prepared, giving forensic physicians more powers to conduct further investigation.
Momenteel wordt gewerkt aan een wijziging van de Wet op de lijkbezorging (Wlb), waarbij de forensisch arts meer bevoegdheden krijgt om nader onderzoek te doen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het rapport “Hinweise zum Einsatz autogener BTV-3 Impfstoffe”

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture about a German expert report on autogenous BTV-3 vaccines, including whether Dutch vets may prescribe them, whether NVWA enforcement threats harm farmers, and liability for damage. The Minister confirmed conditional authorisation of three regular BTV-3 vaccines, said autogenous vaccines are restricted to specific herds and recalled by the German manufacturer for safety issues, refused liability, and declined to individually answer all questions by the deadline.
I am not going to ensure that.
Ik ga daar niet voor zorgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pierik en Van der Plas over het artikel 'Toekomst van Gorsselse melkveehouders onzeker, want in het bos staan eiken in plaats van iepen'

MPs Pierik and Van der Plas asked the minister about a Trouw article on Gorssel dairy farmers facing uncertainty because the Eester Loo forest was reclassified as beech-oak rather than elm-ash, and about the wijzigingsbesluit that added protected habitat types. The minister answered at length on the process, the reclassification, its effects on nitrogen permits, legal certainty and support measures, while stating that existing permits are not affected and that little room exists to ease the rules.
I do not see those possibilities, because the Netherlands is already sailing very close to the wind in this area.
Die mogelijkheden zie ik niet, omdat Nederland op dit vlak al scherp aan de wind zeilt.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the minister about access to the Nationale Databank Flora en Fauna (NDFF), its costs, data control, and alleged overstatement of nitrogen-sensitive habitat on the Veluwe. The minister answered that open access is being prepared but legal anchoring means full opening is delayed to 2025, while disputing the claimed mapping discrepancies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de kersenteelt

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister why a cherry-farming exemption for Exirel conditions excluding treatment after prior cyantraniliprole use leaves most orchards unable to use it, and why the minister chose a different implementation than the parliamentary motion requested. The minister answered that the conditions follow Ctgb advice, that risk-reducing measures are required, and that the NVWA advice on Tracer and Exirel for other crops is expected soon, with a decision to follow after consultation and no firm deadline promised.
In granting an exemption I rely on advice from the Netherlands Food and Consumer Product Safety Authority (NVWA) and the Ctgb.
Ik laat mij bij het verlenen van een vrijstelling adviseren door de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) en het Ctgb.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een noodkreet van het Dijklander ziekenhuis over de geplande wegwerkzaamheden bij de versterking van brug A7 ter hoogte van Purmerend

Ms Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers about the Dijklander hospital's alarm over bridge works on the A7 near Purmerend, including traffic disruption for ambulances, emergency care and births, compensation, and how the ministries coordinated. The government answered that Rijkswaterstaat manages mitigation measures, that a temporary bridge was ruled out for traffic, emissions and permit reasons, and that care providers coordinate through the regional acute care body, while committing to improve future coordination with the care sector.

For future projects, Rijkswaterstaat will, in consultation with the Ministry of VWS and together with the sector, make arrangements on how they are involved in such projects, for the accessibility of care.

Voor toekomstige projecten zal Rijkswaterstaat in afstemming met het Ministerie van VWS samen met de sector afspraken maken over wijze waarop zij betrokken worden bij dergelijke projecten, ten behoeve van de bereikbaarheid van de zorg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mestderogatie

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality to explain the EU enforcement mechanisms (infringement, interim measures, periodic penalties, CAP payment cuts, national court challenges) that would follow if the Netherlands suspended its 2022 manure derogation and reverted to the earlier rules, along with timelines and likelihoods. The Minister answered each sub-question in detail, stating that non-compliance would be evident and likely lead to rapid EU proceedings, fines and penalties, CAP reductions, and quick national court action, and that obtaining a new derogation or using proportionality arguments is not realistic.
Failure to meet the conditions of the decision may be grounds for the Commission to withdraw it.
Het niet voldoen aan de voorwaarden van de beschikking kan voor de EC een reden zijn voor intrekking ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de noodkreet van MSD-baas ’Kankerpatiënt eindeloos in wachtkamer voor nieuwe behandelingen’

An MP asks the Minister of Medical Care why Dutch cancer patients wait longer than patients in other countries for new treatments such as pembrolizumab for triple-negative breast cancer, and what will be done to shorten waits. The Minister defends the sluis (pakketbeoordeling) system on cost and effectiveness grounds, says the Zorginstituut is assessing the indication, and rejects a fixed maximum decision period while promising efficiency measures and a dashboard update.
I point to the responsibility of manufacturers to ask for socially responsible prices.
Ik wijs daarbij op de verantwoordelijkheid van fabrikanten om maatschappelijk verantwoorde prijzen te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Adrz verrast vriend en vijand met sluiting poliklinieken in Zierikzee; college stuurt brief op poten'

Van der Plas (BBB) asks the Minister for Medical Care about the Adrz hospital's decision to close outpatient clinics in Zierikzee, the lack of consultation with the municipality and residents, risks to access and care avoidance for elderly islanders, and the roles of CZ insurer and the Minister. The Minister replies that the hospital decides within legal frameworks, that regional care must be reorganised under the IZA agreements, that CZ and the NZa oversee the duty of care and no signals of breach have been received, and that the Minister sees no reason to talk to the parties personally.
It is up to the hospital board to make balanced choices with the relevant parties, ensuring the quality, accessibility and affordability of care are safeguarded.
Het is aan het ziekenhuisbestuur om met de relevante partijen afgewogen keuzes te maken waarbij de kwaliteit, toegankelijkheid en betaalbaarheid van de zorg zijn geborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over de onlangs openbaar gemaakte Woo-documenten “stikstofadvies Remkes” deel I-II-III

Two MPs from BBB asked the Minister of Nature and Nitrogen, on behalf of the Minister of Agriculture, about the released Woo documents on the Remkes nitrogen advice, covering the MOB letter, bank and supply-chain steering, buffer strips, socio-economic impact methodology, and permit revocation. The government answered that the MOB letter is public, that the Remkes report took its own line, that the Landbouwakkoord failed so the concept commitments are not binding and no instruments to secure supply-chain contributions have yet been developed, and that provinces are not obliged to use the socio-economic impact method or specific instruments.
The agreement did not come about and therefore the draft agreements are not binding.
Het akkoord is er niet gekomen 7 en daarmee zijn de conceptafspraken niet bindend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over noodkreet van gemeenten over doorontwikkeling verwijsindex februari 2024

MP Van der Plas asked whether the government will abolish the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (VIR) without a replacement, given its role in early contact between professionals, and whether youths support it. The State Secretary confirms the plan to remove the statutory basis following a motion and evaluations showing limited use, support and nationwide coverage, while pointing to other youth-care initiatives and a phased wind-down with a handbook and regional alternatives.
It is correct that I intend to implement the motion and thereby remove the legal basis for the Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (VIR) from the Youth Act.
Het klopt dat ik voornemens ben om de motie uit te voeren en zodoende de grondslag voor de Verwijsindex Risicojongeren (hierna: VIR) te schrappen uit de Jeugdwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Ingrijpend miljardenpakket voor opkoop boeren moet koude sanering veestapel voorkomen'

MPs Hermans, Wilders, Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the agriculture minister about press reports of a multi-billion buyout package to prevent a cold clearance of livestock, and whether the government would refrain from announcing buyout schemes during the formation period. The minister says a broad action plan responding to the Van Campen motion is being prepared, that a buyout scheme is only one component, that the European Commission has ruled out a new derogation, and asks the Chamber to debate the plan urgently.
This cabinet considers the situation very urgent and intends to send an action plan to the House at short notice after final decision-making.
Dit kabinet vindt de situatie zeer urgent en is voornemens om, na definitieve besluitvorming, op korte termijn een plan van aanpak aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over het bericht 'Thom kwam met z’n rolstoel wel de Domtoren op, maar station Maarssen is 'onmogelijke horde''

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked about repeated elevator and escalator failures at Maarssen station and whether ProRail and the state meet their accessibility duties. The state secretary said real-time elevator data is being rolled out gradually, that ProRail provides alternative travel advice when elevators fail, and that the Maarssen elevator was repaired on 1 March with the escalator expected back around 22 March.

Following your earlier written questions of 25 August 2023, it was stated that general information will be added to the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management website on accessibility facilities in station buildings

Naar aanleiding van uw eerdere schriftelijke vragen d.d. 25 augustus 2023 is meegedeeld dat algemene informatie zal worden toegevoegd op de website van het Ministerie van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat over toegankelijkheidsvoorzieningen in stationsgebouwen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Diederik van Dijk over patiënten die het Amsterdam UMC aansprakelijk stellen voor schade na gezichtsoperaties

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked the minister about patients holding Amsterdam UMC liable for harm after facial surgeries, including allegations of pressure, incomplete risk information and whether the IGJ should investigate. The minister answered all 13 questions in substance, saying the IGJ sees no reason to investigate, that the care is medically indicated and individually decided, and that the quality standard is being evaluated.
From my position I cannot go into individual files that are before the court.
Ik kan vanuit mijn positie niet ingaan op individuele dossiers die zich onder de rechter bevinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pierik over amfetamine in mestvergisters

MPs Van der Plas and Pierik asked the government about amphetamine found in digestate from manure digesters, the applicability of the Opiumwet and Meststoffenwet, and compensation for affected operators. The minister answered that the Opiumwet is not directly applicable given the mixed-in residues, that digestate may be traded as fertiliser only if it poses no health or environmental risk, that responsibility for waste enforcement lies with provinces and municipalities, and that she declines to offer compensation.
The Ministry of LNV was not involved in this action, but only afterwards provided a view at the request of the provinces on the interpretation of the Meststoffenwet.
Het Ministerie van LNV is in dit handelen niet betrokken, maar heeft op verzoek van de provincies pas naderhand een zienswijze verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een artikel van EenVandaag met de titel ´Waarom het eigen risico afschaffen 3,4 miljard kost, maar ook 6 miljard´

An MP asked the Minister of Health why abolishing the mandatory deductible (eigen risico) would cost about 6 billion euros rather than 3.4 billion, and how these estimates were made and whether further research was planned. The minister explained the cost as lost deductible revenue plus higher spending from reduced cost-consciousness based on a 2020 CPB model, acknowledged the model dates from 2021, declined further research for now, and listed existing cost-containment measures.
This expectation is in line with the international scientific literature.
Deze verwachting is in lijn met de internationale wetenschappelijke literatuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de mestderogatie

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Agriculture why nutrient-polluted (NV) areas were not designated by the 1 January 2024 derogation deadline, and how farmers' costs, Natura 2000 buffer zones, manure surplus reduction, feed subsidies and the 19% agricultural share in water pollution will be handled. The Minister answers that designation was published on 19 December 2023 after consultation with the Commission, that buffer zones follow the derogation decision's whole-site rule, that economic studies will follow in January 2024, and that the binding Commission conditions leave no room to deviate.
I will help farmers in the NV areas ensure water quality there is brought in order as quickly as possible.
Vanwege die ingrijpendheid zal ik de agrariërs in de NV-gebieden helpen om er zo snel mogelijk voor te zorgen dat de waterkwaliteit in deze gebieden op orde komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het besluit van de Omgevingsdiensten in Drenthe, Groningen en Friesland waarbij ruim 20 vergisters een afvoerverbod van digestaat is opgelegd.

An MP asked why the Northern environmental services required about 20 biogas plants to stop removing digestate after amphetamine was found, why it took a month to act, and whether the unaccredited test method and legal basis were sound. The State Secretary and Minister answered that the environmental services acted adequately, the method is used for sporadic analyses at an accredited lab, amphetamine has zero tolerance under the Opium Act, and no sanctions were imposed.
This question concerns the conduct of the environmental services. We do not share your view.
Deze vraag betreft het handelen van de omgevingsdiensten. Wij delen uw mening niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de verlaagde GLB-premies

An MP asked the minister whether the lower provisional CAP payment rates undermine a reliable government, whether compensation is possible, how the cuts affect incentives for sustainability and young farmers, and why the Netherlands secured less CAP funding than France. The minister acknowledged poor communication, said definitive rates will be set in spring 2024, said she is seeking ways to compensate eco-scheme participants despite no guarantees, and explained the budget allocation was set in the EU's multiannual framework.
It is crucial that farmers can rely on the government and on the CAP as an instrument to support them in the transition.
Het is cruciaal dat boeren kunnen rekenen op de overheid en op het GLB als instrument om ze te ondersteunen in de transitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het feit dat de Minister van VWS op een foto stond met een Taliban-vertegenwoordiger in Den Haag

An MP asked how a Taliban representative obtained a Dutch visa and an access pass to a WHO event hosted in The Hague, whether intelligence services should have known, and what security and follow-up steps are planned. The minister answered that the WHO wrongly invited the representative, the visa was assessed under EU rules without a sanctions listing, and the government will review invitation and visa procedures, while the investigation into how the invitation occurred is still ongoing.
Furthermore, this case gives the Ministry of Foreign Affairs reason to examine where the visa process can be tightened so that such visa applications always undergo an additional assessment.
