Voorts is deze casus voor het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken aanleiding te bezien waar het visumproces kan worden aangescherpt zodat dergelijke visumaanvragen altijd een extra afweging ondergaan
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een vullingstoets

An MP asks the nature minister why a additionality check at filling of the nitrogen register (SSRS) is planned, given that law and case law do not require it, and how this affects PAS-reporters seeking legalisation. The minister answers that it is a policy choice to give users more certainty about usable nitrogen deposition space, that PAS-reporters will be served after pre-reservation for housing, and that the exact design is still under discussion with national partners and provinces.
At the same time, I am still in discussion with national partners and provinces about what exactly this filling test will look like in substance.
Tegelijk ben ik nog met rijkspartners en provincies in gesprek over hoe deze vullingstoets er inhoudelijk precies uit komt te zien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Vedder en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwacht megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs Inge van Dijk, Vedder and Van der Plas asked whether farmers who joined the set-aside scheme and planted fast-growing forest were wrongly denied the agricultural exemption and faced tax assessments after decades. The State Secretary of Finance answers that the Tax Authority's position is consistent, that no assurances were given about the agricultural exemption, and that the pending Supreme Court ruling will be awaited.
As with our answers of 5 September 2023 to the previous questions from your House on this subject, we note at the outset that the case is still before the courts.
Net als bij onze antwoorden van 5 september 2023 op de vorige vragen van uw Kamer over dit onderwerp stellen wij voorop dat de zaak nog onder de rechter is
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Koerhuis, Van der Plas enWesterveld over dreigende huisuitzettingen van weeskinderen

Four MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether she knew of threatened evictions of at least five orphaned young adults from social rental homes before the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act takes effect, and how to prevent them and hold housing corporations to the law's spirit. The minister agreed such evictions must be prevented, said corporations should already act in the spirit of the law and that she is in close contact with Aedes to find solutions, and targets entry into force on 1 January 2024.
I am in close contact with Aedes to ensure a suitable solution in the spirit of the Orphans' Tenancy Protection Act in the situations mentioned.
Ik heb nauw contact met Aedes om in de genoemde situaties te zorgen voor een passende oplossing in de geest van de Wet huurbescherming weeskinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de koeiensterfte aan de dijk van het Reevediep

An MP asked about cattle deaths on a farm beside the Reevediep dike and about the investigation into soil used in the dike, including contact with the water board and the farmer's cooperation. The state secretary answered that the province of Gelderland has commissioned soil research, that the dike was built under the soil quality rules with 98.7% of the soil in the cleanest class, that the farmer has withdrawn cooperation, and that results are expected in November 2023 with the parliament to be informed.
Once the final results of the research are known and any follow-up steps, I will inform your House about this.
Zodra de definitieve resultaten van het onderzoek bekend zijn en eventuele vervolgstappen zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘De woest onaantrekkelijke opkoopregeling piekbelasters’

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen why only about 644 farmers signed up for the buyout scheme for peak nitrogen emitters, whether the policy should be paused, and about the expected uptake and voluntariness of the scheme. The minister defended the voluntary approach, said interest is substantial and expected to grow before the application windows close, and refused to pause the policy.
No. The approach targets 3,000 companies that together have the largest burden on overloaded Natura 2000 areas.
Nee. De aanpak richt zich op 3.000 bedrijven die in totaal de grootste belasting hebben op overbelaste de Natura 2000-gebieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Hoop en Van der Plas over het bericht 'Limburg trekt de beurs voor Maaslijn, maar risico’s blijven in hoofdpijndossier'

MPs De Hoop and Van der Plas asked why Limburg must provide extra funding for the Maaslijn rail upgrade, given that the national government should cover remaining shortfalls, and asked about the tender results and financial consequences. The State Secretary answered that cost increases require both co-principals (Limburg and the national government) to cover the gap under the 'samen uit, samen thuis' agreement, that ProRail definitively awarded the contract within the guaranteed amount, and that the government is willing to explore whether project organisation and management can be redesigned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het schrijnende bericht van een jeugdzorginstelling

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Health about a confidential report exposing serious abuses at youth institution Woodbrookers, including pain stimuli, safety, and unreported incidents. The State Secretary answered that the report was commissioned by the IGJ, was published only in anonymised form after a court ruling, led to an improvement plan and the institution's decision to end closed youth care by July 2024, and that pain stimuli are not permitted.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hagen, Peters, Kwint, Beertema, Westerveld en Van der Plas over carnaval en de afname van de doorstroomtoets

Six MPs asked the minister why the doorstroomtoets (transition test) was not moved around the carnival period and whether an extra week could be granted to carnival regions. The minister answered that after a stakeholder meeting the test window was extended from two to three weeks, with the extension for 2024 applied to the digital test and to be codified in law after that, while the test timing will be evaluated later.
Based on that conversation, I have decided to extend the period in which schools can administer a transition test from two to three weeks.
Op grond van dat gesprek heb ik besloten de periode waarin scholen een doorstroomtoets kunnen afnemen van twee naar drie weken te verlengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Inge van Dijk, Temmink, Van der Plas en Dekker-Abdulaziz over de RAM database bij de Belastingdienst

Five MPs asked the government about the RAM database at the Belastingdienst, including whether privacy impact assessments were done, whether parliament was misinformed, and why an external investigation is needed. The State Secretary answered that an external investigation and an investigation by the Dutch Data Protection Authority are pending, so definitive answers and the legality question cannot yet be given, and that memos and documents will be sent later.
I wish to emphasise that definitive answers can only be given after the external investigation and the investigation by the AP.
Ik wil daarbij benadrukken dat pas na het externe onderzoek en het onderzoek door de AP definitieve antwoorden gegeven kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over het vaccin voor blauwtong

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister about the bluetongue vaccine timeline, the South African Blu-Vax vaccine, possible links to water management, farmers' financial risk, producers, wildlife and reporting of cases. The minister said no suitable vaccine is yet available, declined to grant an exemption for Blu-Vax on safety and efficacy grounds, and said farmers bear the financial risk while the government engages with producers and neighbouring countries.
I decide not to grant an exemption at this time to allow this vaccine to be used in the Netherlands.
besluit ik om op dit moment geen vrijstelling te verlenen dit vaccin in Nederland toe te staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over Het Universiteit van Amsterdam (UvA)-rapport inzake stikstofdepositie

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister about a UvA study on nitrogen deposition near dairy farms, including the piekbelasters policy, dry deposition measurement, ammonia from fertilised grassland and combustion, and ammonia emission factors for cattle barns. The minister answered that the study largely confirms existing knowledge, so no policy change is needed, and that research and monitoring expansions are underway (e.g. ten dry-deposition measurement points by mid-2024).
As indicated in the aforementioned letter, the study is primarily a confirmation of existing knowledge.
Zoals aangegeven in de genoemde brief is het onderzoek vooral een bevestiging van bestaande kennis.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van der Plas over impregneermiddelen die gebruikt worden in moestuinbakken en plantenbakken

An MP asked whether treated wood in vegetable and plant boxes poses risks to food crops, health and consumers, and whether the government will investigate and ban such products. The government explained the EU biocide approval system, said it knew of no studies on uptake into crops or health effects, and agreed to ask RIVM for an exploratory review of the literature, with bans to follow only if unacceptable risks are found.

Yes, I am willing to ask RIVM to carry out an exploratory study of what is known in the international literature about the transfer of substances from treated vegetable boxes via the soil to plants and about the risk of health effects.

Ja, ik ben bereid om het RIVM te vragen een verkennend onderzoek uit te voeren naar wat er in de internationale literatuur bekend is over de overdracht van stoffen uit geïmpregneerde moestuinbakken via de grond naar planten en naar (het risico op) gezondheidseffecten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het schrijnende bericht van een rolstoelgebruiker, zoals beschreven in het artikel ‘Rolstoelgebruiker Annemarie in de kou laten staan door NS: ‘Dit mag niet gebeuren’

An MP asked ministers about a wheelchair user left stranded in the cold by NS after a station lift failed, and whether rules and oversight protect such travellers. The state secretary acknowledged the incident, pointed to existing concession and Bestuursakkoord obligations, and said NS will reflect internally, while maintaining that the existing enforcement tools are sufficient and no new rules are proposed.
I have various steering instruments at my disposal.
Ik heb hiervoor diverse sturingsinstrumenten tot mijn beschikking.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Van der Lee, Jasper van Dijk, Boswijk, Ceder, Belhaj, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Sylvana Simons, Dassen en Christine Teunissen over de evacuatie van lokale oud-medewerkers van de Nederlands

MPs from many parties asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers about the evacuation and resettlement of local former Afghan Security Guards and other local staff, including whether guards were excluded and why EUPOL staff were refused. The government answered that individual requests are assessed under the 2014 interpreter arrangement and special scheme, that criteria were not tightened, and that the resettlement project was folded into the ministries' standing organisations while the remaining group of about 100 people is still being pursued.
Defence aims to take current insights into account in implementing policy and will therefore examine these signals further.
Defensie streeft ernaar actuele inzichten te betrekken bij de uitvoering van beleid en zal deze signalen derhalve nader onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Inge van Dijk, Boswijk en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Ruim 200 boeren met bos krijgen onverwachts megaclaims van fiscus’

MPs from CDA and BBB asked whether the Ministry of Agriculture gave farmers who converted land to fast-growing forest under the set-aside scheme a promise that the land would remain agricultural, and why the Tax Authority now taxes capital gains on that land. The minister answers that the ministry only commented on the planning designation, which stayed agricultural, while the tax authority applies the agricultural exemption only to periods when land was used within a farm business, so the case is pending before the Supreme Court and no concrete remedy is offered.
Because the case is still before the courts, we follow the line of recent court rulings in this answer and await the Supreme Court's judgment.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter is volgen we de lijn van de recente rechterlijke uitspraken in deze beantwoording en wachten we het oordeel van de Hoge Raad af.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van der Plas en Vedder over de wolvenaanval op een hobbyboer in Wapse

MPs Van der Plas and Vedder asked the minister about a wolf attack on a hobby farmer in Wapse, the adequacy of information sharing with provinces, and whether the protected status of the wolf should be revised at EU level. The minister expressed regret, said the government would wait for the RDA advice and the EU analysis before taking a position, and noted that the attack is under criminal investigation.
It is not for me to judge while the investigation is ongoing.
Het is niet aan mij om erover te oordelen zolang het onderzoek loopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Omtzigt over over tenminste 259 PAS melders die niet worden gelegaliseerd

MPs Van der Plas and Omtzigt asked why at least 259 PAS-notifying farms are not being legalised and receive no state help, and questioned the government's handling and information provision. The minister answers that these 259 failed verification under the legalisation criteria, that not all have a problem since some may hold other permits, and that provinces will send rejection letters and look for solutions, while asserting the Kamer was fully informed.
I will ask the province to provide that clarity urgently, so that the PAS notifiers know where they stand.
Ik zal de provincie verzoeken die duidelijkheid met spoed te geven, zodat de PAS-melders weten waar ze aan toe zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Zeven boeren op Schiermonnikoog hebben een deel van hun koeien weggedaan, en lopen zo op de troepen vooruit’

An MP asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen about the Schiermonnikoog cattle reduction, noting that ammonia concentrations rose despite a roughly 40 percent cut in dairy cows, and questioned the value of the spending and the nitrogen modelling. The minister answered that weather and distant sources explain the lack of measured reduction, that the methodology is sound, and saw no reason to revise nitrogen policy.
There is no reason to doubt that methodology.
Er is geen reden om aan die methodiek te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de Engbertsdijksvenen

An MP from BBB asked the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen 17 questions about a clay depot built by Staatsbosbeheer in the Engbertsdijksvenen Natura 2000 area, including its location in a nitrogen-overloaded bog, permits, possible contamination, and effects on flora and fauna. The minister answered that permits were issued by the municipality, that natural restoration works are exempt from permit requirements, and that an independent investigation has been commissioned with follow-up agreements planned to prevent similar situations.

I raised this with Staatsbosbeheer, and Staatsbosbeheer, in consultation with the province of Overijssel, decided to carry out in-depth research into the situation of the clay depot in the Engbertsdijksvenen.

Dit heb ik bij Staatsbosbeheer aangekaart en Staatsbosbeheer heeft, in overleg met provincie Overijssel, besloten diepgaand onderzoek te gaan doen naar de ontstane situatie van het leemdepot in de Engbertsdijksvenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Plas, Eppink en Bisschop over de stikstofuitstoot van Schiphol

Four MPs asked the environment and nitrogen minister why Schiphol is absent from the RIVM list of large nitrogen emitters and whether aviation emissions escape the Aerius model, and asked about the status of Schiphol's permit applications and the promised disclosure of nitrogen space purchases. The minister replied that Schiphol falls outside the industry and energy sectors covered by the report, that aviation emissions are calibrated into RIVM's national deposition figures, that the requested purchase data will be included in an ongoing evaluation, and that the Schiphol nature permit decision is still pending.
Following commitments made to Mr Omtzigt and Mr Boswijk, I have requested part of the information on an accelerated basis.
Naar aanleiding van toezeggingen aan de heer Omtzigt 13 en de heer Boswijk 14 heb ik een deel van de informatie versneld uitgevraagd.

Antwoord op vragen gesteld door de leden Omtzigt, Piri, Boswijk, Sjoerdsma, Van der Staaij, Christine Teunissen, Jasper van Dijk, Eppink, Van der Lee, Ephraim, Van Haga, Baudet, Ceder, Dassen, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Simons

MPs asked the government whether it recognises the expert opinion of Luis Moreno Ocampo that the Lachin blockade amounts to ongoing genocide against Armenians in Nagorno-Karabakh, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to prevent genocide and enforce the ICJ interim measures. The minister answers that the Netherlands is very concerned, follows the situation via EUMA and other sources, describes its duty to prevent genocide as an obligation of conduct, and states that the EU and the Netherlands continue to call on Azerbaijan to comply with the ICJ order.
The Netherlands and the EU will continue to call on Azerbaijan to do so.
Nederland en de EU blijven Azerbeidzjan hiertoe oproepen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Van der Plas over het aanpakken van piramidespellen voor jongeren

MPs Van der Lee and Van der Plas asked the government about IM Academy, a pyramid-style scheme targeting young people, including whether it should be banned and whether regulators should investigate. The Minister of Finance replied that the company is not yet proven to have breached Dutch law, that enforcement is for the competent regulators (ACM, AFM), and that no investigations can be announced.
At this moment I see no reason to conduct further research.
Op dit moment zie ik geen aanleiding om nader onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Twee interessante subsidies voor duurzame goederenvervoer'

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister about a provincial Gelderland subsidy for sustainable freight transport using biofuels and whether a national subsidy for biofuels in trucking is appropriate. The minister answered that the government supports provincial efforts, outlines existing instruments such as the HVE system and ETS2, and explains that the truck toll reinvestment programme 2026-2030 excludes biofuel subsidies in favour of zero-emission technology.
Everything provinces do to support that task the cabinet fully endorses.
Alles wat provincies doen om die opgave te ondersteunen onderschrijft het kabinet van harte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het gasveld Middelie

An MP asked the State Secretary about public support for, seismic risks of, and justification for continuing gas extraction at Middelie until 2035, including the Groningen enquiry's conclusions and the Beemster World Heritage status. The State Secretary answered that objections are being reviewed, that advisory bodies see only a small earthquake risk, that no intensification is planned without new permits, and that a site visit will precede a final decision.
I only grant permission to continue existing gas extraction if this can be done safely.
Ik geef alleen toestemming voor het voortzetten van de bestaande winning van gas als dit veilig kan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de ontslagen bij VDL Nedcar en het mogelijk aanwenden van verschillende Europese defensiefondsen

MP Van der Plas asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about mass layoffs at VDL Nedcar and whether EU defence funds (EDIRPA, ASAP) could help, including jobs and redeploying staff at Defence. The state secretary answered that EDIRPA and ASAP offer little direct benefit to VDL Nedcar, that the government is supporting the company's search for new clients, and that Defence is willing to hire some laid-off technical staff.
Too much openness could harm both commercial confidentiality and the process.
Teveel openheid kan zowel de bedrijfsvertrouwelijkheid als het proces schaden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de antwoorden van 14 februari 2023 op de op 10 november 2022 ingezonden vragen over het verzoek in de commissie-Regeling van Werkzaamheden van de procedurevergadering van

An MP asks the minister why production volumes of the tilapia subsidy project were not tracked, why a second inspection and clawback were not carried out, and why the EU correction and the stopped eel-farmers' complaints were not pursued. The minister answers by referring to the final report, stating the volume target was not met but reporting was not a subsidy requirement, and that the subsidy rules were applied lawfully as confirmed by courts.
It was not a requirement of the FIOV subsidy that it had to be reported how many tonnes of tilapia were farmed.
Het was geen eis van de FIOV (Financieringsinstrument voor de oriëntatie voor de Visserij)-subsidie dat er gerapporteerd moest worden hoeveel ton tilapia is gekweekt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Koerhuis, Van den Hil, Van der Plas en Stoffer over het bericht dat Meander opvanglocaties voor schipperskinderen sluit in Maasbracht, Nieuwegein, Lemmer en Terneuzen

MPs asked whether the government will prevent the closure of four boarding houses for bargee children run by Stichting Meander and whether the economic claim right on the buildings blocks relocation. The State Secretary answered that closures are a business decision for the boarding houses, that talks are ongoing and the KPMG study will be shared before summer, and that Meander is not blocked from moving to smaller locations.
The Ministry of VWS is currently in talks with the Meander bargee boarding house, so we cannot agree with the term 'stuck in the Ministry of Health's procedures'.

Het Ministerie van VWS is momenteel in gesprek met schippersinternaat Meander, dus in de term «vastlopen in de procedures van het Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport » kunnen wij ons niet vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het criminele karakter van het asielzoekerscentrum in Gilze en het onder druk zetten van burgers die hier verslag van doen op sociale media

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a separate housing unit for troublesome asylum seekers at the Gilze reception centre, stolen property not being recovered, police pressure on residents who posted about it online, and staff safety. The State Secretary confirmed the unit houses 20 people, said police cannot search rooms without grounds under the Code of Criminal Procedure, rejected changing the law, and said cooperation between partners is being strengthened.
Everyone may tell their story in the Netherlands, including on social media.
Iedereen mag zijn verhaal doen in Nederland, ook op sociale media.
Antwoord op vragen die de leden Nijboer en Van der Plas over de schadeafhandeling van het beleggingsproduct Sprintplan door Aegon

Two MPs asked the Finance Minister whether victims of Aegon's Sprintplan product are still uncompensated, whether settlement is too slow, and what compensation and timelines are appropriate. The minister answered that Aegon has paid out the 2021 settlement to those who accepted it, that one individual court case remains, and that a review of compensation procedures is underway, while declining to set a timeframe for Aegon and stressing the separation of civil and supervisory domains.
I expect Aegon to also act constructively towards consumers who did not accept the settlement proposal.
Ik verwacht van Aegon dat zij zich ook constructief opstelt ten opzichte van consumenten die het schikkingsvoorstel niet hebben geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over de toenemende kritiek op de Dutch Approach in de transgenderzorg voor minderjarigen

Two MPs asked the health minister about growing criticism of the Dutch Approach to gender care for minors, citing Swedish and English reviews, and asked for an independent systematic review, a revision of the quality standard, and information on detransition and causes of rising demand. The minister replied that the standard is being evaluated by the medical specialists' knowledge institute, that the Zorginstituut is not the body to conduct an independent review, that the IGJ has no signals of unsafe care, and that two studies (SiRM and Radboud UMC) will be sent to the House shortly.
It is up to professional parties to jointly give content, through professional standards and guidelines, to the question of what good care is
Het is aan veldpartijen om gezamenlijk, middels professionele standaarden en richtlijnen, invulling te geven aan de vraag wat goede zorg is

Antwoord op vragenvan de leden Sjoerdsma, Jasper van Dijk, Piri, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, Ephraim, Gündoğan, Van der Lee, Sylvana Simons, Eppink, Ceder, Van der Plas, Teunissen, Kuzu, Omtzigt, Van der Staaij, Den Haan,

MPs from across the parliament asked why Jan Zwartendijk, who saved thousands of Jews in WWII, was reprimanded and why he should not receive the highest honour posthumously, and whether a memorial and rule changes are possible. The minister apologised for any reprimand, agreed to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on a posthumous Erepenning in gold, made a one-time exception to the 1951 policy, and said a memorial at the Foreign Ministry is being prepared.
I am therefore wholeheartedly willing to ask the Chapter for Civil Orders for advice on whether Mr Zwartendijk can be posthumously nominated for the Erepenning for Humanitarian Aid, in gold.

Ik ben dan ook van harte bereid om het Kapittel voor de Civiele Orden om advies te vragen of de heer Zwartendijk postuum kan worden voorgedragen voor de Erepenning voor Menslievend Hulpbetoon, in goud.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over asielopvang in Zwaagdijk West

An MP asks whether a provincial plan to build temporary housing for refugee status holders in Zwaagdijk-West, against the municipality's wishes, risks a repeat of the Tubbergen conflict and how the provincial decision and public participation are handled. The minister answers that the province is only conducting a feasibility study, that the municipality is primarily responsible, that a participation process will follow if the project is feasible, and that he sees no reason yet to discuss it with the provincial executive.
Should it turn out that the project is not feasible, the provincial executive does not consider a participation process necessary either.
Mocht blijken dat het project niet haalbaar is, dan acht het provinciale bestuur een participatietraject ook niet nodig.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Peters, Drost, Bisschop, Pouw-Verweij, Beertema en Van der Plas over de antwoorden op vragen van de leden De Hoop, Kwint en Westerveld over het feit dat veel reformatorische scholen nog al

Five MPs asked the minister about a school identity statement that was misquoted in earlier answers as rejecting homosexuality. The minister confirmed the statement does not address sexual orientation, apologised, rectified the record, and said a broader review of the motions on identity statements will be reported to parliament later this year.

In the wording of the parliamentary questions and in the answers to them, a link was unintentionally made between a passage from the Gomarus College identity document and views on marriage and sexual orientation.

In de vraagstelling van de Kamervragen en de beantwoording van de Kamervragen is onbedoeld de link gelegd tussen een passage uit het identiteitsdocument van het Gomarus College en opvattingen over het huwelijk en seksuele oriëntatie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Marijnissen Grinwis, Palland, Kathmann, Teunissen, Pouw-Verweij, Stoffer, Van der Plas, Van Haga en Den Haan over duizenden gezinnen die al jarenlang leven van een inkomen onder h

MPs asked the government how couples on social assistance and single-earner households with disability benefits can end up with less net income plus allowances than a benefit couple, and what will be done after a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling. The minister answered in detail, acknowledging the undesirable outcome and roughly 10,000 affected households, but offered no finished fix, only options under study and no compensation decision yet.
We want to do everything we can to find a solution to this.
We willen er alles aan doen om hier een oplossing voor te vinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de staatsrechtelijke opstelling kabinet nieuwe wetgeving

MP Van der Plas asked whether the cabinet was blocking the IMVO initiative bill and whether ministers would implement a law passed by parliament, and questioned the constitutional relationship. The ministers deny refusing the bill, say talks with initiators are ongoing, confirm they will implement any law adopted by both chambers after royal assent, and promise to inform parliament of the outcome.
These exploratory talks are still ongoing. We undertake to inform your House of the final outcome of these talks.
Deze verkennende gesprekken lopen nog. Wij zeggen toe uw Kamer op de hoogte te brengen van de einduitkomst van deze gesprekken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Brekelmans, Agnes Mulder, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Staaij, Ceder, Piri, Van der Lee, Koekkoek, Teunissen, Eppink en Van der Plas over de uitspraak van het Internationaal

MPs asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands will ensure Azerbaijan complies with the ICJ provisional measures order to reopen the Lachin corridor, and whether it has raised this with Azerbaijan. The minister answers that the Netherlands has repeatedly urged Azerbaijan to comply through bilateral talks, the ambassador, and EU and multilateral channels, but gives no new concrete commitment beyond continued advocacy.
Following this ruling, the Netherlands called on the Azerbaijani authorities to comply with the ruling.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van deze uitspraak de Azerbeidzjaanse autoriteiten opgeroepen om de uitspraak na te leven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van den Berg, Agema, Kuiken, Westerveld, Koekkoek, Stoffer, Azarkan, Gündoğan, Den Haan, Pouw-Verweij, Hijink, Van Esch en Van der Plas over longcovid onderzoek

MPs from many parties asked the health minister about the future of Long COVID research, the 2022 motion calling for more structural biomedical research, earlier incorrect answers on biomedical studies, the funding available and its duration, and whether structural money will be provided. The minister answered that about 14 million euro is currently spent on around twenty studies, thirteen with a biomedical component, that a knowledge agenda is being commissioned from ZonMw, and that extra multi-year funding and an expertise centre are being considered, to be decided in May.
In addition, I intend to make extra budget available for multi-year research and an expertise centre for post-COVID.
Daarnaast ben ik voornemens om extra budget beschikbaar te maken voor meerjarig onderzoek en een expertisecentrum post-COVID.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Eppink, Van der Staaij, Van der Plas en Agnes Mulder over de ontmoeting tussen de minister-president en de Azerbeidzjaanse president Aliyev

MPs asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister about the January 2023 meeting with Azerbaijani President Aliyev in Davos, including gas deliveries, the Lachin corridor blockade, ECHR rulings and Armenian prisoners. The government answered that the meeting raised Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation and the Lachin blockade, that it did not address the ECHR interim measures or Armenian prisoners, and that it did not condemn Azerbaijan's occupation of Armenian territory, while promising continued calls for compliance.
During the conversation, the Prime Minister conveyed the Dutch concerns about the humanitarian situation in Nagorno-Karabakh resulting from the de facto blockade of the Lachin corridor.
Tijdens het gesprek heeft de Minister-President de Nederlandse zorgen over de humanitaire situatie in Nagorno-Karabach als gevolg van de de facto blokkade van de Laçın-corridor overgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over varend ontgassen

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the Netherlands has no national ban on venting toxic vapours from cargo while Belgium and Germany do, and how the government is handling the problem with shippers, shippers' clients and enforcement. The minister replies that no national ban exists in Germany or Belgium as described, that a national ban is legally blocked by the Rhine Navigation Act and the CDNI treaty, that a phased international ban is expected in 2024, and that talks with cargo owners and enforcement cooperation are ongoing.
The ministry takes the position that a national ban would conflict with the object and purpose of the treaty and is therefore not possible.
Het ministerie hanteert het uitgangspunt dat een nationaal verbod in strijd is met het doel en voorwerp van het verdrag en daarom niet mogelijk is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het verzoek in de commissie-Regeling van Werkzaamheden van de procedurevergadering van de commissie LNV van 19 oktober 2022 waarbij een verzoek tot een onafhankelijk onder

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of LNV about the tilapia/meerval subsidy project in the Peel, including its outcomes, EU correction, rebranding as Claresse, a promotion subsidy, harm to existing catfish farmers and a request for an independent investigation. The minister answered that the project was lawful, courts found no causal link, no new independent investigation or compensation will be provided, and that some documents were already released under freedom of information rules.
Based on the proceedings and rulings so far, I see no reason to initiate a new investigation into this case.
Op basis van de gelopen procedures en uitspraken, zie ik geen aanleiding om een nieuw onderzoek naar deze casus in te stellen.
Antwoord op op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Garnalenvloot moet binnen 9 maanden aan stikstofnorm voldoen, 'te snel'’

MP Van der Plas asks why shrimp trawlers must meet a nitrogen standard within nine months, questioning whether they are existing use, the fleet's share of emissions, the fairness versus container ships, and feasibility. The minister replies that shrimp fishing is not treated as existing use, that the fleet's share cannot be given exactly, that the nine-month period is realistic, and that a catalyst is a voluntary option with a fallback permit.
No exact figure can be given for the contribution of the entire shrimp fleet.
Er kan geen exact getal worden gegeven voor de bijdrage van de gehele garnalenvloot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over ‘Report – Meeting with NL ministers Van der Wal, De Jonge, Harbers en Jetten’

An MP from BBB asks why the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen met EU Commissioner officials with other ministers about ADC-procedure options for housing and energy projects, and why nature restoration, livestock reduction and agriculture were absent, and questions the Commissioner's views. The Minister answers that the meeting focused only on ADC-procedure permitting for regional housing and energy projects, that absent ministers do not affect cabinet unity, that the Commissioner did not question Dutch models, and that the policy remains under review, but gives limited concrete commitments.
I mistakenly named a minister who did not take part in the meeting.
Per abuis heb ik inderdaad een bewindspersoon genoemd die niet deelnam aan de vergadering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Landbouw ook aan de lat voor nitraat uit de stad'

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether groundwater monitoring points outside agricultural areas are counted in the Nitrates Directive assessment reported to the EU, and how many there are. The minister answered that these points are excluded from the Dutch agricultural assessment but included in the dataset sent to the EU, and that they do not add to exceedances.

No, this is not correct. The results for measuring points in other types of areas (nature and other) are not included in the Dutch assessment of groundwater quality in the agriculture category reported to the EU.

Nee, dit klopt niet. De resultaten voor de meetpunten in andere typen gebieden (natuur en overig) worden niet meegewogen in de Nederlandse beoordeling van de grondwaterkwaliteit in de categorie landbouw die naar de EU gerapporteerd wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint, Alkaya en Van der Plas over het bericht dat sluiting dreigt voor groen vmbo in Noord-Brabant wegens nieuwe aanbesteding van het openbaar vervoer

Three MPs asked whether the threatened closure of a green vocational school in Andel, linked to a provincial public transport tender cutting pupil buses, is acceptable, and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that the closure threat is premature, that the province guarantees accessibility in its draft programme of requirements, and that it is for decentralised authorities to decide, so the government declines to intervene.
Since both municipalities and the province have their own democratically elected checks, the government exercises restraint here.
Aangezien zowel gemeenten als de provincie hun eigen democratisch verkozen controles hebben past de regering hier terughoudendheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het opstarten van een mediation traject met het COA, rijk en gemeente Westerwolde

An MP asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security about a council motion in Westerwolde calling for mediation with the COA, the national government and the municipality, and about the COA's alleged failure to honour agreed reception capacity limits at Ter Apel. The State Secretary acknowledged the motion, admitted the 2,000-person cap was not always respected due to pressure on the asylum chain, supported mediation as the preferred route, and said the Ombudsman had been asked to take a role.
The aim of a mediation process is precisely to (re)build trust between the parties on a voluntary basis.
Het streven van een mediation traject is immers gericht op het (her)opbouwen van vertrouwen tussen de partijen op vrijwillige basis.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikker, Pouw-Verweij, Van der Staaij, Bevers, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Hijink en Kuik over het bericht ‘Openbaar Ministerie wil tien mensen vervolgen voor verstrekking 'Middel X'

MPs from several parties asked the Justice and Health ministers about prosecutions over the supply of suicide-enabling substance 'Middel X' linked to the Coöperatie Laatste Wil, and about prevention, victim research, and whether the criminal law or chemical sales rules should be tightened. The government said ten people are being considered for prosecution, that voluntary industry measures remain in place with no new substances found, that regulation by law is complex and of limited effect, and that research on victims and support for bereaved families is underway, while declining to comment on the ongoing criminal case or the adequacy of current law.
As long as the criminal case is ongoing, it is also not appropriate for me to give a judgement on the current legal framework.
Zolang de strafzaak loopt past het mij evenmin om een oordeel te geven over het huidige wettelijke kader.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Teunissen, Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over het plan van de Europese Commissie om het Mercosur-verdrag geïmplementeerd te krijgen door nationale parlementen te omzeilen

MPs Teunissen, Van der Plas and Jasper van Dijk asked whether the Commission is splitting the EU-Mercosur agreement to avoid national parliamentary ratification and what the government will do about it. The minister replied that talks with Mercosur continue without new developments, that the form of any agreement is not yet decided, and that national democratic procedures will apply once a proposal reaches the Council.

As the cabinet has repeatedly indicated, it will only take a position on the agreement with the Mercosur countries once the Commission has submitted the necessary decision-making documents to the Council.

Zoals herhaaldelijk door het kabinet aangegeven zal het kabinet pas een standpunt innemen over het akkoord met de Mercosur-landen wanneer de Commissie de benodigde documenten voor besluitvorming aan de Raad heeft aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Tweede pony in korte tijd aangevallen in Wittelte'

An MP asked the minister about wolf-attack reporting, BIJ12 procedures for rejecting reports without on-site inspection, the lack of objection rights, contra-expertise, compensation conditions and environmental assessment for fencing. The minister answered that BIJ12 publishes reports, that objection rights may be explored with the provinces, and that compensation and monitoring are provincial responsibilities.
The member Van der Plas rightly points to this gap, and I agree that it would be good if damage reporters could take action against a decision of BIJ12
Het lid Van der Plas wijst, mijn inziens terecht, op deze lacune en ik ben het met haar eens dat het goed zou zijn indien schademelders tegen een beslissing van BIJ12 in het geweer kunnen komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 25 mei 2021 waarin de minister toezeggingen doet over de opvolging van de motie van het lid Von Martels over rondzwervende wolven

An MP asks whether the evaluation of the current interprovincial wolf plan is complete, what the status of the new wolf plan is, which measures to limit damage are included, and for minutes and participant lists of the Landelijk Overleg Wolf. The minister says no evaluation documents exist, the new plan is delayed to mid-2023 with a concept attached, damage-prevention measures are not yet decided, and the LOW minutes are not public under Chatham House rules.
The LOW is an independent consultation body that does not fall under the responsibility of my ministry or the provinces.
Het LOW is een onafhankelijke overlegvorm die niet onder verantwoordelijkheid van mijn ministerie of van de provincies valt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel 'Aerius dubbel ongeschikt voor opkoop piekbelasters» en de onderliggende studie 'Rebuttal On RIVM’s Critique Of Briggs et al. AERIUS/OPS Model Performance'

An MP asks the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen to define 'piekbelaster' (peak emitter), explain how it is calculated, and address uncertainty in AERIUS modelling and its use in nitrogen rights and litigation. The minister mostly defers to a separate letter, says the memo's criteria are indicative rather than definitive, and states that uncertainty cannot be quantified exactly but is inherent to modelling.
For further elaboration I refer to the aforementioned letter.
Voor een nadere invulling verwijs ik naar voornoemde brief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'NVWA-retributies, een hoge kostenpost die maar doorstijgt'

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Agriculture about reports that NVWA fees keep rising, that industry was not answered on its calls to delay new 2023 tariffs, that the consultation was boycotted, and that the agreed tariff reform and efficiency incentives have not been delivered. The Minister replies that consultation with industry took place, that the tariffs are cost-covering under the coalition agreement, that the 'reistijd = werktijd' dampening will continue in 2023, and that tariffs will not be set until Parliament has had the chance to respond.
At this moment the new NVWA tariffs have not yet been set and published.
Op dit moment zijn de nieuwe NVWA-tarieven nog niet vastgesteld en gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen die het lid Van der Plas over de opname van de Lelylijn op het TEN-T netwerk

An MP from BBB asked the state secretary about public support, expected ridership, costs and benefits, and EU co-financing for including the Lelylijn in the TEN-T network and linking it to northern Germany. The state secretary answered that these matters are still under study in the MIRT review, with participation planned, and that EU co-financing cannot be guaranteed or quantified in advance.
At this moment there are no forecasts on this yet.
Op dit moment zijn daar nog geen prognoses over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 6 juli 2022 inzake de aankondiging van de huis- en hobbydierenlijst

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why deer species were left off the proposed pet and hobby animal list, which would end deer farming and deer parks, and why industry concerns, a 2002 expert report, Skal certification and the Adviescollege's advice on house rules were not reflected. The Minister answered that the list rests on welfare and human-safety risk assessments, that a transition regime and sector consultation are underway, and that the list is consistent with the Andibel ruling.
I understand the concerns of this sector.
Ik begrijp de zorgen van deze sector.
Antwoord op vragen  van het lid Van der Plas over door de Belastingdienst ontvangen (fraude)signalen

An MP asked the State Secretary of Finance about the estimated number of unprocessed fraud signals at the Tax Administration, whether signals forwarded via Meld Misdaad Anoniem, regional tax offices and the FIOD information desk are being handled, and whether fraud policy is still 'in control'. The State Secretary gave detailed estimates (around 30,000 signals in total, about 2,000 forwarded signals not processed), acknowledged that part of the signals cannot currently be followed up, and described ongoing enforcement and a programme to restart the signal process.
That is why I do not think it is good that part of the signals about possible fraud cannot currently be followed up.
Daarom vind ik het niet goed dat een deel van de signalen over mogelijke fraude op dit moment niet kan worden opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het Stelsel Beroepsziekten en Dienstongevallen Politie

MP Van der Plas asks whether offsetting earlier smartengeld (pain-and-suffering damages) against material residual damages for police officers with PTSS is consistent with the Helder motion and CARAP advice, and whether the minister will correct cases already affected. The minister defends the offset as part of a generous, interim settlement approach, notes CARAP advice is followed except in two cases, and says the questions could not each be answered separately.
Because the advice contains privacy-sensitive information about those involved, the minister is only informed in outline by the competent authority.
Omdat de adviezen privacygevoelige informatie bevatten over de betrokkenen word ik als Minister door het bevoegd gezag op hoofdlijnen geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Paulusma, Van den Berg, Agema, Hijink, Bikker, Stoffer, Van Esch, Azarkan, Westerveld, Kuiken, Koekkoek, Van der Plas, Den Haan, Gündoğan en Sylvana Simons over de aangenomen moti

MPs asked the health minister about the adopted motion on Long COVID research, citing US and Dutch figures on prevalence and work incapacity, and asked for an estimate of its size in the Netherlands and a letter on implementation. The minister answered that around one in eight people report lasting symptoms, that 18 ZonMw studies and a RIVM LongCOVID study are under way, and that a joint knowledge agenda and an expert centre are being prepared, without a fixed timeline for the letter.
I refer to the annex 'Preparation and protection – other relevant topics related to the long-term approach to the coronavirus' attached to the letter on the long-term COVID-19 approach.

Antwoord 5 Ik verwijs hiervoor naar de bijlage «Voorbereiding en bescherming – andere relevante onderwerpen die verband houden met de langetermijnaanpak van het coronavirus» 6 bij de Kamerbrief langetermijnaanpak COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de Visserij

An MP asked the minister why Dutch fishing vessels cannot recruit foreign fishers through bilateral STCW-F recognition agreements, and whether agreements with Poland, Lithuania and Portugal will be concluded quickly. The minister acknowledges the shortage and the difficulty of such agreements, but offers only a prioritisation process with the sector and a plan to assess training quality by early next year.
I am therefore in discussion with the sector about which countries could be given priority in reaching bilateral agreements.
Met de sector ben ik daarom in gesprek over welke landen prioriteit zouden kunnen krijgen bij het komen tot bilaterale overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about internal Finance Ministry calculations showing that a 39-kton ammonia reduction target for the national rural area programme exceeds what is needed, and about the number of farms affected, withheld or unpublished modelling, and whether the targets could change. The minister answered that the calculations are unvalidated internal advice not equal to government policy, promised to share them with RIVM and to inform parliament on final figures, but declined to publish the figures now.
These are internal calculations by the Ministry of Finance with an indicative character that have not yet been scientifically validated.
Het betreffen ambtelijke berekeningen van het Ministerie van Financiën met een indicatief karakter en die nog niet wetenschappelijk zijn gevalideerd.
Antwoord op van de vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over stikstof

MPs Van der Plas and Omtzigt asked the minister about nitrogen deposition in Natura 2000 areas, the farm closures needed to meet critical deposition values, monitoring data on nature recovery, and the causal link between buy-outs and nature improvement. The minister answered that many outcomes depend on provincial area processes, that monitoring does not yet isolate nitrogen effects, and that scientific consensus supports nitrogen reduction, while declining to quantify farm closures or give guarantees.
No, I cannot indicate this in advance.
Nee, dit kan ik niet op voorhand aangeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van der Plas over de brandweerzorg

MPs Van Nispen and Van der Plas asked the Justice Minister about relaxed fire-service response times, closures of fire stations and changes made without consulting staff or local councils, and about the lack of data and protective equipment for women firefighters. The minister answered that veiligheidsregio boards are responsible for service levels and accountable to municipal councils, that a new legal framework is due by year-end, and that the region has postponed closure planning and been invited for talks.
Within the legal frameworks, the boards determine the ambitions and quality level of the safety region.
Binnen de wettelijke kaders bepalen de besturen de ambities en het kwaliteitsniveau van de veiligheidsregio.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de escalatie van de boerenprotesten

Van der Plas (BBB) asked the government about escalating farmer protests, including the involvement of other groups, the appointment of Remkes as independent mediator, and whether the nitrogen plans should be paused. The ministers condemned violent and intimidating acts, said dialogue and mediation continue, and refused to pause the nitrogen plans or reconsider Remkes's appointment.
Delaying that process or lowering the national targets is, however, not an option, given the urgent climate, water and nature challenge.
Vertragen op dat proces of verlagen van de nationale doelen is evenwel geen optie, gezien de urgente klimaat-, water- en natuuropgave.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over berekeningen over stikstof van het Ministerie van Financiën, die een totaal ander beeld op de stikstofproblematiek werpen en over de bemiddelingspoging van dhr

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked the government about unpublished Ministry of Finance nitrogen calculations showing smaller agricultural reductions needed if climate targets are met, and why these were not shared with parliament, plus the role of mediator Remkes and the basis of the NPLG targets. The government answered that the calculations are unvalidated, indicative internal advice, that they were shared with LNV and interdepartmentally and later published, and that targets will be adjusted as new projections (KEV 2022) come in.
The cabinet considers publishing unvalidated calculations that are still part of policy preparation not in the interest of good and democratic governance.
Het kabinet acht het openbaar maken van niet-gevalideerde berekeningen die nog onderdeel zijn van de beleidsvoorbereiding niet in het belang van goede en democratische bestuursvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het toenemende gebruik van Signal onder bewindspersonen en het verwijderen van berichten door de minister-president

An MP asked the Minister of Interior about the growing use of Signal by ministers, the deletion of messages by the Prime Minister, and whether this complied with government records policy and Council of State case law. The minister answered that the Prime Minister followed the government-wide policy that only messages on administrative decision-making not otherwise recorded must be kept, that an Inspectorate investigation into archiving at the Ministry of General Affairs is ongoing with results expected 1 October 2022, and that providers do not retain deleted messages.
There was coordination over which department would take on the answer. On the substantive answer there was no coordination between the Ministry of BZK and the Ministry of General Affairs.

Er heeft afstemming plaatsgevonden over welk departement de beantwoording op zich neemt. Over de inhoudelijke beantwoording heeft geen afstemming plaatsgevonden tussen het Ministerie van BZK en het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Van der Plas over een klokkenluidersmelding bij de publieke omroep

MPs Omtzigt and Van der Plas asked about the handling of a whistleblower report at the public broadcaster and the applicable procedures, including whether the report was treated as a whistleblower report and what rights the whistleblower has. The State Secretary answered that the Auditdienst Rijk is investigating the facts and declined to pre-empt the outcome, while describing the applicable procedures and complaint routes (ombudsman, Huis voor klokkenluiders) and refusing to give a timeline or the number of reports.
The factual course of events surrounding this report is being investigated by the ADR, as stated in my answer to question 3.
Naar de feitelijke gang van zaken rond deze melding wordt door de ADR onderzoek gedaan, zoals gemeld in mijn antwoord op vraag 3.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over inbeslagname rijbewijs buitenland

An MP asked whether Dutch truck drivers losing their foreign driving licence for minor offences face job loss, whether the minister had raised this with foreign counterparts, and whether a temporary replacement licence could be provided. The minister replied that no widespread problem is known, that foreign sanctions fall under national law without harmonised rules, that EU licence law does not allow a temporary replacement, and that drivers should comply with local rules.
First of all, it must be noted that the application of this sanction falls under the national criminal or administrative law of a country, for which no harmonised rules or agreements exist.
Voorop moet worden gesteld dat de toepassing van deze sanctie onder het nationale strafrecht of bestuursrecht van een land valt, waarvoor geen geharmoniseerde regels of afspraken bestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Azarkan, Dassen, Van der Plas en Eerdmans over de situatie op Schiphol

MPs asked the Finance Minister whether Schiphol's management had lost control of operations, whether shareholders could face claims and dividend losses, and whether shareholders should call an extraordinary meeting, a letter of objection, or an Enterprise Chamber inquiry. The minister attributed the problems to staff shortages and rising demand, pointed to Schiphol's summer action plan and a passenger cap, said operational responsibility lies with the board, and declined to share the confidential AGM documents while rejecting an extraordinary meeting or formal written objection for now.
The minutes of the General Meeting of Shareholders (including the relevant documents) are classified as commercially confidential and therefore cannot be shared with your House.
Het verslag van de Algemene Vergadering van Aandeelhouders (inclusief de relevante stukken) wordt aangemerkt als bedrijfsvertrouwelijke informatie en kan daarom niet worden gedeeld met uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Eerdmans over het verplicht aanschaffen van (hybride) warmtepompen door huishoudens

MPs Van der Plas and Eerdmans asked the Minister whether the planned norm requiring heat pumps instead of single CV boilers after 2026 amounts to coercion of homeowners, and questioned subsidies, loans, costs, supply, grid capacity and tenant rent increases. The government answered that the norm applies only where economically, technically and functionally feasible, that heat pump investments generally pay back within their lifetime, and that the matter will be further studied, with commitments to inform the House and address tenant and supply concerns.
Further research will be carried out in the coming period to determine the exact scale and design of the norm and the exceptions described above.
Er zal in de komende periode nader onderzoek worden gedaan om de exacte maatvoering en vormgeving van de norm en de uitzonderingen die hierboven beschreven zijn te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het memorandum van het Nationaal Comité 4 en 5 mei

An MP asked the state secretary about the National Committee 4 and 5 May memorandum's reference to Dutch and Indonesian victims of the colonial war in Indonesia, and whether this is painful for Indo-Dutch communities who see perpetrators honoured. The state secretary answered that the commemoration covers all war victims, that the committee decides independently, that feelings of anger are understood, and that the Indies history is part of Dutch history, without committing to changes.
The NC is an independent organisation that decides autonomously on how the 4 May commemoration is shaped.
Het NC is een onafhankelijke organisatie die zelfstandig besluit over de wijze waarop de herdenking op 4 mei wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Haga en Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Minister: 'Rode diesel keert niet terug'

Two MPs asked whether the government will reinstate red diesel for farmers, given that Belgium and Germany offer farmers cheaper fuel and that Dutch farmers face heavy regulation. The minister refused to reinstate red diesel, pointing to the temporary fuel excise cut and EU crisis reserve funds, and gave no separate scheme for farmers.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Nee, daartoe ben ik niet bereid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het openbaar maken van boetes

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality why the NVWA publishes fines for animal transport without distinguishing cases that are still under appeal, overturned by a court, or dropped, and whether such cases count toward stricter supervision and cumulative fines. The Minister answered that the documents are published as they exist under the Wet open overheid, that disputed fines stay in the file but are refunded if overturned, and that contested or annulled violations do not count toward recidivism or enhanced supervision.
If a judge upholds an appeal against a previously imposed fine, that fine is not removed from the file.
Als een rechter het beroep tegen een eerder opgelegde boete gegrond verklaart, wordt deze boete niet uit het dossier geschrapt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over 'Wijziging van de Wet verbod pelsdierhouderij in verband met een vervroegde beëindiging van de pelsdierhouderij' van 22 november 2021 en eerdere toezeggingen aan de sector

An MP asked the Minister why pension compensation for older fur farmers under the Fur Farming Ban has not yet been clarified, and when applications can be submitted. The Minister confirmed the compensation framework, said the complex individual assessment and an external adviser delay matters, and expected information from summer with applications possible from Q4.
Fur farmers are expected to be informed about the further arrangement of the pension provision from the summer.
Naar verwachting zullen pelsdierhouders vanaf de zomer geïnformeerd worden over de verdere invulling van de pensioenvoorziening.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over een mogelijk antisemitisch Wob-verzoek van The Rights Forum

An MP asked whether a Wob information request by The Rights Forum about university ties with Israeli and Jewish institutions is antisemitic under the IHRA definition, whether the group has links to designated terrorist organisations, whether it remains a ministry interlocutor, and whether its ANBI tax status should be reviewed. The government rejected the antisemitism framing, said it has no evidence of terror links, said the group remains a legitimate dialogue partner, and explained in general terms ANBI criteria while citing tax secrecy and declining to comment on the individual organisation.
Under the tax authority's confidentiality obligation (Article 67 General Tax Act), it is however not possible to make statements about the handling of an individual organisation.

Ingevolge de geheimhoudingsplicht van de Belastingdienst (Artikel 67 Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen) is het echter niet mogelijk om mededelingen te doen over de behandeling van een individuele instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mogelijke ontkenning van de Armeense Genocide door de regering

Van der Plas (BBB) asks whether the government has recognised the Armenian Genocide and whether the cabinet's communication and visit to Yerevan were consistent with the Tweede Kamer's motions recognising it. Minister Hoekstra answers that the cabinet has not yet decided on implementing the Voordewind motion, will consult like-minded EU states on recognising genocides, and gives no recognition or denial.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over 'emissies naar lucht uit de landbouw berekend met NEMA voor 1990-2019' van Van Bruggen e.a. en de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant inzake emissiearme stallen van 8

An MP asked about the NEMA agricultural emissions model used for reporting, emission-low stall effectiveness, the ruling of the Oost-Brabant court, and the RAV list. The ministers replied that the NEMA model is used for reporting and deposition inputs, that low-emission floors are treated as equal to conventional ones due to lower practical performance, and that innovation and real-time measurement are being pursued.
I am aware of the ruling of the Oost-Brabant court.
Ik ben bekend met de uitspraak van de rechtbank Oost-Brabant.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Opkopen boeren voor A15 ging tegen wens van provincie in: 'Ik heb ze overvallen''

An MP asked the infrastructure minister about her role, and her direct contacts with a provincial deputy, in buying out farms for the A15 motorway, and about the 'overvallen' remark in leaked messages. The minister answered that contacts concerned administrative agreements, not the voluntary farm buy-out contracts, admitted the remark was sharply worded, and described voluntary nitrogen-mitigation agreements as the route to free up nitrogen space.
The contact between the Minister and the deputy concerned the administrative agreements made, not the agreements with the agricultural businesses.
Het contact tussen Minister en gedeputeerde betrof de gemaakte bestuurlijke afspraken en niet de overeenkomsten met de agrarische bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de oproep van gedeputeerden Overijssel en Utrecht aan het Rijk om sanering asbestdaken vlot te trekken

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about provincial calls to speed up asbestos roof removal, including the falling removal pace, the timeframe, use of remaining business-fund money, national coordination and links to farm-exit and solar policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the slowing pace, said a letter with alternative use of funds would come before the 22 June debate, gave no firm deadline, and referred several questions to other ministers.
My aim is to send this letter to the House before the upcoming External Safety committee debate on 22 June.
Mijn streven is om deze brief voor het komende Commissiedebat Externe Veiligheid van 22 juni, aan de Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Bisschop, Van der Plas, Bikker, Ceder, Van den Berg, Tielen, Brekelmans en Podt over de toegang tot basiszorg voor Oekraïense vluchtelingen

MPs from several parties asked about access to basic healthcare for Ukrainian refugees, including GP, mental health, pharmacy, dental and maternity care, and about coordination with the LHV, InEen and GGD GHOR, medical evacuations, administrative burden, and interpreters. The government answered that Ukrainian displaced persons fall outside the asylum medical scheme, that JenV leads the organisation of access with insurers, that existing systems are being copied, and that it could not answer all questions before the plenary debate but sent a broader letter.
It has not been possible to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Het is niet gelukt om de vragen voor het plenaire debat te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het 'New Crisis Response Mechanism'

An MP asks the Minister whether the DSA's new crisis response mechanism (Article 27a), letting the Commission impose measures on very large platforms without parliamentary or member-state control, is acceptable, and whether Article 25a and digital services coordinators pose risks. The government answers that the Commission needs a Board recommendation and a genuine crisis, that measures are limited to three months and subject to necessity and proportionality tests, that its proposal for qualified-majority member-state control was not adopted, and that national security remains a national competence.
The cabinet successfully urged the French EU presidency to include robust safeguards regarding the exercise of this provision.
Het kabinet heeft bij het Franse EU-voorzitterschap ... er succesvol op aangedrongen om robuuste waarborgen op te nemen met betrekking tot de uitoefening van deze bepaling.
Antwoord op van de leden Agema en Van der Plas over de inzet van influencers tijdens de coronacrisis

MPs Agema and Van der Plas asked how many influencers the government deployed during the COVID-19 crisis, which messages, on which platforms, at what cost, and whether they opposed dissenting views or MPs. The minister answered in detail: 60 influencers were used under the Alleen Samen campaign, costs were listed, and the government denied commissioning influencers to counter dissenters or MPs.
In total, 60 influencers were deployed during the coronavirus crisis under the Alleen Samen campaign, both paid and unpaid.
In totaal zijn 60 influencers ingezet tijdens de coronacrisis in het kader van de campagne Alleen Samen, zowel betaald als belangeloos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over dreigende olietekorten en compensatie voor visserij

An MP asks the ministers whether a diesel and oil shortage linked to Russian oil sanctions threatens sectors such as fishing, and whether compensation for fishers should be paid and the pulse-fishing ban reconsidered. The government answers that it has released diesel from strategic stocks, will not compensate businesses for high energy prices, and sees no reason to revisit the decision.
The cabinet's position is that compensation of businesses for high energy and fuel prices resulting from the war in Ukraine is not on the table.
Het kabinetsstandpunt is dat compensatie van bedrijven vanwege hoge energie- en brandstofprijzen als gevolg van de oorlog in Oekraïne niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Westerveld, Van Esch, Agema, Sylvana Simons, Koekkoek, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Eerdmans en Den Haan over de gewiste opnames van de OMT-vergaderingen

MPs asked whether recordings of OMT (Outbreak Management Team) meetings fall under the Archiefwet, whether the 14 April 2020 recording was destroyed and by whom, and about COVID-19 hotspot archiving lists. The minister answered that audio recordings are used only to draft minutes, that the minutes are archived while recordings are deleted as standard practice, and that some answers (selection lists, hotspot lists) would follow later.
An audio recording of an OMT meeting is deleted by the secretariat after the minutes are finalised. There is no registration of this.
Een geluidsopname van een OMT-vergadering wordt door het secretariaat verwijderd na het definitief vaststellen van het verslag. Hier is geen registratie van.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de hongersnood in Sri Lanka

MP Van der Plas asks the government about Sri Lanka's forced shift to organic farming, Dutch knowledge-sharing, possible lessons for Dutch policy, and lobby influence on fertiliser and pesticide policy. The minister answers that the Netherlands raised concerns with Sri Lanka, offered knowledge exchange and webinars, sees no lessons warranting a study, and states the government's own pesticide transition strategy.
To begin with, it is of course up to a country itself to make its own policy choices.
Vooropgesteld is het uiteraard aan een land zelf om de eigen beleidskeuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Duidelijke koers staatsbanken gewenst’

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Finance Minister about the government's strategy for privatising state stakes in ABN AMRO and the Volksbank, and whether the EU required privatisation. Minister Kaag answered that the ABN AMRO stake will be sold again (NLFI advising on timing, with limited public detail due to share-price sensitivity), that the Volksbank is not yet ready for privatisation, and that the Netherlands committed to returning both banks to the market when conditions allow.
Partly because of share-price sensitivity, I am limited in what I can say about this publicly.
Mede vanwege de koersgevoeligheid ben ik beperkt in wat ik hier in het openbaar over kan zeggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van der Plas over de open brief van het Nationaal OV-Beraad (NOVB) over de staat van het openbaar vervoer en het voorzieningenniveau

MP Van der Plas asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government would act on the Nationaal OV-Beraad's warning that delayed decisions could cut regional public transport by 20-30%, and whether it would secure multi-year bridging support beyond 2022. The State Secretary answered that the transport availability allowance (BVOV) was extended to end-2022 and that the government will keep monitoring, with the KiM forecast to be updated in June.
That is why on 14 April the cabinet decided to extend the transport availability allowance (BVOV) until the end of 2022.
Daarom heeft het kabinet op 14 april jl. besloten de beschikbaarheidsvergoeding OV (BVOV) te verlengen tot eind 2022.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'Olie, gas, graan en geld - Oekraïne laat zien hoe de wereld werkt'

An MP from BBB asked ministers in 19 numbered questions about the effects of the war in Ukraine on food supply, input prices, farm viability and the EU's dependence on imports, and whether the Green Deal transition should be postponed. The minister answered mostly on substance, noting no structural food shortage is expected in the EU, commitments to monitor and share a Wageningen study, and rejected postponing the sustainability transition.
I monitor the situation closely and am also in close contact with the European Commission and the agriculture ministers of the EU member states on this.
Ik monitor de situatie nauwlettend en heb hieromtrent ook nauw contact met de Europese Commissie en de landbouwministers van de EU-lidstaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de waterinjectie door NAM in Twente

An MP from BBB asked the State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate about the chemicals NAM uses in its wastewater injection in Twente, the gas tariff and emergency gas status of the Schoonebeek steam supply, the legal basis for the injection without a storage permit, whether the oil permit could be revoked, and related safety and drinking water questions. The State Secretary answered in detail, describing the chemicals and safety measures, stating that revoking the permit would likely be overturned in court, and committing to work toward ending the injection by end 2022 and moving processing to Drenthe.
This means that if I nevertheless decide to revoke the permit, the court will most likely annul that decision.
Dit betekent dat als ik toch besluit de vergunning in te trekken, de rechter hoogstwaarschijnlijk dit besluit zal vernietigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over stormschade en onderhoudsinventarisatie van kerkgebouwen

An MP asked the state secretary about storm damage to church buildings, the state of their maintenance, church owners' financial worries, and whether a plan is needed to address deferred maintenance and public safety. The state secretary said maintenance is generally good, pointed to the Toekomst Religieus Erfgoed programme, church visions and the SIM subsidy scheme, and saw no need for a specific new plan since owners bear primary responsibility.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over onderzoek naar en compensatie van faunaschade landbouw

Van der Plas (BBB) asked about the number and reasons of rejected wildlife damage claims for agriculture, whether protected status and cross-border migration of wolves and other species hinder deterrence, whether responsibility should shift away from livestock keepers, whether the Netherlands should seek an EU exemption for wolves, and whether there is cross-border communication on fauna. The minister gave detailed figures on rejected claims, stated the legal framework, said no exemption push is warranted, and described cooperation with Germany, Belgium, Poland and international management platforms, promising a provincial wolf plan after summer.
I expect to be able to send this to your House after the summer.
Ik verwacht dit na de zomer aan uw Kamer te kunnen toesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de WNL-documentaire ‘Vertrouwelijk’

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether Peter R. de Vries declined police protection, whether any other protective measures were taken, and what was done about reports of him being followed. The Minister declined to provide any information on whether protective measures were taken, citing operational security, and deferred to the ongoing Dutch Safety Board investigation while describing general strengthening of the protection system.
I cannot make any statements about whether security measures were taken or not.
Over al dan niet genomen beveiligingsmaatregelen kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Teunissen, Kuzu, Van der Plas, Simons en Dassen over het lot van de Afghaanse ambassadebewakers

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister why the Afghan guards employed by an external contractor at the Dutch embassy in Kabul were not evacuated, when the Belhaj motion called for evacuating those who assisted the Dutch government, and whether the contractor was informed of the decision. The minister answered that the guards were not embassy employees and guarded other states' diplomatic missions, so they fell outside the evacuation criteria; he acknowledged the contractor received no timely written reply and that the lists and correspondence are shared only confidentially.
The request of 15 August and both reminders are shared with you on a confidential basis.
Het verzoek van 15 augustus en beide rappels worden op vertrouwelijke basis met u gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de brief van 6 januari 2022 'Mogelijke verhoging gaswinning Groningenveld gasjaar 2021-2022'

An MP asked whether extra Groningen gas extraction for 2021-2022 is legally and ethically permissible given the delayed nitrogen plant, the earlier decision to phase out extraction, and export obligations, and whether new advice should be sought. The government answered that the Mijnbouwwet allows annual and in-year adjustments, that appeals remain open, that the phase-out aim stands, that export contracts are a matter for the parties involved, and that it will inform parliament and decide on the extraction level before 1 April 2022.
Before 1 April 2022 I will take a final decision on the extraction level.
Voor 1 april 2022 zal ik een definitief besluit nemen over het winningsniveau.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Hijink, Omtzigt, Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de positie van zorgverleners die als gevolg van long covid lange tijd thuis zitten

Four MPs asked the health minister about healthcare workers off work for long periods with long COVID, including compensation, income loss and whether those costs are covered. The minister replied that no special social security regime exists for long COVID, that a temporary subsidy for employers retaining such workers was introduced, and that causation from workplace infection cannot be established in many cases.
No registration is kept of the number of healthcare workers who are partly or fully off work after a coronavirus infection.
Er wordt geen registratie bijgehouden van het aantal zorgverleners dat na een coronabesmetting deels of volledig thuiszit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het toenemende gebruik van Signal onder bewindspersonen en ambtenaren

An MP asked the government about officials and ministers increasingly using the disappearing-message app Signal and whether this allows relevant communications to escape Wob freedom-of-information requests and oversight.
