The minister answered that existing policy discourages messaging apps for official decision-making, that chat messages on decisions must be preserved, and that he will add advice to the handbook not to enable automatic deletion, while declining to provide per-ministry usage data or ban Signal.
I will communicate this addition to the handbook government-wide.
Ik zal deze aanvulling op de Handleiding rijksbreed communiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Bisschop over de procedure bij een geconstateerde overtreding door de NVWA met betrekking tot dierenwelzijn

MPs Van der Plas and Bisschop asked the minister how the NVWA follows up detected animal welfare violations, including delays of months before fines are announced, fine escalation and inconsistent inspection. The minister explains the two-step procedure, says steps have been taken to shorten delays and says the fine system will be evaluated.
The NVWA does not keep this data in this way.
De NVWA houdt deze gegevens niet op deze wijze bij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Jasper van Dijk over een verplichte VOG om misbruikschandalen te voorkomen

MPs Van der Plas and Van Dijk asked whether a sector-specific VOG (certificate of conduct) should be made mandatory for humanitarian aid workers to prevent sexual abuse scandals. The minister said screening is a shared responsibility of organisations, that no specific sector request was received, and that she is open to further talks with aid organisations and COVOG on evaluating screening instruments.

I am open to a follow-up conversation with aid organisations to evaluate experiences with the various available personnel screening instruments and to arrive at an effective instrument as quickly as possible.

Ik sta open voor een vervolggesprek met hulporganisaties om de ervaringen met de verschillende beschikbare instrumenten voor screening van personeel te evalueren en zo snel mogelijk tot een effectief instrument te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Pouw-Verweij over de Kamerbrief van 20 december 2021 ‘Toekomstige organisatie van zorg voor patiënten met aangeboren hartafwijkingen’

MPs Van der Plas and Pouw-Verweij asked whether concentrating high-complexity congenital heart surgery in two centres accounts for the projected doubling of adult patients, the vulnerability of a two-centre network, the lack of geographic spread and patient travel burden, knock-on effects on other paediatric care, why the DC3 plan was rejected, and the rationale for limiting concentration to complex adult procedures. The minister defends the two-centre model as needed for quality and continuity, notes that outpatient care stays regional, and commits to asking the NZa for an impact analysis before the summer recess.
I will also ask the Dutch Healthcare Authority (NZa) to carry out an impact analysis and map the consequences of choosing these two locations before the summer recess.
Ik zal ook de Nederlandse Zorgautoriteit (NZa) vragen een impactanalyse uit te voeren en nog voor het zomerreces de gevolgen van de keuze voor deze twee locaties in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Ambtenaren halen kritiek uit stikstofstudie’

An MP from BBB asks the minister whether high-ranking civil servants' criticisms of the stikstof (nitrogen) study by ABDTOPConsult, including on the KDW and AERIUS model, were ignored, and whether the policy should be paused. The minister denies that critical civil servant input was suppressed, says the report was independently drafted, defends the KDW and the nitrogen approach, and refuses to suspend the policy.
No, this is not correct. The report was drawn up by an independent chair of ABDTOPConsult and a supporting civil service secretariat.
Nee, dit is niet correct. Het rapport is opgesteld door een onafhankelijke voorzitter van ABDTOPConsult en een ondersteunend ambtelijk secretariaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over Rijtestlocatie terugbrengen naar Terneuzen

An MP asked the minister why the CBR driving test location in Terneuzen was moved to Goes, arguing that older residents of Zeeuws-Vlaanderen now face longer trips, tolls and unequal treatment. The minister defended the 2016 evaluation and concentration of locations, said the same national criteria apply everywhere, and declined to reinstate tests in Terneuzen.
I will inform your House shortly, as requested by MP de Hoop during the procedural meeting of 1 February, about the medical assessments for driving fitness.
Ik zal uw Kamer conform het verzoek van het lid de Hoop tijdens de regeling van werkzaamheden van 1 februari op korte termijn nader informeren over de medische keuringen voor rijgeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het niet handhaven van het vuurwerkverbod

An MP asks the Justice and Interior ministers whether the government anticipated enforcement shortages before imposing a temporary fireworks ban, whether mayors and police warned of enforceability problems, and how the ban affected cross-border purchases, hospital figures and public trust. The minister replies that the ban was needed to relieve healthcare pressure, that police and prosecutors deliberately prioritised citizen safety over enforcing the ban, that casualty figures fell 40% compared with the last pre-COVID year, and that detailed hospital data will follow in a separate report.
Data on ICU admissions are not available. The report with an additional analysis of the injury figures for the past New Year's period will be sent to your House in the second quarter of 2022.

Gegevens over IC-opnamen zijn niet beschikbaar. De rapportage met een aanvullende analyse van de letselcijfers van afgelopen jaarwisseling zal in het tweede kwartaal van 2022 naar uw Kamer verzonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de (her)opening van scholen

An MP asked the education minister about research on pupils' behaviour after repeated school closures, long-term developmental effects, ventilation projects, national school housing policy, the 'scholen veilig open' call, teacher retention, student support and staff absenteeism. The minister answered mostly with descriptions of existing programmes and monitoring, stating no systematic study or long-term prognosis yet exists, while promising continued reporting and measures.
As far as I have been able to determine, no systematic research has yet been conducted into the effect of school closures on pupils' behaviour in class after a closure.
Voor zover ik na heb kunnen gaan, is er nog geen systematisch onderzoek naar het effect van schoolsluiting op het gedrag van leerlingen na een schoolsluiting in de klas gedaan
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Alkaya over de uitvoering van motie Alkaya/Van der Plas over het zo spoedig mogelijk beëindigen van tolheffing voor de Westerscheldetunnel

MPs Van der Plas and Alkaya asked the minister how the motion to make the Westerscheldetunnel toll-free as soon as possible is being implemented, and why the toll-free date, road-traffic effects, and funding are unclear. The minister answered that toll removal requires funding first, which has not been found, that the timeline depends on the coalition plan for a pay-per-use system around 2030, and that the Draaiboek and internal advice are being shared.
I agree with that, provided the condition of funding the costs of abolishing the toll can be met.
Daar ben ik het mee eens, mits aan de voorwaarde voor dekking van de kosten van afschaffing van de tol kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de lozing van NAM-afvalwater in Dinkelland

An MP asks why NAM's wastewater discharge into Dinkelland will take at least three years to stop, and raises questions about subsurface pressure, earthquake risk, liability, the Commissie Mijnbouwschade's competence, and the division of oversight tasks. The State Secretary answers that the timeline is needed to obtain permits and build new treatment, denies expected extreme effects, says the State is owner of the deep subsurface but NAM is liable, and describes the overlapping responsibilities of SodM, the Mijnraad and other bodies.
The State owns the deep subsurface. NAM is the permit holder and responsible for the water injection and any consequences.
De Staat is eigenaar van de diepe ondergrond. NAM is de vergunninghouder en verantwoordelijk voor de waterinjectie en de eventuele gevolgen daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Alkaya, Grinwis en Van der Plas over de mogelijkheid dat de nachttrein Brussel/Amsterdam-Berlijn/Dresden/Praag ook in Hengelo stopt

MPs asked why the new European Sleeper night train from Brussels/Amsterdam to Berlin/Dresden/Prague does not stop in Hengelo despite earlier investment in the Hengelo-Bad Bentheim link and overnight travel gaps. The State Secretary explained that the stop is commercially and timetable-constrained for European Sleeper, that a stop in 2022 is unlikely, and that the government will explore whether a 2023 stop is feasible and talk with the operator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de compensatieregelingen bij hogere energiekosten

An MP asked whether residents of large complexes such as students and elderly people, who often lack their own energy contract, benefit from the energy tax cut and the extra 200 euro compensation for low incomes. The government answered that residents receive compensation through the energy tax reduction and that targeted support exists, but acknowledged that the distribution cannot be tailored to each household and promised to report on energy prices every two months.
The cabinet therefore continues to closely monitor the development of energy prices.
Het kabinet blijft daarom de ontwikkeling van de energieprijzen nauwlettend in de gaten houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het rapport 'Ecosystem effects of large upscaling of offshore wind on the North Sea'

An MP asks the minister about a report finding ecosystem effects of large-scale offshore wind on the North Sea, and about accountability, cumulative assessment, international cooperation, cables, and mitigation. The minister answers that cumulative effects are considered at each planning and permitting stage, that responsibility is divided among ministries and Rijkswaterstaat, and that further research (Wozep, MONS, ElasmoPower) is underway.

It is now important to gain more insight into these effects in time. For this reason, follow-up research is already planned within the Wozep and the Programme Monitoring and Research Nature Restoration and Species Protection (MONS).

Het is nu van belang om tijdig nog meer inzicht te krijgen in deze effecten. Daarom is al vervolgonderzoek voorzien in het kader van het Wozep en het Programma Monitoring en Onderzoek Natuurherstel en Soortenbescherming (MONS).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht 'GLB-steun voor kalverhouders'

MP Van der Plas asks whether the EUR 60 million pledged in 2014 to make veal farming more sustainable has been spent, whether EUR 30 million remains owed to the sector, and whether the money will reach farms and deadlines be extended. The minister replies that EUR 50 million has been allocated, a final EUR 10 million scheme is forthcoming, unspent EU funds return to the EU rather than the state, and no general deadline extension is planned, only individual extensions.
I will inform your House of the outlines of the subsidy scheme and the conditions attached to it once more is known about it.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de contouren van de subsidieregeling en de randvoorwaarden daarbij, wanneer daar meer over bekend is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het inwerkingtreden van de REACH Verordening

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Health about the EU REACH restriction on hazardous tattoo ink pigments taking effect in January 2022, questioning its scientific basis, the safety of alternatives, transition relief, and risks of illegal tattooing. The Minister replied that the restriction is binding EU law based on thorough scientific review, that manufacturers must ensure their inks are safe, and that no postponement or compensation is possible.
The REACH restriction is binding EU regulation that cannot be postponed at national level.
De REACH restrictie is bindende EU-regelgeving die niet op nationaal niveau kan worden uitgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het vuurwerkverbod

An MP from BBB asked the Justice Minister about the temporary fireworks ban, including cross-border fireworks purchases, enforcement capacity, injury figures, and compensation for the fireworks industry. The government answered that enforcement continues at borders, injury figures fell compared with the last year without a ban, compensation was increased, and it still considers the ban justified.
No information is known about the quantities of fireworks purchased abroad.
Over de hoeveelheden vuurwerk die aangeschaft zijn in het buitenland is geen informatie bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over ammoniakuitstoot van het bedrijf Aurora (onderdeel van Cargill) in Zaandam

An MP asked the State Secretary and Minister whether a Cargill subsidiary's undisclosed ammonia emissions in Zaandam were a sign of gaps in emission reporting and enforcement, and what consequences and actions followed. The answers say the regional environmental service knew of the emissions, that a possible emission-norm breach for one sub-process is under a pending enforcement order, and that the reporting system relies on self-reporting with sampling checks plus a correction mechanism, with improvements planned.

As previously stated in the answer to question 5 from the D66 faction, the Noordzeekanaalgebied environmental service was aware of the ammonia emissions by Cargill Aurora and these are also permitted under certain conditions.

Zoals eerder bij het antwoord op vraag 5 van de D66-fractie aangeven was de omgevingsdienst Noordzeekanaalgebied op de hoogte van de uitstoot van ammoniak door Cargill Aurora en is deze ook toegestaan onder bepaalde voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord.

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, and the Minister for Nature and Nitrogen, 17 questions on the 2021 coalition agreement covering nitrogen targets, the transition fund, carbon credits, sustainable food, buyouts, legalisation of PAS cases and a possible consumer levy. The ministers largely answered by pointing to forthcoming analyses, planned provincial area plans and later decisions, with several answers promising to inform the House soon.
To determine the precise target achievement, an additional calculation is necessary, after further elaboration of the plans.
Om het precieze doelbereik te bepalen is een aanvullende doorrekening noodzakelijk, na verdere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs from across the opposition and coalition asked the Minister of Justice and Security 25 factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering asylum and migration, police staffing, financing, cybersecurity, organized crime and the bar. The government answered many questions only partially, deferring details to later elaboration or a decision by the cabinet, and gave specific answers on police numbers, withdrawn bills, asylum spending and the reasons for expected higher asylum inflow.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Waterstaat factual questions about the coalition agreement, covering short-haul flight discouragement, flight numbers, investment splits, air quality, aviation tax revenue, road safety budgets and infrastructure maintenance. The minister answered most questions in general terms, deferring several figures and allocations to later cabinet decisions or reports.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the government dozens of factual questions about the 2021 coalition agreement's climate, energy, and biomass plans, including Ternaard gas drilling, CCS, nuclear, and the Westerschelde tunnel toll. The minister answered only a handful on substance and deferred most questions to later cabinet decisions.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet. You will be informed about this as soon as possible.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover zo spoedig mogelijk geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from eleven parties asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering minimum wage, childcare subsidy, rent allowance, the AOW gap, child poverty targets, institutional racism and the Rainbow Accord. The government answered most questions substantively but deferred many details (funding, targets, the Rainbow Accord) to later elaboration by the cabinet.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a cabinet decision. You will be informed about this during the further elaboration.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover bij de nadere uitwerking geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the foreign minister, in written questions, about the coalition agreement, covering EU budget and enlargement, ODA targets, asylum spending, migration partnerships, Middle East resolutions, and transparency. The ministers answered most questions in substance, pointing to existing reports and promising further studies and letters, with few concrete commitments.
The cabinet will inform your House about this in more detail with a BNC fiche.
Het kabinet zal uw Kamer hierover met een BNC-fiche nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

Eleven MPs asked the Finance Minister about the coalition agreement, covering the budget, tax burden, fiscal rules, the RRF recovery plan, and wealth inequality. The minister answered most questions in detail, citing indicative figures, and deferred several items (inflation effects, purchasing-power tables, the sugar tax, asset-tax reform) to the Spring Memorandum and later analyses.
The cabinet is examining the options for eventually lowering VAT on fruit and vegetables to 0% and introducing a sugar tax.
Het kabinet beziet de mogelijkheden voor het op termijn verlagen van de btw op groente en fruit naar 0% en het invoeren van een suikerbelasting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parliamentary groups asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the coalition agreement, covering student grants, research funding, teacher pay, press funding, special education, childcare and digitalisation. The government answered most questions with references to further elaboration and future decisions, providing concrete figures only in a few places.
The answer to this question requires further elaboration and a decision by the cabinet. You will be informed about this further.
Het antwoord op deze vraag vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet. U wordt hierover nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Health Minister about the 2021 coalition agreement, covering youth care savings, health inequality, healthcare wages, the chief medical officer, ICU capacity, the health deductible and premium effects. The minister answered most questions in substance, deferred several to later decision-making, and pointed to other documents for details.
For a number of questions, further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet is still required.
Voor een aantal vragen geldt dat deze nog nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming vragen door het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Nijboer, Azarkan, Van der Plas, Van Raan, Omtzigt, Stoffer, Van Haga, Tony van Dijck, Den Haan en Dassen over het coalitieakkoord

MPs from many parties asked the Defence Minister, in a set of factual questions before the government declaration debate, about the defence budget increases in the coalition agreement, how the funds are allocated, European defence cooperation, specialisation and strategic autonomy, and the NATO spending norm. The minister answered that the money is additional, broken down into intensification and maintenance items, will be detailed in a forthcoming Defence Note, and brings spending to the European NATO average of 1.85% of GDP.
How the coalition agreement funds will exactly be spent requires further elaboration and decision-making by the cabinet.
Hoe de middelen uit het coalitieakkoord precies worden uitgegeven, vergt nadere uitwerking en besluitvorming van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over mogelijke scenario’s voor een evacuatie uit Oekraïne

An MP from BBB asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence about possible evacuation scenarios for Dutch citizens in Ukraine amid Russian troop build-up, including escalation risks, travel advice, consular registration, and EU/NATO coordination. The minister answered that evacuation is only considered in exceptional circumstances, there is currently no reason to organise one, travel advice will be updated when developments warrant, and some questions were answered jointly.
At this moment there is no question of an imminent threat to Dutch nationals.
Op dit moment is er geen sprake van een dreigende situatie voor Nederlanders.
Antwoord op de vragen het lid Van der Plas over ontbossing in Brazilië en de link naar een Nederlands diervoeder

An MP asked the agriculture minister about a Zembla broadcast linking Brazilian deforestation to Dutch animal feed, and whether Dutch certified soy is truly exceptional and whether full segregation would harm the sector. The minister acknowledged the facts, declined to confirm that Dutch feed is uniquely fully certified, rejected full segregation as unworkable while noting its costs, and referred the EU deforestation policy question to a forthcoming BNC-fiche.
Whether the Netherlands is therefore the only country in the world where all soy used is certified sustainable, I cannot confirm.
Of Nederland daarmee het enige land ter wereld is waar alle gebruikte soja duurzaam gecertificeerd is, kan ik niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel 'Vogelgriep bij pluimveebedrijf in Tzum, ruim 122.000 kuikens afgemaakt'

Parliamentary questions from MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Agriculture about risk assessments, bird flu monitoring, costs, rules on hatching eggs, and delays in publishing the avian influenza protocol. The minister answered that no new risk assessment was made in September but one was requested in October, that the H5N1 strain is genetically new, that a review will occur only after the 2021-2022 season, that the protocol will be published in early 2022, and that compensation for lost free-range egg income is not given under current policy.
In September the expert group did not make an additional risk assessment for highly pathogenic avian influenza.
In september heeft de deskundigengroep geen (aanvullende) risicobeoordeling gemaakt voor hoogpathogene vogelgriep.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de afhandeling van de schade van de wateroverlast in Limburg en Noord-Brabant van juli 2021

An MP asked the government about the slow handling of flood damage claims in Limburg and Noord-Brabant after July 2021, including delays, strict procedures, insurance exclusions and unclear rules for farmers. The minister said payments had started, defended the procedure and the 13-week and 4-6 week timelines, refused to extend the deadline or make advance payments, and declined to intervene in private insurance policies.
I consider it of great importance that those affected are helped adequately and as quickly as possible.
Ik acht het van groot belang dat gedupeerden adequaat en zo snel mogelijk worden geholpen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Piri, Bromet, Jasper van Dijk, Dassen, Kuzu, Teunissen, Simons, Van der Plas en Omtzigt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse Zaken weigert Afghaanse bewakers ambassade Kabul te evacueren’

MPs asked why Dutch embassy security guards employed via a subcontractor in Kabul were not evacuated while Hungarian guards were, and whether a new direct-employment criterion was introduced without informing parliament. The government answered that the criteria for evacuation (Belhaj motion) were unchanged, that embassy guards fall under host-state responsibility and their employer is responsible, and gave figures on remaining interpreters and Afghans awaiting transfer.
There is no question of a new criterion.
Er is geen sprake van een nieuw criterium.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht "Lange wachtlijst kinderopvang dwingt ouders minder te gaan werken"

An MP asked the state secretary about long childcare waiting lists, the shortage of childcare staff, the decline in registered childminders from about 33,000 to 22,000, and municipal fees for childminder registration. The state secretary answered that staff shortages are a concern, that childminding is a flexible option, that the causes of the decline are unknown pending research due in summer 2022, and that improvement measures will be decided by the next cabinet.
Due to the required legislative amendment, financial coverage and the caretaker status of the cabinet, decision-making on improvement measures is ultimately for the next cabinet.
Vanwege de benodigde wetswijziging, financiële dekking en de demissionaire status van het kabinet, is besluitvorming over verbetermaatregelen uiteindelijk aan het volgende kabinet.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de Regeling ten behoeve van de gerichte opkoop van veehouderijen ter vermindering van de stikstofdepositie op overbelaste stikstofgevoelige Natura-2000 gebieden, zoals toe

MP Van der Plas asks whether the buy-out scheme for livestock farms near overburdened Natura 2000 areas has changed from nitrogen reduction to permanent farm closure, and why the ban on relocating farmers was retained despite earlier agreement to drop it. The minister answers that the goal remains structural nitrogen reduction, that permanent closure is a means to that end, and that a second tranche relaxing the relocation ban is still being explored.

Progress and effects of the source and nature-restoration measures of the Nitrogen Reduction and Nature Improvement Programme, including the buy-out schemes, will be reported every two years, first in 2023.

Over de voortgang en gevolgen van de bron- en natuurherstelmaatregelen van het Programma Stikstofreductie en Natuurverbetering, waaronder de opkoopregelingen, wordt iedere twee jaar gerapporteerd, voor het eerst in 2023.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de aangenomen motie-Van der Plas over inventariseren welke gebouwen van de rijksoverheid geschikt kunnen worden gemaakt voor opvang van Afghanen of andere vluchtelingen ui

An MP asked whether the government would send a letter on how the adopted Van der Plas motion, to inventory state buildings usable for housing Afghan and other refugees, is being carried out. The State Secretary replied that the letter was sent on 12 November and that the motion is considered implemented, citing use of Defence barracks, offices and prisons, and a survey of state land and buildings.
We therefore consider this motion to be implemented.
Daarmee beschouwen wij deze motie als uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Omtzigt, Bikker, Kuzu, Pouw-Verweij en Van der Plas over eiwit-vaccins

MPs asked the health minister about people who want a protein-based COVID-19 vaccine, the cancellation or reduction of Sanofi and Novavax orders, and vaccine efficacy data. The minister said the government has no data on the size of this group, chose Novavax over Sanofi and bought fewer Novavax doses because mRNA vaccines were already sufficient, and gave efficacy figures while noting approval and procurement decisions rest with EMA and the Gezondheidsraad.
I therefore see no need to investigate this in further detail, but will ask the RIVM to keep paying attention to this in its monitoring.
Ik zie daarom geen noodzaak om dit in verder detail uit te zoeken, maar zal het RIVM vragen ook hier in de monitoring aandacht voor te blijven houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht: ‘Klimaatimpact Nederlandse veestapel fors overschat’

Van der Plas (BBB) asked whether IPCC findings on methane accounting (GWP* versus GWP100) require re-assessing the climate target for dairy and cattle farming, and how the government will act on a climate agreement passage about new insights benefiting the dairy sector. Minister Schouten answered that GWP* does not show cow impact is three to four times lower, that GWP100 remains the international standard, that any change would only follow after the IPCC cycle in 2022 and that no change to Dutch policy is currently at issue.
That is not currently at issue.
Dat is vooralsnog niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de inval in kalverslachterij Ekro door 269 Libération Animale

MP Van der Plas asked the Justice Minister about the September 2021 raid on veal slaughterhouse Ekro by 269 Libération Animale, including prior intelligence, whether the group should be classed as terrorist, and how such actions will be prevented. Minister Grapperhaus answered that no prior signals were received locally, that the actions are not terrorism under NCTV definitions, that existing tools will be used against lawbreaking, and that police and prosecutors have agreed a framework and closer information exchange with farm organisations.
I cannot make any statements about whether intelligence investigations are ongoing or not.
Over al dan niet lopende inlichtingenonderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het openbaar maken van gegevens op 16 juli 2021 in het kader van de WOB (Wet Openbaarheid van Bestuur) met als onderwerp Lelystad Airport

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality, on behalf of the Infrastructure Minister, why the legalisation of the Lelystad Airport PAS nitrogen notification was pursued despite flawed calculations, whether it is fair given the state's shareholding, and how good faith and fairness are assured, following WOB disclosures. The minister answered that the process follows statutory procedures, that the state as shareholder leaves operations to the company, that the nitrogen space is not from the Warme Sanering Varkenshouderij, and that good faith is presumed for all notifications; the minister answered all eleven questions but late.
It is a political decision to open the airport.
Het is een politiek besluit om het vliegveld te openen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over niet rijpe mais en de uiterste datum voor inzaaien van vanggewas

MP Van der Plas asks the minister about unripe maize, the harvest-maturity research and the 1 October deadline for sowing cover crops after maize, and whether an exemption will be granted this year. The minister confirms the signals, grants postponement of the sowing deadline on sandy and loess soils, defends the 1 October date on nitrogen-leaching grounds, and says the CDM advice shows unripe maize can raise methane emissions but that feeding it is not unacceptable for animal welfare.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ceder, Van der Werf en Van der Plas over het bericht dat er nieuw beleid is voor gezinshereniging waar de Kamer niet over geïnformeerd is

MPs Ceder, Van der Werf and Van der Plas asked whether the IND had quietly changed family reunification rules for unaccompanied minors, whether the Chamber was informed, and whether the change is compatible with EU law. The State Secretary replied that the IND's practice was an interpretation of 'alleenstaand' rather than a policy change, that the change was dropped after an inventory, and that affected cases will be re-examined individually.
Question 10: Are you willing to reverse the introduced policy immediately? If not, why not?
Vraag 10 Bent u bereid om het ingevoerde beleid per direct terug te draaien? Zo nee, waarom niet?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de toezending van gespreksverslagen van bijeenkomsten van de minister van Landbouw, of haar medewerkers, met de Europese Commissie

An MP asked the agriculture minister why she did not disclose that the European Commission had written a flash report on a 25 February 2021 meeting about the Wierdense Veld, and why minutes of Commission meetings are not sent to parliament promptly. The minister replied that no joint report of the meeting with the Commissioner existed, that she was unaware of an internal Commission email summary, and that minutes of official-level meetings fall outside the EU information agreements, though she pledged general information via letters and debates.
Conversation reports do not fall under those agreements, partly because the cabinet believes this does not benefit how the Netherlands deals with the Commission and other Member States
Gespreksverslagen vallen niet onder die afspraken, mede omdat dit naar de mening van het kabinet niet ten goede komt aan de omgang van Nederland met de Commissie en andere Lidstaten

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over berichten dat op meerdere plaatsen in Nederland, maar in ieder geval in de Achterhoek, West-Brabant en in Zeeland, het momenteel niet mogelijk is om binnen 30 minuten een

MP Van der Plas asks the health minister about closed Testen voor Toegang test sites in Zeeland, the Achterhoek and West-Brabant, the new per-test payment system, and how the 30-minute travel-time motion will be implemented. The minister says 99% of the population is now within 30 minutes of a test site, reopened sites in Renesse, Winterswijk and Roosendaal, and refuses to suspend CoronaCheck app enforcement.
This is no longer necessary. On 14 October a test location was opened in Terneuzen.
Dit is niet (meer) noodzakelijk. Op 14 oktober is er een testlocatie op Terneuzen geopend.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de EU Transportverordening (EG nr. 1/2005) met betrekking tot het vangen van kippen

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture about catching chickens by the legs under the EU transport regulation, including animal welfare, labour and the risk to supply if the practice stopped. The minister confirmed the practice is common in the EU, said she is pausing enforcement of the ban pending an EFSA opinion, and called the current method undesirable while committing to talks with the sector on gentler catching.
I would like to await this advice before deciding how to deal with the ban as it is currently worded in the transport regulation.
Ik wil dit advies graag afwachten voordat ik bepaal hoe om te gaan met het verbod zoals het nu in de transportverordening verwoord is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld, Van der Plas en Bikker over het bericht ‘coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking’

Three MPs asked the health minister how people who can neither be vaccinated nor tested will get a COVID access certificate, and why no route existed when certificates took effect on 25 September, despite a Bikker amendment. The minister answered that a three-week GGD Utrecht pilot started on 6 October to define the group and test a less burdensome method, with exemption certificates as the eventual fallback, and that the answers were late.
After the pilot ends, it will be evaluated on whether it has found a structural solution.
Na afloop van de pilot wordt deze geëvalueerd op de vraag of met de pilot een structurele oplossing is gevonden.
Antwoord  op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het rapport ‘Naar een ontspannen Nederland’

Member Van der Plas asked whether the report 'Naar een ontspannen Nederland' was financed by the minister, what its purpose was, who commissioned it, and whether further nitrogen-reduction research is planned. The minister confirmed a subsidy was granted to the authors on their own initiative, said no commission was issued, and listed existing nitrogen-reduction studies and demonstration projects.
As indicated, this report was not drafted on commission from the Ministry of LNV.
Zoals aangeduid is dit rapport niet in opdracht van het Ministerie van LNV opgesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de enorme woningnood van internationale studenten

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of the Interior about the severe housing shortage for (international) students, including reports of students sleeping in bus shelters, and whether emergency accommodation and better warning of international students were planned. The Minister acknowledged the shortage, pointed to local responsibility and existing measures such as temporary housing in several cities, and promised to update the national housing action plan with stakeholders and to talk again with universities about information for international students.
It is the responsibility of municipalities to ensure sufficient housing at local level.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om op lokaal niveau te zorgen voor voldoende huisvesting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over grote hobbypluimveehouderijen

An MP asked the minister whether hobby poultry keepers contribute to spreading bird flu, how many hobby keepers and screenings exist, and how awareness of registration duties can be raised. The minister answered that registration applies to flocks of 250 or more birds regardless of purpose, that hobby holdings are not separately identifiable, and that information outreach will be improved, without committing to new screening.
The number of hobby poultry farms is not known to RVO, because RVO only records locations with more than 250 birds.
Het aantal hobbypluimveehouderijen is bij RVO niet bekend, omdat bij RVO alleen locaties worden gemeld met meer dan 250 stuks pluimvee.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de aanpak van de N50, tussen Zwolle en Kampen (v.v.)

An MP from BBB asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why the N50 between Zwolle and Kampen has not been widened despite repeated motions and serious accidents, and what measures will improve safety. The minister answers that the project was cut in 2013 for budget reasons, is now stalled by nitrogen rules, that safety measures and a motion-based study are underway, and that answers could not be given by the requested date.

At present, the consequences of the cabinet decision on the maximum calculation distance for nitrogen calculations for the planning and capacity needs of this project and other projects are being mapped.

Op dit moment wordt in beeld gebracht wat de gevolgen van het kabinetsbesluit over de maximale rekenafstand bij stikstofberekeningen zijn voor de planning en capaciteitsbehoefte van dit project en andere projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Van der Plas over coronatoegangsbewijzen voor mensen met een meervoudige beperking

MPs Westerveld and Van der Plas asked whether people with multiple disabilities who can neither be vaccinated nor regularly tested have any route to a COVID certificate, and whether case-by-case solutions exist. The minister answered that no alternative route exists yet because the procedure is complex, that it would apply only to domestic use and not travel under EU rules, that the group is believed to be very small, and that a decision is aimed for autumn.
At this moment there is therefore still no route for people who cannot be vaccinated and cannot be tested.
Op dit moment is er dus nog geen route voor mensen die zich niet kunnen laten vaccineren en niet kunnen laten testen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas en Koerhuis over het op straat zetten van meerderjarige weeskinderen (en/of andere medebewoners van overleden familieleden of partners)

MPs Van der Plas and Koerhuis asked the Minister of the Interior about housing corporations evicting adult orphans and other co-residents after a family member's death, including a case in Enschede. The Minister answered that temporary tenancy contracts will be allowed via a regulation change expected around November, a code of conduct is planned by year end, further legal options are being explored, and corporations will be urged via Aedes to act humanely.

The Regulation on Admitted Housing Institutions is currently being amended so that housing corporations can offer these adult children a temporary lease, allowing them to stay longer in a social rental home.

Momenteel wordt daartoe de Regeling Toegelaten Instellingen Volkshuisvesting (RTIV) aangepast, zodat woningcorporaties deze meerderjarige kinderen een tijdelijk huurcontract aan kunnen bieden waardoor zij langer in een sociale huurwoning kunnen wonen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over afvalwaterberging van de Nederlandse Aardolie Maatschappij (NAM) in de gemeente Dinkelland, mede n.a.v. recente problemen geconstateerd in de opslaglocaties in Rossum, gem

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether NAM remains owner and liable for produced water injected into depleted gas fields in Twente, whether it will be recovered, who is liable for damage, whether emergency plans and baselines exist, and whether continuing is responsible given slow damage compensation. The minister answered that NAM remains owner and liable, that the injection is evaluated every six years and an earlier re-evaluation is planned, that no baseline measurements were taken but monitoring is in place, and that licensing followed the legal process.
NAM is liable for any damage arising from storing produced water in depleted gas fields.
NAM is aansprakelijk voor eventuele schade van het bergen van productiewater in uitgeproduceerde gasvelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de lopende bestelling van Scania vrachtwagens door Defensie en het doorwadingsvermogen van deze voertuigen

Member Van der Plas asked why Defence ordered 2,473 Scania Gryphus trucks with only 75 cm wading capacity, and why only 73 have 150 cm, given the need for flood evacuations, and whether the order will be adjusted. The Minister replied that the ordered trucks serve operational roles for the first and second main tasks, that about 115 have 150 cm wading capacity mainly for amphibious operations, that they can be used for evacuations when conditions allow, and that no change to the order is planned.
No, Defence is receiving with the Scania Gryphus from the subproject Vehicles 50kN, 100kN, 150kN vehicles that fit within the new wheeled vehicle fleet
Nee, Defensie krijgt met de Scania Gryphus uit het deelproject Voertuigen 50kN, 100kN, 150kN voertuigen die passen binnen het nieuwe wielvoertuigenbestand
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de recente vacature voor een beleidsmedewerker op het ministerie

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the Minister of LNV, through 21 questions, about a ministry job advertisement that framed agriculture and nature as clashing, cited Commissioner Timmermans, and omitted agriculture and fisheries knowledge requirements. The minister answered every question, defending the advertisement's wording, stating that agriculture and fisheries remain important, and admitting the ministry does not record staff agricultural backgrounds.
It is not known how many employees have a demonstrable and practical background in agriculture and/or fisheries.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel medewerkers een aantoonbare en praktische achtergrond hebben in de landbouw en/of visserij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Plas, Van der Staaij en Segers over de zoektocht naar Samuël Boujadi

Three MPs asked the Foreign Minister why Italian authorities searched inadequately for missing Dutch national Samuël Boujadi, whether the ministry would support further searches or reimburse the family's search costs, and what it would do to help recovery of his body. The minister answered that Italian authorities have jurisdiction and say they searched longer than usual, that the Netherlands cannot intervene without invitation, that specific assistance was offered but not used, and that no reimbursement was promised.
The Netherlands may not and cannot interfere in investigation and legal proceedings in another state without an invitation or permission.
Nederland mag en kan zich niet zonder uitnodiging c.q. toestemming mengen in de opsporing en rechtsgang in een andere staat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Rechtelijke uitspraak maakt van natuurvoorzorgsprincipe het verlammingsprincipe’

MP Van der Plas (BBB) asked the minister whether a court ruling on the Natura 2000 precautionary principle, which found the province of Drenthe had not sufficiently shown that drainage and pesticide use posed no significant risk, would make ordinary farm and household activities subject to permits and whether the precautionary principle should be amended. The minister answered that the case is ongoing on appeal, that the rule only applies to activities with significant harmful effects, and that the precautionary principle derives from the EU Habitats Directive and case law, so no amendment is planned.
It befits me to await the continuation of this concrete legal proceeding before I can arrive at an interpretation of this issue
Het past mij om het vervolg van deze concrete rechtsgang af te wachten, voordat ik tot een interpretatie van deze kwestie kan komen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over uitrijtermijn voor vaste mest en drijfmest in respectievelijk Limburg en Friesland

An MP asked the minister about manure spreading deadlines in Limburg and Friesland after heavy rain, including extending the solid manure period on loess and making it match the slurry period. The minister confirmed awareness, requested Technical Soil Commission advice on a Limburg extension, deferred structural changes to the Nitrates Directive action programme, and granted a regional slurry exemption in ten Frisian municipalities until 15 September 2021.

Exemption or extension of the spreading period can under the Soil Protection Act only be granted insofar as the interest of soil protection does not oppose it and advice has been requested from the Technical Soil Commission (TCB).

Vrijstelling of het verruimen van de uitrijdperiode kan op basis van de Wet bodembescherming alleen worden verleend voor zover het belang van de bescherming van de bodem zich daartegen niet verzet en er advies gevraagd is bij de Technische Commissie Bodem (TCB).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het eisen van vaccinatiebewijzen door ondernemers en andere organisaties

An MP asked the health minister whether private businesses demanding vaccination certificates for entry amounts to vaccination pressure, whether this is lawful and consistent with fundamental rights, and whether the government's goals and inclusion of the unvaccinated are still sound. The minister answered that vaccination is voluntary, that private parties may not request vaccination certificates under the temporary Covid access-pass law, that the rights concerned can be limited proportionately, and that the courts will judge private businesses' justifications case by case.
I refer you to my answer to question 6.
Ik verwijs u naar mijn antwoord op vraag 17.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Wijngaarden, Piri, Bromet, Belhaj , Teunissen, Kuzu, Dassen, Van der Plas, Leijten , Jasper van Dijk, Simons, Boswijk, Stoffer en Ceder over de evacuatie in Afghanistan

MPs asked the Defence and Foreign Affairs ministers whether the Netherlands would send soldiers to collect evacuees in Kabul and bring them past Taliban checkpoints to the airport, and how the Dutch evacuation would be carried out given the rising number of Dutch nationals in Afghanistan. The ministers replied that the government is doing everything to evacuate the priority groups, that extra special forces have arrived, and that operational details cannot be disclosed for security reasons.
In the interest of the safety of our soldiers, diplomats and evacuees, and so as not to endanger the operation, the cabinet cannot make further detailed statements about this.
In het belang van de veiligheid van onze militairen, diplomaten en de evacués en om de operatie niet in gevaar te brengen kan het kabinet hier verder geen gedetailleerde uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het artikel ‘Stikstofstrijder Johan Vollenbroek: provincie moet boeren zonder vergunning aanpakken’

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about a newspaper report urging provinces to act against farmers operating without permits, and about the legalisation of PAS-melders and interim-mers whose activities were allowed under previous rules. The minister replied that legalisation was not postponed indefinitely, that talks with provinces on interim-mers are underway, and that there will be no active enforcement by competent authorities while legalisation proceeds.
At the same time I have indicated that there will be no active enforcement by the competent authorities.
Tegelijkertijd heb ik aangegeven dat er geen actieve handhaving plaats zal vinden door de bevoegde gezagen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Schade na brand Noardburgum groot, nog veel onduidelijk over zonnepaneeldeeltjes’

An MP from BBB asks the minister about the lack of a protocol for cleaning up solar panel debris after a fire in Noardburgum, insurance coverage of clean-up costs, and government support for affected businesses. The state secretary answers that research by IFV and RIVM is ongoing, that a panel protocol is one option pending results, that insurance coverage varies by policy, and that financing is primarily an insurer liability matter, with a promise to inform parliament after the summer.
If the ongoing research shows that an additional protocol for cleaning up deposits from solar panel fires is needed, I will consider what follow-up steps may be necessary.

Indien uit de lopende onderzoeken blijkt dat een aanvullend protocol voor het opruimen van de depositie bij branden met zonnepanelen nodig is, zal ik bezien welke eventueel vervolgstappen hiervoor nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over de berichten ‘Rechtspraak nodig over blinde vlekken 112-bereikbaarheid’ en ‘Conclusies onderzoek mobiel bereik niet meer bruikbaar’

An MP asked the minister about news reports on blind spots in 112 emergency call reachability and the liability if citizens cannot reach 112 due to poor coverage, and about what government does toward full coverage. The state secretary pointed to broadband and mobile coverage maps, a forthcoming coverage map and consultation, liability as a matter for the parties and civil courts, and existing measures such as 112 calling via any network and WiFi calling.

Because it is in the first instance a matter for the parties involved, and in the second instance for the civil court, it is neither possible nor desirable for me to answer this hypothetical question concretely.

Omdat het in eerste instantie aan betrokken partijen is, en in tweede instantie aan de civiele rechter, is het voor mij niet mogelijk noch wenselijk om deze hypothetische vraag concreet te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte’

Rep. Van der Plas (BBB) asked the ministers of Interior and Agriculture about the PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte', questioning its omissions on food production, its treatment of farmland, housing targets, solar and wind land claims, and datacenter space. The ministers answered that the PBL is independent, that the report takes existing policy as its baseline, and that the housing figure derives from the National Environmental Vision and Primos projections.
The PBL report 'Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte' focuses on the spatial choices the new cabinet must make.
Het PBL-rapport «Grote opgaven in een beperkte ruimte» richt zich op de ruimtelijke keuzes die het nieuwe kabinet moet maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Plas over stikstofreductie en natuurherstel

An MP from BBB asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about nitrogen reduction and nature restoration, including whether groundwater levels rather than nitrogen deposition explain habitat losses, whether there is enough evidence to make critical deposition values a binding result obligation in law, whether a cost-benefit analysis was made, and how the policy relates to global land demand. The minister answered that groundwater is not the explaining factor at the Wageningen site, that an integrated approach is needed, that the critical deposition values rest on scientific and EU-law requirements without a cost-benefit analysis, and that the Dutch agricultural area is used efficiently.
That is why an integrated approach is very important, as has already taken place in the past and is being continued with the Nature Programme.
Daarom is een integrale aanpak heel belangrijk, zoals dat in het verleden al heeft plaatsgevonden en wordt voortgezet met het Programma Natuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van der Plas over het bericht ‘Slachtoffers bloedbad Alphen aan den Rijn strijden na 10 jaar nog altijd om schadevergoeding’

An MP asks the Justice Minister why compensation for victims of the Alphen aan den Rijn shooting is so slow, with only 19 claims settled after the Supreme Court ruling, and what will speed it up. The minister answers that the police and insurer's foundation VSSA handle claims, that 32 cases are now settled of 71 registered, that incomplete dossiers from some victims' representatives cause the delay, and that talks with those representatives are planned with escalation if no breakthrough follows.

The minister acknowledged the report, agreed culture should be accessible to all, described existing museum initiatives and subsidies, and said a subsidy scheme and a knowledge point on accessible culture are being developed, without a count of museums with tactile art.
The exact number of museums that already offer tactile art and other initiatives to make museums more accessible for people with disabilities is not known.
Het exacte aantal musea waarin al sprake is van voelbare kunst en andere initiatieven om musea toegankelijker te maken voor mensen met een beperking is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Veltman over het artikel “Dankzij Marcus (67) kunnen blinden hier veilig oversteken”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a tactile edge marking installed at a rail crossing in Vught for blind and visually impaired pedestrians, and whether such guidance lines should be extended nationally and prioritised near schools and stations. The minister answered that the Vught marking is a temporary, non-standard measure whose effectiveness is still being assessed, that no nationwide extension is planned, and that municipalities are primarily responsible for accessible public space.
For the time being there are no plans to take such measures at more locations.
Voorlopig zijn er geen plannen om op meer locaties dergelijke maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bikkers en De Kort over het artikel ‘Gemeente Amsterdam gaat groep bijstandsgezinnen ‘zomaar’ extra geld geven’

MPs Bikkers and De Kort asked the State Secretary about Amsterdam giving unconditional monthly gifts to welfare families in a Kansfonds research project, questioning fairness, the Participatiewet, and the Gemeentewet. The State Secretary answered that the research fits within Participatiewet limits, is privately funded, is temporary, and that the government wants simpler municipal poverty schemes while noting gifts up to EUR 1,200 per year may be exempted.
Because the municipality of Amsterdam does not pay out the gift and the gift is part of a temporary study, there is no question of income policy.
Doordat gemeente Amsterdam de gift niet uitkeert en de gift onderdeel is van een tijdelijk onderzoek, is er geen sprake van inkomenspolitiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de Duitse “Ergebnisse der Sondierungen von CDU, CSU und SPD”

The MP asks how the Dutch government would ensure fast, priority support to work for benefit recipients able to work, whether recipients who refuse work are identifiable and face consequences, and how it views German plans to cut benefits for repeated work refusal. The State Secretary answers that municipalities are responsible for implementing the Participatiewet, points to existing reintegration measures and pending bills, and states that a 100% benefit reduction for refusal already exists, so the German-style measure would have little additional effect.
For everyone under the Participatiewet who is not exempt from work obligations, there is an obligation to make efforts to find, accept and keep generally accepted work.

Voor iedereen die valt onder de Participatiewet en die niet is vrijgesteld van de arbeidsverplichtingen, geldt dat men zich moet inspannen om algemeen geaccepteerde arbeid te vinden, te aanvaarden en te behouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over Wereldstotterdag

An MP asked the cabinet about stuttering in the labour market, including a reported case of a UWV Werkbedrijf job-seeker told not to stutter, the banenafspraak target group register, and public campaigns. The government acknowledged the difficulties, pointed to a broader equal-opportunities approach, a future vision for the banenafspraak, the Whispp speech technology pilot, and no planned public campaigns.
At this moment there are no planned public campaigns.
Op dit moment zijn er geen voorgenomen publiekscampagnes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het rapport 'Re-integratiedienstverlening in het kader van de Participatiewet'

An MP from the VVD asked the State Secretary about the Labour Inspectorate report on re-integration services under the Participation Act, including high caseloads, the role of private parties, and data sharing with employers. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible and free in their priorities, acknowledged caseload pressures, pointed to ongoing measures such as the banenafspraak and sheltered work funding, and said the VUM data programme will be reported on in the next Stand van de Uitvoering.
I inform you periodically about the progress of VUM via the Stand van de Uitvoering, most recently on 22 January 2024.
Ik informeer u periodiek over de voortgang van VUM via de Stand van de Uitvoering, voor het laatst op 22 januari 2024.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Becker over de nieuwe vo-school van Soner Atasoy

MPs De Kort and Becker asked about the new secondary school founded by Soner Atasoy despite his dismissal as board member of Cornelis Haga Lyceum and AIVD warnings, and about the criteria for school board eligibility, the Tilburg Islamic school, and the 15 km catchment area. The Staatssecretaris answered that Atasoy met all legal requirements, announced a bill to set stricter board requirements for all boards, and deferred structural changes (such as municipal consent rights) until the evaluation of the new founding law at the end of 2025.
My ministry is currently working on a bill that sets further requirements for school boards.
Momenteel werkt mijn ministerie aan een wetsvoorstel waarin nadere eisen worden gesteld aan schoolbesturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht ‘BKR brengt vele duizenden mensen in problemen door ze onterecht te registreren als wanbetaler’

An MP asked the government about reports that BKR credit registrations wrongly label people as payment defaulters, and whether people can easily get negative registrations removed. The minister answered that BKR registrations have no binding legal status, that the government does not use them in its dealings with citizens, that a Wet stelsel kredietregistratie is in preparation, and that BKR and lenders must weigh removal requests case by case under the GDPR while the minister will discuss the refusal practice with BKR.
The register is currently managed by the private foundation BKR without any statutory rules on its management and supervision.
Het register wordt nu beheerd door de private stichting BKR zonder dat over het beheer en toezicht daarop wettelijk iets is geregeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martens-America en De Kort over het artikel 'Havo-leerlingen stappen vaker over naar het mbo'

MPs Martens-America and De Kort asked about rising numbers of havo students leaving secondary school without a diploma for mbo vocational training, and whether basic skills and startkwalificatie are secured. The minister answers that numbers have risen, that the trend is largely positive, that basic skills plans and a planned study on the beroepshavo are underway, and that a tracking study shows 85% of such transfers obtained an mbo diploma.
In the autumn I will commission a study to gain insight into this.
Ik zal in het najaar een onderzoek uitzetten om hier zicht op te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het artikel 'Prostitutie, drugs en vechtpartijen: meer heftige incidenten op middelbare scholen'

The MP De Kort asks the minister for Primary and Secondary Education about rising severe safety incidents at secondary schools, including causes, whether schools' tools are adequate, longer suspensions or expulsions, mandatory reporting to police, locker checks, police presence, data sharing, and reporting. The minister answers that school safety is unacceptable and points to the forthcoming Wetsvoorstel vrij en veilig onderwijs and a letter before summer, declining mandatory suspension changes, a mandatory reporting duty, and routine locker rotation while promising a letter and some reporting.
In this short timeframe it is not possible to gain insight into this.
Op deze korte termijn lukt het niet om hier inzicht in te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘hoe wenselijk zijn islamitische scholen?’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister for Primary and Secondary Education whether Islamic schools' rules (gender-segregated classes, pop-music ban, resilience training against LGBTIQ+ ideology) fit the civic-education duty, and how the inspectorate checks this. The minister says segregation and such teaching are not desirable but are allowed under conditions, that the inspectorate supervises the civic-education duty, and that no talks with schools are currently needed.
The inspectorate will investigate the named schools further if it sees reason to do so.
De inspectie zal nader onderzoek doen naar de genoemde scholen, als zij daar aanleiding toe ziet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het bericht 'Turkse sekte met tweeëntwintig moskee-internaten stapt nu in scholen'

MPs Becker and De Kort asked about reports that a Turkish religious movement with boarding schools was entering mainstream schools in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, raising concerns about civic integration, founder backgrounds, oversight of the approval process and boarding houses. The government answered that the schools meet all legal founding requirements and may open in August 2024, that inspectorates monitor civic education, that it can refuse applications where concrete signals exist, but that no such signals were received, and that the boarding-house oversight and the planned informal-education bill are being maintained.
The powers to investigate persons and/or civil society organisations are not vested in the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Social Affairs and Employment, and Health, Welfare and Sport.

De bevoegdheden om onderzoek te doen naar personen en/of maatschappelijke organisaties zijn niet belegd bij de Ministeries van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) en Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en De Kort over het artikel “Dit is de extreem-conservatieve club die zich ook dit jaar verzet tegen lessen over seks”

Two VVD MPs asked the Education Minister whether pressure by Civitas Christiana on schools to avoid sex-education material (Rutgers) is unacceptable, whether schools are obliged to teach respect for sexual diversity, and whether the government will monitor and act. The minister called the pressure undesirable and misleading, said schools are free to choose materials and reported no known cases of schools dropping them, but stated that the ministries have no legal basis to investigate or ban such organisations and offered support and a newsletter instead.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de stille reserve in het onderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Primary and Secondary Education about reports of a teacher shortage 'stille reserve' of at least 6,000 people, why many qualified teachers left, how many left after short periods, and what is being done to bring them back. The minister answered that teacher retention and return are being addressed through salary increases, workload funds, the professionalisation agenda, regional education partnerships and reports on reasons for leaving, but gave no new commitments beyond existing policy.
Question 4: How many people with a teaching qualification no longer work as teachers but do work in a role related to education?
Vraag 4 Hoeveel mensen met een lesbevoegdheid werken niet meer als leraar, maar wel in een functie rondom het onderwijs?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Bevers over "initiatieven met software die gesproken taal real-time omzet naar geschreven tekst”

MPs De Kort and Bevers asked why speech-to-text software such as Speaksee is not reimbursed for hearing-impaired workers, and about savings, interpreter shortages and access to aids. The minister acknowledges an omission in the Reïntegratiebesluit and intends to amend it so UWV can provide such aids in the interim.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Minhas over het bericht 'Intercity Eindhoven-Aken loopt mogelijk vertraging op 2025 zeer ambitieus'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary whether a direct Intercity Eindhoven-Aken is feasible by 2025 or December 2024 in the off-peak hours, why the €125 million budget falls short, and what the economic and accessibility consequences of delay are. The State Secretary answers that the December 2024 off-peak introduction is still the target but is very ambitious, outlines the remaining steps, names an extra ~€920 million need for Eindhoven station works, and says he will inform parliament in early 2024 on the structural variant.
This is why I indicated in my letter to the House of Representatives of 5 October that the aim of introduction by December 2024 is very ambitious.
Dit maakt dat ik in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer op 5 oktober jl. heb aangegeven dat het streven naar introductie per december 2024 zeer ambitieus is.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden De Kort en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Utrecht wil parkeerkosten voor lage inkomens vergoeden, ook als ze geen auto hebben'

MPs De Kort and Koerhuis asked whether Utrecht's plan to compensate low-income U-pas holders for paid parking, including those without a car, is proportionate, redistributive, or an indirect form of income policy. The minister replied that parking and minima policy fall within municipal competence, that the mobility budget was raised for all U-pas holders because the law does not allow distinguishing car owners, and that no national enforcement is planned.
It falls within the competence of municipalities to make independent considerations and choices regarding parking policy.
Het valt binnen de bevoegdheid van gemeenten om op het gebied van parkeerbeleid eigenstandige afwegingen en keuzes te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht 'Na Zaanstad start ook Tilburg proef met 'gratis geld' voor 150 bijstandsgezinnen'

An MP asked the Minister for Poverty Policy whether Zaanstad and Tilburg's pilots giving 150 euro monthly gifts to benefit families, funded by the private Kansfonds, breach the Participatiewet and undermine work incentives. The minister replied that the gifts are private, municipalities may disregard gifts case by case under existing rules, and a planned 1,200 euro yearly gift exemption will be introduced.
So it is not the municipality that makes a gift, and there is therefore no question of active income policy by the municipality in this case.
Het is dus niet de gemeente die een gift doet en er is dus ook geen sprake van actieve inkomenspolitiek door de gemeente in dit geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smals en De Kort over het artikel 'Stijging ziekteverzuim in 2022 naar 5,6%: hoogste ooit'

MPs Smals and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick-leave rising to 5.6% in 2022, its link to labour shortages, SME support, WIA/IVA inflows and cooperation with occupational physicians and UWV. The minister answered that the rise is mainly driven by COVID and flu rather than work, that prevention is primarily employers' responsibility supported by government schemes, and that the government is working on WIA backlogs and reintegration, without introducing structural changes to executive oversight.
This high sick-leave figure is worrying.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Strien en De Kort over het artikel ‘Ondertiteling voor slechthorenden ontbreekt vaak: Vorm van uitsluiting’

MPs Van Strien and De Kort asked whether the minimum subtitling norms for deaf and hard-of-hearing viewers, set fifteen years ago, are still adequate and why streaming services and commercial broadcasters do not disclose their share of subtitled content. The State Secretary replied that existing quotas and a new progress-reporting duty from July 2022 should suffice, that the Commissariaat oversees compliance, and that talks with streamers and the sector will follow.
For media services not under Dutch jurisdiction there is no legal basis to provide access to this information.
Voor mediadiensten die niet onder de Nederlandse jurisdictie vallen is er geen wettelijke grondslag om inzage in deze informatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over “het artikel ‘Utrecht zet versoepeld bijstandsregime voor jongeren voort, 'geen aanzuigende werking'’

An MP asks the Minister of Poverty Policy, Participation and Pensions about Utrecht's relaxed welfare regime for young people, which waives the four-week job-search requirement, and whether it encourages dependence. The Minister answers that the four-week rule is ineffective for many young people with multiple problems, that the Participatiewet targets participation, and that she is discussing the Utrecht case with the municipality and planning a 'kan'-provision allowing municipalities discretion.
I am in discussion with the municipality to get a better picture of the target group that benefits from not applying the four-week job-search period.
Ik ben met de gemeente in gesprek om een beter beeld te krijgen van de doelgroep die juist baat heeft bij het buiten toepassing laten van de vierweken zoekperiode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over het bericht 'UWV ontdekt Slowaakse fraude met ziekte-uitkeringen'

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported fraud with sickness benefits by Slovak workers, including staffing shortages at UWV, recovery of overpaid benefits abroad, and enforcement of benefit exports. The minister answered that there is no established link to doctor shortages, that about 94 benefits (over EUR 200,000) are being reviewed and recovered, that cooperation with partner agencies exists and a Fraud Council was set up, and that enforcement of exported benefits is being pursued at EU level.
UWV contacted the benefit recipients concerned to request additional information and summon them for examination by a doctor.
UWV heeft met de desbetreffende uitkeringsgerechtigden contact gezocht om aanvullende informatie op te vragen en ze op te roepen voor controle door een arts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Kort en Smals over het artikel 'Tien jaar stilstand reden recordkrapte'

Two VVD MPs asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Poverty, Participation and Pensions about labour shortages and how to get people with a distance from the labour market or older workers into work, including the no-risk policy, employer support points, the labour market infrastructure, dismissal and sick-pay rules, and cao provisions. The ministers answered that the government is pursuing employer incentives, a pilot for a no-risk policy, a regional 'Werkcentrum' plan due by summer 2023, and further reports on flexible contracts and sick-pay reform, while declining to give some figures yet.
In recent years, since the jobs agreement, there has been a lot of attention to the importance of hiring people with a disability.
Er is de afgelopen jaren, sinds de banenafspraak, veel aandacht geweest voor het belang van het aannemen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over de naleving van de banenafspraak door het Rijk

The MP De Kort (VVD) asked the Minister of Interior Affairs about large differences among ministries in meeting the Banenafspraak quota for people with a work disability, the sharing of effective methods, shared responsibility, inclusive employment, monitoring compliance with Social Return contract requirements, the planned network organisation, and accessibility of ICT tools. The minister answered that ministries are responsible for their own quotas, that a central financing arrangement and a Social Return network organisation are planned, that monitoring of contract compliance will be set up as a first action, and that accessibility improvements are underway, with full compliance expected by end 2023.
No monitoring has been set up for compliance with contract requirements.
Voor de naleving van contracteisen is geen monitoring ingericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Kort over ‘Gokken in casino leidt minder snel tot terugvordering volledige bijstandsuitkering’

An MP asks the minister about a court ruling that gambling winnings by welfare recipients need not lead to full benefit recovery, and about gambling-related debt among welfare recipients. The minister says the courts' judgment is not for her to assess, that no data exist on recoveries for gambling, and that gambling protections (limits, CRUKS self-exclusion) exist but municipalities cannot register gambling welfare recipients for privacy reasons.
Figures on this are not available. Municipalities do not record the reason for recovery at such a detailed level.
Cijfers op dit vlak zijn niet beschikbaar. Gemeenten registreren de reden van terugvordering niet op een dergelijk gedetailleerd niveau.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Van der Woude en De Kort over het artikel 'Minister Schouten wil terugkeer schooltandarts'

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers of health and of education about a news report that the minister wanted to bring back the school dentist, and about dentist shortages and the plans for children's dental care. The government answered that it is consulting dental organisations on a plan to increase children's dental visits, that preventive measures beyond school dentists are also being considered, and that a letter on dental care will follow by early October 2022.

I will explain the proposals for measures to encourage visits to the dental care provider in my letter on dental care, which I will send to the House of Representatives by early October 2022 at the latest.
Ik zal de voorstellen voor maatregelen om het bezoek aan de mondzorgverlener te stimuleren, toelichten in mijn brief over mondzorg die ik uiterlijk begin oktober 2022 aan de Tweede Kamer zal sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Becker en De Kort over het bericht ‘Rotterdam geeft statushouders baan: ‘Rijk moet ook bijspringen.’

MPs Becker and De Kort asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Rotterdam's plan to give asylum-status holders (statushouders) jobs through learn-work tracks and whether the national government should contribute. The minister explains that Rotterdam's tracks give regular employment rather than subsidised jobs, that the 23 participants at the municipality all moved into jobs, and that funding and sector-matching options are being explored, while the ministry will share lessons and join local follow-up talks.
