Om deze reden is het belangrijk dat dergelijke voorvallen ook kunnen worden voorgelegd aan het College van de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla, Belhaj en Kuzu over het artikel 'Racisme duwt medewerkers uit de ouderenzorg'

MPs Sahla, Belhaj and Kuzu asked ministers about a NRC article saying racism pushes care workers out of elderly care, and about the scale of discrimination, its effect on health and sickness absence, and what government and care providers are doing. The ministers answered that discrimination is recognised but insufficiently addressed by employers, cited survey data, described existing Arbo duties and support tools, and announced a national study in 2023 and a progress letter in autumn 2023.
The Ministry of VWS intends to start a nationwide study in 2023 into discrimination and equal opportunities in care, welfare and sport.
Het Ministerie van VWS wil in 2023 een landelijk onderzoek starten naar discriminatie en gelijk kansen in de zorg, welzijn en sport.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over kleinschalige zorg voor ouderen

An MP (Sahla, D66) asked the minister about reports on small-scale care for older people, the gap between home care and nursing-home care, and the role of specialist elderly-care physicians. The minister acknowledged the access problems, pointed to planned sector agreements on general medical care and a pending NZa tariff advice, and said no extra powers for the IGJ or NZa are needed.
To better align the care supply within small-scale housing initiatives with clients' care needs, it is not necessary to grant the IGJ and NZa additional powers.
Om het zorgaanbod binnen kleinschalige wooninitiatieven beter te laten aansluiten op de zorgvraag van cliënten is het niet nodig om extra bevoegdheden toe te kennen aan de IGJ en NZa.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulusma en Sahla over de Verliezen in de wijkverpleging

MPs Paulusma and Sahla ask the minister about financial losses in district nursing (wijkverpleging), the NZa's view that the situation is worrying, contracting by insurers, budget underspending and staff sickness. The minister acknowledges sector pressure, points to IZA agreements including a 600 million euro downward adjustment and extra insurer revenue commitments for 2023, and says some data (tariffs, sector-specific sickness and deficit analysis) is not available yet.
I will closely monitor these agreements made in the IZA.
Ik zal deze afspraken die in het IZA gemaakt zijn nauwgezet volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over werving en behoud van pedagogisch medewerkers in de kinderopvang in relatie tot personeelsgebrek en opleiding

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about staff shortages in childcare, part-time hours, training, EVC recognition, VOG screening, administrative burden and GGD inspections. The minister acknowledged the shortages, outlined measures such as working-hours projects, combination jobs, the STAP budget and extended in-training staffing rules, and promised further studies and evaluation follow-up.
How many employees work part-time is not known.
Hoeveel medewerkers parttime werken is niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Bikker over het PGB

MPs Sahla and Bikker asked the Minister for Long-term Care why small-scale residential initiatives that function as care in kind are no longer structurally eligible for personal budgets (PGB), and how this affects beneficiaries' self-direction. The Minister defends the policy as aimed at budget holders who truly self-direct, says the government will work with care offices on contracting while keeping PGB where self-direction is real, and promises further consultation and a self-direction checklist.
My ambition for the PGB in residential initiatives starts from the perspective of the client.
Mijn ambitie met het pgb in wooninitiatieven start vanuit het perspectief van de cliënt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over de verschillen in wet- en regelgeving voor en de kwaliteit van kinderopvang en basisonderwijs

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the differences in rules and quality between childcare and primary education, covering cooperation, staffing, screening (VOG), inspection by GGD and the Inspectorate, ventilation standards and curriculum. The minister's answers describe existing cooperation initiatives, separate screening profiles under review, shared GGD and Inspectorate oversight of early education, and commitments to explore joint guidance and better alignment.
The Ministries of OCW and SZW are examining the possibility and desirability of aligning the screening.
De Ministeries van OCW en SZW onderzoeken de mogelijkheid en wenselijkheid om de screening op elkaar af te stemmen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over de rol van kinderopvang in het integraal huisvestingsplan van gemeenten

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the growing cooperation between primary education and childcare, such as integrated child centres, and about aligning rules and housing for these shared buildings in municipal housing plans. The minister acknowledges the benefits, notes a handbook is being prepared with ministries and partners on overcoming legal and financial obstacles, and says childcare housing will be considered in municipal integrated housing plans.
My ministry is continuously in discussion with the parties to the housing handbook, including the municipalities.
Mijn ministerie is doorlopend in gesprek met de partijen van de handreiking over huisvesting, onder andere de gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sahla over het op straat zetten van alleenstaande gezinnen

An MP asked the state secretary about single-parent families being left homeless due to municipal housing allocation policies and whether child-protection measures are used as pressure. The government answered that housing allocation is decentralised, housing shortages are the underlying cause, child-protection measures cannot be based on housing problems alone, and a study on urgency allocation by housing corporations is underway.
This is not known. This is not registered as such.
Dit is niet bekend. Dit wordt niet als zodanig geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sahla en Paulusma over de inzet van tolken in de jeugdzorg

Two D66 MPs asked the State Secretary of Health about children interpreting for parents in youth care, the funding gap for interpreters under the Jeugdwet compared with mental health care, and risks to fact-finding in child protection cases. The State Secretary acknowledged that child interpreting is undesirable in serious cases, said no signals of children being refused or parents being excluded are known, and announced a study on interpreter funding due before summer.
No extensive investigation has been carried out in response to the questions you ask in questions 6 to 9.
Er is geen uitgebreid onderzoek gedaan naar aanleiding van de vragen die u stelt in de vragen 6 tot en met 9.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Sahla over het gescheiden plaatsen van broers en zussen na een uithuisplaatsing

An MP asks the government about the separate placement of siblings after out-of-home placement, citing a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and asks about effects, registration, WODC research, pleeggezin shortages, legal anchoring and the position of foster parents. The minister answers that about 28% of sibling groups in the sample were placed separately, that this is not registered, that a report and a policy response by 1 April 2022 are promised, and that the legal anchoring question is being explored.
By 1 April 2022 the House will receive a letter in which I, on behalf of the State Secretary for VWS, will inform the House how we will follow up on the recommendations of the research report.

Uiterlijk 1 april 2022 ontvangt uw Kamer een brief waarin ik, mede namens de Staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (VWS), de Kamer zal informeren over de wijze waarop we opvolging gaan geven aan de aanbevelingen van het onderzoeksrapport.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over uitwerken hoe flankerend beleid kan worden vormgegeven zodat het uitdaagrecht ook in de praktijk goed uit de verf komt
Asks the government, with local government and citizen bodies, to work out supporting policy so that citizens' right to challenge (uitdaagrecht) local government works in practice.

requests the government, in consultation with VNG, IPO, the Union of Water Boards, public bodies and citizen organisations, to work out how supporting policy can be shaped so the right to challenge works in practice

verzoekt de regering om in samenspraak met VNG, IPO, de Unie van Waterschappen, de openbare lichamen, het LSA, het Landelijk Samenwerkingsverband Actieve bewoners, de LVKK, de Landelijke Vereniging voor Kleine Kernen, en de vertegenwoordigers van de jongerenraden uit te werken hoe flankerend beleid kan worden vormgegeven
Motie van het lid Hans Teunissen c.s. over het recht op begrijpelijke taal en duidelijke uitleg van besluiten vastleggen in de wet
Asks the government to legally establish a right to understandable language and clear explanation of government decisions.
to legally establish the right to understandable language and clear explanation of decisions
het recht op begrijpelijke taal en duidelijke uitleg van besluiten wettelijk vast te leggen
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. over middelen voor ProDemos
Amendment shifts budget within the departmental budget under Public Administration and Democracy to fund ProDemos activities for youth in regions outside The Hague.
Therefore the submitters make funds available for ProDemos through this amendment
Daarom stellen indieners met dit amendement middelen beschikbaar voor ProDemos
Amendement van het lid Sneller c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 17 over middelen voor ProDemos
Shifts funds within the budget of the Openbaar bestuur en democratie article to give ProDemos money for civic education activities across regions.
the submitters make funds available to ProDemos with this amendment
stellen indieners met dit amendement middelen beschikbaar voor ProDemos
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 11 over facultatieve bindende correctieve referenda voor decentrale overheden
Amends the constitutional provision so that binding corrective referendums for provincial and municipal decisions are set by local ordinance rather than by national law.
This amendment removes in this context the possibility that by law it can be determined that no binding referendums are possible on certain decentralised decisions
Dit amendement schrapt in dit kader de mogelijkheid dat bij wet kan worden bepaald dat over bepaalde decentrale besluiten geen bindende referenda mogelijk kunnen worden gemaakt
Amendement van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over facultatieve bindende correctieve referenda voor provincies en gemeenten
Lets provinces and municipalities decide by ordinance whether to allow binding corrective referendums, instead of national law setting exceptions.
This amendment provides that municipalities and provinces are free to decide themselves by ordinance whether their decisions can be subject to a binding referendum.
Dit amendement regelt dat aan gemeenten en provincies de vrijheid toekomt om zelf wel of niet bij verordening te bepalen dat hun besluiten aan een bindend referendum kunnen worden onderworpen.
Amendement Van der Graaf en Chris Simons over een uitkomstdrempel
Replaces the turnout threshold for binding referendums with a requirement that yes-votes reach a majority of valid votes cast in the latest elections, making referendums harder to succeed.
at least equal to a majority of the number of valid votes cast in the most recent elections of Tweede Kamer members
ten minste gelijk is aan een meerderheid van het aantal bij de meest recente verkiezingen van de leden van de Tweede Kamer uitgebrachte geldige stemmen
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Van Strien over het artikel 'Bevrijdingsfestival Utrecht gaat voor het eerst in 30 jaar niet door'

MPs Chris Simons and Van Strien asked the State Secretaries about the cancellation of the Utrecht Liberation Festival, the value of commemorating liberation, and financial support for liberation festivals. The government answered that the festivals are decentrally organised, that it sees no central role, that it advised talks with provinces and municipalities, and that talks with the National Committee and the VFonds on solutions are still ongoing.
Since the liberation festivals are organised decentrally, I see no role for central government in finding a solution.
Aangezien de bevrijdingsfestivals decentraal georganiseerd worden, zie ik geen rol vanuit het Rijk weggelegd om tot een oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hil, Ellian en Chris Simons over het artikel ‘Claims Conference reageert op kritiek’

MPs Van den Hil, Ellian and Simons asked the state secretary about a Nieuw Israëlitisch Weekblad article on Claims Conference criticism, concerning declining Holocaust knowledge and support for the annual Nationale Kinderherdenking in Madurodam. The state secretary agreed the trends are worrying, said he is in talks with organisations including the Kinderherdenking and is funding a pilot, but ruled out structural subsidy for the Kinderherdenking for now.
However, I have indicated that structural subsidisation of the Nationale Kinderherdenking by the Ministry of VWS is not on the table for now.
Wel heb ik aangeven dat structurele subsidiering van de Nationale Kinderherdenking vanuit het Ministerie van VWS voor nu niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian en Chris Simons over de vertraging bij de realisatie van het Justitieel Complex Vlissingen

MPs Ellian and Chris Simons asked why the Justitieel Complex Vlissingen (EBI) is delayed to around eight years, whether Zeeland faces abandonment, how to provide high-security cells sooner, and whether tendering can be accelerated. Minister Weerwind answered that the delay is regrettable but the project is not cancelled, that an EBI-plus or mini-EBI is only being studied, and that EU tender rules and a switch to partly secret tendering cause the extra time.
The arrival of the JCV is absolutely not up for discussion.
De komst van het JCV staat absoluut niet ter discussie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel ‘Inspectie controleerde twaalf jaar niet op zwaar werk Schiphol’

MPs Chris Simons and Koerhuis asked why the Labour Inspectorate conducted no Arbo Act checks on baggage handling at Schiphol after 2010, despite reported occupational illness, and how this fits risk-based supervision. The minister said she was surprised and shocked, that the inspectorate chose not to inspect for lack of triggers, has started an investigation, and will report back on inspections at Schiphol.
I have asked the Labour Inspectorate to examine whether improvements are possible.
Ik heb de Arbeidsinspectie gevraagd te bezien of er verbeteringen mogelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Haverkort en Chris Simons over het bericht 'Tientallen Deventenaren trekken witte pakken aan om asbest te verwijderen: 'Dat sjouwen wordt nog zwaar''

MPs Haverkort and Chris Simons asked about a Deventer initiative in which residents helped remove asbestos, the scale of remaining asbestos on private, business and government roofs and buildings, the cost of government asbestos removal, and why a foam-based removal method had not been approved by the VIP. The State Secretary answered that such initiatives exist via Milieu Centraal's asbestos-free shed week, that complete inventories of asbestos in government buildings are not feasible or efficient, that cost data are unavailable, and that foam methods have been approved in several cases while applicants are encouraged to submit requests.
This is unfortunately not possible. Research to find this out would cost a lot of time and money due to the large number of clients
Dit is helaas niet mogelijk. Een onderzoek om dit te achterhalen zou veel tijd en geld kosten vanwege het grote aantal opdrachtgevers
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Chris Simons en Koerhuis over het artikel 'Mee op pad met de arbeidsinspectie: ‘Het deugt niet, maar jij wilt wel je pakketje morgen bezorgd hebben’'

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about a press report on harsh working conditions and possible exploitation in parcel delivery, and whether principal contractors such as PostNL bear responsibility for subcontractors. The minister answered that client liability for health and safety exists only in construction, that the SER is advising on redistributing responsibility, and that the Arbeidsinspectie targets the parcel sector through risk-based enforcement.
I see that, partly due to a changing labour market, this allocation of responsibility for prevention and for healthy and safe work does not always work (optimally).
Ik zie dat, mede door een veranderende arbeidsmarkt, deze verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling als het gaat om preventie en de zorg voor gezond en veilig werken, niet in alle gevallen (optimaal) werkt.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Werner c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 28 over regelen dat alle producties behalve sport als Nederlands cultureel audiovisueel product kunnen kwalificeren doch ten minste
Widens the streaming investment obligation to all Dutch productions except sport, while requiring at least half of the investment to go to documentaries and drama or feature films.
At least half of the amount to be invested is used for media content qualifying as Dutch cultural audiovisual product
Ten minste de helft van het te investeren bedrag wordt aangewend ten behoeve van media-aanbod dat kwalificeert als Nederlands cultureel audiovisueel product
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over het cancelen van het Regiment Van Heutsz tijdens de Nationale Indiëherdenking

An MP asked the government about the omission of the Regiment Van Heutsz banner at the 2023 National Indies Commemoration and the enhanced role of the Indonesian ambassador, raising concerns about consultation and the commemoration's direction. The state secretary answered that the independent foundation decides the format, that the banner rotation reflects diversity of military involvement, that the government will not take steps or enter specific talks, and that it supports the organisation.
The Foundation National Commemoration 15 August 1945 is independent and itself decides how the national commemoration on 15 August is shaped.
De stichting Nationale herdenking 15 augustus 1945 is onafhankelijk en bepaalt zelf hoe de nationale herdenking op 15 augustus wordt vormgegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over het vrijgeven van alle documentatie met betrekking tot de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

Two FvD MPs asked the Minister for all government documents mentioning broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland since August 2022, including NPO correspondence, and asked for them before any debate on withdrawing its recognition. The Secretary of State confirmed the documents exist and will be released in one batch only after a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition.

I will release the requested documentation regarding Ongehoord Nederland at the moment I have taken a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition of Ongehoord Nederland.

Ik zal de gevraagde documentatie met betrekking tot Ongehoord Nederland vrijgeven op het moment dat ik een definitief besluit op het verzoek van de NPO tot intrekking van de voorlopige erkenning van Ongehoord Nederland heb genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over het nieuwe NWO-programma voor onderzoeksfinanciering dat de etniciteit van academici beoordeelt

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an NWO research programme on equity in academia that targets researchers with a migration background and mentions ethnic quotas. The Minister answers that the programme aims to promote diversity and equal opportunity, that NWO and the researchers are responsible for its content, and that there are no government plans to introduce quotas.
It is not for me to interpret a research project subsidised by NWO.
Het is niet aan mij om een door NWO gesubsidieerd onderzoeksproject te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over de houding van Nederland wat betreft Europese strategische autonomie ten opzichte van de Verenigde Staten

Two FvD MPs asked the Foreign Minister to define 'strategic autonomy' and state Dutch and EU positions relative to the United States, including reactions to remarks by Rutte, Macron and Michel. The minister gave a substantive but largely policy-restating reply, defining open strategic autonomy as an EU concept, stressing continued NATO and US cooperation, and declining to interpret the remarks of other leaders.
The cabinet is not in a position to further interpret the statements made by the President of the European Council.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om deze door de voorzitter van de Europese Raad gedane uitspraken nader te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de bagatellisering van de Bersiap

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister about vandalism of a Leiden Indies monument and whether the government considers the Bersiap killings a genocide or ethnic cleansing. The Prime Minister said the vandalism is a local matter and declined to qualify the Bersiap violence as genocide, citing its specific legal meaning and the NIOD/NIMH/KITLV report's term 'extreem geweld'.
This is a matter for the local government. The local government has the information and powers that may be relevant here.
Dit is een aangelegenheid van het lokaal bestuur. Het lokaal bestuur beschikt over de informatie en bevoegdheden die hierbij van belang kunnen zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over 'Nederlandse universiteiten die gevoelige militaire informatie delen met China'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Dutch universities share sensitive military knowledge with China's National University of Defense Technology, and what oversight exists. The minister acknowledged the risk, said universities may have shared dual-use technology and cannot be ruled out, and pointed to the national knowledge security guidelines, an external audit and a screening framework as measures.
I therefore cannot rule out that Dutch universities have shared military-relevant technology with the NUDT.
Ik kan dus niet uitsluiten dat Nederlandse universiteiten militair relevante technologie met de NUDT hebben gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de bagatellisering van de Bersiap

An MP asks the Prime Minister about his use of quotation marks around the term Bersiap, whether this minimises the violence, and related questions on the Indies research programme and the Rijksmuseum exhibition. The Prime Minister answers that the term is used in quotation marks out of respect for its place in collective memory, rejects any state supervision of press freedom, and says no link has been found between the research and attacks on the Indisch Monument.
Such a form of supervision is not compatible with freedom of the press (Article 7 of the Constitution).
Een dergelijke vorm van toezicht is niet verenigbaar met de vrijheid van drukpers (artikel 7 van de Grondwet).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Meijeren van Forum voor Democratie over oorlogsmisdaden door het Oekraïense leger

MPs Kerseboom and Van Meijeren asked the government whether it recognises alleged war crimes by Ukrainian soldiers against Russian prisoners of war, whether Dutch military support makes it complicit, and whether it will halt support. The ministers answered that the footage has been examined by organisations and that judging authenticity is for prosecutors and courts, that all parties must respect humanitarian law, and that Ukraine's self-defence is supported with no confirmed violations so far, so support will continue.
It is for the competent investigative and prosecuting authorities and ultimately the competent court to judge the authenticity of the footage and what it shows.
Het is aan de daartoe bevoegde opsporings- en vervolgingsinstanties en uiteindelijk aan de bevoegde rechter om een oordeel over te vellen over de echtheid van de beelden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de uitspraken van de premier van Canada over Canadese burgers die niet tegen COVID-19 gevaccineerd zijn

An MP asked the foreign minister whether he shares Canadian Prime Minister Trudeau's remarks calling unvaccinated people racist and misogynist, and whether he would raise them with Canada. The minister answered that these are Trudeau's statements, that the Dutch government does not comment on democratically elected politicians of partner countries, and that it will not contact Canadian authorities, while describing Canada's provincially run COVID-19 vaccination policy.

These statements are the responsibility of Prime Minister Trudeau. The Dutch government does not comment on statements by democratically elected politicians of (partner) countries on the internal political affairs of their country.

Deze uitspraken zijn voor rekening van premier Trudeau. De Nederlandse regering laat zich niet uit over uitspraken door democratisch gekozen politici van (partner)landen over de interne politieke aangelegenheden in hun land.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Zondo Commission findings on ANC cadre deployment in the judiciary and on state capture under Ramaphosa change Dutch policy opposing land expropriation without compensation in South Africa. The minister rejected the MP's conclusions, stated the interim report does not conclude the JSC or IEC are captured, said Dutch policy on expropriation without reasonable compensation remains unchanged, and committed to no new action.
I therefore see no reason to revise Dutch policy on land expropriation without compensation in South Africa.
Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding voor een herziening van het Nederlandse beleid inzake landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de vaccinatieplicht voor Oostenrijkers

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Austrian COVID-19 vaccine mandate, with fines up to 3,600 euro from 1 February 2022, amounts to coercion and whether the Netherlands would object. The minister answered that public health is a national competence, that Austria must justify its measures under EU values and proportionality, and declined to judge or to summon the Austrian ambassador.
It is up to Austria to determine which measures are necessary in the interest of public health.
Het is aan Oostenrijk om te bepalen welke maatregelen noodzakelijk zijn in het belang van de volksgezondheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de recente uitspraken van de Franse president, Emmanuel Macron, over Franse burgers die niet tegen COVID-19 gevaccineerd zijn

An MP asked the Foreign Minister to react to French President Macron's remarks that unvaccinated citizens are not real citizens and that he enjoys provoking them, and whether the EU's shared values are compatible with this. The minister answered that COVID measures are a national matter for France, that the remarks are a matter for the French parliament and courts, and that the Commission monitors rule-of-law issues through the annual cycle, without condemning Macron personally.
The cabinet trusts that any legal objections to the law can be raised within the French legal process.
Het kabinet vertrouwt er daarbij op dat eventuele juridische bezwaren tegen de wet in de Franse rechtsgang aan de orde kunnen worden gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de verwijdering van Marion Koopmans van het WHO SAGO-team

An MP asked the health minister whether Professor Marion Koopmans was removed from the WHO SAGO team due to Chinese Communist Party ties and whether her independence on the OMT is compromised. The minister answered that the WHO made a different composition choice without integrity concerns, denied CCP funding, saw no conflict of interest, and declined to remove her from the OMT.
I do not decide on the composition of the OMT, and there are no such ties as you mention.
Ik ga niet over de samenstelling van het OMT en er is geen sprake van de door u genoemde banden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Kerseboom over het niet informeren van de FVD-fractie over de aankoop van De Vaandeldrager

Two FvD MPs asked why the FVD faction alone was not informed in advance of the planned purchase of Rembrandt's De Vaandeldrager, and questioned the Rothschild family's role, the price and related dealings. The state secretary replied that the faction had the same information as others when the supplementary budget was submitted, that the decision to inform was a personal political judgement, and that the purchase is a commercial transaction with no commitments or conditions attached, while withholding some details such as family member names for privacy and the sale not being finalised.
I see no reason for that at this time.
Ik zie daarvoor nu geen aanleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over landonteigening zonder compensatie in Zuid-Afrika

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister about South African land expropriation without compensation, the ANC's shift to amending the Expropriation Act after the constitutional change failed, and the risks to Dutch property owners. The minister answered that land reform is a South African national matter, that the Netherlands opposes expropriation without reasonable compensation, that the issue has been raised repeatedly bilaterally and in the EU and OECD, and that Dutch options are limited given South Africa's democratic process and strong courts.
The government will continue to follow this issue and keep sharing the concerns in the Netherlands with South African counterparts for as long as necessary.
De regering zal dit onderwerp blijven volgen en de zorgen die er bestaan in Nederland blijven delen met de Zuid-Afrikaanse gesprekspartners zo lang dat nodig is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de tegenwerking en vertraging van de NPO ten opzichte van aspirant-omroep Ongehoord Nederland, waardoor zij niet per 1 januari 2022 kunnen uitzenden op radio en tv

An MP asked whether the minister recognises Ongehoord Nederland's right to broadcast from January 2022 and whether the NPO is obstructing it, and whether this constitutes censorship. The minister answered that the NPO must provide airtime but programme proposals are assessed against agreed targets, that the NPO is holding a special round to decide quickly, and that the minister cannot intervene in NPO internal processes, pointing to objection and appeal procedures.
I cannot intervene in the internal consultation and programming processes at the NPO.
Ik kan niet treden in de interne overleg- en programmeerprocessen bij de NPO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom aan over de inzet van gezichtsherkenningstechnologie

MP Kerseboom asked the Minister for Legal Protection how a company could use facial recognition at events under the GDPR without a qualifying public interest, whether citizens are sufficiently aware to consent, and how non-consenting bystanders are protected. The Minister answered that consent is the basis relied on, that it must be freely and informed given and is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority or courts to assess, that data minimisation applies, and that measures must prevent processing data of those who did not consent.

Ultimately, it is for the Dutch Data Protection Authority (AP) to determine in the specific case, taking into account the EDPB guidelines 05/2020 on consent, whether this consent was actually given freely.

Uiteindelijk is het aan de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens (AP) om in het specifieke geval – met in acht name van de richtsnoeren 05/2020 inzake toestemming van de European Data Protection Board (EDPB) – te bepalen of deze toestemming daadwerkelijk vrijelijk is gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de Nederlandse houding t.o.v. China

An MP asked the government about the Dutch stance towards China, including COVID-19 origins, lockdown models, Chinese social credit systems, Huawei and 5G security, and Chinese espionage and space ambitions. The ministers answered that no evidence of a lab origin was found by the WHO, that Dutch research on the origin should be internationally coordinated, and that the Netherlands is pursuing an integrated approach to state threats, though many answers referenced existing policy without new commitments.
The cabinet does not make public statements about the knowledge level of the Dutch intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de Nederlandse inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de aankoop van het ANP om politiek-activistische redenen en de gevolgen daarvan voor de onafhankelijke nieuwsgaring

An MP asked the minister about the takeover of the news agency ANP by Chris Oomen for political reasons, its effects on the independence and objectivity of news supplied to the NOS, the NOS's sourcing and contract criteria, and whether the NOS would end cooperation. The minister replied that editorial independence safeguards remain in place, that the NOS and ANP are responsible for their own journalistic choices, and that the contract costs are confidential.
The costs and the duration of the NOS contract with the ANP are confidential business information.
De kosten alsmede de looptijd van het contract van de NOS met het ANP zijn bedrijfsvertrouwelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de situatie in Zuid-Afrika

MP Kerseboom asked the Foreign Minister about the July 2021 unrest in South Africa, including state capture, the causes of the violence, attacks on infrastructure, food security, and the safety of minorities. Minister Kaag answered at length, describing the ongoing Zondo commission and prosecutions, the restoration of order with army deployment, and that minority protection is South Africa's own responsibility, without addressing any Dutch oversight of executive power.
South Africa is a constitutional state with independent judicial bodies.
Zuid-Afrika is een rechtsstaat met onafhankelijke rechterlijke instanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerseboom over de vervolging van de Syrisch-Orthodoxe monnik Aho in Turkije

Member Kerseboom asked the Foreign Minister about the prosecution of a Syriac Orthodox monk in Turkey and what the government would do to improve the position of Christians in Turkey and the Middle East. The minister confirmed awareness of the case, said the embassy is monitoring it and that Netherlands raises rule of law generally, and referred to EU reporting and existing human rights and religious freedom projects, without committing to a specific intervention.
The Dutch embassy, like several other like-minded countries, follows developments in this case closely.
De Nederlandse ambassade volgt net als enkele andere gelijkgestemde landen de ontwikkelingen in deze kwestie op de voet.

m: Motie van het lid Haverkamp over voortzetten van het pilotproject "verbeterd toezicht"
Asks the government to continue and roll out the 'improved supervision' pilot in Gouda's public transport safety and service oversight and report every half year.
calls on the government, in cooperation with the decentralised authorities, to continue this pilot and roll it out to all relevant regions
roept de regering, op om in samenwerking met de decentrale overheden, deze pilot voort te zetten en uit te rollen naar alle hiertoe relevante regio's

Nader gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkamp ter vervanging van nr. 28 over de mogelijkheid van de minister om een gemeente een aanwijzing te geven indien gemeentelijke vergunningen voor emplaceme

Gives the minister power to issue binding instructions to municipalities on environmental permits for rail emplacements that conflict with the Basisnet spoor risk limits, with prior consultation and notice to parliament.
Our Minister may, if required in the general interest, give the competent authority an instruction
Onze Minister kan, indien dat in het algemeen belang geboden is, aan het bevoegd gezag een aanwijzing geven
Motie van de leden Haverkamp en Paulus Jansen over het verlagen van het risico op ongevallen door bronbeleid
Asks the government, with carriers and shippers, to draw up rules to reduce accident risk in transporting dangerous goods through source-oriented policy.
requests the government, in consultation with carriers and shippers, to draw up rules to reduce accident risk in dangerous goods transport

verzoekt de regering, om in overleg met vervoerders en verladers regels op te stellen om door middel van bronbeleid het risico op ongevallen bij het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen zo veel mogelijk te verlagen
Motie van het lid Haverkamp over afspraken over wagenlijsten
Asks the government to agree with ProRail and carriers on submitting freight wagon lists about 24 hours before departure so risk ceilings can be managed in advance.
to make clear agreements to reach an arrangement on the timing of submitting wagon lists
heldere afspraken te maken om tot een regeling te komen over het tijdstip van aanleveren van wagenlijsten
Motie van het lid Haverkamp over een maximaal risicoplafond
Asks the government to draft new legislation setting a maximum risk ceiling for rail routes, so that safety gains do not automatically lead to more traffic.
requests the government to work on new legislation ensuring that a maximum risk ceiling is set
verzoekt de regering, te werken aan nieuwe wetgeving waarmee in ieder geval geborgd is dat er een maximaal risicoplafond wordt vastgesteld
Motie van het lid Dikkers c.s. over het belonen van vervoerders die extra veiligheidsmaatregelen nemen
Asks the government to develop measures rewarding individual transport operators that take extra safety measures in the basic rail network and send proposals to the House within six months.
requests the government to develop measures for the basic network whereby carriers taking extra safety measures are rewarded
verzoekt de regering, om voor het basisnet maatregelen uit te werken waarbij vervoerders die extra veiligheidsmaatregelen nemen, beloond worden
Motie van het lid Haverkamp over het ontzien van dichtbevolkte gebieden
Motion asks government to take measures to spare densely populated areas from rail transport of dangerous goods.
requests the government to take measures to spare densely populated areas as much as possible in the rail transport of dangerous substances
verzoekt de regering, maatregelen te nemen om bij het vervoer van gevaarlijke stoffen via het spoor dichtbevolkte gebieden zo veel mogelijk te ontzien
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkamp ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verwijderen van het begrip 'groepsrisico'uit het wetsvoorstel
Removes the concept of group risk from the hazardous substances transport law, leaving individual risk as the main safety standard.
the definition of group risk is deleted from article 11
Amendement van het lid Haverkamp over een horizonbepaling voor deze wet
Adds a sunset clause so the Wet basisnet provisions lapse on 1 January 2020 and prior rules revive, making the law temporary.
that the provisions of this act lapse on 1 January 2020.
dat het bepaalde in deze wet per 1 januari 2020 vervalt

Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Haverkamp ter vervanging van nr. 22 over de mogelijkheid van de minister om een gemeente een aanwijzing te geven indien gemeentelijke vergunningen voor emplacementen n
Gives the minister power to instruct a municipality on permits for rail yards that conflict with the Basisnet rail risk ceilings, with prior consultation and notice to the Staten-Generaal.
this amendment provides that the minister is given the possibility to give a municipality an instruction
wordt met dit amendement geregeld dat de minister de mogelijkheid krijgt om een gemeente een aanwijzing te geven
Amendement van het lid Haverkamp over de mogelijkheid van de minister om een gemeente een aanwijzing te geven indien gemeentelijke vergunningen voor emplacementen niet in overeenstemming zijn met het

Gives the minister power to issue binding directions to a municipality when its environmental permits for rail yards conflict with the Basisnet spoor risk ceilings, with notice to the States General and power to act in its place.
Our Minister may, if required in the general interest, give the competent authority a direction
Onze Minister kan, indien dat in het algemeen belang geboden is, aan het bevoegd gezag een aanwijzing geven
Amendement van het lid Haverkamp over het verwijderen van het begrip 'groepsrisico' uit het wetsvoorstel
Removes the concept of group risk from the dangerous goods transport law, relying on individual risk limits instead.
With this amendment the concept of 'group risk' is removed from the law.
Met dit amendement wordt het begrip «groepsrisico» uit de wet gehaald.
Motie Aptroot c.s. over wijziging van de tariefstelling
Asks the government to amend the maximum taxi tariff so that a time component guarantees minimum-wage cost coverage without raising consumer prices.
requests the government, to that end, to adjust the maximum taxi prices
verzoekt de regering, daartoe de maximumprijzen-taxi aan te passen
Motie Leegte en Haverkamp over verhoging van het bijmengpercentage
Asks the government to consult the sector on raising the biofuel blending percentage toward 10% in 2020 and to report to the Chamber by 1 September 2011.
requests the government to consult the sector to see whether a further increase of the blending percentage is possible
verzoekt de regering in overleg te treden met de sector om te kijken of het mogelijk is om over te gaan tot een verdere verhoging van het bijmengpercentage
Nader gewijzigd amendement van de leden Haverkamp en Leegte ter vervanging van nr. 12 over transparantie op bedrijfsniveau over de herkomst van biobrandstoffen
Amends the energy law to require the emissions authority to publish company-level information on the origin and sustainability of biofuels.
Transparency of the origin of biofuels contributes to citizens' trust
Transparantie van de herkomst van biobrandstoffen draagt bij aan het vertrouwen van burgers
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Haverkamp en Leegte ter vervanging van nr. 11 over transparantie op bedrijfsniveau over de herkomst van biobrandstoffen
Amends the bill so the emissions authority publishes twice yearly an overview of origin and sustainability of renewable fuels supplied by specified companies.
The emissions authority publishes an overview every year before 1 December and 1 June
De emissieautoriteit maakt ieder jaar voor 1 december en 1 juni een overzicht openbaar
Amendement van het lid Haverkamp over transparantie op bedrijfsniveau over de herkomst van biobrandstoffen
Proposes that the emissions authority publish a half-yearly company-level overview of the origin and sustainability of renewable fuels placed on the market.
The emissions authority publishes a half-yearly overview
De emissieautoriteit maakt halfjaarlijks een overzicht openbaar
Asks the government, with the oil and gas sector, to lead a sustainability process for the fossil-fuel chain, comparable to biomass standards.
requests the government, together with the oil and gas sector, to take the lead in making this chain sustainable too
verzoekt de regering samen met de olie- en gassector het voortouw te nemen om ook deze keten te verduurzamen
Motie-Haverkamp/Leegte over het aanboren van het duurzame potentieel in de samenleving
Motion asking the government to tap sustainable potential in society via an internet consultation and to report adequately to the Chamber on the process.
and to report adequately to the Chamber on this process.
en de Kamer over dit proces adequaat te rapporteren
Motie-Van Veldhoven c.s. over het opsporen van invoer van illegaal gekapt hout
Asks the government to push in EU channels for stronger joint customs checks on timber imports to detect illegally felled wood.
requests the government to work within the EU in 2011 for a greater joint effort in customs work to check timber imports
verzoekt de regering om zich in 2011 in EU-verband in te zetten voor een grotere gezamenlijke inspanning bij douanewerkzaamheden ter controle van de invoer van hout
Motie-Leegte/Haverkamp over verbreden van de doelstelling voor biobrandstoffen
Asks the government to broaden the biofuel blending target to sectors such as inland shipping and aviation and to inform the House on steps to raise the blending obligation.
requests the government to broaden the target as soon as possible to more sectors, such as inland shipping and aviation
verzoekt de regering zo spoedig mogelijk de doelstelling te verbreden naar meer sectoren, zoals de binnenvaart en de luchtvaart
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over niet steunen van de toetreding van Iran tot de IMO
Asks the government not to support Iran's accession to the IMO Council in the election of council members.
requests the government, as a member of the IMO assembly, not to support Iran's accession to the council in the election
verzoekt de regering als lid van de IMO-vergadering, bij de verkiezing van de raad toetreding van Iran hiertoe niet te steunen
Motie Peters en Haverkamp over mensenrechtenbeleid ten aanzien van Rusland, Algerije, Kazachstan en Saoedi-Arabië
Asks the government to formulate intensified human rights and CSR policy for Russia, Algeria, Kazakhstan and Saudi Arabia and to inform the House on its implementation.
requests the government to formulate an intensified and coherent human rights and CSR policy for each of those countries and to inform the House on its implementation
verzoekt de regering voor elk van die landen ook een geïntensiveerd en coherent mensenrechten- en mvo-beleid te formuleren en de Kamer over de uitvoering hiervan te informeren
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over verbetering van de dienstverlening van diplomatieke posten
Asks the government to explore ways to improve passport and consular services at diplomatic posts abroad and inform the House by April 2010.
requests the government to explore options for improving service in this area
verzoekt de regering de mogelijkheden te verkennen ter verbetering van de dienstverlening op dit gebied
Motie Van der Staaij c.s. over plaatsing van het Iraanse Revolutionaire Gardekorps op de lijst van terroristische organisaties
Asks the government to work toward the EU listing the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps as a terrorist organisation.
requests the government to promote that the European Union also place the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps on the European list of terrorist organisations
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat ook de Europese Unie het Iraanse Revolutionaire Gardekorps op de Europese lijst van terroristische organisaties plaatst
Motie Nicolaï c.s. over een selectiever en effectiever postennetwerk
Asks the government to propose a more selective and effective embassy network, including which posts to close, shrink, open or upgrade.
requests the government to come by 1 April 2010 with a proposal based on the Dutch interest for a more selective and effective embassy network
verzoekt de regering uiterlijk 1 april 2010 te komen met een voorstel uitgaande van het Nederlands belang voor een selectiever en effectiever postennetwerk
Motie Voordewind c.s. over monitoren van de behandeling van oppositieleden
Asks the government to monitor the treatment of opposition leaders in Iran and offer them shelter in the embassy if requested.
requests the government to monitor the treatment of opposition members
verzoekt de regering de behandeling van oppositieleden te monitoren
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over een eensgezind en krachtig protest van de EU tegen de Iraanse regering
Asks the government to press the EU and international community for united, strong protest and maximum pressure on Iran, including preparing further sanctions.
requests the government to ensure that the EU and through the EU the wider international community voices united and strong protest
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat de EU en via de EU ook de bredere internationale gemeenschap een eensgezind en krachtig protest laat horen
Asks the government to continue the regional process on Twente airport, present progress on two site plans to parliament, and reach a decision by 15 June.
and inform the House of it without delay
en de Kamer daarvan onverwijld in kennis te stellen
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over een officiële "Go America 2009"
Asks the government to organise an official 'Go America 2009' commemoration event in September 2009.
requests the government to organise an official 'Go America 2009' in line with other initiatives in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering in aansluiting op andere initiatieven in Nederland een officiele «Go America 2009» te organiseren
Motie Diks c.s. over een vrouwenparagraaf in de "stand van zaken"-brief
Asks the government to add a women's rights paragraph to country 'state of affairs' letters where relevant.
requests the government to add a women's paragraph to each country state-of-affairs letter where relevant
verzoekt de regering om, wanneer hier aanleiding toe is, in elke «stand van zaken»-brief over een land een vrouwenparagraaf toe te voegen
Motie Van Baalen c.s. over de erkenning van het lot van troostmeisjes door Japan
Motion asks the government to keep recognition of the comfort women issue in Japan relations and to press Japan for an additional gesture, raising it during visits.
requests the government, in line with the letter, to raise recognition of the comfort women and pressing Japan for an additional gesture with the Japanese government, including during future visits

verzoekt de regering overeenkomstig het gestelde in de bovengenoemde brief, de erkenning van het lot van de troostmeisjes en het aandringen op een aanvullend gebaar van Japan in de richting van hen, ook bij voorkomende bezoeken onder de aandacht van de Japanse regering te brengen
Motie Voordewind c.s. over maatregelen tegen Iran wanneer de maatregelen van de Veiligheidsraad te lang op zich laten wachten
Calls on the government to press for additional Iran sanctions in the Security Council and, if these are delayed too long, to pursue measures within the EU and with like-minded countries.
calls on the government, when additional Security Council measures take too long, to pursue measures within the EU and with like-minded countries
roept de regering op wanneer additionele VR-maatregelen al te lang op zich laten wachten, binnen de EU en met gelijkgezinde landen tot maatregelen te komen
Motie Haverkamp c.s. over een platform economische wederopbouw na conflict
Asks the government to set up a platform on economic reconstruction after conflict, with all relevant departments, NGOs and business represented.
requests the government to establish a platform for economic reconstruction after conflict, in which all relevant departments, NGOs and business are represented
verzoekt de regering een platform Economische Wederopbouw na conflict op te richten, waarin alle departementen ter zake, ngo's en het bedrijfsleven zijn vertegenwoordigd
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Haverkamp over het bericht “NMa geeft nog geen toestemming voor overdracht reisinformatie naar NS”

An MP asked the minister why the competition authority NMa had not finished its review of the transfer of travel information from ProRail to NS in time, and about effects on operations, the winter weather programme and a rail disruption at Schiphol. The minister answered that the NMa approved the transfer in October 2012 on conditions after NS and ProRail revised the proposal, that current operations continued unchanged meanwhile, and that the disruption was caused by a backup power failure and measures are being taken.
Now that the NMa has given the green light, the transfer can also be formally completed in the short term, observing the conditions the NMa attached to its decision.
Nu de NMa groen licht heeft gegeven, kan de overdracht op korte termijn ook formeel worden afgerond met inachtneming van de voorwaarden die de NMa aan haar besluit heeft gesteld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Haverkamp over station Naarden Bussum

An MP asked the minister about long level-crossing closure times at Naarden Bussum station, including whether ProRail's findings could be shared early, whether narrowing the crossing and separating traffic would help, and whether the minister would seek cost estimates for a pedestrian and cycle tunnel. The minister answered that ProRail's results are expected in spring 2013 and cannot be shared earlier, that narrowing and separation would improve safety and shorten closures, and that a planning study and talks with the municipalities are underway.
Given the way this research programme is carried out, it is not possible to make information about this specific level crossing available earlier.
Gezien de wijze waarop dit onderzoeksprogramma wordt uitgevoerd is het niet mogelijk informatie over deze specifieke overweg eerder ter beschikking te stellen.

An MP from the CDA asks the minister about state-owned Bredius land in Muiden, which a municipal council motion wants used for a local sports club, and whether the minister will advocate for part of it. The minister confirms the land is state-owned for the SAA road project, will not release it while the project is ongoing, and says talks with the municipality and the Finance Ministry are underway on a partial arrangement.
Rijkswaterstaat is currently in consultation with the municipality of Muiden and the Ministry of Finance to arrange rehousing of the Sport Combinatie Muiden.
Rijkswaterstaat is op dit moment wel in overleg met de gemeente Muiden en het ministerie van Financiën om een regeling te treffen voor het herhuisvesten van de Sport Combinatie Muiden.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Van der Werf over het rapport ‘Beter OV voor de stadsregio Amsterdam’

CDA MPs Haverkamp and Van der Werf asked the minister whether she knows the report 'Beter OV voor de stadsregio Amsterdam' and whether she will have its proposals tested for feasibility by ProRail and include them in the new main rail concession. The minister confirmed knowledge of the report, said she will consider its vision in the Long-Term Rail Agenda and that IenM will take the initiative for a feasibility analysis with ProRail, NS and the Amsterdam city region, but deferred concrete decisions and left the dienstregeling responsibility mainly with NS.
IenM will take the initiative for this analysis together with rail infrastructure manager ProRail, carrier NS and the Amsterdam city region.
IenM zal het initiatief nemen voor deze analyse samen met spoorbeheerder ProRail, vervoerder NS en de stadsregio Amsterdam.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp over de interpretatie van de wettelijke zorgplicht van provincies voor regionale omroepen

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about provinces cutting regional broadcasters' statutory funding despite the duty under the Mediawet 2008, the court rulings annulling some cuts, and why the Commissariaat voor de Media declined to enforce. The minister gave a province-by-province overview of disputed cuts, said enforcement is for the courts and, as a last resort, the Interior Minister, and stated the Commissariat lacks sanction powers.
It is then for the administrative court to determine whether a province complies with its statutory obligations.
Het is dan aan de bestuursrechter om vast te stellen of een provincie zijn wettelijke verplichtingen nakomt.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Çörüz over het bericht `Politie `laks' bij grote wietzaak Nederhorst'

Two CDA MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether police in Gooi en Vechtstreek give too little priority to cannabis grow operations, given the national drugs policy, and about one reported case in Nederhorst. The minister denied neglect, describing a regional cannabis covenant, specialised investigators, cooperation with neighbouring regions, and 63 raids in 2011 and 26 in 2012 so far, and said the main suspect has been arrested in another case.

No. The Gooi en Vechtstreek police force concluded a cannabis covenant in December 2011 with municipalities, the Public Prosecution Service, housing corporations, the Tax Authority, UWV, SVB and grid operators.
Nee. Het korps Gooi en Vechtstreek heeft in december 2011 een hennepconvenant afgesloten met gemeenten, Openbaar Ministerie, woningcorporaties, Belastingdienst, UWV, SVB en netbeheerders.
Antwoord vragen De Caluwé en Haverkamp over Vliegveld Valkenburg

MPs De Caluwé and Haverkamp asked about the redevelopment of former Valkenburg airfield, the early end of recreational flying there, and alternatives such as a glider airfield. The state secretary answered that accommodating general aviation is primarily a provincial and municipal responsibility, that the RVOB needs the site cleared for preparatory work in 2012, and that the province is still looking for an alternative location.
The accommodation of General Aviation (GA) is a shared responsibility of the national government and the province.
De accommodatie van General Aviation (GA) is een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid van het Rijk en de Provincie.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Aptroot over geluidsoverlast in Lansingerland

MPs Haverkamp (CDA) and Aptroot (VVD) asked the minister about noise nuisance in Lansingerland, including when V250 trains start on HSL-Zuid, the timing of reference measurements, speed reduction effects, and whether a covering is feasible. The minister answered that measurements are underway and may be delayed by weather, gave the expected dB(A) reductions from speed cuts, and said a covering is not being included in the pilot while additional measures will be assessed later.
For now I am focusing first on the reference measurements and carrying out the pilot.
Ik richt mij nu eerst op de referentiemetingen en het uitvoeren van de pilot.

Antwoord vragen Haverkamp, Van Hijum en Omtzigt over de inloopavond in Bathmen over plannen tot intensivering van het goederenvervoer per spoor, in het kader van het Programma Hoogfrequent Spoorvervoer (PHS)

CDA MPs asked the minister about reports that a January 2012 information evening in Bathmen on rail freight plans (PHS) descended into chaos, with ministry staff unable to answer residents' questions. The minister acknowledged the disorder, regretted that not all questions could be answered, and pointed to a follow-up evening, websites, written questions and the formal MER objection channel.
I regret that as a result not everyone's questions could be answered.
Ik betreur het dat daardoor niet ieders vragen beantwoord konden worden.
Antwoord vragen Smilde en Haverkamp over traumahelikopters

MPs Smilde and Haverkamp asked the health minister whether a study finding no proven added value of trauma helicopters over regular ambulance transport was valid and what criteria govern dispatch. The minister disagreed with the study's conclusion, explained the dispatch criteria, and said no obstacles are known to limiting helicopter response.
I think differently about that; in my view that conclusion cannot be drawn.
Daar denk ik anders over, die conclusie kan naar mijn idee niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen Haverkamp en Van Hijum over historische treinstellen

MPs Haverkamp and Van Hijum asked whether historic trains fitted with ATB could still run on ATB-NG lines after an exemption was reportedly withdrawn, and whether this harms heritage and wasted subsidy. The minister denied any exemption remains, said such trains may run on ATB-NG lines only where no alternative route exists and at up to 40 km/h, and saw no need for further measures.
No, there is no longer any such exemption.
Nee, er is geen sprake meer van een dergelijke ontheffing.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Haverkamp over het artikel  “KLM en Transavia in botsing met Schiphol”

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary about reports that Schiphol plans to raise all tariffs by 4% despite earlier pledges, the continued relevance of a 2011 McKinsey/BCG report, the transparency of the regulatory system, the Wet Luchtvaart evaluation timing, and Schiphol's expansion plans and financing. The state secretary answers that the tariff proposal is no longer on the table, the government will report the evaluation and cabinet position in early April, expansion plans are still in development with financing not yet fixed, and investments are mostly planned after 2014.
I will inform you within a few months about the results of the evaluation of the Aviation Act and the cabinet position on it.
Over de resultaten van de evaluatie van de Wet luchtvaart en het kabinetsstandpunt daarover zal ik u binnen enkele maanden informeren.

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «BNN-presentatoren plegen kannibalisme (ingezonden 23 december 2011).

An MP asked ministers whether BNN presenters who had flesh cut from their bodies and eaten on TV amounted to cannibalism, and whether the broadcast should be penalised or the presenters made to pay fines personally. The ministers answered that the broadcaster is responsible for its content, that no criminal offence was apparent, that the regulators lack competence over such content, and that they would examine whether fines should come from association funds rather than public money.
The Public Prosecution Service sees no reason in the broadcast to proceed with prosecution.
Het Openbaar Ministerie ziet in de uitzending geen aanleiding om tot vervolging over te gaan.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de beantwoording van eerder gestelde vragen (29 september 2011) over spoorellende in de Achterhoek (ingezonden 25 nove

MPs Haverkamp and Ormel (CDA) asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment to follow up earlier questions on train disruptions on the Arnhem–Winterswijk line, including punctuality trends, evening disruptions, passenger ratings, causes linked to rolling stock and infrastructure, passenger information during specific disruptions, and whether double tracking is a structural solution. The minister answered that punctuality has improved and cancellations declined, that an independent study commissioned by ProRail and Syntus is examining all causes including double tracking, and that passengers were informed under agreed procedures except for one announcement failure at Terborg.
The total number of disruptions has decreased considerably since summer 2010.
Het totaal aantal verstoringen is sinds de zomer van 2010 aanzienlijk verminderd.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over boetes en schadevergoedingen bij de publieke omroep (ingezonden 4 november 2011).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether broadcasters should pay fines and damages for unlawful programme conduct, citing TROS, BNN and a Supreme Court TNT ruling, and whether employees or producers should bear the costs. The Minister answers that liability lies with the broadcaster under the Mediawet, that recovery from employees or producers depends on civil law and contracts, and that the matter of individual guilt is for the courts.

It is not for me to judge whether the two BNN presenters and the programme makers of the VOC programme violated the law and, if so, whether that was done intentionally. That is a matter for the judge.

Het is niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de vraag of de twee BNN-presentatoren en de programmamakers van het programma VOC de wet hebben overtreden en zo ja, of dat opzettelijk is gebeurd. Dat is een zaak van de rechter.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over het bericht «oprichting RETBuzz gaat niet door (ingezonden 4 novemb

MPs Haverkamp and Monasch asked whether the planned RET-Qbuzz joint venture was blocked by the competition authority NMa and what the government can do given the tender deadline. The minister answers that the NMa issued no decision because the parties withdrew their notification, that the late filing was the parties' own responsibility, and that the tender timing is for the Stadsregio Rotterdam and the companies to decide.
The Stadsregio Rotterdam is responsible for further organising the tender procedure.
De Stadsregio Rotterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de verdere inrichting van de aanbestedingsprocedure.
Vragen van de leden Knops en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Infrastructuur en Milieu en van Defensie over Vliegbasis Volkel (ingezonden 5 juli 2011).

MPs Knops and Haverkamp asked why the Volkel air base airport decision was repeatedly postponed since 2002 and whether residents can be allowed new housing in the village in the meantime. The ministers explained the delays through successive changes (F-16 reductions, regional requests for optimisation) and offered a consultation with the municipality of Uden by year end on local housing options.
I will inform you further about the outcome of this.
Over de uitkomst hiervan zal ik u nader informeren.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de toegankelijkheid van het OV (ingezonden 19 oktober 2011).

An MP asked the minister whether wheelchair users, including those with electric wheelchairs, may be refused on buses, whether this is legally prohibited, how other operators handle it, and whether national policy is needed. The minister answered that no law forbids refusal, operators have discretion under their own guidelines, and new equal-treatment rules and an EU passenger-rights regulation will strengthen rights from 2012-2013.

When the public transport section of the Equal Treatment Act on grounds of disability or chronic illness enters into force (planned for 2012), the rights of people with disabilities will be strengthened.

Wanneer de paragraaf over openbaar vervoer in de Wet gelijke behandeling op grond van handicap of chronische ziekte in werking treedt (gepland in 2012) worden de rechten van mensen met een beperking versterkt.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ormel (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het artikel «Rampweek voor Syntus: alwéér seinstoring» (ingezonden 29 september 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about repeated signalling failures and poor performance on the Arnhem-Winterswijk rail line operated by Syntus and managed by ProRail, including who is responsible and what will be done. The minister answers that performance has improved markedly since June 2010, lists measures taken and planned, attributes remaining disruptions mainly to rolling stock and infrastructure, and assigns responsibility to ProRail for infrastructure and Syntus for rolling stock.
There has been a considerable improvement in performance since June 2010.
Er heeft een aanzienlijke verbetering van de prestaties plaatsgevonden sinds juni 2010.
Vragen van de Leden Haverkamp en Van der Werf (beiden CDA) aan de minister en staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over vervuild spoorballast (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Van der Werf asked whether ProRail discards about 500,000 tonnes of contaminated track ballast yearly and how it is processed, and whether it could be reused in higher-value ways, including through procurement criteria. The minister replied that much of the ballast is not seriously contaminated, that ProRail lacks an overview of processing routes, that reuse is preferred where possible, and that the government will study Dubocalc and related instruments.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.

Vragen van de leden Van Gent (GroenLinks), Haverkamp (CDA), Bashir (SP) en Verhoeven (D66) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de bediening van NS station Hoogeveen door intercitytreinen (ingezonden 22 juli

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, SP and D66 asked the minister whether NS plans to drop intercity stops at Hoogeveen from 2013, whether Zwolle-Assen would then be the longest stretch without an IC station, whether the concession should require IC stops there, and whether through-running stoptrains from Groningen as intercitys was studied. The minister replied that the timetable is NS's responsibility, the concession sets only minimum service levels (not train type or stops), she will not add IC-stop requirements, and through-running is possible but has disadvantages that NS judged unattractive, while noting ProRail's Zwolle station works.
I will therefore not interfere in NS's choice regarding Hoogeveen station or any other station.
Ik zal mij dus niet mengen in de keuze van NS ten aanzien van station Hoogeveen of welk ander station dan ook.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het rapport «Uitbreiding Lelystad Airport» (ingezonden 2 augustus 2011).

The MP asks the state secretary about a business-circle report on expanding Lelystad Airport, including air traffic control, accessibility, Schiphol's willingness to invest, and whether the region's interests are weighed equally. The state secretary answers that an action plan and a pending Alders advisory process govern next steps, that financial and legal instruments will only be considered after an irrevocable designation decision and the Alders advice, and that the government will set a position later.
Before financial and legal instruments can be discussed, it is important that there is 1) an irrevocable designation decision and 2) an Alders advice for the future has been adopted.

Voordat er gesproken kan worden over het inzetten van financiële en juridische instrumenten is het van belang dat er 1) een onherroepelijk aanwijzingsbesluit ligt en 2) een Aldersadvies voor de toekomst is vastgesteld.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de treinverbinding tussen Maastricht, Luik en Brussel (ingezonden 20 juli 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the minister of Infrastructure and Environment about NMBS's plan to end the direct Maastricht-Liège-Brussels train, its causes, possible action, and reactivating station Eijsden and cross-border links. The minister answered that NMBS is examining a Maastricht-Liège stopping service from December 2011, that the decision rests with the carriers, and that a bus replaces the Eijsden train, with further details promised soon.
The NMBS expects to be able to take a decision on this in the short term.
De NMBS verwacht op korte termijn hierover een besluit te kunnen nemen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over met het artikel «Luchtvaart woest om hulp bij claim» (ingezonden 11 augustus 2011).

An MP asks the state secretary whether passengers can claim flight compensation without commercial intermediaries, given a Consumentenbond partnership with EUclaim that takes a share of claims and steers consumers toward one paid service. The secretary answers that passengers can always claim directly with IVW, the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart or the civil court, that the Consumentenbond cannot decide claims, and that the partnership and its role as co-founder of the dispute commission need not conflict.
A passenger can after all take his complaint directly to the IVW, the Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart and the civil court himself.
Een passagier kan met zijn klacht immers zelf rechtstreeks terecht bij de IVW, de Geschillencommissie Luchtvaart en de civiele rechter.
Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over sportcomplexen (ingezonden 15 juli 2011).

MPs Koopmans and Haverkamp asked the state secretary why a Flora- and faunawet exemption for a sports complex in Nederhorst den Berg took so long, and what would speed up permitting. The secretary explained that the partial refusal protected bats and owls, that delays stemmed from an incomplete application and enforcement action against the municipality, and pointed to better guidance for applicants.
In addition, the procedure had to be suspended because of a violation of the Flora and Fauna Act by the applicant, so enforcement action was taken by the Dienst Regelingen (DR).
Daarnaast moest de procedure worden stilgezet vanwege een overtreding van de Flora- en faunawet door de aanvrager, waardoor er handhavend is opgetreden door Dienst Regelingen (DR).
Vragen van de leden Ormel en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het bericht «Saoedi-Arabië blokkeert Wereldomroep-websites» (ingezonden 15 augustus 2011).

MPs Ormel and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether Saudi Arabia blocked Wereldomroep websites and what Dutch policy is when foreign states block Dutch internet content. The minister confirmed awareness, said it could not be established who was responsible or why, that the site was accessible again on 15 August, and that Dutch diplomatic channels are used to raise such blocks.
On this matter, the embassy of Saudi Arabia in The Hague will be contacted for clarification.
Over deze kwestie zal ter navraag met de ambassade van Saudi-Arabië in Den Haag contact opgenomen worden.
Vragen van de leden Van der Werf en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister en de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de veiligheid van rangeerterreinen (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

MPs Van der Werf and Haverkamp (CDA) asked about safety at rail marshalling yards after an Inspectorate study found that dangerous goods on trains were often unidentified, and about violations by carriers and ProRail's role. The minister acknowledged the findings, said sanctions are being imposed and ProRail has adopted an improved information procedure, but declined to send a cabinet response and only promised to forward the report.
I will send the investigation report, including the actions already underway, to the House before 13 September.
Ik zal het onderzoeksrapport inclusief de al lopende acties voor 13 september aan de Kamer toesturen.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Bruins Slot (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over aandacht voor de Paralympische Spelen (ingezonden 11 augustus

CDA MPs asked whether public broadcasting gives enough attention to the Paralympic Games after a sailor criticised media coverage of disabled sport. The minister replied that the complaint targets Dutch media generally, that the NOS must cover the Paralympics under the 2008 Media Decree, and that NOS plans expanded daily coverage in London, so no measures are needed.
On the basis of the above, I do not consider it necessary to take measures.
Op grond van het bovenstaande acht ik het niet nodig maatregelen te nemen.
Vragen van lid Haverkamp aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de financiering van de Regionale Omroep (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

MP Haverkamp asks the education and culture minister whether provinces are obliged to keep funding regional broadcasters and whether recent provincial budget cuts in Utrecht and Noord-Holland are acceptable, and urges the minister to get provinces to suspend cuts. The minister confirms provinces committed to continuing funding with indexation, sees no changed circumstances justifying cuts, and points to the Commissariaat voor de Media's enforcement powers.
There are no changed circumstances on which provinces can base the view that they no longer need to fulfil the duty of care in this way.
Er zijn geen gewijzigde omstandigheden waarop provincies het standpunt kunnen baseren dat zij niet langer op deze wijze aan de zorgplicht hoeven te voldoen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over Radio 227 (ingezonden 11 juli 2011).

The MP asks whether the costs that Radio 227 faces for cable distribution (copyright fees to Buma/Stemra, Sena, the Commissariaat voor de Media and the Reclame Code Commissie) are fair, and whether the costs of the Commissariaat and the Reclame Code Commissie can be reduced. The minister answers that the Commissariaat's supervisory fees are based on households able to receive the programme and that a review of the fee scheme aimed at 2012 is under way, while the other fees are set by private bodies with little government involvement.
Currently OCW, together with the Commissariaat, is looking at a possible revision of the supervisory fee scheme.
Momenteel kijkt OCW, samen met het Commissariaat, naar een mogelijke herziening van de toezichtskostenregeling.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA), Slob (ChristenUnie) en Omtzigt (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de vertraging ombouw station Enschede (ingezonden 15 april 2011).

MPs Haverkamp, Slob and Omtzigt asked why the reconstruction of Enschede station was delayed and whether a parliamentary motion on cross-border through-connection had been taken into account. The minister answered that the delay stems from new timetable insights requiring 60 km/h switches, and that the motion is separate and will be decided after a study expected to report in October.
I expect to be able to inform the House of the outcomes and the decision to be taken in October.
Ik verwacht de Kamer over de uitkomsten en het te nemen besluit in oktober te kunnen berichten.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Woerden weer intercitystation» (ingezonden 31 mei 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Verburg asked whether Woerden is a major, centrally located station lacking intercity status and what criteria apply for intercity stops. The minister answered that Woerden already has intercity stops twice hourly, that NS decides stops independently under concession rules, and that other transport options are for local authorities.
If by 'intercity status' you mean that intercity trains stop at a station, then Woerden is a station with intercity status.
Als u met «intercitystatus» bedoelt dat op een station intercity’s stoppen, dan is Woerden dus een station met intercitystatus.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Monasch (PvdA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Duitse verbinding Betuwelijn vertraagd» (ingezonden 6 juni 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Monasch asked whether the minister had discussed with German minister Ramsauer the German schedule for the third track at Emmerich, and about German budgets and the need for the line in Rotterdam. The minister replied that talks were held and a visit is planned, that the third track has high priority in Germany, that the start of construction is delayed, and that existing track capacity should suffice until about 2015.
I am asking ProRail and Keyrail, together with DBnetz, to raise the utilisation rate and look for logistical options to use the existing two tracks more intensively.
