Ik vraag ProRail en Keyrail om samen met DBnetz die benuttingsgraad te gaan verhogen en naar logistieke mogelijkheden te zoeken om de bestaande twee sporen intensiever te gebruiken.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de voorgenomen bezuinigingen door de provincies op de regionale omroep (ingezonden 26 mei 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science why several provinces are cutting funding for regional broadcasters despite their statutory obligations under the Mediawet and the Commissariaat voor de Media's warning, and whether the Minister will act to stop cuts before 1 January. The Minister answers that provinces must respect the minimum statutory activity level, that enforcement lies with the Commissariaat and could be escalated to the Interior Minister, and that the government's position is unchanged, but declines to take a new concrete step against the provinces.
In any case, any cuts by provinces may not result in funding for regional broadcasting falling below the level of activities laid down in the Mediawet 2008.

In ieder geval mogen eventuele bezuinigingen door provincies niet tot gevolg hebben dat de bekostiging van de regionale omroep leidt tot een daling van het niveau van activiteiten, zoals vastgelegd in de Mediawet 2008.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Chinese bezwaren tegen het EU «Emissions Trading Scheme» (ETS) (ingezonden 24 mei 2011).

An MP asked the minister about Chinese government opposition to including Chinese airlines in the EU ETS, possible Chinese retaliatory sanctions, and the government's strategy for global emissions trading and the sector. The state secretary confirmed the Chinese objections and that retaliation is threatened, stated the ETS is lawful under international law, and committed to consulting other member states and the Commission and to informing parliament about sectoral developments.
Within the possibilities I have, I will consult closely with other EU member states and the European Commission on how China is to be met.
Binnen de mogelijkheden die ik hiertoe heb zal ik samen met ander EU-lidstaten en de Europese Commissie nauw overleg voeren over de wijze waarop China tegemoet wordt getreden.
Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Koopmans (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Vrije meningsuiting beknot» (ingezonden 29 april 2011).

MPs Haverkamp and Koopmans asked the Interior Minister whether Wijdemeren's move to commercially tender outdoor advertising boards threatens free expression, since local associations may lose free posting space. The minister confirmed the change, said eight free digital and poster boards remain for non-commercial notices, and declined to consult the VNG or take further action.
In the case of the municipality of Wijdemeren, as indicated, space remains for posting non-commercial messages through the installation of the eight digital information boards.
In het geval van de gemeente Wijdemeren blijft er, zoals aangegeven, ruimte voor het plaatsen van niet-commerciële berichten met het installeren van de acht digitale informatieborden.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de versnelde aanleg van liften op station Gorinchem (ingezonden 12 april 2011).

An MP asked the minister about station Gorinchem becoming inaccessible to disabled travellers during the Merwede-Lingelijn works, whether ProRail is legally obliged to keep platforms accessible, and when the lift will open. The minister admitted the oversight, stated ProRail has no such legal duty yet, described a taxi/train compensation scheme, and expected the lift in 2013.
Due to the closure of the service path at Gorinchem station, platform 2 is no longer accessible to people with a motor disability.
Door sluiting van het dienstoverpad op station Gorinchem is perron 2 van dit station niet meer bereikbaar voor mensen met een motorische functiebeperking.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het artikel «Grote broer komt de media redden» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

MP Haverkamp (CDA) asked the Education, Culture and Science minister whether the competition authority NMa will review the takeover of minority stakes in SBS and RTL Nederland, whether the review will look broader than competition effects, whether a level playing field for producers remains, and whether a separate investigation by the Commissariaat voor de Media is planned. The minister replied that the NMa is assessing whether a permit is needed under a competition test, explained the merger control framework, and said the Commissariaat no longer has an official role but may comment in its monitoring report.
Due to the lapse of the Temporary Media Concentrations Act, the Commissariaat no longer has an official role in reviewing proposed media concentrations.
Door het vervallen van de Tijdelijke Wet Mediaconcentraties heeft het Commissariaat geen officiële rol meer bij het toetsen van voorgenomen mediaconcentraties.

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de ministers van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie over de toegang tot de digitale doorgifte van de publieke omroepen (ingezonden 20 a

An MP asks whether the Commissariaat voor de Media ruling on SchagenFM versus Ziggo, and the 50% digital-subscriber rule, mean local public broadcasters are still denied adequate access to dominant cable distribution, and questions the fees charged and local funding. The minister answers that the rule applies, that the dispute concerns signal delivery costs, that the government will ask NLKabel and OLON to explore cheaper alternatives, and commits to annual reporting on access, while declining to link the case to a June letter.
I will ask NLKabel and OLON to jointly explore whether cheaper workable alternatives are possible.
Ik zal NLKabel en OLON vragen om samen te onderzoeken of er goedkopere werkbare alternatieven mogelijk zijn.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp (CDA) en Slob (ChristenUnie) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Euroterminal Coevorden (1712) en de spoorcapaciteit Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen (1713) (ingezonden 1 april 2011).

The MPs ask about the rail capacity dilemma for freight transport to Euroterminal Coevorden, including whether a freight path is available on Zwolle–Coevorden–Emmen, the effect on passenger services, and the planned amendment to the capacity allocation AMvB. The minister acknowledges the tension, says a freight path is available from around 22:00, notes that concession conditions do not a priori block cooperation, and says the AMvB amendment will be split, with the second part sent to parliament after summer 2011.
The second part will be submitted to your House for prior review after the summer of 2011.
Dit tweede deel zal na de zomer van 2011 bij uw Kamer worden voorgehangen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de ondertiteling bij uitzending gemist (ingezonden 25 maart 2011).

Haverkamp (CDA) asked why subtitles are often missing on the public broadcaster's catch-up service Uitzending Gemist, how many live-subtitled programmes lack them, what initiatives exist and what percentage is subtitled. The minister answers that about 80% of Nederland 1 and 2 catch-up content is subtitled, that live programmes are only corrected for the Journaal and De Wereld Draait Door due to capacity limits, and that 95% legal subtitling on teletext is met.
About 80% of Nederland 1 and 2 broadcasts available via Uitzending Gemist of the public broadcaster NPO carry written subtitles.
Van de uitzendingen van Nederland 1 en 2 die via «Uitzending Gemist» (UG) van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep (NPO) beschikbaar komen is ongeveer 80% voorzien van geschreven ondertitels.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Verburg (beiden CDA) aan de ministers van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie en van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de hoogspanningsverbinding Beverwijk–Bleiswijk (ingezonden 2 februa

MPs Haverkamp and Verburg asked why the Beverwijk–Bleiswijk 380 kV line decision was delayed, why the information evening for residents was postponed, and whether the process will be careful and inform parliament. The ministers said a new preliminary decision now covers both eastern and western corridors, that the information evening was postponed until the route choice is known, and that parliament will be informed of the outcome.
As before, we will inform the House of the outcomes of the process.
Zoals eerder ook het geval, zullen wij de Kamer informeren over de uitkomsten van het proces.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over grensoverschrijdend vervoer (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

An MP asks the minister about cross-border rail links in the Euregio, including Provincial States motions on station Eijsden, HSL connections, and business cases for Eindhoven-Venlo-Duisburg and Eindhoven-Heerlen-Aachen lines. The minister answers that regional matters lie with regional authorities, the Eijsden station reopening is not financially viable but the government stays open to new proposals, and cross-border coordination takes place with partner countries.
It is up to the regions to consider pooling their powers in a cross-border transport authority if they believe this would lead to a more efficient regional offer for travellers.

Het is aan de regio's om te overwegen om hun bevoegdheden te bundelen in een grensoverschrijdende vervoerautoriteit indien zij menen zo tot een efficiënter regionaal aanbod te kunnen komen voor de reiziger.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de drukke overwegen bij station Naarden-Bussum (ingezonden 1 maart 2011).

An MP asked the minister about long, frequent level-crossing closures at Naarden-Bussum station and whether removing unused tracks or moving signals could shorten them, and whether this would be studied before summer 2011. The minister agreed to study track reduction and signal optimisation as short-term measures, but declined to send the national study to parliament before summer 2011, citing its expected completion in 2012.
No. The results of the measurement and research programme on shortening level-crossing closure times on the PHS and OV SAAL corridors are expected to be ready during 2012.
Nee. De resultaten van het meet- en onderzoeksprogramma naar verkorting van dichtligtijden van overwegen op de PHS en OV SAAL corridors zijn naar verwachting in de loop van 2012 gereed.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) Neppérus en Van der Burg (beiden VVD) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over informatie over Nederlandse charitatieve instellingen (ingezonden 14 december 2010).

MPs asked the state secretary of Finance about public disclosure of Dutch charitable institutions (ANBIs) compared with the UK Charity Commission, including why only name and town are published and whether the English model should inform the new Geefwet. The state secretary said only name and seat are published by design, that ANBIs face the same disclosure duties as other foundations, and that he is willing to discuss broader data and transparency of ANBI assessments with the sector and ministries.
I am willing to reconsider, in consultation with the umbrella organisations, whether extending the published data with other information is possible.
Ik ben bereid om in overleg met de koepelorganisaties opnieuw te bezien of uitbreiding met andere gegevens mogelijk is.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over spoorwegincidenten in de gemeente De Bilt (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

An MP asked the minister about a near-accident at a level crossing in De Bilt, why the ATB-Vv safety system was not installed earlier, whether cameras operate 24 hours, and the crossing's closing times and incident history. The minister answered that ProRail has since installed ATB-Vv and improved signalling, that an investigation is ongoing under Inspection supervision, that a grade-separation study is underway, and provided the incident register.
The Inspectorate of Transport and Water Management is supervising this.
De Inspectie Verkeer en Waterstaat ziet hier op toe.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over Euroterminal Coevorden (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MP Haverkamp asked the minister whether he was aware that ProRail changed the timetable so that no freight trains could pass to and from Coevorden during daytime hours, and whether he had been consulted, whether he recognised the importance of modal shift, and whether he would convene talks with the parties before 1 May 2011. The minister answered that capacity allocation is the responsibility of ProRail and the carriers under EU and Dutch rules, supervised by the NMa Vervoerkamer, that he was not consulted and has no operational role, and that carriers may reapply for the 2012 timetable.
The process of capacity allocation is a matter for the carriers and ProRail.
Het proces van capaciteitsverdeling is een zaak van de vervoerders en ProRail.

Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu over de voorstellen van het Europees agentschap voor de veiligheid van de luchtvaart (EASA) tot verlening van vliegbrevetten aan vl

Haverkamp (CDA) asked the state secretary about the EASA flight crew licensing rules adopted in December 2010, including whether they weaken recognition of foreign pilot licences and ICAO standards. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands was involved via EASA consultation and comitology, that the rules keep ICAO recognition principles, and that a transitional period to 2014 allows an EU-US agreement to be concluded.
The number of countries that do not properly comply with the ICAO standards therefore cannot be given.
Het aantal landen dat de ICAO-standaarden niet goed naleeft, is dan ook niet te geven.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over de problemen bij NS en ProRail (ingezonden 29 december 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment about problems at NS and ProRail, including whether NS will keep the passenger concession after 2015, whether the board should be dismissed, and why the minister informed parliament late. The minister rejects the claim that NS is unassailable, says the 1 February analysis will be sent as planned, and states that the shareholder minister of Finance handles NS board employment.

I have told the House that if that is a good proposal, I find it logical to continue with NS and to announce a policy intention to award the new main rail passenger concession to NS again directly from 2015.

Ik heb aan uw Kamer aangegeven dat indien dat een goed voorstel is, ik het logisch vind om met NS verder te gaan en een beleidsvoornemen uit te doen om de nieuwe vervoerconcessie voor het hoofdrailnet per 2015 opnieuw onderhands aan NS te gunnen.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het effect van elektromagnetische straling van zendinstallaties (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

MP Haverkamp (CDA) asked the state secretary about reported research on effects of wireless internet radiation on plants and trees, and whether the underlying study would be made public. The secretary replied that the study was not available to the government, that it is up to the researcher or the commissioning municipality to publish it, and that preliminary results are unconfirmed.
It is up to the researcher or the commissioning party to make the study public.
Het is aan de onderzoeker of aan de opdrachtgever om het onderzoek openbaar te maken.
Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het stilleggen van het treinverkeer op de Heuvellandlijn (ingezonden 16 november 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the minister whether ProRail stopped train traffic on the Heuvellandlijn because trains were no longer detected by safety systems, whether the cause was ruled out as leaf fall or related to a recent signal failure, whether the province and passengers will be compensated, when the Chamber will be informed, and how the problem will be solved. The minister answered that detection problems caused by a greasy substance from crushed leaves were the cause, that neither leaf fall nor the signal failure was ruled out, that compensation will follow an evaluation by Veolia, the province and ProRail, that the reply was delayed for need of information, and listed maintenance measures taken.
I have tried to inform your Chamber as quickly as possible, but needed further information from ProRail and the province of Limburg for a careful answer.
Ik heb geprobeerd uw Kamer zo snel mogelijk te informeren, maar had voor een zorgvuldige beantwoording nog informatie nodig van ProRail en de provincie Limburg.

Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris voor Infrastructuur en Milieu en de minister van Volksgezondheid Welzijn en Sport over de milieuvergunning aan Thermphos (ingezonden 18 novem

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary about the environmental permit granted by the Zeeland province to Thermphos for dioxin emissions, and about the central government's oversight role and whether independent health research would be done. The state secretary replied that the province is primarily responsible, that the VROM-Inspectie exercises interbestuurlijk toezicht and will follow the agreements closely, and that no additional independent research is currently planned beyond the province's own health study.
For the time being I see no reason to conduct or commission additional research myself.
Vooralsnog zie ik geen reden om zelf aanvullend onderzoek te (laten) doen.
Vragen van de leden Koopmans en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Problemen Heuvellandlijn nog steeds niet opgelost» (ingezonden 29 november 2010).

MPs Koopmans and Haverkamp asked the minister about renewed disruptions on the Heuvellandlijn rail line, including whether the causes were foreseeable and whether ProRail took all possible measures. The minister answered that the November disruptions had a different cause (a signalling fault), that ProRail replaced components and took several preventive measures, and that the Inspectorate approved resuming service.
On the basis of these investigation results, ProRail has replaced a number of components in the signalling section of the signalling installation.
Op basis van deze onderzoeksresultaten heeft ProRail een aantal onderdelen in het signaleringsdeel van de seintechnische installatie vervangen.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over mogelijke betrokkenheid van de Zweedse oliemaatschappij Lundin bij mensenrechtenschendingen in Soedan (ingezonden 15 juni

MPs Haverkamp and Ferrier asked the Dutch foreign minister about alleged complicity of Lundin in war crimes in Sudan's Block 5A and whether Lundin, active in the Netherlands, should face consequences. The minister replied that Sweden, Austria and Malaysia must decide on further investigation, that Lundin is only a gas-licence co-holder in the Netherlands, and that Dutch consequences await the Swedish prosecutor's inquiry.
Pending the aforementioned investigation by the Swedish Public Prosecution Service, this is not an issue at this stage.
Hangende het eerdergenoemde onderzoek van het Zweedse Openbaar Ministerie is dit in dit stadium niet aan de orde.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het stopzetten van programma's van een christelijke niet-gouvernementele organisatie (ngo) in Afghanistan (ingezonden 8 ju

Two CDA MPs asked the foreign minister about the suspension of Church World Service programmes in Afghanistan over proselytizing allegations, and whether this reflects wider pressure on Christian organisations. The minister confirmed the temporary suspension by Afghan authorities pending an investigation, said the Netherlands will raise concern and will inform parliament of the outcome, and reported no known general trend of pressure.
Of course I will closely follow the progress of the investigation and inform the House of its outcome once it is made public.
Uiteraard zal ik het verloop van het onderzoek nauwlettend volgen en de Kamer na bekendmaking van de uitkomsten van het onderzoek hierover informeren.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Haverkamp (beiden CDA), Voordewind (ChristenUnie) en Van der Staaij (SGP) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de bomaanslagen in Mosul op bussen met christelijke studenten (ingezonden

MPs asked the foreign minister about bomb attacks on buses of Christian students in Mosul and how to increase international protection of minorities, including a round-table conference and UN action. The minister confirmed the attack, said protection of minorities is the Iraqi government's responsibility, pointed to existing EU/Dutch human rights and aid efforts, and reported that the UN mission discussed minority protection, without committing to a new conference or UN initiative.
Guaranteeing the safety and human rights of minorities is a matter for the Iraqi government.
De waarborging van de veiligheid en mensenrechten van minderheden is een zaak voor de Irakese regering.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp, Ferrier en Ten Hoopen (allen CDA) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Economische Zaken over de immer verslechterende situatie in de Indiase deelstaat Manipur (ingezonden 27 mei

CDA MPs asked the foreign and economic affairs ministers about the deteriorating situation in India's Manipur state, including religious tensions, Dutch economic interests, and the effect on civil society and NGOs. The foreign minister answered that Naga independence demands and an economic blockade cause the unrest, that no Dutch firms or investments are present, and that the Netherlands and EU will raise the matter with Indian authorities if needed.
The Netherlands and the EU are following this process and will, where necessary, raise the situation in contacts with the Indian authorities.
Nederland en de EU volgen dit proces en zullen zonodig de situatie aan de orde stellen in contacten met de Indiase autoriteiten.

Vragen van de leden Haverkamp en Omtzigt (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken en de staatsecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over blanco stemformulieren voor kiezers in het buitenland

MPs Haverkamp and Omtzigt asked about blank ballot papers sent to overseas voters due to a printing error and whether a third of registered voters had not yet received ballots in time. The state secretary explained replacement options, including embassy briefstembureaus, and said the mistake did not invalidate ballots missing a signature, while noting late-arriving ballots would be addressed by setting up embassy polling points.
Some voters received a blank ballot as a result of a production error by a supplier of the municipality of The Hague.
Een aantal kiezers heeft als gevolg van een productiefout van een leverancier van de gemeente Den Haag een blanco stembiljet ontvangen.
Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over betrokkenheid van vrouwen bij wederopbouw van Haïti (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the role of women in Haiti's post-earthquake reconstruction, including in the donor conference and the Post-Disaster Needs Assessment, should be strengthened in line with UN Resolution 1325. The minister agreed women should be actively involved, said Dutch partners are pressing for this through the UN and EU, and listed concrete steps such as gender-responsive budgeting and a UNDP/UNFPA panel.
Vragen van het lid Haverkamp (CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over de uitnodiging aan een Hamas-minister voor een conferentie in Duitsland (ingezonden 3 mei 2010).

Haverkamp (CDA) asked the foreign minister whether a Hamas health minister invited to a German academic conference could obtain an EU visa, and how Palestinian reconciliation and Egyptian mediation stood. Minister Verhagen answered that the official had not applied for a visa, that Netherlands policy on Hamas contacts follows the Quartet principles, and that Germany's role is limited to a Shalit-related request from Israel.
Inquiries show that the Hamas official concerned has not applied for a visa.
Navraag leert dat betrokken Hamas-functionaris geen visum heeft aangevraagd.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Haverkamp (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over het verlies aan geloofwaardigheid van het Kimberley proces inzake diamantenhandel in Zimbabwe (ingezonden 27 april 2010).

CDA MPs Ferrier and Haverkamp asked the foreign minister whether the Kimberley Process has lost credibility over Zimbabwean diamond trade, including whether Zimbabwe should be suspended if it shows no improvement by June 2010. The minister rejected the claim that the process is a sham, agreed that human rights abuses and military involvement are serious, noted an approved Zimbabwean action plan monitored by a KP observer, and said suspension is an ultimate measure to be decided by the EU at the KP meeting.
The Netherlands is represented within the KP by the EU.
Nederland wordt binnen het KP vertegenwoordigd door de EU.
